papers.title: Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities
papers.abstract_en: Dualities play an important role in establishing both microscopic and emergent phenomena in a wide range of physical systems. In practice, though, it can often be computationally challenging to establish when two systems are dual, even when all of the "rules of the game" are well-known. Said differently, when confronted with two systems, how can one efficiently establish that they are in fact dual? In this paper we use machine learning methods to address this question for Seiberg dualities of supersymmetric quiver gauge theories. Mathematically, this involves establishing mutations of quivers, which is in turn a variation on the theme of "learning to unknot". On the one hand, this leads us to a practical tool for establishing the computational complexity of different dualities. On the other hand, it also allows us to study how different network architectures learn how to trace Seiberg dualities. We find that for quivers with a modest number of quiver nodes (of order $10$), different network architectures consisting of transformers and multi-layer perceptrons tend to outperform deterministic algorithms. Supplementing the network by well-established pathfinder algorithms (essentially "Google Maps for quivers") leads to an additional improvement in the efficiency and accuracy of the search strategy. We anticipate that this class of questions can serve as a useful benchmark for frontier AI models applied to theoretical physics.
papers.comment: 59 pages + appendices, 38 figures. Code and tools available at https://github.com/alexmininno/GNN-Pathfinders
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用机器学习方法判断超对称 quiver 规范理论之间的 Seiberg 对偶，数学上等价于研究 quiver 的 mutation，并类比 "learning to unknot"。作者发现对节点数约 10 的 quiver，Transformer 和多层感知机（MLP）等网络架构通常优于确定性算法，而在网络中补充 pathfinder 算法（论文称为 "Google Maps for quivers"）可进一步提升搜索策略的效率与准确率。
Motivation: 实际中即使对偶规则完全已知，判定两个系统是否对偶仍然常常计算困难；本文试图用机器学习高效处理 Seiberg 对偶判定，并借此研究不同对偶的计算复杂度。
Method: 将 Seiberg 对偶问题转化为 quiver mutation 的判定，使用 Transformer 和多层感知机等多种网络架构进行学习，并用 pathfinder 算法作为辅助工具来改进搜索路径。
Result: 对于节点数约 10 的 quiver，不同网络架构（Transformer、MLP）的表现通常优于确定性算法；加入 pathfinder 算法后，搜索策略的效率和准确性进一步提高。
Conclusion: 作者认为这类问题可以作为前沿 AI 模型应用于理论物理领域的有用基准，并提供了相关代码和工具。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReToken: One Token to Improve Vision-Language Models for Visual Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Long visual context poses a challenge for vision-language models: performance degrades as the number of distractors grows, and processing all tokens at once is computationally infeasible under GPU memory constraints. We present ReToken, a single learnable embedding trained as an explicit retrieval target that selects a sparse set of query-relevant visual tokens from a pre-filled visual KV cache. Trained on only a small image-QA dataset, ReToken yields consistent gains across image and video benchmarks: on Visual Haystacks it improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points (>20% relative), and on LVBench it transfers zero-shot to long video for an 8.0-point gain with Qwen3VL-8B. Thanks to its lightweight design, both training and long-video inference fit on a single H100. Code is available at: https://github.com/avaxiao/ReToken
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReToken 针对长视觉上下文下视觉语言模型性能退化的问题，提出将一个可学习嵌入训练为显式检索目标，从预填充的视觉 KV cache 中稀疏选取与查询相关的视觉 token。仅用小规模图像问答数据训练，即在 Visual Haystacks 上使 Qwen3VL-8B 提升 13.4 点、InternVL3.5 提升 12.4 点，并在 LVBench 上零样本迁移至长视频任务。轻量设计使训练和长视频推理都能在单张 H100 上完成。
Motivation: 长视觉上下文对视觉语言模型构成挑战：干扰物 (distractor) 数量增加时性能持续下降，且一次性处理全部 token 在 GPU 显存限制下计算上不可行。
Method: 提出 ReToken，一个可学习的单 token 嵌入，被训练为显式检索目标，从预填充的视觉 KV cache 中选择一组稀疏的查询相关视觉 token；该方法只需在小型图像问答数据集上训练，并采用轻量设计以降低资源需求。
Result: 在 Visual Haystacks 基准上，ReToken 使 Qwen3VL-8B 提升 13.4 点、InternVL3.5 提升 12.4 点（相对提升超过 20%）；在 LVBench 上零样本迁移到长视频任务，Qwen3VL-8B 获得 8.0 点提升；训练与长视频推理均可在一张 H100 上完成。
Conclusion: 摘要认为单个轻量检索 token 即可有效改进视觉语言模型在长视觉上下文中的检索表现，并展现出从图像到长视频的零样本迁移能力，且训练数据需求较小。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
papers.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time. Existing datasets fragment this experience across viewpoints, modalities, or spatial scales, leaving the full perception-action loop only partially observed. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios. ACE operates at two complementary scales: a table-scale configuration resolves hand-object manipulation, while a room-scale configuration captures whole-body motion, locomotion, and interactions across a furnished home. ACE records egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, full-body and articulated hand motion, object geometry and 6-DoF trajectories, audio, and tactile signals as a unified multisensory stream. Using ACE, we build ACE-Data-0, comprising 150 hours and 17M video frames across 200 task categories, performed by 50 participants in 2 environments, for a total of 75,000 interaction episodes. The dataset spans atomic manipulation, long-horizon chains of household activities, and human-scene interaction, while preserving natural behavioral variation through goal-level rather than step-by-step instructions. We further introduce a hierarchical benchmark that progresses from signals to scene components and then to interactions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art methods expose substantial gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long temporal horizons. ACE-Data-0 provides synchronized human demonstrations with aligned perceptual, kinematic, and contact supervision, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, vision-language-action systems, and embodied AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出环境捕捉引擎 (Ambient Capture Engine, ACE)，一种以人为中心的数据引擎，将真实家庭环境改造为空间校准、时间同步的录制场地，在桌面尺度捕捉手-物操作、在房间尺度捕捉全身运动与场景交互。基于 ACE 构建的 ACE-Data-0 数据集包含 150 小时、1700 万帧视频、200 个任务类别、50 名参与者在 2 个环境中的 7.5 万个交互 episode，并同步记录第一/多视角视频、全身与手部运动、物体几何与 6-DoF 轨迹、音频与触觉信号。作者还引入从信号到场景组件再到交互的层次化基准，评测表明现有 SOTA 方法在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时间跨度下存在明显差距。
Motivation: 具身智能面临数据瓶颈：模型需要捕捉第一人称感知、全身运动、灵巧操作、物体状态、声音和触觉在人类追求目标过程中的协同演化，而现有数据集将这类经验按视角、模态或空间尺度割裂，导致感知-行动闭环只能被部分观测。
Method: ACE 以两种互补尺度工作：桌面尺度解析手-物操纵，房间尺度捕捉全身运动、移动及家具环境中的交互；统一记录第一人称与多视角外置视频、全身与关节手部运动、物体几何与 6-DoF 轨迹、音频和触觉信号。ACE-Data-0 采用目标级而非逐步指令以保留自然行为多样性，并构建了从信号到场景组件再到交互的层次化基准。
Result: ACE-Data-0 提供 150 小时、1700 万帧视频、200 个任务类别、50 名参与者、2 个环境、共 7.5 万个交互 episode，覆盖原子操作、长时程家务链与人物-场景交互。对 SOTA 方法的评估显示，在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时间跨度条件下存在显著性能差距。
Conclusion: ACE-Data-0 提供带有对齐的感知、运动学和接触监督的同步人类演示，作者称其为模仿学习、世界模型、视觉-语言-行动 (vision-language-action) 系统与具身 AI 的可扩展数据基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision and use it to explicitly reason about how the physical world evolves. Accordingly, PhiZero adopts a reason-then-render paradigm: it first infers future world evolution as a physical-language sequence and then renders the inferred transitions into videos. Extensive experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks validate the ability of PhiZero to model physically coherent world evolution. We further show its potential for realistic and interactive world modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhiZero，一个以“物理语言”（physical language）为核心的物理世界模型，其中物理语言是一种紧凑离散的世界状态转换表示。PhiZero 采用先推理后渲染（reason-then-render）范式：先从野外视频中自监督学习物理语言，再推理未来世界演化为物理语言序列，最后将该序列渲染为视频。实验在生成与理解基准上验证了其对物理一致世界演化的建模能力，并展示了交互式世界建模、细粒度动作条件模拟和零样本运动迁移的潜力。
Motivation: 现有物理世界模型通常直接在像素空间预测未来视频，世界动态被隐含在高维视觉预测器中，缺乏显式推理。作者受人类从视觉经验中抽象预测结构并用自然语言组织进行显式推理的能力启发，希望引入显式的离散物理语言来建模世界演化。
Method: 从野外视频中通过自监督学习得到物理语言这一紧凑离散表示，并采用 reason-then-render 范式：先推断未来世界演化对应的物理语言序列，再将推断出的状态转换渲染为视频。
Result: 在生成和理解基准上的大量实验表明 PhiZero 能建模物理一致的世界演化；进一步实验显示其在真实感和交互式世界建模、细粒度动作条件模拟以及零样本运动迁移方面具有潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，围绕物理语言构建世界模型能够显式推理物理世界演化，从而支持多种下游应用；摘要未讨论明确的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract_en: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAC-MAN，一个感知感知的 CBF-RL 框架，将控制障碍函数 (CBF) 安全约束与部署现实的机载感知相结合，用于人形机器人躲避球。策略仅通过头戴相机的分割掩码深度图像感知球，训练时用 CBF 引导表征每个身体连杆的间隙，并通过对抗运动先验正则化躲避反射。在受控的任意连杆接触基准上，策略接近特权状态预言机；零样本部署到 Unitree G1 真实机器人，成功躲避 95% 的投掷。
Motivation: 现有 CBF 安全控制方法通常假设理想的状态感知，而实际机器人只有机载传感器，导致安全屏障在部署中不可用。本文目标是使安全屏障训练与真实机载感知匹配，从而在整个人形机器人上实现基于视觉的全身安全行为。
Method: 提出感知感知的 CBF-RL 框架：训练时策略输入为头部相机得到的分割掩码深度图像，CBF 引导信号表示所有身体连杆的间隙，并用对抗运动先验正则化躲避反射。对比了 Joint-CBF 与 Link-CBF 两种屏障结构，以及固定相机、球跟踪云台和特权运行时滤波等感知配置。
Result: 在单次投掷和包含返回站位与恢复的部署循环两种基准下，策略表现接近特权状态预言机。Joint-CBF 在精确球状态时性能最佳，但在固定相机观测下仅作为训练引导时会退化；Link-CBF 策略零样本部署到 Unitree G1，在真实世界中承受不完美感知，成功躲避 95% 的投掷，并利用语义分割来躲避不同球。
Conclusion: 固定机载相机足以实现躲避，但可用的屏障结构强烈依赖感知可观测性；链路级 CBF 在设计上更能容忍真实世界中的不完美感知，适合作为部署策略。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 PAC-MAN，一个感知感知的 CBF-RL 框架，将控制障碍函数 (CBF) 安全约束与部署现实的机载感知相结合，用于人形机器人躲避球。策略仅通过头戴相机的分割掩码深度图像感知球，训练时用 CBF 引导表征每个身体连杆的间隙，并通过对抗运动先验正则化躲避反射。在受控的任意连杆接触基准上，策略接近特权状态预言机；零样本部署到 Unitree G1 真实机器人，成功躲避 95% 的投掷。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 CBF 安全控制方法通常假设理想的状态感知，而实际机器人只有机载传感器，导致安全屏障在部署中不可用。本文目标是使安全屏障训练与真实机载感知匹配，从而在整个人形机器人上实现基于视觉的全身安全行为。
summary_sections.method: 提出感知感知的 CBF-RL 框架：训练时策略输入为头部相机得到的分割掩码深度图像，CBF 引导信号表示所有身体连杆的间隙，并用对抗运动先验正则化躲避反射。对比了 Joint-CBF 与 Link-CBF 两种屏障结构，以及固定相机、球跟踪云台和特权运行时滤波等感知配置。
summary_sections.result: 在单次投掷和包含返回站位与恢复的部署循环两种基准下，策略表现接近特权状态预言机。Joint-CBF 在精确球状态时性能最佳，但在固定相机观测下仅作为训练引导时会退化；Link-CBF 策略零样本部署到 Unitree G1，在真实世界中承受不完美感知，成功躲避 95% 的投掷，并利用语义分割来躲避不同球。
summary_sections.conclusion: 固定机载相机足以实现躲避，但可用的屏障结构强烈依赖感知可观测性；链路级 CBF 在设计上更能容忍真实世界中的不完美感知，适合作为部署策略。

papers.title: AskChem: Claim-Centered Infrastructure for Chemistry Literature Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Chemistry literature synthesis often requires assembling specific findings scattered across many publications, yet existing literature-search systems primarily return ranked document lists. As a result, scientists and AI agents need to locate relevant information, verify their provenance, and assemble cross-paper answers manually. We present AskChem, a claim-centered infrastructure for cross-paper chemistry search. AskChem changes the unit of retrieval from the paper to the provenance-carrying claim: each paper is converted into atomic, typed claims, each grounded by a source DOI and a verbatim quote or an explicit evidence locator. Over this shared claim store, AskChem exposes complementary structures for search and synthesis: a stabilized faceted taxonomy for hierarchical retrieval and browsing, an evidence graph linking claims through relations, and an exploratory living taxonomy that situates indexed papers under scientific principles. AskChem currently indexes 2.4M claims from 147K papers and provides a web interface, as well as REST, SDK, and MCP access for AI agents. On AskChem-Bench, grounding a GPT-5.5 reader in AskChem yields 100% resolvable DOIs, compared with 88.3% without retrieval, and the highest citation density among five tested systems. AskChem is live at https://askchem.org.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AskChem 是一个面向化学文献的 claim 级检索基础设施，将检索单位从论文细化为带来源的原子 claim，每条 claim 由 DOI 与逐字引用或显式证据定位器支撑。系统索引了 147K 篇论文中的 2.4M 条 claim，并提供分面分类法、证据图和探索性活分类法三种互补的检索/综合结构，以及 Web、REST、SDK 和 MCP 接口。在 AskChem-Bench 上，将 GPT-5.5 reader 接入 AskChem 可获得 100% 可解析 DOI（无检索时为 88.3%），并在五个被测试系统中取得最高引用密度。
Motivation: 现有化学文献检索系统主要返回排序后的文档列表，科学家和 AI agent 仍需自行定位相关信息、验证来源并手工整合跨论文答案。作者提出以 claim 为单位组织文献，以支持跨论文的查找与综合。
Method: AskChem 将每篇论文转换为原子化、带类型的 claim，每条 claim 由源 DOI 和逐字引用或显式证据定位器支撑；在此基础上构建三种互补结构：稳定的分面分类法用于层级检索与浏览、连接 claim 关系的证据图，以及将论文置于科学原理之下的探索性活分类法。系统提供 Web 界面以及 REST、SDK 和 MCP 访问方式供 AI agent 使用。
Result: AskChem 目前索引 147K 篇论文中的 2.4M 条 claim。在 AskChem-Bench 上，接入 AskChem 的 GPT-5.5 reader 达到 100% 可解析 DOI（无检索时为 88.3%），并在五个被测试系统中取得最高引用密度。
Conclusion: 作者认为将检索单位从论文变为带来源的 claim，并配合多种互补结构，可以有效支撑跨论文的化学文献检索与综合；系统已上线并提供公开访问。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
papers.abstract_en: System prompts are instructions configured by developers to govern the behaviors of foundation models in AI applications. They are used throughout commercial AI products, but are rarely disclosed to the public or regulators, creating a serious trust and accountability gap in the wide deployment of AI systems. In this paper, we introduce Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), a user-centric framework for systematically auditing system prompts in AI systems. AISPA examines specific parts of a system prompt and evaluates them along eight dimensions that matter to users. We then use this framework to review 3,249 instructions from system prompts in 88 commercial AI products, classifying each instruction as either protective (of users) or problematic. Our audit surfaces four core findings. First, system prompt design varies substantially across products and developers, with some organizations averaging over 60 protective instructions per product while others average fewer than 5. Second, protective instructions are widely adopted but shallow in scope: 98.9% of products contain at least one, yet only 24% cover all eight dimensions of the AISPA taxonomy. Third, system prompts have grown steadily longer and more protective of users, suggesting that user protection is becoming a more visible concern in commercial prompt design. Fourth, despite this progress, problematic instructions remain pervasive: roughly 40% of products contain at least one instruction that works against user interests, and protective and problematic instructions frequently coexist within the same prompt. Our findings highlight the need for greater transparency, standardization, and independent oversight for system prompts in commercial AI products.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AISPA（Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance），一个以用户为中心的系统提示词审计框架，用于系统性地审查 AI 应用中的系统提示词。作者利用该框架对 88 个商业 AI 产品中的 3,249 条系统提示词指令进行分类，区分保护用户与有问题的指令，并报告了四项核心审计发现。
Motivation: 系统提示词广泛用于商业 AI 产品以控制基础模型行为，但很少向公众或监管机构披露，造成 AI 系统大规模部署中的信任与问责缺口。
Method: 提出 AISPA 框架，检查系统提示词的特定部分，并沿八个对用户重要的维度进行评估；随后用该框架对 88 个商业 AI 产品中的 3,249 条指令进行审计，将每条指令归类为保护性的或有问题的。
Result: 审计发现四点：不同产品间提示词设计差异巨大；98.9% 的产品至少包含一条保护性指令，但只有 24% 覆盖 AISPA 全部八个维度；系统提示词持续变长且更偏向保护用户；约 40% 的产品包含至少一条损害用户利益的指令，且保护性与有问题的指令常共存于同一提示词中。
Conclusion: 作者强调商业 AI 产品中的系统提示词需要更高的透明度、标准化和独立监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Visual generation increasingly requires high-resolution images, long videos, and multimodal context, making the quadratic cost of full attention prohibitive. We introduce Chimera, a hybrid visual diffusion backbone with a principled scaling recipe. Chimera processes text, image, and video tokens in one raster-ordered stream without positional embeddings. It combines Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) for long-context state tracking with O(N) complexity, interleaved Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for direct global interaction, and modality-aware short convolutions for local spatiotemporal context. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers expand capacity while controlling activated compute. To scale this heterogeneous architecture, we introduce HeteroP, a module-wise scheme that transfers hyperparameters across width and depth according to each tensor's functional fan-in and model depth. HeteroP yields a consistently tuned family used to fit Chinchilla-style compute-optimal laws for activated model size, training-token count, and image-video data ratio. Guided by these laws, we train an 11B-parameter Chimera with 2B activated parameters. Experiments show three results. First, measured by pretraining diffusion loss, the dense backbone is 1.7x as compute-efficient as a matched full-attention Wan-2.1 2B baseline, while the complete system reaches 7.3x. Second, without length-specific fine-tuning, Chimera extrapolates zero-shot from 5-second training clips to 30-second videos, with only 6.5% FID degradation in the last five seconds. Third, the fitted laws show that compute-optimal image pretraining divides compute nearly evenly between activated model size and training-token count, whereas video pretraining modestly favors model size at higher budgets. These results establish a foundation for designing and scaling efficient long-context diffusion architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chimera，一种混合视觉扩散骨干网络，将 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)（O(N) 复杂度长上下文状态跟踪）、交错的多头潜在注意力 (MLA)、模态感知短卷积以及稀疏 MoE 层组合在单一 raster 顺序 token 流中，并弃用位置编码。作者进一步提出 HeteroP 模块级超参数缩放方案，用于拟合 Chinchilla 风格的计算最优定律，并据此训练了一个 11B 参数、2B 激活参数的模型。实验显示该架构在预训练扩散损失上比匹配的全注意力 Wan-2.1 2B 基线更高效，并能零样本外推到更长视频。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像、长视频和多模态上下文使得全注意力的二次复杂度代价过高，需要更高效的视觉扩散骨干设计及其可扩展的缩放法则。
Method: 提出混合视觉扩散 Transformer Chimera：无位置编码的单一 raster 序 token 流，结合 KDA、交错 MLA 和短卷积，并用 MoE 层在控制激活计算的同时扩展容量；同时提出 HeteroP，一种按张量功能 fan-in 和模型深度跨宽度与深度迁移超参数的模块级缩放方案，据此拟合计算最优定律。
Result: 预训练扩散损失显示稠密骨干相比匹配的全注意力 Wan-2.1 2B 基线计算效率提升 1.7 倍，完整系统达到 7.3 倍；无需长度特定微调，模型可从 5 秒训练片段零样本外推到 30 秒视频，最后 5 秒 FID 仅退化 6.5%；拟合定律表明图像预训练中计算最优在激活模型大小与训练 token 数之间近乎均分，而视频预训练在高预算下略偏向模型大小。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果奠定了设计和缩放高效长上下文扩散架构的基础。

papers.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OSReward，一个用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为计算机使用智能体 (CUA) 轨迹判官可靠性的基准。基于多个人类验证指令和跨平台轨迹构建，并派生 OSReward-Hard 与 OSReward-Multi 子集。评估发现即便是最先进的 VLM 判官也存在系统性宽松偏差 (leniency bias)，将失败轨迹误判为成功；作者据此构建 OS-Shepherd-100K 语料并训练 OS-Shepherd (9B/35B) 奖励模型，以低于前沿模型 30-60% 的成本匹配商业判官性能。
Motivation: 验证 CUA 轨迹是否完成指令是评估、数据整理和强化学习的核心，但人工验证无法规模化扩展，学界愈发依赖 VLM 作为轨迹判官；然而这些 VLM 判官自身的可靠性长期未被系统检验。
Method: 构建 OSReward 基准，轨迹来自多种智能体主干 (agent backbones) 执行经人工验证的跨平台指令，并通过多阶段人工标注给出 ground-truth 判定；再推出聚焦困难样本的 OSReward-Hard 和细粒度效率/对齐评分的 OSReward-Multi；最后发布带推理标注的轨迹判定语料 OS-Shepherd-100K，并训练开源奖励模型 OS-Shepherd。
Result: 迄今为止最大规模的 VLM 判官评测显示，最先进模型仍达不到理想判官水平，普遍存在把失败轨迹标成成功的宽容偏差；少数可信模型推理成本过高，而廉价开源模型差距明显。OS-Shepherd 奖励模型在比前沿模型低 30-60% 成本下匹配商业判官表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要标准化的 CUA 轨迹判官评测，并表明低成本的可靠开放奖励模型可以弥合与商业模型的差距；作者还指出广泛分析可为规模化构建可靠 CUA 奖励提供设计指引。该工作为进行中研究 (work in progress)，代码、基准、数据集与模型权重均已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 OSReward 基准，轨迹来自多种智能体主干 (agent backbones) 执行经人工验证的跨平台指令，并通过多阶段人工标注给出 ground-truth 判定；再推出聚焦困难样本的 OSReward-Hard 和细粒度效率/对齐评分的 OSReward-Multi；最后发布带推理标注的轨迹判定语料 OS-Shepherd-100K，并训练开源奖励模型 OS-Shepherd。
summary_sections.result: 迄今为止最大规模的 VLM 判官评测显示，最先进模型仍达不到理想判官水平，普遍存在把失败轨迹标成成功的宽容偏差；少数可信模型推理成本过高，而廉价开源模型差距明显。OS-Shepherd 奖励模型在比前沿模型低 30-60% 成本下匹配商业判官表现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调需要标准化的 CUA 轨迹判官评测，并表明低成本的可靠开放奖励模型可以弥合与商业模型的差距；作者还指出广泛分析可为规模化构建可靠 CUA 奖励提供设计指引。该工作为进行中研究 (work in progress)，代码、基准、数据集与模型权重均已公开。

papers.title: KAISEN: Reproducible Subgroup Fairness Auditing for Clinical Risk Models
papers.abstract_en: Clinical risk models routinely achieve strong aggregate performance while producing materially different error rates across patient subgroups. Audit pipelines have been proposed to catch this, but their components are rarely stress-tested, so it is unclear which parts of an audit can be trusted and under what conditions. We present KAISEN, a five-phase audit pipeline covering subgroup stratification, disparity measurement, mechanism diagnostics, post-hoc mitigation, and drift monitoring, evaluated to the point of failure on a synthetic benchmark of 16 disease tasks, 15 social-determinant axes from Healthy People 2030, and three prespecified intersections. Four findings follow. (i) Significance tracks each axis's gap against its own minimum detectable effect: rank correlation between significance count and raw equalized-odds difference (EOD) across the 15 axes is rho = 0.56, rising to rho = 0.78 once EOD is standardized by that floor. (ii) Per-group threshold optimization reduces EOD in 48 of 48 held-out runs (paired delta = -0.285, 95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]), while group-wise Platt scaling -- the better calibrator -- behaves as a coin flip on EOD (19 of 48 runs improved, 95% CI [0.26, 0.55]) with mean effect near zero, so what an audit should report is the variance, not the average. (iii) The mechanism diagnostic classifies 144 of 144 controlled cases correctly but recovers none of 48 model-driven cases under proxy misspecification, with no signal that it failed. (iv) CUSUM failures and false alarms track cohort realization far more than disease: at the reference threshold, all 27 false alarms and 7 of 8 missed shifts come from different seeds (chi-squared p = 0.002), so a threshold tuned on one cohort fails to transfer. All results are synthetic with known ground truth and do not establish clinical validity. Code, artifacts, and scripts reproducing every number are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KAISEN，一个五阶段的可复现子群公平性审计流程，用于临床风险模型，覆盖亚组分层、差异度量、机制诊断、事后缓解和漂移监测。作者在包含 16 个疾病任务、15 个 Healthy People 2030 社会决定因素轴和 3 个预定交叉组的合成基准上测试该流程直到失效点，报告了显著性检验、阈值优化、校准方法和 CUSUM 漂移监测在已知 ground truth 下的可信度边界。
Motivation: 临床风险模型常出现总体指标良好但各患者亚组错误率差异大的情况；现有审计流程的组件很少被压力测试，因此不清楚审计的哪些部分在什么条件下可以信任。
Method: 提出五阶段审计流程 KAISEN，依次进行亚组分层 (subgroup stratification)、差异度量 (disparity measurement)、机制诊断 (mechanism diagnostics)、事后缓解 (post-hoc mitigation) 和漂移监测 (drift monitoring)，并在合成数据上对每个组件进行至失效点的评估。
Result: 摘要报告：显著性计数与原始 equalized-odds difference (EOD) 在 15 个轴上的秩相关为 rho=0.56，按最小可检测效应标准化后升至 0.78；每组建阈值优化在 48/48 次 held-out 运行中降低 EOD（配对 delta=-0.285，95% CI [-0.313, -0.252]），而组级 Platt scaling 对 EOD 近乎随机（19/48 次改进，95% CI [0.26, 0.55]）；机制诊断在 144/144 个受控案例中正确，但在代理误设定下对 48 个模型驱动案例全部失败且无失败信号；参考阈值下 27 个 CUSUM 假警报和 8 个漏报中的 7 个来自不同种子（chi-squared p=0.002）。
Conclusion: 所有结果均为合成数据上的基准测试且具有已知 ground truth，不建立临床有效性；作者强调审计应报告方差而非平均值，并发布可复现每个数字的代码、工件和脚本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm. In this work, we rethink agentic visual reasoning through two key dimensions of tool use: Mode Adaptiveness (MA) and Tool Effect (TE). Mode Adaptiveness characterizes whether an MLLM can recognize when tools are truly necessary and invoke them accordingly, thereby avoiding unnecessary computational overhead while improving performance on challenging problems that require tool assistance. Tool Effect characterizes the actual impact of tool use: tools should extend the model's capabilities on problems unsolvable through text-only reasoning, while avoiding additional errors on problems that the model can already solve without tools. We conduct a comprehensive analysis to quantify these two properties and empirically reveal that existing agentic visual reasoning models exhibit limited Mode Adaptiveness, while the gains produced by tool use on hard examples are largely offset by the harm introduced on easy examples that the models can already solve. Motivated by these observations, we propose Beacon, a novel agentic visual reasoning model that achieves stronger overall performance, improved Mode Adaptiveness, and genuine tool-induced performance gains. At the core of Beacon are the Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and the Hint-Guided Capability Expansion mechanism in the reinforcement learning stage, which respectively encourage adaptive tool invocation based on task necessity and strengthen the model's tool-use capability on the most challenging problems. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate the strong overall performance of Beacon and its substantial improvements in both Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体视觉推理 (agentic visual reasoning) 中工具使用的两个维度：模式自适应性 (Mode Adaptiveness, MA) 和工具效应 (Tool Effect, TE)。作者通过分析发现现有模型在 MA 上表现有限，且工具调用在困难样本上的收益被其在对模型本可解决的简单样本上引入的误差所抵消。据此提出 Beacon 模型，在强化学习阶段引入 Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward 和 Hint-Guided Capability Expansion 机制，在多个基准上取得更强的整体性能并显著改善 MA 与 TE。
Motivation: 现有智能体视觉推理模型往往无法判断何时真正需要工具，导致不必要的计算开销；同时工具调用可能在模型本可解决的简单问题上引入额外错误，使整体收益被抵消。作者希望量化工具调用的必要性和实际效果，并针对性地改进这两方面。
Method: 提出 Beacon，核心是在强化学习阶段加入 Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward，根据任务必要性鼓励自适应工具调用，以及 Hint-Guided Capability Expansion，在最困难问题上强化模型的工具使用能力。
Result: 摘要报告 Beacon 在多个基准上取得强整体性能，并在 Mode Adaptiveness 和 Tool Effect 两个维度上均获得显著改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，同时考虑工具是否必要以及工具是否带来真实增益，可以避免工具调用对易例的伤害并提升困难问题的成功率。

papers.title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
papers.abstract_en: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs task states through Patch Reversal, Code Mapping, or Agent Reconstruction, and validates the lifecycle from a healthy base to a task state and a restored state. By deriving multiple tasks grounded in developer evidence from maintained environments, Change2Task provides executable data for coding agent training and evaluation while reducing repeated environment setup, storage, and task construction effort. We evaluate the system through five common and widely adopted coding agent task families: Bug Fix, Feature Addition, Test Generation, Application Programming Interface Migration, and Security Repair. Starting from 1,130 source changes eligible for construction, Change2Task achieves 79.6% verified task construction success across these task families. On a matched candidate set, it recovers 29.2% more verified tasks than a construction baseline based on pull requests. Historical and reconstructed cases achieve up to 98.0% matched outcome agreement under agent evaluation, while reuse of modern bases reduces measured expenditure across the complete pipeline by 10.8%.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, and 15 tables, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Change2Task，一个基于仓库历史（repository history）的系统，将已合并的 pull request 转换为当前健康版本仓库上的可执行编码智能体任务与环境。它通过 Patch Reversal、Code Mapping 或 Agent Reconstruction 重建任务状态，并验证从健康基态到任务状态再到恢复状态的完整生命周期。在五类常见编码智能体任务（Bug Fix、Feature Addition、Test Generation、API Migration、Security Repair）上，从 1,130 个源变更中实现 79.6% 的验证任务构建成功率。
Motivation: 扩展编码智能体需要持续供给可执行数据用于训练、基准测试和持续评估，而每个任务需要将现实软件状态与规格、开发工具和可靠验证相结合。现有基于 pull request 的构建方式在任务数量和验证成功率上不足。
Method: Change2Task 将已合并的 pull request 与演化后的代码对齐，利用 Patch Reversal、Code Mapping 或 Agent Reconstruction 三种方式重建任务状态，并验证从健康基态到任务状态再到恢复状态的完整生命周期，从而生成基于开发者证据的多样化任务。
Result: 在 1,130 个符合条件的源变更中达到 79.6% 的验证任务构建成功率；在匹配候选集上比基于 pull request 的构建基线多恢复 29.2% 的验证任务；历史与重建案例在智能体评估下达到最高 98.0% 的匹配结果一致性；复用现代基态使整个流水线的测量开销降低 10.8%。
Conclusion: Change2Task 能够从维护良好的仓库环境中派生多个基于开发者证据的可执行任务，为编码智能体训练与评估提供数据，同时减少重复环境搭建、存储和任务构建成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VAD: Attributing Visual Evidence for Target Reconstruction in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers fine-grained visual knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with a privileged-view teacher. Yet its next-token corrections are source-mixed, combining visual signals with linguistic priors and teacher-specific effects. The key challenge is to estimate which corrections are supported by visual evidence, not merely where or how strongly to distill. We introduce Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD), a counterfactual target-reconstruction algorithm that estimates the visually attributable part of a teacher correction. At each student-generated prefix, VAD evaluates the same fixed teacher with the relevant evidence present and removed. The corresponding change in centered log-probabilities defines ut, a signed proxy for the visual evidence direction that estimates how revealing the evidence supports or refutes candidate tokens. VAD projects the original correction onto this proxy to obtain an intervention-aligned component and a proxy-unexplained residual, then reconstructs a student-anchored target from the former. During training, this reconstructed target supplies the primary supervision signal, while the privileged teacher contributes a weak regularizer. Across six fine-grained visual benchmarks at 4B and 9B scales, VAD outperforms direct privileged-view distillation and visual-advantage weighting. Token- level and controlled-target analyses show that the proxy-aligned component is enriched in task-relevant visual corrections and yields stronger target shifts, especially when evidence refutes a mistaken answer. These results support counterfactual target reconstruction as an effective alternative to source-mixed supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Visual Attribution Distillation (VAD)，用于多模态 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中估计教师修正被视觉证据支持的部分。VAD 在相同的固定教师上、证据存在与移除两种条件下评估，用中心化对数概率 (centered log-probabilities) 的变化定义视觉证据方向代理，再把原始修正投影到该代理上，用对齐分量重构学生锚定目标。在 6 个细粒度视觉基准、4B/9B 规模上，VAD 优于直接特权视图蒸馏和 visual-advantage weighting；token 级与受控目标分析显示代理对齐分量富含任务相关视觉修正并产生更强目标偏移。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 的 next-token 修正是 source-mixed 的，混合了视觉信号、语言先验和教师特有影响；关键困难不是在哪里或多大强度蒸馏，而是判断哪些修正确实由视觉证据支持。
Method: VAD 在每步学生生成前缀上，对同一教师分别在有/无相关视觉证据的条件下评估，把中心化对数概率的变化作为视觉证据方向的带符号代理 u_t；接着把原始修正投影到该代理上，得到 intervention-aligned 分量和 proxy-unexplained 残差，仅用前者重构学生锚定目标；训练时重构目标作为主要监督信号，特权教师只作弱正则项。
Result: 摘要报告在 4B 和 9B 规模、六个细粒度视觉基准上，VAD 优于直接特权视图蒸馏和 visual-advantage weighting；token 级与受控目标分析表明代理对齐分量富集任务相关视觉修正、产生更强目标偏移，尤其在视觉证据反驳错误答案时。
Conclusion: 作者认为反事实目标重构 (counterfactual target reconstruction) 是 source-mixed 监督的有效替代方案。摘要未说明该方法在视觉语言任务之外的泛化性或具体局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: VAD 在每步学生生成前缀上，对同一教师分别在有/无相关视觉证据的条件下评估，把中心化对数概率的变化作为视觉证据方向的带符号代理 u_t；接着把原始修正投影到该代理上，得到 intervention-aligned 分量和 proxy-unexplained 残差，仅用前者重构学生锚定目标；训练时重构目标作为主要监督信号，特权教师只作弱正则项。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 4B 和 9B 规模、六个细粒度视觉基准上，VAD 优于直接特权视图蒸馏和 visual-advantage weighting；token 级与受控目标分析表明代理对齐分量富集任务相关视觉修正、产生更强目标偏移，尤其在视觉证据反驳错误答案时。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为反事实目标重构 (counterfactual target reconstruction) 是 source-mixed 监督的有效替代方案。摘要未说明该方法在视觉语言任务之外的泛化性或具体局限。

papers.title: MixFrag: Fragility-Guided Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as an effective solution for deploying Vision Transformers (ViTs) on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTQ methods typically employ uniform bit-widths across transformer components, overlooking their heterogeneous sensitivity to quantization and leading to inefficient precision allocation. In this paper, we propose {MixFrag, a fragility-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework for Vision Transformers. MixFrag first estimates component-level quantization fragility by measuring the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between full-precision and isolated quantized output distributions using a small calibration set. It then formulates bit allocation as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP), enabling adaptive layer-wise precision assignment under a target bit budget. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K across multiple Vision Transformer architectures demonstrate that MixFrag achieves competitive classification performance under practical mixed-precision settings. Furthermore, evaluations on COCO object detection and instance segmentation show that MixFrag achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing mixed-precision PTQ methods, improving the previous best method by up to 9.6 AP under the challenging MP3/MP3 setting. Additional analyses validate the proposed fragility metric and demonstrate its strong correlation with the learned bit allocation. These results establish MixFrag as an effective framework for mixed-precision post-training quantization of Vision Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MixFrag，一个面向 Vision Transformer 的脆弱性引导混合精度后训练量化（PTQ）框架。它先用小规模校准集上全精度与隔离量化输出分布的 KL 散度估计组件级量化脆弱性，再将位宽分配建模为多重选择背包问题（MCKP），在目标位预算下自适应分配层间精度。ImageNet-1K 上的实验表明其达到有竞争力的分类性能，COCO 检测与实例分割任务上也取得现有混合精度 PTQ 方法中的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法通常对 Transformer 各组件使用统一位宽，忽略它们对量化的异构敏感性，导致精度分配低效。
Method: MixFrag 首先通过测量 KL 散度（Kullback-Leibler divergence）估计组件级量化脆弱性，然后将位分配形式化为 Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem (MCKP) 以在目标位预算下实现自适应的逐层精度分配。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上多个 Vision Transformer 架构下获得有竞争力的分类性能；在 COCO 目标检测与实例分割中，MixFrag 在 MP3/MP3 设置下相比先前最佳方法提升了最多 9.6 AP。
Conclusion: 额外分析验证了所提脆弱性度量与学习的位分配之间存在强相关性，表明 MixFrag 是用于 Vision Transformer 混合精度后训练量化的有效框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue by extracting issue references from the PR description; the issue description is used as the problem statement, and the PR patch serves as the test oracle. However, due to the inherent complexity of developing and maintaining large repositories, such PR-Issue pairings are often misaligned in practice. In this work, we systematically study SWE-bench Verified instances, finding that 13.6% exhibit misalignment across five patterns in eleven fine-grained scenarios. To enable reliable and scalable construction of those benchmarks in the future, we propose PAIChecker, a multi-agent system for checking PR-Issue misalignment in SWE-bench-like benchmarks. Specifically, PAIChecker adopts a three-phase design that combines specific pattern identification, cross-agent label synthesis, and code-level validation, thereby enabling more accurate, generalizable, and progressively verified detection. Experiments on SWE-Gym and SWE-bench Multilingual show that PAIchecker achieves the best performance across all four LLM backbones, reaching up to 92.12% and 91.67% binary accuracy, respectively.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SWE-bench 类基准中 PR-Issue 配对错位问题，系统研究 SWE-bench Verified 实例后发现 13.6% 的配对存在错位，涵盖五种模式、十一类细粒度场景。作者提出 PAIChecker，一个多智能体系统，采用特定模式识别、跨智能体标签合成与代码级验证的三阶段设计来检测此类错位。在 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，PAIChecker 在四种 LLM 后端上均取得最佳表现，二元准确率分别达到 92.12% 和 91.67%。
Motivation: SWE-bench 类基准通常从 PR 描述中提取 issue 引用来构建 PR-Issue 配对，并以 issue 描述作为问题陈述、PR 补丁作为测试预言，但大型仓库开发与维护的固有复杂性使这种配对在实际中经常错位，从而威胁基准的可靠性。
Method: 提出 PAIChecker 多智能体系统，采用三阶段设计：特定模式识别 (pattern identification)、跨智能体标签合成 (cross-agent label synthesis) 和代码级验证 (code-level validation)，以对 SWE-bench 类基准中的 PR-Issue 错位进行更准确、可泛化且逐步验证的检测。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 中发现 13.6% 的实例存在 PR-Issue 错位，并归纳为五种模式、十一类场景；在 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上的二元准确率分别达到 92.12% 和 91.67%，且在全部四种 LLM 后端上优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，PR-Issue 错位是现实存在的普遍现象，而 PAIChecker 的三阶段验证设计能够实现更准确、可泛化并逐步验证的检测，为未来可靠、可扩展的 SWE-bench 类基准构建提供支持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $β$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $β$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 在推理语言模型实践中脆弱、需要大量工程调参，并识别出其结构性根源：vanilla OPSD 正是 β=1 的 KL 惩罚政策优化特例。作者提出 β-OPSD，将 β 变为可控正则化参数，导出最优策略为参考策略与特权教师之间的几何插值；为避免直接 RL 优化的高方差，他们把闭式解转化为蒸馏目标，通过混合 token 级 logits 实现。实验在数学推理基准上表明 β-OPSD 一致优于 vanilla OPSD，提升优化稳定性与下游推理性能。
Motivation: OPSD 在实践中有希望但脆弱，可靠工作常需大量工程努力；作者定位到结构性原因是 KL 惩罚锚定参考策略的权重被隐式固定为 1，无法在贴近参考策略与利用教师指导之间灵活权衡。
Method: 引入 β-OPSD，将 β 作为可调正则参数并推导最优策略为参考策略与特权教师的几何插值；不直接优化高方差、昂贵的 RL 目标，而是利用其闭式解构造蒸馏目标，通过按 β 混合两者的 token 级 logits 实现，并借助 return-to-go 信用分配使 token 更新对齐序列级目标。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，β-OPSD 相比 vanilla OPSD 一致提升优化稳定性和下游推理性能；摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作提供了一条从自蒸馏到策略优化再回到自蒸馏的原则性路径，在不牺牲 OPSD 高效性的前提下改善其稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ROAD: Reciprocal-Objective Alignment of Discriminative Semantics for 3D Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity 3D generation predominantly relies on scaling model capacity and data, which incurs prohibitive computational costs. This paradigm typically requires learning geometry from scratch and overlooks the rich semantic and structural priors already encapsulated in discriminative 3D foundation models. We contend that leveraging the profound understanding of the 3D world possessed by these discriminative models can significantly reduce generative cost. To this end, we propose ROAD, a framework that reduces the training cost of 3D generation by transferring these rich discriminative priors into diffusion transformers. To address the inherent semantic-structural heterogeneity between generative and discriminative latents, we introduce a reciprocal-objective alignment strategy. This method synergizes Holistic Semantic Condensing to enforce global semantic coherence and Structural Optimal Alignment, which is formulated as a bipartite matching problem to rigorously align microscopic geometric details between disparate latent spaces. The 3D foundation model is only used for training-time supervision of alignment and is not used at inference, incurring no additional inference cost. Compared with the industrial baseline Step1X-3D, the proposed ROAD achieves highly competitive generation performance with only 1.5% of the training data and significantly reduces training costs, effectively reducing the computational overhead of high-fidelity 3D generation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/ROAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ROAD 框架，通过将判别式 3D 基础模型蕴含的语义与结构先验迁移至扩散 Transformer，降低高保真 3D 生成的训练成本。针对生成与判别潜在空间之间的语义-结构异质性，引入互惠目标对齐策略，包含整体语义压缩（Holistic Semantic Condensing）与结构最优对齐（Structural Optimal Alignment，形式化为二部匹配问题）。该 3D 基础模型仅用于训练阶段监督，推理时不使用，因此不增加推理开销。相比工业基线 Step1X-3D，ROAD 仅用 1.5% 的训练数据即达到极具竞争力的生成性能。
Motivation: 高保真 3D 生成高度依赖模型容量与数据规模的扩展，计算成本高昂，且通常需要从零学习几何结构，忽略了判别式 3D 基础模型已封装的丰富语义与结构先验。
Method: 提出 ROAD 框架，将判别式 3D 先验迁移进扩散 Transformer；设计互惠目标对齐策略，通过整体语义压缩保证全局语义一致性，并将结构最优对齐构建为二部匹配问题以严格对齐不同潜在空间中的微观几何细节。
Result: 与工业基线 Step1X-3D 相比，ROAD 仅使用 1.5% 的训练数据即获得高度有竞争力的生成性能，显著降低训练成本，且推理阶段无额外开销。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用判别式 3D 模型对 3D 世界的深层理解可以有效削减高保真 3D 生成的计算负担；3D 基础模型仅作为训练时的监督信号，不参与推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualG-MRAG，一个面向多模态检索增强生成 (MM-RAG) 的双层框架，用于解决复杂多跳推理任务。该框架将宏观推理与微观匹配解耦：构建 Macro Graph 进行全局拓扑路由、Micro Graph 进行细粒度局部验证，并利用图神经网络 (GNN) 将检索建模为查询驱动的消息传递过程，再通过动态规划解码从 GNN 前向传播中提取显式推理路径。实验表明该方法在证据召回和复杂问答准确率上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有 MM-RAG 方法侧重独立的实例级匹配，难以捕捉跨模态和跨文档的显式关系；图增强方法虽引入结构建模，但细粒度视觉特征会导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声，而粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。
Method: 提出 DualG-MRAG 双层级框架：用 Macro Graph 做全局结构推理、Micro Graph 做细粒度证据验证以隔离噪声；将检索形式化为 GNN Retriever 上的查询驱动消息传递；并设计动态规划解码机制，直接从 GNN 前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代孤立文档片段作为生成模型的输入。
Result: 大量实验表明 DualG-MRAG 在证据召回和复杂问答准确率上均优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将宏观结构推理与微观证据匹配解耦、并通过可解释推理路径指导生成，是缓解多模态检索噪声与图扩张问题的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sample More, Reflect Less: Self-Refine and Reflexion Lose to Repeated Sampling at Equal Token Cost, from 1.5B to 7B
papers.abstract_en: Methods that make a language model plan, criticise and rewrite its own answer, reflect on mistakes, pick the best of several attempts, or debate with copies of itself nearly all make it generate far more text than a single chain of thought. Because generating more text raises accuracy by itself, a gain over one chain of thought does not show the method's idea is what helped. Wang et al. (2024) reported that a simple baseline, sampling the same question repeatedly and keeping the most common answer, often wins once budgets are comparable, but gave point estimates with no confidence intervals or significance tests. We rerun that comparison as a designed experiment: seven methods, open models of 1.5B, 3B and 7B parameters, two mathematics benchmarks, 150 questions each. We count every generated token, including those spent on critiques, reflections, debate turns and checking, and compare each method against repeated sampling at its own measured cost. All 36 comparisons are paired by question, with bootstrap intervals and multiplicity correction. No method is reliably better than repeated sampling at equal cost anywhere. Ten are reliably worse, all of them methods where the model inspects its own output, and all 18 self-inspection comparisons are negative. The two kinds of self-inspection part company as models grow. Choosing stops hurting: taking Best-of-N's eight samples and just counting the most common answer beats letting the model pick by 8.0 and 11.3 points at 1.5B, but only 2.0 and 1.3 at 7B, no longer distinguishable from zero. Rewriting does not recover: Self-Refine and a forced Reflexion stay 3.6 to 10.1 points below baseline at 7B. Reflexion as published never triggered its own retry on the smallest model. It judged itself correct every time and silently became a single chain of thought. We release code, prompts, all generations, and our verification scripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以受控实验重新检验 LLM 自我改进类方法（自规划、批评、重写、反思、辩论、选优等）在等 token 预算下是否真的优于简单重复采样。作者对七个方法、1.5B/3B/7B 开放模型、两个数学基准各 150 题做配对比较，并统计包括批评、反思、辩论和检查在内的全部生成 token。结果显示 36 项比较中没有任何方法在等成本下稳定超过重复采样，10 项显著更差且全部属于模型自我检查类方法。
Motivation: 让模型规划、批评、重写或反思自身答案的方法几乎都会比单条思维链生成更多文本，而更多文本本身就能提高准确率，因此单条思维链上的增益并不能证明方法思想有效。前人工作只给出点估计，没有置信区间或显著性检验。
Method: 把对比做成设计实验：七个方法、三种规模的开放模型（1.5B、3B、7B）、两个数学基准各 150 题；逐 token 计量成本，将每个方法与其自身实测成本下的重复采样比较；按问题配对，使用 bootstrap 区间和多重比较校正。还检验了 Best-of-N 选优与多数投票的差异。
Result: 全部 36 项配对比较中，没有任何方法在等成本下可靠优于重复采样；10 项显著更差且全是自我检查类方法，18 项自我检查类比较全部为负。取 Best-of-N 的 8 个样本直接多数投票优于让模型选优：1.5B 下差 8.0 和 11.3 点，7B 下仅差 2.0 和 1.3 点，已无法与零区分。Self-Refine 和强制 Reflexion 在 7B 下仍比基线低 3.6 到 10.1 点；1.5B 下按原样发布的 Reflexion 从未触发重试，实际退化成单条思维链。
Conclusion: 在等 token 成本下，重复采样并取最常见答案是一个很难被击败的基线；自我检查类方法并未带来额外收益。作者公开了代码、提示词、全部生成结果和验证脚本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Algorithms for Structured Elections under Thiele Voting Rules
papers.abstract_en: We study the computational complexity of winner determination problems in approval-based committee elections under Thiele voting rules. These form a class of rules parameterized by a fixed weight vector that specifies how a voter's satisfaction depends on the number of approved candidates elected. We first analyze the structure of optimal solutions based on the sets of voters who approve each candidate---that is, how voters' approval ballots induce dependencies between candidates---revealing constraints on a winning committee under any fixed Thiele voting rule. Using this, we design FPT algorithms for Proportional Approval Voting (PAV) and other Thiele rules on a natural restricted domain known as the Voter Interval (VI) domain---that is, after a suitable ordering of voters, each candidate is approved by a consecutive interval of voters. In particular, we show that every Thiele rule on VI is FPT with respect to a parameter for which the problem is NP-hard on general instances, even when the parameter takes constant values. Our results advance the understanding of the computational complexity of PAV on Voter Interval instances, which remains one of the central open questions in this area. We further resolve two open questions from the literature on PAV (and other Thiele voting rules) by providing a polynomial-time algorithm for instances where each candidate is approved by at most two voters, and an FPT algorithm parameterized by the total score of a winning committee.
papers.comment: 18 pages. A conference version of this work appeared in AAAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究批准制委员会选举中 Thiele 投票规则下的胜者确定问题，重点关注 Voter Interval (VI) 受限域的计算复杂度。作者基于候选人被哪些选民批准所诱导的依赖结构，为比例批准投票 (PAV) 及其他 Thiele 规则设计了固定参数可解 (FPT) 算法，并解决了文献中的两个开放问题。摘要报告称在 VI 域上每个 Thiele 规则关于某个在一般实例上即使参数为常数也 NP-hard 的参数均是 FPT。
Motivation: PAV 在 Voter Interval 实例上的计算复杂度是该领域的核心开放问题之一；此外文献中还有两个关于 PAV 及其他 Thiele 规则的开放问题待解决。
Method: 先分析基于批准选民集合的最优解结构，揭示选民的批准选票如何在候选人之间产生依赖约束；随后利用该结构为 VI 域上的 PAV 和其他 Thiele 规则设计 FPT 算法，并针对特定受限实例给出多项式时间算法。
Result: 证明了 VI 域上每个 Thiele 规则相对于某个参数都是 FPT，而该参数在一般实例上即使取常数也导致 NP-hard；同时给出了每个候选人至多被两位选民批准实例的多项式时间算法，以及以胜者委员会总分为参数的 FPT 算法。
Conclusion: 这些结果推进了对 PAV 在 Voter Interval 实例上计算复杂度的理解，并解决了文献中的两个开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了本地部署的计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents, CUA）中推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）的效果，在OSWorld基准上评估了Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B。结果表明额外计算常带来收益递减并改变失败模式：上下文扩展能提升轨迹稳定性和任务准确率但会饱和，时间扩展减少max-step停滞却不显著提升成功率，结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划与格式开销，并行扩展只能以高计算成本部分缓解失败。
Motivation: 本地部署CUA对隐私、成本与实用性日益重要，但严格硬件约束下提升性能仍具挑战；推理时扩展虽可改善前沿智能体，其在资源受限本地模型上的效果尚不清楚。
Method: 作者对本地CUA的推理时扩展进行系统性实证研究，覆盖上下文（contextual）、时间（temporal）、结构（structural）与并行（parallel）四个维度，并在OSWorld基准上评测了三种本地视觉语言模型。
Result: 上下文扩展改善轨迹稳定性与任务准确率但收益随token成本饱和，且失败从重复/停滞轨迹转向过早虚假成功；时间扩展减少max-step停滞但不能大幅提升任务成功率；结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中带来额外开销；并行扩展可部分缓解失败但计算成本显著。
Conclusion: 作者认为高效的本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、故障感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型能力与局限设计的智能体框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
papers.abstract_en: Operational Earth observation increasingly calls for answering queries such as ``find the image pairs where a new building appeared.'' This means searching an archive of before-and-after (bi-temporal) satellite image pairs and ranking each pair by how well it matches a natural-language description of the change. The component that performs this match, the fusion module that combines the ``before'' and ``after'' views, must be run at query time across many candidate pairs, so its speed largely sets the cost of every search. We present a controlled comparison of how to build that module. Using one fixed image encoder (a frozen CLIP model) and one training recipe for all variants, we evaluate eight designs drawn from three families: attention, state-space models (Mamba), and learned compression (our Temporal Bottleneck Fusion, TBF). Each design is tested on two benchmarks (LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC) with ten random seeds, so the reported differences are statistically grounded. We outline three findings: first, a training-free two-stage search (a cheap difference model that shortlists candidates, followed by attention fusion that re-ranks them) matches or exceeds full-fusion recall on LEVIR-CC while cutting query cost $10$-$15\times$, with comparable R@1/R@5 on Dubai-CC; second, the linear-time scan of Mamba, attractive on paper, gives no speed benefit at the patch counts typical of vision transformers ($L{=}196$): the scan is limited by memory bandwidth, whereas attention maps cleanly onto parallel hardware; and third, compressing the fused representation (TBF) reduces parameters by $2.3\times$ and latency by $1.6\times$ for a change-only BLEU-1 cost of $0.007$, although more aggressive compression quietly discards change-relevant detail that aggregate metrics fail to reveal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从自然语言描述检索双时相卫星图像对中的变化，重点是比较构建融合模块的不同设计。作者固定使用冻结的CLIP图像编码器和统一训练方案，评估了注意力、状态空间模型（Mamba）以及提出的学习压缩方法Temporal Bottleneck Fusion（TBF）共八种设计，在LEVIR-CC和Dubai-CC两个基准上各用十个随机种子进行统计可靠的对比。结果显示两阶段搜索可降低约10-15倍查询成本且召回率不降，Mamba的线性扫描在典型patch数量下无速度优势，TBF压缩虽减参数和延迟但过度压缩会丢失变化相关细节。
Motivation: 运行地球观测需要回答诸如“找到出现新建筑物的图像对”这类自然语言查询，即从档案中检索双时相卫星图像对并按变化描述排序。融合“之前”和“之后”视图的模块必须在查询时对大量候选对运行，其速度很大程度上决定了每次搜索的成本，因此需要系统比较该模块的构建方式。
Method: 作者进行受控对比实验：固定一个图像编码器（冻结的CLIP模型）和统一训练流程，评估三个家族共八种设计——注意力机制、状态空间模型（Mamba）以及提出的学习压缩方法Temporal Bottleneck Fusion（TBF）。每种设计在两个基准（LEVIR-CC和Dubai-CC）上用十个随机种子测试。
Result: 三个主要发现：一是免训练的两阶段搜索（先用廉价差异模型筛选候选，再用注意力融合重排）在LEVIR-CC上达到或超过全融合召回率，同时查询成本降低10-15倍，在Dubai-CC的R@1/R@5上表现相当；二是Mamba的线性时间扫描在视觉Transformer常见的patch数（L=196）下没有速度优势，因其受内存带宽限制，而注意力能更好地映射到并行硬件；三是TBF压缩将参数减少2.3倍、延迟降低1.6倍，但仅在变化部分的BLEU-1上损失0.007，然而更激进的压缩会悄悄丢弃变化相关细节，而聚合指标无法揭示这一点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调融合模块的设计选择对端到端检索成本和效果有显著影响：两阶段级联策略能在不损失召回率的情况下大幅降低查询成本，Mamba的线性优势在实际patch规模下不成立，压缩方法需要警惕对变化细节的不可见损失。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning for Longitudinal Causal Inference with Irregular Histories
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal causal studies often record histories as irregular functional fragments: laboratory values, physiologic signals, sensor streams, and image-derived summaries measured at unequal and informative times. Standard doubly robust estimators usually require scalar summaries, whereas sequence learners optimize prediction losses that need not stabilize the efficient influence function. We propose Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning (DR-FRL), a cross-fitted workflow that turns irregular histories into estimand-targeted states for observed-history regimes. Functional and temporal encoders map point clouds and prior histories into states; nuisance heads estimate outcome, treatment, and censoring functions; and EIF-targeted validation, calibration, overlap, tail, and ablation diagnostics assess whether the state supports the estimating equation. If the selected state preserves the nuisance information needed by the EIF, representation error enters the same second-order product remainder as ordinary nuisance error, and the mean estimator is asymptotically linear under explicit rate, overlap, calibration, and stability conditions. Catoni aggregation is treated separately as a bounded-influence point estimator, not a replacement for Wald inference. Simulations show gains when functional confounding is high-dimensional, measurement is informative, support is weak, or pseudo-outcomes are heavy-tailed. A VitalDB audit shows that DR-FRL can use irregular laboratory point clouds and deliver a useful negative finding: for this ICU-disposition endpoint, scalar laboratory summaries already carry much endpoint-relevant information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Doubly Robust Functional Representation Learning (DR-FRL)，一种用于纵向因果推断的交叉拟合 (cross-fitted) 工作流，将不规则历史数据（如不等时间间隔的实验室值、生理信号、传感器流）转化为面向估计目标 (estimand-targeted) 的状态表示。功能编码器和时序编码器把点云与历史记录映射为状态，多个 nuisance 头估计结局、治疗和删失函数，并配套 EIF-targeted 验证、校准、重叠、尾部及消融诊断。模拟实验显示在高维功能混杂、信息性测量、弱重叠或重尾伪结局等场景下有增益；VitalDB 审计则给出阴性发现：对该 ICU 结局，标量实验室摘要已携带大量相关信息。
Motivation: 纵向因果研究常把历史记录视为不规则功能片段，但标准双稳健估计量通常要求标量摘要，而序列学习器优化的预测损失并不一定能稳定高效影响函数 (efficient influence function, EIF)，导致估计方程难以得到良好支持。
Method: 提出 DR-FRL 交叉拟合框架：用功能与时序编码器把不规则点云和历史转换为状态；由 nuisance 头估计结局、治疗与删失函数；并通过 EIF-targeted 验证、校准、重叠、尾部和消融诊断来检验状态是否支撑估计方程；Catoni 聚合被单独视为有界影响点估计器，而非替代 Wald 推断。
Result: 论文给出理论保证：若所选状态保留 EIF 所需的 nuisance 信息，表示误差进入与普通 nuisance 误差相同的二阶乘积余项，均值估计量在显式速率、重叠、校准和稳定性条件下渐近线性。模拟表明在高维功能混杂、信息性测量、弱支持或重尾伪结局情形下收益明显；VitalDB 审计显示不规则实验室点云可用，但对该 ICU 结局，标量实验室摘要已足以承载大部分端点相关信息。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将不规则历史转化为 EIF 目标化状态可使表示误差按二阶乘积余项进入估计，从而支持渐近线性推断；同时指出在实际数据中，标量摘要有时已足够，功能表示并非总是必要。
Relevance: 6

papers.title: MIND: Multimodal Intent-Driven Network via Diffusion Transformers for Medical Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Medical image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from diverse imaging modalities to support clinical diagnosis. Existing methods typically apply uniform fusion rules globally, lacking a deep understanding of diagnostic intents and pathological structures. To address these limitations, we propose MIND, a Multimodal Intent-Driven Network via Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for medical image fusion. Specifically, we utilize BioMedGPT to generate intent-driven fusion texts from source images, guiding the fusion process with pathology-aware diagnostic intents. To combat the loss of 2D spatial continuity caused by 1D sequence flattening in DiTs, we design a Multi-scale Latent Adapter. This module explicitly extracts source image features before serialization, injecting them into the network via strict dimensional alignment to effectively supplement image features. To resolve the semantic shift caused by decoupling image outputs from diagnostic intents, we design a medical semantic consistency loss. This loss ensures deep semantic locking between fused images and fusion texts while maintaining the stability of the underlying physical manifold reconstruction. Comprehensive experiments on the Harvard, BraTS, and GFP datasets reveal that MIND delivers superior fusion quality, significantly improves downstream brain tumor segmentation accuracy, and enables flexible interactive fusion, holding significant promise for intent-driven intelligent clinical decision support systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIND，一种基于扩散 Transformer (DiTs) 的多模态意图驱动医学图像融合网络。它利用 BioMedGPT 从源图像生成意图驱动的融合文本，并通过多尺度潜在适配器 (Multi-scale Latent Adapter) 和医学语义一致性损失来分别缓解序列化造成的空间连续性损失与图像输出和诊断意图之间的语义偏移。在 Harvard、BraTS 和 GFP 数据集上的实验表明，MIND 取得更优的融合质量，显著提升下游脑肿瘤分割精度，并支持灵活的交互式融合。
Motivation: 现有医学图像融合方法通常全局应用统一的融合规则，缺乏对诊断意图和病理结构的深层理解，难以针对不同临床需求产生适应性融合结果。
Method: 使用 BioMedGPT 生成基于源图像的意图驱动融合文本以引导融合过程；设计多尺度潜在适配器，在序列化之前显式提取源图像特征并通过严格维度对齐注入网络；提出医学语义一致性损失，在保持底层物理流形重建稳定性的同时，实现融合图像与融合文本之间的深层语义锁定。
Result: 在 Harvard、BraTS 和 GFP 数据集上的综合实验显示，MIND 在融合质量上优于现有方法，显著提高下游脑肿瘤分割准确率，并支持灵活的交互式融合。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MIND 有望用于意图驱动的智能临床决策支持系统；其核心在于将病理感知的诊断意图引入融合过程，并通过空间特征补充与语义一致性约束保证融合效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APO（Atomic Policy Optimization），一个完全无监督的原子系统三维结构预测对齐框架，无需 ground-truth 参考结构。它将 group-relative policy optimization 适配到 3D 原子环境，利用双奖励机制（基于样本相似度特征分解强化主导潜结构模态，以及强制热力学稳定性）让模型在采样组内自我纠偏。在晶体与抗体结构预测基准上，APO 一致超越完全监督基线，并在匹配率和结构保真度上取得新 SOTA，同时通过拉直概率路径显著提升推理效率。
Motivation: 现有的 flow-matching 类模型（如 FlowDPO）依赖与 ground-truth 坐标对齐的监督偏好学习，而新晶体相或从头设计蛋白的实验标签获取成本极高，形成数据稀缺场景下的结构建模瓶颈。
Method: 将 group-relative policy optimization 扩展到三维原子环境，提出双奖励机制：其一通过对样本相似度做特征分解（eigen-decomposition）来强化策略的主导潜结构模态，其二强制热力学稳定性；框架在采样组内识别物理上合理的构型，实现模型的自我纠正。
Result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测基准上，APO 一致优于完全监督基线，取得匹配率与结构保真度的新 SOTA；此外，APO 能有效拉直概率路径，显著改善推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，内在物理一致性相比带噪声的监督坐标匹配，可以作为更好的对齐引导信号。

papers.title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs a live OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system--exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks that systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard--a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access degrades every metric. Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are order of magnitudes larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required before frontier coding agents can be safely entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/ORCA-bench.

papers.title: ScaFE: Data-Efficient Scar Classification with LLM-Generated Clinical Feature Programs
papers.abstract_en: Classifying pathological scars from clinical photographs requires distinguishing keloids from hypertrophic scars despite limited expert-labeled data and substantial acquisition variation across hospitals. End-to-end image models remain data-dependent, whereas sending photographs to a hosted vision-language model (VLM) may conflict with local data-governance requirements and yields decisions that are difficult to reproduce and audit. We introduce ScaFE (Scar Feature Engineering), which transfers clinical knowledge from a large language model (LLM) into deterministic, executable feature programs instead of asking the model to diagnose images. A web-enabled LLM retrieves clinical evidence and synthesizes programs that measure visually assessable scar attributes. Candidate programs execute in a restricted local environment, and only aggregate validation statistics and feature-level SHAP summaries are returned for iterative repair and refinement; raw images and patient-level outputs remain local. A lightweight Random Forest then operates on the resulting structured representation. On 600 photographs from three hospitals under leave-one-site-out evaluation, ScaFE achieves 81.0% site-macro balanced accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline, BiomedCLIP, by 10.0 percentage points. With only 10% of the development data, ScaFE retains 72.0% balanced accuracy and an 11.8-point lead. Iterative refinement also raises the executable-program rate from 66.7% to 95.0%, with verified evidence for 91.7% of the final features. These results show that LLM knowledge can support data-efficient, cross-site medical image classification through local and auditable feature programs rather than direct VLM decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScaFE（Scar Feature Engineering），将大语言模型（LLM）的临床知识转化为确定性的、可执行的临床特征程序，而非直接让模型诊断图像。程序在受限本地环境中运行，仅返回聚合验证统计量与特征级 SHAP 摘要用于迭代修复；轻量级 Random Forest 基于其结构化表示分类。在来自三家医院的 600 张照片、留一院址评估下，ScaFE 达到 81.0% 的 site-macro balanced accuracy，超过最强基线 BiomedCLIP 10.0 个百分点；仅用 10% 开发数据时仍有 72.0% 的 balanced accuracy 和 11.8 个百分点的领先。
Motivation: 病理性瘢痕分类需区分瘢痕疙瘩与增生性瘢痕，但专家标注数据有限且各医院拍摄差异大；端到端图像模型依赖数据，而将照片发送给云端视觉语言模型（VLM）可能与本地数据治理要求冲突，且决策难以复现和审计。
Method: ScaFE 让具备联网能力的 LLM 检索临床证据并综合生成可测量瘢痕视觉属性的特征程序；候选程序在受限本地环境执行，仅回传聚合验证统计和特征级 SHAP 摘要用于迭代修复与改进，原始图像和患者级输出保持本地。最终用轻量级 Random Forest 处理结构化特征表示。
Result: 在 600 张来自三家医院的临床照片、leave-one-site-out 评估下，ScaFE 达到 81.0% 的 site-macro balanced accuracy，比最强基线 BiomedCLIP 高 10.0 个百分点；仅用 10% 开发数据时保持 72.0% 的 balanced accuracy，领先 11.8 个百分点。迭代修复将可执行程序率从 66.7% 提升到 95.0%，最终特征中有 91.7% 具备经核实的证据支持。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 LLM 知识可通过本地、可审计的特征程序支持数据高效且跨院址的医学图像分类，而不是依赖直接的 VLM 决策；ScaFE 的设计将数据治理和可复现性作为核心约束。

papers.title: Graph Neural Network Force Fields for Spin Dynamics in Metallic Magnets
papers.abstract_en: Metallic magnets exhibit complex spin dynamics governed by electronically generated interactions. Predictive simulations of such dynamics typically require repeated solutions of an underlying electronic problem throughout the time evolution, creating a major computational bottleneck. Here we introduce a graph neural network (GNN) magnetic force-field framework that learns the effective magnetic energy functional governing itinerant spin dynamics directly from electronic calculations. Conceptually analogous to machine-learned interatomic potentials, the proposed framework enables efficient evaluation of spin torques while capturing the nonlinear and spatially extended interactions generated by itinerant electrons. We benchmark the method on representative metallic magnetic systems exhibiting collinear, noncollinear, and noncoplanar magnetic order. The learned force fields accurately reproduce electronically generated spin torques and yield nonequilibrium spin dynamics in excellent agreement with direct electronic simulations. Our results establish graph neural networks as a powerful framework for machine-learned magnetic force fields, providing a pathway toward predictive large-scale simulations of nonequilibrium magnetism across multiple length and time scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向金属磁体中巡游自旋动力学的图神经网络 (GNN) 磁力场框架，直接从电子结构计算中学习有效的磁性能量泛函。该框架在概念上类比机器学习原子间势 (interatomic potentials)，可高效评估自旋力矩并捕捉巡游电子产生的非线性、空间延展相互作用。在共线、非共线和非共面磁序的典型金属磁性体系上，学习到的力场能准确重现电子层面的自旋力矩，并使非平衡自旋动力学与直接电子模拟高度一致。
Motivation: 金属磁体的自旋动力学由电子产生的相互作用主导，但预测性模拟通常需要在时间演化中反复求解底层电子结构问题，构成主要计算瓶颈。
Method: 提出 GNN 磁力场框架，学习描述巡游自旋动力学的有效磁性能量泛函；与机器学习原子间势类似，该方法可直接评估自旋力矩，而无需每一步求解电子问题。
Result: 在具有共线、非共线和非共面磁序的代表性金属磁性体系中验证，学习到的力场准确复现电子产生的自旋力矩，得到的非平衡自旋动力学与直接电子模拟结果高度吻合。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作确立了 GNN 作为机器学习磁力场的有效框架，为跨多个长度和时间尺度的非平衡磁性大规模预测模拟提供了路径。

papers.title: MarkushGlyph and OCSRGlyph: Improved Chemical Structure Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Chemical structures appear in patents and the scientific literature as images. For programmatic usage, such as indexing in databases or constructing machine learning model training sets, they must be transformed into line notations. The two common forms of this task are translating an image of a single molecule (optical chemical structure recognition - OCSR) and translating a Markush structure that represents a family of molecules. While prior work in the former case is quite mature, Markush structure parsing remains a challenging task. In this work, we treat both tasks as an image-to-text translation problem. We then propose OCSRGlyph, a state-of-the-art OCSR model, improving performance over prior methods by carefully considering stereochemistry. For the Markush task, we introduce MarkushGlyph, a vision-language model that reads the entire Markush structure as an image. This contrasts with prior systems, which often use multiple stages to separately process visual and text input content. Finally, we introduce a new metric for determining the accuracy of Markush structure translations, handling failure modes present in prior metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把化学结构识别统一建模为图像到文本（image-to-text）翻译问题，覆盖单分子光学化学结构识别（OCSR）与 Markush 结构解析两类任务。作者提出 OCSRGlyph，在立体化学（stereochemistry）处理上改进并超越先前 OCSR 方法；同时提出 MarkushGlyph，一个将整个 Markush 结构作为图像输入的视觉-语言模型，以替代以往多阶段分别处理视觉与文本内容的系统。此外还引入一个新的 Markush 结构翻译准确率度量，针对先前度量的失败模式。
Motivation: 化学结构在专利和科学文献中以图像形式出现，程序化使用（如数据库索引或构建机器学习训练集）需要将其转换为行记号。单分子 OCSR 已较成熟，但 Markush 结构解析仍然困难，且现有系统多为分别处理视觉与文本输入的多阶段流程。
Method: 将 OCSR 与 Markush 解析都视为图像到文本翻译问题；提出 OCSRGlyph 作为新的 OCSR 模型，重点审慎处理立体化学；提出 MarkushGlyph，一个直接读取整幅 Markush 结构图像的视觉-语言模型；并设计新的 Markush 转换准确率度量以覆盖先前度量的失败模式。
Result: 摘要报告 OCSRGlyph 在 OCSR 任务上相比先前方法取得性能提升，收益来自对立体化学的仔细建模；MarkushGlyph 采用单阶段端到端方式读取 Markush 结构；新度量针对现有度量的失效情况。
Conclusion: 作者认为将两类化学结构识别统一为图像到文本翻译是有效方案，Markush 解析可通过视觉-语言模型避免多阶段流程，并且需要更合适的度量来准确评估结构转换。

papers.title: MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MANTA（Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation），一个让基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在推理时自我演化通信拓扑的框架。MANTA 在执行前基于先验结构经验初始化任务条件拓扑，并在部署中监控协作轨迹、在组织不足时执行有界结构更新。在信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行和数学推理五个基准上，MANTA 平均得分 74.0，超过最强基线 5.8 个百分点，并在 PlanCraft 上取得最佳结果。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通常把通信拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标，缺乏推理阶段的动态适应能力，限制了复杂任务中的协作效率。
Method: MANTA 在执行前根据先验结构经验初始化任务条件拓扑；部署时监控智能体协作轨迹，并在当前组织结构不足时应用有界结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保持任务接口与智能体预算不变。
Result: 在五个基准上，MANTA 平均得分 74.0，比最强基线高 5.8 个百分点，并在 PlanCraft 上取得最佳结果，优于代表性单智能体与多智能体基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些结果表明推理时自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，而不仅是智能体行为或策略。

papers.title: What to Remove, What to Preserve: Dual-Ambiguity Rectification for All-in-One Image Restoration
authors: Guoming Lu (1) ((1) University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract_en: All-in-one image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified framework. Existing methods commonly encode heterogeneous degradation conditions in a shared latent space, where degradation-related cues and scene content can remain entangled. We characterize the resulting challenge as dual ambiguity: semantic ambiguity in channel-wise modulation and spatial ambiguity in restoration responses, which can lead to content corruption and residual artifacts. To mitigate this issue, we propose DAR-Net, a Dual-Ambiguity Rectification Network for all-in-one image restoration. DAR-Net first introduces a Degradation Archetype Representation (DAR) module to construct a structured degradation state through simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling. Based on this state, a Semantic Ambiguity Rectification (SeAR) module generates degradation-aware prompts to improve channel-wise conditioning in the decoder. A Spatial Ambiguity Rectification (SpAR) module further regularizes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces, reducing spatial interference between removal and preservation cues. Extensive experiments on standard all-in-one restoration benchmarks show that DAR-Net achieves the best overall performance under both three-degradation and five-degradation settings, improving the average PSNR over the strongest competitor by 0.14 dB and 0.34 dB, respectively; it additionally shows superior performance on CDD-11 and WeatherBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全能图像恢复（all-in-one image restoration）中不同退化条件在共享潜空间内纠缠的问题，提出双歧义矫正网络 DAR-Net。作者将挑战刻画为双重歧义：通道级调制中的语义歧义和恢复响应中的空间歧义。摘要报告 DAR-Net 在三退化与五退化设置的标准基准上均达到最佳平均性能，并在 CDD-11 和 WeatherBench 上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有全能恢复方法通常将异构退化条件编码到共享潜空间，导致退化相关线索与场景内容纠缠，进而引起内容损坏和残余伪影。论文将这一挑战归纳为语义歧义与空间歧义，并指出其是限制统一框架恢复质量的关键问题。
Method: 提出 DAR-Net，包含三个模块：退化原型表示（Degradation Archetype Representation, DAR）模块通过单纯形约束的原型混合建模构造结构化退化状态；语义歧义矫正（Semantic Ambiguity Rectification, SeAR）模块基于该状态生成退化感知提示，改进解码器的通道级调节；空间歧义矫正（Spatial Ambiguity Rectification, SpAR）模块将退化感知特征与互补特征正则化到正交响应子空间，减少去除与保留线索之间的空间干扰。
Result: 在标准全能恢复基准上，DAR-Net 在三退化和五退化设置下均取得最佳整体性能，相对最强竞争者的平均 PSNR 分别提升 0.14 dB 和 0.34 dB；在 CDD-11 与 WeatherBench 上还报告了更优表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过分别矫正通道级语义歧义和空间响应歧义，可以有效解耦退化去除与内容保留，从而提升全能恢复框架的统一处理能力。

papers.title: Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了同一图上的节点分类 (NC) 与链接预测 (LP) 跨任务迁移，并提出一种无泄漏 (leakage-free) 的评估协议，统一节点/边划分、共享消息传递图与固定负样本。在 GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS 三种骨干网络上，作者发现迁移具有强方向性和可预测性：同配图 (homophilic graphs) 上 NC→LP 一致有益，而 LP→NC 在朴素表示复用下脆弱甚至降精度，仅在 LP 容易而 NC 未饱和的结构主导场景中可靠为正。论文还提出 CoTask Score (CTS) 以衡量共享编码器同时服务两任务时的联合效用，并表明同配性等简单数据集统计量可指导机制选择、避免负迁移。
Motivation: 同一底层结构支持多个预测任务，但现有评估因使用不兼容的数据划分、观测图假设和负采样规则，导致关于同图跨任务迁移的结论不可靠。
Method: 提出无泄漏的同图 NC-LP 迁移协议：固定节点与边划分、共享排除被评估边的消息传递图、对 LP 使用固定负样本；并引入 CoTask Score (CTS) 来总结共享编码器下的联合 NC+LP 效用。
Result: 跨三种骨干网络 (GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS) 的实验显示迁移强方向性：同配图上 NC→LP 一致有益，LP→NC 脆弱且朴素表示复用可能降低精度；LP→NC 仅在 LP 易而 NC 未饱和的结构主导场景中可靠为正。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨任务迁移可通过同配性等简单数据集统计量来预测和引导，CTS 与协议可用于避免负迁移并选择机制。
Relevance: 3
