papers.title: Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update
papers.abstract_en: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信度受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），其核心思路是在执行可信度受限转移之前，先针对每个源世界把认知输入变换为一个更弱的代理输入，从而允许复合输入中仅部分内容被接受。作者给出了该类更新算子的语义与公理化刻画，并识别出两个性质良好的子类：一致性保持算子与最大一致性保持算子。最后证明该框架在恢复 credibility-limited 信念更新的同时，当去掉可信度限制且变换函数取恒等函数时也能恢复 Katsuno-Mendelzon 信念更新，从而统一并严格扩展了既有方法。
Motivation: 已有的 credibility-limited belief update 把认知输入当作不可分割的整体，因此无法表达复合认知输入中只有一部分能够在某个源世界中实现的情况。
Method: 对每个源世界定义一个变换函数，将原始认知输入转化为较弱的代理输入，再对该代理执行可信度受限的转移；随后从语义和公理两方面刻画所得更新算子类，并定义两个子类：一致性保持更新要求原始输入一致时其代理输入从该源世界看是可信的，最大一致性保持更新还要求所选代理在原始输入的可信后果中是信息量最大的。
Result: 摘要报告了框架的一般性结果：credibility-limited belief update 是该框架的特例；当去掉可信度限制且变换函数为恒等函数时，恢复 Katsuno-Mendelzon belief update。这些结果表明该框架更具表达力，并支持依赖源世界的选择性接受。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为信念更新提供了统一且严格更具表达力的刻画，涵盖既有方法并支持选择性接受；摘要未涉及实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agents That Certify Their Own Exploits: Confidence-Scheduled Restricted Responses for Safe Opponent Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: An agent playing a Nash-equilibrium strategy in a two-player zero-sum imperfect-information game secures the game value but forfeits the additional value offered by a flawed opponent. Diffuse deviations pose a particular challenge: binary release rules may gather too little evidence to act, while a full best response to an incomplete opponent model can be highly exploitable. We introduce \emph{budget-constrained confidence-scheduled restricted responses} (CS-RNR), the first opponent-exploitation method whose safety guarantee is a certificate the agent computes on the strategy it actually deploys, so that every exploit it commits to is one it has audited itself. The method tracks pooled action frequencies with anytime-valid confidence sequences and treats a frequency as exploitable only once its interval separates from an equilibrium reference. The confirmed deviations define a conservative opponent model, which a restricted-response solve turns into candidate counter-strategies over a grid of pin levels. Before deployment, each complete candidate is evaluated by a full-tree best response. The resulting certificate is compared with a user-specified budget and committed atomically with the strategy. Because this check is performed on the played strategy, model quality determines the exploitation achieved while the certificate controls reference-relative expected loss. In Leduc hold'em, CS-RNR obtains $6.2\times$ the steady-state gain of a money-verified binary gate while keeping every deployed strategy within budget. A trajectory mixture using the same estimator reaches $13.6\times$ the budget. Across Leduc, Liar's Dice, and 5-rank Leduc, all $36{,}000$ audited hands satisfy the reported certificate tolerance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预算约束的置信度调度受限响应 (budget-constrained confidence-scheduled restricted responses, CS-RNR)，一种用于二人零和、不完美信息博弈中的对手利用方法。其安全保证是智能体在实际部署的策略上自行计算的证书，使得每次承诺的利用都经过了自身审计。方法用任意有效置信序列 (anytime-valid confidence sequences) 跟踪动作频率，并在频率区间与均衡参考分离后才认定其可利用；随后通过受限响应求解和全树最佳响应生成带证书的候选策略。在 Leduc hold'em 中，CS-RNR 的稳态收益是 money-verified binary gate 的 6.2 倍，且所有部署策略都保持在预算内；轨迹混合版本达到 13.6 倍。
Motivation: 采用纳什均衡策略的智能体能保住博弈价值，但会放弃从有缺陷对手身上获得的额外价值。弥散性偏差 (diffuse deviations) 带来特殊挑战：二值释放规则可能因证据不足而无法行动，而针对不完整对手模型的完全最佳响应又可能高度易被利用。
Method: CS-RNR 使用任意有效置信序列跟踪池化动作频率，仅当区间与均衡参考分离时才认定某频率可利用。确认的偏差构成保守对手模型，通过受限响应 (restricted response) 求解在 pin level 网格上生成候选反制策略；每个完整候选在部署前经全树最佳响应评估。所得证书与用户指定预算比较，并与策略原子化地一同提交。
Result: 在 Leduc hold'em 中，CS-RNR 获得 money-verified binary gate 稳态收益的 6.2 倍，且每个部署策略都在预算内；使用相同估计器的轨迹混合 (trajectory mixture) 达到预算的 13.6 倍。在 Leduc、Liar's Dice 和 5-rank Leduc 上，全部 36,000 手被审计牌局均满足所报告的证书容差。
Conclusion: 该方法的独特之处在于安全保证是智能体在实际部署策略上计算的证书，因此每次利用都已通过自身审计；模型质量决定实现的利用程度，而证书控制相对于均衡基准的期望损失。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出预算约束的置信度调度受限响应 (budget-constrained confidence-scheduled restricted responses, CS-RNR)，一种用于二人零和、不完美信息博弈中的对手利用方法。其安全保证是智能体在实际部署的策略上自行计算的证书，使得每次承诺的利用都经过了自身审计。方法用任意有效置信序列 (anytime-valid confidence sequences) 跟踪动作频率，并在频率区间与均衡参考分离后才认定其可利用；随后通过受限响应求解和全树最佳响应生成带证书的候选策略。在 Leduc hold'em 中，CS-RNR 的稳态收益是 money-verified binary gate 的 6.2 倍，且所有部署策略都保持在预算内；轨迹混合版本达到 13.6 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 采用纳什均衡策略的智能体能保住博弈价值，但会放弃从有缺陷对手身上获得的额外价值。弥散性偏差 (diffuse deviations) 带来特殊挑战：二值释放规则可能因证据不足而无法行动，而针对不完整对手模型的完全最佳响应又可能高度易被利用。
summary_sections.method: CS-RNR 使用任意有效置信序列跟踪池化动作频率，仅当区间与均衡参考分离时才认定某频率可利用。确认的偏差构成保守对手模型，通过受限响应 (restricted response) 求解在 pin level 网格上生成候选反制策略；每个完整候选在部署前经全树最佳响应评估。所得证书与用户指定预算比较，并与策略原子化地一同提交。
summary_sections.result: 在 Leduc hold'em 中，CS-RNR 获得 money-verified binary gate 稳态收益的 6.2 倍，且每个部署策略都在预算内；使用相同估计器的轨迹混合 (trajectory mixture) 达到预算的 13.6 倍。在 Leduc、Liar's Dice 和 5-rank Leduc 上，全部 36,000 手被审计牌局均满足所报告的证书容差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法的独特之处在于安全保证是智能体在实际部署策略上计算的证书，因此每次利用都已通过自身审计；模型质量决定实现的利用程度，而证书控制相对于均衡基准的期望损失。

papers.title: Beyond Frame Selection: Generative Latent Evidence Aggregation for Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-video understanding commonly compresses videos into a small set of frames or visual tokens for answer generation. Existing compact pipelines focus on retaining relevant visual content as explicit evidence. Yet making evidence available does not ensure that complementary cues across moments are integrated for answering. Our key idea is to organize selected frames into query-relevant cross-frame evidence before generation. We formulate this post-selection stage as a latent evidence interface and instantiate it with GenEvA ($\textbf{Gen}erative$ $Latent$ $\textbf{Ev}idence$ $\textbf{A}ggregation$), a distribution-guided latent evidence aggregation framework. Specifically, GenEvA uses a query-conditioned evidence distribution to focus aggregation on relevant frames, forming compact cross-frame latent evidence from their frame-specific information. Since cross-frame integration is not always needed, the same distribution determines whether to insert this latent complement. Across four benchmarks and two Video-MLLM backbones, GenEvA consistently improves matched-frame baselines. At 8 frames, it raises the four-benchmark LLaVA-Video average by $+5.2$ points and Qwen2.5-VL accuracy on LVBench by $+10.1$ points. These gains require only $0.11\%$--$0.40\%$ average video-token overhead; analyses further show task-aware allocation and benefits from Adaptive Evidence Invocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频理解中‘选取帧后如何整合跨帧互补线索’的问题，提出生成式隐式证据聚合框架 GenEvA（Generative Latent Evidence Aggregation）。GenEvA 用查询条件化的证据分布（query-conditioned evidence distribution）决定聚合哪些相关帧，并形成紧凑的跨帧隐式证据；同一分布还决定是否插入该隐式补充。在四个基准和两个 Video-MLLM 主干上，GenEvA 一致提升匹配帧基线，且仅增加约 0.11%–0.40% 的视频 token 开销。
Motivation: 现有长视频紧凑型流水线主要保留相关视觉内容作为显式证据，但‘证据可用’并不保证回答生成时能整合跨时刻的互补线索。作者希望补足选帧后的证据聚合阶段，使互补信息得以在生成前被组织起来。
Method: 将选帧后的阶段建模为潜在证据接口，提出 GenEvA：用查询条件化证据分布引导聚合聚焦于相关帧，从帧级信息形成紧凑的跨帧隐式证据；同一分布同时决定是否需要插入该隐式补充，即自适应证据调用（Adaptive Evidence Invocation）。
Result: 在四个基准和两个 Video-MLLM 主干上，GenEvA 一致优于匹配帧基线；8 帧设置下，LLaVA-Video 的四基准平均提升 +5.2 点，Qwen2.5-VL 在 LVBench 上准确率提升 +10.1 点，平均视频 token 开销仅 0.11%–0.40%。分析还显示任务感知分配（task-aware allocation）与自适应证据调用的收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为选帧后引入分布引导的跨帧隐式证据聚合，可以在极小 token 开销下提升长视频理解；该接口设计支持按查询任务自适应决定是否聚合。

papers.title: RefCaptioner: Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Existing video captioning models generate natural descriptions of video content but cannot explicitly ground local visual elements to multiple reference images. We introduce multi-reference image-grounded video captioning, a new task requiring factual video descriptions with phrase-level reference grounding, and propose RefCaptioner, a two-stage post-training framework for this task. RefCaptioner combines mixed-data SFT with Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO to jointly improve reference selection, phrase-level binding, distractor rejection, and cross-reference consistency while preserving general video-captioning ability. To support training, we construct a corpus containing $20,000$ videos and 171,354 reference images. We further introduce MRVBench, a benchmark for evaluating caption factuality and multi-reference grounding on both real-world and AI-generated videos. Experiments show that RefCaptioner achieves the best overall performance among the open-source models while remaining competitive on standard video captioning benchmarks. Human evaluation further confirms that its captions are preferred by annotators and enable more source-faithful video reconstruction with both open-source and proprietary video generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多参考图像接地的视频字幕生成 (multi-reference image-grounded video captioning) 新任务，要求字幕在短语级别接地到多个参考图像。作者提出 RefCaptioner，一个两阶段后训练框架，结合混合数据 SFT 与 Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO，并构建包含 20,000 个视频和 171,354 张参考图像的训练语料以及 MRVBench 基准。实验表明 RefCaptioner 在开源模型中取得最佳整体性能，并在标准视频字幕基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有视频字幕模型能生成自然语言描述，但无法显式地将局部视觉元素接地到多张参考图像；该任务、训练数据与评估基准此前均缺失。
Method: 提出 RefCaptioner 两阶段后训练框架：先进行混合数据 SFT，再用分层覆盖折扣 GRPO (Hierarchical Coverage-Discounted GRPO) 联合优化参考选择、短语级绑定、干扰拒绝和跨参考一致性，同时保留通用视频字幕能力；并构建包含 171,354 张参考图像的语料集与 MRVBench 基准。
Result: 在 MRVBench 上，RefCaptioner 达到开源模型中最佳整体性能，并在标准视频字幕基准上保持竞争力；人工评估显示其字幕更受标注者偏好，且能帮助开源和专有视频生成器实现更源忠实的视频重建。
Conclusion: 作者认为多参考图像接地视频字幕任务及 RefCaptioner 框架有效，能在不牺牲通用字幕能力的前提下改善事实性和多参考接地质量。

papers.title: InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation. In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%. Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个持续更新、动态抗饱和的 AI 安全基准，用于衡量前沿语言模型被国家支持的信息操作 (information operations) 利用的程度。基准基于实时监控管道中的 2,100 多个俄罗斯、中国和伊朗官方信息资产案例，测试了来自 8 家提供商的 17 个模型在四种提示框架下的表现。结果显示大多数模型可被诱导参与信息操作，完整性分数 (定义为拒绝请求的百分比) 在 8.8% 到 94.5% 之间，且该差距无法由模型规模解释。
Motivation: 现有基准容易饱和，难以持续评估模型在真实、动态演变的虚假信息场景中的安全性；作者希望提供一种能抵抗饱和、紧贴实时监控数据的基准来度量前沿模型被国家支持的舆论操控利用的风险。
Method: 提出一个主动更新 (live) 的基准，从监控管道中提炼俄罗斯、中国和伊朗国家支持的信息资产作为测试样本，并配套每周更新的网站。基准用四个提示框架测试 17 个模型 (共 8 家提供商)，以拒绝请求的百分比作为完整性分数，并额外统计事实核查率等行为指标。
Result: 大部分模型可以被用于信息操作；完整性分数从 8.8% 到 94.5%，跨度为 85.7 个百分点且与模型规模无关。模型选择还会改变生成内容的性质：有的模型会编造细节、比源材料更有害，有的在服从的同时削弱主张；事实核查率在 2.9% 到 72.9% 之间。除 Z.ai 的 GLM 5.2 外，中国开发的模型在事实成立但批评中国的请求上合规率骤降 48 到 70 个百分点。
Conclusion: 模型在信息操作上的安全性至少部分与其对良性请求也拒绝生成内容的倾向相关，这凸显了在模型可用性与安全之间权衡的挑战；基准的动态设计使其对饱和具有抵抗力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TCA-SIR: Learning Target-Conditioned Abstractions for Scientific Inspiration Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Scientific hypothesis generation for AI for Science typically involves Scientific Inspiration Retrieval (SIR) followed by hypothesis composition. Existing SIR methods rank papers by topical similarity and do not explicitly represent how a candidate inspiration transfers to a target problem. This is especially limiting for remote inspirations, whose value often lies in reusable problem-solving principles rather than topical overlap. Motivated by how humans abstract transferable aspects of a source and remap them to a new target, we reformulate SIR as target-conditioned abstraction (TCA). The retrieval object is a transferable abstract principle extracted from a candidate specifically for the target. We present TCA-SIR, which learns to generate target-conditioned abstractions and uses their representations to predict transferability. On ResearchBench, TCA-SIR outperforms prior SIR methods and direct LLM retrieval, improving HitRate@top4% over MOOSE-Chem by more than 10 percentage points. Learned abstractions also recover target-relevant mechanisms more clearly than an untrained TCA prompt, yielding both stronger retrieval and an interpretable rationale for scientific inspiration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI for Science 中的科学灵感检索（Scientific Inspiration Retrieval）提出 TCA-SIR，将检索目标重新定义为针对目标问题条件化的可迁移抽象原则（target-conditioned abstraction），而非仅按主题相似度排序论文。方法在 ResearchBench 上优于既有 SIR 方法和直接 LLM 检索，HitRate@top4% 比 MOOSE-Chem 提升超过 10 个百分点，并能为灵感提供可解释的理由。
Motivation: 现有 SIR 方法仅按主题相似度对论文排序，没有显式表示候选灵感如何迁移到目标问题，尤其难以处理远程灵感（remote inspiration），其价值往往来自可复用的解题原则而非主题重叠。
Method: 将 SIR 重构为目标条件化抽象（TCA）：从候选论文中提取针对目标问题的可迁移抽象原则，学习生成这些抽象并利用其表征预测可迁移性；摘要提到同时比较了未训练的 TCA 提示（untrained TCA prompt）作为对照。
Result: 在 ResearchBench 上，TCA-SIR 优于先前 SIR 方法和直接 LLM 检索，HitRate@top4% 比 MOOSE-Chem 提高超过 10 个百分点；学习到的抽象比未训练 TCA 提示更清晰地恢复与目标相关的机制，并带来更强的检索性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将检索对象从论文本身转为面向目标的可迁移抽象，能同时提升科学灵感的检索效果并给出可解释的依据。

papers.title: The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining. In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究算法递归 (algorithmic recourse) 中因果结构的作用，提出一个因果执行性 (causal performative) 框架来建模递归动作经由结构因果模型传播后对真实标签和行为响应的影响。作者证明忽略因果结构的递归策略会诱发大规模失配的行为响应，而因果递归可收敛到性能稳定 (performatively stable) 的均衡并减少博弈性操纵。在半合成与真实信贷数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于标准经验风险最小化，并降低因策略行为引起的重复重训需求。
Motivation: 现有算法递归方法大多只关注翻转模型预测，不区分推荐改变是否真正提升个体资质，还是仅用于策略性博弈分类器，导致部署后预测精度下降且重训后失效。
Method: 提出因果执行性框架，将递归动作通过结构因果模型传播并刻画其对真实标签的影响；将因果响应建模为非凸优化问题，并分析存在可高效计算的性能稳定解的条件，借助简单迭代动力学求解。
Result: 理论分析显示忽略因果结构的递归策略会引发大规模失配行为响应；在信贷数据集的实验中，所提方法优于标准经验风险最小化，并减少因策略性智能体行为造成分布偏移所需的重复模型重训。
Conclusion: 论文强调因果感知的递归策略能形成稳定均衡并降低博弈激励，是设计可持续递归政策的关键。

papers.title: Stage-Replay Divergence Follows the KV Cache: Fixed-Prefix Precision Controls and Bidirectional Cache Transplantation
papers.abstract_en: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and 20 correctness labels; the accuracy difference is only one point (paired 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]). A fixed-prefix 2x2 holds all 200 token states constant while crossing construction and precision. The BF16 disagreements recur, whereas FP32 produces no decoded disagreement (95% Wilson upper bound 1.88%). A prospective bridge makes token-by-token incremental and retained live caches bit-exact on 12/12 rows; an all-200 saved-ledger audit reproduces every retained trajectory and comparison fingerprint. Bidirectional transplantation of all 48 key/value layers makes every tested divergent continuation follow its cache donor, both on a selected set at the primary checkpoint (24/24) and an outcome-blind replication at a later checkpoint (43/43). Exact-token replay can therefore be repeatable without preserving live-state fidelity. On the tested states, boundary K/V cache is a causally sufficient carrier of the divergent trajectory, while numerical precision moderates its behavioral expression.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Reproducibility artifacts (frozen manifests, token IDs, per-item scores, analysis harnesses) described in Section 3.9
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究阶段重放（stage-replay）诊断的一个核心假设：用一次性预填充重建中间 token 前缀，是否等价于从原先到达该前缀的解码器状态继续。作者在 Qwen2.5 衍生系统的推理阶段边界上，通过 200 项配对实验比较保留的活跃缓存（live cache）与相同整数 token 的一次性预填充，并引入精度对照。BF16 下两种构造在 166 个后缀和 20 个正确性标签上出现分歧，但准确率仅差 1 个百分点；FP32 下无解码分歧。随后对全部 48 层 key/value 缓存做双向移植，使分歧延续跟随缓存供体，说明边界 KV 缓存是分歧轨迹的因果充分载体。
Motivation: 阶段重放诊断假定重建前缀等同于从原始解码器状态继续，但该假设本身未被审计；缓存构造方式与数值精度可能共同影响重放保真度，进而影响基于重放的正确性判断。
Method: 采用匹配的 200 项实验对比保留活跃缓存与一次性预填充，用固定前缀 2x2 设计在保持全部 200 个 token 状态不变的同时交叉构造方式和精度（BF16/FP32）；提出前瞻桥接（prospective bridge）使逐 token 增量式与保留活跃缓存比特精确一致，并执行全量 200 项保存账本审计。最后对全部 48 层 key/value 缓存做双向移植实验，测试分歧续写是否跟随缓存供体。
Result: BF16 下两种构造在 166 个后缀和 20 个正确性标签上分歧，准确率差仅 1 点（配对 95% CI [-3.5, +5.5]）；FP32 下无解码分歧（95% Wilson 上界 1.88%）。前瞻桥接在 12/12 行上实现逐 token 比特精确一致；全量 200 项账本审计复现所有保留轨迹。双向移植在主检查点 24/24、稍后检查点的盲复制 43/43 上均使分歧随缓存供体。
Conclusion: 精确 token 重放可以可重复，却未必保持活状态保真；在被测状态下，边界 KV 缓存是分歧轨迹的因果充分载体，而数值精度只调节其行为表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE（Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination），一个将供应链实体表示为 token、通过共享操作表示进行上下文化并映射到对应决策接口的复合策略模型，旨在统一补货计划中的选品、货源分配、补货频率和配送路由等耦合决策。该框架在城市生鲜零售补货场景中实例化，并在叮咚买菜和京东的真实运营数据上评估。结果表明 SCOPE 一致优于每个决策阶段单独优化的方法以及供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线。
Motivation: 现代供应链中补货相关决策（选品、货源分配、补货频率、路由）通常由不同部门通过独立系统优化，但这些决策在运营上相互耦合，孤立优化会导致缺货、库存风险和可避免的运输成本。
Method: 提出 SCOPE 复合策略模型：将供应链实体编码为 token，利用共享的操作表示（shared operational representation）对实体进行上下文化，并将每种 token 类型映射到对应的决策接口；每个决策基于先前决策形成的部分计划，完成后的计划用共享的系统级效用（system-level utility）进行评估。
Result: 在叮咚买菜和京东两个不同补货层级的真实运营数据上，SCOPE 均优于分阶段独立优化的方法和供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习和协调跨部门的运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策。

papers.title: AuricularWorld: Hierarchical Action-Guided World Modeling for Fine-Grained Auricular Structure Segmentation from CT Scans
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained segmentation of auricular structures in CT is challenging because the ear occupies a small image region, cartilage boundaries are highly irregular, and interfaces between cartilage and surrounding soft tissues are often ambiguous. Clinical annotations may also include both composite structures containing cartilage and adjacent skin and their corresponding cartilage-only regions, producing nested and overlapping labels. We propose a world-model-based segmentation framework that enables iterative anatomical reasoning beyond conventional feed-forward prediction. Built on an encoder-decoder architecture, the framework introduces a deterministic recurrent state-space model into the intermediate latent space. Multi-scale encoder features and partially decoded representations are fused to form a structural observation that initializes the latent dynamics. During inference, the model performs a three-step latent rollout without ground-truth guidance. Hierarchical anatomical actions update the recurrent state and progressively refine the latent representation. The resulting latent trajectory is projected back into the decoder and combined with high-resolution features to produce the final segmentation. To learn reliable latent transitions, we introduce a balanced hierarchical action objective that addresses foreground sparsity, missing anatomical groups, and imbalance between add and remove operations. Extensive experiments show that the proposed framework consistently improves segmentation accuracy and reduces HD95 by more than 43% for small, irregular, and overlapping auricular structures in CT. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of latent world-model reasoning for challenging medical image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AuricularWorld，一个基于世界模型 (world model) 的耳部结构 CT 分割框架。该框架在编码器-解码器架构的中间潜在空间引入确定性循环状态空间模型 (deterministic recurrent state-space model)，将多尺度编码特征与部分解码表示融合为结构化观测来初始化潜在动力学，并在推理时执行三步无真值引导的潜在空间 rollout (latent rollout)，通过分层解剖动作 (hierarchical anatomical actions) 逐步精化潜在表示后再投影回解码器。摘要报告该方法在细小、不规则且重叠的耳部结构分割上持续提升准确率，并将 HD95 降低超过 43%。
Motivation: 耳廓在 CT 中占图像区域很小，软骨边界极不规则，软骨与周围软组织界面模糊，且临床标注可能同时包含含软骨和皮肤的复合结构及其对应的纯软骨区域，形成嵌套与重叠标签，使常规前馈预测难以完成细粒度分割。
Method: 在编码器-解码器框架中，向中间潜在空间加入确定性循环状态空间模型；多尺度编码特征与部分解码表示融合成结构化观测以初始化潜在动力学。推理阶段执行三步 latent rollout，由分层解剖动作更新循环状态并逐步精化潜在表示，之后将潜在轨迹投影回解码器并与高分辨率特征结合生成最终分割。训练采用平衡分层动作目标 (balanced hierarchical action objective)，以应对前景稀疏、解剖组缺失以及加/减操作不平衡。
Result: 大量实验表明，该框架在 CT 中尺寸小、形状不规则且相互重叠的耳部结构分割上持续提升分割准确率，并将 HD95 降低超过 43%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果验证了潜在世界模型推理 (latent world-model reasoning) 对具有挑战性的医学图像分割任务的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Towards Real-Time PixOOD: Efficient Anomaly Segmentation for Autonomous Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Real-time anomaly segmentation is essential for the safety of autonomous systems. Although recent approaches offer high accuracy, their computational cost limits their deployment on embedded hardware. This work presents an efficient and accelerated pipeline designed for both embedded and desktop platforms, targeting the autonomous driving and railway domains. The proposed approach reformulates the Neyman-Pearson scoring stage of PixOOD, a state-of-the-art out-of-distribution detection method, and deploys the full pipeline through hardware-optimized TensorRT compilation, reaching up to 182 FPS on a desktop NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU and 75 FPS on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin embedded platform, respectively 20x and 18x faster than the original baseline. The achieved results demonstrate that advanced anomaly segmentation can be efficiently deployed for onboard processing in autonomous driving and railway applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶与铁路场景的实时异常分割（anomaly segmentation）问题，提出一种面向嵌入式与桌面平台的高效加速流水线。该工作重构了 PixOOD（一种先进的分布外检测方法）的 Neyman-Pearson 评分阶段，并通过硬件优化的 TensorRT 编译部署完整流水线，在桌面 NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU 上达到 182 FPS，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 嵌入式平台上达到 75 FPS，分别比原始基线快 20 倍和 18 倍。
Motivation: 现有异常分割方法虽然精度高，但计算成本限制了它们在嵌入式硬件上的部署，而实时异常分割对自动驾驶等自主系统的安全性至关重要。
Method: 对 PixOOD 的 Neyman-Pearson 评分阶段进行重构，并将完整流水线通过硬件优化的 TensorRT 编译进行部署，以同时覆盖嵌入式平台和桌面平台，面向自动驾驶与铁路两大应用领域。
Result: 摘要报告在 NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU 上达到 182 FPS，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上达到 75 FPS，相较原始基线分别提速 20 倍和 18 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明先进的异常分割方法可以被高效部署于自动驾驶和铁路应用的车载处理（onboard processing）中。该论文为 ICANN 2026 的 Efficient Deep Learning 研讨会录用论文，篇幅 12 页。

papers.title: A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks
papers.abstract_en: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification. Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，用于下水道管道严重性预测：Swin Transformer 从图像预测 14 种多标签检查 CODE 度数，J48 决策树路径被转换为 19 条固定 IF-THEN 规则，再通过模糊逻辑（t-norm 激活、s-norm 组合、规则置信度加权）得到可解释的严重性证据。在 3,244 张图像、五个高度不平衡严重性类别的数据集上，相比纯图像分类，accuracy、balanced accuracy、Macro F1 和 MCC 分别提升 17.9%、12.2%、23.0% 和 17.3%，兼顾类平衡性能与可追踪推理。
Motivation: 标准自动下水道管道严重性评估直接对图像分类，形成一种黑盒：视觉缺陷与最终严重性分数之间的关联是隐式的。作者希望解耦神经感知与符号推理，使推理过程可解释、可追踪。
Method: 感知模块使用 Swin Transformer 直接从图像预测 14 种多标签检查 CODE 度数；推理模块用 Weka 的 J48 决策树在 ground-truth CODE 与严重性标签上训练，并将树路径转换为 19 条 IF-THEN 规则。推理采用模糊逻辑：CODE 条件的 t-norm 激活按规则置信度加权，并用对应 s-norm 组合，生成可解释的类别证据；评估了 Product、Łukasiewicz 和 Hamacher 算子对。
Result: 在 3,244 张图像、五个高度不平衡严重性类别的数据集上，相对仅图像分类，accuracy 提升 17.9%，balanced accuracy 提升 12.2%，Macro F1 提升 23.0%，MCC 提升 17.3%。ground-truth 标签由五个独立大语言模型对原始检查员笔记的分析结果取共识生成。
Conclusion: 该框架将竞争性的类平衡性能与从预测 CODE 度数到规则支持再到严重性证据的可追踪推理相结合，缓解了黑盒问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将板载推理与生成式数据增强相结合的工作流，用于纳米卫星的自主飞机监视。推理在配备低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行，扩散模型通过低秩适配微调生成合成少数类图像，并由中间检测器自动伪标注后与经典增强样本合并。结果显示平衡数据集将全局平均精度从77.9%提升到82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升到0.811，量化检测器适配片上内存并实现25-30 FPS在轨处理。
Motivation: 低地球轨道空中监视受两个相互关联的瓶颈制约：纳米卫星下行链路预算有限，但传统方法仍传输大量原始图像到地面处理；开放卫星飞机数据集稀缺且类别严重不平衡，阻碍标准检测器学习少数类的鲁棒表示。
Method: 提出同时解决上述两个问题的工作流，即板载推理与生成数据增强结合。推理在搭载低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行；扩散模型通过低秩适配微调生成合成少数类图像，输出由中间检测器自动伪标注并与经典增强样本合并。
Result: 平衡数据集使全局平均精度从77.9%提高到82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提高到0.811；量化后的检测器适配片上内存，在轨可处理25-30帧每秒。
Conclusion: 计算测试支持该工作流作为从纳米卫星进行实时、自主空中监视的决策支持工具，与卫星仅作被动数据收集的常规弯曲管道架构形成对比。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Memory compression and physical state augmentation favor different AMOC prediction tasks
papers.abstract_en: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation is monitored and emulated through reduced indices, but such projections discard thermohaline structure and may require either explicit physical state or memory of the observed index. We compare these strategies in 30 branch-consistent CMIP6 trajectories from eight model families using leave-one-family-out validation. Salinity, temperature and density information improves direct 20-year forecasts, whereas compact scalar memory is top-ranked at every recursive horizon and yields the lowest case-averaged Brier score. A matched ablation confirms that feedback from memory improves long-horizon prediction. Physical state and recent trends also predict future ocean-state changes beyond the emissions pathway, most robustly at five years. NorESM under SSP5--8.5 identifies a forcing-dependent limit of scalar compression, while MIROC shows negative long-horizon transfer. A resolvent analysis explains why stable memory components do not guarantee stability of the complete learned model. Physical augmentation and memory compression therefore serve different AMOC prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 30 条来自八个模型族的分支一致 CMIP6 轨迹上，用留一族验证 (leave-one-family-out) 比较两类 AMOC 预测策略：显式物理状态（盐度、温度、密度）与紧凑标量记忆。结果表明盐度、温度和密度信息能改进直接 20 年预报，而紧凑标量记忆在每个递归预测时域上都排名最高，并取得最低的逐案例平均 Brier score。匹配消融实验确认记忆反馈能改善长时域预测，物理状态与近期趋势还能预测超越排放情景的未来海洋状态变化，且在五年尺度上最稳健。
Motivation: AMOC 常通过降维指标被监测和模拟，但这类投影会丢弃温盐环流结构，可能既需要显式物理状态，也需要观测指标的记忆。
Method: 在 30 条分支一致的 CMIP6 轨迹上，使用留一族验证比较显式物理状态增强与标量记忆压缩两种预测策略，并辅以匹配消融和 resolvent analysis 分析稳定性。
Result: 盐度、温度、密度信息提升直接 20 年预报；紧凑标量记忆在每个递归时域均排名最高且 Brier score 最低；记忆反馈改善长时域预测；物理状态与近期趋势预测超出排放路径的未来海洋状态变化，五年最稳健；NorESM 在 SSP5-8.5 下显示标量压缩的强迫依赖极限，MIROC 出现负的长时域迁移。
Conclusion: 物理增强与记忆压缩服务于不同的 AMOC 预测任务；resolvent analysis 表明稳定的记忆分量并不能保证完整学习模型的稳定性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoCLIP，一种针对结肠镜的视觉语言基础模型，从 280,476 份常规结肠镜报告中渐进恢复出 125,756 个病灶级图文对用于训练。在病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中，EndoCLIP 在零样本与线性探针 (linear probe) 设置下均优于通用和生物医学视觉语言编码器。在良恶性分类上，其线性探针在包含 12 位内镜专家的盲评中接近专家表现。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在结肠镜中未得到充分利用，常规报告虽记录了病灶外观、大小和位置，但总结的是整个检查过程而非逐帧描述，导致临床发现与对应图像之间只有弱关联。
Method: 作者开发 EndoCLIP，从大规模常规结肠镜报告中渐进式恢复病灶级图文对并训练视觉语言基础模型，然后在检索、报告生成和临床分类任务上评估，并用 12 位内镜专家的盲评比较良恶性分类性能。
Result: 在病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务上，EndoCLIP 在零样本和线性探针设置下均超过通用及生物医学视觉语言编码器；良恶性分类的线性探针性能接近专家读者。
Conclusion: 恢复发现与帧之间的对应关系可以将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标能够用语言描述而非为每个任务单独标注。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在病灶级图文检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务上，EndoCLIP 在零样本和线性探针设置下均超过通用及生物医学视觉语言编码器；良恶性分类的线性探针性能接近专家读者。
summary_sections.conclusion: 恢复发现与帧之间的对应关系可以将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标能够用语言描述而非为每个任务单独标注。

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Reason about AI Edits in Images?
papers.abstract_en: Detection and localization of AI-tampered images are critical for trustworthy AI, yet modern generative models have made such manipulations increasingly difficult to identify. While traditional binary classifiers can detect image tampering, they lack interpretability and generalization. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative due to their strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities; however, existing approaches typically rely on supervised finetuning with curated explanations rather than exploiting their inherent reasoning capabilities. In this work, we investigate whether VLMs can be trained to reason about AI-generated image edits using reinforcement learning (RL) rather than explicit reasoning supervision. Motivated by the success in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an RL technique that incentivizes the model to reason by generating thinking traces prior to giving the final answer, we propose a GRPO-based training framework that utilizes simple accuracy and format rewards. Given an input image, the model produces a structured reasoning trace and predicts whether the image has been tampered with. A lightweight segmentation model is then guided by the reasoning output to generate pixel-level localization masks. Experiments across multiple image manipulation datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive detection and localization performance compared to state-of-the-art image forgery detectors, despite requiring substantially weaker supervision. We introduce effective intersection over union (eff-IoU), a unified metric to jointly evaluate detection and localization. These results suggest that reinforcement learning provides an effective and scalable mechanism for teaching VLMs to reason about AI-generated content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否不依赖显式推理监督，而用强化学习 (RL) 训练视觉语言模型 (VLM) 对 AI 编辑图像进行推理。作者提出基于 GRPO 的训练框架，模型先产生结构化推理轨迹再判断图像是否被篡改，并用轻量分割模型依据推理输出生成像素级定位掩码；同时引入 eff-IoU 作为统一评价指标。实验表明该方法在多个图像篡改数据集上达到与最先进的图像伪造检测器相当的性能，但所需监督明显更弱。
Motivation: 传统二分类器能检测图像篡改但缺乏可解释性和泛化能力；现有 VLM 方案通常依赖带人工解释的监督微调，没有利用模型固有的推理能力，因此作者探索用 RL 而非推理监督来训练 VLM 进行推理。
Method: 提出基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 的训练框架，仅使用简单的准确率和格式奖励；模型输入图像后生成结构化推理轨迹并输出是否被篡改的预测，再由轻量分割模型根据推理结果生成像素级定位掩码。文中还提出 eff-IoU 这一统一指标来联合评估检测和定位性能。
Result: 在多个图像操纵数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比当前最先进的图像伪造检测器取得了有竞争力的检测与定位性能，同时需要显著更弱的监督。
Conclusion: 摘要认为强化学习为教导 VLM 对 AI 生成内容进行推理提供了一种有效且可扩展的机制。

papers.title: VisualRouter: Query-Grounded Visual Sampling for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved significant progress in video understanding, yet understanding long videos remains challenging due to the large number of visual tokens and limited context windows. Visual sampling provides a practical solution by selecting an informative subset of frames. However, existing methods typically either rely on relevance-aware sampling, leading to redundant frame selection and insufficient temporal coverage, or adopt a fixed sampling strategy regardless of query type. In this paper, we propose VisualRouter, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for query-grounded visual sampling. VisualRouter first classifies each query as either global or local and then applies the corresponding sampling strategy. For global queries, it employs a relevance-coverage hybrid strategy that preserves temporal coverage while retaining query-relevant visual evidence. For local queries, it adopts an event-aware frame selection strategy that performs event partitioning, segment-level frame allocation, and intra-event frame selection, jointly balancing relevance, coverage, and diversity with a limited number of input frames. Experiments show that VisualRouter consistently improves multiple LVLMs over uniform sampling, achieving gains of 5.2%, 7.7%, and 11.6% on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and outperforming existing training-free visual sampling methods under the same setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisualRouter，一个无需训练、即插即用的查询引导视觉采样框架，用于长视频理解。它先将查询分类为全局或局部，再分别采用对应的帧采样策略：全局查询使用相关性-覆盖混合策略，局部查询使用事件感知的帧选择策略。实验表明，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，该方法在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上相比均匀采样分别提升 5.2%、7.7% 和 11.6%，并优于同设置下其他无需训练的视觉采样方法。
Motivation: 长视频理解中，大量视觉 token 与有限的上下文窗口构成主要挑战。现有视觉采样方法要么采用相关性感知采样，导致帧冗余和时间覆盖不足；要么采用固定采样策略，忽略查询类型的差异。
Method: 提出 VisualRouter，一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，先将每个查询分类为全局（global）或局部（local），再应用相应策略。全局查询采用相关性-覆盖混合策略，在保留时间覆盖的同时保留与查询相关的视觉证据；局部查询采用事件感知帧选择策略，通过事件划分、段级帧分配和事件内帧选择，在有限帧数下联合平衡相关性、覆盖度和多样性。
Result: 实验显示，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，VisualRouter 在 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 和 MLVU 上相比均匀采样分别取得 5.2%、7.7% 和 11.6% 的提升，并在相同设置下优于现有无需训练的视觉采样方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，无需训练且按查询类型自适应的视觉采样方法可以一致地提升多个 LVLM 在长视频理解任务上的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cybersecurity Detection Classification with Reasoning-enabled Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A major issue in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) is alert fatigue, as the number of detections reported is more than staff can triage in a given day. Prior work prompts or fine-tunes large language models (LLMs) to emit a triage label directly, but does not train them to reason about whether a detection is a genuine threat. We train a chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning-enabled triage classifier on real, human-labeled Windows endpoint detections by combining automated prompt optimization, self-training, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. We find that CoT reasoning also degrades the label-token probabilities that automated triage relies on, so we separately train a calibrator that reads the full reasoning trace and estimates the probability that the verdict is correct. Our system reaches 82.6% test accuracy and, at the high-confidence operating point that governs automated triage, improves benign recall by 43.0% and malicious recall by 18.3% over a direct-label LLM classifier. We further show that the trained calibrator is necessary - an untrained confidence judge collapses high-confidence recall to zero - and that a finetuned 30B model significantly outperforms frontier general-purpose models, motivating targeted training over scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对安全运营中心(SOC)的告警疲劳问题，提出一种带推理能力的告警分类方法。作者在真实人工标注的Windows端点检测数据上，结合自动提示优化、自训练和带可验证奖励的强化学习，训练了一个链式思维(CoT)推理告警分类器。系统达到82.6%的测试准确率，并在高置信度运行点上相比直接标签LLM分类器将良性召回率提升43.0%、恶意召回率提升18.3%。作者还展示了校准器(cailibrator)的必要性，并发现微调的30B模型显著优于前沿通用模型。
Motivation: 安全运营中心(SOC)面临告警疲劳，检测数量超过人员每日可处理的量。已有工作直接提示或微调大语言模型(LLM)输出分诊标签，但没有训练模型推理检测是否为真实威胁。
Method: 训练一个链式思维(CoT)推理型分诊分类器，使用真实人工标注的Windows端点检测数据，结合自动提示优化(auto prompt optimization)、自训练(self-training)和带可验证奖励的强化学习(reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards)。另外训练一个校准器(calibrator)，读取完整推理轨迹并估计判定正确的概率。
Result: 系统达到82.6%的测试准确率；在高置信度运行点(管控自动分诊)上，良性召回率提升43.0%，恶意召回率提升18.3%，对比直接标签LLM分类器。未训练的置信度判断会使高置信度召回率降至零，表明训练校准器是必要的。微调的30B模型明显胜过前沿通用模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对性的训练比单纯扩大模型规模更有效，并且校准器对可靠的高置信度推理分诊至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LeanCSP，一个在 Lean 定理证明器中验证约束规划 (constraint programming) 的 reformulation 与求解过程的框架。它覆盖两层验证：面向整个问题族参数化地证明等价性、equisatisfiability 以及对称性破坏约束的正确性；并通过翻译后端（MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB）检查单个实例的求解器证书。将两层结合可得到不信任外部求解器的端到端工作流，从而确立约束问题的可满足性或不可满足性。
Motivation: 约束规划被用于调度、规划、配置和验证等关键场景，因此其结果需要两层保证：前置的 reformulation 必须保持语义，求解器必须给出正确答案。现有工具往往只覆盖其中一层，缺乏同时验证两层的统一方案。
Method: 框架基于 Lean 定理证明器实现两层验证：第一层参数化地证明 formulation-level 属性，如等价性、equisatisfiability 和对称性破坏正确性，适用于整个问题族；第二层通过到 MiniZinc、SMT-LIB 和 OPB 等外部格式的翻译后端，检查求解器为具体实例生成的证书。
Result: 实验表明，经过验证的对称性破坏在实践中有效：每个问题族只需一个可复用所有实例规模的参数化证明，即可将求解器搜索工作量最多降低至原来的 2x10^7 分之一；同时整个 in-Lean 认证过程成本可控，最大实例也只需几分钟。
Conclusion: 作者强调，双层次验证组合可形成端到端工作流，在不信任外部求解器的前提下建立约束问题的可满足或不可满足结论，且验证开销在实际规模下可接受。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
papers.abstract_en: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer only when the verdict is Correct and confidence exceeds a threshold, and otherwise continues refinement using its own self-verification. Ground-truth correctness is used only to construct training rewards and is never exposed to the policy through refinement prompts or required at inference. SVR is trained with GRPO on fixed-horizon trajectories using rewards that promote solution correctness, calibration-aware self-verification, and stop-ready correct states; adaptive stopping is activated only at inference. On seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3.5-2B, SVR achieves a macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with only 2.99 inference turns on average. In the evaluated complete-system comparison, it exceeds standard GRPO, strong multi-turn baselines, and a fixed-budget oracle-guided score-feedback reference while requiring substantially fewer turns than fixed ten-turn inference. These results demonstrate that learned self-verification can serve as an effective internal control signal for answer retention and adaptive test-time compute allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR)，一个无外部 oracle 的多轮强化学习框架，让模型在每一轮同时输出解答、离散正确性判定 (verdict) 和置信度分数，仅当判定为 Correct 且置信度超过阈值时才保留当前答案，否则基于自身验证继续细化。训练采用 GRPO 在固定长度轨迹上进行，自适应停止只在推理时启用。在七个数学推理基准上，Qwen3.5-2B 达到宏平均准确率 0.563，平均仅用 2.99 轮推理。
Motivation: 均匀分配测试时计算会浪费在简单输入上，而 verifier-guided refinement 依赖外部反馈。作者希望用模型自身的自验证作为计算控制信号，实现无外部 oracle 的自适应测试时计算分配。
Method: 提出 SVR，一种无 oracle 的多轮强化学习框架。每轮模型生成解决方案以及离散正确性判定和置信度分数；保留答案的条件是判定为 Correct 且置信度超过阈值，否则基于自验证继续细化。ground-truth 仅用于构造训练奖励，不暴露给策略；训练使用 GRPO，奖励涵盖解答正确性、校准感知的自验证和正确可停止状态。
Result: 在七个数学推理基准上，Qwen3.5-2B 的宏平均准确率为 0.563，平均推理轮数仅 2.99。完整系统对比中，SVR 超过标准 GRPO、强多轮基线和固定预算的 oracle-guided score-feedback 参考，同时比固定十轮推理使用更少的轮数。
Conclusion: 摘要认为学习到的自验证可以作为答案保留与自适应测试时计算分配的有效内部控制信号。

papers.title: Graph Neural Multilevel Preconditioners for Iterative Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Solving large, sparse linear systems is a core task in scientific computing, and efficient iterative solvers rely critically on effective and robust preconditioning. While classical methods such as algebraic multigrid (AMG) are highly scalable, their robustness can degrade on indefinite or nonsymmetric systems where heuristics originally developed for elliptic PDEs are less reliable. Recently, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as data-driven preconditioners; yet, the practical impact of imposing an AMG-style hierarchy remains underexplored for general sparse matrices. In this work, we propose a Graph Neural Multilevel Preconditioner (GMP) that adopts an AMG hierarchy as a structural prior and learns smoothing, restriction, and interpolation operators in a unified framework. Our method targets general sparse systems and is instantiated as a drop-in preconditioner for standard Krylov solvers. On a benchmark of over 800 sparse matrices, we compare against classical AMG, single-level ILUT, and state-of-the-art GNN preconditioners, and characterize the regimes where multilevel graph neural preconditioning improves convergence or, conversely, introduces overhead relative to strong single-level baselines. These results highlight both the promise and the limitations of enforcing AMG-style multilevel structure in learned preconditioners for large-scale scientific simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种图神经网络多级预条件子 (Graph Neural Multilevel Preconditioner, GMP)，以代数多重网格 (AMG) 层级作为结构先验，在一个统一框架中学习光滑算子、限制算子和插值算子，并作为标准 Krylov 求解器的即插即用预条件子。在超过 800 个稀疏矩阵的基准上，作者与经典 AMG、单层 ILUT 及现有 GNN 预条件子比较，刻画了多级图神经网络预条件在哪些情况下能改善收敛、哪些情况下相对强单层基线引入额外开销。
Motivation: 大型稀疏线性系统的迭代求解器高度依赖有效且鲁棒的预条件；经典 AMG 对椭圆 PDE 启发式假设在不定或非对称系统上鲁棒性下降，而现有 GNN 预条件子很少系统考察施加 AMG 式层级结构的实际影响。
Method: 提出 GMP，将 AMG 层级结构作为先验，在一个统一框架中学习光滑、限制和插值算子，并作为标准 Krylov 求解器的即插即用预条件子，面向一般稀疏矩阵。
Result: 在超过 800 个稀疏矩阵的基准上，与经典 AMG、单层 ILUT 和最先进的 GNN 预条件子比较；结果表明多级图神经网络预条件在某些场景改善收敛，但在其他场景相对强单层基线会引入开销。
Conclusion: 作者强调在学习的预条件子中强制加入 AMG 式多级结构既有前景也有局限，需要根据问题类型权衡收敛收益与额外计算开销。

papers.title: Machines that know they are aging: a framework for hardware-aware autonomous intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems inevitably age, yet their artificial intelligence typically assumes hardware remains in its original condition. Batteries degrade, sensors drift, processors accumulate timing errors, and memory reliability declines, creating a growing mismatch between assumed and actual capability. This can lead to agnostic collapse, where mission failure arises from accumulated hardware degradation rather than a single component fault. We propose Aging-Aware Autonomous Intelligence (AAAI), a framework that integrates hardware health directly into reasoning, planning, and mission execution. AAAI is built on three pillars: hardware self-awareness, which continuously estimates the health of power, sensing, memory, and computation subsystems using physics-of-failure models; self-adaptive reasoning, which adjusts inference complexity, planning horizon, and task priorities according to remaining hardware capability; and survival-centric intelligence, which allocates remaining operational life across mission objectives through performance optimization, resource conservation, and graceful degradation. Rather than introducing new hardware, AAAI unifies prognostics, lifecycle management, and hardware-aware computing into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. We argue that such integration is essential for autonomous systems operating in inaccessible or safety-critical environments, including space missions, marine robotics, and implantable medical devices. By enabling machines to recognize and respond to their own aging, AAAI improves resilience, extends operational lifetime, and supports safer, more graceful mission completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aging-Aware Autonomous Intelligence (AAAI) 框架，将硬件健康状态直接纳入自主系统的推理、规划与任务执行，以应对硬件老化导致的假设能力与实际能力之间的失配。框架基于三大支柱：硬件的持续自感知（利用 physics-of-failure 模型估计电源、传感、内存和计算子系统的健康）、自适应推理（根据剩余硬件能力调整推理复杂度、规划时域和任务优先级）以及以生存为中心的智能（在任务目标间分配剩余运行寿命，实现性能优化、资源节约和优雅降级）。作者强调该集成对不可达或安全关键环境（如太空任务、海洋机器人和植入式医疗设备）中的自主系统必不可少。
Motivation: 自主系统不可避免会老化，但现有 AI 通常假设硬件维持原始状态；电池退化、传感器漂移、处理器时序错误积累和内存可靠性下降会造成假设能力与实际能力的失配，进而引发由累积硬件退化而非单点故障导致的整体性任务失败 (agnostic collapse)。
Method: AAAI 是一个不引入新硬件的闭环认知架构，统一了 prognostics、生命周期管理和硬件感知计算；具体包括持续估计电源、传感、内存和计算子系统健康度的硬件自感知、随剩余能力调整推理复杂度和规划时域的自适应推理，以及通过性能优化、资源保存和优雅降级来分配剩余运行寿命的生存中心智能。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或基准验证；该文以框架性论证为主，主张上述集成能提升系统韧性、延长运行寿命并支持更安全、更优雅的任务完成。
Conclusion: 作者认为将硬件老化感知整合进智能体认知架构，对运行于不可达或安全关键环境的自主系统是必要的，使机器能够识别并响应自身老化，从而提高韧性并延长任务执行窗口。

papers.title: ViewMind3D: Modular View-Aware Inference for Training-Free 3D-QA
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled new possibilities for 3D question answering (3D-QA), a key capability for embodied AI and robotic perception. However, most existing methods rely on 3D-specific training or fine-tuning with costly annotations, limiting their scalability and real-world applicability. We present \textbf{ViewMind3D}, a fully training-free and modular framework for 3D spatial reasoning over multi-view observations of a scene without requiring complete 3D reconstruction. The framework decomposes the 3D-QA task into four interpretable components: (1) question-driven multi-view selection, (2) guided visual grounding with language-conditioned object cues, (3) spatial context encoding via a bird's-eye-view (BEV) viewpoint indicator, and (4) structured answer generation through role-based reasoning. This design enables structured, robust, and interpretable reasoning without requiring model tuning. Experimental results on ScanQA and SQA3D show that ViewMind3D achieves competitive performance compared to prior training-free and fine-tuned 3D-LLMs. In particular, our method improves performance on spatially grounded question types, such as ``What'' questions in SQA3D, while maintaining strong overall accuracy (50.8\%) and achieving 73.4 CIDEr on ScanQA. These results demonstrate that effective 3D reasoning can be achieved through modular orchestration of general-purpose LLMs and VLMs for robotic perception in real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViewMind3D，一个完全无需训练 (training-free) 的模块化框架，用于基于多视角场景观测的 3D 问答 (3D-QA)，不需要完整 3D 重建或 3D 专用微调。框架将任务分解为四个可解释组件，并编排通用 LLM/VLM 完成空间推理。在 ScanQA 和 SQA3D 上取得与既有 training-free 及微调 3D-LLM 相当的性能，尤其改善 SQA3D 中空间接地型问题（如 “What” 问题），并在 ScanQA 上达到 50.8% 总体准确率和 73.4 CIDEr。
Motivation: 现有 3D-QA 方法大多依赖 3D 专用训练或带昂贵标注的微调，限制了可扩展性和实际部署；论文希望在不做模型调优的情况下，仅靠通用 LLM/VLM 的模块化编排实现有效的 3D 空间推理。
Method: 将 3D-QA 分解为四个可解释组件：问题驱动的多视角选择 (question-driven multi-view selection)、语言条件目标线索引导的视觉定位 (guided visual grounding)、鸟瞰视角 (bird's-eye-view, BEV) 指示器编码空间上下文，以及基于角色推理的结构化答案生成；全程不需要模型微调。
Result: 在 ScanQA 和 SQA3D 上，ViewMind3D 相比先前的 training-free 与微调 3D-LLM 具有竞争力；具体地，它在 SQA3D 的空间接地问题类型（如 “What” 问题）上表现更好，同时保持 50.8% 的总体准确率，并在 ScanQA 上达到 73.4 CIDEr。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过模块化编排通用 LLM 和 VLM，可以在真实环境中实现有效的 3D 推理，而无需 3D 专用训练或完整重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory
papers.abstract_en: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 short-term graph memory，一种用于分子优化（molecular optimization）的即插即用模块，在固定 oracle 预算下通过在线图神经网络代理（graph neural surrogate）对每轮候选池预筛选，将预算花在预测效用更高的分子上。该模块保持生成器架构和原生更新规则不变，并在标准分子优化基准上提升了平均 top-10 分数，且不增加 oracle 调用成本；在 1000 次调用的紧预算下，四个测试生成器均受益。作者还分析了代理引导选择如何与不同生成器的探索/利用行为相互作用。
Motivation: 分子优化通常在有限的 oracle 预算下进行，因此决定评估哪些分子与决定生成哪些分子同样重要，现有方法缺少对这种选择性评估的显式建模。
Method: 引入 short-term graph memory：一个在线图神经网络代理持续从已评估分子中学习，对每轮生成器产出的候选池进行预筛选，使固定 oracle 预算优先用于高预测效用的分子，且不改变生成器架构与更新规则。
Result: 在标准分子优化基准上，该模块使基于片段的生成器（fragment-based generator）的平均 top-10 分数提升且无额外 oracle 成本，并在任何 oracle 上都不低于基线；在 1000 次调用的紧预算下，四个测试生成器均获得增益。更大预算下的收益与骨干的两个性质一致：搜索的广泛程度，以及其原生搜索利用 oracle 反馈的有效程度。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种更选择性地花费固定 oracle 预算的简单方法，并给出哪些生成器能从该策略中受益的证据。

papers.title: Metaphor Tracer: A Theory-Informed Analysis of Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: What do a language model's hidden states say about the organization of a single text? From one forward pass, without training, we score every token position on two properties. The *aggregator* measures whether the position consolidates the whole text into a stable configuration. The *differentiator*, whether other tokens are transiently carried into its subspace as the model reads: metaphor in its root sense, transport. Constants were frozen on one discovery text; every other is confirmatory. The aggregator is not, in the classic sense, an information measure, nor a measure of salience. Across three unrelated models, as a signifier repeats, its surprisal and its attention drain while its aggregator score holds: the channel marks a token's place in the text. That this tracks a reading rests on independent ground truth: an engineered register the aggregator follows across its boundaries (6/6 cells), and a psychoanalyst's marking of clinical transcripts, fixed before the instrument existed, in 34/36 cells, with a graded increment above lexical controls and dissociations no type-level measure reproduces. A transfer test gives the result its shape: the model whose token structure travels with lexical type reads the singular discourse worst, and in a matched base/instruct pair tuning raises fidelity without moving type-transfer. Structural value is a property of a token's place in *this* text, not of its vector alone: a relational rather than essentialist reading of hidden states, operationalizing theory that predated the instrument.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Metaphor Tracer，一种无需训练的隐藏状态分析方法：仅用一次前向传播，就给每个 token 位置计算两个属性——aggregator（该位置是否把全文整合为稳定构型）与 differentiator（其他 token 是否被暂时携带进其子空间，即隐喻本义的“运输”）。作者在一个发现文本上固定常量，其余文本全部作为验证，跨三个无关模型显示：当符号重复时，其 surprisal 和 attention 下降而 aggregator 分数保持，表明该通道标记 token 在文本中的位置。摘要报告其在人工设计的 register 上 6/6 单元格跟随，在精神分析师预先标注的临床转录本上 34/36 单元格匹配。
Motivation: 现有工作多把隐藏状态视为 token 向量的本质属性，本文试图回答语言模型的隐藏状态如何组织单个文本，并主张一种关系性（relational）而非本质主义（essentialist）的解读，即结构价值属于 token 在“这一个”文本中的位置。
Method: 不训练模型，从一次前向传播中对每个 token 位置打分两个属性：aggregator 衡量位置是否将全文巩固为稳定构型，differentiator 衡量其他 token 是否被短暂携带进其子空间。常量只在一个发现文本上固定，其余文本均为确认性验证；并用人工 register 和精神分析师的临床转录标注作为独立真值。
Result: 随着符号重复，surprisal 和 attention 下降而 aggregator 分数保持；aggregator 在人工 register 上 6/6 个单元格跟随其边界，在精神分析师预先固定的临床转录标注上 34/36 个单元格匹配，且呈现高于词汇对照的分级增量，并出现类型级（type-level）度量无法复现的分离。迁移测试显示：token 结构随词汇类型游走的模型对单一话语的阅读最差，在匹配的 base/instruct 对中，调优提升保真度但不改变类型迁移。
Conclusion: 结构价值是 token 在特定文本中位置的属性，而非其向量单独决定；作者将先于该工具出现的理论操作化，主张一种关系性的隐藏状态解读。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNICON (UNified In-Context Operator Networks)，一个在数值上下文 (numerical context) 中展现跨学科智能的基础模型。模型以同一系统的图结构示例为上下文，推断其中共享的预测关系并应用到该系统的查询上；在训练中未出现的学科上，同一模型无需重训练即可接近专家水平性能。与语言模型智能体结合后，模型还能在未见学科上超越 state-of-the-art 专家，且训练语料多样性会进一步提升对未见学科的泛化能力。
Motivation: 智能常被理解为从语言上下文中获取并应用知识的能力，但科学和社会系统同样需要从数值上下文获取与运用知识；现有方法缺少面向这种数值智能 (numerical intelligence) 的基础模型。
Method: 引入 UNICON，一种统一上下文算子网络 (in-context operator network)，使用系统提供的图结构示例作为上下文，从中推断跨示例共享的预测关系，并将该关系应用于同一系统的查询；此外研究将 UNICON 与语言模型智能体结合的方式。
Result: 摘要报告 UNICON 在包括训练中未出现学科在内的科学与社会系统中，无需重训练即可逼近专家性能；结合语言模型智能体后，在未见学科上超越 state-of-the-art 专家，并显示训练语料多样性有利于对未见学科的泛化。
Conclusion: 作者将 UNICON 定位为数值智能的基础模型，并认为它可以作为更广泛人工智能生态系统的构建模块。

papers.title: Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $ρ(B_γ)\leq 1+δ$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $Ω(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables, was presented at the 10th International Conference 'Deep Learning on Computational Physics (DLCP2026)', under review for the Moscow University Physics Bulletin, Physics series
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE)，一种受物理启发的基于能量的模型，用稀疏图上的谱嵌入取代稠密 CNN 分类器。它将预训练特征映射到准循环 LDPC 图上，构造正则化 Laplacian 作为 Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian，并通过 FFT 与低阶 Rayleigh refinement 在 O(N log N + k^2_mode N) 时间内求解 D 个独立的通道谱问题。在 ImageNet-1000 的 transductive 协议下，使用冻结的 EfficientNet-B4 特征（D=1792），KSSE 以约 21.24M 参数达到 88.93% Top-1 准确率。
Motivation: 论文针对稠密 CNN 分类器在参数规模和计算开销上的瓶颈，试图用稀疏图上的物理启发射谱嵌入作为替代，从而在不依赖大规模 Transformer 的情况下获得具有竞争力的分类精度。
Method: KSSE 将预训练特征映射到准循环低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）图上，构造一个作为 Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian 的正则化 Laplacian，利用 Z/pZ 的 Pontryagin 自对偶性在循环块上通过 FFT 求解 D 个通道谱问题，并用低阶 Rayleigh refinement 精化。图拓扑通过 star-domain surgery 优化：构造边位移在码字附近形成局部凸性，同时将残余 frustration 限制在 ρ(B_γ)≤1+δ。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1000 transductive 协议下，KSSE 以约 21.24M 参数达到 88.93% Top-1 准确率，优于 Swin-L（197M，86.4-87.3%），并匹配 ViT-H/14（632M，88.0-89.5%）在标准 inductive 设置下的表现，模型规模分别减少约 10 倍和 30 倍。
Conclusion: 论文证明六个理论结果，包括推广的 Ihara-Bass 恒等式、trapping-set 特征值对应、加性通道可分离性、surgery 定理、拟平稳扰动界和不动点收敛定理，并展示物理启发的谱嵌入可以在大幅降低参数量的同时匹配大规模视觉 Transformer 的分类性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Negative controls reveal volume-driven confounding in radiomics and imaging foundation model features
papers.abstract_en: Radiomics and imaging foundation models promise non-invasive biomarkers of tumour biology, yet predictive signatures may reflect tumour volume or acquisition artifacts rather than meaningful image structure. We introduce READII-2-ROQC, an open-source framework that uses volume-preserving negative controls to assess whether radiomic and deep imaging features capture independent spatial signals. READII-2-ROQC generates voxel-perturbed images across tumour, background and whole-image regions using configurable randomization strategies, then compares feature behaviour and model performance between original and control images. Applied to three public cancer imaging cohorts, the framework processed 3,552 tumour volumes and extracted PyRadiomics and foundation-model features from original images and nine matched controls. Reproducing published survival and HPV-status signatures, we show that multiple models retain performance after spatial structure is destroyed, revealing volume-driven or contextual confounding, whereas others show perturbation-sensitive signal. READII-2-ROQC provides a scalable quality-control strategy for developing interpretable, biologically grounded imaging biomarkers and reproducible radiomics workflows.
papers.comment: 22 pages (including supplementary), 6 figures, 2 supplementary tables, 5 supplementary figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 READII-2-ROQC，一个开源的影像组学与成像基础模型特征质量控制框架，通过体积保持的负对照（volume-preserving negative controls）来检测预测特征是否受肿瘤体积或采集伪影混淆。框架在三个公开癌症影像队列、3552 个肿瘤体积上应用，对 PyRadiomics 和基础模型特征在原始图像及九种匹配对照图像间比较特征行为与模型性能。结果显示部分已发表的生存与 HPV 状态签名在空间结构被破坏后仍保持性能，表明存在体积驱动或情境性混淆，而另一些特征则表现出对扰动的敏感信号。
Motivation: 影像组学与成像基础模型被用作肿瘤生物学的非侵入性生物标志物，但预测签名可能反映肿瘤体积或采集伪影而非有意义的图像结构，需要系统性的质量控制方法来判别特征是否捕获独立的空间信号。
Method: 提出 READII-2-ROQC 框架，利用体积保持的负对照，在肿瘤区域、背景区域和全图像区域生成体素扰动图像，并采用可配置的随机化策略；随后比较原始图像与对照图像之间的特征行为和模型性能。
Result: 框架处理了 3,552 个肿瘤体积，从原始图像和九个匹配对照中提取 PyRadiomics 与基础模型特征；再现已发表的生存和 HPV 状态签名，发现多种模型在空间结构被破坏后仍保持性能，揭示体积驱动或情境性混淆，而其他模型显示对扰动敏感的信号。
Conclusion: READII-2-ROQC 提供了一种可扩展的质量控制策略，用于开发可解释、生物学可信的成像生物标志物和可复现的影像组学工作流；摘要未提及明显的局限性。

papers.title: QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction
papers.abstract_en: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QAdapt，一个面向表面码量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码框架。它捕获 syndrome 数据中的局部时空相关性，顺序适应漂移的噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，然后将残差 syndrome 转发给传统全局解码器。在 110 种合成分布外噪声配置和 Google Willow 基准数据上，QAdapt 均降低了逻辑错误率并缩短了后端解码延迟。
Motivation: 容错量子计算的性能不仅受物理噪声限制，还受经典解码器处理快速生成 syndrome 数据的延迟限制；硬件噪声强、异构且非平稳，加上模拟到硬件的分布漂移会显著降低固定神经解码器的效果。
Method: QAdapt 是一个噪声自适应的神经预解码框架：它提取 syndrome 数据的局部时空关联，通过顺序自适应跟踪变化的噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，再把残差 syndrome 交给常规全局解码器完成最终解码。
Result: 在 110 种rotated surface-code memory circuits 的合成分布外噪声配置上，QAdapt 一致地降低了相对神经预解码基线的逻辑错误率；在 Google Willow 基准数据上，无需目标域微调即可实现逻辑错误率最高降低 5.79%，后端解码延迟最高降低 9.32%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 QAdapt 提供了一种实用且与解码器兼容的方式，可在演化的硬件噪声下提升量子纠错的鲁棒性和后端解码效率。

papers.title: When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.
papers.comment: 25 pages, including references and supplementary material; 3 figures and 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出派生特征过度信任（derived-feature over-trust, DFOT）这一概念，指LLM把实例依赖性有效的派生测量当作直接事实使用。以生理传感为例，作者定义了五个估测量（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM、UHR）来量化LLM对PPG派生心律与离线ECG证据冲突时的行为，并用ECG到PPG的特权蒸馏（privileged distillation）作为基线方法，在5万对PPG-ECG记录上验证框架。
Motivation: 派生测量（如由PPG推算的心律）被直接输入LLM流程作为事实，但其有效性依赖具体实例；LLM可能过度信任这类测量并在其有效范围外使用，现有评估缺乏对这一失败模式的系统性度量。
Method: 定义DFOT及其五个估计量；以ECG作为训练监督和离线参考但永不展示给LLM，构建两个测试任务D1（接受被离线ECG反驳的PPG心律）和D2（在误导性严重病史下拒绝离线确认的可靠PPG心律）。采用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为说明性基线与仅PPG推理对比，框架不依赖特定可靠性生成器。
Result: 在协议固定的187患者测试集上，基线在四个修复与特异性端点提升1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间不含零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4 到 +1.7）。
Conclusion: DFOT为更强缓解方法提供了统一评估目标；摘要未讨论具体局限性。代码已开源。

papers.title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WIDE，一个端到端可微的 token 级动态宽度剪枝 (token-level dynamic width pruning) 框架，面向 LLM 推理的 prefill 与 decode 两个阶段。WIDE 允许每个 token 动态选择注意力头组和 FFN 通道组，将动态剪枝从 layer 级扩展到 neuron-block 级粒度，并配合两阶段训练流程学习 token 级稀疏执行模式。在 50% 稀疏度下，WIDE 相比最先进的动态深度剪枝在仅校准 (calibration-only) 设置下带来 55.1% 的性能提升，并实现接近理论值的 kernel 级加速与显著端到端加速。
Motivation: 现有静态结构化剪枝硬件友好但计算分配与输入无关，在激进稀疏度下精度损失严重；近期动态稀疏方法虽能按输入自适应分配计算，但多限于粗粒度的结构决策，且在实际推理场景中的加速效果存疑。WIDE 的目标是实现细粒度、可实用的动态剪枝。
Method: WIDE 提出 token 级动态宽度剪枝，让每个 token 独立选择注意力头组与 FFN 通道组，并设计两阶段训练流程学习 token 级稀疏执行模式。为落地细粒度动态剪枝，作者进一步提出剪枝-内核协同设计 (pruning-kernel co-design)，将动态稀疏加速分解为 mask 重排、硬件无关的 block 级跳过和硬件相关的 intra-block 跳过三部分。
Result: 在 50% 稀疏度下，WIDE 相比最先进的动态深度剪枝在 calibration-only 设置下取得 55.1% 的性能提升；prefill 与 decode 的 kernel 级加速最高分别达 1.98x 和 4.95x，端到端加速分别为 1.68x 和 1.55x。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 WIDE 是首个同时面向 prefill 和 decode 的端到端可微 token 级动态宽度剪枝框架，在保持较好质量的同时将细粒度动态剪枝推进到可实用的程度，并公开了代码。

papers.title: QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜空间世界模型 (latent world model) 中正则化目标对尾部样本梯度消失的问题，提出 QQWorld，用分位数-分位数匹配 (quantile-quantile matching) 替代 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 中基于 Epps-Pulley (EP) 的各向同性高斯正则化。作者进一步提出跨批次 QQ 以扩大有效排序池，并刻画其偏差-方差权衡。在四个控制环境中，QQWorld 提高了 LeWM 的平均规划成功率，并带来更好的高斯对齐和更薄的潜变量尾部。
Motivation: LeWM 使用 Epps-Pulley (EP) 目标将潜变量正则化为各向同性高斯，但 EP 的校正梯度在孤立尾部样本上迅速消失，导致重尾偏差得不到有效控制，限制了潜空间建模质量与后续规划表现。
Method: 提出 QQWorld，用分位数-分位数匹配目标直接对齐投影后的潜样本与按秩匹配的高斯分位数，使尾部保持有效校正梯度；并开发 cross-batch QQ，利用前一批次中分离的样本扩大有效排序池，同时分析其偏差-方差权衡。
Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld 相比 LeWM 提升了平均规划成功率，并且持续获得更好的高斯对齐和更薄的潜变量尾部。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用分位数匹配替代 EP 目标可以修复世界模型正则化中的尾部梯度消失问题，从而提升规划成功率；跨批次设计在排序池大小与偏差之间提供了可控的权衡。

papers.title: Windowed thinning and query complexity for the bouncy particle and Zigzag samplers
papers.abstract_en: Let $μ(d x)\propto e^{-U(x)} d x$ on $\R^d$, where $U$ is $m$-strongly convex and $L$-smooth, and denote by $κ=L/m$ the condition number. We consider windowed thinning, an exact simulation method for the bouncy particle sampler and the coordinate Zigzag process. The method divides a trajectory into deterministic windows and uses a gradient evaluation at the beginning of each window to construct a tractable local envelope for the event rate. Combining this construction with quantitative mixing estimates and finite-time bounds on the expected numbers of bounces and flips yields query complexity guarantees from a Gaussian cold start.
