papers.title: Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Oversmoothing is a fundamental limitation of deep graph neural networks (GNNs), where repeated message passing causes node representations to become increasingly similar, eventually collapsing toward a low-dimensional subspace. This phenomenon limits the effective depth of message-passing architectures and motivates the search for mechanisms that preserve representation diversity. In this paper, we study a recurrent graph neural network in which independent Gaussian noise is injected after every propagation step and analyze the resulting architecture as a stochastic dynamical system. Under a standard global contraction assumption on the deterministic update, we prove that the hidden representations form a geometrically ergodic Markov chain admitting a unique invariant probability measure. Our main theoretical result establishes an explicit positive lower bound on the expected stationary Dirichlet energy, proportional to both the noise variance and the spectral gap of the underlying graph. Consequently, the stationary representations cannot collapse onto the constant manifold, providing a rigorous guarantee that asymptotic oversmoothing is prevented in the sense of non-vanishing Dirichlet energy. Our analysis reveals persistent stochastic perturbations as a fundamentally different mechanism for combating oversmoothing, complementing existing deterministic approaches based on residual connections, normalization, and graph rewiring. Finally, numerical experiments on both linear and nonlinear recurrent graph neural networks closely match the theoretical predictions, illustrating the emergence of a stationary distribution and the predicted dependence of the limiting Dirichlet energy on the noise intensity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种在每次传播后注入独立高斯噪声的循环图神经网络 (recurrent GNN)，并将其作为随机动力系统分析。在确定性更新的标准全局收缩假设下，作者证明隐表示构成几何遍历的马尔可夫链，存在唯一不变概率测度，并给出平稳期望 Dirichlet 能量的显式正下界（正比于噪声方差与图的谱间隙）。因此平稳表示不会坍缩到常数流形，从非零 Dirichlet 能量的意义上严格防止了渐近过平滑 (oversmoothing)。在线性和非线性循环 GNN 上的数值实验与理论预测高度一致。
Motivation: 过平滑是深层图神经网络的固有限制：重复消息传递使节点表示趋同并坍缩到低维子空间，限制了消息传递架构的有效深度。现有对策多为确定性机制（残差连接、归一化、图重连），本文旨在探索随机扰动作为另一种防过平滑机制。
Method: 在每个传播步骤后注入独立同分布的高斯噪声，把整个架构建模为随机动力系统；在确定性更新满足全局收缩的假设下，分析隐表示的马尔可夫链性质，并推导平稳状态下期望 Dirichlet 能量的下界。
Result: 主要理论结果给出期望平稳 Dirichlet 能量的显式正下界，其大小正比于噪声方差与底层图的谱间隙；这意味着平稳表示不可能坍缩到常值流形，即渐近过平滑被严格阻止。摘要还报告数值实验与理论预测吻合，验证了平稳分布的存在以及极限 Dirichlet 能量对噪声强度的依赖。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续随机扰动是抵抗过平滑的一种根本不同的机制，可与基于残差连接、归一化和图重连的确定性方法互补。本文结论限于循环 GNN 架构和全局收缩条件下的渐近行为。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Multi-channel Uplift Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce platforms must allocate fixed marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize business utility. However, standard predict-then-optimize (PTO) paradigms fail in this compositional space due to observational confounding and severe extrapolation. We formulate this challenge as a simplex-constrained uplift decision problem and propose ReAlloc, a fast-slow causal framework. Specifically, an agile Orthogonal Teacher extracts unbiased local gradients from short-term logs, while an Explanation-Guided Student distills them into a structured marginal field over long-term horizons. This design enables support-aware, conservative decisions that capture cross-channel substitutions. Extensive simulations and large-scale online A/B tests on Taobao platform demonstrate that ReAlloc achieves simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income.

Result: 摘要报告在大量仿真实验和淘宝大规模在线 A/B 测试中，ReAlloc 在支付订单数和收入两个指标上同时取得提升（simultaneous lifts in both pay order and income）。

papers.title: Integrating AI into Requirements Quality Learning in Software Engineering Education: A TPACK-Guided Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) in software engineering (SE) practice creates a need for pedagogically grounded approaches to AI integration in SE education, especially in conceptually intensive subjects such as requirements engineering (RE). This study examines a TPACK-guided integration of a multi-agent AI tool into a master-level RE assignment on requirements quality analysis. Using a mixed-methods design (N=100; 72 submissions analysed), we examine how structured assignment design shaped students' AI use, affected their understanding of user story quality criteria, and influenced their perceptions of AI's benefits and limitations. Results show that students used the AI tool selectively, mainly as support for analysis and evaluation rather than automation. Alignment improvements were most evident for structurally concrete requirements quality dimensions, such as value articulation and testability, while negotiability showed mixed effects. Students reported conditional trust, active refinement, and increased awareness of quality criteria, alongside moderate usability challenges. The findings show that TPACK-guided scaffolding can align AI affordances with pedagogical goals and RE content, offering design guidance for responsible AI integration in RE education.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, presented in the 38th CSEE&T in Florence, Italy, from July 20-22, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项 TPACK 指导下的实证研究，将多智能体 AI 工具整合进硕士层次的需求工程（RE）课程作业，用于用户故事质量分析。研究采用混合方法设计（N=100，分析 72 份提交），考察结构化作业设计如何塑造学生的 AI 使用行为、影响其对用户故事质量标准的理解，以及改变其对 AI 收益与局限的感知。结果表明学生选择性地使用 AI，主要将其作为分析与评估的辅助而非自动化工具。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 在软件工程实践中的快速普及，要求软件工程教育在概念密集型科目（如需求工程）中采用有教学法基础的 AI 整合方式，但目前缺乏系统的实证指导。
Method: 采用 TPACK（Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge）框架指导多智能体 AI 工具在需求质量分析作业中的整合，并通过混合方法设计对学生的 AI 使用模式、质量对齐表现和感知进行定量与定性分析。
Result: 学生主要将 AI 用于分析与评估而非自动化；在价值表达（value articulation）和可测试性（testability）等结构性较强的需求质量维度上，对齐改进最明显，而可协商性（negotiability）呈现混合效果。学生报告了条件性信任、主动精炼以及对质量标准的更高意识，同时存在中等程度的可用性挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TPACK 指导的脚手架设计能够将 AI 能力与教学目标及 RE 内容对齐，为负责任的 AI 整合进入需求工程教育提供设计指导。

papers.title: AgenticASR: Refining Speech Recognition in Real-World Scenarios via an Agentic Approach
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved substantial gains in transcription accuracy, yet verbatim transcription does not necessarily produce readily usable text. It retains fillers, repetitions, false starts, and self-corrections that increase reading effort, obscure the speaker's final intent, and propagate unresolved or abandoned content to downstream tasks. Existing spoken-to-written methods process completed audio or transcripts but cannot revise emitted text when later speech changes how preceding content should be interpreted. We therefore formulate Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR), an audio-to-clean-text task that removes disfluencies, resolves self-corrections, and normalizes written form while preserving the speaker's final intent. AgenticASR implements this task through an ASR--Refiner architecture that repeatedly transforms a bounded active context and replaces its corresponding output span as audio arrives. This enables continual emission and revision over streams of arbitrary duration. We also introduce AASR-Bench, a bilingual benchmark with fine-grained atomic rubrics. Across multiple ASR front ends, AgenticASR attains the highest AASR-Bench scores among evaluated systems. A human--AI agreement study shows that rubric-based judgments align with independent expert assessments. Ablations characterize Refiner capacity, context length, and the quality--latency trade-off between online and offline inference. Together, these results establish AgenticASR as a practical framework for intent-preserving clean transcription during ongoing speech. Code, AASR-Bench, and a demo will be released at https://github.com/AnXMuy/AgenticASR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Speech Recognition (AgenticSR) 任务，将语音转为去除口误、重复、假起头和自我纠正的干净文本，并保留说话者最终意图。作者实现 AgenticASR 系统，采用 ASR–Refiner 架构，在音频流式到达时反复变换有界的活动上下文并替换对应输出片段，从而支持任意时长的持续输出与修订。论文同时发布包含细粒度原子评分标准 (atomic rubrics) 的双语基准 AASR-Bench，并报告 AgenticASR 在多个 ASR 前端上取得最高基准分数。
Motivation: 逐字转录 (verbatim transcription) 虽准确但包含填充词、重复和假起头，增加阅读负担并可能把未完成内容传播给下游任务；现有 spoken-to-written 方法只能处理完整音频或转录稿，无法在后续语音改变前文语义时修订已输出文本。
Method: 将音频到干净文本定义为 AgenticSR 任务，提出 ASR–Refiner 架构：系统持续利用一个受限的活动上下文 (bounded active context)，音频到达时重写该上下文并替换对应的输出片段，从而同时支持连续发射和修订。此外构建双语基准 AASR-Bench，以细粒度原子评分标准进行评测。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 ASR 前端下，AgenticASR 在 AASR-Bench 上取得所有被测系统中最高的分数；人机一致性研究表明基于 rubrics 的评价与独立专家评估一致；消融实验刻画了 Refiner 容量、上下文长度以及在线与离线推理之间的质量–延迟权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果确立了 AgenticASR 作为持续语音期间保留意图的干净转录的实用框架；代码、AASR-Bench 和演示将在 GitHub 发布。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Search Strategies for Optimal Classification and Regression Trees
authors: Jacobus G. M. van der Linden
papers.abstract_en: Optimal decision trees (ODTs) are compact, interpretable machine learning models that globally optimize a given objective, but their scalability remains challenging. While recent work has proposed a variety of search strategies to improve scalability, the precise contribution of each strategy remains unclear. To address this gap, we introduce a general algorithmic framework for ODTs that instantiates previously used search strategies and enables the definition of new ones. This provides a common lens through which to understand and compare different strategies, which we use to empirically investigate the effect of 18 search strategies. Compared to the state of the art, the best strategy in our evaluation achieves significantly better anytime performance for classification, and improves runtime by more than an order of magnitude for regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对最优决策树 (optimal decision trees, ODTs) 的可扩展性问题，提出一个通用算法框架，用于实例化已有搜索策略并定义新策略。作者通过该框架对 18 种搜索策略进行实证比较；与现有最优方法相比，最佳策略在分类任务上显著改善 anytime performance，在回归任务上将运行时间提升一个数量级以上。
Motivation: ODTs 能够全局优化目标且模型紧凑可解释，但可扩展性仍是瓶颈；已有多种搜索策略被提出，但各自的具体贡献缺乏清晰归因，难以相互比较。
Method: 引入一个统一的 ODT 算法框架，将已有搜索策略以可复用组件的形式实例化，并允许在该框架内定义新的搜索策略，从而为系统比较不同策略提供共同视角。
Result: 在实证评估中比较了 18 种搜索策略；相对现有最优方法，最佳策略在分类上实现显著更好的 anytime performance，在回归上运行时间提升超过一个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能为理解和对比 ODT 搜索策略提供统一视角，并表明经过框架化比较的搜索策略可显著推进 ODT 的可扩展性。

papers.title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adaptive sampling, the other axis of training-free acceleration, paces how quickly positions commit while decoding continues but never verifies that the output itself has stabilized. We introduce a training-free, candidate-aware early-exit framework that keeps the two axes separate and matches each decision to evidence of its own scope. Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) governs when the sequence may stop by verifying confidence and sustained argmax stability over the dynamically extracted candidate span using a deterministic parser specified from each task's output format. Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) governs where to accelerate by applying a cheaper local rule to non-final blocks, while leaving the final block and global termination under CVC. We refer to their combination as LATCH (Localized Acceleration with Tracked-Candidate Halting). Unlike prior methods, LATCH needs no suffix-prompt construction; it is prompt-anchor-free but format-aware. We evaluate LATCH end to end on 11 tasks under zero-shot settings using LLaDA and Dream. LATCH stays within 2.0 percentage points of full-decoding accuracy across all 22 evaluation settings, with one frozen hyperparameter set that transfers cross-backbone untuned, while achieving end-to-end TPS speedups of 9.3-17.8x on short-answer tasks and 2.0-3.3x on long-reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型 (diffusion language models, DLMs) 提出一种免训练的候选感知早退解码框架 LATCH，将解码加速拆分为“何时停止”与“何处加速”两个独立决策。框架由 Confidence-Verified Commit (CVC) 和 Block-Wise Early Commit (BWEC) 组成，利用任务输出格式的确定性解析器动态提取候选跨度并验证其 argmax 稳定性，从而无需构造后缀提示。在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上的 11 个零样本任务中，LATCH 在全部 22 个评估设置下与完整解码的准确率差距保持在 2.0 个百分点以内，并在短答案任务上获得 9.3–17.8 倍、长推理任务上获得 2.0–3.3 倍的端到端 TPS 加速。
Motivation: 现有 DLM 的早退门控依赖固定区域置信度统计或调度依赖性规则，证据粒度太粗，会在长思维链 (chain-of-thought) 输出上过早终止；自适应采样虽然能调节提交速度，但从不验证输出本身是否已稳定。
Method: 提出候选感知的免训练早退框架 LATCH，将何时停止与何处加速分离：CVC 通过任务输出格式派生的确定性解析器动态提取候选跨度，验证置信度与持续 argmax 稳定性来决定序列是否可以终止；BWEC 对非最终块应用更廉价的局部规则以加速，而最终块与全局终止仍由 CVC 控制。该方法无需后缀提示构造，是 prompt-anchor-free 但 format-aware 的。
Result: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上对 11 个任务进行零样本端到端评估，LATCH 在全部 22 个评估设置中与完整解码的准确率差距不超过 2.0 个百分点，且一套冻结超参数可跨骨干网络直接迁移；端到端 TPS 加速在短答案任务上为 9.3–17.8 倍，在长推理任务上为 2.0–3.3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为将停止决策与加速位置解耦、并让每类决策匹配相应范围的证据，可以在不依赖后缀提示的情况下实现高效的扩散语言模型解码加速；其适用性依赖于为每个任务输出格式提供的确定性解析器，摘要未报告该依赖在自由格式任务上的表现。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 DLM 的早退门控依赖固定区域置信度统计或调度依赖性规则，证据粒度太粗，会在长思维链 (chain-of-thought) 输出上过早终止；自适应采样虽然能调节提交速度，但从不验证输出本身是否已稳定。
summary_sections.method: 提出候选感知的免训练早退框架 LATCH，将何时停止与何处加速分离：CVC 通过任务输出格式派生的确定性解析器动态提取候选跨度，验证置信度与持续 argmax 稳定性来决定序列是否可以终止；BWEC 对非最终块应用更廉价的局部规则以加速，而最终块与全局终止仍由 CVC 控制。该方法无需后缀提示构造，是 prompt-anchor-free 但 format-aware 的。
summary_sections.result: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上对 11 个任务进行零样本端到端评估，LATCH 在全部 22 个评估设置中与完整解码的准确率差距不超过 2.0 个百分点，且一套冻结超参数可跨骨干网络直接迁移；端到端 TPS 加速在短答案任务上为 9.3–17.8 倍，在长推理任务上为 2.0–3.3 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将停止决策与加速位置解耦、并让每类决策匹配相应范围的证据，可以在不依赖后缀提示的情况下实现高效的扩散语言模型解码加速；其适用性依赖于为每个任务输出格式提供的确定性解析器，摘要未报告该依赖在自由格式任务上的表现。

papers.title: S-Avatar: Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Head Avatars from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: We propose S-Avatar, a novel method for generating photorealistic 3D head avatars from a single image using a diffusion-guided 3D model generation module and strategies for animating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). While single-image head avatar reconstruction is crucial for lifelike Virtual Reality (VR) applications, existing approaches often struggle to preserve 3D consistency under unseen viewpoints. S-Avatar addresses this limitation through a three-stage pipeline. First, a high-resolution 3DGS is synthesized directly from a single image using a diffusion-based Gaussian splat generation module. Next, the parametric head model FLAME is aligned with the generated 3DGS by optimizing its parameters and spatial transformations. Finally, to adapt the 3DGS to FLAME variations, we construct a binding template that encodes the spatial relationship between the initial splats and FLAME. The dynamic 3D head avatar can then be rendered in real time by deforming the 3DGS with the binding template. By combining diffusion-guided canonical 3DGS generation with FLAME-based control, our method achieves efficient and accurate reconstruction with enhanced 3D consistency. Evaluations on public datasets demonstrate that S-Avatar outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel-view and expression generation, achieving superior realism and consistency. Consequently, our approach represents a significant advance in accessible avatar creation, applicable to a wide range of VR/AR applications. The project page is available at https://github.com/hailsong/savatar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S-Avatar，一种从单张图像生成逼真 3D 头部化身的方法，结合扩散引导的 3D 模型生成模块与 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 动画策略。方法采用三阶段流程：先用基于扩散的高斯生成模块从单图直接合成高分辨率 3DGS，再通过优化参数与空间变换将参数化头部模型 FLAME 与生成的 3DGS 对齐，最后构建绑定模板 (binding template) 编码初始 splats 与 FLAME 的空间关系，用于实时变形渲染动态头部化身。公开数据集上的评估表明，S-Avatar 在新视角和表情生成上优于现有方法，并具备更好的真实感与一致性。
Motivation: 单图像头部化身重建对 VR 应用至关重要，但现有方法在未见视角下难以保持 3D 一致性，影响真实感。
Method: 提出三阶段管线：扩散引导的 3DGS 生成、FLAME 参数与空间变换对齐、通过绑定模板将 3DGS 变形到 FLAME 变化实现实时渲染。
Result: 在公开数据集上的评估显示，S-Avatar 在新视角与表情生成任务中优于现有最先进方法，并实现更优的真实感和一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将扩散引导的 canonical 3DGS 生成与 FLAME 控制结合，可实现高效准确的头部化身重建，适用于广泛的 VR/AR 应用。

papers.title: A Mathematical Framework for Topological Causal Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Many modern outcomes, including images, point clouds, networks, and spatial fields, are structured objects for which \(Y^1-Y^0\) may be undefined or scientifically inadequate. We introduce \emph{Topological Causal Data Analysis} (TCDA), a framework separating the observation space, causal-model class, topological representation, and causal query. Topology does not define interventions; it supplies stable, shape-sensitive summaries after causal assumptions have been specified. We distinguish outcome-level TCDA, which transforms individual potential outcomes, from distribution-level TCDA, which transforms interventional outcome laws, and characterize when outcome and distribution level contrasts agree. Building on recent outcome-level theory, we formulate identification and doubly robust representations for Banach-space-valued summaries. At the distribution level, we identify targets through the standard causal \(g\)-formula and derive stability-transfer bounds and plug-in consistency. We also place target-specific topological ignorability within the framework, clarifying when a covariate-standardized coarse effect can be identified without identifying the full interventional laws. Finally, we delimit the role of observational topology in causal discovery: it can assist diagnosis on restricted model classes but cannot by itself identify causal structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Topological Causal Data Analysis (TCDA) 框架，将观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示和因果查询分离，用于图像、点云、网络、空间场等结构化的因果目标。框架区分了 outcome-level TCDA（变换个体潜在结果）与 distribution-level TCDA（变换干预结果分布），并刻画两者一致的条件；在分布层面通过 g-formula 识别目标，并给出稳定性迁移界与 plug-in 一致性。摘要还澄清了目标特定的拓扑可忽略性，并界定了观测拓扑在因果发现中的有限作用。
Motivation: 许多现代结果变量是结构化对象，此时 Y^1-Y^0 可能无定义或在科学上不充分，需要一种在因果假设明确后再施加稳定、形状敏感摘要的框架。
Method: 提出 TCDA 框架，明确区分观测空间、因果模型类、拓扑表示与因果查询；对 Banach 空间取值的摘要建立识别与双重稳健表示，并在分布层面借助标准因果 g-formula 识别目标，推导稳定性迁移界和 plug-in 一致性，同时形式化目标特定的拓扑可忽略性。
Result: 摘要刻画了 outcome-level 与 distribution-level 对比何时一致；推导出 Banach 空间取值摘要的识别与双重稳健表示，以及分布层面的稳定性迁移界和 plug-in 一致性；并说明协变量标准化的粗效应在何种条件下无需识别完整干预分布即可被识别。
Conclusion: 拓扑本身不定义干预，而是在因果假设指定后提供稳定的形状敏感摘要；观测拓扑在受限模型类上可辅助因果发现诊断，但单凭拓扑无法识别因果结构。

papers.title: OPLD: On-Policy Latent Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Interleaved multimodal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves visual reasoning by incorporating auxiliary visual evidence into intermediate reasoning. However, existing approaches remain constrained by externally defined reasoning traces and visual operations, limiting their ability to develop flexible and abstract visual thinking. Reasoning with latent has recently offered a promising direction by internalizing intermediate computation into continuous representations. Nevertheless, existing visual-latent methods mainly supervise latent states through alignment with compressed auxiliary visual features, treating them as proxies for visual observations rather than active reasoning states. Consequently, they capture the provided evidence but fail to fully internalize the abstract reasoning process induced by multimodal CoT. In this paper, we propose OPLD (On-Policy Latent Distillation), a simple framework that transfers the reasoning capability induced by privileged multimodal CoT into latent reasoning representations. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that OPLD consistently outperforms existing latent reasoning methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. The results suggest that supervising latent representations at the reasoning-process level provides a more effective paradigm for multimodal latent reasoning than conventional feature-level alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPLD（On-Policy Latent Distillation），一个将特权多模态链式思维（multimodal CoT）所诱导的推理能力迁移到潜在推理表示（latent reasoning representations）中的框架。与现有视觉-潜在方法将潜在状态与压缩辅助视觉特征对齐不同，OPLD 在推理过程层面监督潜在表示。在多个多模态基准上的实验表明，OPLD 一致优于现有潜在推理方法，并在多个基准上达到当前最优水平。
Motivation: 现有交错多模态 CoT 方法受限于外部定义的推理轨迹和视觉操作，难以形成灵活、抽象的视觉思维；而现有视觉-潜在方法仅通过对齐压缩的辅助视觉特征来监督潜在状态，把潜在状态当作视觉观测的代理而非主动推理状态，因此只捕获了给定证据，未能内化多模态 CoT 引发的抽象推理过程。
Method: OPLD 是一个简单的在线策略潜在蒸馏（on-policy latent distillation）框架，其核心思想是将特权多模态 CoT 诱导出的推理能力迁移到潜在推理表示中，在推理过程层面（reasoning-process level）监督潜在表示，而非采用传统的特征级对齐（feature-level alignment）。
Result: 摘要报告在多个多样化的多模态基准上进行的大量实验表明，OPLD 一致优于现有潜在推理方法，并在多个基准上取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在推理过程层面对潜在表示进行监督，为多模态潜在推理提供了比传统特征级对齐更有效的范式。

papers.title: What Makes Deep Learning Work for Traditional Chinese Medicine Tongue Diagnosis? A Comprehensive Ablation Study
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has shown promise for automated tongue diagnosis in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), yet the design space remains underexplored. We conducted a systematic ablation study spanning 20+ model versions under rigorous 5-fold cross-validation on TongueDx2 (5,109 images, 976 expert-annotated) and a merged dataset of 11,101 samples. We compared six backbone architectures, four loss functions, five augmentation strategies, and six training strategies. The best 976-sample model achieved weighted-F1 of 0.6625 using ConvNeXt-Tiny with restrained augmentation and weak-group ensemble, while the best 11,101-sample model reached weighted-F1 of 0.7761. Six key design principles emerged: (1) ConvNeXt-Tiny offers optimal parameter efficiency; (2) BCE substantially outperforms Asymmetric Loss (+2.7%); (3) restrained color augmentation is critical; (4) weak-group ensemble replacement (+2.1%) outperforms probability averaging; (5) data scaling yielded +20.6% improvement; (6) expanding from 13 to 45 label dimensions caused catastrophic collapse (0.78 to 0.22). These principles are generalizable to multi-label medical image classification with class imbalance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对深度学习用于中医舌诊自动诊断的设计空间进行了系统性消融研究，在 TongueDx2（5,109 张图像，其中 976 张专家标注）和 11,101 样本的合并数据集上，通过严格 5 折交叉验证比较了六种骨干网络、四种损失函数、五种增强策略和六种训练策略。最佳 976 样本模型采用 ConvNeXt-Tiny、受限增强和 weak-group ensemble，weighted-F1 达到 0.6625；最佳 11,101 样本模型达到 0.7761。作者总结出六条设计原则，并强调这些原则可推广到类别不平衡的多标签医学图像分类。
Motivation: 深度学习已在中医舌诊自动诊断中显示出潜力，但该任务的设计空间（架构、损失函数、数据增强与训练策略的选择）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 作者在 TongueDx2 与合并数据集上开展 20 多个模型版本的系统消融实验，采用 5 折交叉验证，比较六种骨干架构、四种损失函数、五种增强策略和六种训练策略，以量化各设计维度对分类性能的影响。
Result: 结果显示，最佳 976 样本模型（ConvNeXt-Tiny 配合受限增强和 weak-group ensemble）weighted-F1 为 0.6625，最佳 11,101 样本模型为 0.7761。BCE 比 Asymmetric Loss 高 2.7%，weak-group ensemble 比概率平均高 2.1%，数据规模扩展带来 +20.6% 的提升，而标签维度从 13 扩到 45 导致性能灾难性下降（0.78 到 0.22）。
Conclusion: 作者提炼出六条关键设计原则，包括 ConvNeXt-Tiny 的参数效率最优、BCE 优于 Asymmetric Loss、受限颜色增强至关重要、weak-group ensemble 优于概率平均、数据扩展收益显著，以及过大的标签维度会造成性能崩溃，并指出这些原则适用于类别不平衡的多标签医学图像分类。

papers.title: Can Agents Deceive? Evaluating Reasoning and Deception in ParliamentBench using a Social Deduction Game
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as agents in high-stakes settings, such as medical and legal systems, understanding their deceptive capabilities is fundamental to safety. Controlled social deduction games provide a reproducible proxy for isolating and evaluating these complex adversarial behaviors. We present the open-source benchmark framework ParliamentBench based on the game Secret Hitler to evaluate LLMs in scenarios that require deception, persuasion, and reasoning under information asymmetry. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 1,600 simulated matches playing each other, playing against humans, and compare them against a large set of online games. We introduce three novel metrics that isolate social deduction, reasoning, and deceptive consistency. Our experiments reveal that frontier models achieve strong performance across cooperative and deceptive roles, with a strong top-four cluster (GPT-5.4, Kimi K2.5, Grok 4.1 Fast, and DeepSeek 3.1 Terminus), whereas the weakest models fall short of random (33%) and simple algorithmic (45%) baselines. Most LLMs struggle to maintain a consistent deceptive persona throughout an entire game, with deception retention dropping below 50%.

papers.title: ReGenVC: End-to-End Real-Time Generative Video Coding at Ultra-Low Bitrate
papers.abstract_en: We present ReGenVC, an end-to-end generative video codec that compresses talking-head video to an ultra-low bitrate and decodes it in real time. The encoder reduces a source clip to a compact bitstream -- a neurally compressed first frame, per-frame pose keypoints, and metadata -- totaling about 26 kB for a 77-frame sequence. The decoder is a four-step distilled diffusion transformer that reconstructs the video conditioned on the transmitted pose and reference frame. Compared with x264/x265, ReGenVC reduces the bitrate to roughly one tenth of that required by traditional codecs (about 26 kB vs. 250--280 kB for essentially artifact-free reconstruction); at a matched ultra-low bitrate, conventional codecs collapse into blocking artifacts while ReGenVC stays sharp by exploiting a strong generative prior. The central obstacle to deploying such a codec is decoder latency: multi-step sampling with transformer and VAE components is too slow for interactive use. We make the decoder real-time through four-step distillation and three model-preserving system techniques: (i) eight-GPU unified sequence parallelism (Ulysses & Ring), (ii) a spatially-split VAE, and (iii) a three-stage overlapped pipeline; an analytical timing model characterizes the real-time feasibility region. On an 8-GPU node, the system sustains 24 fps output (972 ms per 25-frame window, within the 1000 ms budget), enabling a live browser stream without observed frame underruns. A hybrid CPU-GPU deployment further runs the encoder on the CPU at 24 fps and offloads the decoder-side one-shot conditioning encoders to the CPU, reducing the per-GPU memory peak from 21.1 GB to about 7.7 GB. To our knowledge, ReGenVC is the first end-to-end generative video codec to combine ultra-low-bitrate encoding with real-time decoding on an 8-GPU system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGenVC，一个面向 talking-head 视频的端到端生成式视频编码器，能在约 26 kB 的超低码率下压缩 77 帧序列，并在 8 张 GPU 上实现 24 fps 的实时解码。解码器采用四步蒸馏扩散 Transformer，并配合八卡统一序列并行（Ulysses 与 Ring）、空间切分 VAE 以及三级重叠流水线等系统技术。相比 x264/x265，ReGenVC 在近无伪影重建时码率约为传统编码器的十分之一；在相同超低码率下传统编码器出现块效应而 ReGenVC 保持清晰。
Motivation: 超低码率下传统视频编码器会产生严重块状伪影，而生成式编解码器虽能借助强生成先验保持清晰，但多步采样带来的解码延迟使其难以用于交互式实时场景，这是部署该类编解码器的核心障碍。
Method: 编码器将源视频压缩为神经压缩的首帧、逐帧姿态关键点（pose keypoints）和元数据组成的紧凑比特流；解码器是一个四步蒸馏扩散 Transformer，以传输的姿态和参考帧为条件重建视频。为达到实时性，作者采用四步蒸馏以及三种保持模型的系统技术：八 GPU 统一序列并行（Ulysses & Ring）、空间切分 VAE 和三阶段重叠流水线，并建立了解析时序模型刻画实时可行域。
Result: 在 8-GPU 节点上，系统达到 24 fps 输出（25 帧窗口 972 ms，低于 1000 ms 预算），可实现在线浏览器直播且未观察到帧下溢；比特流约 26 kB，而 x264/x265 无伪影重建约需 250–280 kB。混合 CPU-GPU 部署将编码器放在 CPU 上以 24 fps 运行，并把解码端的一次性条件编码器卸载到 CPU，使每 GPU 显存峰值从 21.1 GB 降至约 7.7 GB。
Conclusion: 作者称 ReGenVC 是首个在 8-GPU 系统上同时实现超低码率编码与实时解码的端到端生成式视频编解码器；摘要强调其可行性依赖于计算并行与流水线优化的系统级设计。

papers.title: Asymmetric Communication: Large Language Models and Language Games
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI discourse attributes to language models properties they cannot bear: general intelligence as substrate-independent cognition, hallucination as cognitive failure, agency as autonomous goal-pursuit, sentience as emergent inner life, alignment as goal synchronization. This paper argues that these are instances of a single category mistake--properties constituted within human communicative practice are projected onto the machine side--and explains its structure. Human-LLM interaction constitutes a language game in which one side bears all normative activity. We call this configuration asymmetric communication since model outputs circulate communicatively, entering further exchanges, without the system undertaking commitments, bearing entitlements, or performing the assessment on which discursive standing depends. Three conditions define the asymmetry: (i) correctness is enforced exclusively by the receiver; (ii) accountability is borne by human participants alone; and (iii) the practical standing of any output depends entirely on human uptake. These conditions are structural, hold independently of capability, and remain unchanged as more powerful models raise the stakes of misattribution. The framework draws on Wittgenstein (meaning enacted in shared practices), Luhmann (communication completed on the receiver's side), Esposito (algorithmic contingency sufficient for uptake), and Brandom (normative scorekeeping as the source of discursive standing). Applied to all five, it reclassifies each as a receiver-side phenomenon, grounds guardrails as structural necessities rather than manifestations of machine moral agency, and yields an implication for AI governance. Alignment is institutional constraint engineering, not goal synchronization between agents, while responsibility remains with human institutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从语言游戏 (language games) 与规范性记分 (normative scorekeeping) 出发，认为当前 AI 话语把通用智能、幻觉、能动性、感受性与对齐等属性错误投射到语言模型上，属于同一类范畴错误。作者提出“不对称沟通”(asymmetric communication) 框架，指出人机交互中模型输出虽参与传播，却不承担承诺、资格与评估，三个结构条件使正确性、责任与实践地位完全落在人类一侧。该框架借助 Wittgenstein、Luhmann、Esposito 与 Brandom 的理论，将上述五种现象重新归类为接收者侧现象，并得出对齐属于制度性约束工程而非目标同步的治理结论。
Motivation: 当代 AI 话语把由人类交往实践构成的性质（如能动性、对齐、幻觉）投射到机器侧，导致概念混乱与误归因；随着模型能力增强，误归因的代价上升，因而需要澄清这种结构性不对称。
Method: 构建“不对称沟通”概念框架，提出三个定义性条件（(i) 正确性仅由接收者执行；(ii) 责任仅由人类参与者承担；(iii) 输出的实践地位完全取决于人类接受），并援引 Wittgenstein 的共享实践意义论、Luhmann 的沟通完成于接收者侧、Esposito 的算法偶然性足以支持接受，以及 Brandom 的规范性记分作为话语地位来源来论证。
Result: 文章将通用智能、幻觉、能动性、感受性与对齐五种现象统一重分类为接收者侧 (receiver-side) 现象，并主张护栏 (guardrails) 是结构性必然，而非机器道德能动性的体现。
Conclusion: 对齐应被理解为制度性约束工程 (institutional constraint engineering)，而非智能体间的目标同步；责任仍由人类制度承担。作者强调该不对称性独立于模型能力，并随更强模型的部署而保持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required. We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search. Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LM-GRASP，一种将 GRASP 的随机构造阶段重构为在线模仿学习 (online imitation learning) 的元启发式框架：以局部搜索作为专家预言机，用 decoder-only Transformer 作为构造策略，并在每个问题实例上从零训练。在 Taillard PFSP 基准的 ta51-ta60 实例上，LM-GRASP 平均比 GPU-GRASP 少 28.4 个 makespan 单位，与 GPU 加速相对串行执行的收益 (27.2 单位) 相当。
Motivation: 现有面向组合优化的机器学习方法通常依赖在大规模离线数据上通过强化学习训练的神经构造器，预训练成本高且对训练分布之外的实例泛化差；经典 GRASP 则依赖基于局部标量成本的静态、短视启发式规则。
Method: 将 GRASP 的随机构造阶段改造成在线模仿学习任务，由局部搜索过程充当专家，decoder-only Transformer 作为构造策略；采用迭代的 learn-infer-improve 循环，通过在动态精英轨迹存档上做行为克隆 (behavioral cloning) 在线训练策略，无需外部数据或离线预训练，整个流程仅通过目标评估器与领域交互。
Result: 在 Taillard PFSP 基准的 ta51-ta60 块上（该块一半最优值未知，最具区分度），LM-GRASP 平均优于 GPU-GRASP 28.4 个 makespan 单位，接近 GPU 加速相对串行执行的 27.2 单位增益，但两者的标准差有重叠。
Conclusion: 摘要认为实例特定、在线训练的语言模型是手工构造器的有前景的实用替代方案，尤其适用于经典贪婪构造难以奏效的优化地形；该方法的优势在于无需人工特征工程、无外部数据或离线预训练。

papers.title: Convolutional Neural Shading for High-Quality 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
papers.abstract_en: We propose a convolutional neural shading (CNS), a novel pipeline to reconstruct high-quality 3D shapes from multi-view images. Several recent studies have used neural radiance fields and other neural differentiable rendering methods to understand 3D geometry. However, these approaches rely on single-point geometric information, such as positions and normals of the surface, leading to a lack of detailed local geometry. Our approach addresses the inherent limitations of single-point information by leveraging a neural shader to capture variations even in dark and textureless regions with a convolutional neural shader, resulting in far more accurate geometry predictions. Additionally, our method mitigates surface irregularities at image boundaries by introducing a fine-detail displacement network, which utilizes spatial information of surface geometry and learns fine displacement details by correlating neighboring values in the rendering coordinates. Through extensive experiments, our proposed method has demonstrated significant quality improvements in the reconstructed shapes and rendered images over current state-of-the-art methods.

Motivation: 现有神经辐射场和神经可微渲染方法在理解三维几何时只使用单点几何信息，例如表面位置和法线，导致缺少详细的局部几何信息，尤其在暗区和无纹理区域表现不佳。
Method: 提出卷积神经着色管道，通过卷积神经着色器捕捉单点信息之外的局部变化；并引入细粒度位移网络，利用渲染坐标中的表面几何空间信息，通过学习邻近值的相关关系来补充精细位移细节，以改善图像边界处的表面不规则性。
Result: 广泛实验表明，该方法在重建形状质量和渲染图像质量上均显著优于当前最先进的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过将神经着色器与位移网络结合，可以在单点信息之外利用局部变化信息，从而获得更精确的几何预测并缓解边界区域的不规则性。

papers.title: Collaborative Feature Aggregation for Face Super-Resolution and Robust Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel collaborative approach for face super-resolution (SR) and robust person re-identification from sequential or multi-view facial images. Traditional SR methods often suffer from blurring and distortion in faces recovered from poor-quality images due to low resolution. Image- and video-based facial SR methods using facial landmarks or segmentation also have similar challenges. To overcome these limitations, we leverage multiple correlated facial observations, across time or viewpoints, by introducing a transformer-based collaborative feature aggregation method that unifies identity features from multi-sequence or multi-view data. This allows faces in multiple sequences of an individual to contribute to accurately estimating common facial features. Furthermore, we propose a cascade SR network to progressively restore the high-resolution image of the target's face with gradual facial feature unification. The unified identity representation is further utilized in person re-identification scenarios, enabling accurate matching even under severe image degradation. The exhaustive experimental results and comparisons show that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating consistent improvements in both face super-resolution and re-identification performance. Our work highlights the effectiveness of joint identity reconstruction and progressive image restoration from multiple facial inputs in enhancing downstream visual recognition tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 transformer 的协同特征聚合方法，用于从多时序或多视角人脸图像中恢复高分辨率人脸，并进行鲁棒的人物重识别。级联 SR 网络逐步恢复目标人脸的高分辨率图像，统一身份表示用于 re-ID。实验表明该方法在超分辨率和重识别上都优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统人脸超分辨率在低质量图像下易产生模糊和畸变，基于 facial landmarks 或 segmentation 的图像/视频 SR 方法仍有类似问题。作者希望利用跨时间或跨视角的多个相关人脸观测来更准确地估计共同面部特征。
Method: 引入 transformer-based 协同特征聚合，统一来自多序列或多视角数据的身份特征；提出级联 SR 网络逐步恢复目标人脸高分辨率图像，并渐进式统一面部特征；统一身份表示进一步用于 person re-identification 场景。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验对比显示，该方法在 face super-resolution 和 person re-identification 性能上均一致优于其他 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合身份重建与渐进式图像恢复能利用多个人脸输入增强下游视觉识别任务。

papers.title: Face and Voice Cross-modal Association with Learning Convex Feature Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Face-and-voice association learning is one of the most challenging tasks in deep learning. In this paper, we propose a simple but powerful cross-modal feature embedding method for the association of faces and voices. Previous work has studied cross-modal association tasks to establish the correlation between voice clips and facial images. These works have addressed cross-modal discrimination but underestimate the importance of handling heterogeneity in inter-modal features between audio and video, resulting in a lot of false positives and false negatives. To tackle the problem, the proposed method learns the embeddings of cross-modal features by making another feature exist between cross-modal features, facilitating the voice and face features of the same person to be embedded in a convex hull. Moreover, the incorporation of cross-modal attention mechanisms with convex embedding techniques represents a highly effective strategy for the attenuation of false positives and false negatives, accomplished via the minimization of inter-class discrepancies. We exhaustively evaluated our method for cross-modal verification, matching, and retrieval tasks on the large-scale VoxCeleb dataset. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.journal_ref: Multimedia Systems, vol. 31, no. 4, pp. 296, July 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人脸与语音的跨模态关联学习，提出一种基于凸包嵌入 (convex hull embedding) 的跨模态特征学习方法：在人脸和语音特征之间构造另一特征，使同一人的两类特征被嵌入到同一凸包内，并结合跨模态注意力机制减少假阳性和假阴性。作者在 VoxCeleb 数据集上对跨模态验证、匹配与检索任务进行评估，报告称相比现有最先进方法取得明显改进。
Motivation: 已有跨模态关联工作主要聚焦于跨模态判别，但低估了音频与视频特征之间的模态间异质性 (inter-modal heterogeneity)，导致大量假阳性和假阴性。
Method: 提出一种简单但有效的跨模态特征嵌入方法：让另一特征存在于跨模态特征之间，从而使同一人的语音特征和人脸特征被嵌入到一个凸包 (convex hull) 中；同时将跨模态注意力机制 (cross-modal attention) 与凸嵌入技术结合，通过最小化类间差异来抑制假阳性和假阴性。
Result: 在大规模 VoxCeleb 数据集上对跨模态验证、匹配和检索任务进行了全面评估，摘要声称相比现有最先进方法获得显著改进，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调凸嵌入与跨模态注意力的结合能有效缓解模态间异质性带来的错误匹配；具体改进幅度、对比基线和局限性在摘要中未说明。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM-Judged Helpfulness as a Pedagogy Signal: A Pre-Registered Audit Across Tutor Models
papers.abstract_en: LLM tutoring poses a measurement problem: can a general-purpose helpfulness rubric distinguish direct answer-giving from pedagogical guidance? We audit this signal in a pre-registered study. Within each of three tutor bases, we compare conversational and pedagogical policies instantiated with the same underlying model and paired with one fixed weak simulated student. Deterministic detectors measure answer leakage and next-turn independent work. Claude Opus 4.8 is the frozen, condition-blind primary judge. After the Opus scores were fixed, GPT-5.6 Sol was prospectively specified for a post hoc robustness audit of the same 1,179 confirmatory answer-phase tutor turns under the frozen helpfulness and pedagogy rubrics. On the primary base under Opus, the policies do not differ significantly in helpfulness but are perfectly rank-separated under the pedagogy rubric (Cliff's $|δ|{=}0.10$ vs. $1.0$). Across the two judges, pedagogy contrasts retain their direction where detected, whereas the helpfulness ordering is judge-contingent, reversing between judges on two of three bases. In an Opus-only ablation, seven primary-base policies span $2.3$ points in mean judged pedagogy within a $0.25$-point band of mean judged helpfulness. Separately, answer-revealing turns are followed by less independent student work on every base, a result that is judge-invariant by construction. In this controlled setting, general-purpose helpfulness is not a reliable pedagogy signal. Tutor evaluation should pair pedagogy-targeted rubrics with deterministic process measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项预注册审计检验通用帮助性（helpfulness）评分是否能区分直接给答案与教学引导（pedagogical guidance）。在三个辅导基座（tutor bases）上，用同一底层模型分别实例化对话式与教学式策略，并配以固定的弱模拟学生；以 Claude Opus 4.8 作为冻结的条件盲主裁判，用 GPT-5.6 Sol 对 1,179 个确认性回答阶段辅导回合做前瞻性稳健性审计。结果显示，在主基座上两种策略的帮助性得分无显著差异，但在教学性（pedagogy）评分下完全分序（Cliff's |δ| 分别为 0.10 与 1.0），且帮助性排序在不同裁判间会反转。作者据此认为通用帮助性不是可靠的教学信号。
Motivation: LLM 辅导面临测量问题：通用帮助性评分标准能否区分直接给出答案与提供教学引导？该问题关系到辅导系统的效果评估是否有效。
Method: 采用预注册审计设计：在三种辅导基座上，用同一底层模型实例化对话式与教学式策略，并固定一个弱模拟学生；用确定性检测器测量答案泄漏（answer leakage）和下一轮独立作业（independent work），以 Claude Opus 4.8 作为冻结且条件盲的主裁判，并用 GPT-5.6 Sol 对相同的 1,179 个回答阶段辅导回合进行前瞻性稳健性审计。
Result: 在 Opus 主裁判下，主基座上的策略在帮助性上无显著差异，但在教学性评分上完全分序（Cliff's |δ|=0.10 vs 1.0）；帮助性排序在三个基座中的两个上随裁判反转。Opus 单独消融中，七个策略的平均教学性评分跨度 2.3 分，而平均帮助性评分仅落在 0.25 分带宽内。此外，在所有基座上，揭示答案的回合之后学生独立作业更少，且该结果在构造上不依赖裁判。
Conclusion: 在该受控设置下，通用帮助性（general-purpose helpfulness）不是可靠的教学性信号；辅导评估应将面向教学性的评分标准（pedagogy-targeted rubrics）与确定性过程指标结合使用。

papers.title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to a market-agnostic, supervised learning paradigm that relies on limited, static and human-annotated datasets, and thus are incapable of adapting to evolving market conditions. To address this limitation, we introduce FinSMART, the first market-aligned reinforcement learning framework for financial sentiment analysis, which directly optimizes sentiment signals using realized market outcomes. To deal with the noisy, non-stationary, and multifactorial nature of financial markets, FinSMART incorporates a signal extraction pipeline that combines market-aware data filtering with a discrete asymmetric trading reward, enabling stable reinforcement learning from economically meaningful market feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that FinSMART significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in profitability, risk-adjusted performance, and sentiment signal quality, improving cumulative trading returns by 220% over the strongest baseline. Uniquely, the FinSMART framework naturally supports market-aware retraining, at any point in time, by replacing costly manual annotation with newly observed financial articles and their realized market outcomes. Such a retraining strategy enables the model to continuously adapt to changing market dynamics, resulting in consistent performance gains over its static counterpart. These findings demonstrate the practical applicability of market-aligned reinforcement learning and highlight its potential as a next-generation paradigm for developing adaptive financial LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinSMART，一个面向金融情感分析的市场对齐强化学习（market-aligned reinforcement learning）框架，用已实现的市场结果直接优化情感信号，替代依赖静态人工标注数据的市场无关监督范式。框架包含结合市场感知数据过滤与离散非对称交易奖励的信号提取流程，使模型能在噪声、非平稳、多因素的金融市场中稳定训练。实验显示 FinSMART 在盈利能力、风险调整表现和情感信号质量上显著超过现有方法，累积交易回报比最强基线提升 220%，并支持随时基于新文章和市场结果进行市场感知重训练。
Motivation: 现有金融大语言模型（financial LLMs）的情感分析仍局限于市场无关的监督学习，依赖有限、静态、人工标注的数据集，无法随市场条件演化而适应；作者希望用真实市场结果作为反馈来突破这一局限。
Method: FinSMART 是首个将市场对齐强化学习用于金融情感分析的框架，直接利用已实现市场结果优化情感信号；通过市场感知数据过滤加离散非对称交易奖励的信号提取流程，从经济上有意义的市场反馈中获得稳定强化学习信号。
Result: 实验表明 FinSMART 在盈利能力、风险调整表现和情感信号质量上显著优于现有最先进方法，累积交易回报较最强基线提升 220%；其市场感知重训练策略相比静态版本带来持续性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果展示了市场对齐强化学习的实际可用性，并指出它有望成为开发自适应金融大语言模型的下一代范式；该框架用新观察到的金融文章和对应市场结果替代昂贵的人工标注，实现模型的持续适应。

papers.title: ConMem: Contribution-Aware Memory for Long-Horizon Manufacturing Inspection Logs
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon steel-equipment inspection requires reasoning over heterogeneous records accumulated across repeated inspection cycles. Existing retrieval-augmented generation systems treat historical logs as a static corpus and retain records without estimating their diagnostic value, failing to report early risk. To this end, we propose ConMem, a contribution-aware memory framework for LLM-assisted equipment inspection, supporting a human-in-the-loop early-risk screening system. Specifically, our ConMem first segments inspection logs into functional evidence units, then estimates each memory unit's contribution to downstream diagnosis through a Shapley-style estimation, and finally retains high-value evidence under a constrained memory budget. In experiments, we evaluate ConMem on real-world dataset and ConMem achieves 76.0% QA accuracy, exceeding the strongest directly comparable baseline. Relative to the naive 8K-context LLM baselines, it reduces the average number of input tokens by 88.2% and response time by 86.6%. Ablation studies also show that the functional-role-aware segmentation and contribution-based valuation are helping prioritize weak degradation signals for targeted field inspection. Practical deployments further confirm that ConMem retains the weak early signal across three inspection cycles, providing an early-stage seal-wear alert targeted for on-site inspectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConMem，一个面向长周期钢设备检修日志的贡献感知记忆框架 (contribution-aware memory)，用于 LLM 辅助、人在回路 (human-in-the-loop) 的早期风险筛查。方法先将检修日志分割为功能证据单元，再用 Shapley 式估计衡量各单元对下游诊断的贡献，并在受限记忆预算下保留高价值证据。在真实数据集上 QA 准确率达到 76.0%，相比朴素 8K 上下文 LLM 基线减少 88.2% 的平均输入 token 数和 86.6% 的响应时间，实际部署中能跨三个检修周期保留弱早期信号。
Motivation: 现有检索增强生成系统将历史检修日志视为静态语料，保存记录时不估计其诊断价值，难以报告早期风险。长周期钢设备检修需要在跨检修周期的异构记录上推理，因而需要一种能优先保留弱退化信号的记忆机制。
Method: ConMem 首先将检修日志切分为功能证据单元 (functional evidence units)，然后通过 Shapley 式估计 (Shapley-style estimation) 评估每个记忆单元对下游诊断的贡献，最后在受限记忆预算下只保留高价值证据，并集成到带人为筛查的早期风险系统中。
Result: 在真实数据集上，ConMem 取得 76.0% 的 QA 准确率，超过最强直接可比基线；相对于朴素 8K 上下文 LLM 基线，平均输入 token 数减少 88.2%，响应时间减少 86.6%。消融实验显示功能角色感知分割和基于贡献的估值有助于优先定位弱退化信号；实际部署中系统在三个检修周期内保留弱早期信号并给出面向现场检查人员的早期密封磨损预警。
Conclusion: 摘要强调按诊断贡献筛选并保留高价值记忆单元可显著提升 LLM 辅助检修的早期风险筛查效率，并在真实部署中验证了跨周期弱信号的保留能力；摘要未涉及明显局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Practical Algorithm Selection for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Numerous unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) algori-thms exist, but for clinical practice, selecting the best-suited one along with proper hyperparameters often remains unclear, as the unlabeled deployment (target) domain prevents direct evaluation. We propose a label-free criterion that jointly selects the algorithm and hyperparameters for UDA. Given a pool of candidate models from multiple algorithms trained with different hyperparameters, our approach scores each candidate against an agreement reference, and selects the one with the highest score. The agreement reference is constructed in two levels without using target labels. First, we leverage multiple label-free selection signals, using each to nominate a model within every algorithm. Second, the nominated models are aggregated across algorithms to form a reference prediction for each unlabeled target sample. The candidate whose predictions agree most with this reference is then selected for deployment. Experimental results on four brain MRI and four chest X-ray datasets across seven clinically relevant transfer scenarios show that our method achieves better selection performance than other methods and remains effective across different algorithm pools. Our approach takes a step towards practical, label-free algorithm selection for clinical deployment of UDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督域适应（UDA）在医学影像临床部署中难以选择合适算法与超参数的问题，提出一种无标签的联合选择准则。该方法利用多个无标签选择信号在每个算法内提名模型，再跨算法聚合形成参考预测，并选出与参考预测一致性最高的候选模型。在四个脑MRI和四个胸部X光数据集、七个临床相关迁移场景上的实验表明，其选择性能优于其他方法。
Motivation: 临床实践中未标记的目标域无法直接评估UDA算法，导致在众多算法与超参数中选择最适合部署的模型变得困难。
Method: 提出两级无标签参考构建：先在每个算法内用多种无标签选择信号各自提名一个模型，再将各算法提名的模型跨算法聚合，形成每个目标样本的参考预测；候选模型与参考预测的一致性最高者被选中用于部署。
Result: 在四个脑MRI和四个胸部X光数据集、七个临床相关的迁移场景中，该方法的选择性能优于其他方法，并在不同算法池下保持有效。
Conclusion: 该方法为医学影像UDA的临床部署提供了一种无需目标标签的实用算法选择途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Information Bottleneck Learning for Faithful Time Series Forecasting Explanations
papers.abstract_en: As forecasts increasingly drive decisions in fields such as energy, transportation, and healthcare, understanding the historical data behind these predictions has become as crucial as the predictions themselves. Although existing interpretable-by-design forecasters reveal their internal structures, they offer no guarantee that these structures faithfully reflect the underlying evidence driving the predictions. In contrast, while faithfulness-oriented methods explicitly verify model behavior, they are almost exclusively designed for post-hoc classification tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose IB-Forecast, an inherently interpretable multivariate time-series forecasting framework. It decomposes forecasting into a learned periodic component and a residual component computed with explainable masks over input tokens. With a budget-constrained information bottleneck, end-to-end optimization enables users to directly control explanation sparsity. With a rigorous faithfulness evaluation protocol, extensive experiments demonstrate that IB-Forecast matches the forecasting error of leading black-box models while providing faithful explanations at no additional inference cost. Furthermore, under a matched sparsity budget, these native explanations consistently surpass gradient-based, occlusion-based, and optimization-based baselines across all evaluated datasets. Ultimately, whereas the native explanations of existing interpretable forecasters exhibit poor faithfulness, IB-Forecast guarantees high explanation fidelity, requiring only 14-20% of the observations to deliver low-error predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IB-Forecast，一个内在可解释 (inherently interpretable) 的多元时间序列预测框架，旨在同时满足预测精度与解释忠实性。它将预测分解为可学习的周期成分与基于输入 token 可解释掩码的残差成分，并通过带预算约束的信息瓶颈 (information bottleneck) 进行端到端优化。摘要报告该方法在预测误差上可与领先黑盒模型持平，且无需额外推理成本即可提供忠实解释。
Motivation: 现有可解释性设计 (interpretable-by-design) 的预测器虽能展示内部结构，却无法保证这些结构忠实反映预测背后的真实证据；而面向忠实性 (faithfulness) 的方法几乎只针对事后 (post-hoc) 分类任务，时间序列预测场景缺乏兼顾两者的方案。
Method: IB-Forecast 将多变量时间序列预测分解为周期成分和带可解释掩码的残差成分，采用带预算约束的信息瓶颈，使端到端优化能直接控制解释的稀疏度 (sparsity)，并用严格的忠实性评估协议验证解释质量。
Result: 大量实验表明，IB-Forecast 的预测误差与领先黑盒模型相当，同时提供无需额外推理成本的忠实解释；在匹配稀疏度预算下，其原生解释在所有数据集上一致优于基于梯度、基于遮挡和基于优化的基线。
Conclusion: 现有可解释预测器的原生解释忠实性较差，而 IB-Forecast 只需 14-20% 的观测数据即可实现低误差预测，并保证高解释忠实度。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled failures with complete accepted and rejected repair trajectories. We compare typed edits, exact source patches, and complete module rewrites under matched source, feedback, model, and budget, one episode per state and interface. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the three interfaces solve almost the same number of the benchmark's localized failures. Typed repair is the cheapest per solved state (patching is 1.30x as expensive, rewriting 2.06x), and within 10,000 completion tokens per task it reaches almost all of its final coverage, while both free-form interfaces are well behind. A second model, Qwen3.6-Flash, solves fewer states but keeps typed repair cheapest, puts it ahead on the proof-authoring states, and repeats the localized pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BlueprintRepair，一种面向基于 LLM 的 Lean 证明系统的修复接口，允许模型通过十种经 schema 校验的局部操作修改证明蓝图（依赖图）。作者构建了包含 142 个受控失败及其完整接受/拒绝修复轨迹的基准 BlueprintTrace，并在匹配来源、反馈、模型和预算的条件下比较了类型化编辑、精确源码补丁和完整模块重写三种接口，发现类型化修复在每解决状态成本上最低且预算内覆盖收敛最快。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 Lean 证明系统越来越多地将证明组织为形式化语句的依赖图（blueprint），但当前修复手段多为自由形式的源码补丁或模块重写，既昂贵又可能改变目标定理。需要一个既能约束编辑范围、又由 Lean 逐项校验的局部修复接口。
Method: 提出 BlueprintRepair，包含十种 schema 校验的局部操作；每个操作显式命名所编辑的节点，因而无法改动目标定理，且 Lean 会检查每次应用，接受的修复必须声明其证明用到的所有蓝图引理。同时构造 BlueprintTrace 基准，包含 142 个受控失败以及完整的接受/拒绝修复轨迹，并在匹配预算的条件下对比类型化编辑、精确源码补丁与完整模块重写。
Result: 使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 时，三种接口解决的局部失败数量几乎相同，但类型化修复每解决状态成本最低（补丁为 1.30 倍，重写为 2.06 倍），且在每任务 10,000 个 completion token 内几乎达到最终覆盖率，而两种自由形式接口明显落后。使用 Qwen3.6-Flash 时解决状态更少，但类型化修复仍最便宜，并在 proof-authoring 状态上领先，重复了局部失败上的模式。
Conclusion: 类型化、经 schema 校验的局部编辑是一种高效的 Lean 证明蓝图修复接口，在成本与预算内覆盖率上优于自由形式的补丁和重写，且该优势在两个不同模型上均成立。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 类型化、经 schema 校验的局部编辑是一种高效的 Lean 证明蓝图修复接口，在成本与预算内覆盖率上优于自由形式的补丁和重写，且该优势在两个不同模型上均成立。

papers.title: Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic textbook data has improved language model pre-training, but prior work largely treats the benefit as a property of generated content or local rewriting style. We study a different factor: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. We contribute both a scalable synthesis pipeline and controlled evidence that this organization matters. The pipeline retrieves source material from a pre-training corpus, clusters it into topical units, plans hierarchical tables of contents, and assembles source-grounded sections into complete books (our Full setting), yielding 686K textbooks (32B tokens) across 15,000+ disciplines. Replacing natural books in a mid-training mix with this corpus improves downstream performance by +1.09 on average. Controlled comparisons then disentangle the relevant design factors. A content-matched Split condition holds generated text and tokens fixed but treats each section as an independent document; Full's +1.02 mean gain isolates document packaging. A length-matched RandomConcat control that joins sections from different books remains below Full, ruling out document length alone. A retrieval-pool-matched Rephrase condition independently rewrites individual retrieved documents under the same audience-by-style scheme, without clustering, TOC planning, or book assembly; Full's +1.17 gain demonstrates the value of structured synthesis. On Llama3-8B, Full likewise outperforms both RandomConcat and Natural Books, supporting book-level organization as a useful axis for synthetic pre-training data design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成教科书数据 (synthetic textbook data) 对语言模型中期训练 (mid-training) 的增益是否不仅来自生成内容或局部改写风格，还来自将相关内容组织成连贯的书籍级文档。作者提出一个可扩展的合成流水线：从预训练语料中检索素材、按主题聚类、规划层级目录，并组装成完整书籍，共生成 686K 本教科书（32B token），覆盖 15,000+ 学科。将自然书籍替换为该语料后，下游任务平均提升 +1.09；受控对照实验表明文档打包 (document packaging)、而非纯长度或独立改写，是增益的关键。
Motivation: 以往工作大多把合成教科书数据的收益归因于生成内容本身或局部改写风格，本文关注一个被忽视的因素：相关内容是否被组织成连贯的书籍级文档，以及这种组织方式对预训练数据设计是否有独立价值。
Method: 提出检索-聚类-目录规划-书籍组装的合成流水线：从预训练语料中检索源材料，聚类成主题单元，规划层级目录 (hierarchical tables of contents)，并将基于源内容的章节组装成完整书籍（Full 设置）。为解耦影响因素，设计了内容匹配的 Split 条件（每节作为独立文档）、长度匹配的 RandomConcat 对照（拼接不同书籍的章节）以及 retrieval-pool 匹配的 Rephrase 条件（无聚类、目录规划或书籍组装的独立改写）。
Result: 在中期训练混合数据中用该语料替代自然书籍，下游任务平均提升 +1.09。Full 相比 Split 的平均增益为 +1.02，隔离了文档打包的作用；RandomConcat 始终低于 Full，排除文档长度单独解释；Full 相比 Rephrase 的增益为 +1.17，显示结构化合成优于独立改写。在 Llama3-8B 上，Full 同样优于 RandomConcat 和自然书籍。
Conclusion: 作者认为书籍级组织 (book-level organization) 是合成预训练数据设计中一个有效的独立维度，除内容质量与改写风格外，数据打包方式也值得纳入设计考量。

papers.title: mmRadarTwin: A Measurement-Calibrated Signal-Level Digital Twin Platform for Indoor mmWave Radar
papers.abstract_en: Indoor mmWave radar perception is difficult to reproduce because measured range-angle responses depend on scene geometry, material response, multipath, hardware conventions, and signal processing. Existing ray-tracing and digital-twin tools often expose rendering, channel, or path-level quantities, while radar sensing requires complex signal products that can be processed and compared in the same domain as real FMCW measurements. We present mmRadarTwin, a signal-level and path-attributed digital-twin platform for indoor mmWave radar. mmRadarTwin links a real radar measurement branch with an Unreal Engine scene-simulation branch through a shared receive-channel and range-angle processing interface. The simulator writes complex multi-channel receive grids and exports per-path contribution records that identify the actor, material tag, propagation event, and output-bin support of each simulated return. We evaluate mmRadarTwin in an office deployment using a commodity monostatic mmWave radar and mobile scene-capture hardware. Across 154 measured poses spanning 22 radar locations, the current physics-only path-basis simulator recalls 70.8% of measurement-active geometry-supported response regions in the central usable field of view while exposing residuals caused by weak or missing path support, shifted responses, unsupported anchors, and missing physical mechanisms. Rather than claiming complete radar-map reconstruction or cross-room generalization, mmRadarTwin establishes a practical systems workflow for constructing, comparing, and diagnosing indoor radar digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mmRadarTwin，一个面向室内毫米波雷达的信号级、逐路径属性数字孪生平台。平台将真实雷达测量分支与 Unreal Engine 场景仿真分支通过共享的接收通道与 range-angle 处理接口连接，仿真器输出复数多通道接收网格并导出逐路径贡献记录。在办公室部署中，使用商用单站毫米波雷达与移动场景采集硬件，在 22 个雷达位置、154 个测量位姿下评估，当前仅物理路径基础的仿真器在中心可用视场内召回 70.8% 的受测量支持、几何支持响应区域，并暴露了弱路径支持等残差来源。
Motivation: 室内毫米波雷达感知难以复现，因为测量的距离-角度响应依赖场景几何、材料响应、多径、硬件约定和信号处理；现有光线追踪与数字孪生工具多暴露渲染、信道或路径级量，而雷达感知需要可在与真实 FMCW 测量相同域中处理和比较的复杂信号产品。
Method: 构建信号级且逐路径属性可归因的数字孪生平台 mmRadarTwin，通过共享接收通道与 range-angle 处理接口连接真实雷达测量分支与 Unreal Engine 场景仿真分支；仿真器写入复数多通道接收网格，并输出标识每个仿真回波的参与者、材料标签、传播事件与输出 bin 支持的逐路径贡献记录。
Result: 在办公室部署中，使用商用单站毫米波雷达开展评估，覆盖 22 个雷达位置、154 个测量位姿；当前物理路径基础的仿真器在中心可用视场内对受测量支持且几何支持的响应区域达到 70.8% 召回，同时暴露出弱或缺失路径支持、响应偏移、不支持锚点及缺失物理机制造成的残差。
Conclusion: 作者不声称实现完整的雷达图重建或跨房间泛化，而是将 mmRadarTwin 定位为建立、比较和诊断室内雷达数字孪生的实用系统工作流。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MIND: Lightweight and Effective Memory Injection Defense for LLM Agents via Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented LLM-based agents are vulnerable to memory injection attacks: Agents may retrieve poisoned memory from attackers, which diverts their behavior from initial user intent and finally causes task failure. However, existing defense mechanisms either incur high computational cost or suffer from information redundancy in multi-turn contexts. To address these challenges, we propose Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising(MIND), a lightweight defense framework for memory injection attack. Our preliminary analysis reveals that benign and poisoned trajectories exhibit distinguishable relationships between the initial user intent and subsequent behavior. Building on this observation, MIND employs an intent-aware Information Bottleneck(IB) to extract compact intent--behavior representations from the initial intent and turn-level behavior. The IB preserves intent-relevant cross-turn attack signals while filtering task-irrelevant and repetitive information, and a lightweight detector identifies malicious memories from the resulting representations. As such, MIND mitigates information redundancy in multi-turn contexts while avoiding the overhead of repeated LLM auditing. Extensive experiments show that MIND reduces attack success rates while preserving task accuracy and inference efficiency. Notably, on ReAct-StrategyQA, MIND reduces mean ASR-r and ASR-a by 55.4% and 55.3%, respectively, while matching the undefended agent in average accuracy and latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIND（Memory Intent-Aware Neural Denoising），一个针对 LLM 智能体记忆注入攻击（memory injection attacks）的轻量级防御框架。MIND 利用初始用户意图与后续行为之间的关系，通过意图感知信息瓶颈（Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck, IB）提取紧凑的意图-行为表示，并用轻量级检测器识别恶意记忆。实验表明，在 ReAct-StrategyQA 上，MIND 将平均 ASR-r 和 ASR-a 分别降低 55.4% 和 55.3%，同时保持与无防御 agent 相近的平均准确率和推理延迟。
Motivation: 记忆增强的 LLM 智能体容易受到记忆注入攻击，攻击者通过投毒记忆使智能体偏离用户初始意图。现有防御机制要么计算成本高，要么在多轮上下文中存在信息冗余问题。
Method: MIND 基于良性与恶意轨迹在初始意图与后续行为之间关系的可区分性，采用意图感知信息瓶颈（IB）从初始意图和逐轮行为中提取紧凑的意图-行为表示，保留与意图相关的跨轮攻击信号，同时过滤任务无关和重复信息，再由轻量级检测器识别恶意记忆。
Result: 在 ReAct-StrategyQA 数据集上，MIND 使平均 ASR-r 降低 55.4%、ASR-a 降低 55.3%，同时平均准确率和延迟与未防御的智能体相当，表明该方法在降低攻击成功率的同时保持了任务准确性和推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MIND 能够缓解多轮上下文中的信息冗余，并避免重复 LLM 审计带来的计算开销，是一种轻量级且有效的记忆注入防御方案。

papers.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数学上等价的专家归约顺序在稀疏 MoE 推理中产生可观察行为差异的现象。作者在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上冻结局部 MoE 状态、仅改变聚合语义，分离操作数表示与累加器精度，发现同一 layer-5 fork 下 720 种 A-mode 顺序产生 10 个续写 basin，720 种 B-mode 顺序形成 360 个精确结构类和 11 个 basin。结果将专家操作数转换、累加器精度与归约顺序定义为稀疏 MoE 运行时与硬件后端的数值兼容性契约。
Motivation: 现有稀疏 MoE 推理通常隐含假设数学上等价的归约顺序产生相同执行，但实际数值行为可能分叉，影响路由、token 序列与文本，且发散可跨 token 边界存活并延迟显现，因此需要将其纳入运行时数值兼容性契约。
Method: 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 中冻结局部 MoE 状态，仅变化聚合语义；设计四种方案将操作数表示与累加器精度分离，并通过最大 L-infinity B 分支选择、192 条持久轨迹对照以及对 B 分支完整持久状态做精确 FP64 重建来定位发散边界。
Result: 摘要报告同一 fork 下 720 种 A-mode 顺序形成 10 个续写 basin，720 种 B-mode 顺序形成 360 个结构类和 11 个 basin；某中文 prompt 下 B 类分为 202 个裁撤、113 个招聘和 45 个其他续写。最大 L-infinity B 分支选择在 8/16/32 token 处分别分开 12/24/36 个 prompt；192 条轨迹对照中 P32、A、B 均改变原生参考路由轨迹，而 C 保持路由、token 序列与文本不变，且 FP64 精确重建可复现下游轨迹。
Conclusion: 控制实验将 post-mHC 确定为 intra-token 边界、完整持久状态为跨 token 续写边界，表明相同 token 并不保证相同自回归状态。作者强调这些结果是受控因果可能性而非部署发生率，且 C 的顺序不变性仅限于所评估的六项状态与调度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究数学上等价的专家归约顺序在稀疏 MoE 推理中产生可观察行为差异的现象。作者在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上冻结局部 MoE 状态、仅改变聚合语义，分离操作数表示与累加器精度，发现同一 layer-5 fork 下 720 种 A-mode 顺序产生 10 个续写 basin，720 种 B-mode 顺序形成 360 个精确结构类和 11 个 basin。结果将专家操作数转换、累加器精度与归约顺序定义为稀疏 MoE 运行时与硬件后端的数值兼容性契约。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有稀疏 MoE 推理通常隐含假设数学上等价的归约顺序产生相同执行，但实际数值行为可能分叉，影响路由、token 序列与文本，且发散可跨 token 边界存活并延迟显现，因此需要将其纳入运行时数值兼容性契约。
summary_sections.method: 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 中冻结局部 MoE 状态，仅变化聚合语义；设计四种方案将操作数表示与累加器精度分离，并通过最大 L-infinity B 分支选择、192 条持久轨迹对照以及对 B 分支完整持久状态做精确 FP64 重建来定位发散边界。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告同一 fork 下 720 种 A-mode 顺序形成 10 个续写 basin，720 种 B-mode 顺序形成 360 个结构类和 11 个 basin；某中文 prompt 下 B 类分为 202 个裁撤、113 个招聘和 45 个其他续写。最大 L-infinity B 分支选择在 8/16/32 token 处分别分开 12/24/36 个 prompt；192 条轨迹对照中 P32、A、B 均改变原生参考路由轨迹，而 C 保持路由、token 序列与文本不变，且 FP64 精确重建可复现下游轨迹。
summary_sections.conclusion: 控制实验将 post-mHC 确定为 intra-token 边界、完整持久状态为跨 token 续写边界，表明相同 token 并不保证相同自回归状态。作者强调这些结果是受控因果可能性而非部署发生率，且 C 的顺序不变性仅限于所评估的六项状态与调度。

papers.title: An Instrument to Evaluate Governance Proposals: AI Policy Analysis at Scale
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a policy analysis framework for systematic, transparent assessment of AI governance proposals in an evolving and contested regulatory landscape. AI policy debates often collapse into binary positions that obscure underlying tradeoffs and normative assumptions. The framework structures policy analysis around multiple policy attributes, allowing users to surface priorities and tensions without prescribing outcomes. We use a mixed-methods approach that integrates qualitative insights from subject matter experts with computational text analysis to inform the design of policy attribute rubrics. This quantifies the relative emphasis of different policy objectives and presents them through comparative visualizations that support interpretability and cross-policy comparison. The paper also examines the use of commercial LLMs for rubric-based policy analysis, benchmarking their outputs against a domain-trained rubric-calibrated model with explicitly defined analytical assumptions. Rather than assessing policy effectiveness or desirability, the framework focuses on relevance and alignment across attributes. By making analytical assumptions explicit, including attribute selection, rubric construction, and weighting schemes, the framework enables users to evaluate whether its embedded priorities align with the users' own normative commitments. The approach is jurisdiction-agnostic and intended to support policymakers, analysts, and researchers navigating complex AI governance environments. Contributions: (1) multidimensional policy assessment through empirically grounded rubrics that surface tradeoffs rather than resolving them; (2) a transparent hybrid methodology combining feedback from subject-matter experts with computational validation; and (3) use of domain-trained rubric-calibrated models as a benchmark for comparing different general-purpose large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于 AI 治理提案的系统化政策分析框架，旨在对不断变化且充满争议的监管环境进行透明评估。框架围绕多个政策属性组织分析，并采用混合方法：结合领域专家定性反馈与计算文本分析来设计政策属性 rubric，量化不同政策目标的相对权重，并通过对比可视化支持跨政策比较。文章还考察了商用 LLM 在基于 rubric 的政策分析中的表现，将其输出与一个领域训练且具有明确分析假设的 rubric 校准模型进行基准对比。
Motivation: AI 政策辩论常退化为二元立场，掩盖了底层的权衡和规范性假设；现有讨论缺乏系统、透明且不预设结果的评估工具。
Method: 提出多维政策评估框架，围绕多个政策属性构建由实证支撑的 rubric；采用混合方法，将领域专家反馈与计算文本分析结合以指导 rubric 设计，并用领域训练的 rubric 校准模型作为基准来比较不同通用大语言模型。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅说明将商用 LLM 的 rubric 分析输出与领域训练的 rubric 校准模型进行基准对比，并强调框架聚焦于属性间的相关性与一致性而非政策效果。
Conclusion: 框架不评判政策的有效性或可取性，而是通过明确说明属性选择、rubric 构建和权重方案等分析假设，让用户判断框架内置优先级是否符合自身规范性立场；该方法与管辖区域无关，面向政策制定者、分析师和研究人员。

papers.title: Meteosat Third Generation imagery improves CNN-based SSI retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Surface Solar Irradiance (SSI) estimation is increasingly important for photovoltaic energy monitoring and forecasting. The recently introduced Meteosat Third Generation (MTG) satellite constellation provides imaging data with higher spatial resolution compared to the Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) satellite constellation, but its benefits for machine-learning-based SSI retrieval have not been well established. In this work, we introduce a multi-imager and multi-resolution convolutional neural network architecture for 10-minute SSI retrieval over Northern Europe (Estonia) using MSG/SEVIRI and MTG/FCI satellite imagery together with solar-geometry and clear-sky irradiance features. Model performance is evaluated against ground-based pyranometer measurements from eight Estonian meteorological stations using site-based cross-validation and multiple training seeds. Model performance is also compared with the SARAH-3 physics-based satellite SSI product. The hybrid SEVIRI-FCI model significantly outperformed the SEVIRI-only model under overcast and cloudy conditions, reducing RMSE by 8.2 W m$^{-2}$ and 5.7 W m$^{-2}$, respectively. However, under partly cloudy or clear skies, no statistically significant difference in RMSE was observed between the SEVIRI-FCI hybrid and the SEVIRI-only models. Compared with physics-based SARAH-3, the hybrid model yielded skill scores of 35 % under overcast conditions, 21 % under cloudy conditions, and 20 % overall. Furthermore, both models underperformed SARAH-3 in clear-sky conditions. These results show that higher-resolution MTG/FCI imagery improves CNN-based SSI retrieval when clouds dominate irradiance variability, but also indicate that higher spatial resolution alone is insufficient to address clear-sky limitations in machine-learning-based SSI retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多成像仪、多分辨率的卷积神经网络架构，用于北欧（爱沙尼亚）10分钟尺度的地表太阳辐照度（SSI）反演，输入为 MSG/SEVIRI 与 MTG/FCI 卫星图像，并附加太阳几何与晴空辐照度特征。模型通过与爱沙尼亚八个气象站的地面总辐射表测量值进行基于站点的交叉验证和多种训练种子评估，并与基于物理的 SARAH-3 卫星产品比较。结果显示，混合 SEVIRI-FCI 模型在阴天和多云条件下显著优于仅使用 SEVIRI 的模型，RMSE 分别降低 8.2 与 5.7 W m^-2；在部分多云或晴空条件下两者无显著差异。相对 SARAH-3，混合模型在阴天、多云和总体条件下的技能分数分别为 35%、21% 和 20%，但两种模型在晴空条件下均逊于 SARAH-3。
Motivation: 准确估计地表太阳辐照度对光伏能量监测与预测日益重要。新一代 Meteosat Third Generation (MTG) 星座相比 Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) 提供更高空间分辨率成像数据，但其对基于机器学习的 SSI 反演是否有益尚未得到充分验证。
Method: 提出一种多成像仪、多分辨率的卷积神经网络架构，联合使用 MSG/SEVIRI 与 MTG/FCI 卫星图像，以及太阳几何和晴空辐照度特征，进行 10 分钟尺度的 SSI 反演。评估基于爱沙尼亚八个气象站的实测数据，采用基于站点的交叉验证（site-based cross-validation）与多个训练种子。
Result: 混合 SEVIRI-FCI 模型在阴天和多云条件下显著优于 SEVIRI-only 模型，RMSE 分别降低 8.2 W m^-2 与 5.7 W m^-2；部分多云或晴空条件下 RMSE 无统计学显著差异。与物理模型 SARAH-3 相比，混合模型在阴天、多云和总体条件下的技能分数分别为 35%、21% 和 20%，但两种模型在晴空条件下均不如 SARAH-3。
Conclusion: 更高分辨率的 MTG/FCI 图像在云主导辐照度变化时能够改善基于 CNN 的 SSI 反演，但仅靠更高的空间分辨率不足以解决机器学习方法在晴空条件下的反演局限。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: PerturbMap: Cross-Context Transfer of Single-Cell Perturbation Responses
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell perturbation atlases rarely measure every intervention in every cellular context: a query perturbation is often observed in one or more source contexts but missing in the recipient context where its effect is needed. Ignoring those measured responses discards query-specific experimental evidence, whereas copying or weakly calibrating them across contexts risks transferring the wrong signal. We propose PerturbMap, which predicts a missing recipient-context effect by combining a recipient-local low-rank base with accepted proposals that transport the same perturbation's measured source responses through source-to-recipient ridge experts fit on paired training perturbations, with proposal weights determined by route reliability estimated on validation anchors. On the Perturb-CITE-seq melanoma cohort, PerturbMap improves full-effect MSE by 4.1\% over a recipient-local low-rank base and achieves lower MSE than FedAvg, zero-response, raw-copy, calibrated-copy, and identity-shuffled affine controls. It remains within $2.82\times10^{-6}$ MSE of our centralized token-matched pooled reference, which uses a stronger training interface. A condition-mean specificity diagnostic shows the same direction: same-recipient top-10 counterpart retrieval by cosine increases from 74.5\% for the low-rank base to 80.5\% for PerturbMap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PerturbMap，用于预测单细胞扰动数据中缺失的受体环境（recipient context）效应。方法将受体局部的低秩基线（low-rank base）与通过源到受体岭专家（source-to-recipient ridge experts）迁移同一种扰动已测响应的提案相结合，并用验证锚点估计的路线可靠性加权。在 Perturb-CITE-seq 黑色素瘤队列上，该方法将全效应 MSE 相对低秩基线提升 4.1%，并优于多种对照。
Motivation: 单细胞扰动图谱很少在每种细胞环境中测量所有干预：查询扰动往往在一个或多个源环境中被观测到，却在其效应所需的受体环境中缺失。直接忽略这些测量会丢弃查询特异的实验证据，而跨环境复制或弱校准又可能迁移错误信号。
Method: PerturbMap 由两部分组成：一个受体局部低秩基线，以及若干被接受的提案；这些提案将同一扰动的已测源响应，通过基于配对的训练扰动拟合的源到受体岭专家迁移到受体环境。提案权重由验证锚点上估计的路线可靠性决定。
Result: 在 Perturb-CITE-seq 黑色素瘤队列上，PerturbMap 将全效应 MSE 相对受体局部低秩基线改进 4.1%，且 MSE 低于 FedAvg、零响应、原始复制、校准复制和恒等打乱仿射等对照；它与使用更强训练接口的集中式 token 匹配池化参考之间的 MSE 差距在 2.82×10^-6 以内。条件均值特异性诊断显示，同一受体的 top-10 反事实检索余弦命中率从低秩基线的 74.5% 提高到 PerturbMap 的 80.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将受体局部基线与按路线可靠性加权的跨上下文迁移结合，比简单复制或弱校准更能准确地填补缺失的受体环境效应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diversifying Personalized Research Ideation against AI-Induced Homogenization
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted research ideation has emerged as a promising paradigm for accelerating scientific discovery, with systems now capable of generating research directions conditioned on papers, topics, or lightweight researcher contexts. Yet current systems largely optimize individual suggestions in isolation. This leaves two blind spots. First, coarse researcher representations may elicit mainstream directions that appear broadly feasible, but lack sufficient researcher-specific grounding. Second, independent recommendations can concentrate a community's portfolio around recurring high-probability themes. To address these blind spots, we propose DivAlign, a four-stage pipeline for alignment-preserving de-homogenization. DivAlign extracts fine-grained researcher profiles, generates profile-conditioned candidate directions, scores them along three alignment dimensions (Executability, Comprehensibility, and Growth Potential), and surfaces researcher-local directions while reducing redundancy across the community portfolio. On a benchmark we construct from 95 AI researchers across five subfields, DivAlign reduces community-level redundancy while preserving researcher-direction fit. Compared with coarse single-shot ideation, it lowers average pairwise similarity from 0.331 to 0.294 and nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.704 to 0.608. Compared with the independent top-choice variant, DivAlign reduces nearest-neighbor similarity from 0.663 to 0.608 while retaining 99.9% of the researcher-direction fit score. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ruixxxx/DivAlign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 辅助科研选题中出现的同质化问题，提出 DivAlign，一个保持对齐的去同质化四阶段流程。它提取细粒度研究者画像，生成以画像为条件的候选方向，并按 Executability、Comprehensibility、Growth Potential 三个对齐维度打分，在保留研究者-方向匹配度的同时降低社区层面的冗余。作者在由 95 位 AI 研究者、五个子领域构成的基准上验证，DivAlign 将平均两两相似度由 0.331 降至 0.294、最近邻相似度由 0.704 降至 0.608。
Motivation: 现有 AI 辅助科研选题系统大多孤立地优化单条建议，导致两个盲点：粗略的研究者表征可能引出缺乏个体依据的主流方向，且独立推荐会使社区选题集中到重复出现的高概率主题上。
Method: 提出 DivAlign 四阶段流水线：提取细粒度研究者画像，生成画像条件化的候选方向，沿 Executability、Comprehensibility、Growth Potential 三个对齐维度评分，并在保留研究者局部方向的同时降低社区选题冗余。
Result: 在包含 95 位 AI 研究者、五个子领域的基准上，DivAlign 将平均两两相似度从 0.331 降至 0.294、最近邻相似度从 0.704 降至 0.608；与独立 top-choice 变体相比，最近邻相似度从 0.663 降至 0.608，同时保留 99.9% 的研究者-方向匹配得分。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法能在保留研究者-方向对齐的前提下降低社区层面的选题冗余，并公开了代码与数据。

papers.title: Distilling Answer Set Programming Theories from Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Writing Answer Set Programming (ASP) theories from scratch is a difficult and time-consuming task. We take a neurosymbolic approach to study whether a model can distill complete and correct theories, given a fixed agent harness with the solver in the loop. The protocol is dataset-agnostic: with a single prompt and an empty file as the starting point the model is given a 1-hour time limit to derive a complete theory. We chose VQA as the application domain, three benchmarks (CLEVR, GQA, CLEVRER), as these are publicly available and non-trivial. In order to study the model scale required for solving this task we nine different models: four frontier (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, DeepSeek V4 Pro), two mid-tier (DeepSeek V4 Flash, gpt-oss-120b), and three open-weights (qwen3.6-27b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3.5-9b). Three of four frontier models reach 100% on CLEVR and 92.8%-98.8% on GQA; on CLEVRER, Sonnet, Opus, DeepSeek V4 Pro score 92.7%-95.3%. GPT-5 reaches 98.7% on CLEVR but drops to 41.8% on GQA and to 86.7% on CLEVRER. Adding handwritten reference theories from other datasets moves the other three frontier models by at most +/-3.4 pp but reduces GPT-5's accuracy by 3-19 pp. We release the code, prompts, and theories distilled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 方法研究：在固定 agent harness 且求解器在环 (solver in the loop) 的条件下，大型语言模型能否从零蒸馏出完整且正确的 Answer Set Programming (ASP) 理论。协议与数据集无关：以单个提示词和空文件为起点，给模型 1 小时时限推导完整理论。作者在 VQA 领域选择 CLEVR、GQA、CLEVRER 三个基准，测试了四个前沿模型、两个中端模型和三个开放权重模型，并发布了代码、提示词和蒸馏出的理论。
Motivation: 从头编写 ASP 理论困难且耗时，本文关注的是模型是否能在求解器辅助下自动蒸馏出完整正确的理论，以及解决该任务所需的模型规模。
Method: 提出数据集无关的蒸馏协议：模型以单个提示和空文件开始，在 1 小时时限内通过固定 agent harness 与求解器交互，推导出完整 ASP 理论；用九个不同规模的模型在三个公开 VQA 基准上评估。
Result: 四个前沿模型中有三个在 CLEVR 上达到 100%、在 GQA 上达到 92.8%-98.8%；在 CLEVRER 上 Sonnet、Opus、DeepSeek V4 Pro 达到 92.7%-95.3%。GPT-5 在 CLEVR 上达 98.7%，但在 GQA 上降至 41.8%、在 CLEVRER 上降至 86.7%。加入其他数据集的手写参考理论后，其余三个前沿模型变化最多 ±3.4 个百分点，却使 GPT-5 的准确率下降 3-19 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，在给定时间限制和固定协议下，部分前沿模型能够蒸馏出在若干 VQA 基准上完整且正确的 ASP 理论，但不同模型间的稳健性差异显著，且外部参考理论可能带来负面影响（尤其对 GPT-5）。该结论限定于 VQA 应用域和所提出的蒸馏框架。

papers.title: On a joint simultaneous learning of relevant feature subsets and subspaces in regression-like problems
papers.abstract_en: We extend a recently introduced Entropy-Optimal Manifold Clustering (EOMC) to allow for a joint simultaneous identification of subsets and subspaces of relevant features in nonstationary and nonlinear regression problems. It is shown that the proposed extension - that we coin as Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression (EOMR) - allows a robust learning with linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities. EOMR is compared to the most complete set of state-of-the-art tools from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) that is available to the author, on the very challenging problems from chaotic and fluid dynamics: (i) on predicting the Lorenz-96 systems dynamics in strongly- and very-strongly chaotic regimes (with forcing parameter being $F=8$ and $F=12$, respectively); and, (ii) on a data from the Hasegawa-Wakatani model on the edge of the tokamak plasma. It is demonstrated that the proposed benchmarks (i) and (ii), indeed, are the very challenging problems for the state of the art ML and AI tools - since both the general-purpose gradient boosted random forests and deep neuronal networks, as well as transformer-based AI tools like TabPFN v.03 (more spezialised for large-dimensional small data learning problems) - result in orders of magnitude inferior root mean squared prediction errors, and orders of magnitude larger model complexities, when compared to the EOMR. For a Hasegawa-Wakatani example, EOMR distills a very simple entropy-optimal and skilful description of the leading Essential Orthogonal Function (EOF) dynamics, given by linear, causal and weakly-stationary autoregressive process described by just 8 parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出熵最优流形回归 (Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression, EOMR)，将最近提出的熵最优流形聚类 (EOMC) 扩展到非平稳非线性回归问题，实现相关特征子集与子空间的联合同时学习，并保持线性的迭代与内存复杂度。作者在 Lorenz-96（强迫参数 F=8 与 F=12 的强混沌和极强混沌状态）以及 Hasegawa-Wakatani 托卡马克边缘等离子体数据上对比了多种 SOTA 机器学习与人工智能工具，报告 EOMR 的均方根预测误差和模型复杂度均低几个数量级。
Motivation: 在高维、非平稳非线性的回归问题中，同时识别相关特征子集和子空间具有挑战性，而现有通用机器学习与人工智能工具（如梯度提升随机森林、深度神经网络及 TabPFN）在这些复杂动力系统预测任务上表现不佳。
Method: 在 EOMC 基础上扩展出 EOMR，通过联合优化特征子集选择与子空间学习来实现鲁棒学习，并保证迭代和内存复杂度随问题规模线性增长。
Result: 在 Lorenz-96 和 Hasegawa-Wakatani 基准上，EOMR 相比梯度提升随机森林、深度神经网络及 transformer 类工具 TabPFN v.03，均方根预测误差和模型复杂度低几个数量级；对于 Hasegawa-Wakatani，EOMR 仅用 8 个参数的线性、因果、弱平稳自回归过程就提炼出前导 EOF 动力学的简洁有效描述。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 EOMR 能在极具挑战性的非平稳非线性回归问题上以极低的模型复杂度获得远优于现有 SOTA 工具的预测技能，并可用于从复杂动力系统中蒸馏可解释的简约动力学模型。
