papers.title: It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations
papers.abstract_en: Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming. To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization. Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: https://github.com/fferflo/einx
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 einx，一种用于张量操作 (tensor operations) 的通用符号表示。作者从向量化 (vectorization) 的角度重新审视张量运算，将不同阶的操作统一为声明式、逐点 (pointful) 的表达式，以替代 Numpy 风格 API 和 einsum/einops 等受限方案。摘要声称该符号能把现有框架的大型 API 化简为一小组基础操作，并在 Python 中提供了与现有张量框架无缝集成的实现。
Motivation: 主流张量框架的 Numpy 风格符号难以读写，并且因大量操作之间存在不一致规则而容易产生形状错误 (shape errors)；einsum 和 einops 虽流行但只支持少数操作，缺乏作为通用张量编程模型的普适性。
Method: 作者将向量化视为一种变换张量操作的函数，用它把低阶操作提升为高阶操作，并将高阶操作概念性地分解为低阶操作及其向量化。基于这一思想，einx 采用与循环记号 (loop notation) 类比定义的声明式 pointful 表达式，统一表达张量运算。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是提出 einx 符号体系及其嵌入式 Python 实现；实现地址为 https://github.com/fferflo/einx，并声称能与现有张量框架无缝集成。
Conclusion: 作者认为 einx 证明了基于向量化的通用符号可以将现有框架的大规模 API 简化为少量基本操作，并提供一致、可读可写的代码表示；该工作以符号设计与实现为主，未在摘要中讨论适用范围或局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems have widened the gap between producing candidate outputs and reviewing them. This paper asks a practical architectural question: should domain specialization be built into an evaluator's weights, or into the rule that decides when its judgment can be trusted? We study 99,952 public, rubric-conditioned examples. Supplying the correct rubric improves locked-test accuracy by 2.11 points over a response-only control; replacing it with an unrelated rubric costs 2.66 points. Dividing the same training corpus among eight criterion-family LoRA judges, however, loses 10.05 points and cuts audited coverage at a 5% risk target from 24.44% to 5.43%. Matching the bank's stored capacity with one rank-64 adapter does not reproduce this loss. Nor is the result explained by learning rate or optimizer steps. Initializing the family adapters from a shared, trained judge recovers test accuracy to 76.85%, 19.94 points above scratch training at the same learning rate (95% interval 18.88-21.02). The result changes when specialization governs deferral rather than judgment. On RewardBench 2, learned correctness heads route examples through a 0.6B-4B-8B cascade without changing any reward score. Across 20 locked repartitions, the cascade attains 89.40% accuracy, compared with 84.75% for 8B alone, at 0.415 normalized parameter compute. Every run passes an exact one-sided 95% risk audit; margin-based rules remain near 84.8% accuracy while using at least 0.94 compute. These results suggest a qualified design rule: share the learning of judgment until there is enough data to justify a split, and place domain-specific adaptation in an audited release boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体系统评测中的一个架构问题：领域专门化应放在评测器（evaluator）的权重里，还是放在决定其判断何时可被信任的规则里。作者基于 99,952 个带 rubric 条件的公开样本，比较了多组 LoRA 专家评测器与共享评测器、以及基于延迟（deferral）的级联路由设置。结果是切分训练语料训练八组 criterion-family LoRA 评测器显著掉点，而从共享训练好的评测器初始化可恢复精度；在 RewardBench 2 上，用学习到的正确性头做级联路由可以在更低参数计算量下超过单 8B 模型。
Motivation: 智能体系统让候选输出的生成与审查之间的差距变大，作者想回答一个实际架构问题：领域专门化应当内置到评测器的权重中，还是内置到决定其判断何时可信的规则中。
Method: 在评测器权重侧，论文对照响应-only 基线、正确/无关 rubric 条件，并训练八组 criterion-family LoRA 评测器及一个 rank-64 adapter，比较随机初始化和从共享已训练评测器初始化；在延迟侧，论文在 RewardBench 2 上让学习到的正确性头将样本路由经过 0.6B-4B-8B 级联，但不改变任何奖励分数。
Result: 提供正确 rubric 比响应-only 对照提升 locked-test 精度 2.11 点，替换为无关 rubric 损失 2.66 点；把训练语料分给八个 LoRA 评测器损失 10.05 点，5% 风险目标下的可审计覆盖率从 24.44% 降到 5.43%。从共享已训练评测器初始化可将测试精度恢复到 76.85%，比同学习率下 scratch 训练高 19.94 点（95% 区间 18.88-21.02）。在 RewardBench 2 的 20 次锁定重划分上，级联达到 89.40% 准确率，高于单 8B 的 84.75%，归一化参数计算量为 0.415。
Conclusion: 作者给出一个有条件的经验法则：在数据量足以支撑拆分之前应共享判断学习，并把领域特定适配放在经过审计的发布边界（audited release boundary）中，即专门化应控制延迟而非判断本身。

papers.title: ViP-Rig: Visual-Prompted Controllable Rigging
papers.abstract_en: Rigging is inherently task-dependent because the same mesh may require different skeletons and deformation behaviors across animation tasks. In practice, artists often inspect an initial rig and repeatedly edit its skeletal structure and deformation behavior to meet specific animation requirements. Existing automatic methods primarily generate a plausible rig from geometry, offering limited explicit control over the resulting skeleton and deformation behavior. In this work, we present ViP-Rig, a visual-prompted framework that supports both prompt-first rigging and result-guided editing by injecting features extracted from user-drawn or edited 2D skeletal and rigidity prompts into frozen pretrained backbones. Specifically, ViP-Rig consists of two stages, Skeleton Generation and Skinning Prediction. In the first stage, the skeletal sketch is processed by the Dense-to-Compact Visual Prompt Encoding to produce compact, fixed-length conditioning tokens. The resulting tokens are injected into a frozen pretrained autoregressive generator through gated adapters to control joint placement and branching structure while preserving the generator's geometric prior. In the second stage, the rigidity map is processed using the same visual encoding design, while the pretrained skinning backbone remains frozen. The resulting tokens are symmetrically injected into the point and joint streams to modulate point-joint compatibility and the resulting skinning weights. Experiments on Articulation-XL2.0 and zero-shot evaluation on ModelsResource show that ViP-Rig more accurately recovers target skeletons and skinning weights than geometry-conditioned baselines under prompt-guided evaluation. Qualitative results further demonstrate explicit and localized control in both prompt-first rigging and result-guided editing.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Zihan Qin and Mingze Sun contributed equally. Xianming Liu is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViP-Rig，一个基于视觉提示的可控蒙皮绑定框架，支持 prompt-first rigging（先给提示再生成）和 result-guided editing（根据结果编辑）。方法把用户绘制或编辑的 2D 骨骼草图与刚性图（rigidity map）编码成紧凑的固定长度条件 token，并注入冻结的预训练骨干网络，分 Skeleton Generation 和 Skinning Prediction 两阶段控制骨架与蒙皮权重。实验在 Articulation-XL2.0 和 ModelsResource 零样本评估上表明，ViP-Rig 比基于几何条件的基线更准确地恢复目标骨架和蒙皮权重，并展现出显式、局部化的控制能力。
Motivation: 蒙皮绑定高度依赖具体动画任务，同一网格在不同任务中可能需要不同骨架和形变行为，而现有自动方法主要从几何生成看似合理的绑定，对结果骨架和形变行为缺乏显式控制，导致艺术家仍需反复人工编辑。
Method: ViP-Rig 包含两阶段流程：第一阶段用 Dense-to-Compact Visual Prompt Encoding 处理骨骼草图，生成紧凑 token，并通过 gated adapters 注入冻结的预训练自回归生成器，以控制关节点位置和分支结构；第二阶段用同样的编码方式处理刚性图，并将 token 对称注入冻结的蒙皮预测骨干的点流与关节点流，调制点-关节兼容性和蒙皮权重。
Result: 在 Articulation-XL2.0 数据集以及 ModelsResource 上的零样本评估中，ViP-Rig 在提示引导评估下比基于几何条件的基线更准确地恢复目标骨架和蒙皮权重；定性结果也展示了 prompt-first rigging 和 result-guided editing 中的显式、局部化控制。
Conclusion: 论文强调 ViP-Rig 在冻结预训练骨干中注入视觉提示，能够在保留几何先验的同时实现可控的骨架生成和蒙皮预测，并同时支持提示优先绑定与结果引导编辑两种交互方式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Generalization Bounds on Optimal Control for Transformer Training and Wasserstein Distributional Robustness
papers.abstract_en: We derive finite-sample generalization bounds for Transformers trained with dynamic programming recursions. Building on the doubly lifted, measure-valued formulation of Transformer dynamics, we view data sets as probability laws on pairs of empirical input-output measures, allowing us to interpret the training problem as a finite-horizon Markovian control problem. We then analyze a quantized model, derived by quantizing the state, action, and measure-state spaces, and derive explicit finite-sample generalization bounds using concentration inequalities for empirical laws on finite metric spaces together with a Lipschitz stability estimate for the value function. These bounds are transferred to the base model at the cost of an explicit approximation error. Finally, we show that the same machinery yields a distributionally robust control formulation of the training problem, connecting Transformer generalization to Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为以动态规划递推训练的 Transformer 推导有限样本泛化界。作者基于双重提升的测度值 Transformer 动态，将训练问题视为有限时域马尔可夫控制问题，通过对状态、动作和测度状态空间量化得到量化模型，并借助集中不等式与值函数的 Lipschitz 稳定性给出显式泛化界。最后指出该框架可导出 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒控制形式的训练问题。
Motivation: Transformer 训练可被形式化为动态规划/最优控制问题，但此类视角下缺乏显式的有限样本泛化保证。
Method: 将数据集视为经验输入-输出测度对的概率分布，构造有限时域马尔可夫控制问题；对状态、动作和测度状态空间进行量化，利用有限度量空间上经验律的集中不等式以及值函数的 Lipschitz 稳定性估计导出有限样本泛化界，并通过显式近似误差将界转移回原模型。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值，主要成果是显式有限样本泛化界以及将 Transformer 泛化与 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒优化相联系的分布鲁棒控制结论。
Conclusion: 作者强调同一套量化与控制机制可把训练问题表达为分布鲁棒控制，连接 Transformer 泛化与 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒优化；摘要未给出实验验证或局限说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Now You Have My Healthy Attention: A U-DiT for Brain-MRI Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: The ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis (Inpainting) task asks for the anatomically plausible completion of healthy brain tissue within a masked region of a T1-weighted MRI, providing a tumor-free anatomical reference for downstream analysis. As the task is scored by distortion metrics (SSIM, PSNR, MSE), we build a deterministic regression model and focus on giving it inductive biases tailored to inpainting. Our network follows the U-DiT principle of performing self-attention on a downsampled token grid: a volumetric encoder-decoder imports long-range context through a downsampled global self-attention block with three-dimensional rotary position embeddings, while convolutions and skip connections preserve high-frequency detail. Two ideas drive our results. First, we constrain the attention so that occluded ("void") tokens attend only to known-healthy tokens of the same volume, with a learned bias toward each query's contralateral homologue, forcing the completion to be inferred from observed anatomy rather than from other unknown regions. Second, we add a contralateral-symmetry input that supplies the mirrored healthy hemisphere as a patient-specific prior; since the brain is approximately bilaterally symmetric and lesions are typically unilateral, this prior improves the distortion metrics at matched structural similarity. On the official BraTS-2026 validation leaderboard our submission reaches a mean healthy-region SSIM of $0.864$, PSNR of $24.7$\,dB and MSE of $4.6{\times}10^{-3}$ over $219$ cases. We further analyse the residual smoothness inherent to distortion-optimal regression and discuss its implications for anatomical realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 ASNR-MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis (Inpainting) 任务，提出一种基于 U-DiT 的确定性回归模型，用于在 T1 加权 MRI 的掩膜区域内补全健康脑组织。模型通过下采样全局自注意力引入长程上下文，并引入两类归纳偏置：掩膜 token 只关注同体积中已知健康 token（带对侧同源偏置），以及将镜像健康半球作为患者特定先验输入。在 BraTS-2026 官方验证集上，提交结果达到健康区域平均 SSIM 0.864、PSNR 24.7 dB、MSE 4.6×10^-3（219 例）。
Motivation: BraTS 局部合成（inpainting）任务要求对掩膜区域进行解剖学合理的健康组织补全，以提供无肿瘤的参考影像；任务以失真指标评分，因此需要为确定性回归模型设计针对 inpaining 的归纳偏置。
Method: 采用 U-DiT 结构：体素编码器-解码器通过下采样全局自注意力块（带三维旋转位置编码）获取长程上下文，卷积与跳跃连接保留高频细节。注意力被约束为掩膜（void）token 仅关注同体积内已知健康 token，并加入朝向对侧同源区域的学习偏置；同时加入对侧对称输入，将镜像健康半球作为患者特定先验。
Result: 在官方 BraTS-2026 验证集 leaderboard 上，219 例的健康区域平均 SSIM 为 0.864、PSNR 为 24.7 dB、MSE 为 4.6×10^-3。作者还分析了失真最优回归固有的残差平滑性及其对解剖真实性的影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为约束注意力来源和引入对侧对称先验能利用脑部近似双侧对称、病灶通常单侧的特点提升失真指标；同时指出以失真指标为目标的回归会带来残差平滑，这对解剖真实性有影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAPO 提出一种面向 LLM 智能体的过渡感知策略优化框架，在标准强化学习更新之外，利用 rollout 数据对共享主干模型施加基于动作的条件化下一观测预测监督，从而提升模型对环境转移动态和动作后果的敏感性。作者在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上结合多种规模的基座模型与策略优化算法进行实验，结果表明 TAPO 持续优于纯策略优化基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体强化学习后训练主要依赖稀疏任务奖励，未充分利用在线交互中动作执行后天然存在的密集环境反馈信号；而理论研究表明多步目标导向任务的泛化依赖对环境后果的预测性知识。
Method: TAPO 是一个统一训练框架，在策略优化与过渡监督之间交替进行；除标准 RL 更新外，它将 rollout 数据重新用于对共享主干模型施加动作条件化的下一观测预测监督，作为现有智能体 RL 算法的轻量级即插即用增强模块，无需额外专家数据、额外采样成本或推理开销。
Result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上的系统实验表明，集成不同规模基座模型和不同策略优化算法时，TAPO 始终比纯策略优化基线带来任务性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TAPO 通过让模型更敏感于环境转移动态和动作后果，能在策略优化的同时提升任务表现，且是一种计算上轻量、可直接接入现有算法的增强方案。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上的系统实验表明，集成不同规模基座模型和不同策略优化算法时，TAPO 始终比纯策略优化基线带来任务性能提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 TAPO 通过让模型更敏感于环境转移动态和动作后果，能在策略优化的同时提升任务表现，且是一种计算上轻量、可直接接入现有算法的增强方案。

papers.title: FootprintNet: State-Transition-Guided Dynamic Footprint Learning for Multi-temporal Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Despite substantial progress in remote sensing multi-temporal change detection (MTCD), most existing MTCD methods still represent the dynamic process at each spatial location over the entire observation period using a single change category associated with the final observation. This implicit single-change assumption limits their ability to characterize regions of recurrent change closely related to human activities. To address this limitation, we introduce Urban Building Dynamics Detection (UBDD), which identifies building-change dynamic footprints, i.e., the temporal intervals in which changes occur, from multi-temporal imagery and produces pixel-wise classification masks. For regions undergoing two or more changes, UBDD introduces an independent multi-change class for unified representation, thereby enabling unified modeling of single- and multi-change processes. Furthermore, we propose FootprintNet, which abstracts building-change processes as interactions between latent states and actions, and imposes state-action transition constraints to guide the learning of causally coherent change trajectories. It further exploits temporal change-boundary cues to enhance feature contrast across boundary sides, thereby improving the discrimination among different dynamic footprints and enabling accurate detection of dynamic footprints. Moreover, we introduce the Building Change Dynamics Score (BCDS) to address the inability of conventional metrics to reflect the temporal proximity between predicted footprints and labels. It evaluates predictions according to their preservation of change semantics and temporal offsets from the corresponding labels. Extensive experiments on TSCD, MUDS, and WUSU demonstrate that FootprintNet outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/zmoka-zht/FootprintNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多时相遥感变化检测（MTCD）提出建筑动态足迹检测问题 UBDD，并用 FootprintNet 建模建筑变化过程。方法将变化视为潜在状态与动作的交互，通过状态-动作转移约束学习因果一致的变化轨迹，并利用时间变化边界线索增强特征对比，以区分不同动态足迹。在 TSCD、MUDS、WUSU 三个数据集上，FootprintNet 优于现有 SOTA，同时提出 Building Change Dynamics Score（BCDS）衡量预测与标签在时间偏移上的接近程度。
Motivation: 现有 MTCD 方法通常用与最终观测相关联的单一变化类别来表示每个空间位置在整个观测期的动态过程，这种隐含的单次变化假设限制了其对与人类活动密切相关的反复变化区域的刻画能力。
Method: 引入 UBDD 任务，对发生两次及以上变化的区域设置独立的多变化类别，以统一建模单次与多次变化过程；提出 FootprintNet，将建筑变化过程抽象为潜在状态与动作的交互，施加状态-动作转移约束来引导因果一致的变化轨迹学习，并利用时间变化边界线索增强边界两侧特征对比，提升动态足迹判别能力；额外提出 BCDS 指标来评估预测与标签在变化语义和时间偏移上的匹配程度。
Result: 在 TSCD、MUDS 和 WUSU 上的大量实验表明，FootprintNet 在动态足迹检测任务上优于当前最先进方法；BCDS 解决了传统指标无法反映预测足迹与标签时间邻近性的问题。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过统一建模单次与多次变化过程，并结合状态-动作转移约束与变化边界对比，可以有效检测多时相遥感影像中的建筑动态足迹；代码已开源。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Rewards: A Comparative Study of Reward Design for Reinforcement Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning seeks to selectively remove specific knowledge from trained language models without full retraining, a growing necessity under privacy regulations such as GDPR and the EU AI Act. Recent work has reformulated unlearning as a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) problem, where models are optimized against verifiable rewards computed directly from their outputs. However, existing methods rely on sparse binary rewards that provide minimal learning signal, indicating only whether forbidden content was avoided, and limiting convergence speed. In this paper, we study how reward design affects unlearning efficiency within the Reinforcement Unlearning (RUL) framework. We introduce a principled reward decomposition framework that decouples verifiability from sparsity, and propose two new reward functions: an exponential reward that provides graded penalties based on the count of forbidden-concept occurrences, and a PageRank inspired reward that weights penalties by semantic importance. We conduct experiments on the Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) benchmark, demonstrating that both rewards consistently outperform the binary setting, while reaching similar forgetting performance up to $3\times$ faster and preserving general model utility. Our results show that reward design is a key driver of unlearning efficiency offering a practical path toward scalable and efficient machine unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在强化学习反学习 (Reinforcement Unlearning, RUL) 框架下奖励设计对机器反学习效率的影响。作者提出一个将可验证性 (verifiability) 与稀疏性解耦的奖励分解框架，并设计两种新奖励：按禁忌概念出现次数提供分级惩罚的指数奖励，以及按语义重要性加权惩罚的 PageRank 启发奖励。在 Real World Knowledge Unlearning (RWKU) 基准上，两种奖励一致优于二元奖励，达到相似遗忘性能时收敛速度最多提升 3 倍，同时保持模型通用能力。
Motivation: 现有把反学习建模为 Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) 的方法依赖稀疏二元奖励，只表示是否避开禁忌内容，学习信号弱且限制收敛速度；在 GDPR 和 EU AI Act 等隐私法规下，需要更高效的奖励设计来提升反学习效率。
Method: 提出奖励分解框架，将可验证性与稀疏性解耦；在此基础上提出两种新奖励函数：一种根据禁忌概念出现次数给出分级惩罚的指数奖励，另一种受 PageRank 启发、按语义重要性加权惩罚的奖励。
Result: 在 RWKU 基准上的实验表明，两种新奖励均一致优于二元奖励设置，在达到相近遗忘性能时收敛速度快最多 3 倍，并保持通用模型效用 (general model utility)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调奖励设计是反学习效率的关键驱动因素，为可扩展、高效的机器反学习提供了实用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MARS-RA: Rank Aggregation for Credit Assignment via Multimodal Comparisons in Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
papers.abstract_en: Credit assignment is a fundamental challenge in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly in embodied AI settings characterized by limited and delayed feedback as well as dynamically changing numbers of active agents. We propose MARS-RA, a framework that reformulates credit assignment as a rank aggregation problem using contribution-based pairwise comparisons among agents generated by large multimodal models. This shift from absolute to relative estimation ensures robustness against noise and dynamic agent participation, converting comparison results into contribution scores for potential-based reward shaping. We provide theoretical justification for the convergence and robustness of the proposed framework, and show that Shapley values can be used as an interpretive reference. Experimental results on challenging tasks of different types indicate that MARS-RA can guide agents toward effective cooperation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARS-RA，一个面向具身多智能体合作中信用分配 (credit assignment) 的框架，将问题重构为基于贡献的成对比较的排名聚合 (rank aggregation) 问题，并借助大型多模态模型生成比较结果。该框架从绝对贡献估计转向相对估计，把比较结果转化为用于基于势能的奖励塑形 (potential-based reward shaping) 的贡献分数，并为收敛性和鲁棒性给出理论依据。实验在多种挑战性任务上表明 MARS-RA 能引导智能体实现有效合作。
Motivation: 在具身 AI 的多智能体强化学习中，信用分配因反馈有限且延迟、活跃智能体数量动态变化而尤为困难；现有绝对估计方法对噪声和参与人数变化较敏感。
Method: 提出 MARS-RA，用大型多模态模型对智能体进行基于贡献的成对比较，再把比较结果聚合成排名以得到贡献分数；借此将信用分配转化为排名聚合问题，并用贡献分数进行基于势能的奖励塑形，同时以 Shapley 值作为可解释性参照。
Result: 摘要报告在多种类型的挑战性任务上，MARS-RA 能引导智能体走向有效合作；同时给出框架收敛性与鲁棒性的理论论证。
Conclusion: 作者认为从绝对估计转向相对比较估计可以提升对噪声和动态智能体参与的鲁棒性，MARS-RA 为具身多智能体场景提供了一种可解释且理论有据的信用分配方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What Makes Graph Unified? Principles and Generative Sliding-Window Transformer for Graph Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose graph learning, aiming to learn reusable knowledge that generalizes across diverse graph domains and downstream tasks, reducing the need for specific model development. Achieving this goal requires reconciling the substantial heterogeneity in node features, graph structures, and semantic information across domains. Among them, heterogeneous node features constitute a fundamental input-level barrier, as their dimensionality and semantics vary substantially across datasets. Existing studies typically project or map heterogeneous node features into a fixed-dimensional space, often implicitly equating dimensional uniformity with effective feature unification. Yet dimensional consistency alone does not ensure that the unified features preserve informative semantics and capture transferable patterns that can support cross-domain knowledge transfer. To bridge this conceptual gap, we distill four desiderata for cross-domain graph feature unification: formal uniformity, cross-domain transferability, information preservation, and backbone compatibility. Guided by these principles, we propose SliGFM, a graph foundation model built upon topology-aware sliding-window feature encoding and generative reconstruction. SliGFM orders feature dimensions by topological smoothness and scans the reordered features with a shared sliding-window feature encoder, transforming heterogeneous features into a common space of ordered fixed-dimensional feature tokens. This formulation enables a smoothness-aware transformer to capture transferable relational patterns among feature tokens within each node, while the generative reconstruction objective encourages preservation of the original feature information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论图基础模型（Graph Foundation Models）中跨域节点特征统一的问题。作者指出将异构节点特征映射到固定维度空间只是表面统一，维度一致并不保证语义信息保留和跨域可迁移。据此提出四个统一原则，并设计SliGFM，用拓扑感知的滑动窗口特征编码和生成式重构将异构特征转换为有序的固定维度特征token。摘要未报告实验数据。
Motivation: 异构节点特征的维度和语义在不同图数据集间差异很大，是图基础模型跨域泛化的输入级障碍；现有方法依赖维度对齐（dimensional alignment），却忽略特征语义与可迁移模式。
Method: 提出跨域特征统一需满足形式统一、跨域可迁移、信息保留和骨干兼容四条原则；在此基础上构建SliGFM，按拓扑平滑度排序特征维度，用共享滑动窗口编码器生成固定维度的有序特征token，并配合平滑感知Transformer和生成式重构目标。
Conclusion: 作者强调维度一致并不等同于有效的特征统一，需要显式地兼顾可迁移模式与原始信息保留。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Specification-Guided Synthesis of Deadlock-Free Communication Protocol Refinements with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring behavioural correctness in communication protocols is a central challenge in distributed software systems, as subtle inconsistencies can lead to deadlocks. In such settings, protocol refinement - the safe substitution of a protocol that preserves correctness and compatibility with other components - is essential. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and program synthesis, yet lack mechanisms to reliably produce outputs with correct behaviour. Formal specification approaches, such as multiparty session types (MPST), offer rigorous guarantees, including deadlock freedom, but provide limited support for automatically constructing protocol refinements. In this paper, we present Syntropy, a framework for synthesising protocol refinements guided by MPST specifications and LLMs. It incorporates refinement constraints directly into the generation process, ensuring the generated variants satisfy these guarantees. Our comprehensive evaluation indicates that Syntropy achieves 95.6%-99.5% validity while maintaining high syntactic correctness, and produces diverse, non-trivial refinements across multiple LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Syntropy，一个受多参与方会话类型 (MPST) 规范引导、结合大语言模型 (LLM) 的通信协议精化合成框架。该框架把精化约束直接嵌入生成过程，使生成的协议变体满足行为正确性（如无死锁）。综合评估显示，在多个 LLM 上 Syntropy 达到 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性，同时保持较高的语法正确性，并能产生多样且非平凡的协议精化。
Motivation: 通信协议中的行为正确性（尤其是避免死锁）是分布式软件系统的核心挑战；LLM 虽在代码生成上表现出色，但缺乏可靠的行为正确性保证，而形式化方法如 MPST 能提供无死锁等保证，却对自动构造协议精化的支持有限。
Method: Syntropy 框架将 MPST 规范与 LLM 结合，在生成过程中直接引入精化约束，使得生成的协议变体满足规范所蕴含的正确性保证。
Result: 摘要报告 Syntropy 在多个 LLM 上达到 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性并保持高语法正确性，同时生成的精化具有多样性且非平凡。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 MPST 形式规范与 LLM 相结合可为协议精化提供具备正确性保证的自动合成途径；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 通信协议中的行为正确性（尤其是避免死锁）是分布式软件系统的核心挑战；LLM 虽在代码生成上表现出色，但缺乏可靠的行为正确性保证，而形式化方法如 MPST 能提供无死锁等保证，却对自动构造协议精化的支持有限。
summary_sections.method: Syntropy 框架将 MPST 规范与 LLM 结合，在生成过程中直接引入精化约束，使得生成的协议变体满足规范所蕴含的正确性保证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Syntropy 在多个 LLM 上达到 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性并保持高语法正确性，同时生成的精化具有多样性且非平凡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将 MPST 形式规范与 LLM 相结合可为协议精化提供具备正确性保证的自动合成途径；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: FiRE: Enhancing MLLMs with Fine-Grained Context Learning for Complex Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Due to their strong generalizable multimodal processing and reasoning capabilities, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential as universal image retrievers, effectively addressing diverse real-world image retrieval tasks. Nevertheless, pioneering studies, while promising, overlook the potential of fine-grained context modeling and disentangled fine-tuning objectives in enhancing MLLMs' retrieval performance, particularly for complex tasks such as long-text-to-image retrieval, visual dialog retrieval, and composed image retrieval (CIR). Therefore, in this work, we propose an automated fine-grained multimodal quintuple dataset construction pipeline and a novel two-stage fine-grained multimodal fine-tuning strategy. The dataset generation pipeline produces a comprehensive CIR dataset with fine-grained image captions and modification text, facilitating fine-grained context modeling. Beyond the previously entangled fine-tuning paradigm, our approach separates the fine-tuning process into two distinct stages: (1) fine-grained context reasoning-oriented fine-tuning and (2) fine-grained retrieval-oriented fine-tuning. These stages aim to sequentially enhance the model's context understanding and query-target alignment capabilities, thereby improving retrieval performance. Extensive experiments across five datasets encompassing diverse and complex image retrieval tasks demonstrate the remarkable superiority of our method over existing approaches in zero-shot retrieval settings, even with a more lightweight MLLM backbone compared to those methods.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FiRE，一种面向复杂图像检索任务的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）微调方法。作者设计了自动化的细粒度多模态五元组数据集构建流程，并给出解耦的两阶段微调策略，分别进行细粒度上下文推理导向和检索导向的微调。摘要报告在五个数据集、零样本检索设置下优于现有方法，且使用的 MLLM 骨干比对比方法更轻量。
Motivation: 现有将 MLLM 作为通用图像检索器的研究忽略了细粒度上下文建模与解耦微调目标，导致在长文本到图像检索、视觉对话检索和组合图像检索（CIR）等复杂任务上检索性能受限。
Method: 提出自动化细粒度多模态五元组数据集构建流程，生成带细粒度图像描述和修改文本的 CIR 数据集以支持细粒度上下文建模；将微调分为细粒度上下文推理导向阶段和细粒度检索导向阶段，依次增强上下文理解与查询-目标对齐能力。
Result: 在五个覆盖多样复杂图像检索任务的数据集上，该方法在零样本检索设置下显著优于现有方法，且所用 MLLM 骨干比对比方法更轻量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调细粒度上下文建模与解耦的微调目标能够有效提升 MLLM 在复杂图像检索任务上的表现。

papers.title: $Σ$-Mem: An Online Reliability Memory for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Memory is central to long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing memory systems primarily preserve interaction content rather than modeling which agents can be trusted and under what conditions. This limitation is particularly important in multi-agent systems, where a central model may be unable to directly verify plausible or correlated peer responses. We introduce $Σ$-Mem, an online reliability memory that records historical competence evidence for individual peers and peer relationship evidence across the peer set. Both forms of evidence are maintained as real symmetric states and updated from post-decision correctness feedback. By Weyl's inequality, the spectral change caused by each event-level update is bounded, enabling stable online adaptation without retraining the underlying models. $Σ$-Mem provides a general write-and-read interface: the same memory can be used for residual steering of a central model, response-free peer routing, or reliability-weighted voting. Across five Qwen-family models, $Σ$-Mem adapts to counterfactual reliability shifts and generalizes to unseen peers and task domains. Direct memory readouts also outperform majority voting and the best fixed peer over the full OOD evaluation set. Moreover, performance improves consistently as more correctness feedback becomes available, indicating that $Σ$-Mem progressively accumulates actionable reliability information. These results establish reliability memory as a reusable foundation for adaptive coordination in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Σ-Mem，一种面向 LLM 多智能体系统的在线可靠性记忆，记录单个 peer 的历史能力证据以及 peer 之间的关系证据，两者均以实对称状态维护，并依据决策后的正确性反馈更新。利用 Weyl 不等式保证每次事件级更新引起的谱变化有界，从而在无需重训底层模型的情况下稳定在线适应。该记忆提供通用的写入-读取接口，可用于中心模型的残差引导、无响应 peer 路由或可靠性加权投票；在五个 Qwen 系列模型上的实验表明其能适应反事实可靠性变化，并泛化到未见过的 peer 和任务域。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 记忆系统主要保存交互内容，而非建模哪些 peer 在什么条件下可信；在多智能体系统中，中心模型往往无法直接验证看似合理或相互关联的 peer 响应，因此需要显式的可靠性建模。
Method: 提出在线可靠性记忆 Σ-Mem，将个体能力证据和 peer 关系证据维护为实对称状态，并通过事后正确性反馈持续更新；利用 Weyl 不等式保证谱更新有界，使在线适应保持稳定。记忆提供统一的写读接口，支持残差引导、响应无关的路由选择以及可靠性加权投票三种使用方式。
Result: 在五个 Qwen 系列模型上，Σ-Mem 能适应反事实可靠性变化并泛化到未见 peer 与任务域；在完整 OOD 评估集上，直接记忆读出优于多数投票和最优固定 peer；随着正确性反馈增多，性能持续提升，说明其能逐步积累可用的可靠性信息。
Conclusion: 摘要认为可靠性记忆可作为 LLM 多智能体系统中自适应协调的可复用基础，并指出其收益来自对历史能力证据与关系证据的在线累积。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SciSchema.org: A Multidisciplinary Collection of Schemas for Structured Scientific Process Descriptions
papers.abstract_en: Scientific processes are often described in heterogeneous article discourse, with details needed for comparison, reproducibility, reuse, and automation dispersed across prose, tables, figures, protocols, and supplementary files. We present the first release of SciSchema.org, a multidisciplinary collection of 16 expert-annotated schemas spanning Biology & Biotechnology, Materials & Chemistry, Imaging & Measurement, Physics, and Psychology. Each schema defines reusable fields for describing process instances, including inputs, outputs, materials, instruments or software, parameters, conditions, procedural steps, measurements, and provenance-related information. The schemas were created through a human-in-the-loop schema-mining workflow in which large language models generated candidate structures from process specifications, scientific articles, and expert feedback, followed by domain-expert construction of final master schemas. The dataset contains final schemas in JSON Schema and SHACL formats, intermediate model-generated schemas, expert-feedback records, source-paper metadata, community-development materials, and analysis scripts. Technical validation assessed schema structure, development provenance, expert review, and syntactic conformance. The collection supports structured annotation, metadata enrichment, scientific knowledge graphs, information extraction, semantic publishing, and cross-study comparison.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, Submitted for peer review to Nature Scientific Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布 SciSchema.org 的首个版本，一个跨学科的科学过程结构化描述 schema 集合，包含 16 个专家标注的 schema，覆盖生物学与生物技术、材料与化学、成像与测量、物理学和心理学。每个 schema 定义可复用的字段来描述过程实例，包括输入、输出、材料、仪器或软件、参数、条件、程序步骤、测量和溯源相关信息。Schema 通过人机协同的 schema 挖掘流程构建，由大语言模型生成候选结构，领域专家最终整理为 master schemas，并以 JSON Schema 与 SHACL 格式发布。
Motivation: 科学过程常以异构的文章篇章描述，比较、复现、重用和自动化所需的细节分散在正文、表格、图、实验方案和补充文件中，缺乏统一的结构化描述框架。
Method: 提出一种人在回路 (human-in-the-loop) 的 schema 挖掘工作流：大语言模型根据过程规范、科学文章和专家反馈生成候选 schema 结构，再由领域专家构建最终 master schemas；数据集包含最终 schema、中间模型生成结果、专家反馈记录、源论文元数据、社区开发材料和分析脚本。
Result: 技术验证评估了 schema 结构、开发溯源、专家评审和句法符合性 (syntactic conformance)；摘要未报告具体的量化指标。
Conclusion: 该集合支持结构化标注、元数据富化、科学知识图谱、信息抽取、语义出版和跨研究比较，但摘要未讨论其在特定学科（如气象学）中的适用性或局限性。

papers.title: AutoPref: Automatic Discovery of Task-Specific Preference Objectives for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) underpin many real-world decisions, but their exponentially large search spaces make high-quality solutions costly to obtain. Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) learns fast construction policies, typically with reinforcement learning (RL), while preference-based NCO improves sample efficiency by learning from relative solution quality. However, existing preference objectives combine two distinct design choices in manually specified, one-size-fits-all formulations: what learning signal to extract from each solution pair and how to weight each pair relative to the sampled set. We present AutoPref, the first LLM-guided framework for automated preference-objective discovery in NCO. AutoPref factorizes the objective into a pairwise loss program, which defines the learning signal, and a set-aware weighting program, which determines each pair's relative contribution. Their composition forms a unified programmatic objective space containing existing preference objectives as special cases. To make its search tractable, we introduce a staged conditional search strategy with behavioral gates that filter inadmissible programs before short-horizon training and evaluation. Across TSP, CVRP, FFSP, and JSSP, AutoPref consistently outperforms strong hand-designed baselines across problem scales, demonstrating the benefits and scalability of automated objective discovery for NCO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoPref，据称是首个由 LLM 引导的神经组合优化 (NCO) 偏好目标自动发现框架。AutoPref 将偏好目标分解为成对损失程序 (pairwise loss program) 与集合感知加权程序 (set-aware weighting program)，二者组合构成一个统一的程序化目标空间，并把现有偏好目标作为特例包含在内。配合带行为门控的分阶段条件搜索策略，AutoPref 在 TSP、CVRP、FFSP 和 JSSP 上于不同问题规模下一致优于手工设计的强基线。
Motivation: 现有偏好式 NCO 通过相对解质量进行学习以提高样本效率，但其偏好目标以手工指定的一刀切方式组合两类设计选择：从每个解对提取何种学习信号，以及每个解对相对采样集合如何加权。这种手工设计缺乏针对具体任务的适配，论文因此提出自动化偏好目标发现。
Method: AutoPref 将偏好目标因子化为成对损失程序（定义学习信号）与集合感知加权程序（决定每个解对的相对贡献），其组合形成统一的程序化目标空间，且现有偏好目标属于其特例。为使搜索可行，论文引入分阶段条件搜索策略和行为门控 (behavioral gates)，在短视界 (short-horizon) 训练与评估之前过滤掉不可行的程序。
Result: 在 TSP、CVRP、FFSP 和 JSSP 四个问题上的多种规模设置中，AutoPref 一致优于强手工设计基线，摘要以此说明自动化目标发现对 NCO 的收益与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动化偏好目标发现能够持续超越手工设计的偏好目标，并为 NCO 的偏好目标设计提供可扩展的通用路线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LAST: The Last Query Token Guides Visual Token Pruning for Edge-Cloud Collaborative MLLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models are reshaping edge-cloud visual intelligence from task-specific feature pipelines into token-based interfaces, where edge devices encode visual inputs into tokens for a general-purpose cloud MLLM. However, dense visual-token sequences increase cloud-side inference costs. Existing pruning methods mainly target centralized inference: vision-driven methods can operate before cloud execution but are typically query-agnostic, whereas query-guided methods often rely on internal states of the target MLLM and cannot determine token relevance before transmission. Compact guidance models offer an alternative, but existing designs may require costly attention aggregation or auxiliary generation. We propose LAST, a training-free framework for query-dependent visual token pruning in edge-cloud collaborative MLLM inference. LAST uses a compact edge-side VLM as a guidance proxy and derives a lightweight importance signal from the last query token's attention to visual tokens. Under causal attention, the last query token can attend to the full visual sequence and the entire query context, enabling query-aware pruning without cloud-model access, autoregressive generation, or costly aggregation over multiple query positions. LAST then retains a diverse set of query-relevant visual tokens under a fixed token budget. We evaluate LAST on 11 multimodal benchmarks under multiple token budgets against pruning methods with different guidance strategies. Experiments show that LAST consistently achieves the strongest performance, preserving 95.4% of the full-token accuracy while retaining only 12.5% of the visual tokens, with low edge-side selection overhead and reduced cloud-side computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAST，一种无训练 (training-free) 的查询相关视觉 token 剪枝框架，用于边云协同多模态大模型 (MLLM) 推理。LAST 在边缘侧使用紧凑 VLM 作为引导代理，仅利用最后一个查询 token 对视觉 token 的因果注意力生成轻量重要性信号，从而在传输前实现查询感知剪枝。在 11 个多模态基准上，LAST 在仅保留 12.5% 视觉 token 时保持完整 token 精度的 95.4%。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝主要面向集中式推理：视觉驱动方法查询无关，查询引导方法依赖云端 MLLM 内部状态，难以在传输前确定 token 相关性。紧凑引导模型需要昂贵的注意力聚合或辅助生成，缺乏既查询感知又适合边缘执行的高效方案。
Method: LAST 使用边缘侧紧凑 VLM 作为引导代理，利用因果注意力下最后一个查询 token 能关注完整视觉序列和全部查询上下文这一特性，从该 token 对视觉 token 的注意力导出轻量重要性信号，无需云端模型访问、自回归生成或多查询位置聚合；随后在固定 token 预算下保留多样化且查询相关的视觉 token。
Result: 在 11 个多模态基准、多种 token 预算下，LAST 一致取得最强性能，保留 12.5% 视觉 token 时维持完整 token 精度的 95.4%，且边缘侧选择开销低、云端计算量减少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无训练、查询感知的 token 剪枝可在传输前完成，适用于边云协同 MLLM 推理，并展示了低开销下的精度保持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Safeguards Based on Copyable Context Cannot Provide Reliable Safety for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language model safeguards decide whether to answer before seeing how an answer will be used. This creates a basic problem for dual-use tasks: the same answer can help an authorized professional or an attacker, while an attacker can imitate a benign request and interaction history. We separate the capability released by the model from the evidence available about downstream use. When that evidence is copyable, we derive the exact worst-case floor on attacker assistance while preserving useful answers. The result yields a safety trilemma: Useful Capability, Reliable Safety, and Open Access cannot coexist. We then show how a trusted credential can complement existing safeguards by adding hard-to-copy information that predicts actual downstream use, and identify the stronger condition needed to eliminate the floor. Evidence from dual-use evaluations, adaptive attacks, and deployed trusted-access programs supports the practical relevance of these conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证基于可复制上下文（copyable context）的 LLM 安全护栏无法可靠保障安全：模型在回答前无法知晓答案将如何被使用，而攻击者可模仿良性请求与交互历史。作者把模型释放的能力与下游使用的证据分开，推导出在保留有用答案前提下攻击者可获得的最坏情况帮助下界，并提出一个安全三难困境（safety trilemma）：有用能力、可靠安全与开放访问三者不可兼得。随后展示可信凭证（trusted credential）可通过补充难以复制的信息来预测实际下游用途，并给出消除该下界所需的更强条件。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全护栏在双用途任务（dual-use tasks）中存在根本问题：同一答案既可帮助授权专业人员也可帮助攻击者，而基于可复制上下文的证据无法可靠区分良性与恶意使用，导致安全保证失效。
Method: 将模型释放的能力与关于下游使用的可获取证据分离，形式化推导当证据可复制时攻击者帮助的精确最坏情况地板（worst-case floor）；进一步提出用可信凭证引入难以复制的信息，以预测实际下游使用并消除该地板，同时分析所需更强条件。
Result: 得到安全三难困境：有用能力、可靠安全与开放访问不能同时成立；双用途评估、自适应攻击（adaptive attacks）和已部署的可信访问项目的证据支持这些条件的实际相关性。
Conclusion: 论文强调仅靠可复制上下文无法为 LLM 提供可靠安全，必须引入可信凭证等硬复制信息，并满足更强条件才能消除最坏情况帮助下界。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Complementary Matrix-Gated QKAN Fast-Weight Programmers for Quantum Dynamics Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Sequence models must decide what to write into memory and what to retain. In quantum and quantum-inspired sequence learning, nonlinear recurrent updates often require repeated circuit evaluations and sequential backpropagation through time, making long contexts costly. Gated fast-weight programmers (FWPs) based on quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (QKANs) alleviate this bottleneck by storing context in time-varying fast parameters. However, their scalar gate applies one retention-write balance to every fast-state coordinate, forcing all parameters to share a memory timescale. We introduce Self-Modulating QKAN-based FWPs, which replace this broadcast gate with low-rank-generated element-wise modulation of the new-proposal branch, a bounded old-state branch, or both. We further propose Complementary Matrix Gating (CMG), which uses one sigmoid matrix gate to retain the old state and its complement to write the new proposal. CMG provides coordinate-wise memory control while preserving the bounded convex update and affine prefix-scan structure of scalar gating, at the modulation-head cost of a single-branch rule. We compare four self-modulating rules with scalar gating across four FWP architectures combining classical and QKAN-based slow and fast programmers. Across seven single-step forecasting benchmarks and five sequence lengths, CMG gives the most consistent improvements for architectures whose fast programmer incorporates a QKAN-based module. In direct multi-step forecasting of Jaynes-Cummings and transmon-resonator dynamics simulated with CUDA-Q Dynamics, CMG models maintain mean-squared errors on the order of 0.001 or lower across forecasting horizons of 4, 8, and 16 steps, while improving on their scalar-gated counterparts by at least 91.2%. These results establish coordinate-wise complementary modulation as a stable and effective update for QKAN-based FWPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子与量子启发的序列学习中非线性循环更新需要重复电路求值和沿时间反向传播、导致长上下文代价高昂的问题，提出基于自调制量子启发 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（QKAN）的快速权重程序员（FWP）。作者用低秩生成、逐元素调制代替标量门控，并提出互补矩阵门控（CMG），以 sigmoid 矩阵门保留旧状态、其互补写新提议，保持有界凸更新与仿射前缀扫描结构。在七种单步预测基准与五种序列长度上，CMG 对含 QKAN 快速程序员的架构带来最一致的改进；对 Jaynes-Cummings 与 transmon-resonator 动力学的直接多步预测中，CMG 在 4、8、16 步预测范围内保持均方误差约 0.001 或更低，并比标量门控版本至少提升 91.2%。
Motivation: 现有门控快速权重程序员使用标量门控，对所有快速状态坐标施加相同的保留-写入平衡，迫使所有参数共享单一记忆时间尺度，限制了量子动力学序列建模的表达力。
Method: 提出自调制 QKAN 快速权重程序员（Self-Modulating QKAN-based FWPs），用低秩生成的逐元素调制替代广播式标量门控，作用于新提议分支、有界旧状态分支或两者；并进一步提出互补矩阵门控（CMG），以一个 sigmoid 矩阵门保留旧状态、其互补门写入新提议，提供逐坐标记忆控制同时保持有界凸更新和仿射前缀扫描结构。
Result: 在四种结合经典与 QKAN 慢/快程序员的 FWP 架构、七个单步预测基准和五种序列长度上，CMG 对含 QKAN 模块的架构带来最一致的改进；对 Jaynes-Cummings 与 transmon-resonator 动力学的多步预测中，CMG 模型在 4、8、16 步预测时均方误差保持在 0.001 或更低，相对标量门控版本至少提升 91.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为逐坐标互补调制是 QKAN 快速权重程序员的一种稳定且有效的更新方式，其收益主要出现在快速程序员包含 QKAN 模块的架构中。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interpretable Representation via LLM-Driven Generative Disentanglement for Local-Life Service Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced ID-based recommendation through Semantic ID (SID) modeling, existing SID generation frameworks largely follow a single-representation-then-quantization paradigm. This design faces two bottlenecks: semantic entanglement mixes heterogeneous attributes, such as geography, brand, and category, causing information loss during quantization, low-quality SIDs, and severe collisions; moreover, black-box representation learning provides neither explicit attribute semantics nor clear geographic or semantic meanings for SID positions. These limitations weaken both retrieval reliability and the ability to diagnose or control SID generation. We propose Interpretable Representation via LLM-Driven Generative Disentanglement for Local-Life Service Recommendation (LGRID). LGRID introduces a generative disentanglement paradigm through an Encode -> Disentangle -> Align -> Quantize pipeline. It first uses joint LLM encoding to preserve cross-attribute geographic-semantic dependencies, rather than encoding fields independently. A Structured Disentangled Block then routes hidden states into attribute-aligned slots for geographic and semantic factors. Synergistic Alignment Learning makes these slots both generatively decodable and discriminative for retrieval, while Dual-Stream Residual Quantization separately discretizes the two streams into compact SIDs with explicit attribute correspondence. This design yields interpretable SIDs with positions grounded in item attributes and local-service semantics. Experiments on Kuaishou and Foursquare show that LGRID consistently outperforms strong SID baselines, achieving up to a 5.44 percent relative AUC gain. It also achieves over 99 percent attribute-decoding accuracy for coarse geographic fields and reduces the full-SID collision rate to 39.9 percent, compared with 97.0 percent for LGSID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的 Semantic ID (SID) 生成在本地生活服务推荐中的语义纠缠与不可解释问题，提出 LGRID，一种生成式解耦表示框架。LGRID 采用 Encode -> Disentangle -> Align -> Quantize 的流水线，用联合 LLM 编码保留跨属性地理-语义依赖，并通过结构化解耦块、协同对齐学习和双流残差量化生成属性可对应的紧凑 SID。在 Kuaishou 和 Foursquare 上，LGRID 相对强 SID 基线最高取得 5.44% 的相对 AUC 提升，并将完整 SID 碰撞率从 LGSID 的 97.0% 降至 39.9%。
Motivation: 现有 SID 生成框架大多遵循单一表示后量化的范式，语义纠缠会把地理、品牌、类别等异质属性混在一起，导致量化信息损失、SID 质量低和严重碰撞；同时黑盒表示学习缺少显式属性语义，难以诊断或控制 SID 生成，削弱检索可靠性与可解释性。
Method: LGRID 提出生成式解耦范式，先通过联合 LLM 编码保持跨属性的地理-语义依赖；再以结构化解耦块 (Structured Disentangled Block) 将隐状态路由到属性对齐的槽位；协同对齐学习 (Synergistic Alignment Learning) 使这些槽位既可生成解码又具有检索判别性；最后用双流残差量化 (Dual-Stream Residual Quantization) 将地理和语义两路分别离散化为属性显式对应的紧凑 SID。
Result: 在 Kuaishou 与 Foursquare 数据集上，LGRID 一致优于强 SID 基线，最高相对 AUC 提升 5.44%；粗粒度地理字段的属性解码准确率超过 99%；完整 SID 碰撞率降至 39.9%，而 LGSID 为 97.0%。
Conclusion: LGRID 通过生成式解耦得到位置锚定在物品属性与本地服务语义上的可解释 SID，从而改善检索可靠性和对 SID 生成的诊断控制能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TriShield: Zero-Utility-Loss Defense Against Privacy Backdoors in Federated Language Model Fine-Tuning via Orthogonal Gradient Projection and Optimizer State Entanglement
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enables collaborative training without exposing raw data. However, a recent attack, NeuroImprint [1] (arXiv:2606.20553), demonstrates that a malicious parameter server can corrupt a PEFT adapter into a privacy backdoor: by assigning a dedicated memorization neuron to each training sample and ensuring each neuron updates at most once, the server can analytically reconstruct 59\%--79\% of client training data with high semantic fidelity. Existing defenses---including local differential privacy (LDP) [8] and gradient clipping---either fail against this attack or impose unacceptable utility degradation. We present \textbf{TriShield}, a three-layer deterministic defense that completely prevents NeuroImprint-style reconstruction with \textbf{zero model utility loss} and \textbf{no additional communication rounds}. TriShield consists of: (1) a \textbf{Parameter Artifact Detector} that identifies memory-neuron signatures in distributed model parameters before local training begins; (2) a \textbf{Stateful Virtual Iteration} mechanism that forces Adam/AdamW's momentum state to irreversibly entangle gradients across virtual steps, invalidating NeuroImprint's closed-form inversion; and (3) a \textbf{Zero-Utility Orthogonal Projection} operator that projects all local gradient updates onto the main-task semantic subspace computed via SVD, physically eliminating any gradient components that carry private memorization. We prove theoretically that after Layers 2 and 3, the mutual information between the uploaded gradient and any individual training sample is zero. Experiments on GPT-2 (117M) and Llama-Guard-3-1B verify that TriShield reduces NeuroImprint reconstruction rate to \textbf{0\%} across all tested attack variants, while maintaining or improving training accuracy, with less than 5\% additional GPU computation overhead.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 神经印记 (NeuroImprint) 攻击表明恶意参数服务器可借助 PEFT 适配器中的记忆神经元，在无原始数据接触的情况下高保真重构客户端训练数据；现有防御手段（如本地差分隐私 LDP、梯度裁剪）对此攻击无效或造成不可接受的效用损失。

papers.title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on LLM agents is shifting from external capability elicitation to capability internalization, enabling agents to retain useful skills without retrieval at inference time. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising direction, but many existing methods typically supervise students by scoring actions along student-generated trajectories. Such supervision has two limitations: teacher preferences are not validated by environment outcomes, and action-level scores underuse information from student rollouts, teacher rollouts, and their behavioral relationship. We therefore advocate outcome-verified teacher supervision and comparative learning over teacher-student trajectories. Based on this view, we propose Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation (OVCSD). OVCSD organizes failed student rollouts into a prefix tree, adaptively invokes a skill-conditioned teacher from student-reached states, and retains only outcome-verified successful continuations. It then applies localized comparative learning at the first state-aligned divergence and distills the post-divergence teacher suffix to transfer completion behavior. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop across three model scales show that OVCSD consistently outperforms skill-free RL and existing self-distillation baselines, achieving up to 29.7 and 5.4 absolute success-rate gains over the strongest baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while adding less than 3% privileged interaction during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation (OVCSD)，用于让 LLM agent 在训练阶段将外部能力内化，避免推理时检索。方法将失败的学生轨迹组织成前缀树，从学生到达的状态出发自适应调用技能条件化教师，只保留经环境结果验证的成功后续，并在首个状态对齐分歧点做局部对比学习、蒸馏教师后缀。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上、三种模型规模下，OVCSD 一致优于无技能强化学习与现有自蒸馏基线，最高分别取得 29.7 和 5.4 个绝对成功率提升，且训练中特权交互占比不足 3%。
Motivation: 现有基于 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 的方法常沿学生生成轨迹对动作打分来监督学生，存在两个局限：教师偏好未经环境结果验证，且动作级分数未充分利用学生轨迹、教师轨迹及二者行为关系中的信息。
Method: OVCSD 将失败学生轨迹存入前缀树，在状态对齐的首个分歧点处进行局部对比学习，并对分歧后的教师后缀进行蒸馏以迁移完成行为；同时只保留经环境结果验证的成功教师续段作为监督信号。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上跨三种模型规模，OVCSD 超过无技能 RL 与现有自蒸馏基线，最强基线上分别获得最多 29.7 和 5.4 个绝对成功率提升，训练期间额外特权交互少于 3%。
Conclusion: 作者主张用环境结果验证的教师监督和基于教师-学生轨迹的对比学习替代动作级打分，从而更有效地把外部能力内化为 agent 自身的技能。

papers.title: Shapes from Examples: Foundations of Shape Learning in Recursive SHACL
papers.abstract_en: SHACL shapes enable data graph validation, making automatic shape learning essential for knowledge graph applications. We investigate the well-known fitting approach to this task: given sets P and N of positive and negative example nodes from an input graph, compute a shape expression C, possibly using shape names defined in a recursive shape catalogue, that validates at every node in P and none in N. We focus on the case where C is written in a core fragment of SHACL corresponding to the Description Logic ELI. For the catalogue, we consider the well-founded, stable, and supported semantics. We address fitting existence and most specific fitting computation, establish tight exponential-time upper bounds for both problems, and obtain polynomial bounds for relevant special cases.
papers.comment: full version of a paper accepted at ISWC26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究递归 SHACL 中基于示例的形状学习（shape learning）问题：给定输入图上的正负示例节点集合 P 和 N，学习一个形状表达式 C，可能使用递归形状目录（shape catalogue）中定义的形状名，使得所有 P 中节点被验证而 N 中节点不被验证。作者聚焦于对应描述逻辑 ELI 的 SHACL 核心片段，考察 well-founded、stable 和 supported 三种语义下的拟合存在性（fitting existence）与最具体拟合计算（most specific fitting computation）。摘要报告对这两个问题建立了紧的指数时间上界，并对相关特殊情形给出多项式时间界。
Motivation: 知识图谱应用依赖自动形状学习来验证数据图，而递归形状目录与多种语义下拟合问题的理论基础尚不充分，因此需要系统刻画其可计算性与复杂性。
Method: 将形状学习任务形式化为拟合问题：在对应描述逻辑 ELI 的 SHACL 核心片段中构造形状表达式 C，并在递归形状目录的 well-founded、stable、supported 三种语义下研究拟合存在性与最具体拟合计算的复杂性。
Result: 摘要报告拟合存在性与最具体拟合计算两个问题均具有紧的指数时间上界，并且若干相关特殊情形可达到多项式时间界。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献集中在问题形式化与复杂性理论结果上；摘要未讨论实验或应用层面的验证，属于 ISWC26 接受论文的完整版。

papers.title: The Geometric Nature and a Free Proxy for Flow-Matching Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has become a popular action head paradigm for modern embodied models. However, as a conditional generative model, it does not explicitly expose its inherent uncertainty, producing faulty action chunks even when it misinterprets the scene or encounters out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Therefore, determining when an FM-generated action can be trusted is essential for safe deployment, yet existing uncertainty estimation methods on real-time control suffer from several issues: extra training budget, high computational overhead, and low generalization ability. In this work, we provide a geometric interpretation of FM uncertainty in the velocity field, showing that uncertainty manifests as deviation from an ideal affine-isotropic contraction field. Building on this observation, we introduce denoising acceleration ($\mathrm{accel}$), a highly-generalizable and cost-free uncertainty proxy that measures the bending of the denoising trajectory from a single forward pass, without additional model evaluations, training, or resampling. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that $\mathrm{accel}$ is a faithful proxy for FM uncertainty and further test its utility in online failure detection. Results show that $\mathrm{accel}$ identifies failing rollouts well before termination, matching or even outperforming costly resampling- and training-based baselines across settings under realistic deployment budget. Code and demos available at: https://github.com/rrrrrrzy/fm-geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 flow matching (FM) 作为现代具身模型 action head 时的不确定性估计问题，提出一种几何解释：FM 的不确定性表现为速度场偏离理想仿射各向同性收缩场。基于此，作者引入 denoising acceleration (accel)，一种仅需单次前向传播、无需额外训练或重采样的不确定性代理，用于在线失败检测。摘要称该代理能提前识别失败的 rollout，并在实际部署预算下匹配或超过基于重采样和训练的高成本基线。
Motivation: FM 作为条件生成模型不会显式暴露其固有不确定性，在场景误解或 OOD 输入时会产生错误动作块，因此判断 FM 生成动作何时可信对安全部署至关重要。现有不确定性估计方法存在额外训练预算、高计算开销和低泛化能力的问题。
Method: 在速度场 (velocity field) 中为 FM 不确定性提供几何刻画，将其视为对理想仿射各向同性收缩场 (affine-isotropic contraction field) 的偏离；进而提出 denoising acceleration (accel) 作为不确定性代理，通过单次前向传播测量去噪轨迹的弯曲程度，不引入额外的模型评估、训练或重采样。
Result: 作者在理论上和经验上表明 accel 是 FM 不确定性的忠实代理，并验证其在在线失败检测中的有效性；摘要报告它在 rollout 终止前就能识别失败，且在现实部署预算下匹配或超过基于重采样和训练的基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 accel 是一种高泛化、零额外成本的不确定性代理，可用于具身模型的实时安全监控；代码和演示已公开在 GitHub。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Meta-Task: Turning Terminal Task Synthesis into a Terminal Task for Scalable Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Training terminal agents at scale requires diverse, verifiable terminal tasks and high-quality interaction trajectories, yet acquiring such data remains a significant challenge. Existing synthesis methods face two key limitations: (1) weak reliability caused by the disconnect between task generation and real execution, and (2) limited diversity and scalability due to dependence on existing repositories. We propose Meta-Task, a framework that redefines terminal task synthesis as a Terminal-Bench-format task itself: an agent operates within a real container environment to iteratively generate, execute, and verify tasks, so that synthesized components are checked for internal consistency and executability within the generation loop itself. Building upon this, we decouple the target task requirements along multiple dimensions, introduce a multi-phase mechanism that dynamically designs novel task specifications before producing the actual tasks, and incorporate optional external material support to enhance diversity and realism. We additionally apply LLM-as-Judge filtering to ensure the quality of the final training data. Experiments on Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that fine-tuning on only 3,221 Meta-Task synthesized trajectories achieves 22.5% and 31.8% Avg Pass@1 for Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B respectively, outperforming concurrent approaches with significantly less training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Meta-Task，一个将终端任务合成本身定义为 Terminal-Bench 格式任务的框架，让 agent 在真实容器环境中迭代地生成、执行并验证任务，从而在生成循环内检查合成组件的内部一致性与可执行性。该方法将目标任务需求沿多个维度解耦，引入多阶段机制先动态设计新任务规格再生成实际任务，并支持可选的外部材料支持来增强多样性与真实性，最后用 LLM-as-Judge 过滤保证训练数据质量。在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，仅用 3,221 条合成轨迹微调 Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 分别取得 22.5% 和 31.8% 的 Avg Pass@1，并以显著更少的训练数据超过同期方法。
Motivation: 规模化训练终端 agent 需要多样化、可验证的终端任务与高质量交互轨迹，但现有合成方法存在两个局限：任务生成与实际执行脱节导致可靠性弱，以及依赖已有代码库导致多样性与可扩展性受限。
Method: 将终端任务合成重新建模为 Terminal-Bench 格式任务本身，使 agent 在真实容器环境中循环执行生成、执行与验证；把目标任务需求沿多维度解耦，用多阶段机制先设计新任务规格再生成任务；加入可选外部材料支持，并使用 LLM-as-Judge 过滤保证训练数据质量。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，仅用 3,221 条 Meta-Task 合成轨迹微调，Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 分别达到 22.5% 和 31.8% 的 Avg Pass@1，以明显更少的训练数据超越同期方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为将任务合成本身转化为可执行、可验证的代理任务，能够以更少数据实现更强的终端 agent 训练效果；该框架强调在生成循环内完成一致性检查与验证。

papers.title: Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting
papers.abstract_en: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize validation losses. These methods rely on strong structural assumptions, such as rank invariance or scaling laws, which are often violated, resulting in non-negligible estimation bias. A promising approach is to directly optimize the weighting scheme from data. However, it suffers from unstable optimization trajectory and prohibitive computational overhead, limiting its potential to search better domain weights configurations. This paper presents a Bayesian domain weighting method to infer the weights from a Dirichlet distribution via introducing Gamma prior information learned from observations. Experimental results demonstrate that proposed method could achieve stable and efficient domain weights learning, and identifies optimal mixtures while consuming substantially less data than search-based function-fitting methods, revitalizing optimization-based domain weighting for large-scale applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯域加权方法，用于优化大规模语言模型（LLM）预训练数据中多领域数据的配比。该方法从 Dirichlet 分布推断域权重，并引入从观测中学习的 Gamma 先验信息。摘要称与基于搜索的函数拟合方法相比，该方法能用显著更少的数据实现稳定高效的域权重学习并找到最优数据混合。
Motivation: 多领域预训练数据的分布组成从根本上影响 LLM 性能，而早期人工启发式难以捕捉域间复杂协同关系。现有代理方法通过拟合域权重到验证损失的映射来搜索最优权重，但依赖秩不变性或缩放定律等强结构假设，这些假设常被违背并导致不可忽略的估计偏差；直接优化权重则面临训练轨迹不稳定和计算开销过大的问题。
Method: 提出贝叶斯域加权方法，从 Dirichlet 分布中推断域权重，并引入由观测数据学习的 Gamma 先验信息，以在不做强结构假设的前提下稳定高效地学习最优数据混合权重。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法能实现稳定且高效的域权重学习，并识别出最优数据混合；相比基于搜索的函数拟合方法，其消耗的数据量显著更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以较低的数据开销重新激活了基于优化的域加权思路，使其适用于大规模 LLM 预训练场景；摘要未报告具体基准数值或方法局限。

papers.title: ARD-REFSM: Enhancing Reflection Symmetry Detection with Asymmetric Denoising and Rotation Equivariance
papers.abstract_en: Reflection symmetry detection remains challenging due to interference from asymmetric regions and arbitrary orientations of symmetric patterns. Asymmetric regions introduce background clutter that disrupts symmetric pattern matching, whereas conventional convolutional neural networks lack rotation equivariance, leading to inconsistent feature representations under rotational transformations. To address these issues, we propose an Asymmetric Region Denoising (ARD) module and a Rotation Equivariant Feature Similarity Matching (REFSM) module. The ARD module suppresses asymmetric interference to refine symmetric patterns, while the REFSM module enhances rotation equivariance through feature similarity matching between original and rotated images. Specifically, our dual-input REFSM framework leverages rotation loss to maximize consistency between the score maps of original and rotated images, thereby enabling precise prediction of rotation-equivariant symmetry axes. Furthermore, we introduce GMSYM, a new benchmark dataset that categorizes images into diverse scenarios and incorporates various interferences to address the limitations of existing reflection symmetry detection benchmarks. Extensive experiments on four standard datasets (DENDI, NYU, LDRS, SDRW) and our proposed GMSYM dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both accuracy and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对反射对称性检测中不对称区域干扰和对称图案任意朝向带来的挑战，提出 ARD-REFSM 方法，包含不对称区域去噪（ARD）模块与旋转等变特征相似性匹配（REFSM）模块，并构造了新基准数据集 GMSYM。在 DENDI、NYU、LDRS、SDRW 及 GMSYM 上，方法取得最先进的准确率与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 反射对称性检测面临两类问题：不对称区域产生背景杂波干扰对称模式匹配，而传统卷积神经网络缺乏旋转等变性，导致旋转变换下特征表示不一致。
Method: ARD 模块通过抑制不对称干扰来细化对称模式；REFSM 模块采用双输入框架，利用旋转损失最大化原始图像与旋转图像得分图之间的一致性，从而实现旋转等变的对称轴预测。作者还提出 GMSYM 基准数据集，按多样场景和多种干扰类型分类图像，以弥补现有基准的不足。
Result: 在四个标准数据集 DENDI、NYU、LDRS、SDRW 以及新提出的 GMSYM 上，该方法在准确率和鲁棒性两方面均达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，不对称去噪与旋转等变特征匹配相结合能够显著提升反射对称性检测性能，同时 GMSYM 数据集有助于解决现有基准场景覆盖不足的问题。

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.abstract_en: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (\textbf{PT-Flow}), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct \textbf{ODEWorld}, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. \href{https://dstate.github.io/odeworld_website/}{Project Website}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow)，在结构化表示空间中学习一个以物理时间为变量的连续潜速度场，并用常微分方程 (ODE) 参数化时序动态；基于此构建 ODEWorld，一种连续时间潜空间世界模型。ODEWorld 通过提取时变特征并对动态表示空间和潜速度场施加 ODE 约束，缓解潜世界模型中的表示坍缩 (representation collapse) 问题，支持长时间跨度的隐状态预测与高质量图像重建，还能进行任意时间分辨率乃至反向预测。实验显示该方法在视频生成和机器人控制任务上同时兼顾规划友好的动态抽象与视觉真实性。
Motivation: 物理世界中的空间和时间本质上是连续的，而现有世界建模的机器学习范式大多局限于离散时间预测，难以高效捕捉物理动力学。
Method: 提出 PT-Flow 学习连续潜速度场，将长期预测转化为在压缩潜空间中用 ODE 求解器进行时间积分；在此基础上构建 ODEWorld，利用时变特征提取和对潜动力学空间的 ODE 约束来避免表示坍缩，并为下游策略学习提供规划相关信息。
Result: 综合实验表明 ODEWorld 在视频生成与机器人控制任务上同时取得规划友好的动力学抽象和视觉真实感，且能支持任意时间分辨率与向前/向后预测，这在大多数离散时间模型中无法实现。
Conclusion: 作者认为连续时间潜世界模型能够更好地匹配物理世界的时间连续性，并同时改善长时程预测质量和下游规划任务的可用性；该方法定位在通用世界建模，尚未涉及具体的气象或降水预报场景。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: One Anchor for All: Unified Multilingual and Multimodal Safety Alignment for LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: As large vision-language models (LVLMs) are deployed globally, the combination of multilingual instructions and visual information makes malicious attacks more covert and sophisticated than ever before. However, existing methods isolate language and modality defenses, which, coupled with the scarcity of safety data and high fine-tuning costs, makes it difficult for models to defend against compound attacks. To address this severe challenge, we propose a neuron-level cross-dimensional safety alignment framework driven by modality- and language-shared safety neurons (MLS-Neurons). First, we identify monolingual and unimodal safety neurons by comparing responses to harmful and benign samples, quantifying functional saliency through activation strength and downstream impact. Then, by intersecting these unimodal neurons within each language, we extract modality-shared safety neurons (MS-Neurons) responsive to both visual and textual risks, bridging the safety representation gap between modalities. Furthermore, using English as a semantic anchor, we intersect MS-Neurons across languages to identify modality- and language-shared safety neurons (MLS-Neurons), serving as key defenses against compound attacks. Finally, we update only this minimal subset of shared neurons (~0.03% of parameters), transferring English-only safety supervision to multilingual and multimodal scenarios. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse multilingual and multimodal safety benchmarks while preserving general utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的神经元级跨维度安全对齐框架，旨在防御结合多语言指令与视觉信息的复合攻击。作者通过识别单语单模态的安全神经元，再在模态内和跨语言间逐步取交集，得到模态与语言共享的安全神经元（MLS-Neurons），并仅更新约占模型参数 0.03% 的这一最小子集，将仅英语的安全监督迁移到多语言多模态场景。实验表明该方法在多个多语言多模态安全基准上显著优于现有方法，同时保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法将语言与模态的防御割裂开来，难以应对结合多语言指令和视觉信息的复合攻击；同时安全数据稀缺且微调成本高，使模型更难以防御此类攻击。
Method: 通过比较有害与良性样本的响应，依据激活强度和下游影响量化功能显著度，先识别单语单模态安全神经元；对每种语言内取这些单模态神经元的交集得到模态共享安全神经元（MS-Neurons）；再以英语为语义锚点，跨语言求交集得到模态与语言共享的安全神经元（MLS-Neurons）；最后仅更新这一极小参数子集以完成安全监督的跨语言跨模态迁移。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种多语言和多模态安全基准上显著优于当前最优方法，并保留通用能力；更新的共享神经元仅占参数约 0.03%。
Conclusion: 作者认为用极少量跨语言跨模态共享安全神经元即可把英语安全监督迁移到多语言多模态场景，为抵御复合攻击提供了一条参数高效的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact Action Values Are Not Enough: Rollout-Verified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of a Reasoning Model for Multi-Zone VAV Control
papers.abstract_en: Multi-zone variable-air-volume control must balance thermal comfort, indoor air quality, and electricity use across several continuous actuators. Model predictive control and reinforcement learning are widely studied, but deployment typically requires building-specific modeling or training, limiting scalability. We first test whether a frontier reasoning model (an LLM trained to use additional inference-time computation) can achieve competitive VAV control from text without building-specific training. With that capability established, we then test whether TD3-guided reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) can transfer control knowledge into a locally deployable open-weight model. Five controllers are evaluated over three summer days in a physics-based four-zone emulator. Relative to a Guideline 36-based baseline, TD3 reduced HVAC electricity by 4.5% while improving temperature and CO$_2$ compliance. Without building-specific training, GPT-5 achieved the largest reduction (6.2%) but reduced the ventilation margin. For RFT, deterministic rollouts restore a saved state, apply one candidate, and follow TD3 to score each action. Auditing a learned critic against these rollouts exposed a failure hidden by its near-perfect across-time correlation ($r=0.9998$): within-state ranking was unreliable; the critic selected the rollout-best candidate in only 5 of 10 states. Even with the rollout verifier, 200 RFT steps produced no sustained improvement in sampled-action return; the open-weight controller used more electricity than the baseline before and after training, and its five-minute predictions remained worse than persistence. GPT-5 predicted transitions far better. Exact rollout scores rank sampled actions but reveal neither next-state effects nor an improvement direction. The unchanged transition errors motivate transition-focused supervised fine-tuning before value-based RFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多区域变风量 (VAV) 暖通控制中，推理模型 (reasoning model) 能否不经建筑定制训练直接胜任控制，以及能否通过 TD3 引导的强化微调 (RFT) 将控制知识迁移到本地开源权重模型。在物理四区域仿真器上对比五种控制器，TD3 相比 Guideline 36 基线降低暖通空调用电 4.5% 并改善温度与 CO2 达标率；GPT-5 实现最大降幅 6.2% 但牺牲通风裕度。RFT 中的 rollout 验证失败：学习批评者 (critic) 的跨时间相关 r=0.9998 却掩盖了其状态内排序不可靠的问题，200 步 RFT 未带来采样动作回报的持续改善。
Motivation: 多区域 VAV 控制需平衡热舒适、室内空气质量和电力消耗，但模型预测控制与强化学习通常需要针对具体建筑的建模或训练，限制可扩展性；作者希望检验推理模型能否从文本直接获得竞争力，并将控制知识迁移到本地可部署的小模型。
Method: 先测试前沿推理模型 GPT-5 在无建筑特定训练下进行 VAV 控制；再测试 TD3 引导的强化微调 (RFT)：确定性 rollout 恢复保存状态、应用单个候选动作并按 TD3 为每个动作评分，同时用 rollout 审计学习到的批评者。
Result: 相对 Guideline 36 基线，TD3 降低暖通空调用电 4.5% 并改善温度和 CO2 合规；GPT-5 降幅最大 (6.2%) 但降低通风裕度。批评者审计显示其跨时间相关 r=0.9998 却存在状态内排序缺陷，仅在 10 个状态中的 5 个选出 rollout 最佳动作；200 步 RFT 未带来采样动作回报的持续提升，开源权重控制器训练前后用电均高于基线，其五分钟预测仍差于持续性预测 (persistence)。
Conclusion: 精确的 rollout 分数只能给采样动作排序，既不能揭示下一状态影响，也不能指出改进方向；迁移误差未变这一结果提示，在基于价值函数的 RFT 之前应先进行面向迁移 (transition) 的监督微调。

papers.title: S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.
papers.comment: This is the pre-rebuttal version of a paper accepted at MICCAI 2026. The camera-ready version will be posted following the embargo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S-CEReBrO，一个面向连续 EEG 监测的流式基础模型，在 CEReBrO 架构上演进，引入 Windowed Alternating Attention 机制，将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，从而保证 KV cache 内存与信号时长解耦。模型在超过 25,000 小时、12,000 余名受试者的数据上预训练，在 11 个下游任务中的 7 个上达到最优性能，且参数最多减少 60%。该工作被 MICCAI 2026 接收。
Motivation: 基于 Transformer 的 EEG 基础模型面临关键瓶颈：全局注意力机制使注意力内存状态与信号时长耦合，连续监测时会导致内存溢出。
Method: 提出 Windowed Alternating Attention 机制，将注意力计算分解为固定大小的时空窗口，仅活动窗口需要驻留注意力图，从而保证常量 KV cache 内存；S-CEReBrO 在此机制下于大规模多受试者 EEG 数据上预训练。
Result: 缩放分析显示，windowed alternating attention 可处理比全自注意力长 100 倍、比低秩线性注意力长 3 倍的信号；相比低秩线性注意力，在长上下文下仅需 55% 的内存，推理吞吐提升 2.1 倍。在 11 个下游任务中 7 个达到最优，参数最多减少 60%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作朝高效、可泛化且可持续的连续 EEG 监测迈出重要一步；arXiv 注释表明当前为 MICCAI 2026 接收论文的 pre-rebuttal 版本，camera-ready 版本将在 embargo 后发布。

papers.title: IFHierBench: Hierarchical Instruction Following for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-following ability is critical for deploying large language models in real-world applications, where downstream components depend on the output satisfying specific constraints. Modern deployments increasingly handle the full task in a single LLM call, with one prompt specifying a layered output whose overall artifact, structural sections, and nested fields must each satisfy concrete constraints. Existing instruction-following benchmarks treat the constraint set as a flat list applied uniformly to the response, so they cannot scope a check to a particular section of the output. We introduce IFHierBench, a hierarchical instruction-following benchmark of 600 prompts stratified across four constraint-tree depths and 35 distinct constraints, each prompt paired with a deterministic checker that verifies satisfaction at every scope. Evaluating seven leading proprietary and open-weight models, we find that even the strongest model only marginally exceeds 50% prompt-level accuracy and that accuracy degrades sharply as constraint depth grows. Reliably following nested constraints remains a substantial gap for current LLMs, motivating future training methods that consider constraint adherence at finer granularity to achieve better instruction-following ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IFHierBench，一个面向分层指令遵循 (hierarchical instruction following) 的评测基准，包含 600 个提示，覆盖四种约束树深度和 35 种不同约束，每个提示配有在每一作用域验证满足性的确定性检查器。作者评估了七个专有和开源权重模型，发现最强模型在提示级准确率上仅勉强超过 50%，且准确率随约束深度增加而急剧下降。
Motivation: 现有指令遵循基准将约束集视为统一应用于整体响应的扁平列表，无法将检查限定到输出的特定章节；而真实部署中单次 LLM 调用常需要满足整体产物、结构章节和嵌套字段各层的具体约束。
Method: 引入 IFHierBench，以分层约束树的形式组织提示，并使用确定性检查器在每一作用域验证约束满足情况；随后对七个领先的专有和开源权重模型进行系统评估。
Result: 最强模型在提示级准确率上仅勉强超过 50%，且准确率随约束树深度增加而显著下降，表明当前 LLM 在可靠遵循嵌套约束方面仍存在明显不足。
Conclusion: 可靠遵循嵌套约束仍是当前 LLM 的实质差距，摘要据此呼吁未来训练方法在更细粒度上考虑约束遵从性，以提升指令遵循能力。

papers.title: A Cross-Architecture Audit of Direction-Based Inference-Time Defences in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Inference time defences against vision language model jailbreaks often subtract a calibrated direction from the residual stream at a chosen decoder layer. We compare five defence candidates across 15 model and layer cells from four architectural families under a magnitude controlled protocol that matches the intervention size for each prompt and pairs every direction with a random control of the same norm. The candidates are the mean image conditioning shift, a CMRM style refusal direction, a ShiftDC style attack specific residual, a prompt instruction to ignore the image, and a random control. No single candidate dominates on both refusal recovery and utility preservation. The image conditioning shift leads on LLaVA 1.5 and Pixtral 12B and is the only candidate whose utility loss remains at the measurement noise floor in every family. The prompt instruction leads on Qwen2.5 VL, while the attack specific residual leads on Qwen2 VL 2B. The image conditioning direction is direction specific in 13 of 15 cells, but strongly architecture specific and nontransferable across the only dimension compatible pair, LLaVA 1.5 13B and Pixtral 12B. We also connect text only and multimodal refusal geometry. The CMRM direction has positive cosine alignment with the image conditioning shift in all 15 cells, with mean 0.35, range 0.17 to 0.65, 15 to 25 times the random vector null, and a sign test p value of about 3e-5. These results show that the two recipes recover partially overlapping geometry and that direction based defences should be calibrated separately for each language decoder family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 越狱的推理时防御进行跨架构审计，此类防御通常在选定解码器层的残差流中减去一个校准方向。作者在四种架构家族的 15 个模型-层单元上、采用幅度受控协议比较五个防御候选，发现没有任何单一候选能在拒绝恢复和效用保持上同时占优。图像条件偏移 (image conditioning shift) 在 LLaVA 1.5 与 Pixtral 12B 上领先，且在全部家族中是唯一效用损失保持在测量噪声底层的候选；CMRM 式拒绝方向与图像条件偏移在所有 15 个单元中均呈正余弦对齐，均值 0.35、范围 0.17 至 0.65、为随机向量零分布的 15 至 25 倍、符号检验 p 值约 3e-5。
Motivation: 推理时防御常通过从残差流减去校准方向来对抗 VLM 越狱，但现有工作缺乏跨架构、跨层的系统比较，难以判断不同方向候选的普适性与可迁移性。
Method: 提出幅度受控协议 (magnitude controlled protocol)：对每个提示匹配干预大小，并将每个防御方向与同范数的随机控制配对。比较五个候选：平均图像条件偏移、CMRM 式拒绝方向、ShiftDC 式攻击特定残差、忽略图像的提示指令以及随机控制。
Result: 图像条件偏移在 LLaVA 1.5 和 Pixtral 12B 上领先，且是唯一在所有架构家族中效用损失处于测量噪声底层的候选；提示指令在 Qwen2.5 VL 上领先，攻击特定残差在 Qwen2 VL 2B 上领先。图像条件方向在 15 个单元中的 13 个具有方向特异性，但强架构特异且在唯一兼容的 LLaVA 1.5 13B 与 Pixtral 12B 之间不可迁移。CMRM 方向与图像条件偏移在所有 15 个单元中正对齐，均值 0.35，范围 0.17 至 0.65，为随机向量零分布的 15 至 25 倍，符号检验 p 值约 3e-5。
Conclusion: 两种方向式防御配方恢复出部分重叠的几何结构，说明纯文本与多模态拒绝几何存在联系；方向式防御应按语言解码器架构家族分别校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Integrating Contextual Embeddings into Evaluation of Expressive MIDI Piano Performances
papers.abstract_en: Objective evaluation of expressive MIDI piano performances typically relies on attribute statistics such as timing, velocity, and duration of individual notes. However, these methods often disregard dependencies between notes, which poses a potential limitation in assessing the similarity between two sets of performances. In generative applications, the wide variety of expressive attributes makes it difficult to aggregate them into a single scalar metric for model selection. In this work, we reexamine attribute-scoped metrics and explore the perceptual properties of contextual embeddings from self-supervised symbolic music models, Aria and CLaMP3. Results from our listening study indicate that these models can be used as perceptual proxies, showing agreement with per-sample human ratings on par with traditional metrics. To measure conditional distributional similarity, we adapt Kernel Audio Distance to the symbolic music domain. Unlike Pearson correlation and reconstruction error, kernel-based methods on contextual embeddings do not require note alignment and are sensitive to contextual perturbations. To facilitate reproducibility, we release Pereval, an open-source library that integrates performance evaluation utilities, including both attribute-scoped and deep feature metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将自监督符号音乐模型的上下文嵌入用于表现性 MIDI 钢琴演奏的客观评估。作者重新审视属性范围（attribute-scoped）的指标，引入 Aria 和 CLaMP3 的上下文嵌入作为感知代理，并将 Kernel Audio Distance 适配到符号音乐域以度量条件分布相似性。听感实验显示这些嵌入与人类评分的吻合度不逊于传统指标，且不依赖音符对齐；同时发布开源库 Pereval 以集成各类评估工具。
Motivation: 传统表现性演奏评估依赖单音符的属性统计（时序、力度、时值），忽略音符间依赖，难以在生成式应用中把多样的表现属性聚合为单一标量以进行模型选择。
Method: 重新审视属性范围指标，使用自监督符号音乐模型 Aria 和 CLaMP3 的上下文嵌入作为感知代理；将 Kernel Audio Distance 适配到符号音乐域，用于度量条件分布相似性，该方法不要求音符对齐且对上下文扰动敏感。
Result: 听感实验表明上下文嵌入模型与逐样本人类评分的吻合度与传统指标相当；与 Pearson 相关和重构误差相比，基于核的方法不需要音符对齐，并能感知上下文扰动。
Conclusion: 为促进可复现性，作者发布开源库 Pereval，集成包含属性度量和深度特征度量的演奏评估工具。
