papers.title: Robust Wavelength Selection for Partial Least Squares Sugar Content Estimation Using Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Wavelength selection is one of the important preprocessing methods in near-infrared spectroscopy to improve prediction accuracy and interpretability of spectral data. We formulate wavelength-region selection for sugar content estimation as a binary black-box optimization problem and propose a method based on Bayesian optimization. The proposed method constructs a sparse quadratic surrogate model and sequentially extracts interested wavelength regions by Thompson sampling. Minimizing an acquisition function is performed as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem by simulated or quantum annealing. Experiments show that the proposed method improves the prediction accuracy of partial least squares regression and yields more consistent wavelength regions than genetic-algorithm-based selection and simulated annealing. Under one-bit local perturbations, the selected wavelength regions show minimal fluctuations in root mean square errors between observed and predicted values of a validation set. This local stability suggests that our method converges to a smoother error landscape and avoids isolated overfitted solutions. These results indicate that combinatorial Bayesian optimization is a useful framework for robust feature selection in spectroscopic prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将近红外光谱中糖含量估计的波长区域选择建模为二元黑箱优化问题，提出基于组合贝叶斯优化（combinatorial Bayesian optimization）的方法。方法构建稀疏二次代理模型，通过 Thompson 采样顺序提取感兴趣的波长区域，并把最小化采集函数转化为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，用模拟退火或量子退火求解。实验表明，该方法相比遗传算法和模拟退火能提高偏最小二乘回归的预测精度，并得到更一致的波长区域。
Motivation: 波长选择是近红外光谱中提升预测精度和可解释性的重要预处理步骤，但传统选择方法可能得到不稳定或不一致的波长区域。论文将波长区域选择形式化为二元黑箱优化，目标是在保持鲁棒性的同时改进偏最小二乘回归的预测精度。
Method: 提出基于贝叶斯优化的波长区域选择方法：构造稀疏二次代理模型，用 Thompson 采样逐步提取感兴趣的波长区域；采集函数的最小化被归约为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，通过模拟或量子退火求解。
Result: 实验显示该方法在糖含量估计上提升偏最小二乘回归的预测精度，且相比基于遗传算法的选择和模拟退火产生更一致的波长区域；在一比特局部扰动下，验证集的观测值与预测值之间均方根误差波动极小，表明收敛到更平滑的误差景观，能避免孤立的过拟合解。
Conclusion: 摘要认为组合贝叶斯优化是光谱预测任务中稳健特征选择的有效框架；结论主要基于糖含量估计实验和局部稳定性分析。

papers.title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks, but often fail under imperfect or shifted contexts. A reliable MLLM should refuse truly out-of-context (OOC) questions with subject-level context shifts while still answering shifted in-context (Shifted IC) questions with non-subject context shifts. Existing benchmarks mainly target OOC or visually unanswerable questions, but overlook answerable Shifted IC cases and cover limited OOC shifts. To fill this gap, we present MMOOC, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating refusal and robust answering abilities of MLLMs. MMOOC contains over 41K image-question pairs, including answerable Shifted IC cases and unanswerable OOC cases, spanning three question formats, eight shift types and six visual scenarios, with data quality ensured through MLLM-based filtering and human verification. We evaluate model responses using Accuracy and Refusal Rate, and further introduce an LLM-as-a-Judge metric to assess the correctness of model reasoning. Experiments on diverse MLLMs show that current models still struggle to balance answer-ability and refusal under shifted contexts. We further analyze key failure patterns and show that post-training can improve robustness. MMOOC will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMOOC，一个大规模多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 越界上下文 (out-of-context) 评测基准，包含超过 41K 图像-问题对，覆盖可回答的 Shifted IC 情况与不可回答的 OOC 情况，涉及三种问题格式、八种位移类型和六种视觉场景。评测使用 Accuracy 和 Refusal Rate，并引入 LLM-as-a-Judge 指标评估推理正确性。实验表明现有模型在位移上下文下仍难以平衡可答性与拒绝行为。
Motivation: 现有基准主要针对 OOC 或视觉不可回答的问题，忽略了下文位移但可回答的 Shifted IC 情况，且对 OOC 位移类型覆盖有限。
Method: 构建 MMOOC 基准，包含超过 41K 图像-问题对，涵盖 Shifted IC 与 OOC 两类样本；通过 MLLM 过滤和人工验证保障数据质量。评估采用 Accuracy 和 Refusal Rate，并额外设计 LLM-as-a-Judge 指标来检查模型推理的正确性。
Result: 在多种 MLLM 上的实验显示，当前模型在位移上下文下难以同时兼顾可答性和拒绝行为；文章还分析了关键失败模式，并指出后训练 (post-training) 可以提升鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要使 MLLM 更可靠地处理上下文位移问题，并承诺公开 MMOOC 基准。

papers.title: HALO: Heterogeneous Admission through Localized Obligations for Safe Agentic Execution
papers.abstract_en: Recent agentic AI systems may return a heterogeneous response containing notices, requests, handoffs, and actions. Conditions can change before external use, so components from the same response need not remain supported together. Rejecting the whole response discards useful components, whereas checking components independently can leave a dependent without its prerequisite. We present Heterogeneous Admission with Localized Obligations (HALO), a runtime protocol that preserves supported components whose declared prerequisites also remain supported, rechecks each exact action before dispatch, and allows blocked actions to be replaced only by fresh candidates. HALO matched all 96 admission expectations and passed all 20 protocol tests. In structured-response replay, it retained 248/248 supported components, including 128/128 unaffected by unrelated changes, while a whole-response policy retained 0/248. Across ten cold-start PX4/Gazebo sessions, HALO blocked every tested stale route, observed no matching stale setpoint, and completed all fresh recoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HALO（Heterogeneous Admission with Localized Obligations），一个面向智能体系统（agentic AI）异构响应的运行时准入协议。该协议保留声明前置条件仍受支持的组件，在派发前重新检查每个确切动作，并只允许用新候选替换被阻止的动作。摘要报告 HALO 通过全部 96 项准入预期和 20 项协议测试，在结构化响应重放中保留 248/248 个受支持组件，并在 PX4/Gazebo 冷启动会话中拦截所有测试过的陈旧路径。
Motivation: 智能体系统返回的异构响应可能包含通知、请求、交接和动作，而外部使用前条件可能已变化，因此同一响应中的组件未必仍能一起受支持。整体拒绝会丢弃仍有用的组件，而独立检查又可能让依赖组件缺少其前置条件。
Method: 提出 HALO 运行时协议：保留声明前置条件仍然受支持的组件，对每个确切动作在派发前重新校验，并且仅允许以全新的候选动作替换被阻止的动作。
Result: HALO 匹配全部 96 项准入预期并通过全部 20 项协议测试；在结构化响应重放中保留 248/248 个受支持组件（其中 128/128 个不受无关变更影响），而整体响应策略仅保留 0/248；在十次 PX4/Gazebo 冷启动会话中拦截所有测试过的陈旧路径，未观察到匹配的陈旧设定点，并完成全部新鲜恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，基于局部义务的异构准入可以在组件级保留有效部分并拦截因条件变化而失效的动作，相关验证基于协议测试和 PX4/Gazebo 模拟场景。

papers.title: HealthCAT: An Interpretable Encoder-only Transformer Framework for Health Indicator Prediction and Temporal Interpretation of Wearable Sensor Data
papers.abstract_en: Wearable sensors continuously capture fine-grained multivariate time-series data, providing opportunities to model behavioural patterns associated with health outcomes. However, existing deep learning methods prioritise predictive accuracy over interpretability, limiting their application in health research. In this study, we present HealthCAT, a flexible framework that integrates an Encoder-only Transformer with an Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) to generate class-specific, time-step-level interpretations. These interpretations can be mapped back onto behavioural cycles that are relevant to the domain (e.g., time-of-day), supporting individual-level analysis of wearable sensor data. We evaluated HealthCAT using two real-world wearable sensor datasets (306 participants in total). HealthCAT outperformed deep learning baselines by up to 17\% in F1-score and 12\% in accuracy on both datasets ($p<0.05$). In masking experiments, the time steps identified by HealthCAT carried significantly more predictive value than random selection across all masking conditions ($p<0.05$), indicating that the identified time steps are predictively informative. By coupling predictive performance with validated time-step-level interpretability, HealthCAT moves wearable sensor analysis beyond aggregated metrics towards temporal patterns that support health monitoring, behavioural pattern analysis, and intervention design in health research. The significance of this work is that it enables accurate prediction of health indicators from wearable sensor data while providing insights into when and how physical activity patterns occur, rather than relying solely on aggregated summary measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HealthCAT，一个基于 Encoder-only Transformer 与 Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) 的可解释框架，用于从可穿戴传感器多变量时间序列中预测健康指标，并生成类别相关的逐时间步解释。在两个真实可穿戴数据集（共 306 名参与者）上，HealthCAT 相比深度学习基线在 F1-score 上最高提升 17%、准确率上提升 12%（p<0.05）；掩码实验表明其识别的时间步携带显著更高的预测信息。作者强调该方法将预测性能与经过验证的时间步级可解释性结合，支持个体层面的行为周期分析和健康监测。
Motivation: 可穿戴传感器产生细粒度多变量时间序列，可用于建模与健康结果相关的行为模式，但现有深度学习方法优先追求预测精度而忽视可解释性，限制了其在健康研究中的应用。
Method: 提出 HealthCAT，将 Encoder-only Transformer 与 Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) 集成，生成类别特定、时间步级的解释，并将解释映射回时间-日等行为周期，以支持个体层面的穿戴传感器数据分析。
Result: 在两个真实可穿戴传感器数据集（共 306 名参与者）上，HealthCAT 相比深度学习基线在 F1-score 上最高提升 17%、准确率上提升 12%（p<0.05）；掩码实验中，其识别的时间步在所有掩码条件下都比随机选择携带显著更多的预测价值（p<0.05）。
Conclusion: HealthCAT 使可穿戴传感器分析不再局限于聚合指标，而是提供关于身体活动模式何时发生以及如何发生的时序洞察，支持健康监测、行为模式分析和干预设计；其核心价值在于同时实现健康指标的准确预测与验证过的时间步级可解释性。

papers.title: 4DHumanDiff: Direct Text-to-4DGS Generation for Consistent 360-Degree Dynamic Humans
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality 360-degree dynamic human assets from text prompts is challenging. Existing methods usually synthesize monocular or multi-view videos first and then fit a 4D representation, which is expensive and often causes incomplete geometry or view-inconsistent renderings. We present 4DHumanDiff, a diffusion framework that directly generates dynamic humans represented by 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) from text prompts. By modeling the structured 4D representation space end-to-end, 4DHumanDiff avoids video pre-generation and per-scene reconstruction, making it better suited for view-consistent and temporally coherent asset generation. The model uses a 3D U-Net backbone with temporal attention for motion-aware generation. We further construct a large-scale text-to-4DGS dataset with 60,000 high-quality pairs, and introduce 2D regularization and training-free 4D interpolation to improve rendering quality and motion smoothness. Experiments show that 4DHumanDiff generates consistent 360-degree dynamic humans within one minute, achieves better temporal and multi-view consistency, and reduces inference time by more than 10x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 4DHumanDiff，一个直接从文本提示生成由 4D 高斯泼溅 (4DGS) 表示的动态人体的扩散框架。它端到端建模结构化 4D 表示空间，跳过视频预生成和逐场景重建，并配合 3D U-Net 骨干与时间注意力、6 万对文本-4DGS 数据集、2D 正则化和免训练 4D 插值。实验表明该方法可在约一分钟内生成一致的 360 度动态人体，时间与多视角一致性更好，推理时间降低超过 10 倍。
Motivation: 现有方法通常先从文本合成单目或多视角视频，再拟合 4D 表示，流程昂贵且容易产生不完整几何或视角不一致的渲染。
Method: 提出端到端扩散框架，直接在 4DGS 表示空间生成动态人体；使用 3D U-Net 骨干加时间注意力实现运动感知生成，并构造 60,000 对文本-4DGS 的大规模数据集，引入 2D 正则化和免训练 4D 插值以提升渲染质量与运动平滑度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能在约一分钟内生成一致的 360 度动态人体，达到更好的时间一致性和多视角一致性，并将推理时间减少超过 10 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调端到端建模 4D 表示空间可避免视频预生成和逐场景重建，更适合视角一致且时间连贯的动态人体资产生成。

papers.title: First-order Constrained Trilevel Optimization Over Distributed Networks for Robust Coreset Selection
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of the Internet of Things (IoT), massive amounts of data are generated across distributed edge networks. Training models on full data incurs significant computational overhead and storage bottlenecks, rendering coreset selection a critical paradigm. Furthermore, given the privacy-sensitive nature of local data and the escalating demand for model robustness in real-world deployments, developing an effective distributed optimization framework for robust coreset selection is vital, yet remains largely unexplored. To this end, this work first characterizes the hierarchical dependencies among coreset selection, robust optimization, and distributed learning, and formulates the distributed robust coreset selection as a trilevel optimization problem with level-wise constraints. Furthermore, to effectively solve the trilevel problem in a distributed manner, the \underline{F}ederated \underline{F}irst-order \underline{C}onstrained \underline{T}rilevel \underline{O}ptimization (F$^2$CTO) is proposed, which synergistically integrates a hierarchical composite value-function reformulation and a distributed alternating projected gradient algorithm. To the best of our knowledge, F$^2$CTO is the first method developed for distributed robust coreset selection, as well as the first distributed optimization approach for trilevel optimization problems with level-wise constraints. Additionally, we prove that the proposed method achieves a non-asymptotic convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-3/2})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary point. Extensive empirical evaluations on reliable continual learning demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed F$^2$CTO.

papers.title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challenging. The standard critic often fails to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states, resulting in noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates. In this paper, we propose ReDiPPO, a Reference-guided and Discrepancy-aware PPO framework for mathematical reasoning. ReDiPPO introduces a reference-guided critic that uses reference answers as training-time privileged signals to provide more accurate value estimation. Meanwhile, it retains a standard critic and quantifies the token-level reference-standard discrepancy between the standard value estimate and the reference-guided value estimate. This discrepancy serves as an indicator of difficult reasoning states and is used to reweight the corresponding token-level advantages during PPO optimization. Extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ReDiPPO improves value-estimation accuracy and consistently outperforms strong policy optimization baselines, including PPO, DAPO, and GSPO, in final reasoning performance. Our code is available on https://github.com/cii030/ReDiPPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReDiPPO，一种用于数学推理的 reference-guided 与 discrepancy-aware PPO 框架。它引入参考答案作为训练时特权信号来校准 critic 的价值估计，并用标准 critic 与 reference-guided critic 之间的 token 级差异对 PPO 优势做重加权。实验表明在多个数学推理基准上，ReDiPPO 一致优于 PPO、DAPO、GSPO 等强基线。
Motivation: 数学推理任务具有长推理链和稀疏结果奖励，标准 critic 难以对中间推理状态做可靠的 token 级 credit assignment，导致优势估计有噪声并产生次优策略更新。
Method: 提出 ReDiPPO：reference-guided critic 利用参考答案作为训练时特权信号以提供更准确的价值估计；同时保留标准 critic，量化两者在 token 层面的 reference-standard 差异，并将该差异作为困难推理状态的指示，用于重加权对应 token 级优势。
Result: 在多个数学推理基准上的实验表明，ReDiPPO 提升了价值估计准确度，并在最终推理性能上一致优于 PPO、DAPO 和 GSPO 等策略优化基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调使用参考答案作为特权信号并依据 token 级差异重加权优势可缓解数学推理中稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题；代码已开源。

papers.title: SCOPE: Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box combinatorial optimization requires systematically identifying high-quality solutions under a limited evaluation budget, yet the unknown objective function provides little guidance for deciding where the search should explore next. We introduce SCOPE, a general framework for Synthetic Conditional Objectives for Policy Evolution in Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization. Rather than directly optimizing the inaccessible objective, SCOPE learns a set of synthetic objectives conditioned on the accumulated search history, where each objective is designed to expose a distinct and potentially useful preference over candidate solutions. These objectives are then used to evolve search policies that generate diverse candidates, whose true quality is subsequently assessed through black-box evaluations. The outer loop adaptively updates and selects synthetic objectives according to how effectively their induced policies discover promising regions. In contrast, the inner loop returns a portfolio of top-performing policies to reduce the risk of relying on a single surrogate preference. This formulation reframes objective design as a mechanism for guiding policy exploration, enabling the search process to exploit observed evidence while maintaining structured diversity across discrete solution spaces. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark problems demonstrate that SCOPE consistently improves black-box search performance under limited evaluation budgets and generalizes well across diverse combinatorial structures.
papers.comment: 43 pages; Kiet, Duc, and Bang contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE，一个面向黑盒组合优化的通用框架，用于在有限评估预算下引导搜索。SCOPE 不直接优化不可访问的目标函数，而是基于累积搜索历史学习一组合成目标 (synthetic objectives)，每个目标对候选解暴露不同偏好，并据此演化生成多样化候选的搜索策略。外层循环根据策略发现优质区域的效果自适应更新和选择目标，内层循环则返回一组高性能策略以降低依赖单一代理偏好的风险。摘要报告在多个基准问题上，该方法在有限预算下持续提升黑盒搜索性能，并能泛化到多样的组合结构。
Motivation: 黑盒组合优化要求在有限评估预算下系统性地找到高质量解，但未知目标函数给下一步搜索方向提供的指导很有限。
Method: 提出将目标设计作为引导策略探索机制的框架：学习基于搜索历史条件的合成目标集合，用它们演化搜索策略以生成多样候选，再经真实黑盒评估；外层循环根据策略表现自适应更新和筛选目标，内层循环保留一组性能靠前的策略作为组合 (portfolio)，以避免依赖单一代理偏好。
Result: 摘要称在多个基准问题上，SCOPE 在有限评估预算下一致提高了黑盒搜索性能，并展现了对不同组合结构的良好泛化；但摘要未给出具体量化指标或数据集名称。
Conclusion: SCOPE 将合成目标的重构与策略探索结合，使搜索过程既能利用已观察到的证据，又能在离散解空间中保持结构化多样性。

papers.title: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BlindPSNR，一个轻量级无参考网络，用于低光图像增强（LLIE）中预测 PSNR，从而在没有参考图的情况下实现增强参数的自动选择。方法通过窗口交叉注意力（windowed cross-attention）融合增强图像与原始低光输入，并采用异方差回归（heteroscedastic regression）估计 PSNR。实验显示 BlindPSNR 在基准上的 top-1 选择准确率达到 89.5%，优于标量回归基线的 54.4%，并泛化到未见数据集（SRCC = 0.61–0.67）。
Motivation: 低光增强方法常含固定可调参数，跨场景使用时性能会下降，而人工选择配置耗时且不总是可行。PSNR 是自动选择参数的自然保真准则，但其计算需要通常不可得的 ground-truth 参考；现有的无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）关注感知质量而非信号保真，作者测试的七个基线在基准上的 top-1 选择准确率均为 0%。
Method: 利用配对训练数据使 ground-truth PSNR 可解析计算，从而提供精确监督而无需单独的教师网络。在此基础上提出 BlindPSNR，一个轻量级无参考网络，通过窗口交叉注意力融合增强图像与退化的低光输入，并用异方差回归估计 PSNR。
Result: 标量回归基线的 top-1 选择准确率为 54.4%，BlindPSNR 将其提升到 89.5%，regret 从 1.62 dB 降至 0.026 dB；该方法还能泛化到未见数据集，SRCC 为 0.61–0.67。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首个以学习方式处理低光图像增强无参考 PSNR 预测的工作，可有效用于自动化参数选择，并展示了跨数据集的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Arm2Air: Cross-Embodiment Skeleton Transfer for 3D Relay Formation
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) relay networks can restore connectivity after communication infrastructure is damaged. Urban relay placement is difficult because line-of-sight blockage, communication range, altitude, and three-dimensional obstacles must be considered jointly. Arm2Air transfers obstacle-avoidance skeletons from robot arms to UAV relay placement through cross-embodiment transfer. Source-domain robot-arm motions from a pretrained Neural MP model are converted into ordered skeletons that pretrain a transformer-based transfer platform, which is then adapted to the UAV domain using limited target data and Low-Rank Adaptation. The transferred skeleton initializes a relay chain that is refined for connectivity, bottleneck capacity, delay, and movement cost. On nine held-out high-clutter 3D urban maps, Arm2Air reduced median end-to-end planning runtime by 64.9 percent relative to the fastest conventional planner. On the high-obstruction group of a separate 30-map dense urban holdout, it increased bottleneck capacity by 32.6 percent, reduced capacity variance by 74.7 percent, reduced maximum hop distance by 13.2 percent, reduced hop-distance variance by 75.2 percent, and reduced relay displacement by 16.9 percent relative to IMPC-MD. With only three target-domain training maps, Arm2Air reduced relay-position root mean square error by 53.6 percent relative to training from scratch while updating 0.134 million parameters, compared with 1.383 million for Scratch and Full Fine-tuning. These results demonstrate computationally and data-efficient UAV relay placement and suggest a broader principle for transferring ordered structural priors across heterogeneous embodied tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Arm2Air，一种跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 骨架迁移方法，用于三维城市环境中的 UAV 中继部署。其思路是把预训练 Neural MP 模型生成的机械臂避障运动转换为有序骨架，用来预训练基于 Transformer 的迁移平台，再借助少量目标域数据和 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 适配到 UAV 域；迁移得到的骨架初始化中继链，并针对连通性、瓶颈容量、时延和移动代价进行优化。摘要在多组高遮挡城市图上报告了规划耗时、瓶颈容量和位移等指标的改进，并强调计算与数据效率。
Motivation: 城市 UAV 中继部署困难，因为视距遮挡、通信距离、飞行高度和三维障碍物需要联合考虑；现有方法在密集高楼环境中规划效率与容量稳定性不足。
Method: 从机械臂域提取有序避障骨架作为跨域结构化先验，预训练基于 Transformer 的迁移平台，再用少量 UAV 目标域数据和 LoRA 进行适配；迁移骨架初始化中继链，并通过连通性、瓶颈容量、时延和移动代价等目标进行精化。
Result: 在 9 张高杂乱度 3D 城市地图上，Arm2Air 相比最快的传统规划器将中位端到端规划运行时间降低 64.9%；在独立 30 张密集城市地图的高遮挡分组上，相比 IMPC-MD 将瓶颈容量提高 32.6%、容量方差降低 74.7%、最大跳距降低 13.2%、跳距方差降低 75.2%、中继位移降低 16.9%。仅用 3 张目标域训练地图时，相比从零训练将中继位置 RMSE 降低 53.6%，且仅更新 0.134M 参数（Scratch 与 Full Fine-tuning 为 1.383M）。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果展示了计算与数据高效的 UAV 中继部署，并暗示一种更一般的原理：可在异构具身任务之间迁移有序结构先验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Real-Time Hard Peak Age-of-Information Safety with No-Regret Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safety-critical IoT systems such as industrial closed-loop control, V2X coordination, and remote teleoperation require every sensor's peak Age of Information (peak AoI, also abbreviated PAoI) to stay below a hard per-slot deadline, not merely an average bound. Existing approaches meet this requirement only under restrictive assumptions: stochastic channels for Whittle-index AoI, simulator rollouts for deep reinforcement learning, or sublinear cumulative violation for long-term constrained online convex optimization. Under adversarial coefficients, OCO-PAoI-Hard guarantees zero per-slot violation of the modeled AoI state under one-step viability and O(sqrt(T)) regret against any static safe comparator; packet-level safety requires stronger service assumptions. Our key observation is that the fractional peak-AoI deadline collapses exactly to an affine half-space constraint on the resource-allocation vector, turning hard real-time scheduling into time-varying constrained online convex optimization over a polyhedral safe set. A strictly causal proposal-shield-update loop enforces feasibility through one Euclidean projection per slot, the gradient step preserves no-regret behavior, and the classical virtual queue is reduced to an a-posteriori certificate. We establish closed-form static and dynamic regret bounds, a matching Omega(sqrt(T)) minimax lower bound, a margin-safe variant against execution noise, and a deadline-induced competitive ratio. On a four-sensor adversarial fluid-model trap channel, OCO-PAoI-Hard attains zero modeled-state deadline violations across all ten seeds, while four representative baselines miss between 1.65 percent and 64.0 percent of slots, and the empirical normalized regret stays below the theoretical envelope across two orders of magnitude in T.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE Real-Time Systems Symposium (RTSS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OCO-PAoI-Hard，一种面向硬实时峰值信息年龄（peak AoI）约束的在线学习调度方法。作者将每个时隙的分数化峰龄截止期限精确等价为资源分配向量上的仿射半空间约束，从而把硬实时调度转化为多面体安全集上的时变约束在线凸优化（OCO）。在对抗性系数下，该方法在一步可行性条件下实现零单时隙违规和 O(√T) 遗憾，并在四传感器对抗流模型陷阱信道上验证了零违规与低经验遗憾。
Motivation: 安全关键 IoT 系统要求每个传感器的 peak AoI 每时隙都满足硬性截止期限，而现有方法（Whittle-index、深度强化学习模拟、长期约束 OCO）仅在随机信道、模拟器或次线性累计违规等较弱假设下满足要求。
Method: 核心观察是把分数化峰龄截止期限折叠为资源分配向量的仿射半空间约束；随后构造严格因果的 proposal-shield-update 循环，每时隙一次欧氏投影保证可行性，梯度步保持无遗憾性质，并将经典虚拟队列降级为事后证书（a-posteriori certificate）。
Result: 摘要报告了闭式静态与动态遗憾界、匹配的 Ω(√T) 极小极大下界、针对执行噪声的 margin-safe 变体以及截止期限诱导的竞争比；在四传感器对抗流模型陷阱信道上，OCO-PAoI-Hard 在全部十个种子中零建模状态截止期限违规，而四个基线错过 1.65% 至 64.0% 的时隙，经验归一化遗憾在 T 的两个数量级内低于理论包络。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将硬实时调度建模为多面体安全集上的时变约束 OCO 可以实现对抗环境下零违规的 peak-AoI 硬安全保证，同时保持 O(√T) 遗憾；论文已被 2026 IEEE RTSS 接收。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MedXplore: Towards Reliable and Unbiased Generalized Category Discovery in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has shown strong potential in medical image analysis, but most existing methods rely on large-scale annotations and a closed-world assumption that rarely holds in clinical practice. Although Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) has advanced rapidly on natural images, it remains underexplored in medical imaging. To address this issue, we propose MedXplore, a unified framework for reliable and unbiased medical GCD, optimizing from both perceptual and decision levels. Specifically, at the perceptual level, taking a frequency domain perspective, Frequency-SNR Adaptive Attention and Consistency (FAAC) performs learnable full-spectrum filtering and global-local energy contrast activation to not only highlight local abnormal signals relative to the global context, but also provide reliable semantic anchors for patch consistency learning. At the decision level, Adaptive Cosine-Angular Margin (ACAM) adjusts angular margins using semantic difficulty and feature confidence to balance intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. Together, the two modules improve lesion-sensitive representation learning and mitigate old-class bias. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show an average \textbf{8.5\%} gain in \textit{All} accuracy over the strongest competing methods. On Kvasir, MedXplore reduces false-old errors from 14.50\% to 0.80\%, demonstrating strong robustness under severe old-new ambiguity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedXplore，一个面向医学影像的广义类别发现 (Generalized Category Discovery, GCD) 统一框架，旨在同时从感知层和决策层提升可靠性与无偏性。感知层使用 Frequency-SNR Adaptive Attention and Consistency (FAAC)，通过可学习全频谱滤波和全局-局部能量对比激活来突出局部异常信号并提供语义锚点；决策层使用 Adaptive Cosine-Angular Margin (ACAM)，依据语义难度和特征置信度调整角度边界以平衡类内紧凑性与类间可分性。实验显示在多个基准上 All 准确率平均提升 8.5%，并在 Kvasir 上将 false-old 错误率从 14.50% 降到 0.80%。
Motivation: 现有医学影像深度学习方法依赖大规模标注并假设封闭世界，而临床实践常违反该假设；GCD 在自然图像上发展迅速，但在医学影像中尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 MedXplore 框架，包含感知层的 FAAC 模块（频域视角下的全频谱滤波与全局-局部能量对比激活，并为 patch 一致性学习提供语义锚点）和决策层的 ACAM 模块（根据语义难度和特征置信度自适应调节角度边界，兼顾类内紧凑与类间分离）。
Result: 在多个基准上相对最强对比方法平均提升 8.5% 的 All 准确率；在 Kvasir 数据集上将 false-old 错误从 14.50% 显著降低到 0.80%，展示了在严重新旧类别混淆下的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为感知层与决策层的联合优化能增强病灶敏感表示学习并缓解旧类偏置，从而提升医学 GCD 的可靠性与无偏性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hidden APIs in Language Models: Discovering Reusable Causal Interfaces from Forked Futures
papers.abstract_en: Identical language-model answers can arise from hidden states that support different future computations, so current-answer probes do not establish a reusable internal interface. We introduce forked futures: future operations are sampled only after a prefix state has formed, and states are compared through the response distributions induced by those operations. This yields an empirical causal quotient over hidden states without requiring researcher-specified latent labels. Shared, Local, Mixture, and Distributed interfaces then compete under prequential causal description length subject to future-signature fidelity and matched capacity constraints. In the two detailed model evaluations, Shared has the lowest held-out description length, with gains of 0.216 nats on Qwen2.5-1.5B and 0.294 nats on Llama-3-8B, while maintaining tightly clustered mean future-signature distortion; a five-backbone sweep preserves the positive direction of Sharedness Gain. The figure-aligned transplantation analysis gives Shared the strongest joint target-correctness, locality, copy-preservation, and composite profile, and API-aligned paths mediate 0.749 of the target effect versus 0.150 for matched null paths. In the blind four-class model-organism test, 14/16 architectures are recovered, with one observed non-Shared to Shared error among 12 non-Shared organisms. These results support an economical reusable causal interface within the tested operation banks, while keeping the claim explicitly conditional on the candidate architectures, interventions, and held-out futures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对“相同答案可能来自支持不同未来计算的隐藏状态”这一问题，提出 forked futures 方法：在前缀状态形成后才采样未来操作，并通过这些操作诱导的响应分布比较隐藏状态，从而无需研究者指定潜在标签即可建立经验因果商。作者在预序列因果描述长度 (prequential causal description length) 下比较 Shared、Local、Mixture、Distributed 四类接口，发现 Shared 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 Llama-3-8B 上取得最低留出描述长度，并在移植分析与盲测中表现最强。
Motivation: 现有基于当前答案的探针 (probe) 无法确证隐藏状态构成可复用的内部接口，因为完全相同的输出可以源自支持不同未来计算的隐藏状态；需要一种不依赖人工指定潜在标签的因果比较方式。

Result: Shared 接口的留出描述长度最低，在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上增益 0.216 nats、在 Llama-3-8B 上增益 0.294 nats，且平均未来签名失真保持紧密聚集；五骨干扫描保持 Sharedness Gain 的正方向。移植分析中 Shared 的综合轮廓最强，API 对齐路径中介了 0.749 的目标效应（匹配零路径为 0.150）；盲法测试恢复 14/16 架构，12 个非 Shared 生物体中仅出现一次非 Shared 到 Shared 的误判。
Conclusion: 结果表明在所测试的操作库内存在经济且可复用的因果接口，但作者明确将该声明限定于候选架构、干预方式与留出未来操作的范围内。

papers.title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image and personalized editing models now synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease. Yet placing multiple named people into shared contact actions such as embrace, carry, or grapple still exposes major failures: fused limbs, invented extremities, and interpenetrating bodies. Existing evaluations largely overlook these anatomical and geometric issues, and VLM-as-a-judge checklists often saturate on Interaction while the errors remain obvious to humans. We introduce MPIE-Bench, a 2,500-sample benchmark of video-mined editing triplets spanning 405 scenes, 14 interaction categories, and four contact densities (C0-C3). We also propose MPIE-Eval, whose two new axes score contact-time geometry from a frozen public multi-person mesh reconstruction. Anatomy asks whether every human-like mass is explained by a complete set of reconstructed bodies, and Interaction asks whether the penetration and surface distance between those bodies match the contact the instruction asked for. Across ten editors, mesh Anatomy tops out at 0.65 and mesh Interaction at 0.72 on two different models, so no single editor is strong on both, while VLM checklists rate the same images above 0.95. A five-rater study confirms that both axes track human judgement more closely than a zero-shot VLM judge, and the rankings hold under ablation of every weight and threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MPIE-Bench，一个面向多人交互编辑 (multi-person interaction editing) 的基准，包含 2,500 个从视频挖掘的编辑三元组，覆盖 405 个场景、14 类交互和四种接触密度 (C0-C3)。作者同时提出 MPIE-Eval，用冻结的多人网格重建 (mesh reconstruction) 从 Anatomy 和 Interaction 两个新维度评估接触时刻的几何质量。结果显示在十个编辑模型上，网格 Anatomy 最高只有 0.65，网格 Interaction 最高 0.72，没有单一编辑器在两个维度上都强，而 VLM 检查表对相同图像评分超过 0.95，暴露了现有评判方式的饱和问题。
Motivation: 文本到图像和个性化编辑模型在单主体图像上已能生成高保真结果，但在让多个命名人物执行拥抱、扛起、扭打等接触动作时仍存在肢体融合、虚构肢体和身体互相穿透等明显失败。现有评测大多忽略这些解剖与几何问题，且以 VLM 为评判者的检查表在 Interaction 维度上饱和，误差对人类肉眼依然明显。
Method: 引入 MPIE-Bench，一个基于视频挖掘的 2,500 样本基准，包含 405 个场景、14 个交互类别和四个接触密度等级 (C0-C3)；并提出 MPIE-Eval，其两个新维度通过冻结的公开多人网格重建来量化接触时刻几何：Anatomy 检查每个类人质量块是否由完整重建身体集合解释，Interaction 检查身体之间的穿透和表面距离是否与指令要求的接触一致。
Result: 在十个编辑模型上，网格 Anatomy 得分最高 0.65，网格 Interaction 最高 0.72，且这两个最高分来自两个不同模型，说明没有哪个编辑器在两个维度都强；而 VLM 检查表对同一批图像的评分超过 0.95。五项评分者研究确认这两个维度比零样本 VLM 评判者更贴近人类判断，且在对所有权重和阈值做消融后排名依然成立。
Conclusion: MPIE-Bench 和 MPIE-Eval 表明，现有编辑器在多人接触动作的解剖真实性和交互几何上均远未达标，且 VLM 式自动评分会高估这些图像的交互质量；作者强调该基准的两个评估维度在消融下排名稳定，可作为更可靠的多人与接触场景评测依据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CORE: In-Context Reconstruction for Unified Tabular Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Tabular anomaly detection (TAD), which focuses on identifying abnormal samples that deviate from the majority in tabular data, has received growing attention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend towards unified TAD, which seeks to detect anomalies across different datasets using a single generalizable model. In unified TAD, aligning heterogeneous data remains challenging. While existing methods often rely on distance-based unified feature construction, they may obscure the semantics of the original features. Moreover, existing approaches typically formulate anomaly detection as a binary classification task, which may overlook diverse anomaly patterns from various datasets and be misled by unrepresentative synthetic anomalies. To address these challenges, we propose an in-COntext REconstruction approach for unified TAD (CORE for short). It introduces a decorrelated feature alignment module to directly align heterogeneous features into a unified representation space, which retains their semantic information. Meanwhile, CORE formulates unified TAD as an in-context reconstruction problem, eliminating the need for labeled or synthesized anomalies. Specifically, the in-context reconstruction module reconstructs each sample by leveraging contextual normal samples to capture dataset-specific distributions, such that reconstruction errors reflect its deviation from normality, facilitating unified TAD on arbitrary unseen datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORE，一种面向统一表格异常检测 (unified tabular anomaly detection) 的上下文内重建 (in-context reconstruction) 方法。CORE 先从去相关特征对齐模块将异质表格特征映射到统一表示空间并保留语义信息，再将异常检测建模为上下文内重建问题：利用上下文中的正常样本重建每个样本，用重建误差衡量其偏离正常分布的程度，从而无需标注或合成异常即可在任意未见数据集上进行统一 TAD。
Motivation: 统一 TAD 需要跨数据集对齐异质特征，现有基于距离的统一特征构造方法可能破坏原始特征语义；同时，将异常检测看作二分类任务会忽视来自不同数据集的多样异常模式，并易被不具代表性的合成异常误导。
Method: 提出 CORE，包含去相关特征对齐模块 (decorrelated feature alignment module)，直接把异质特征对齐到统一表示空间；以及上下文内重建模块 (in-context reconstruction module)，通过上下文正常样本重建每个样本，使得重建误差反映样本相对于正常分布的偏离，从而支持在任意未见数据集上的统一异常检测。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；其核心断言是该方法无需标注或合成异常，即可借助重建误差实现对任意未见数据集上的统一异常检测。
Conclusion: 作者强调保留了原始特征语义并以重建误差衡量正常性，从而避免二分类范式对多样异常模式的忽视以及合成异常的误导。

papers.title: DualAnchor: Preserving Language Priors and Improving Lexical Fidelity in Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led sign language translation (SLT), the task of converting sign-language videos into spoken-language text, to increasingly adopt LLMs as textual backbones. However, despite their strong language modeling capabilities, existing LLM-based SLT methods often undermine rather than exploit this language prior, producing disfluent translations, a failure we term language-prior degradation. Meanwhile, existing methods typically align videos and text at the sentence level, which does not ensure accurate lexical details and creates a lexical fidelity gap. To address both issues, we propose DualAnchor, a gloss-free LLM-based SLT training framework that couples two complementary anchors for linguistically fluent and visually faithful generation. Token-level Prior Anchoring (TPA) preserves the LLM's language prior by regularizing the multimodal decoder at each decoding step toward the next-token distribution of a frozen LLM conditioned on the same autoregressive prefix. Optimal Transport Alignment (OTA) improves lexical fidelity by formulating visual-textual matching as entropy-regularized partial optimal transport, with Sinkhorn optimization inducing a soft alignment between visual tokens and textual content tokens under a cosine cost. DualAnchor achieves strong overall performance on both PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily. Targeted analyses attribute these gains to the complementary effects of the two anchors: TPA improves fluency, whereas OTA reduces fine-grained lexical errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualAnchor，一种基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的无注释 (gloss-free) 手语翻译 (SLT) 训练框架，旨在同时缓解语言先验退化 (language-prior degradation) 与词汇保真度不足。方法包括 token 级先验锚定 (TPA) 与最优传输对齐 (OTA)，在 PHOENIX-2014T 和 CSL-Daily 上取得强整体性能，并通过针对性分析将提升归因于两个锚点的互补作用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的手语翻译方法虽以 LLM 为文本骨干，却常削弱而非利用其语言先验，导致译文不流畅；同时句子级视频-文本对齐无法保证词汇细节准确，形成词汇保真度缺口。
Method: DualAnchor 包含两个互补锚点：TPA 在每个解码步用冻结 LLM 基于相同自回归前缀的下一 token 分布正则化多模态解码器，以保留语言先验；OTA 将视觉-文本匹配形式化为熵正则的部分最优传输，通过 Sinkhorn 优化在余弦代价下得到视觉 token 与文本内容 token 的软对齐。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 PHOENIX-2014T 和 CSL-Daily 上取得强整体性能；针对性分析表明 TPA 提升流畅度，OTA 降低细粒度词汇错误。
Conclusion: 摘要强调语言流畅与视觉保真这两个锚点的互补效应是性能提升的主要来源，未提及具体局限。

papers.title: Kalman Meets Curriculum: Efficient Dynamic Prompt Selection for Adaptive RL Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) finetuning significantly enhances the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet its effectiveness critically depends on selecting prompts of appropriate difficulty for the current policy. This is challenging because prompt difficulty evolves throughout training. Existing online methods therefore face a trade-off: evaluation-based approaches are accurate but expensive, while prediction-based approaches are efficient but typically assume stationary difficulty, making them ill-suited to RL's non-stationary training dynamics. To address these issues, we propose a Kalman-Guided Prompt Selection method (KGPS), which reformulates prompt selection as a dynamic state estimation problem rather than static difficulty prediction. KGPS models each prompt's latent success rate in logit space using a linear-Gaussian state-space model, with process noise coupled to the magnitude of policy updates so that uncertainty increases when the policy changes more substantially. A Kalman filter then maintains a calibrated Gaussian posterior over prompt difficulty, and prompts are selected by maximizing a posterior-expected training utility that favors intermediate-difficulty prompts while naturally revisiting uncertain ones. The resulting procedure is adaptive to policy drift and requires no additional rollouts beyond standard policy training. Extensive experiments across mathematics, planning, and geometry reasoning benchmarks, as well as multiple RL algorithms, show that KGPS consistently improves both final accuracy and rollout efficiency over strong baselines, establishing state-of-the-art performance among online prompt selection methods. For example, on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B, KGPS uses 83% fewer rollouts than DS while even improving the average performance by 0.12 point across six math reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kalman-Guided Prompt Selection (KGPS)，将 RL 微调中的 prompt 难度选择建模为动态状态估计问题，而非静态难度预测。KGPS 用线性高斯状态空间模型刻画每个 prompt 在 logit 空间中的隐式成功率，并让过程噪声与策略更新幅度耦合，再由 Kalman 滤波器维护难度的校准后验，从而偏好中等难度 prompt 并自然重访不确定样本。摘要称该方法在数学、规划与几何推理基准及多种 RL 算法上一致提升最终准确率和 rollout 效率，无需额外 rollout。
Motivation: RL 微调的效果高度依赖为当前策略选择合适难度的 prompt，但 prompt 难度在训练中持续变化。现有在线方法面临权衡：基于评估的方法准确但昂贵，基于预测的方法高效却通常假设难度平稳，难以适配 RL 的非平稳训练动态。
Method: KGPS 将 prompt 选择重构为动态状态估计问题：对每个 prompt 的 latent success rate 在 logit 空间建立线性高斯状态空间模型，过程噪声与策略更新幅度耦合；Kalman 滤波器维护校准的高斯后验，并通过最大化后验期望训练效用来选择 prompt，该效用偏向中等难度样本并自然重访不确定样本。整个过程除标准策略训练外不需要额外 rollout。
Result: 在数学、规划、几何推理基准以及多个 RL 算法上的实验显示，KGPS 在最终准确率和 rollout 效率上均一致优于强基线，达到在线 prompt 选择方法中的最优性能。例如在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B 上，KGPS 比 DS 少用 83% 的 rollout，同时六个数学推理基准的平均性能还提升 0.12 分。
Conclusion: KGPS 能自适应策略漂移，且不引入额外 rollout，摘要将其定位为在线 prompt 选择方法中的新最优。

papers.title: Revisiting the Adversarial Robustness of Graph-Based Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting by graph-based AI is a critical component of intelligent transportation systems, motivating security research on robustness to malicious sensor readings. We argue that prior robustness evaluations are largely shaped by unrealistic threat models and untargeted objectives, so both attacks and defenses must be revisited. We study a practical adversary with limited model knowledge and the ability to monitor and manipulate only a few road sensors. More importantly, practical attacks can be localized to specific links or routes, causing incorrect estimated arrival times or unnecessary rerouting while leaving the broader network largely unaffected. This targeted setting remains underexplored, and defenses such as adversarial training do not transfer well from the norm-bounded attacks they train on to structurally different, physics-aware attacks that mimic genuine congestion. We therefore reframe robustness as a detection problem, introducing a learned physics-informed detector whose output is fed to a hardened forecaster as an input feature and trained against adaptive attacks with the forecaster fixed. We evaluate across a variety of model architectures and benchmarks. The physics-aware attack multiplies target-link error several-fold while the network-wide error barely moves, and adversarial training, tuned to norm-bounded perturbations, barely dents it. Our detection--mitigation defense improves even on adversarial training hardened against the physics-aware attack itself, on $13$ of $15$ model--dataset settings and by the widest margin on a held-out attack, at near-zero clean cost. The results emphasize the need to examine abstracted AI adversarial attacks under application-specific constraints to assess their true security impacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于图的交通预测的对抗鲁棒性，认为以往评估被不现实的威胁模型和非定向目标主导，因此攻击与防御都需要重新考察。作者提出一种具有有限模型知识且只能监控和操纵少数道路传感器的实际攻击者，并聚焦于可定位到特定路段或路线的定向攻击，使估计到达时间错误或引发不必要绕行而几乎不影响整体网络。作者将鲁棒性重构为检测问题，引入学习型物理感知检测器，其输出作为加固预测器的输入特征，并在预测器固定的条件下针对自适应攻击训练。实验显示该物理感知攻击使目标链路误差成倍增长而网络整体误差几乎不变，且针对范数有界扰动的对抗训练几乎无法抵御；所提检测-缓解防御在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于针对该物理感知攻击本身进行对抗训练，并在留出攻击上优势最大，干净代价接近零。
Motivation: 现有基于图的交通预测鲁棒性评估主要依赖不现实的威胁模型和非定向目标，而实际攻击者只有有限模型知识并仅能操纵少数传感器；针对特定链路或路线的定向攻击仍未被充分探索，且对抗训练难以从范数有界攻击迁移到结构不同、模拟真实拥堵的物理感知攻击。
Method: 将鲁棒性重新定义为检测问题，提出一个学习型物理感知检测器，其输出作为加固预测器的输入特征，并在预测器固定的条件下针对自适应攻击进行训练。
Result: 物理感知攻击使目标链路误差放大数倍而网络整体误差几乎不变；针对范数有界扰动调优的对抗训练几乎无效；所提检测-缓解防御在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于针对物理感知攻击本身加固的对抗训练，并在留出攻击上取得最大优势，且干净代价接近零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要在应用特定约束下审视抽象AI对抗攻击，才能评估其真实安全影响。作者未在摘要中明确说明方法本身的局限。

papers.title: Scalable Graph Coreset Selection via Greedy Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling representative nodes from large graphs is fundamental to graph signal processing and network analysis, yet existing methods require access to the full graph Laplacian, making them impractical at scale. We propose a simple and effective column-selective graph sampling algorithm based on a minimum inner product greedy selection rule. At each iteration, the algorithm accesses only a small random subset of Laplacian columns, requiring no eigendecomposition or global graph traversal, making it well-suited for large-scale graphs where the full Laplacian cannot be stored in memory. We analyze the algorithm under the stochastic block model and show that, when the degree distribution is balanced across nodes, the algorithm achieves sampling proportional to cluster size, and that the resulting mean estimate is controlled for band-limited graph signals in the Paley-Wiener space, with the error decaying as inter-cluster connectivity weakens. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world data validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的图核心集选择方法，基于最小内积贪心规则逐列采样图拉普拉斯矩阵，每次迭代只访问少量随机列子集，无需特征分解或全局图遍历。作者在随机块模型下分析该算法，证明当节点度分布均衡时采样比例与簇大小相关，并给出带限图信号在 Paley-Wiener 空间中的均值估计误差界，误差随簇间连接减弱而衰减。合成与真实数据上的数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有代表性节点采样方法通常需要访问完整的图拉普拉斯矩阵，在大规模图场景下存储和计算开销过大，难以实用。
Method: 提出基于最小内积贪心选择规则的列选择性图采样算法；每次迭代只访问拉普拉斯矩阵的一个小随机列子集，避免特征分解和全局遍历，从而适用于无法在内存中保存完整拉普拉斯的大图。
Result: 在随机块模型下证明，当节点度分布均衡时，算法达到与簇大小成比例的采样；对 Paley-Wiener 空间中的带限图信号，均值估计误差受控，并随簇间连接减弱而衰减。数值实验在合成和真实数据上验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为大规模图提供了一种低内存、免特征分解的采样方案，并给出了采样比例与误差衰减的理论保证。

papers.title: Back from the Future: Key-Value Cache Management by Counter-Causal Surprise
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache management through compression and eviction strategies has emerged as an important research direction in recent years. Computational demands of large language models (LLMs) and their multi-modal variants during output generation can be partially alleviated by caching previous key and value calculations needed by subsequent scaled dot-product attention operations. However, this leads to another problem: the size of the resulting KV cache grows linearly with context length and quickly consumes all available GPU memory when either the prompt or the generated output are long. KV cache management periodically prunes entries from the cache thereby reducing its memory footprint while attempting to retain sufficient information for accurate generation. A by-product is faster inference speed. We propose a simple yet effective KV eviction scheme motivated by the insight that past tokens which can be well-predicted from more recent tokens are redundant and their associated keys and values can be removed from the cache. To score entries for eviction we run the model on the tokens in their original order, reusing the key and value representations already stored in the KV cache, and applying a counter-causal attention mask so that each position attends only to its future context. This is in-distribution, tied directly to the actual cache contents, and requires no additional training. To further reduce cost, we additionally propose a fast single-layer approximation that restricts the counter-causal pass to the last transformer layer, achieving a significant speedup per refresh cycle at marginal accuracy cost. We evaluate our strategy on various open-source LLMs and benchmark datasets showing competitive or improved performance over other state-of-the-art methods. Reference code is available at https://github.com/metacognitionai/counter_causal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于反因果惊讶度 (counter-causal surprise) 的 KV cache 逐出策略：如果一个过去的 token 能被更近期的 token 很好地预测，则认为其键值对是冗余的，可从缓存中移除。打分时模型按原始 token 顺序运行，复用缓存中的键值表示，并施加反因果注意力掩码使每个位置只关注未来上下文；该方法分布匹配、直接依赖真实缓存内容且无需额外训练。作者还提出仅对最后一层做反因果传递的快速单层近似，以显著加快每次刷新速度并仅带来轻微精度损失。
Motivation: LLM 及其多模态变体在输出生成时，KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长，长提示或长输出会迅速耗尽 GPU 显存，现有压缩和逐出策略需要在内存占用与生成准确性之间权衡。
Method: 提出用反因果注意力掩码对缓存中的 token 打分：让每个位置仅关注其未来上下文，若旧 token 可被新 token 高置信预测则视为冗余并逐出；同时提出单层近似方案，只对最后一个 transformer 层执行反因果传递以降低刷新开销。
Result: 在多种开源 LLM 和基准数据集上的评估显示，该方法相较其他最先进逐出策略具有竞争力或更优性能，且单层近似在较小精度代价下显著加速每次缓存刷新。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于未来上下文可预测性的逐出是一种简单有效的 KV cache 管理方式，其优势在于无需训练、与缓存内容直接相关，并提供参考代码链接。

papers.title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract_en: Building generalizable agents for diverse applications remains a fundamental challenge. While imitation learning-based policies succeed in specific training environments, they often fail to generalize to novel scenes and tasks. In this work, we propose World Action Planner, a robot planning system that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and the physical grounding of a multi-task pose-image conditioned world model. Our system enables an agent to propose initial action plans and iteratively refine them via optimization and search, reasoning over imagined world model rollouts. We demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance across compositional tasks, new layouts, and zero-shot generalization scenarios, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art end-to-end policy models such as VLAs and WAMs. Project website at worldactionplanner.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 World Action Planner，一种机器人规划系统，结合了视觉语言模型 (Vision-Language Model, VLM) 的推理能力与多任务位姿-图像条件世界模型 (pose-image conditioned world model) 的物理基础。系统先提出初始动作计划，再通过在想象的世界模型 rollout 上进行优化与搜索来迭代细化。摘要声称该方法在组合任务 (compositional tasks)、新布局和零样本泛化场景上显著优于 VLA、WAM 等端到端策略模型。
Motivation: 基于模仿学习的策略在特定训练环境中有效，但往往无法泛化到新场景和新任务，构建适用于多样化应用的通用智能体仍是一项根本性挑战。
Method: 利用 VLM 的推理能力生成初始动作计划，借助多任务位姿-图像条件世界模型提供物理支撑，并基于想象的 world model rollouts 进行优化和搜索，从而迭代地改进动作计划。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在组合任务、新布局和零样本泛化场景中取得优于现有方法的表现，明显超过 VLA 和 WAM 等最先进的端到端策略模型；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合 VLM 与世界模型 rollouts 的规划方法可以提升跨任务场景下的可泛化决策能力；摘要未提及具体限制。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 World Action Planner，一种机器人规划系统，结合了视觉语言模型 (Vision-Language Model, VLM) 的推理能力与多任务位姿-图像条件世界模型 (pose-image conditioned world model) 的物理基础。系统先提出初始动作计划，再通过在想象的世界模型 rollout 上进行优化与搜索来迭代细化。摘要声称该方法在组合任务 (compositional tasks)、新布局和零样本泛化场景上显著优于 VLA、WAM 等端到端策略模型。

papers.title: Wiring diagram extraction and gluing: a case study in classifying figure skating jumps using 3D dataset
papers.abstract_en: Hasse clustering is an algorithm that extracts common patterns in sequential data and represents them in graphical forms. As the number of expected clusters grows, however, the algorithm can become infeasible to run due to combinatorial complexity. In this article, we describe a theory of gluing wiring diagrams, allowing iterative applications of Hasse clustering to achieve the same result as a single application. We test our theory in the context of classifying videos of figure skating jumps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将接线图 (wiring diagrams) 粘合 (gluing) 的理论，使得 Hasse 聚类可以迭代应用，从而在保留单次聚类结果的同时降低因组合复杂度带来的不可行性。作者将该理论用于花样滑冰跳跃视频的分类任务。
Motivation: Hasse 聚类可以从序列数据中提取共同模式并以图形表示，但随着预期簇数量增长，算法因组合复杂度而变得不可行，需要一种分解或迭代的方式来缓解该问题。
Method: 描述接线图粘合的理论框架，使多次应用 Hasse 聚类能够产生与单次应用相同的结果，并在花样滑冰跳跃的 3D 视频数据集上进行验证。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果或具体实验数字，仅说明该理论在花样滑冰跳跃视频分类场景中进行了测试。
Conclusion: 作者认为接线图粘合使得 Hasse 聚类的迭代应用可行，并能在保持结果一致的同时应对集群规模增长带来的计算困难。

papers.title: A Systems Engineering Framework for Vision-Language-Enabled UAV Triage and Disaster Response
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision Language Models (VLMs) have created new opportunities for disaster response, where responders must interpret large volumes of sensor data under time pressure. Current VLM applications include social media monitoring for situational awareness, generation of draft action plans, and translation of technical alerts into public-facing messages. While these efforts can accelerate information flow, they remain largely limited to decision-support roles. Such approaches can increase operator burden because humans must still translate outputs into coordinated actions across teams and robotic assets. This study explores the viability of embedding VLMs as coordination agents within the human-UAV loop. The proposed architecture integrates natural language interaction, mission-level task coordination, software-in-the-loop implementation, and communication aligned with the Incident Command System (ICS). Rather than functioning solely as advisory tools, VLMs facilitate communication between human operators, mission control logic, and UAV task execution. The framework was developed using a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approach, with use case and block definition diagrams representing system roles, internal structure, and component interactions. Three key elements, the VLM Coordinator Agent, UAV Mission Control, and Task Allocator, were implemented within an integrated simulation and control environment. A preliminary human-factors evaluation with seven participants showed reduced perceived workload across mental demand, effort, and frustration, along with high ratings for AI trust and communication clarity. By integrating MBSE, software-in-the-loop testing, and human-factors evaluation, this work advances scalable human-autonomy teaming for high-stakes disaster response, with broader implications for aerospace autonomy and civil safety.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为人-UAV 回路中的协调代理用于灾害响应，而不仅限于决策支持工具。研究采用基于模型的系统工程 (MBSE) 方法设计架构，包含 VLM 协调代理、UAV 任务控制和任务分配器，并在集成仿真与控制环境中实现。初步人因评估显示七名参与者的感知工作负荷降低，且 AI 信任和沟通清晰度评分较高。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在灾害响应中的应用主要停留在决策支持层面，如社交媒体监测和草拟行动计划，人类仍需将输出转化为跨团队和机器人资产的协调行动，从而增加操作员负担。
Method: 提出一种将自然语言交互、任务级协调、软件在环实现以及与事故指挥系统 (ICS) 对齐的通信机制相结合的架构；使用 MBSE 的用例图和块定义图描述系统角色与交互，并实现 VLM 协调代理、UAV 任务控制和任务分配器三个核心组件。
Result: 摘要报告在七名参与者参与的初步人因评估中，心理需求、努力和挫败感方面的感知工作负荷降低，同时获得较高的 AI 信任与沟通清晰度评分。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合 MBSE、软件在环测试和人因评估，该方法推进了高风险灾害响应中可扩展的人-自主团队协作，并对航空航天自主性和民事安全具有更广泛意义。

papers.title: Beyond Similarity: Grounded Agentic Extraction and Expert-Adjudicated Evaluation of Intertextuality in Classical Chinese Histories
papers.abstract_en: Computational approaches to intertextuality have advanced from string matching to neural retrieval, yet their outputs, similarity scores and parallel-passage lists, identify where texts reuse one another without characterizing how or why. We recast fine-grained intertextuality extraction as an agentic task in which a large language model (LLM) reads two text units in full and, through a constrained tool interface, must ground each proposed reuse in exact character spans on both sides and label it under a five-dimension typology of reuse (form, aspect, source-marking, function, stance). We validate the approach on an exhaustive comparison of the Analects with the Book of Han, where three domain experts adjudicate a pooled multi-model candidate set into a benchmark of 2,533 intertextual pairs. Against this standard we study twelve LLMs, reporting precision (56%-93%), a 51$\times$ cost spread at comparable quality, and how well their confidence is calibrated. Expert agreement traces a reliability gradient: dimensions legible on the textual surface are annotated consistently, while those requiring inference of intent are contested, delimiting the claims such annotation supports. Scaling the validated extractor to the full Twenty-Four Histories (65,380 comparisons, 5,766 pairs) recovers corpus-level structure a similarity score cannot express. The interpretive composition of citation shows no systematic change across eighteen centuries, yet the same passage is quoted less and less literally. Stability in the aggregate with drift in the individual case is what a cultural-attraction account expects. We release the extraction protocol and the expert-adjudicated benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把古典中文史书中的互文性（intertextuality）细粒度抽取重构为代理式（agentic）任务：LLM 完整阅读两个文本单元，通过受限工具接口将每处复用锚定到两侧的精确字符片段，并按五维复用类型学（form、aspect、source-marking、function、stance）标注。作者以《论语》与《汉书》的穷尽式比对为验证场景，由三位领域专家裁决多模型候选集，形成 2,533 对互文基准；在该基准上评测了 12 个 LLM，报告精确率 56%-93%，同等质量下成本跨度 51 倍，并考察置信度校准。将验证后的抽取器扩展到二十四史（65,380 次比较、5,766 对）后，恢复了相似度分数无法表达的语料级结构。
Motivation: 现有计算方法从字符串匹配演进到神经检索，其输出（相似度分数和平行段落列表）只能指出文本在哪里相互复用，却无法刻画复用的方式与原因（how 和 why），这是计算互文性研究中的缺口。
Method: 提出 grounded agentic extraction：LLM 完整读取两个文本单元，通过受限工具接口把每个候选复用锚定在两侧的精确字符跨度上，并用五维类型学标注；采用多模型候选池加三位领域专家人工裁决的方式构建基准，再以验证过的抽取器扩展到二十四史。
Result: 在 2,533 对互文基准上，12 个 LLM 的精确率在 56%-93% 之间，达到相近质量时成本差异为 51 倍；扩展至二十四史后得到 5,766 对互文。量表显示：十八个世纪中引用的解释性构成没有系统性变化，但同一段落的引用越来越不逐字化。
Conclusion: 专家标注一致性呈现可靠性梯度：文本表面可读的维度标注稳定，而需要推断意图的维度存在争议，限定了此类标注能支撑的论断；总体稳定而个案漂移符合文化吸引（cultural attraction）解释。作者发布了抽取协议与专家裁决基准。

papers.title: Compliance2LoRA: On-Demand Safety Alignment on Arbitrary Policy Subsets via Hypernetwork-Generated LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment in large reasoning models (LRMs) has significantly improved their adaptability to diverse safety compliance settings. However, as LRMs personalization for downstream users takes center stage, the demand for varying levels of policy compliance grows as different user-specific LRMs must adhere to distinct subsets of safety policies. Training a separate LRM for each policy subset introduces severe combinatorial overhead. While in context learning methods overcome this combinatorial overhead, they introduce additional computational challenges associated with long context generation. To address this challenge, we propose \ours, a unified adaptive hypernetwork-based framework for multi-policy compliance. In our framework, safety policies serve as customizable inputs to a LoRA adapter generator, which learns to produce policy compliant LoRA weights for downstream LRM. When added to the LRM these weights enable the generation of responses compliant with the specified policy subsets. In this work, we demonstrate that training such a hypernetwork enables on-demand policy adjustments on a single LRM without sacrificing task performance across reasoning models of different sized and different evaluation datasets. This highlights the effectiveness and practicality of adaptive hypernetwork based alignment in LRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compliance2LoRA，一个基于自适应超网络 (hypernetwork) 的统一框架，用于大型推理模型 (LRM) 的多安全策略合规对齐。安全策略作为可定制输入送入 LoRA adapter 生成器，生成对应策略子集的 LoRA 权重，加到下游 LRM 后即可按需调整输出合规行为。摘要称该方法能在单一 LRM 上实现按需策略调整，且在不同规模的推理模型和不同评测数据集上不牺牲任务性能。
Motivation: 针对不同用户定制 LRM 需要服从不同安全策略子集的需求，为每个策略子集单独训练模型会产生严重的组合开销；而上下文学习方法虽避免该开销，却引入与长上下文生成相关的额外计算挑战。
Method: 提出 Compliance2LoRA 框架：将安全策略作为输入条件，训练一个统一的超网络 (hypernetwork) 来生成对应策略子集的 LoRA adapter 权重，将其注入下游 LRM 以实现策略合规。
Result: 摘要报告，训练该超网络后可在单个 LRM 上实现按需策略调整，并在不同规模的推理模型和不同评测数据集上保持任务性能不下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于自适应超网络的对齐方式在大型推理模型安全合规调整中是有效且实用的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeshFM: 2D Features Are All You Need for 3D Shape Understanding
papers.abstract_en: We present MeshFM, an efficient feedforward framework for extracting rich features from 3D inputs. Our method distills 2D features from visual foundation models into 3D. We train a feedforward network to directly predict 3D features without requiring optimization during inference. The approach utilizes a two-stage training strategy. First, we optimize a feature field in 3D using only 2D feature supervision. Second, we train a network to regress this feature field. The entire procedure requires no 3D annotation, instead relying on the powerful information in 2D foundation models. We demonstrate that our learned features can be immediately applied to downstream tasks, including part segmentation, dense correspondence, and mesh deformation. Extensive experiments show that MeshFM, trained solely with 2D supervision, performs on par with methods trained explicitly with 3D supervision, even without task-specific fine-tuning. Moreover, our model is trained to be robust to extreme rotations of the input objects. Project page: https://threedle.github.io/MeshFM/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MeshFM，一个从 3D 输入提取特征的前馈框架，将视觉基础模型的 2D 特征蒸馏到 3D 特征场。训练采用两阶段策略：先用 2D 特征监督优化 3D 特征场，再训练前馈网络直接回归该特征场，推理时无需逐样本优化。实验表明，仅用 2D 监督训练的 MeshFM 在部分分割、稠密对应和网格变形等下游任务上与 3D 监督方法表现相当，且无需任务特定微调。
Motivation: 现有 3D 特征学习方法通常依赖 3D 标注或在推理时进行优化，成本较高。作者希望利用 2D 基础模型蕴含的丰富语义信息来学习 3D 特征，从而避免对 3D 标注的依赖。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：第一阶段仅用 2D 特征监督在 3D 上优化一个特征场；第二阶段训练一个前馈网络回归该特征场。整个流程无需 3D 标注，推理时仅需一次前向传播，且模型对输入对象的极端旋转具有鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告 MeshFM 仅以 2D 监督训练，在部分分割、稠密对应和网格变形三个下游任务上达到与显式 3D 监督方法相当的性能，且无需任务特定微调。
Conclusion: 作者认为 2D 基础模型的特征足以支撑 3D 形状理解，并展示了前馈预测结合 2D 特征蒸馏可以替代昂贵的 3D 监督和推理时优化。

papers.title: Prox: Training-Free FFN Activation Sparsity via Approximate Intermediate-Channel Salience in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) dominate memory traffic and computation in large language model (LLM) inference, making them a primary target for activation sparsification. However, existing training-free methods suffer substantial model-quality degradation at high sparsity due to limitations in their channel-selection strategies. We observe that the SwiGLU intermediate state provides a highly effective channel-selection signal, but obtaining it requires costly dense computation. To address this, we present \emph{Prox}, a two-stage training-free framework for sparse SwiGLU FFNs. Prox hinges on the key insight: sparse execution requires only the channel mask induced by the intermediate state, which can be constructed from the magnitude ranking of its entries rather than their exact values. Specifically, Stage 1 uses input sparsity and quantized proxy weights to construct a shared mask; Stage 2 computes the selected channels exactly, enabling sparse execution of all three projections. Across ten LLMs from six model families, Prox outperforms training-free baselines at all sparsity levels, achieves up to a $1.99\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup at 70\% FFN sparsity, and is compatible with quantization and sparse attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prox，一种针对 SwiGLU FFN 的无需训练 (training-free) 激活稀疏化框架。其核心观察是稀疏执行只需由中间状态诱导的通道掩码，而掩码可由条目幅值排序而非精确值构造，从而避免获取中间状态所需的稠密计算。Prox 采用两阶段流程：先用输入稀疏性与量化代理权重构造共享掩码，再精确计算被选通道以稀疏执行三个投影。在六个模型家族共十个 LLM 上，Prox 在所有稀疏度下优于无训练基线，并在 70% FFN 稀疏度下取得最高 1.99 倍的端到端解码加速，且兼容量化与稀疏注意力。
Motivation: FFN 主导 LLM 推理中的内存流量和计算，是激活稀疏化的主要目标；现有无训练方法在高稀疏度下因通道选择策略受限而出现明显的模型质量下降。作者观察到 SwiGLU 中间状态是高效的通道选择信号，但获取它需要代价高昂的稠密计算，这成为无训练稀疏化的瓶颈。
Method: 提出两阶段无训练框架 Prox，基于"稀疏执行只需要中间状态诱导的通道掩码，且掩码可由条目幅值排序而非精确值构造"这一洞见。Stage 1 利用输入稀疏性和量化代理权重构造共享掩码；Stage 2 精确计算被选中的通道，从而实现对三个投影的稀疏执行。
Result: 在六个模型家族共十个 LLM 上，Prox 在所有稀疏度水平下均优于无训练基线；在 70% FFN 稀疏度下实现最高 1.99 倍的端到端解码加速，并与量化及稀疏注意力兼容。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用幅值排序近似中间通道显著性可以绕过昂贵稠密计算，从而在不训练的情况下实现高质量、高比例的 SwiGLU FFN 稀疏化，并为与量化、稀疏注意力的联合部署提供支持。

papers.title: Is Solving Better Than Evaluating GenAI Solutions?
papers.abstract_en: As Generative AI (GenAI) tools become increasingly capable of generating solutions to computing assignments, the computing education community is exploring pedagogical approaches that emphasize solution evaluation, verification, and critique alongside traditional solution generation. However, evidence regarding the impact of such evaluation-centered tasks on student learning remains limited, particularly in upper-division, theory-heavy courses. We conducted a randomized A/B crossover study (N=220) in a junior-level algorithms course to compare evaluating GenAI-generated solutions with traditional problem solving. Across six assignments, student working groups either solved challenging algorithmic problems directly or evaluated often-flawed GenAI-generated solutions, with roles reversed midway through the semester. We found no statistically significant differences between groups in midterm scores, final exam scores, overall course grades, or exam problems structurally aligned with the homework interventions. Students received significantly higher homework scores when evaluating GenAI-generated solutions, but this localized advantage did not translate into downstream summative gains. Survey data further indicated that most students reported no change in study habits in response to the intervention; however, those who reported adapting their study strategies rated the GenAI-evaluation assignments as significantly more helpful. These findings suggest that GenAI evaluation redistributes student effort from open-ended solution construction toward verification, diagnosis, and judgment, but does not automatically produce stronger conceptual transfer. We conclude that GenAI-evaluation activities can be incorporated into algorithms coursework without broad performance losses, but meaningful learning gains may require deliberate scaffolding that pushes students beyond simple error diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在一门 junior-level 算法课程中开展随机 A/B 交叉实验（N=220），对比“评估 GenAI 生成的解决方案”与传统“直接解题”两种作业形式的学习效果。结果表明两组在期中、期末、总评成绩以及与作业干预结构对齐的考试题目上均无统计显著差异；评估组在家作分数上显著更高，但这种局部优势没有转化为后续总结性成绩收益。调查显示多数学生报告学习习惯未改变，而自报调整学习策略的学生显著更认可 GenAI 评估类作业。
Motivation: GenAI 工具日益能够生成计算作业的解答，计算教育界开始探索强调评估、验证与批判的作业设计，但评估中心任务在高年级、理论密集型课程中对学生学习的影响证据仍然有限。
Method: 在一个三年级算法课程中进行随机 A/B 交叉实验：六次作业中，学生工作组要么直接解决有挑战性的算法问题，要么评估常含缺陷的 GenAI 生成解，并在学期中途互换角色；同时收集考试成绩、作业分数和问卷调查。
Result: 两组在期中、期末、总评成绩以及与家作干预结构对齐的考试题上均无统计显著差异；评估组作业分数显著更高，但该局部优势未转化为下游总结性收益。多数学生报告学习习惯无变化，而自报适应学习策略的学生显著更认为 GenAI 评估类作业有帮助。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GenAI 评估类活动可以纳入算法课程而不造成广泛的成绩损失，但更显著的学习收益可能需要刻意设计的脚手架（scaffolding），推动学生超越简单的错误诊断。

papers.title: ZMIS-SAM: Segment Anything Model Enhanced with Wavelet Transform for Zooplankton Microscopy Image Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: As primary consumers in the marine food chain, zooplankton play a crucial role in maintaining marine ecological balance. However, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) exhibits limited performance in microscopic image instance segmentation due to its lack of zooplankton-specific domain knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose a novel instance segmentation model based on SAM and wavelet transform (ZMIS-SAM), effectively tackling issues such as inaccurate classification, discontinuous segmentation of slender appendages, and incomplete boundary segmentation. Our framework incorporates three core innovations: ZM-ViT enhances SAM's capability to model zooplankton morphology and image intensity distributions through two lightweight adapters, the Neighboring Feature Aggregation Module (NFAM) improves continuous segmentation of semi-transparent slender appendages by integrating general-purpose and domain-specific features, and the Wavelet-based Multi-scale Multi-directional Feature Enhancement (WM2FE) module effectively recovers high-frequency details to refine boundary segmentation completeness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZMIS-SAM achieves state-of-the-art instance segmentation performance on the zooplankton dataset and exhibits strong generalization capability across multiple public cross-domain datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZMIS-SAM，一种基于 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 和 wavelet transform 的浮游动物显微镜图像实例分割模型，解决 SAM 因缺乏领域知识而在该任务上分类不准、细长附肢分割不连续和边界不完整的问题。模型包含三个核心模块：ZM-ViT 通过两个轻量 adapter 增强形态与灰度分布建模，NFAM 融合通用与领域特征以改善半透明细长附肢分割，WM2FE 用多尺度多方向小波特征增强恢复高频细节以细化边界。实验表明在浮游动物数据集上达到最先进实例分割性能，并在多个跨域公开数据集上展现出较强泛化能力。
Motivation: 浮游动物作为海洋食物链初级消费者对生态平衡至关重要，但 SAM 在显微镜图像实例分割中表现有限，原因是缺乏浮游动物专用领域知识，导致分类不准、附肢分割不连续和边界不完整。
Method: 提出 ZMIS-SAM 框架，包含 ZM-ViT 适配器增强形态与强度分布建模、NFAM 邻域特征聚合整合通用与领域特征以提升连续分割，以及基于小波变换的 WM2FE 模块恢复高频细节以细化边界。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在浮游动物数据集上取得最先进实例分割性能，并在多个公开跨域数据集上表现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将领域适配器与小波多尺度特征增强融入 SAM 可有效提升显微镜图像实例分割质量，并具备跨数据集泛化潜力。

papers.title: MUGEN: A Unified Framework for Efficient Motion Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Grounding human motion in language, and language in motion, is a central step toward physical AI systems that can understand, generate, and communicate human behavior. Unified motion--language systems first coupled the two directions through a shared discrete motion codebook, but quantization limits generation quality. The strongest generators buy quality back at growing cost: stacked residual codebooks enlarge the representation; masked decoding stages, long autoregressive rollouts, and denoising chains of tens to hundreds of steps stretch inference; even the continuous-latent designs among them reach their latent only through an iterative diffusion head; and none of this decoding machinery serves understanding. We therefore propose MUGEN, a unified motion--language framework that pays neither cost: no codebook, one draw. A single adaptive-length autoencoder compresses any-length motion into a few continuous latent slots, the system's only motion representation: the language model generates them for text-to-motion and reads them back for motion understanding. Depth-routed hidden states let each slot read from the transformer depth it needs, and a calibrated head predicts a joint distribution over the full latent set, so a single draw carries the text-conditional, cross-slot variation a description permits. At a decoding cost of K language-model steps, one draw, and one decoder pass, MUGEN leads language-model baselines on FID on HumanML3D while raising retrieval precision above the real-motion reference under the standard evaluator, achieves the best CIDEr and BLEU@4 scores, and surpasses the discrete-token state of the art on every retrieval and alignment metric on SnapMoGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUGEN，一个统一的运动-语言框架，采用无码本（codebook）且单次采样（one draw）的设计：单一自适应长度自编码器将任意长度运动压缩为少数连续潜在槽（continuous latent slots），语言模型既为文本到运动生成这些槽，也读取它们用于运动理解。摘要报告在 HumanML3D 上以 K 步语言模型解码、一次采样和一次解码器前向传播的代价，在 FID 上领先语言模型基线，并在标准评估器下使检索精度超过真实运动参考；在 SnapMoGen 上超越离散 token 方法的所有检索与对齐指标。
Motivation: 现有统一运动-语言系统通过共享离散运动码本耦合文本与运动，但量化限制了生成质量；更强的生成器依赖堆叠残差码本、掩码解码、自回归 rollout 或数十至数百步去噪链来弥补，且这些解码机制并不服务于理解任务，代价高昂。
Method: MUGEN 的核心是无码本、单次采样的连续潜在表示：自适应长度自编码器把任意长度运动压缩成少数潜在槽，语言模型统一负责生成与读取这些槽；深度路由隐藏状态（depth-routed hidden states）允许每个槽从所需的 transformer 深度读取信息，校准头（calibrated head）预测完整潜在集上的联合分布，使单次采样即可携带文本条件下的跨槽变异性。
Result: 解码成本仅为 K 个语言模型步骤、一次采样和一次解码器前向传播；在 HumanML3D 上 MUGEN 的 FID 领先语言模型基线，并在标准评估器下将检索精度提高到超过真实运动参考，同时取得最佳 CIDEr 和 BLEU@4；在 SnapMoGen 上超过离散 token 方法的所有检索与对齐指标。
Conclusion: 摘要表明统一的连续潜在表示配合单次采样可同时服务于生成与理解，消除码本量化和迭代解码的开销；实验验证集中在 HumanML3D 与 SnapMoGen 等运动-语言基准上。

summary_sections.method: MUGEN 的核心是无码本、单次采样的连续潜在表示：自适应长度自编码器把任意长度运动压缩成少数潜在槽，语言模型统一负责生成与读取这些槽；深度路由隐藏状态（depth-routed hidden states）允许每个槽从所需的 transformer 深度读取信息，校准头（calibrated head）预测完整潜在集上的联合分布，使单次采样即可携带文本条件下的跨槽变异性。
summary_sections.result: 解码成本仅为 K 个语言模型步骤、一次采样和一次解码器前向传播；在 HumanML3D 上 MUGEN 的 FID 领先语言模型基线，并在标准评估器下将检索精度提高到超过真实运动参考，同时取得最佳 CIDEr 和 BLEU@4；在 SnapMoGen 上超过离散 token 方法的所有检索与对齐指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明统一的连续潜在表示配合单次采样可同时服务于生成与理解，消除码本量化和迭代解码的开销；实验验证集中在 HumanML3D 与 SnapMoGen 等运动-语言基准上。

papers.title: From Minds to Models: The Intersection of Psychology and LLM Behaviours
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often compared with the human mind because their decision-making is complex, non-linear and difficult to interpret. Psychological methods developed to investigate unobservable mental processes may therefore help examine LLM behaviour, particularly in government and healthcare. Building on prompt-based adaptations of the Implicit Association Test, this study tested whether ChatGPT produced sentiment differences across racial conditions in open-ended text. Fourteen base questions were crossed with eight racial categories and a race-agnostic control, producing 126 prompts. Each was submitted once to GPT-3.5T, GPT-4 and GPT-4T, yielding 378 responses. Sentiment scores were derived from categorical labels and source scores: positive labels retained the source score, negative labels were assigned its negative, and neutral responses were coded zero. A two-way ANOVA found a small main effect of racial condition, F(8, 351) = 2.04, p = .042, partial-eta squared = .044, but no effect of model, F(2, 351) = 0.07, p = .933, and no interaction, F(16, 351) = 0.23, p = .999. However, the effect was not retained in a rank-transformed sensitivity analysis, F(8, 351) = 1.53, p = .145, and Tukey-corrected comparisons found no significant pairwise differences. An uncorrected European-Indigenous Australian comparison was significant, but was selected post hoc and is reported only as hypothesis-generating. Evidence for sentiment differences was therefore weak and analysis-dependent. Sentiment scoring also cannot distinguish evaluative bias from the valence of historical content elicited by a prompt. We outline design changes needed to address these limitations and argue for interdisciplinary development of behavioural measures of model bias. Keywords: Implicit Bias, Psychological Research Methods, Artificial Intelligence, ChatGPT, Large Language Models, Sentiment Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用心理学方法检测 LLM 的种族偏见。基于内隐联想测验的提示改编，跨种族条件生成 378 条 ChatGPT 开放文本回复，并用情绪得分和双因素 ANOVA 分析。摘要报告种族条件主效应很小且仅出现在原始分析中，秩变换敏感性分析与事后校正均不稳健，作者认为证据弱且依赖分析方法。
Motivation: LLM 的决策复杂、非线性且难以解释，常被与人类心智类比；针对不可观察心理过程的心理学方法或可帮助检查 LLM 行为，尤其在政府和医疗场景中，但目前缺少基于行为测量的稳健模型偏见评估手段。
Method: 将 14 个基础问题与八个种族类别及一个种族无关控制组交叉，生成 126 条提示；每条提示分别提交给 GPT-3.5T、GPT-4 和 GPT-4T 各一次，共 378 条回复。情绪得分由类别标签与来源分数编码：正标签保留原分数，负标签取负值，中性记为零，随后进行双因素 ANOVA 与秩变换敏感性分析。
Result: 双因素 ANOVA 显示种族条件主效应小（F(8,351)=2.04, p=.042, partial-eta squared=.044），模型主效应（F(2,351)=0.07, p=.933）和交互（F(16,351)=0.23, p=.999）均不显著；秩变换敏感性分析不显著（F(8,351)=1.53, p=.145），Tukey 校正后无显著配对差异，仅未校正的 European-Indigenous Australian 事后比较显著。
Conclusion: 摘要认为跨种族条件下 ChatGPT 情绪差异的证据弱且依赖分析方法；情绪得分无法区分评价性偏见与提示引发历史内容的效价。作者提出需要相应的设计改进，并主张通过跨学科合作发展模型偏见的行为测量方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What makes prompts a graph: necessary and sufficient conditions for prompt graph engineering
papers.abstract_en: Prompts stopped being isolated strings some time ago. In real systems, one model call feeds another, retrieval interleaves with generation, routers branch, and aggregators merge parallel results. Practice converged on a single structure to hold this together: the graph. Frameworks such as LangGraph, DSPy, and Prompt Flow expose it openly, and research systems already optimize it automatically. The vocabulary, however, lags behind. Graph names, variously, a reasoning topology inside one sampling strategy, a multi-agent conversation, or an orchestration artifact, while prompt engineering still evokes writing one good string. What is missing is a reference definition treating prompts as nodes of an explicit, executable, improvable graph. We build that definition through conceptual analysis over sources with persistent identifiers, complemented by primary grey literature. We reconstruct the genealogy of the idea, from dataflow graphs and build systems, through prompt chaining and the thought topologies (chain, tree, graph), to graphs compiled and optimized as artifacts. We then propose a constitutive definition of prompt graph engineering, state its four conditions (explicit structure, separation between structure and prompt content, executable semantics, and the graph as a first-class engineering artifact), and operationalize them as an inclusion and exclusion test. We draw the boundary against six neighboring concepts and apply the test to six real systems (LangGraph, DSPy, Prompt Flow, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Claude Code subagents); it includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized along four design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition and a shared vocabulary for a practice that industry already exercises daily without naming precisely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“提示词图工程”(prompt graph engineering)的构成性定义，主张将提示视为显式、可执行、可改进的图中的节点，而非孤立字符串。作者通过概念分析重建思想谱系（数据流图、构建系统、提示链、思维拓扑、编译优化的图），给出四个必要条件：显式结构、结构与提示内容分离、可执行语义、图作为一等工程工件，并将其操作化为包含/排除测试，应用于六个真实系统。
Motivation: 真实系统中模型调用已形成图结构（如 LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow），但领域词汇滞后，提示工程仍被理解为写单个字符串，缺乏统一的参考定义。
Method: 基于有持久标识符的文献和主要灰色文献进行概念分析，提出提示词图工程的定义和四个条件，并操作化为包含/排除测试；同时划定与六个相邻概念的边界，并对六个真实系统应用该测试。
Result: 包含/排除测试在 LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow、AutoGen、CrewAI 和 Claude Code subagents 六个真实系统上保持一致地包含和排除。
Conclusion: 贡献是提供一个操作化定义和共享词汇，并给出沿四条设计张力轴组织的研究议程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heterogeneous Ranking in Industrial-Scale Recommender Systems: A Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous recommendation feeds present complex challenges that extend beyond those found in highly homogeneous environments (e.g., music-only or video-only closed-ecosystem platforms). In Google Discover, a unified feed integrates diverse content sourced from the decentralized open web, including web articles, long-form and short-form videos, user-generated content (UGC), and beyond. Different content types exhibit distinct feature densities and user interaction patterns. Building a unified ranking model that sustains high performance across such heterogeneity, while avoiding negative transfer or majority bias, remains a significant industrial challenge. This paper presents an end-to-end case study on the industrial-scale multi-task ranking of heterogeneous feeds, grounded in real-world deployment. We introduce HA-MoE, a heterogeneity-adaptive multi-gated mixture-of-experts architecture that incorporates explicit heterogeneity context into both gating networks and expert representations. This approach enables effective specialization without significantly increasing operational overhead. To support reliable deployment, we introduce LENS, a lightweight observability framework that provides interpretable diagnostics of expert specialization and tracks this functional heterogeneity across continuous retraining. We evaluate our method using Dual-Level AUC (DL-AUC), a heterogeneity-aware evaluation metric that combines global ranking performance with cross-segment ranking correctness. Offline evaluations on a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, online A/B testing confirms gains in feed activity and exploration metrics. Together, offline and online results validate the effectiveness of our approach for managing heterogeneity in industrial-scale recommender systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是Google Discover工业级异构推荐feed排序的端到端案例研究，提出HA-MoE（heterogeneity-adaptive multi-gated mixture-of-experts）架构，将显式异构上下文注入门控网络与专家表示；同时引入LENS轻量可观测框架用于诊断专家专业化，以及DL-AUC（Dual-Level AUC）评估指标。离线大规模工业数据集显示一致改进，在线A/B测试在feed活跃度与探索指标上也获得提升。
Motivation: 异构推荐feed（如Google Discover）整合来自开放网页的多种内容类型，不同内容具有不同的特征密度和用户交互模式，统一排序模型易出现负迁移或多数偏差，这是超越同质环境（如纯音乐或纯视频平台）的工业挑战。
Method: 提出HA-MoE，一种异构自适应多门控混合专家架构，在门控网络和专家表示中都引入显式异构上下文，在不大幅增加运维开销的前提下实现专家有效专业化；配套提出LENS轻量可观测框架，为专家专业化提供可解释诊断并跟踪持续重训练中的功能异构性；评估上采用结合全局排序性能与跨段排序正确性的DL-AUC指标。
Result: 离线评估在大型工业数据集上相比基线模型表现出一致提升；在线A/B测试确认了feed活跃度和探索指标的增益。
Conclusion: 摘要总结离线与在线结果共同验证了该方法在工业级推荐系统中管理异构性的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Policy Gradient Steering: Interventions from Behavioral Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering has emerged in large language models as a lightweight alternative for dynamically changing a model's behavior at inference time. However, we show that existing steering methods fail to steer even a simple policy in a two-route gridworld environment. To address this limitation, we propose Policy Gradient Steering (PGS), which formulates steering as a reinforcement learning problem. PGS accumulates gradients of a temporary behavioral objective over a small set of rollouts or demonstrations to construct a removable task vector. We first demonstrate the calibration and reversibility of PGS in a two-route gridworld environment. Using chess puzzles, we then evaluate independently fitted PGS vectors both in isolation and in combination, finding that compatible tactical objectives accumulate constructively. Finally, in competitive football, we show that PGS can alter specific team behaviors and that its effects transfer across opponents. Together, these results show that policy gradients provide a natural interface for constructing temporary and composable behavioral adaptations across diverse decision-making domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Policy Gradient Steering (PGS)，将大语言模型中的激活引导（activation steering）形式化为强化学习问题，通过在少量 rollouts 或演示上累积临时行为目标的梯度，构造可移除的任务向量。作者在双路线网格世界中展示了 PGS 的校准性和可逆性，在国际象棋谜题中验证了兼容战术目标的独立向量可组合叠加，并在足球环境中表明 PGS 能改变特定团队行为且效果可迁移至不同对手。
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法即使在简单的双路线网格世界策略中也会失效，缺乏通用的干预机制来在推理阶段动态调整行为。
Method: 提出 PGS，把转向干预看作强化学习问题：在少量 rollouts 或演示上计算一个临时行为目标的策略梯度，并累积成可添加、可移除的任务向量，从而实现无需重新训练的行为修改。
Result: 在双路线网格世界中验证了 PGS 的校准与可逆性；在国际象棋谜题中，独立拟合的 PGS 向量既能在隔离时生效，也能以兼容方式组合累积；在足球环境中，PGS 能改变特定团队行为，且效果能跨对手迁移。
Conclusion: 策略梯度为构造临时、可组合、且跨场景迁移的行为适应提供了自然接口，适用于多种决策领域。
Relevance: 0
