papers.title: Recognition and Label-Free Adaptation Across Recording Sessions in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Recognition accuracy obtained during a recording session does not persist when a user puts on the electrodes again after the electrodes had previously been removed. The electrodes may have moved slightly, the skin may be drier or wetter, or the elbow may be positioned differently; these factors all contribute to day-to-day variability and therefore represent a major obstacle to implementing successful pattern-recognition based myoelectric control systems in daily practice. However, simply recalibrating a user's hand for 20 min at every doff/don event is a clearly unrealistic expectation. A montage-agnostic encoder built for cross-user, cross-montage transfer is trained here using data collected during a particular recording session, and then applied to data collected later in a different recording session without adjusting anything, on the ten intact subjects of NinaPro DB6. The performance of this approach is compared to that of a per-user LDA classification pipeline, and to that of two published approaches that only rely on source data collected from the same recording session. Carried unchanged across recording sessions, the encoder retains 0.688 macro-F1 against 0.540 for the per-user pipeline, and, on the per-window metric the published baselines use, sits above both published source-only results, a band of two points that locates the encoder rather than ranking it. Of five label-free test-time adaptations, only feature-statistic alignment improves every subject; batch-normalisation re-estimation, a standard method in the domain-adaptation literature, collapses this architecture entirely. Aligning the encoder's feature statistics to the new session recovers about what a single labelled calibration repetition would.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Modified Dynamic Mixed Subgrid-scale Models for Geophysical Flows: Forced Two-Dimensional and $β$-plane Turbulence
papers.abstract_en: Subgrid-scale (SGS) models for large-eddy simulations (LES) of geophysical turbulence typically need to balance dissipative regularization with backscatter, the upscale transfer of energy from unresolved to resolved scales. Dynamic mixed models (DMMs) combine functional eddy viscosity and structural closures through dynamically estimated coefficients that are least-squares optimal with respect to the Germano identity error (GIE). We show that this classical DMM least-squares estimation can be dominated by the structural component, thereby limiting the functional component's dissipative regularizing role. To address this limitation, we develop a modified Gram-based framework to construct a novel parametric family of fully-coupled, sequential, and fully-decoupled DMMs with tunable structural-functional balance. We evaluate the resulting closures using an idealized forced two-dimensional and $β$-plane turbulence framework with the Leith model and the fourth-order nonlinear gradient model. A priori results show that structurally-dominated models achieve strong agreement with the ideal SGS forcing and accurately reproduce local SGS energy exchange, including backscatter. However, in a posteriori tests, structurally dominated models exhibit noise-like artifacts with high-wavenumber spectral deviations, indicating insufficient net dissipation. In contrast, the sequential DMM in which the functional component is determined first and then corrected by the structural component retains much of the a priori structural accuracy while improving the a posteriori vorticity fields, spectra, and domain-averaged diagnostics. Spectral SGS energy and enstrophy-transfer analyses show that this sequential DMM permits backscatter at scales larger than the forcing scale with enhanced dissipation at smaller scales, thereby improving the balance between instantaneous structural fidelity and long-term accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球物理湍流大涡模拟（LES）中的亚格子（SGS）模型，提出一种基于修改的 Gram 框架来构造新的动态混合模型（DMM）参数族，以可调方式平衡结构分量与功能耗散分量的作用，并在强迫二维和 β 平面湍流框架中评估这些闭合模型。先验分析表明结构主导模型与理想 SGS 强迫高度吻合并准确再现局部 SGS 能量交换（含 backscatter），但后验测试中出现噪声样伪影和高波数谱偏差；而顺序 DMM（先确定功能分量再由结构分量修正）在保留先验结构精度的同时改善了后验涡量场、频谱和域平均诊断。
Motivation: 经典动态混合模型（DMM）的最小二乘估计可能被结构分量主导，从而限制功能分量（涡粘性）的耗散正则化作用，导致后验模拟的净耗散不足。需要一个能显式控制结构-功能平衡的框架来改进 LES 闭合模型。
Method: 基于修改的 Gram 框架构建一个参数化的新 DMM 族，包括全耦合、顺序和全解耦三种估计形式，并在理想化强迫二维与 β 平面湍流中结合 Leith 模型和四阶非线性梯度模型进行先验（a priori）与后验（a posteriori）评估。
Result: 先验结果显示结构主导模型与理想 SGS 强迫一致并能准确描述局部 SGS 能量交换和 backscatter；后验测试中结构主导模型出现高波数谱偏差的噪声样伪影。顺序 DMM 在大于强迫尺度的尺度上允许 backscatter，同时在更小尺度上增强耗散，改善了后验涡量场、频谱和域平均诊断。
Conclusion: 动态混合模型中结构分量与功能分量的平衡对 LES 的瞬时结构保真度与长期精度至关重要，顺序估计策略是兼顾两者的有效途径。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Objective-Aligned Direct Answer SFT for Robust Multi-Frame Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Multi-frame medical VQA appears to reward increasingly complex adaptation: controller-style inference, localization-aware reranking, static hard-negative mixing, and staged continuation all appear plausible from first principles. We test a simpler competing hypothesis on MedFrameQA: methods that remain tightly aligned with the benchmark's final answer objective should be the strongest \emph{robust} adaptation family once evaluation is controlled across fixed splits, matched budgets, repeated seeds, and calibration. We compare controller-based methods, scaffold evolution, static mixed supervision, continuation-heavy variants, and direct answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The strongest robust family is direct decoder-only answer SFT on MedGemma-1.5-4B. Empirically, this family yields substantial improvements in held-out report accuracy over frozen baselines while remaining remarkably stable across repeated seeds and matched controls, ensuring our claims reflect true family-level robustness rather than an isolated hyperparameter peak. Furthermore, post-hoc calibration effectively repairs confidence estimation without compromising accuracy, and the core approach transfers consistently to secondary backbones like Qwen2.5-VL-3B. The main result is therefore not that a complex auxiliary mechanism wins, but that objective-aligned direct answer SFT is the strongest robust adaptation family we found for MedFrameQA. By establishing this strong, minimalist baseline, we hope to redirect community focus toward fundamentally robust optimization rather than architectural complexity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 MedFrameQA 基准上检验一个简洁假设：与基准最终答案目标紧密对齐的适配方法，在固定划分、匹配预算、重复种子和校准控制下，是最稳健的适配族。作者对比了 controller 式方法、scaffold 演化、静态混合监督、续练变体以及直接答案监督微调 (SFT)，发现最强的稳健族是对 MedGemma-1.5-4B 进行仅解码器的直接答案 SFT。该方法在保持跨种子稳定性的同时显著提升未见报告准确率，且后验校准可修复置信度估计而不牺牲准确率，并一致迁移到 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 等次级骨干。
Motivation: 现有多帧医学 VQA 的适配倾向于增加复杂度，如 controller 式推理、定位感知重排、静态难例混合和分段续练，但这些复杂机制是否真的必要缺乏受控验证。作者希望检验更简单的替代假设：与基准最终答案目标对齐的直接适配应是最稳健的基准族，从而引导社区关注稳健优化而非架构复杂度。
Method: 在 MedFrameQA 上系统比较多个适配族，包括 controller 式方法、scaffold 演化、静态混合监督、continuation-heavy 变体和直接仅解码器答案 SFT，并采用固定划分、匹配预算、重复种子和校准进行受控评估。核心方法是对 MedGemma-1.5-4B 做 objective-aligned 的直接答案 SFT，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上验证迁移性，同时使用 post-hoc 校准修复置信度估计。
Result: 直接解码器答案 SFT 是 MedFrameQA 上最强的稳健适配族，相对冻结基线在未见报告准确率上有显著提升，且在重复种子和匹配控制下非常稳定，排除了孤立超参数峰值的可能性。post-hoc 校准在不损失准确率的前提下修复了置信度估计，核心方法也一致迁移到 Qwen2.5-VL-3B。
Conclusion: 作者强调主要结论不是复杂辅助机制取胜，而是 objective-aligned 直接答案 SFT 是 MedFrameQA 上最稳健的适配族；通过建立这一极简强基线，希望把社区关注点引向稳健优化而非架构复杂度。

papers.title: A Montage-Agnostic Encoder for Calibration-Light Cross-User Gesture Recognition from Surface Electromyography
papers.abstract_en: Pattern-recognition control promises a myoelectric prosthesis that responds to many intended gestures rather than one or two, but the promise has stayed in the laboratory. A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A montage-agnostic encoder is introduced that reads each electrode with shared weights and locates it by its physical coordinate rather than its index, so one architecture ingests any channel count without montage-specific parameters. Trained across users, it exceeds a per-user Hudgins and linear-discriminant classifier by 0.234 macro-F1 on DB1 for every held-out subject and by 0.108 on DB2, and falls below it on the ten-subject DB5. Each of the encoder's three key components individually accounts for more than half of its 3-shot macro F1 in an otherwise budget-matched ablation study. A controlled subject-count sweep shows the margin is close to flat from nine training subjects to thirty-nine, so the training pool binds only as a stability floor below which cross-user training fails to converge; what tracks the direction of the comparison across the three databases is instead the strength of the per-user baseline, which signal fidelity sets. Comparing against an LDA baseline depends on budget spent training models and on how good that baseline is, and self-supervised pretraining had no benefits once a supervised model was adequately trained.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表面肌电 (sEMG) 手势识别的跨用户迁移问题，提出一种与电极布局无关 (montage-agnostic) 的编码器：以共享权重读取每个电极，并用物理坐标而非通道索引定位电极，从而同一架构可处理任意通道数且无需针对特定电极布局的参数。跨用户训练后，该编码器在 DB1 上对每个留出受试者的 macro-F1 比逐用户 Hudgins + 线性判别分析 (LDA) 分类器高 0.234，在 DB2 上高 0.108，但在十个受试者的 DB5 上低于该基线。消融表明三个关键组件各自单独贡献了 3-shot macro-F1 的一半以上；受试者数量从 9 增至 39 时性能差距几乎不变，且自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后没有带来收益。
Motivation: 模式识别控制的肌电假肢承诺支持多种意图手势，但训练好的识别器很难从一个用户迁移到另一个用户，通常需要用户重新进行带标签的标定；这限制了其走出实验室。本文目标是实现免标定或标定成本低的跨用户手势识别。
Method: 提出 montage-agnostic 编码器：每个电极用共享权重独立读取，并以物理坐标而非通道序号定位电极，使单一架构可吸入任意通道数、无需 montage 特定参数。研究内容包括跨用户训练、与逐用户 Hudgins + LDA 基线的比较、budget-matched 消融、受试者数量扫描以及自监督预训练的效果评估。
Result: 该编码器在 DB1 上相对逐用户 Hudgins + LDA 提升 0.234 macro-F1（每个留出受试者均如此），在 DB2 上提升 0.108，但在 DB5 上低于基线。消融中三个关键组件各自单独对 3-shot macro-F1 的贡献均超过一半；训练受试者从 9 到 39 个时性能差距基本平稳，且自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后无收益。
Conclusion: 训练数据池规模只起稳定性下限作用，低于该下限跨用户训练不收敛；三个数据库上比较方向的变化由逐用户基线的强弱决定，而基线强弱由信号保真度决定。与 LDA 基线的比较结果取决于训练模型花费的预算以及基线本身的好坏；自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后没有额外好处。

summary_sections.method: 提出 montage-agnostic 编码器：每个电极用共享权重独立读取，并以物理坐标而非通道序号定位电极，使单一架构可吸入任意通道数、无需 montage 特定参数。研究内容包括跨用户训练、与逐用户 Hudgins + LDA 基线的比较、budget-matched 消融、受试者数量扫描以及自监督预训练的效果评估。
summary_sections.result: 该编码器在 DB1 上相对逐用户 Hudgins + LDA 提升 0.234 macro-F1（每个留出受试者均如此），在 DB2 上提升 0.108，但在 DB5 上低于基线。消融中三个关键组件各自单独对 3-shot macro-F1 的贡献均超过一半；训练受试者从 9 到 39 个时性能差距基本平稳，且自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后无收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 训练数据池规模只起稳定性下限作用，低于该下限跨用户训练不收敛；三个数据库上比较方向的变化由逐用户基线的强弱决定，而基线强弱由信号保真度决定。与 LDA 基线的比较结果取决于训练模型花费的预算以及基线本身的好坏；自监督预训练在监督模型充分训练后没有额外好处。

papers.title: Inference-Time Agentic Decision Rules Beat Longer Evolving Search for Multi-Image Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-image medical VQA is not merely a prompt-length problem; it is a fundamental challenge of agentic decision-making. Medical vision-language agents must aggregate evidence across ordered images, remain robust to answer-order perturbations, and avoid overfitting to noisy search-time feedback. We study MedFrameQA through a controlled comparison of five inference-time agentic strategies, optimized using the same high-budget ShinkaEvolve configuration and evaluated on a reproducible internal frozen split (1,331 evolution, 665 holdout, 855 final test). Across five independent repeated runs, the strongest method emerges as the simplest robust aggregator: the \textbf{order-vote} policy achieves $57.89 \pm 0.65\%$ final-test accuracy, significantly outperforming the fixed baseline ($52.73 \pm 0.42\%$) and the more complex, albeit brittle, order-rerank variant ($55.79 \pm 0.43\%$). Paired bootstrap analysis confirms these significant gains. Extending the evolutionary search budget from 50 to 100 generations yields no generalization benefit: while holdout performance marginally increases, final-test accuracy drops from $57.89\%$ to $56.02\%$. Our findings suggest that for multi-image medical reasoning, defining the correct agentic decision rule is substantially more impactful than expanding the optimization search budget.
papers.comment: Presented at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Multi-Modal Reasoning for Agentic Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多图像医学 VQA 中的推理时智能体决策规则，在 MedFrameQA 上以相同的 ShinkaEvolve 高预算配置对比五种推理时策略。结果表明最简单稳健的 order-vote 聚合策略在最终测试上达到 57.89±0.65% 准确率，显著优于固定基线（52.73±0.42%）和更复杂的 order-rerank 变体（55.79±0.43%）；将进化搜索预算从 50 代扩到 100 代反而导致最终测试准确率从 57.89% 降至 56.02%。作者据此认为，定义正确的智能体决策规则比扩大搜索预算更重要。
Motivation: 多图像医学 VQA 不仅是提示长度问题，更是智能体决策问题：模型需要跨有序图像聚合证据、对答案顺序扰动保持稳健，并避免过拟合搜索阶段的有噪声反馈。
Method: 在固定数据划分（1,331 进化集、665 保留集、855 最终测试集）上，使用相同高预算 ShinkaEvolve 配置，对五种推理时智能体策略进行受控比较，包括固定基线、order-rerank 与 order-vote 等稳健聚合策略，并用配对 bootstrap 分析显著性。
Result: 五次独立重复实验中，order-vote 策略达到 57.89±0.65% 的最终测试准确率，显著超过固定基线 52.73±0.42% 和 order-rerank 变体 55.79±0.43%；将进化搜索代数从 50 增至 100 时保留集性能略升，但最终测试准确率从 57.89% 下降到 56.02%。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：对多图像医学推理而言，选择正确的推理时智能体决策规则比扩展优化搜索预算更能带来泛化收益，并强调复杂变体可能更脆弱。

papers.title: Strategies for Milestone-driven Start-ups in Multi-activity Settings
papers.abstract_en: New venture start-ups need to ``survive'' through multiple stages of reaching milestone targets. We investigate the strategies for start-ups in a milestone-oriented setting. We examine a model of an entrepreneurial start-up firm, where its state is captured by a diffusion process. The entrepreneur can choose between multiple activities (or controls), which incur different cost and determine the drift and the variance of the process. Depending on whether the process reaches a fixed upper boundary or a lower one, the start-up firm succeeds or fails. Continuous-time stochastic models with multiple ($\ge 3$) controls are typically very challenging to deal with. In this work, we are able to completely solve for the optimal policy and provide an explicit characterization of its structure. In particular, the optimal policy only uses controls from a set characterized by a so-called efficient frontier curve that orders the controls by two intuitive measures: riskiness (drift-to-volatility ratio) and cost-effectiveness (drift-to-cost ratio). A unique feature of our model is that depending on the model parameters, the efficient frontier curves can be of different types, resulting in qualitatively different structures of the optimal policy. As far as we know, this is the first study that analyzes a stochastic control model which admits efficient frontier curves of different types. Our work provides start-up firms with intuitive measures to evaluate their activities and offers valuable insights on how the optimal strategies in a milestone-oriented setting change qualitatively contingent upon the specific scenario. We believe the results provide a foundational block in the study of entrepreneurial decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多活动环境下以里程碑为驱动的创业公司最优策略。作者将公司状态建模为扩散过程，创业者可在多个活动中选择，这些活动影响过程的漂移和方差，并决定过程到达上边界（成功）或下边界（失败）。该文完全求解了最优策略，并给出其结构的显式刻画：最优策略仅使用由有效前沿曲线（efficient frontier curve）按风险性（漂移-波动比）和成本效益（漂移-成本比）排序的控制集合。据作者所述，这是首个分析允许不同类型有效前沿曲线的随机控制模型的工作。
Motivation: 创业公司需要在多个阶段达到里程碑目标以求生存；含多个（≥3）控制的连续时间随机模型通常非常棘手，现有研究缺乏对最优策略结构的完整刻画。
Method: 采用连续时间随机控制模型，公司状态由扩散过程描述；创业者可在多个活动（控制）中选择，这些控制具有不同成本并决定过程的漂移与方差，设定上下边界分别对应成功与失败；通过有效前沿曲线对控制排序，并给出最优策略的显式刻画。
Result: 摘要宣称完全求解了最优策略并显式刻画其结构；最优策略只用有效前沿曲线定义的控制集合；根据模型参数不同，有效前沿曲线可呈现不同类型，进而导致最优策略产生不同的定性结构。
Conclusion: 该工作为创业公司提供评估活动的直观指标（风险性和成本效益），并揭示里程碑驱动场景下最优策略如何随具体情景发生定性变化；作者认为结果为创业决策研究提供了基础性模块。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepResearch Agent System
papers.abstract_en: The DeepResearch Agent System is a large language model system engineered for deep information retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and autonomous research tasks. Built upon a sparse activation architecture with 30 billion total parameters of which only 3 billion are activated per token, the system achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple agent search benchmarks while delivering 3.2 times faster inference compared to dense counterparts of equivalent scale. The system supports a 128K-token context window with hierarchical attention mechanisms that yield 18.7% accuracy and 23.4% recall improvements over standard long-context approaches. A dual-mode reasoning engine provides both a ReAct paradigm for basic multi-step problem solving and an IterResearch mode for high-performance iterative research with up to 20 reasoning steps, collectively delivering a 31.2% accuracy improvement over single-pass baselines. Multi-tool coordination integrates retrieval, computation, web search, and file parsing modules to achieve 92.1% tool-use accuracy. A reinforcement learning optimization framework based on the GRPO algorithm provides token-level policy gradients that improve training stability by 35% and accelerate convergence by 42%. An automated data synthesis pipeline with seed-based expansion achieves a 92.5% usability rate. Benchmark results include 87.3% on Humanity's Last Exam, 85.3% on BrowserComp Chinese, and 91.2% on WebWalkerQA. The system is fully open-sourced, including data synthesis, training, and inference code, and supports applications in academic research, business analysis, R&D support, and education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DeepResearch Agent System，一个面向深度信息检索、多步推理与自主研究任务的稀疏激活大语言模型系统。系统总参数 300 亿、每 token 仅激活 30 亿参数，相比同规模稠密模型推理快 3.2 倍；支持 128K token 上下文与分层注意力，并配备 ReAct 与 IterResearch 双模式推理引擎。摘要在 Humanity's Last Exam、BrowserComp Chinese、WebWalkerQA 上分别报告 87.3%、85.3%、91.2% 的成绩，且系统已完全开源，包括数据合成、训练与推理代码。
Motivation: 该工作面向深度信息检索与自主研究任务，目标是构建兼具长上下文处理、多步推理和多工具协同的 agent 系统；与标准长上下文方法和单次推理基线相比，现有方案在准确率与推理效率上仍有不足。
Method: 系统采用稀疏激活架构，每 token 只激活 30 亿参数；用分层注意力机制支持 128K token 上下文；推理引擎包含 ReAct 模式与最多 20 步的 IterResearch 模式；集成检索、计算、网页搜索、文件解析等工具模块；以 GRPO 强化学习框架进行 token 级策略梯度优化；并用基于种子扩展的自动化数据合成管线生成训练数据。
Result: 摘要报告相对同规模稠密模型推理速度提升 3.2 倍；分层注意力带来 18.7% 准确率和 23.4% 召回率提升；双模式推理相对单次基线提升 31.2% 准确率；工具使用准确率为 92.1%；GRPO 使训练稳定性提升 35%、收敛加速 42%；数据合成可用率为 92.5%。基准成绩包括 Humanity's Last Exam 87.3%、BrowserComp Chinese 85.3%、WebWalkerQA 91.2%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该系统可应用于学术研究、商业分析、研发支持和教育等场景，并已完全开源数据合成、训练与推理代码；摘要未明确讨论该方法的局限或失败案例。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Drawing-Recode: Annotation Grounding for Parametric CAD Code Generation from Raster 2D CAD Drawings
papers.abstract_en: Recovering Parametric CAD sequences from raster-format 2D Computer-Aided Design (CAD) drawings accumulated prior to digital transformation is important for part reproduction and manufacturing process automation. However, existing studies either process only vector drawings or are limited to specific domains, and fail to explicitly connect dimensional annotations to geometric information, limiting their use of dimensional information for 3D Parametric CAD sequences recovery. We propose Drawing-Recode, a framework that generates Parametric CAD sequences as CAD code from raster 2D CAD drawings. Drawing-Recode extracts geometric features via an image encoder and recognizes annotations through a separate text recognition module, then explicitly grounds annotations to geometric information using cross-attention and our proposed Annotation Grounding Loss (AGL). The resulting features are fed into a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate CAD code in the Structured Parametric CAD Code (SPCC) format. Experiments show that Drawing-Recode outperforms existing baselines and remains robust on scanned drawings resembling industrial conditions. We expect Drawing-Recode contributes to digitizing raster 2D CAD drawings in industrial settings and to part reproduction and manufacturing automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drawing-Recode，一个从栅格 2D CAD 图纸生成参数化 CAD 代码的框架。它通过图像编码器提取几何特征、独立文本识别模块识别尺寸标注，并用交叉注意力与提出的 Annotation Grounding Loss (AGL) 将标注显式对接到几何信息，再由大语言模型生成 SPCC 格式的 CAD 代码。实验表明该方法优于现有基线，并对接近工业条件的扫描图纸保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 数字化转型前积累的大量栅格 2D CAD 图纸难以直接用于零件复制与制造自动化；现有研究主要处理矢量图纸或局限于特定领域，且未能将尺寸标注与几何信息显式关联，限制了维度信息在参数化 CAD 序列恢复中的利用。
Method: 提出 Drawing-Recode 框架：图像编码器提取几何特征，独立文本识别模块识别标注，通过交叉注意力与提出的 Annotation Grounding Loss (AGL) 将标注显式绑定到几何信息，最终将融合特征输入大语言模型 (LLM) 生成 Structured Parametric CAD Code (SPCC) 格式的 CAD 代码。
Result: 实验表明 Drawing-Recode 在参数化 CAD 代码生成任务上优于现有基线，并在模拟工业条件的扫描图纸上表现鲁棒。
Conclusion: 作者期望该方法能推动工业场景中栅格 2D CAD 图纸的数字化，并支持零件复制与制造自动化。

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly plan, execute, and interpret biological analyses, yet fluent responses, successful tool calls, and benchmark performance alone do not establish scientific credibility. Existing reviews primarily organize biological agents by application, architecture, and agentic capability, but do not jointly operationalize the accountability of agent-generated workflows. We address this gap by treating the inspectable workflow trajectory, rather than architecture or final output alone, as the primary unit of analysis. We introduce the Function--Evidence--Validation (FEV) framework, which separates demonstrated workflow operations, traceable support for actions and claims, and use-case-specific validation. Using FEV, we map 109 agentic or agent-adjacent systems and 28 benchmark or evaluation resources, representing 128 unique publications across genomics, single-cell and spatial omics, protein science, drug discovery, computational pathology, and general bioinformatics automation. Across domains, planning and tool-mediated execution have advanced more rapidly than replayability, provenance, robust scientific assessment, external validation, and prospective empirical testing. We therefore argue that agentic bioinformatics should be assessed through workflow correctness rather than final-answer correctness alone. FEV provides a practical basis for comparing systems and designing transparent, auditable, and scientifically accountable bioinformatics workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Function–Evidence–Validation (FEV) 框架，以可审查的工作流轨迹（而非架构或最终输出）作为主要分析单元，用于评估大语言模型智能体在生物信息学中的科学可信度。作者用 FEV 系统梳理了 109 个智能体或类智能体系统及 28 个基准/评估资源，覆盖 128 篇出版物，涉及基因组学、单细胞与空间组学、蛋白质科学、药物发现、计算病理学等方向。分析显示规划与工具介导执行进展较快，而可回放性、溯源、稳健科学评估、外部验证和前瞻性实证测试相对滞后。
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地参与生物学分析的规划、执行与解读，但流畅回答、成功工具调用和基准性能不足以确立科学可信度。现有综述多按应用、架构和智能体能力组织，未能共同操作化智能体生成工作流的可问责性。
Method: 引入 FEV 框架，将工作流轨迹作为主要分析单元，分别考察可演示的工作流操作（Function）、支持行动与主张的可追溯证据（Evidence）以及针对特定用例的验证（Validation），并用该框架对大量系统与基准资源进行映射分析。
Result: 对 109 个智能体/类智能体系统和 28 个基准或评估资源的分析表明，跨域来看，规划与工具介导执行的发展快于可回放性、溯源、稳健科学评估、外部验证和前瞻性实证测试。
Conclusion: 作者主张智能体生物信息学应以工作流正确性而非仅最终答案正确性进行评估，FEV 为比较系统及设计透明、可审计、科学可问责的生物信息学工作流提供了实用基础。

papers.title: Using Large Language Models for Idea Generation in Innovation
papers.abstract_en: This research evaluates the efficacy of large language models (LLMs) in generating new product ideas. To do so, we compare three pools of ideas for new products targeted toward college students and priced at 50 dollars or less. The first pool of ideas was created by university students in a product design course before the availability of LLMs. The second and third pools of ideas were generated by GPT-4 from OpenAI using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, respectively. We evaluated idea quality using standard market research techniques to predict average purchase intent probability. We used text mining to assess idea similarity and human raters to evaluate idea novelty. We find that AI-generated ideas outperform human-generated ideas in terms of average purchase intent, with few-shot prompting yielding slightly higher intent than zero-shot prompting. However, AI-generated ideas are perceived as less novel and exhibit higher pairwise similarity, particularly with few-shot prompting, indicating a less diverse solution landscape. When focusing on the quality of the best ideas rather than the average ideas, we find that AI-generated ideas are seven times more likely to rank among the top 10 percent of ideas, demonstrating a significant advantage over human-generated ideas. We propose that this seven-to-one advantage is a conservative estimate because it does not account for the greater productivity of AI. Our findings suggest that despite some drawbacks, AI creativity presents a substantial benefit in generating high-quality ideas for new product development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 在创新产品创意生成中的效果，比较了大学生、GPT-4零样本提示和少样本提示生成的三组面向大学生且定价50美元以下的新产品创意。结果显示AI生成的平均购买意图更高，但感知新颖性更低且创意间相似度更高；然而，AI创意进入前10%高质量创意的可能性是人类创意的七倍。
Motivation: 产品设计中的创意生成是创新流程的关键环节，而LLM能否在这一任务中超越人类创造力尚缺乏系统性的市场研究方法评估。
Method: 将大学产品设计课程学生生成的创意与GPT-4在零样本和少样本提示下生成的创意进行对比，使用标准市场研究技术预测平均购买意图概率，通过文本挖掘评估创意相似性，并由人类评分者评价新颖性。
Result: AI生成创意的平均购买意图高于人类创意，少样本提示略优于零样本；但AI创意被认为新颖性较低，且成对相似度更高，少样本提示下尤其明显。在最佳创意质量上，AI创意进入前10%的可能性是人类创意的七倍，作者认为因未计入AI更高生产力，此估计偏保守。
Conclusion: 尽管存在多样性和新颖性方面的缺陷，LLM在高品质新产品创意的生成方面仍具有显著优势，对新产品开发有实质价值。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in large-scale imitation learning for robot manipulation has been driven by leveraging datasets across a wide range of robot embodiments. However, achieving significant cross-embodiment transfer is often still challenging. In this work, we study the role of using behavior-aligned representations (e.g., object bounding boxes, language motions, end-effector traces of robot motion) in vision-language-action (VLA) models to promote cross-embodiment transfer. We hypothesize that by possessing invariances across embodiments while being predictive of robot actions, these representations can help unify large-scale cross-embodiment data to enhance transfer. To assess our hypothesis, we develop a simulation-based benchmark designed to assess transfer with diverse cross-embodiment data to new embodiments. Using this benchmark, we compare different representations and ways of incorporating them. We identify that end-effector traces can be particularly beneficial for transfer, representations are generally more useful with larger prior datasets, and can be used to benefit from action-free data. We also demonstrate that they can enhance sim-to-real cross-embodiment transfer, improving task completion progress of real robot policies pre-trained on simulation data by 28%. We provide videos of our evaluations at our website: https://ajaysridhar.com/barx/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模机器人操作模仿学习中的跨本体迁移（cross-embodiment transfer），提出在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中使用行为对齐表征（如物体边界框、语言运动、末端执行器轨迹）来统一不同机器人本体的数据。基于仿真 benchmark，作者发现末端执行器轨迹对迁移特别有效，表征在更大先验数据集下更有用，并能利用无动作数据；此外可将仿真数据预训练的机器人策略的 sim-to-real 跨本体任务完成进度提升 28%。
Motivation: 尽管大规模跨本体数据集推动机器人操作模仿学习，但实现显著的跨本体迁移仍具挑战；作者假设对动作有预测性且对本体差异具有不变性的行为对齐表征能帮助统一大规模跨本体数据，从而增强迁移。
Method: 提出在 VLA 模型中以行为对齐表征（如 object bounding boxes、language motions、end-effector traces）作为输入或条件信号，并构建用于评估跨本体迁移的仿真 benchmark，比较不同表征及其引入方式。
Result: 摘要报告末端执行器轨迹（end-effector traces）对迁移特别有益；表征在更大先验数据集下通常更有用，并可用于行为无关数据；在仿真数据预训练的真实机器人策略上，跨本体 sim-to-real 迁移的任务完成进度提升 28%。
Conclusion: 作者认为行为对齐表征能够促进跨本体与 sim-to-real 迁移，其中端末执行器轨迹尤为有效；该结论主要基于仿真 benchmark 和特定表征设计，结论的适用范围仍需在更多本体与真实场景中进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Literacy: An Exercise in Power-Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: As generative artificial intelligence becomes one of the most significant systems of knowledge production in our society today, questions relating to who can access and shape that production grow increasingly important in our discourse. This paper argues that the existing frameworks for AI literacy, which are dominated by technical competency and responsible-use principles, are insufficient because they enforce a "consumer" orientation toward AI rather than fostering genuine epistemic agency. Based upon Foucault's concept of power-knowledge, Freire's pedagogy of critical consciousness, and scholarship of digital literacy, this paper proposes a reconceptualization of AI literacy as a critical practice that equips individuals not just to use AI systems, but to critically evaluate them, resist their structuring assumptions, and participate in their governance. The paper further argues that unequal access to AI tools in society recapitulates longstanding epistemic injustices, and that a literacy framework oriented toward empowerment must account for these structural inequities. A three-part framework of AI literacy based on the notions of contextual use, critical interrogation, and participatory governance frames this literacy as a cultivation of epistemic "agents" rather than the training of competent consumers of AI-generated information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从批判理论视角重新定义 AI 素养 (AI literacy)，认为现有以技术能力和负责任使用为主导的素养框架强制用户扮演‘消费者’角色，阻碍真正的认识论能动性 (epistemic agency)。作者借鉴 Foucault 的权力-知识 (power-knowledge)、Freire 的批判意识教育学以及数字素养研究，提出将 AI 素养重构为一种批判实践，并给出由情境使用 (contextual use)、批判性审问 (critical interrogation) 与参与式治理 (participatory governance) 构成的三部分框架。摘要未提供实证结果，属于理论性论述。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 已成为社会重要的知识生产系统，但现有 AI 素养框架由技术能力和负责任使用原则主导，强化了对 AI 的‘消费者’取向，未能培养真正的认识论能动性；同时 AI 工具的不平等获取延续了长期存在的认识论不公正 (epistemic injustice)。
Method: 基于 Foucault 的权力-知识概念和 Freire 的批判意识教育学，结合数字素养研究，将 AI 素养重新概念化为批判实践；提出以情境使用、批判性审问和参与式治理为核心的三部分框架，目标是培养认识论‘行动者’(agents) 而非 AI 生成信息的合格消费者。
Result: 该论文为理论论证，摘要未报告实验数据或量化结果；其核心产出是上述三部分 AI 素养框架和相应的概念重构。
Conclusion: 作者主张指向赋权的素养框架必须考虑结构性不平等，AI 素养应使个体不仅使用 AI 系统，还能批判性评估、抵制其结构假设并参与其治理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Memory Efficient Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Foundation Models, such as TabPFN, have received a large amount of recent attention due to their performance on in-context tabular machine learning tasks, which often exceeds classical baselines. However, practical deployment considerations of these models has received less attention. In this paper we investigate the memory requirements for these models. We demonstrate that employing model compression approaches can enable memory reductions of up to 7.6 with similar levels of performance, reducing deployment requirements by nearly 87%. Our work provides insight to practitioners seeking efficient deployment of these models in practical settings.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures Accepted at FMSD @ ICML 2026
papers.journal_ref: FMSD @ ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注表格基础模型（如 TabPFN）在实际部署中的内存需求问题，研究模型压缩方法能否在不显著损失性能的前提下降低内存占用。摘要报告压缩可将内存需求减少最高 7.6 倍，部署需求降低近 87%，同时保持相近的性能水平。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在上下文表格机器学习任务上表现优异，但实际部署中的内存需求较少被研究，这限制了其在资源受限场景中的实用化。
Method: 采用模型压缩方法（具体压缩技术未在摘要中说明）对表格基础模型进行压缩，并评估压缩后的性能与内存需求。
Result: 摘要报告内存需求最高可降低 7.6 倍，部署需求减少近 87%，且性能与原始模型相近。

papers.title: Subtract or Replay? Exact Deletion from Language-Model Memory
papers.abstract_en: Exact deletion from persistent language-model memory depends on how that memory represents a record. Addressable influence can be removed by algebraic decrement; influence transformed by later writes inside shared recurrent state requires rebuilding from before the write. We test this distinction in two pretrained models against explicit record-omitted references. First, we replace Gemma 3's global-attention layers with support-vector memory. After low-rank recovery at 1B, decrement and retained-key refit agree at the next-token output to median KL $5.4\times10^{-15}$ over 31 support-token deletions, with $+2.0\%$ perplexity relative to a matched fine-tune. A masked-refit proxy is indistinguishable from the never-ingested floor under elicitation, relearning, sampling, and LiRA attacks. At 4B and 12B, certificate ordering persists but utility cost rises to $11.2\%$ and $44.3\%$. Second, in a 48B Kimi Linear hybrid, additive writes admit a fixed decrement and diagonal decay a corrected one, whereas the delta rule makes $12$--$49\%$ of a record's contribution suffix-dependent. Checkpointed rewind-and-replay deletes real clinical records at contexts up to 18,842 tokens, matching never-ingested logits and all recurrent states bit for bit within a deterministic MLX implementation; replaying a correction provides exact amendment. Exact deletion is therefore a property of memory representation: subtract addressable records and replay entangled writes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从已训练语言模型持久记忆中进行精确删除（exact deletion）的问题，核心论点是删除取决于记忆的表征方式：可寻址的影响可通过代数递减（decrement）移除，而共享循环状态中被后续写入变换的影响则需要从写入前状态重建。作者在 Gemma 3 与 Kimi Linear 混合模型上验证了这一区分，并用确定性 MLX 实现证明回退-重放（rewind-and-replay）可在最长 18,842 token 的上下文中逐位匹配从未摄入的 logits 与循环状态。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究较少区分“可寻址记忆”与“被后续写入纠缠的记忆”，导致精确删除缺乏统一框架；作者希望表明删除能力本质上是记忆表征的属性，而不是单纯的训练或推理技巧。
Method: 方法分两部分：其一，将 Gemma 3 的全局注意力层替换为支持向量记忆（support-vector memory），在 1B 低秩恢复后比较递减（decrement）与保留键重拟合（retained-key refit）；其二，在 48B Kimi Linear 混合模型中分析加性写入、对角衰减与 delta rule 各自支持何种删除，并提出检查点回退-重放（checkpointed rewind-and-replay）实现精确修正。
Result: 1B 模型上递减与重拟合在 31 个支持 token 删除上的下一 token 输出中位 KL 为 5.4e-15，困惑度相对匹配微调高出 2.0%；4B 与 12B 下证书排序保持但效用成本升至 11.2% 与 44.3%。Kimi Linear 中 delta rule 使记录贡献的 12–49% 依赖后缀，而回退-重放在最长 18,842 token 的真实临床记录删除上逐位匹配从未摄入的 logits 与循环状态。
Conclusion: 精确删除是记忆表征的属性：可寻址记录用减法删除，纠缠写入用重放删除；作者强调在确定性实现下删除与修正可逐位验证。

papers.title: ProgFormer: Hierarchical Voxel Diffusion Transformer for Longitudinal Brain MRI Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting future structural MRI of a brain is challenging because longitudinal changes are often subtle and confined to specific anatomical regions, while most subject-specific brain structure remains stable over time. An effective model should therefore preserve global brain structural consistency while remaining sensitive to fine-grained disease progression. Existing latent-space-based methods improve computational efficiency, but suffer from information loss during their compression-reconstruction procedure. In contrast, direct voxel-space methods avoid latent reconstruction but commonly use a unified prediction pathway to model brain structure and progression-related changes. Subtle local changes may therefore be overshadowed by the dominant stable brain structure. To address these challenges, we propose ProgFormer, a hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer for longitudinal brain MRI prediction. ProgFormer uses a coarse pathway to perform the primary volumetric prediction from 3D patch tokens. This pathway models overall brain structure and longitudinal context. The fine pathway then uses the coarse representations as spatio-temporal grounding for voxel-level refinement within individual patches. The two pathways jointly estimate a velocity field directly in voxel space through conditional flow matching, enabling end-to-end prediction without a separately learned image autoencoder. The predicted future scan is then generated from Gaussian noise by integrating the estimated velocity field over a sequence of Euler steps. Extensive experimental results on three widely used benchmarks, ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS, under both pairwise and trajectory settings demonstrate favourable performance compared against several state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProgFormer，一种分层体素空间 Diffusion Transformer，用于纵向脑 MRI 预测。它通过粗路径从 3D patch tokens 生成整体体积预测，再利用细路径以粗表示为时空基础进行逐 patch 的体素级精化，两条路径联合在体素空间通过条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 估计速度场，并沿 Euler 步积分从高斯噪声生成未来扫描，无需单独学习的图像自编码器。在 ADNI、AIBL、OASIS 三个基准上的成对与轨迹设置下，摘要报告其性能优于若干现有方法。
Motivation: 纵向脑 MRI 中的变化通常微妙且局限于特定解剖区域，而大部分结构保持稳定，模型需兼顾全局结构一致性与细粒度疾病进展的敏感性。现有潜空间方法在压缩-重建中存在信息损失，直接体素空间方法则常用统一预测路径，导致微小的局部变化容易被主导的稳定结构掩盖。
Method: 提出分层的体素空间 Diffusion Transformer：粗路径从 3D patch tokens 进行主要体积预测，建模整体脑结构与纵向上下文；细路径使用粗表示作为时空 grounding，在单个 patch 内执行体素级精化。两条路径通过条件流匹配在体素空间联合估计速度场，无需单独学习的图像自编码器，即可端到端地从高斯噪声经 Euler 积分生成预测扫描。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 ADNI、AIBL 和 OASIS 三个常用基准上，于成对 (pairwise) 与轨迹 (trajectory) 两种设置下均取得优于若干 state-of-the-art 方法的表现，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 分层粗-细双路径设计能够在保持整体脑结构一致性的同时捕捉细粒度的进展变化，并规避潜在空间压缩带来的信息损失；其适用范围为纵向脑 MRI 预测任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Strategy, Not Payoffs: A Behavioural Embedding of Normal-Form Games
papers.abstract_en: Learning a strategic task changes more than what is directly taught: fine-tuning on one game can either enhance or degrade an agent's ability to reason in another. Understanding and predicting this transfer of strategic capabilities, however, remains a key challenge for large language models (LLMs). Normal-form games provide an ideal testbed for analyzing this phenomenon, as they feature explicitly defined payoffs and well-characterized equilibrium behaviours. In this work, we investigate whether game embeddings can explain and predict changes in LLM strategic capabilities following fine-tuning across different games. We propose a lightweight two-feature embedding that captures fundamental behavioural demands: the entropy of the Nash equilibrium and the sensitivity of optimal responses to an opponent's action. We show that while existing published structural embeddings primarily memorize game identities and fail to generalize, our behavioural embedding reliably predicts performance changes on held-out games. These results demonstrate that the transfer of strategic capabilities in LLMs is not dictated by the payoff geometry of a game, but by the underlying structure of the decision-making behaviour it requires.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在多个规范式博弈（normal-form games）上微调之后战略能力的迁移现象。作者提出一种轻量两特征行为嵌入（behavioral embedding），用纳什均衡的熵和最优应对对对手动作的敏感性来刻画博弈的行为需求，并显示该嵌入能在未参与训练的博弈上预测微调带来的能力变化，而现有结构嵌入主要记忆博弈身份、无法泛化。
Motivation: 理解并预测 LLM 战略能力在不同博弈之间的迁移仍是关键难题；规范式博弈因具有显式收益和刻画良好的均衡行为，成为分析该现象的合适测试平台。
Method: 提出轻量两特征嵌入，特征分别为纳什均衡的熵（entropy of the Nash equilibrium）与最优应对对对手动作的敏感性（sensitivity of optimal responses to an opponent's action），并用该嵌入解释和预测跨博弈微调后的能力变化。
Result: 摘要报告，现有已发表的结构嵌入主要记忆博弈身份并难以泛化，而所提行为嵌入能可靠预测在保留博弈（held-out games）上的性能变化。
Conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 战略能力的迁移不由博弈的收益几何（payoff geometry）决定，而是由所需决策行为结构决定。

papers.title: Can Deep Generative Models Reproduce Non-Stationary Gaussian Random Fields?
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models (DGMs) are widely used for complex high-dimensional data and increasingly applied to spatial and spatio-temporal modeling. Their generated samples implicitly represent the learned data distribution and associated uncertainty. However, for real-world data, assessing whether DGMs have learned the underlying process is difficult because the ground truth is unknown and evaluation often relies on observations alone. We evaluate representative DGMs, flow matching (FM), DDPM, score-SDE, and VAE, on a known non-stationary Gaussian random field. This paper provides comprehensive metrics to assess recovery of the ground-truth mean and covariance structures, with oracle samples and a stationary control as references. All four models recover the mean surface, while their covariance recovery differs across model families: DDPM and score-SDE recover the covariance structure reasonably well, FM exhibits mildly attenuated non-stationarity and slight variance under-dispersion, and VAE has difficulty recovering the covariance structure. An experiment on ERA5 temperature anomalies further demonstrates how the framework can support the validation and development of DGMs for complex real-world spatio-temporal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在已知的非平稳高斯随机场（non-stationary Gaussian random field）上系统评估四类深度生成模型：flow matching (FM)、DDPM、score-SDE 和 VAE，并以 oracle 样本和平稳对照作为参考，提出综合指标来衡量模型对真实均值与协方差结构的恢复程度。摘要报告所有模型都能恢复均值面，但协方差恢复因模型而异：DDPM 和 score-SDE 恢复得较好，FM 呈现轻微削弱的非平稳性和方差欠分散，VAE 则难以恢复协方差结构。ERA5 温度异常实验进一步展示了该框架可用于复杂真实时空数据的 DGM 验证与开发。
Motivation: 真实时空数据中地面真值未知，仅凭观测难以判断深度生成模型是否学到了潜在过程，因此需要已知地面真值的基准设置和系统化评估指标来检验模型对分布与不确定性的学习。
Method: 在已知的非平稳高斯随机场上训练并比较 FM、DDPM、score-SDE 和 VAE，提出全面度量来评估真实均值与协方差结构的恢复，并使用 oracle 样本和平稳随机场作为参考基准。
Result: 所有四种模型均能恢复均值面；DDPM 和 score-SDE 的协方差结构恢复较合理，FM 的非平稳性被轻微削弱且方差略欠分散，VAE 难以恢复协方差结构。ERA5 温度异常实验表明该框架可用于真实时空数据的模型验证。
Conclusion: 该框架为验证和开发面向复杂真实时空数据的深度生成模型提供了参考，摘要强调其在实际数据上的示范作用。

papers.title: Nudging Sustainable Choices through LLM-Generated Recommendation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems mediate everyday consumption, offering a promising channel for encouraging sustainable choices. Prior research shows that explanations influence users' perceptions of recommendations and can support more informed decisions. We argue that explanations can also serve as behavioral nudges by foregrounding sustainability information at the moment of choice. This study investigates how different behavioral framings of sustainability information in recommendation explanations affect user choices and perceptions. Using generative AI, we generate sustainability-aware explanations by drawing on nudge theory and validate them through human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge audits. Building on this foundation, we conduct two randomized studies (N = 529) in a low involvement domain (instant coffee) and a high involvement domain (hotel bookings), in which participants choose among preference matched recommendations accompanied by these explanations. Our results show that, across both domains, merely disclosing sustainability information in explanations does not change choices, whereas framing that information or invoking a descriptive social norm significantly increases sustainable selections and eases decision-making. Notably, perception and behavior diverge, as plain disclosure improves explanation evaluations without translating into more sustainable selection behavior. Our work demonstrates how LLMs can generate theory-grounded explanations at scale, pointing toward practical explanation-based interventions for social good. We conclude by discussing implications for adaptive explanation design with generative AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）生成的推荐解释能否通过突出可持续性信息来引导用户做出更可持续的选择。作者依据助推理论（nudge theory）借助生成式 AI 构造可持续性感知的解释，并在即时咖啡（低介入）与酒店预订（高介入）两个领域开展两项随机实验（N=529）。结果表明，仅披露可持续性信息不改变选择，而采用框架化表述或唤起描述性社会规范（descriptive social norm）能显著提高可持续选择并降低决策难度；感知与行为出现分化，即普通披露改善解释评价却不转化为更可持续的选择行为。
Motivation: 推荐系统是日常消费的媒介，可能成为鼓励可持续选择的渠道；已有研究表明解释会影响用户对推荐的感知和决策，本文进一步提出解释可作为一种行为助推（nudge），在选择时刻前置可持续性信息。
Method: 基于 nudge theory 使用生成式 AI 生成可持续性感知的解释，并通过人工评估与 LLM-as-a-judge 审计加以验证；随后在偏好匹配的推荐条目旁附带这些解释，开展两项随机实验考察不同行为框架（framing）对用户选择与感知的影响。
Result: 两个领域中，仅在解释中披露可持续性信息不改变选择；而框架化该信息或援引描述性社会规范显著增加可持续选择并简化决策。感知与行为不一致：普通披露提升了解释评价，但未转化为更可持续的选择行为。
Conclusion: 研究表明 LLM 可以大规模生成有理论依据的解释，为面向社会公益的基于解释的干预提供可行路径；作者讨论了对生成式 AI 自适应解释设计（adaptive explanation design）的启示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agent Skills Matter: Inferring Proprietary Skills from Execution Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills package reusable procedures that improve downstream performance. Their lightweight, portable form enables marketplace monetization and private deployment behind cloud-hosted agent interfaces, giving providers incentives to keep high-value skills proprietary. Yet hiding the artifacts does not conceal their behavioral effects, which remain observable in execution trajectories and form a behavioral side channel. We define this exposure as Skill Leakage: reconstructing proprietary skills from trajectories elicited by benign queries, without reference answers or success labels. We introduce SigLeak, a black-box framework that exploits recurring skill signatures in agent behavior. It constructs diverse, decision-rich diagnostic tasks, contrasts matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled trajectories, and iteratively refines a reconstructed skill from the isolated patterns. Across five scenarios, three model families, and three agent frameworks, SigLeak outperforms or matches three baselines in nearly every setting. It raises the success rate by 6.88 percentage points over the skill-disabled reference on average and achieves the highest overall SkillSim, our metric for coarse- and fine-grained semantic similarity. These results show that benign execution trajectories can expose proprietary procedural knowledge. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SigLeak-D1DB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出技能泄漏 (Skill Leakage) 问题，即通过良性查询引发的执行轨迹重建智能体被保密的专有技能 (proprietary skills)，无需参考答案或成功标签。作者提出黑盒框架 SigLeak，利用智能体行为中重复出现的技能签名，构造决策丰富的诊断任务，对比技能启用与技能禁用轨迹并迭代精炼重建技能。在五个场景、三个模型家族和三个 agent 框架下，SigLeak 在几乎全部设置中优于或持平三个基线，平均比技能禁用参考提升 6.88 个百分点成功率，并获得最高的 SkillSim 语义相似度。
Motivation: 轻量可移植的 agent 技能可在市场变现并部署在云端接口之后，提供商有动力将高价值技能保守为专有；但隐藏工件并不能隐藏可观察的行为效应，形成行为侧信道。作者将该暴露形式定义为 Skill Leakage，并指出缺乏从轨迹中无标签重建专有技能的方法。
Method: 提出黑盒框架 SigLeak：构造多样且决策丰富的诊断任务，对比匹配的技能启用与技能禁用轨迹，提取反复出现的技能签名，并通过迭代方式精炼重建出的技能。
Result: 在五个场景、三个模型家族和三个 agent 框架上，SigLeak 在几乎每项设置中优于或持平三个基线；平均比技能禁用参考提升 6.88 个百分点成功率，并取得最高的 SkillSim（粗粒度与细粒度语义相似度）得分。
Conclusion: 结果表明良性执行轨迹足以暴露专有程序性知识，技能泄漏构成实际的隐私与商业风险；作者将代码开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Speedups for Stochastic Optimization with Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic optimization with heavy-tailed gradient noise. We first propose a novel quantum mean estimator for multivariate heavy-tailed random variables that achieves lower query complexity than optimal classical estimators in the low-dimensional regime. We further develop an unbiased quantum mean estimator by applying a generalized multi-level Monte Carlo technique. We prove quantum lower bounds showing that, when the dimension $d$ of the random vector is small and can be viewed as a constant, our quantum estimators are optimal up to logarithmic factors. We further derive stronger dimension-dependent lower bounds for tail index $p>4/3$, showing that a nontrivial dependence on the dimension is unavoidable in the low-dimensional regime. Based on these estimators, we propose a quantum normalized stochastic gradient descent method ($\texttt{QNSGD}$), which finds an $ε$-stationary point using $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt d\,ε^{-\frac{5p-4}{2p-2}}\big)$ queries to the quantum stochastic gradient oracle. For a convex objective function, we propose a quantum projected stochastic gradient descent method ($\texttt{QPSGD}$), which computes a solution with $ε$-optimal solution using $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt d\,ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{2p-2}}+ε^{-2}\big)$ queries in expectation. These sharper bounds improve upon the classical lower bounds $Ω\big(ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{p-1}}\big)$ for nonconvex problems and $Ω\big(ε^{-\frac{p}{p-1}}\big)$ for convex problems in the low-dimensional regimes $d\lesssimε^{-\frac{p}{p-1}}$ and $d\lesssimε^{-\frac{2-p}{p-1}}$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重尾梯度噪声下的随机优化问题，提出面向多元重尾随机变量的量子均值估计器，并通过广义多层蒙特卡洛 (multi-level Monte Carlo) 技术构造无偏版本。基于这些估计器，作者提出量子归一化随机梯度下降 (QNSGD) 与量子投影随机梯度下降 (QPSGD)，在低维情形下分别改进非凸与凸问题的查询复杂度，并证明相应的量子下界。
Motivation: 经典随机优化在重尾梯度噪声下已有查询复杂度下界，低维情形下量子 oracle 能否突破这些经典下界并获得量子加速尚未被充分研究。
Method: 提出一个新的量子均值估计器及其无偏变体（借助 generalized multi-level Monte Carlo），并以此构建 QNSGD（非凸问题）与 QPSGD（凸问题）两种量子随机梯度方法，二者均通过量子随机梯度 oracle 进行查询。
Result: 摘要给出 QNSGD 找到 ε-驻点需要 Õ(√d·ε^{-(5p-4)/(2p-2)}) 次查询；QPSGD 在期望意义下以 Õ(√d·ε^{-(3p-2)/(2p-2)} + ε^{-2}) 次查询得到 ε-最优解。在低维区域 d≲ε^{-p/(p-1)} 与 d≲ε^{-(2-p)/(p-1)} 中，这些界分别优于经典下界 Ω(ε^{-(3p-2)/(p-1)}) 与 Ω(ε^{-p/(p-1)})；对 p>4/3 还证明了低维情形下维度依赖不可避免。量子下界表明，当维度 d 可视为常数时，所提估计器在至多对数因子内是最优的。
Conclusion: 作者总结，在低维重尾随机优化中量子均值估计器可以达到最优（至多对数因子），所提出的 QNSGD/QPSGD 展现出超越经典下界的查询复杂度优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RIDGE: An Autonomous Framework for Validation and Method Discovery in LLM-Generated Option Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Automated code generation is becoming an important tool in quantitative finance, where large language models can generate option pricing implementations directly from mathematical model specifications. Validating such implementations, however, requires considerably more than conventional software testing: numerical pricing methods must remain mathematically consistent, numerically stable, and reliable across a wide range of model parameters. We introduce RIDGE, an autonomous validation framework in which generated pricing implementations are subjected to structured no-arbitrage tests, stress tests, benchmark comparisons, and consistency checks. Validation evidence is interpreted diagnostically, while the resulting knowledge is accumulated in a repository and reused across models and successive validation iterations. This enables systematic refinement of both the pricing implementation and the validation methodology. The framework is applied to five stochastic volatility models. Across these studies, all detected implementation defects are removed and, in two cases, the validation process reveals methodological limitations and motivates the development of alternative numerical methods. The supplementary material is available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/ShQiangLiu/ridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RIDGE，一个面向大语言模型生成期权定价代码的自主验证框架。它通过结构化无套利测试、压力测试、基准对比和一致性检查来验证实现，并将验证证据作诊断性解释，把知识积累到仓库中跨模型和迭代复用。框架应用于五个随机波动率模型，摘要报告所有检测到的实现缺陷均被移除，其中两个案例还暴露了方法论局限并催生了替代数值方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型可以直接从数学模型规格生成期权定价实现，但这类数值代码的验证远超常规软件测试，必须保证数学一致性、数值稳定性以及在广泛模型参数下的可靠性。
Method: RIDGE 框架将生成的定价实现提交给结构化无套利测试、压力测试、基准对比和一致性检查，诊断式解释验证证据，并把所得知识积累到仓库中，在模型之间和连续验证迭代中复用，从而系统性地改进定价实现与验证方法本身。
Result: 该框架应用于五个随机波动率模型；摘要报告所有检测到的实现缺陷均被移除，并且有两个案例中验证过程揭示了方法论局限，促使开发替代数值方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自主验证与知识复用可以实现对 LLM 生成定价实现的系统性精化，同时也能推动验证方法论的演进；补充材料见 GitHub 仓库。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal Cascade: Distribution-Free Accuracy Guarantees for Multi-Tier LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) cascades reduce inference cost by routing easy queries to a small model and deferring hard queries to a larger one. Production cascades govern this deferral through a confidence threshold, but LLM confidence scores are miscalibrated, the threshold must be tuned per model pair and per domain, and no setting yields a formal bound on cascade accuracy. We introduce \textbf{Conformal Cascade} (CC), a multi-tier inference framework that uses conformal prediction set size as the deferral rule: accept when the calibrated set collapses to a single answer, defer otherwise. The procedure delivers a distribution-free, finite-sample accuracy guarantee. By a per-tier union bound, the prediction set at the accepting tier covers the correct answer with probability at least $1 - Kα$ for any user-specified $α$; under a selection-preservation condition (consistent with, but not strictly implied by, our marginal coverage results), the bound tightens to $1 - α$. We further characterise expected cascade cost as an explicit function of $α$ and the calibration-set acceptance rate. Across 18 multiple-choice benchmarks spanning science, medicine, commonsense, and standardized exams, evaluated on two-tier cascades drawn from four open-weight model families, CC strictly improves over the strongest calibration-tuned heuristic cascade on the majority of family--benchmark pairs, with the largest gains on reasoning-heavy benchmarks where majority vote is unreliable; on easier benchmarks the cascade commits the vast majority of queries to the small model at no accuracy cost. Extension to open-ended generation requires an answer-clustering step that we leave for future work. The method requires no model training and only black-box API access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Conformal Cascade (CC)，一种用于多层 LLM 推理级联的分布无关置信度框架：以共形预测集 (conformal prediction set) 是否收缩为单一答案作为延迟规则，替代传统置信度阈值。该方法在任意有限样本下提供精确度保证，并给出期望级联成本的显式表达式；在 18 个多项选择基准、四个开源模型族构成的两级级联上，多数情况下优于最强校准调优启发式，尤其在依赖推理的基准上增益最大。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 级联依赖置信度阈值来决定是否将查询转发给大模型，但 LLM 置信度校准不良、阈值需针对每个模型对和领域单独调整，且任何设置都无法给出级联精确度的形式化保证。
Method: 使用共形预测集大小作为延迟规则：当校准后的预测集收缩为单一答案时接受，否则延迟到更高层。通过逐层联合界 (per-tier union bound) 在任意用户指定的 α 下给出覆盖概率至少 1-Kα 的保证，并在选择保持条件 (selection-preservation condition) 下紧化为 1-α；同时将期望级联成本显式表述为 α 与校准集接受率的函数。方法无需训练，仅需黑盒 API 访问。
Result: 在覆盖科学、医学、常识和标准化考试的 18 个多项选择基准上，使用四个开源模型族构成的两层级联，CC 在大多数模型族-基准组合上严格优于最强校准调优启发式；最大增益出现在多数投票不可靠的推理密集型基准上，而在较简单的基准上，绝大多数查询可交给小模型且无损精确度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法提供分布无关、有限样本的精确度保证，并将成本表征为 α 的函数；扩展到开放式生成需要额外的答案聚类步骤，作者将其留作未来工作。

papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. We show that this objective is under-identified at the branch level: positive- and negative-branch errors can compensate in the guided prediction. Through two contrasting cases, we find that naive matching remains effective under shared negative conditioning, where both branch errors decrease jointly. When the model's native CFG schema retains privileged information in the teacher's negative branch that is unavailable to the student, however, this joint reduction breaks down and the composed objective induces antagonistic branch-error dynamics, reducing the positive-branch error while increasing the negative-branch error. We term this failure mode Negative Branch Asymmetry (NBA). To address NBA, we introduce Positive--Direction Matching (PDM), a branch-aware OPD objective that separately constrains the positive prediction and the CFG conditional direction. We apply PDM to dense-to-sparse video control, where naive guided matching is highly sensitive to inference guidance scales, while branch-aware supervision enables more robust and effective knowledge transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 下的行为，指出现有方法直接对 CFG 组合后的 guided velocity 做匹配会导致分支级欠定问题：正、负分支误差可相互补偿。作者将一种失败模式命名为 Negative Branch Asymmetry (NBA)，并提出分支感知的目标 Positive-Direction Matching (PDM)，分别约束正分支预测和 CFG 条件方向，并在 dense-to-sparse 视频控制任务中展示其比朴素 guided matching 更稳健。
Motivation: 现代扩散系统默认使用 CFG，但 OPD 在 CFG 下应如何工作缺乏理解。现有方法直接匹配 teacher 与 student 的 guided velocity，该目标在分支层面欠定，尤其当 teacher 负分支持有 student 无法获得的特权信息时，联合误差下降机制失效并引发对抗性分支误差动态。
Method: 提出 PDM (Positive-Direction Matching)，一种分支感知的 OPD 目标，将正分支预测与 CFG 条件方向分别约束，以替代对组合后 guided prediction 的直接匹配；该方法被应用于 dense-to-sparse 视频控制。
Result: 摘要报告在 dense-to-sparse 视频控制中，朴素 guided matching 对推理 guidance scale 高度敏感，而 PDM 的分支感知监督带来更稳健有效的知识迁移；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 NBA 是 OPD 在 CFG 下的一类关键失败模式，PDM 通过分离正分支与条件方向约束来缓解该问题；应用场景限于 dense-to-sparse 视频控制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Machine Learning to Large-Scale EO Products: Best Practices for Making Maps
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have seen a rapid expansion in the production of large-scale geospatial maps derived from Earth observation (EO) data, driven largely by advances in machine learning (ML) and large computing infrastructure. Although the barrier to generating such maps has dropped substantially, established best practices have yet to emerge, and design decisions made early in the pipeline can quietly propagate errors into the final product. Producing a technically sound and scientifically credible product remains challenging. Choices made at every stage are tightly coupled: preprocessing decisions shape the training signal, dataset design governs what the model can learn and how reliably its performance can be assessed, and global-scale inference introduces engineering challenges in compute and data access at scale, as well as artifact mitigation. Furthermore, uncertainty quantification and independent map validation each require dedicated methodological attention that is often underestimated. This paper presents a concise, end-to-end account of the recommended practices spanning the pipeline from satellite data to an operational map product. We organize the discussion around six interconnected themes: the EO data infrastructure landscape, data selection and preprocessing, ML dataset construction and model training, uncertainty quantification, map production and distribution, and validation. This paper is a condensed version of a longer guide that provides greater depth across all stages, accessible online at ghjuliasialelli.github.io/ML-EO-Maps/.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026 TerraBytes II Workshop paper, non-archival
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 ECCV 2026 TerraBytes II Workshop 的非存档短文，面向大规模地球观测（EO）地图产品的生产流程，给出从卫星数据到运行级地图的端到端推荐实践。全文围绕六个相互关联的主题展开：EO 数据基础设施、数据选择与预处理、ML 数据集构建与训练、不确定性量化、地图生产与分发、以及验证。作者强调各阶段决策紧密耦合，早期设计选择会把误差静默传播到最终产品，并指出不确定性量化与独立验证常被低估；该文是一份更长在线指南的浓缩版。
Motivation: 基于机器学习和大规模算力的地理空间地图生产快速增长，但业界尚未形成成熟的最佳实践，早期流程中的设计决策可能悄无声息地污染最终产品；此外，不确定性量化和独立地图验证所需的方法学投入常被轻视。
Method: 以指南形式系统梳理最佳实践，按六阶段组织：EO 数据基础设施、数据选取与预处理、ML 数据集构建与模型训练、不确定性量化、地图生产与分发、验证；每个环节被描述为与其余环节紧密耦合，并指引读者访问在线长版指南以获取更多细节。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验或基准结果；本文的贡献在于提供一套端到端的推荐实践框架，并指出不确定性量化与独立验证需要专门方法学关注。
Conclusion: 作者强调，制作技术上可靠且科学可信的 EO 地图产品需要全流程统筹，各阶段决策相互依赖，且长版在线指南可提供更深入的分阶段阐述。

papers.title: Debiased Machine Learning: Identification, Estimation, and Shape Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We develop a general framework of identification and estimation for automatic debiased machine learning (DML) where the parameter of interest $θ_0$ is identified by a moment condition involving a nuisance $γ_0$ that may be high dimensional. We establish conditions under which the Riesz representer $α_0$, which is at the core of DML, is identified, and show that the identification occurs precisely when $α_0$ uniquely optimizes a quadratic functional. This characterization enables us to develop a general estimation procedure for $α_0$ that allows for generic $γ_0$ including those defined by models with endogeneity and encompasses both classical sieves and modern architectures such as deep neural networks. To improve estimation precision and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, we incorporate shape constraints on $γ_0$ by embedding them into a possibly nonlinear parameter space. We illustrate our estimation procedure through simulations and empirical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动去偏机器学习（DML）的通用识别与估计框架，目标参数由含高维 nuisance 的矩条件识别。作者证明 Riesz representer 的识别等价于其唯一优化某个二次泛函，并基于此构造适用于一般 nuisance（包括内生性模型）的估计程序，涵盖经典 sieve 与深度神经网络。形状约束被嵌入可能非线性的参数空间以缓解维数灾难，并通过模拟和实证应用展示效果。
Motivation: 现有 DML 方法对 nuisance 的结构和估计器有较多限制，尤其在存在内生性或高维 nuisance 时，Riesz representer 的识别条件和通用估计程序尚不清晰。本文旨在给出一般性识别刻画，并支持现代机器学习架构。
Method: 以 Riesz representer 唯一优化二次泛函作为识别条件，建立一般估计框架；允许 nuisance 由含内生性的模型定义，估计器可基于经典 sieve 或深度神经网络；通过将形状约束嵌入可能非线性的参数空间来提升精度、缓解维数灾难。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明作者通过模拟和实证应用展示了所提估计程序的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架统一了经典 sieve 与现代深度架构下的 DML 估计，并指出形状约束有助于缓解维数灾难；但未讨论局限性。

papers.title: The Phase Transition in Online PCA Depends on $n/d\log(d)$, not $n/d$
papers.abstract_en: High dimensional statistical theory has established the importance of constant aspect ratio, when the number of dimensions ($d$) and samples ($n$) satisfy $n,d\to\infty$ with $n/d\to γ\in(0,\infty)$, in understanding the limits of canonical estimation problems. In particular, for estimating the top eigenvector of a $d\times d$ population covariance matrix from $n$ iid samples, the BBP phase transition gives a precise threshold -- a simple functional of the aspect ratio -- such that the top sample principal component attains nonzero asymptotic correlation with the truth only when the leading population eigenvalue exceeds it. In this paper, we show that for online / streaming algorithms the story is very different, and constant aspect ratio is insufficient for nonzero overlap. We study Oja's algorithm, the most popular method for online PCA. Let $Σ=θ^2 v_0v_0^\top+I\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$, and run Oja's algorithm with step size $δ/d$ on $n$ iid samples $X_k\sim\mathcal{N}(0,Σ)$, with output $\hat v_n$. Then, as $n,d\to\infty$ with $n/d\log d\toγ\in(0,\infty)$, we establish a phase transition: $|\langle\hat v_n,v_0\rangle|\to 0$ when $γ<γ_*$, and $\toρ_*$ when $γ>γ_*$. Here $ρ_*=ρ_*(θ,δ)=\sqrt{(θ^2-δ/2)_+/θ^2(1+δ/2)}$ and $γ_*=γ_*(θ,δ)=1/2δ(θ^2-δ/2)_+$. Further, at criticality, when $n=[γ_*d\log d+ηd]$ and $d\to\infty$, $η\in\mathbb{R}$, the correlation is random: $|\langle\hat v_n,v_0\rangle|\stackrel{w}{\to}ρ_*|G|\exp(η/2γ_*)/\sqrt{ρ_*^4+G^2\exp(η/γ_*)}$ where $G\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1)$. This is in stark contrast to ordinary high dimensional PCA, where nonzero overlap is possible at constant $n/d$ and improves as $n/d$ increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线主成分分析（online PCA）中 Oja 算法的相变阈值，证明非零重叠（nonzero overlap）的条件由 n/(d log d) 而非常数纵横比 n/d 决定。在 spike 协方差模型 Σ=θ²v0v0^⊤+I 下，当 n,d→∞ 且 n/(d log d)→γ 时，存在阈值 γ_*：γ<γ_* 时输出与真实主方向 v0 的相关性趋于 0，γ>γ_* 时趋于 ρ_*；在临界尺度 n=γ_* d log d+ηd 下，相关性依分布收敛到一个含标准正态变量 G 的随机表达式。
Motivation: 经典高维统计理论表明常数纵横比 n/d→γ 决定批量 PCA 中 BBP 相变的精确阈值，但这一结论是否适用于在线/流式估计并不清楚。作者指出，对于 Oja 算法这类在线方法，常数纵横比不足以保证非零重叠。
Method: 分析 Oja 算法在步长 δ/d、n 个独立同分布高斯样本上的行为，在 n,d→∞ 且 n/(d log d)→γ 的新机制下推导相变阈值 γ_* 与极限相关 ρ_* 的闭式表达，并刻画临界尺度下的随机极限。
Result: 摘要给出精确结果：γ_*=1/(2δ(θ²−δ/2)_+)，ρ_*=√((θ²−δ/2)_+/(θ²(1+δ/2)))；当 γ 低于阈值时相关性趋于 0，高于阈值时趋于 ρ_*，且在临界点相关性成为带高斯波动的随机量。这与批量高维 PCA 中常数 n/d 即可产生非零重叠且随纵横比改善的行为形成鲜明对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调在线 PCA 的相变依赖于 n/(d log d) 而不是 n/d，说明常数纵横比不足以刻画流式算法的估计极限；本文属于理论分析，未涉及具体应用场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 分析 Oja 算法在步长 δ/d、n 个独立同分布高斯样本上的行为，在 n,d→∞ 且 n/(d log d)→γ 的新机制下推导相变阈值 γ_* 与极限相关 ρ_* 的闭式表达，并刻画临界尺度下的随机极限。
summary_sections.result: 摘要给出精确结果：γ_*=1/(2δ(θ²−δ/2)_+)，ρ_*=√((θ²−δ/2)_+/(θ²(1+δ/2)))；当 γ 低于阈值时相关性趋于 0，高于阈值时趋于 ρ_*，且在临界点相关性成为带高斯波动的随机量。这与批量高维 PCA 中常数 n/d 即可产生非零重叠且随纵横比改善的行为形成鲜明对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调在线 PCA 的相变依赖于 n/(d log d) 而不是 n/d，说明常数纵横比不足以刻画流式算法的估计极限；本文属于理论分析，未涉及具体应用场景。

papers.title: CachedSearch: Training-Free Cached Exploration for Test-Time Search in Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Test-time search lets small video diffusion models rival larger ones, but costs 2-10x more. All candidates are fully denoised, although most are discarded. Training-free caching makes each rollout 2-3x faster at near-lossless quality. Composition is safe only if lossy caching preserves verifier rankings. We present the first study of whether caching corrupts candidate ranking in video test-time search. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with an adaptive caching wrapper (~2x per-candidate speedup), ImageReward scores seed-matched cached and full rollouts. Median per-prompt Spearman rank correlation is 0.905, with 72% top-1 agreement on the VBench suite. VBench-2.0 replicates this result on a harder suite. Recomputing the cached winner at full compute retains 90-94% of the full-search gain. Errors cluster among near-tied candidates, making corruption self-limiting. This finding leads to CachedSearch. It explores every candidate with aggressive caching, then re-generates only the winner at full compute. At N=8, it captures 94.7% of best-of-N's gain at 63% of the cost. Capture rises with width. At matched budget, it searches twice as wide for 38% more gain. The result holds from 1.3B-14B across six models and four families: Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, and Hunyuan. Wan2.1-14B matches the 1.3B model's fidelity. Mid-trajectory pruning multiplies the exploration saving to 3.11x at 88.6% capture. Ports to other model families require recalibrating a single parameter, showing that fidelity tracks architecture rather than parameter count. CachedSearch is training-free, verifier-agnostic, and orthogonal to the search algorithm, making it a plug-in multiplier for test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频扩散模型测试时搜索（test-time search）中缓存（caching）是否破坏候选排序，并提出训练无关的方法 CachedSearch。它先用激进缓存探索所有候选，再仅对获胜者进行全计算重新生成，在 N=8 时捕获 best-of-N 约 94.7% 的收益而成本仅为 63%。作者称该方法与验证器及搜索算法正交，可作为测试时扩展的即插即用乘数。
Motivation: 测试时搜索能让小型视频扩散模型接近大型模型，但推理成本高出 2-10 倍，且大多数候选被丢弃；训练无关的缓存可使每次 rollout 快 2-3 倍，但尚不清楚有损缓存是否破坏验证器对候选的排名，这是论文聚焦的缺口。
Method: 提出 CachedSearch：对每个候选使用激进缓存进行探索，然后在全计算下仅重新生成获胜者。该方法是训练无关、验证器无关且与搜索算法正交的；迁移到其他模型家族时只需重校准单一参数。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上，缓存与全 rollout 的 ImageReward 分数中位 per-prompt Spearman 秩相关为 0.905，VBench 上 top-1 一致性 72%；VBench-2.0 在更难套件上复现。重算缓存胜者保留全搜索收益的 90-94%。N=8 时捕获 94.7% 的 best-of-N 收益、成本 63%；匹配预算下搜索宽度加倍、收益多 38%。该结论在 1.3B-14B 的六个模型、四个家族（Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, Hunyuan）上成立；中轨迹剪枝使探索节省乘数达 3.11 倍，捕获率 88.6%。
Conclusion: CachedSearch 是训练无关、验证器无关、与搜索算法正交的插件式加速手段，其保真度跟踪架构而非参数数量；但移植到其他模型家族需要重新校准单一参数，且错误集中在几乎并列的候选上，使损坏具有自限性。

papers.title: REPREC: Representation Driven Parameter-Efficient Recommendation System
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied to sequential recommendation by formulating it as a natural language task. Previous work has improved personalization by incorporating collaborative and sequential signals through input conditioning or LLM fine-tuning. However, existing approaches often rely on one or more of the following: LLM fine-tuning, additional architectural modules, representation distillation, or item-level conditioning over long interaction histories, increasing training complexity and deployment cost. We propose REPREC, a lightweight framework that reformulates LLM-based sequential recommendation through lightweight user representation alignment. REPREC maps a fixed-size user embedding from a frozen sequential encoder into a small set of learned soft tokens through a lightweight MLP injector that conditions a frozen LLM, leaving both pretrained backbones unchanged while training only the injector. We conducted exhaustive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and demonstrate that REPREC consistently outperforms LoRA while remaining compatible with different pretrained sequential encoders and LLM backbones, enabling a modular and production-friendly recommendation pipeline without modifying either pretrained component. The gains are particularly pronounced for casual and core users across all datasets, highlighting REPREC's effectiveness in low-data regimes. Finally, when trained on short prompt histories and evaluated with longer contexts, REPREC maintains 85-100% of LoRA's performance while reducing per-epoch training time by an average of 1.51X, demonstrating an effective balance between recommendation quality and computational efficiency for production deployment. The code is available at https://github.com/phdbotcode/REPREC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REPREC，一个轻量级框架，将基于 LLM 的序列推荐问题转化为用户表示对齐任务。它用冻结的序列编码器生成固定大小用户嵌入，再通过轻量级 MLP 注入器映射为少量可学习软 token，从而在不修改预训练编码器和 LLM 的前提下只训练注入器。实验表明 REPREC 在多个基准数据集上一致优于 LoRA，并兼容不同预训练编码器和 LLM 主干，且训练时间更短。
Motivation: 现有将 LLM 应用于序列推荐的工作常依赖 LLM 微调、额外架构模块、表示蒸馏或基于长交互历史的逐项条件化，增加了训练复杂度和部署成本。
Method: REPREC 使用冻结的序列编码器生成固定大小的用户嵌入，通过轻量级 MLP 注入器将该嵌入映射为少量可学习软 token，用来条件化冻结的 LLM；预训练组件均保持不变，仅训练注入器。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上 REPREC 一致优于 LoRA，并且与不同预训练序列编码器和 LLM 主干兼容；对 casual 和 core 用户的提升尤其明显，在低数据场景下表现突出。在短提示历史训练、长上下文评估时，REPREC 保持 LoRA 性能的 85-100%，同时平均减少每 epoch 训练时间 1.51 倍。
Conclusion: REPREC 在不修改任何预训练组件的情况下实现了模块化且生产友好的推荐流程，在推荐质量与计算效率之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Claude Code Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone)，一种基于文件系统的操作层，围绕 Claude Code 原生 Agent Teams 构建，将每个 agent 和 teammate 视为人类员工，并在名为 "workstation" 的专用目录中保存其工作状态、技能、hooks 和脚本。论文针对长生命周期 agentic 工作流中的四个问题：agent 团队状态不可恢复、compaction 侵蚀工作细节、agentic "技术债务"以及频繁编写长 prompt。ATWZ 支持团队周期性备份状态、在 compaction 后恢复 agent 知识、用单条命令恢复已结束的团队，并允许 agent "员工"之间互发文档以降低 prompt 编写成本。
Motivation: Claude Code 等 LLM coding agent 能完成复杂编码任务，但长期 agentic 工作流存在若干缺陷：Agent Teams 的累积工作状态在进程停止（如关闭终端）后丢失且无法恢复；compaction 将对话压缩为摘要，使 agent 的工作细节变得模糊；用户决策与 agent 操作逐渐被困在压缩后的旧对话中，形成 agentic "技术债务"，增加维护与审查难度；任务分配或交接需要用户反复编写长 prompt。
Method: 提出 ATWZ，一个围绕 Claude Code 原生 Agent Teams 构建的基于文件系统的操作层。其核心设计原则是把每个 agent/teammate 视为人类员工，将重要工作状态保存在专用 "workstation" 目录中，并配套使用和维护这些文件的 skills、hooks 与 scripts。ATWZ 使 agent 团队能够周期性备份工作状态，从而在 compaction 后恢复 agent 的知识；进程结束后可通过单条命令恢复整个团队；agent "员工"之间可以互相发送文档，从而大幅减少 prompt 编写量。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要陈述该设计能够解决上述四类问题：恢复 agent 团队工作状态、缓解 compaction 导致的知识细节丢失、显著减轻 agentic "技术债务"，并降低任务分配/交接时的 prompt 编写负担。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ATWZ 以文件系统为中心、把 agent 当作员工来管理的设计，可以改善长生命周期 Claude Code agent 团队的可恢复性与可维护性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AgentHOI: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Human-Object-Interaction Video Generation via Implicit Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion models have spurred interest in human-object interaction (HOI) video generation, which demands fine-grained control over interaction logic beyond single-subject animation. However, existing HOI methods rely heavily on explicit motion control, limiting scalability and generalization across diverse objects and interactions. In this study, we propose AgentHOI, a text-driven HOI video generation following a thinking-before-generation framework that bridges the gap between high-level textual intent and physical execution through multi-agent reasoning over perception, interaction, and motion planning. Building upon the generated interaction plans, we further strengthen text-driven motion understanding. We introduce an implicit text-motion alignment strategy that distills text-to-motion priors into the video diffusion model, enabling robust HOI synthesis without explicit motion inputs at inference. Experiments show that AgentHOI significantly improves interaction naturalness, object appearance preservation, and adherence to complex textual instructions across challenging object-centric scenarios such as wearing and riding. The code is available at https://github.com/bone-11/agenthoi.
papers.comment: Under review. The code is available at https://github.com/bone-11/agenthoi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentHOI，一种文本驱动的 Human-Object-Interaction (HOI) 视频生成方法，采用“先思考再生成”框架，通过多智能体推理将高层文本意图转化为感知、交互与运动规划，并进一步引入隐式文本-运动对齐 (implicit text-motion alignment) 策略，把 text-to-motion 先验蒸馏进视频扩散模型，使推理时无需显式运动输入。实验显示在穿着、骑行等物体中心场景中，该方法显著提升交互自然度、物体外观保持度以及对复杂文本指令的遵从度。
Motivation: 现有 HOI 视频生成方法高度依赖显式运动控制，限制了其在不同物体与交互类型上的可扩展性和泛化能力；同时高层文本意图与实际物理执行之间存在鸿沟，需要更稳定的文本驱动交互建模。
Method: 提出 think-before-generation 的多智能体推理框架，让多个智能体分别负责感知、交互和运动规划以生成交互计划；在此计划基础上，引入隐式文本-运动对齐策略，将 text-to-motion 先验知识蒸馏到视频扩散模型中，从而在推理时不依赖显式运动输入即可合成 HOI 视频。
Result: 摘要报告 AgentHOI 在 wearing、riding 等具有挑战性的物体中心交互场景中，显著改善交互自然度、物体外观保持以及对复杂文本指令的遵循，但未给出具体量化数值。

papers.title: What AI Red-Team Evaluations Can and Cannot Prove
papers.abstract_en: Red-team evaluations of AI models support some claims and not others, and the boundary between the two is calculable rather than merely a matter of judgment. We define the evidential ceiling of an evaluation as the largest factor by which one result can move belief under a fixed testing budget, derive it in closed form for the benchmark null result, and use it to locate that boundary exactly. We find that above a calculable harm rate, a benchmark of modest size certifies a category to a stated evidentiary standard, and a clean sheet is then the stronger of the two possible observations, outweighing a single reproduced failure. Below that rate, no passive benchmark of feasible size provides the specified evidence of safety under the fixed scoring rule and approximately independent trial structure. The crossing between the two regimes has a closed form. The bound is not specific to benchmarks: written in terms of a procedure's hypothesis conditioned elicitation rates, it covers adaptive and automated red teaming as well, and shows that discrimination between the hypotheses rather than attack success is what determines evidential worth. Auditing eight evaluation suites against the boundary, we find that current benchmarks are adequate for high-frequency harm categories and several orders of magnitude short for rare, catastrophic ones. Safety benchmarks are not uninformative. They are informative about a specific and computable set of propositions, and the discipline they need is to state which.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从证据学视角分析 AI 红队评测（red-team evaluation）能够支持哪些主张。作者定义评测的“证据上限”（evidential ceiling），即在固定测试预算下单个结果能改变信念的最大倍数，并以闭式解刻画 benchmark 零结果（clean sheet）的证据边界。摘要指出存在一个可计算的危害率阈值：高于该阈值时，中等规模的 benchmark 能以规定的证据标准认证某个危害类别，且零失败反例强于单个复现的失败；低于该阈值时，任何可行规模的被动 benchmark 都无法在固定评分规则和近似独立试验结构下提供所要求的证据。作者还用该上界审计了八套评测系统，发现当前 benchmark 对高频危害类别足够，而对罕见灾难性危害类别差若干数量级。
Motivation: AI 红队评测声称能证明模型的安全性，但哪些主张可以被评测结果支撑、哪些不能，往往被当作主观判断问题。作者希望把这一边界变成可计算的对象，而不是停留在争论层面。
Method: 定义评测的证据上限为固定测试预算下单个结果对信念更新的最大因子，并在 benchmark 零结果上推导出闭式解。该上界以程序假设条件下的诱发率（elicitation rates）表达，因而也覆盖自适应和自动化红队，强调证据价值取决于对两个假设的区分能力而非攻击成功率。
Result: 摘要给出危害率临界点的闭式表达式：高于该危害率时，中等规模 benchmark 足以按既定证据标准认证危害类别，干净结果比单个复现失败更有说服力；低于该危害率时，任何可行规模的被动 benchmark 都无法提供安全证据。对八套评测套件的审计显示，现有 benchmark 对高频危害类别足够，对罕见灾难性危害类别则短缺几个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为安全 benchmark 并非无信息，而是只对一组特定且可计算的命题有信息；评测实践需要明确陈述这些命题，并接受证据边界是可计算的这一约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior laundering: learned priors with inherited, undetectable overconfidence
papers.abstract_en: Learned generative priors now supply the regularization in ill-posed imaging inverse problems, and the uncertainty read from their posterior samples is taken as evidence earned from data. When examples of the true image are scarce, as in seismic and medical imaging, the widely adopted recourse is to train such a prior not on truths but on an archive of past reconstructions---prior laundering. We show that the uncertainty it then reports can be overconfident, and that no measurement-side check can reveal it. On the directions a forward operator leaves unresolved, this prior reports not what the data support but the assumption built into the older reconstruction method. More specifically, when the archive holds posterior samples, its population law---averaged over the measurements---is exactly the old regularizer advanced a single expectation--maximization step, frozen on the operator's blind subspace. The freeze leaves no signature in the data. Two truths differing only there induce identical data laws, so no goodness-of-fit test separates them, and self-consistency diagnostics, simulation-based calibration among them, pass whatever the prior believes. In the more realistic case, where the archive keeps a single-best reconstruction rather than posterior samples, the blind credible interval collapses to zero width. We prove these statements and demonstrate the inherited overconfidence on deployed seismic and groundwater imaging against a truth-trained control. We recommend reporting which directions the operator resolves---separating the confidence the data support from belief inherited through the pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究‘先验洗钱’（prior laundering）现象：在真实样本稀缺的 ill-posed 成像反问题中，常用做法是用过去的重建结果（archive of past reconstructions）而非真实图像来训练生成式先验。作者证明这种先验从后验样本中读出的不确定性可能过度自信，且任何基于测量的检查都无法发现；在前向算子未解析的方向上，该先验报告的是旧重建方法内建的假设而非数据支持。
Motivation: 在地震成像、医学成像等真实样本稀缺的场景中，广泛采用的做法是用历史重建档案训练先验；论文关注这种先验所报告的不确定性是否真的来自数据证据，并发现其可能继承旧方法的过度自信且不可检测。
Method: 通过理论分析刻画 prior laundering：当档案保存后验样本时，其总体分布（对测量平均）恰好等于旧正则化器前进一个期望最大化（expectation–maximization）步骤后在算子盲子空间（blind subspace）上的冻结版本；该冻结不留下数据痕迹，因此 goodness-of-fit 检验无法区分，仿真校准（simulation-based calibration）等自洽诊断也会通过。当档案只保存单一最佳重建时，盲可信区间（credible interval）坍缩为零宽度。
Result: 论文证明了上述命题，并在已部署的地震成像与地下水成像任务上，以真值训练的控制组为对照，展示了这种继承的过度自信。
Conclusion: 作者建议报告算子能够解析的方向，把数据支持的置信度与通过管线继承的信念（belief）区分开，以避免把先验洗钱的过度自信误当作数据证据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improved lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of odd cycles
papers.abstract_en: The Shannon capacity $Θ(G)$ of a graph $G$ quantifies the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted with zero error over a noisy channel. It is lower bounded by $α(G^d)^{1/d}$ for any $d$, where $α(G^d)$ is the independence number of the $d$-th strong product of $G$. We construct independent sets of size $134753$ in $C_7^{10}$, $21909$ in $C_{11}^{6}$, $62530$ in $C_{13}^{6}$, and $8076974$ in $C_{15}^{8}$, improving the best known lower bounds for the Shannon capacity of these graphs to $Θ(C_7)\geq 134753^{1/10}>3.258020$, $Θ(C_{11})\geq 21909^{1/6}>5.289773$, $Θ(C_{13})\geq 62530^{1/6}>6.300109$, and $Θ(C_{15})\geq 8076974^{1/8}>7.301399$. We also improve the best known lower bounds on the independence numbers of several individual strong products of odd cycles that do not improve the Shannon capacity lower bound. The constructions were discovered through iterative interactions with a Large Language Model (LLM), illustrating the potential of LLMs for finding explicit combinatorial constructions.
papers.comment: v2: added improvement on lower bound for the Shannon capacity of C15
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为奇数环图的 Shannon 容量构造了更强的下界。作者在强乘积（strong product）中构造显式独立集：C_7^{10} 中大小为 134753，C_11^{6} 中为 21909，C_13^{6} 中为 62530，C_15^{8} 中为 8076974，从而将 Shannon 容量下界分别提升为 Θ(C_7) ≥ 134753^{1/10} > 3.258020、Θ(C_11) ≥ 21909^{1/6} > 5.289773、Θ(C_13) ≥ 62530^{1/6} > 6.300109、Θ(C_15) ≥ 8076974^{1/8} > 7.301399。这些构造是通过与大型语言模型（LLM）的迭代交互发现的。
Motivation: Shannon 容量刻画零错误信道中可无差错传输的信息速率，其下界由任意外层强乘积的独立数给出。改善奇数环图（尤其 C7、C11、C13、C15）的 Shannon 容量下界是零错误信息论与组合学中的公开难题，现有下界仍与上界存在显著差距。
Method: 作者在奇数环图的 d 次强乘积 G^d 中显式构造出更大的独立集。构造过程利用了与大型语言模型（LLM）的迭代交互来搜索显式组合构造，而非仅依靠传统启发式或代数构造。
Result: 摘要报告了四个强乘积中新的独立集规模：C_7^{10} 为 134753、C_11^{6} 为 21909、C_13^{6} 为 62530、C_15^{8} 为 8076974，对应的 Shannon 容量下界提升至 3.258020、5.289773、6.300109 与 7.301399 以上。此外还改进了若干不影响 Shannon 容量下界的单个奇数环强乘积的独立数下界。
Conclusion: 作者将这些改进归功于 LLM 辅助下发现的显式独立集构造，并指出该过程展示了 LLM 在寻找显式组合构造方面的潜力。摘要未讨论这些下界与上界之间的差距、构造的具体结构或计算成本。
