papers.title: PATS: Policy-Aware Training Scaffolding for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In long-horizon LLM agent reinforcement learning, weak policies often repeat similar failures, producing uninformative rollout trajectories and limiting effective policy optimization. Existing skill-centric methods improve exploration by optimizing, filtering, or internalizing reusable skills. However, they remain centered on the skills themselves rather than being designed as adaptive training-time support for the evolving policy. To address this, we propose a policy-centric training paradigm that reframes skills as a dynamic training scaffold. Our framework, PATS, converts rollout groups from the latest policy into evidence cards and uses task-specific evaluation to adjust the context used in subsequent rollouts. Concrete guidance helps weak policies to complete challenging tasks. As policy improves, redundant context is revised or removed to reduce reliance on explicit guidance while preserving useful rollout variation. The policy is optimized with environmental rewards using standard RLVR, and the training scaffold is discarded at deployment. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and seven search-augmented QA benchmarks, PATS achieves performance competitive with SOTA baselines while using 25%-50% fewer tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向长程 LLM 智能体强化学习的策略感知训练脚手架（PATS），将技能重新定义为随策略演化的动态训练支撑。框架把最新策略产生的 rollout 分组转换为证据卡片（evidence cards），并通过任务特定评估调整后续 rollout 的上下文；弱策略可获得具体指导，策略变强后冗余上下文被修订或移除。摘要报告在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和七个检索增强 QA 基准上取得与 SOTA 相当的性能，同时减少 25%-50% 的 token 使用。
Motivation: 长程智能体强化学习中，弱策略常重复相似失败，产生信息量低的 rollout，限制策略优化；现有以技能为中心的方法未针对演化中的策略提供自适应的训练期支持。
Method: 提出以策略为中心的训练范式，将 rollout 分组转为证据卡片，利用任务特定评估动态调整后续 rollout 的上下文；具体指导辅助弱策略，随策略提升再修订或移除非必要上下文，并在部署时丢弃脚手架。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 及七个检索增强 QA 基准上与 SOTA 基线性能相当，且 token 使用量减少 25%-50%；策略使用标准 RLVR 以环境奖励优化。
Conclusion: 作者将该训练脚手架定位为仅在训练期使用、部署时丢弃的适配性支持机制，强调其无需改变底层奖励优化方式。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出以策略为中心的训练范式，将 rollout 分组转为证据卡片，利用任务特定评估动态调整后续 rollout 的上下文；具体指导辅助弱策略，随策略提升再修订或移除非必要上下文，并在部署时丢弃脚手架。
summary_sections.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 及七个检索增强 QA 基准上与 SOTA 基线性能相当，且 token 使用量减少 25%-50%；策略使用标准 RLVR 以环境奖励优化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将该训练脚手架定位为仅在训练期使用、部署时丢弃的适配性支持机制，强调其无需改变底层奖励优化方式。

papers.title: Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions
papers.abstract_en: Deep Research agents conduct long-horizon investigations by iteratively planning, retrieving evidence, and generating reports. However, it remains unclear whether they can resist apparently credible but factually false information introduced into these workflows. To study this failure mode, we introduce MisKnow-Agent, a controlled evaluation framework that constructs task-specific documents supporting manually audited false conclusions with controlled authority cues and source styles. Applied to the tasks from DeepResearch Bench, it generates 5,933 misleading documents after filtering. We evaluate DeerFlow and WebThinker with three backbone LLMs, together with Gemini Deep Research, using a report-level false-conclusion adoption rate (FCAR) that counts only reports endorsing the false conclusion. Across the configurations, introducing one misleading document increases the mean FCAR from 0\% in the no-injection control to 54.7\%. FCAR varies substantially with lifecycle stage and framework design, and also with source authority and presentation style, whereas search-result rank and additional documents beyond the first have limited influence. Although cross-model verification consistently classifies retained instances as misleading, Deep Research agents can still adopt the corresponding false conclusions during long-horizon research. Pre- and post-research defenses reduce FCAR but do not eliminate adoption, motivating continuous verification when evidence enters intermediate research states and final synthesis. To facilitate reproducibility, our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/whfeLingYu/MisKnow-Agent and https://huggingface.co/datasets/whfeLingYu/Misleading_Knowledge, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Deep Research 智能体在长时程调研中是否会采纳看似可信但事实虚假的信息，并为此提出受控评测框架 MisKnow-Agent。基于 DeepResearch Bench 任务构造 5,933 篇误导性文档后，作者评测 DeerFlow、WebThinker（配三种骨干大模型）和 Gemini Deep Research，发现注入一篇误导文档会使报告级错误结论采纳率 (FCAR) 从 0% 升至平均 54.7%。论文还分析了生命周期阶段、框架设计、来源权威性与呈现风格对 FCAR 的影响，并检验了前后置防御手段的效果。
Motivation: Deep Research 智能体通过迭代规划、检索证据和生成报告完成长时程调研，但其能否抵御过程中看似可信、实为虚假的信息尚不明确；现有工作缺少对这一失败模式的受控评测。
Method: 提出 MisKnow-Agent 受控评测框架，为每个任务构造支持人工审计错误结论的文档，并控制权威线索 (authority cues) 与来源风格；用报告级错误结论采纳率 (FCAR) 衡量智能体最终报告是否明确认可虚假结论，评测多种框架、骨干模型与防御配置。
Result: 在无注入对照组中 FCAR 为 0%，注入一篇误导文档后平均 FCAR 升至 54.7%；FCAR 随生命周期阶段、框架设计、来源权威性和呈现风格显著变化，而搜索结果排名及首篇之后的额外文档影响有限。跨模型验证虽能将留存实例一致判为误导，但智能体在长时程调研中仍会采纳相应错误结论；前置与后置防御可降低但无法消除 FCAR。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Deep Research 智能体对误导性知识的脆弱性，并指出需要在证据进入中间研究状态及最终综合阶段时进行持续验证，而不能仅依赖一次性防御；代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
papers.abstract_en: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告在 Ascend NPU SuperPOD 上对 DeepSeek-V4 系列模型进行全参数后训练（post-training）的系统优化实践，提出名为 SLAI T-Rex 的端到端框架，覆盖模型并行、计算-通信编排与底层 kernel 执行。系统达到 34.22% 的 MFU，较开源基线配方提升 2.93 倍，并基于该基础设施为复杂运筹优化（OR）任务构建 CPT 与 SFT 流程，得到含 10K 高质量 SFT 样本的领域数据集。在 OR 任务上，使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 微调出的专用模型平均零样本 Pass@1 达到 71.81%，超过 GPT-5.4-Mini 与基础 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型。
Motivation: 万亿参数规模 MoE 模型的全参数后训练在分布式训练中面临严重内存压力、通信无法重叠以及 kernel 执行低效等系统级挑战，且现有大规模训练系统大多基于 GPU 集群，缺乏在 Ascend NPU 平台上的端到端优化方案。
Method: 提出分层优化框架 SLAI T-Rex，从模型级并行、计算与通信编排、底层 kernel 执行三个层面进行联合优化；随后建立面向 OR 任务的 CPT 与 SFT 数据流水线，结合收集的领域资源与 solver 验证的合成优化文档，构建跨四个任务类别、三种问题表示的数据集。
Result: 系统训练实现 34.22% 的 Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU)，相对开源基线配方提升 2.93 倍，并保持训练稳定性；基于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的专用模型在评估模型中获得最高平均零样本 Pass@1，达 71.81%，分别超过 GPT-5.4-Mini 和基础 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 3.98 与 11.27 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作展示了从 Ascend 基础设施上的高效万亿参数后训练到面向 solver 约束数学建模的领域专用 Flash 模型的完整技术路径，推动复杂推理的前沿模型系统发展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, holiday, and network data; every observable signal is archived in full-system snapshots; and each evaluation case is labeled by a pointer to an existing record rather than by post-hoc annotation or a large language model (LLM) judge. We evaluate this method with 16 personas in Beijing. The generated data closely matches the held-out real-user benchmark in category distribution (Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) 0.070) and in the daily rhythm of communication records (JSD below 0.1), though generated records remain shorter than real ones. Without scripted interaction, personas form a fully reciprocated dialogue subgraph and differentiated behavioral repertoires. Projected into 717 evaluation cases, the generated data exposes 78 failures in a production smartphone assistant, concentrating on call and Short Message Service (SMS) records while contacts, schedules, and alarms never fail. The snapshot pointer confirms each failure as an assistant-side retrieval error, with no LLM judge involved. Overall, SenWorld offers a privacy-safe, reproducible, and distribution-checked path to evaluation data whose labels are fixed by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SenWorld，一个基于物理约束、确定性事件溯源 (event-sourced) 的数字孪生仿真系统，用于生成智能手机个人助手评测所需的上下文丰富数据，且标签由构造固定。作者在北京用 16 个 persona 评估该方法，生成数据在类别分布上与真实用户基准接近 (JSD 0.070)，通信记录的日常节奏也接近真实 (JSD 低于 0.1)，但生成的记录偏短。将数据投影为 717 个评测样本后，暴露了生产环境手机助手的 78 个失败，且快照指针确认这些失败均为助手侧检索错误，全程无需 LLM 裁判。
Motivation: 智能手机个人助手需要基于长期纵向个人数据进行推理，但其评测需要既有上下文丰富又已知正确答案的数据；真实设备痕迹因隐私敏感难以共享，因此需要一种能生成带固定真值标签的评测数据的方法。
Method: SenWorld 用真实地图、天气、节假日和网络数据构建一个物理世界，每名 persona 在其中生活一整天；所有可观测信号存档于全系统快照中，每个评测样本通过指针指向已存在的记录来标注，而非采用事后标注或 LLM 裁判。
Result: 在 16 个北京 persona 上，生成数据与留出的真实用户基准在类别分布上 JSD 为 0.070，通信记录日常节奏的 JSD 低于 0.1，尽管生成记录比真实记录更短。717 个评测样本中，生产环境助手出现 78 个失败，集中在电话和短信记录上，而联系人、日程和闹钟从未失败；快照指针证明这些失败是助手侧检索错误。
Conclusion: SenWorld 提供了一条隐私安全、可复现且经过分布校验的评测数据生成路径，其标签由构造固定，不依赖后验标注或 LLM 判断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PathAgentBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Seeking Vision-Language Models on Whole-Slide Pathology Image
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide image (WSI) diagnosis requires identifying diagnostically relevant regions, examining them across magnifications, and integrating multi-scale evidence. However, most existing pathology benchmarks evaluate models on pre-cropped patches or pre-extracted slide features, leaving their ability to acquire evidence directly from gigapixel WSIs largely untested. We introduce PathAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-seeking vision-language models (VLMs) across four complementary capabilities: image-to-text matching for evidence interpretation, text-to-image retrieval for evidence verification, diagnostic-region localization for evidence acquisition, and multi-scale reasoning for evidence integration. The benchmark is organized as a diagnostic tree that links nested regions across magnifications with scale-specific findings and path-level diagnoses. It contains 1,822 TCGA WSIs and 17,135 diagnostic paths annotated by ten board-certified pathologists. An additional private cohort of 190 breast cancer WSIs with detailed annotations is used to evaluate autonomous whole-slide exploration. We evaluate 20 general-purpose, medical, and pathology-specialized models. Leading open-weight models achieve over 93% accuracy in multi-scale reasoning and over 50% accuracy in both cross-modal matching tasks. In contrast, diagnostic-region localization remains challenging: the best text-guided mean intersection-over-union is below 0.09, underperforming a simple center-based heuristic. During autonomous exploration, the unconditional hit rate decreases from 0.522 at low magnification to 0.185 at intermediate magnification and 0.020 at high magnification. These results reveal a pronounced gap between reasoning over curated evidence and acquiring that evidence directly from WSIs. PathAgentBench provides a unified framework for measuring and improving evidence-seeking pathology models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PathAgentBench，一个评估视觉语言模型（VLM）直接从千兆像素全切片病理图像（whole-slide image, WSI）中获取证据能力的基准。基准以诊断树组织跨放大倍数的嵌套区域、尺度相关发现与路径级诊断，包含 1,822 张 TCGA WSI 和 17,135 条由十位认证病理学家标注的诊断路径。评估 20 个通用、医学与病理专用模型后发现，多尺度推理和跨模态匹配表现较好，但诊断区域定位与自主全切片探索能力明显不足。
Motivation: 现有病理基准大多在预裁剪的 patch 或预提取的 slide features 上评测模型，无法检验模型直接从千兆像素 WSI 中获取证据的能力。作者希望用一个统一框架衡量证据获取型（evidence-seeking）病理 VLM 的实际表现。
Method: 构建包含四个互补能力的 PathAgentBench：图像到文本匹配（证据解释）、文本到图像检索（证据验证）、诊断区域定位（证据获取）以及多尺度推理（证据整合）。基准以诊断树结构组织，并额外使用 190 张带详细标注的乳腺癌 WSI 私有队列评估自主全切片探索。
Result: 领先开源模型在多尺度推理上准确率超过 93%，在两个跨模态匹配任务上超过 50%；但诊断区域定位仍具挑战，最佳文本引导平均交并比（mIoU）低于 0.09，不如简单中心启发式。自主探索中，无条件命中率从低放大倍率的 0.522 降至中等倍率的 0.185 和高倍率的 0.020。
Conclusion: 结果揭示了模型在已整理证据上的推理与直接从 WSI 获取证据之间的显著差距；PathAgentBench 为测量和改进证据获取型病理模型提供了统一框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 PathAgentBench，一个评估视觉语言模型（VLM）直接从千兆像素全切片病理图像（whole-slide image, WSI）中获取证据能力的基准。基准以诊断树组织跨放大倍数的嵌套区域、尺度相关发现与路径级诊断，包含 1,822 张 TCGA WSI 和 17,135 条由十位认证病理学家标注的诊断路径。评估 20 个通用、医学与病理专用模型后发现，多尺度推理和跨模态匹配表现较好，但诊断区域定位与自主全切片探索能力明显不足。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有病理基准大多在预裁剪的 patch 或预提取的 slide features 上评测模型，无法检验模型直接从千兆像素 WSI 中获取证据的能力。作者希望用一个统一框架衡量证据获取型（evidence-seeking）病理 VLM 的实际表现。
summary_sections.method: 构建包含四个互补能力的 PathAgentBench：图像到文本匹配（证据解释）、文本到图像检索（证据验证）、诊断区域定位（证据获取）以及多尺度推理（证据整合）。基准以诊断树结构组织，并额外使用 190 张带详细标注的乳腺癌 WSI 私有队列评估自主全切片探索。

papers.title: Text Template Tokens Are Implicit Semantic Registers in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate images through joint attention, in which text and image tokens interact directly within a single sequence. In large-scale DiTs, the conditioning input contains not only the user prompt but also chat-template tokens introduced by LLM-based text encoders. Yet how these tokens participate in the denoising computation remains poorly understood. To probe this, we introduce a causal interpretability framework. Using it to separate prompt-content tokens from chat-template tokens, we find that the template tokens carry little prompt-specific information at the encoder output. Yet surprisingly, they emerge as dominant image-to-text attention sinks and causally maintain object identity inside the DiT, acting as implicit semantic registers. We show that they acquire this identity indirectly. Rather than reading the prompt tokens, they draw the identity from the image latents into which the prompt semantics have already been injected at the very first layer. We further reveal a division of labor across heads and depth in DiTs, where distinct heads route semantics or render visual structure, and identity is committed in early blocks, carried by middle blocks, and refined in late ones. As a practical payoff, this analysis yields a training-free pruning rule that removes the causally inert prompt-reading heads and cuts $20\%$ of joint-attention FLOPs at a $1.4$-point cost in GenEval accuracy. Overall, our work not only reveals that the tokens encoding semantics at the input need not be those that maintain them during generation, but also provides a causal view of internal mechanisms in diffusion transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散Transformer（DiT）中文档模板token的作用提出一套因果可解释性框架，将提示内容token与聊天模板token分离。摘要发现模板token在编码器输出处几乎不携带提示特定信息，却意外地成为主导的image-to-text注意力汇聚点（attention sinks），并因果地维持物体身份，充当隐式语义寄存器；身份来自图像潜变量而非提示token。作者还揭示了不同注意力头和深度层次的分工，并据此提出免训练的剪枝规则，削减20%的联合注意力FLOPs，GenEval精度仅下降1.4点。
Motivation: 大规模DiT中，基于LLM的文本编码器会引入聊天模板token，但这类token如何参与去噪计算以及是否影响生成语义仍不清楚，缺乏因果层面的解释。
Method: 提出因果可解释性框架，分离提示内容token与聊天模板token，通过干预和因果归因分析它们在注意力中的角色，并基于因果惰性头部识别提出训练免剪枝规则。
Result: 摘要报告模板token作为隐式语义寄存器，间接从图像潜变量获取身份并维持物体身份；不同头分别负责语义路由或视觉结构渲染，身份在早期块确定、中间块携带、晚期块细化；剪枝可减少20%联合注意力FLOPs，GenEval精度代价为1.4点。
Conclusion: 作者强调，输入中编码语义的token并不一定是在生成过程中维持语义的token，该工作为扩散Transformer内部机制提供了因果视角。

papers.title: Optimizing Regret
papers.abstract_en: Building on the identity that expected regret equals the covariance between costs and decisions, this paper develops a derivative theory of the covariance regret functional. We derive the Gâteaux derivative, showing that the universal steepest-descent direction is the contrarian policy $-(c-\bar c)$, while ascent yields momentum. For linear policies $\hatπ(c)=Ac+b$, the gradient is the cost covariance matrix $Σ_c$, with a zero Hessian implying boundary-optimal solutions such as the minimum-variance portfolio. We extend to constrained optimization, sign-gradient duality between regret minimization and alpha maximization, finite-sample convergence bounds paralleling Thompson Sampling, and gradient-descent algorithms requiring only input observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在期望遗憾等于成本与决策之间协方差这一恒等式的基础上，发展了一个关于协方差遗憾泛函的微分理论。作者推导出 Gâteaux 导数，证明通用最陡下降方向是逆向策略 (contrarian policy) $-(c-\bar c)$，上升方向则产生动量；对线性策略 $\hat\pi(c)=Ac+b$ 而言，梯度为成本协方差矩阵 $\Sigma_c$，Hessian 为零，因此最优解在边界上，例如最小方差组合。文中还扩展到约束优化、遗憾最小化与 alpha 最大化之间的符号梯度对偶、与 Thompson Sampling 平行的有限样本收敛界，以及仅需输入观测的梯度下降算法。
Motivation: 传统遗憾最小化方法往往依赖具体策略结构或近似，本文试图利用期望遗憾与协方差之间的恒等式，为遗憾泛函建立一种可求导的理论框架，从而直接导出最优策略方向和算法。
Method: 基于期望遗憾等于成本与决策间协方差的恒等式，推导协方差遗憾泛函的 Gâteaux 导数，识别最陡下降方向为逆向策略；对于线性策略，给出梯度等于成本协方差矩阵且 Hessian 为零的分析，并推广到带约束优化、符号梯度对偶和仅需输入观测的梯度下降算法。
Result: 摘要给出的理论结果表明：通用最陡下降方向是 $-(c-\bar c)$，上升方向对应动量；线性策略下的梯度为 $\Sigma_c$，零 Hessian 导致边界最优解（如最小方差组合）；并得到与 Thompson Sampling 平行的有限样本收敛界。
Conclusion: 本文建立了一个基于协方差恒等式的遗憾优化微分框架，并指出其与 alpha 最大化之间的对偶关系，为设计无需显式模型、仅依赖输入观测的梯度下降算法提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlexiGrad: Adaptive Gradient Modulation for Hierarchical Fine-Grained Classification
papers.abstract_en: Many fine-grained recognition tasks contain hierarchical labels such as order, family and species. Although this supervision should be beneficial, jointly optimising all levels often leads to unstable training because coarse and fine classifiers impose inconsistent gradients on the shared backbone. This hierarchical gradient conflict prevents the model from learning a coherent coarse-to-fine representation. In this paper, we propose FlexiGrad, a simple and parameter-free method that regulates gradient interactions during backpropagation. FlexiGrad removes only the harmful conflicting component when tasks disagree and reinforces the shared direction when they partially agree through a smooth hierarchy-aware weighting function. This produces stable optimisation and preserves both global structure and fine-grained discriminative cues. FlexiGrad integrates into existing architectures without modification while improves multi-granularity accuracy on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft and Stanford Cars. The code will be available at PRIS-CV/FlexiGrad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexiGrad，一种简单且无参数的梯度调制方法，用于层次化细粒度分类。层次标签（如目、科、种）的联合优化中，粗粒度和细粒度分类器会对共享骨干产生不一致梯度，引发层级梯度冲突；FlexiGrad 在任务不一致时只移除有害的冲突分量，在部分一致时通过平滑的层次感知加权函数强化共享方向，从而稳定优化并保留全局结构与细粒度判别线索。该方法可直接集成到现有架构而无需修改，并在 CUB-200-2011、FGVC-Aircraft 和 Stanford Cars 上提升多粒度准确率。
Motivation: 在带层次标签的细粒度识别任务中，同时优化所有层级常导致训练不稳定，因为粗粒度和细粒度分类器对共享骨干施加的梯度不一致；这种层级梯度冲突阻碍模型学习一致的粗到细表示。
Method: 提出 FlexiGrad，一个无参数的梯度调制方法，在反向传播时调节梯度交互：当层级任务不一致时删除有害的冲突分量，当部分一致时用平滑的层次感知加权函数增强共享方向，且无需修改现有架构即可集成。
Result: 摘要报告在 CUB-200-2011、FGVC-Aircraft 和 Stanford Cars 上多粒度准确率均获得提升，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FlexiGrad 能稳定优化并同时保留全局结构和细粒度判别信息，代码将公开于 PRIS-CV/FlexiGrad；摘要未涉及限制或更多验证细节。

papers.title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
papers.abstract_en: Question-order effects in human survey data have been reported to approximately satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, a parameter-free prediction of the standard projective quantum question-order model. We develop this equality into an audit framework for sequential binary judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize mechanism families that satisfy QQ robustly, show that classical repetition can reproduce the equality exactly, and combine QQ with the rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion through $|q_{QQ}| \le \mathrm{OSS}$. This separates order sensitivity, QQ imbalance, and residual contextuality rather than treating them as interchangeable signatures. Methodologically, we introduce a committed multi-turn forced-branch protocol that reconstructs order-conditioned joint distributions from next-token log-probabilities under counterbalanced label mappings and pre-specified health gates. A first-signal pilot on an open-weight instruction-tuned model reveals the central measurement problem. Although all pre-specified health gates passed, the binary-conditioned distributions were near-deterministic for 17 of 18 item pairs under the direct-evaluation framing and 7 of 8 under the persona framing. Label assignment materially changed several mapping-specific QQ verdicts, and no item was certified as residually contextual. Thus, under the tested conditions, the observed QQ outcomes did not uniquely identify a response mechanism in the presence of a saturated and label-sensitive measurement interface. The main implication is methodological: next-token probabilities should not be interpreted as survey-response distributions without first establishing adequate dispersion. We therefore argue that saturation screening and label counterbalancing should precede structural interpretation in distribution-level audits of LLM judgments.
papers.comment: v2: major revision. Five restructured findings separating order sensitivity, QQ imbalance, and residual contextuality; two-layer discriminant table; pipeline figure and per-item joint table; envelope pooling and certified Gamma bounds specified; retrospective batch-1 G3 re-validation (all verdicts preserved). No new pilot measurements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将量子问题序模型中的 QQ (quantum question) 等式发展为对自回归大语言模型顺序二值判断的审计框架。理论上刻画了满足 QQ 等式的机制族，指出经典重复可精确复现该等式，并用 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS 将 QQ 与 rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default 判据结合。方法论上提出多轮强制分支协议，从 next-token log-probabilities 重建顺序条件联合分布；在开放权重指令微调模型的初步实验中，发现 17/18 个直接评估项目和 7/8 个 personas 框架项目的二值条件分布接近确定性，标签分配会改变多个 QQ 判定，且没有项目被认证为残留情境性 (residual contextuality)。
Motivation: 人类调查数据中的问题序效应近似满足 QQ 等式这一无参数预测，而现有 LLM 审计缺乏对顺序敏感性、QQ 不平衡与残余情境性的区分框架。作者希望把 QQ 等式发展为检验 LLM 顺序二值判断的结构性工具，并指出核心测量问题：饱和的 next-token 分布使观察到的 QQ 结果无法唯一识别响应机制。
Method: 提出基于 QQ 等式的审计框架：理论上刻画稳健满足 QQ 的机制族，证明经典重复可精确复现等式，并通过 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS 将 QQ 与 rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default 判据关联；方法论上引入多轮强制分支协议，在反平衡标签映射和预先设定的健康门 (health gates) 下从 next-token log-probabilities 重建顺序条件联合分布。
Result: 初步实验显示，尽管所有预设健康门均通过，直接评估框架下 18 个项目对中有 17 个、personas 框架下 8 个中有 7 个的二值条件分布接近确定性；标签分配实质上改变了几项映射特定的 QQ 判定，且没有项目被认证为残余情境性。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是方法学层面的：next-token 概率不能未经检验就被视为调查响应分布，分布级 LLM 判断审计应先进行饱和度筛查 (saturation screening) 和标签反平衡 (label counterbalancing)，再进行结构解释；在饱和且标签敏感的测量界面下，QQ 结果不足以唯一识别响应机制。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文将量子问题序模型中的 QQ (quantum question) 等式发展为对自回归大语言模型顺序二值判断的审计框架。理论上刻画了满足 QQ 等式的机制族，指出经典重复可精确复现该等式，并用 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS 将 QQ 与 rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default 判据结合。方法论上提出多轮强制分支协议，从 next-token log-probabilities 重建顺序条件联合分布；在开放权重指令微调模型的初步实验中，发现 17/18 个直接评估项目和 7/8 个 personas 框架项目的二值条件分布接近确定性，标签分配会改变多个 QQ 判定，且没有项目被认证为残留情境性 (residual contextuality)。

summary_sections.method: 提出基于 QQ 等式的审计框架：理论上刻画稳健满足 QQ 的机制族，证明经典重复可精确复现等式，并通过 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS 将 QQ 与 rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default 判据关联；方法论上引入多轮强制分支协议，在反平衡标签映射和预先设定的健康门 (health gates) 下从 next-token log-probabilities 重建顺序条件联合分布。
summary_sections.result: 初步实验显示，尽管所有预设健康门均通过，直接评估框架下 18 个项目对中有 17 个、personas 框架下 8 个中有 7 个的二值条件分布接近确定性；标签分配实质上改变了几项映射特定的 QQ 判定，且没有项目被认证为残余情境性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者的结论是方法学层面的：next-token 概率不能未经检验就被视为调查响应分布，分布级 LLM 判断审计应先进行饱和度筛查 (saturation screening) 和标签反平衡 (label counterbalancing)，再进行结构解释；在饱和且标签敏感的测量界面下，QQ 结果不足以唯一识别响应机制。

papers.title: RELIC: Revealed Principles for Learning Interpretable Composable Skills in Multi-Agent Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent planning becomes substantially harder when agents must improve specialized decision-making skills while keeping their executable implementations private. This setting arises when independently developed agents expose heterogeneous interfaces, observations, and capabilities, yet must coordinate under a shared team objective. Existing approaches commonly rely on centralized optimization, shared policy access, or common skill representations, assumptions that limit knowledge reuse when function signatures differ. We introduce RELIC, a framework for learning interpretable and composable programmatic skills through revealed principles. Each agent improves its own executable skill locally, while useful decision logic and coordination patterns are distilled into compact textual principles. Rather than requiring direct program exchange, these abstractions can be re-instantiated under agent-specific interfaces and reused across incompatible implementation spaces. A shared principle memory accumulates transferable knowledge and promotes abstractions that repeatedly improve team-level performance. This separation allows discoveries made by one agent to guide others while preserving local executable implementations and decentralized execution. RELIC therefore supports strategic transfer across both heterogeneous-role and shared-role cooperative teams. Extensive experiments across routing, scheduling, combinatorial optimization, and distributed coordination settings demonstrate RELIC's effectiveness against independent and joint LLM-based search methods, together with consistent benefits across task structures and LLM backbones.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RELIC框架，用于多智能体规划中学习可解释且可组合的程序化技能。每个智能体在本地改进自身可执行技能，同时将有用的决策逻辑与协调模式蒸馏为紧凑的文本原则（textual principles），存入共享原则记忆，从而在不交换程序的情况下跨异构接口复用知识。实验覆盖路由、调度、组合优化和分布式协调等场景，显示RELIC优于独立的和联合的基于LLM的搜索方法。
Motivation: 多智能体规划中，智能体需要在保持可执行实现私有的同时改进专业化决策技能，且各智能体接口、观测和能力异构。现有方法通常依赖集中优化、共享策略访问或共同技能表示，当函数签名不同时知识复用受限。
Method: RELIC通过‘揭示原则’（revealed principles）学习技能：每个智能体本地改进可执行技能，将决策逻辑和协调模式提炼为紧凑文本原则，共享原则记忆随团队表现反复提升而积累可迁移知识。这些抽象可在智能体特定接口下重新实例化，从而跨不兼容实现空间复用，同时保留本地可执行实现与去中心化执行。
Result: 摘要报告在路由、调度、组合优化和分布式协调等大量实验中，RELIC相对独立和联合的基于LLM的搜索方法均有效，并且在任务结构和LLM骨干上表现出一致收益。
Conclusion: 这种将知识发现与本地可执行实现分离的设计，使一个智能体的发现可以指导其他智能体，同时保持本地实现和去中心化执行，支持异构角色与共享角色协作团队中的策略迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its operating regime in reinforcement-learning post-training remains unclear. We map this regime on ALFWorld, a sparse-reward agentic benchmark, using three group-based objectives and Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 3B. Under a shared KL and clipping recipe, matched optimizer comparisons and AdamW learning-rate controls trace the usable step-size range. AdamW responds non-monotonically to its learning rate, whereas fan-in Muon remains stable at a more aggressive effective step. At a learning rate of 3 x 10^-5, it improves late success over an AdamW 10^-6 baseline after correction across rate-metric tests. Its normalized-AUC effect is directionally positive but less uniform; the heuristic-matched lower-rate effect is less consistent, and tuned AdamW nearly matches high-rate Muon on 3B GraphGPO. High-rate Muon applies 3.53 times AdamW's hidden-matrix update RMS, while a full-budget RMS-matched control removes the late-success gain. Together, these results identify a recipe-level operating regime in which fan-in Muon supports a more aggressive stable effective step under shared KL and clipping. The margin is largest when optimization headroom remains and contracts near saturation, after AdamW tuning, or under magnitude matching. The scale-matched control ties this spectral effect to Muon's scaling convention rather than establishing a universal optimizer ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 ALFWorld 稀疏奖励智能体基准上，系统绘制了 Muon 优化器在强化学习后训练（RL post-training）中的适用区间，使用三种基于分组的训练目标以及 0.5B 到 3B 的 Qwen2.5 模型。在共享 KL 与裁剪设置的匹配优化器对比下，fan-in Muon 在更激进的等效步长下保持稳定，而 AdamW 对学习率呈非单调响应；在 3e-5 学习率下 Muon 相比 AdamW 1e-6 基线提升了晚期成功率，但增益在 AdamW 调优或幅值匹配（magnitude matching）后收缩。
Motivation: Muon 在大规模预训练中可与 AdamW 竞争，但它在强化学习后训练中的运行区间尚不明确，作者希望界定其有效的超参与目标设置条件。
Method: 在 ALFWorld 上对三种基于分组的 RL 目标进行匹配的优化器对比，引入 AdamW 学习率扫描作为控制，并设计全预算 RMS 匹配控制实验，以区分 Muon 的缩放约定（scaling convention）带来的谱效应。
Result: 在 3e-5 学习率下，fan-in Muon 经率-指标检验校正后相比 AdamW 1e-6 基线提升晚期成功率；其归一化 AUC 效应方向为正但不统一，启发式匹配的较低学习率效应不一致，调优后的 AdamW 在 3B GraphGPO 上几乎追平高学习率 Muon。高学习率 Muon 的隐矩阵更新 RMS 是 AdamW 的 3.53 倍，而全预算 RMS 匹配控制消除了晚期成功率的提升。
Conclusion: 这些结果界定了一个配方级（recipe-level）运行区间：在共享 KL 与裁剪下，fan-in Muon 支持更激进的稳定等效步长；当优化余量（headroom）存在时边际最大，在接近饱和、AdamW 调优后或幅值匹配下边际收缩。作者强调这一谱效应来自 Muon 的缩放约定，而非普遍的优化器排序。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Closed-Loop Bayesian Bandit Encoder with GRAND Receiver for a Bursty Interference Channel
papers.abstract_en: Interleaving mitigates burst errors but introduces decoding delay and removes temporal error structure that a channel-aware decoder could exploit. We consider packet-level selection between a random linear code and the same code used with cross-codeword interleaving, over a channel with an unknown number of on/off interferers. The receiver uses Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (GRAND) with a replaceable noise model and feeds aggregate channel statistics back to a Bayesian estimator at the transmitter. Once the interference amplitudes and timing parameters are estimated, the receiver's noise model is replaced: it computes hidden-Markov-model posterior bit-flip probabilities and uses them to order GRAND queries. A discounted Thompson sampler selects between the two transmission modes using a goodput-minus-latency reward whose distribution is endogenously nonstationary: receiver adaptation, rather than channel change, alters the value of each mode. Across five simulation seeds, the interleaved mode is preferred before channel estimation converges. After the learned decoder is activated, the non-interleaved mode becomes preferable because it achieves lower block error rate without interleaving delay. In the reference configuration, the learned noise model reduces block error rate by approximately one order of magnitude relative to ORBGRAND. Using partial channel estimates before full convergence reduces pre-convergence block error rate by up to $4.5\times$. Adding model-predicted utilities as confidence-weighted pseudo-observations reduces post-transition selection of the inferior arm by approximately $65\%$. Under an idealized airtime conversion at a 100~MHz 5G~NR-like symbol rate, the learning transient corresponds to a few milliseconds of occupied symbol time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究突发干扰信道下，在随机线性码与其交叉码字交织（interleaving）版本之间做数据包级自适应选择的闭环编码方案。接收端采用可替换噪声模型的 GRAND 解码器，并把聚合信道统计反馈给发送端的贝叶斯估计器；估计收敛后接收端用隐马尔可夫模型后验比特翻转概率来排序 GRAND 查询。仿真显示，信道估计收敛前优先选择交织模式，而学习后的解码器启用后非交织模式更优，因为其块错误率更低且无交织延迟。
Motivation: 交织可缓解突发错误，但会引入解码延迟并抹平信道时间结构，使信道感知解码器难以利用错误时序信息。在未知数量 on/off 干扰源的突发干扰信道上，需要自适应地在交织与非交织两种传输模式间选择。
Method: 提出一个闭环贝叶斯 bandit 设计：接收端使用 GRAND 解码，噪声模型可从信道统计学习中替换；发送端用贝叶斯估计器估计干扰幅度和时序参数，并以折扣 Thompson 采样依据 goodput 减延迟的奖励选择交织或非交织模式。解码器激活后，噪声模型被替换为基于隐马尔可夫模型后验比特翻转概率的查询排序。
Result: 五组仿真种子上，信道估计收敛前交织模式更受偏好，学习解码器启用后非交织模式更优；在参考配置下，学习到的噪声模型相比 ORBGRAND 将块错误率降低约一个数量级；使用部分信道估计可在完全收敛前将块错误率降低最多 4.5 倍；加入模型预测效用的置信加权伪观测，可将转变后对较差臂的选择降低约 65%；在 100 MHz 5G NR 类符号速率的理想化空口转换下，学习瞬态只占几毫秒符号时间。
Conclusion: 作者提出，接收端自适应解码与发送端模式选择的闭环耦合可以显著降低突发干扰信道下的块错误率并避免不必要的交织延迟，且该学习过程在无线符号时间尺度上足够快。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agent systems create, revise, and retire their own skills, but every such loop assumes a reliable evaluation metric already exists. In many real applications none does. We show the metric itself can be the evolving object: our loop searches compositions of small typed drawback detectors under a full evolutionary lifecycle, selecting for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set and regularizing by consensus over unlabeled outputs. What evolves is the function that grades one output, never the fixed task sets it is scored on, and what comes out is an inspectable expression rather than an opaque judge. It is also valid: on code generation it gains 0.21 agreement with hidden ground truth on a locked set that metric selection never reads (paired $p=0.014$), beating the bare LLM judge it contains. Validity is where safety lives: removing the anchor guards collapses the metric into a vacuous always-pass detector while removing the detector lifecycle does not, inverting the lesson from skill evolution. That collapse warns this line of work that downstream task score cannot validate a self-evolved evaluator, since the collapsed metric trains skills just as well. Task score answers only sufficiency, and an evolved metric suffices: \emph{Double Ratchet}, co-evolving the metric with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88--110\% of the lift ground truth or a hand-written rubric buys, across MBPP+, Spider~2.0-Snow, and report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an independent judge caught it and one added detector repaired it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Double Ratchet，将评估指标本身作为可进化对象，与生命周期管理的技能循环共同演化，以解决自进化智能体系统中缺少可靠评估指标的问题。指标进化在完整进化生命周期内搜索小型带类型缺陷检测器 (typed drawback detectors) 的复合，并用十项锚定参考集 (anchored reference set) 和未标注输出上的一致性进行选择与正则化，产出的评估器是可检查的表达式而非黑箱。摘要报告该指标在代码生成上比其所包含的裸 LLM 评判器更接近隐藏真实标签，且移除锚定守卫会导致指标退化为恒通过的检测器。
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体系统自行创建、修订和淘汰技能，但这类循环默认存在可靠的评估指标，而许多真实应用并不具备这一前提；同时下游任务分数无法验证自进化评估器的有效性，因为即使指标退化为恒通过，也能照常训练技能。
Method: 提出 Double Ratchet，将指标与生命周期管理的技能循环共同演化。指标进化通过完整的进化生命周期搜索小型带类型缺陷检测器的组合，以与十项锚定参考集的一致性为选择目标，并用未标注输出上的共识进行正则化；被进化的函数只评价单个输出，不改变被评分的固定任务集。

papers.title: RFMSR: Residual Flow Matching for Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Image super-resolution (ISR) has witnessed remarkable progress with diffusion models and flow matching. The dominant text-to-image (T2I) based approaches leverage large-scale foundation models as generative priors, achieving impressive perceptual quality but at the cost of massive model sizes and prohibitive training expenses. Recent flow-matching-based vision-only approaches have made significant strides; however, they adopt standard flow formulations that transport from a pure Gaussian prior to the data distribution, discarding the rich structural information already present in the low-quality (LQ) input. Furthermore, existing single-step acceleration techniques often forfeit the model's multi-step inference capability. In this paper, we propose Residual Flow Matching for Image Super-Resolution (RFMSR), a vision-only framework that centers the source distribution at the LQ latent, reducing transport distance and preserving structural priors throughout the flow trajectory. We further introduce a two-phase training strategy: Phase I pretrains the velocity field via conditional flow matching, while Phase II applies end-to-end supervision to the single-step prediction while retaining the velocity loss across all timesteps, achieving high-quality single-step generation without sacrificing multi-step refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RFMSR achieves comparable or even superior perceptual quality compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/Faze-Hsw/RFMSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RFMSR（Residual Flow Matching for Image Super-Resolution），一个纯视觉的图像超分辨率框架。它将流匹配的源分布中心放在低质量（LQ）潜在表示上，缩短传输距离并沿流轨迹保留结构先验；同时设计两阶段训练，先通过条件流匹配预训练速度场，再对单步预测施加端到端监督，同时保留所有时间步的速度损失。摘要报告该方法在感知质量上与 SOTA 方法相当或更优，并提供开源代码。
Motivation: 现有基于文生图（T2I）的超分方法依赖大规模基础模型作为生成先验，感知质量好但模型体积和训练成本过高；而近期纯视觉的流匹配方法采用从纯高斯到数据分布的标准流公式，丢弃了 LQ 输入中已有的丰富结构信息。此外，已有的单步加速技术往往牺牲模型的多步推理能力。
Method: RFMSR 将流匹配的源分布中心化到 LQ 潜在表示，从而减小传输距离并保留结构先验。训练采用两阶段策略：阶段一用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）预训练速度场；阶段二在保持所有时间步速度损失的同时，对单步预测施加端到端监督，兼顾单步生成质量与多步细化能力。
Result: 大量实验表明，RFMSR 与现有最先进（SOTA）方法相比取得了相当甚至更优的感知质量；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调以 LQ 潜在为中心源分布并结合两阶段监督训练，可以在不牺牲多步细化能力的前提下实现高质量单步生成；源代码已公开在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: Training-Free Decoding of SAM3 Semantic Responses for Cross-Domain Infrastructure Crack Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain infrastructure crack segmentation is challenged by variations in materials, imaging conditions, crack morphology, and background interference. Although text-promptable foundation models reduce the need for task-specific training, SAM3's native proposal interface may not fully expose the crack evidence already encoded by the frozen model. We identify and quantify an output-interface mismatch in which the internal language-conditioned response preserves ground-truth-aligned crack evidence that is absent from the native proposal output. Based on this finding, we propose \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{E}dge \textbf{R}esponse \textbf{D}ecoding (\textbf{SERD}), a training-free method that replaces proposal-based readout with direct response decoding. SERD normalizes the dense response, calibrates it using a fixed Sobel prior, and applies a single threshold to produce the crack mask. SAM3 remains frozen without any target-domain annotations. Using one source domain solely for threshold selection, SERD achieves an average Crack IoU of 58.00\% on five unseen datasets, compared with 54.33\% for native SAM3. Across six rotated source-domain settings, it obtains a mean target-domain IoU of 60.23\% and a Boundary F1 of 67.18\%, exceeding SAM3 by 3.27 and 2.70 percentage points, respectively. The results show that task-aligned internal-response decoding provides a simple and transferable solution for cross-domain infrastructure crack segmentation. \textit{Code is available at: \href{https://github.com/xauat-liushipeng/SERD}{GitHub}.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域基础设施裂缝分割，指出 SAM3 的本地 proposal 接口并未充分暴露冻结模型内部已编码的裂缝证据，并量化了这一输出接口不匹配（output-interface mismatch）。作者提出无需训练的 SERD 方法，将基于 proposal 的读取替换为直接解码密集语义响应，保持 SAM3 完全冻结且不需要目标域标注。在五个未见数据集上，SERD 的平均 Crack IoU 为 58.00%，优于原生 SAM3 的 54.33%；在六种旋转源域设置下平均目标域 IoU 达 60.23%，Boundary F1 为 67.18%，分别高出 3.27 和 2.70 个百分点。
Motivation: 跨域基础设施裂缝分割受材料、成像条件、裂缝形态和背景干扰等变化的影响，尽管文本提示的 foundation model 减少了任务特定训练需求，但 SAM3 的原生 proposal 输出未能完全呈现内部语言条件响应中已经存在的、与真值对齐的裂缝证据。
Method: 提出 SERD（Semantic-Edge Response Decoding）：对 SAM3 的稠密响应做归一化，用固定的 Sobel 先验校准，再用单一阈值生成裂缝掩码，完全替代 proposal 读取。SAM3 保持冻结，不使用任何目标域标注，仅用单一源域进行阈值选择。
Result: 在五个未见数据集上平均 Crack IoU 为 58.00%，相比原生 SAM3 的 54.33% 提升；在六种旋转源域设置下平均目标域 IoU 为 60.23%，Boundary F1 为 67.18%，较 SAM3 分别提升 3.27 和 2.70 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务对齐的内部响应解码（internal-response decoding）能为跨域基础设施裂缝分割提供简单且可迁移的解决方案，且无需训练；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Backbone-Agnostic Stochastic Perturbation Learning for End-to-End Real-World Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Real-world paired image dehazing remains challenging because haze degradation is spatially non-uniform, illumination-dependent, and physically ambiguous even when haze-free references are available. Existing end-to-end restoration networks usually learn a deterministic mapping from a hazy observation to a clean target, while degradation-sensitive feature responses, reverse haze-formation consistency, and cross-domain negative structure remain insufficiently exploited. In this paper, we propose Backbone-Agnostic Stochastic Perturbation Learning (BSPL), a plug-and-play framework for end-to-end real-world image dehazing. BSPL first introduces a Learnable Stochastic Perturbation Modulator (LSPM), which learns input-conditioned channel-wise and spatial-wise perturbation distributions and converts the resulting feature-response discrepancies into adaptive modulation weights. It then develops a Prior-informed Perturbation-guided Reconstruction Module (PPRM), which reuses the learned bottleneck perturbations together with transmission and atmospheric-light priors to reconstruct the hazy observation from the restored result and enforce degradation consistency. Furthermore, we propose a Dual-space Domain-diversified Distribution-aware Contrastive Loss ($D^3$CL) to regularize both clean restoration and hazy reconstruction spaces with real-world and synthetic negatives. Experiments on five real-world paired benchmarks show that BSPL consistently improves multiple representative backbones with only marginal additional inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Backbone-Agnostic Stochastic Perturbation Learning (BSPL)，一种即插即用的端到端真实图像去雾框架。BSPL 通过可学习随机扰动调制器（LSPM）建模输入条件化的通道/空间扰动分布，并用先验引导的扰动重建模块（PPRM）结合传输图和大气光先验重构有雾观测以施加退化一致性，同时引入双空间对比损失 D3CL 正则化清晰重建与有雾重建空间。在五个真实配对去雾基准上，BSPL 能以极小的额外推理开销稳定提升多种代表性骨干网络。
Motivation: 真实世界的配对图像去雾仍然困难，因为雾霾退化在空间上不均匀、依赖光照且物理上具有歧义；现有端到端网络通常学习从有雾观测到干净目标的确定性映射，对退化敏感的特征响应、逆雾形成一致性和跨域负结构利用不足。
Method: 提出 LSPM 学习输入条件化的逐通道与逐空间扰动分布，并将特征响应差异转化为自适应调制权重；设计 PPRM 复用瓶颈扰动并结合传输图和大气光先验，从恢复结果重构有雾观测以强制退化一致性；进一步提出双空间域多样化分布感知对比损失（D3CL），利用真实与合成负样本同时正则化清晰恢复空间和有雾重建空间。
Result: 在五个真实世界配对去雾基准上的实验表明，BSPL 能一致地提升多个代表性去雾骨干网络的性能，且仅引入极小的额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BSPL 是骨干无关的即插即用框架，通过随机扰动学习和退化一致性约束改善端到端真实图像去雾。

papers.title: Interpreting learning dynamics of autoencoders: Transient scaling and emerging concepts of the Ising model
papers.abstract_en: We study how unsupervised autoencoders trained on microscopic spin configurations from the Ising model learn macroscopic, theory-relevant variables underlying the data-generating process. We quantify learning across multiple spatial (coarse-graining) scales and reveal two distinct dynamical regimes that appear sequentially, controlled by the main hyperparameters (model depth, width, and learning rate): one in which magnetization and another in which energy is learned across scales. The first exhibits error fluctuations ordered to scale and learns global averages only; The second gradually resolves smaller scales relevant for the energy representation. Deep models trained at moderate and fast rates become arrested before reaching these regimes. We connect reconstruction errors with the latent representations using a novel analysis of self-recursive trajectories. These intrinsic dynamics are induced by prediction errors, exposing how training drives representation changes for macroscopic concepts. We utilize the intuition that learning operates as a process driven far from equilibrium by fluctuations from the training data to provide an interpretive basis grounded in both the physical world and the machine models that represent it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 Ising 模型微观自旋构型上训练的无监督自编码器如何学习数据生成过程背后的宏观可观测量（磁化强度 magnetization 与能量 energy），并跨多个空间粗粒化尺度量化学习过程。作者发现由模型深度、宽度和学习率控制的两个依次出现的动力学区域，并引入自递归轨迹分析把重建误差与隐表示联系起来。学习被解释为一种由训练数据波动驱动的远离平衡的过程，为理解物理世界与其机器表示提供基础。
Motivation: 目标是从理解角度回答无监督模型如何从微观数据中涌现出理论相关的宏观变量，以 Ising 模型作为可控测试平台，揭示学习动力学的内在机制。
Method: 在 Ising 模型的自旋构型上训练自编码器，跨多个空间（粗粒化）尺度量化学习过程；通过超参数（深度、宽度、学习率）控制动力学行为；提出自递归轨迹分析，把重建误差与隐表示的演化联系起来，并用远离平衡的涨落驱动过程解释训练动力学。
Result: 摘要报告两个依次出现且由超参数控制的动力学区域：一个区域跨尺度学习磁化强度，仅学习全局平均且误差涨落按尺度有序；另一个逐步解析与能量表示相关的较小尺度。中等和快速学习率下的深度模型在到达这些区域之前停滞。

papers.title: Geometric mean-based pairwise comparison method with the reference values -- statistical approach
papers.abstract_en: For many years, the decision-making method based on pairwise comparison of alternatives has been frequently and readily used for decision-making with the participation of experts. The best-known example of this method is the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). In this now classic approach, the weights of alternatives are calculated using the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix. In this paper, we present a statistical view of the pairwise comparison method using reference values and the geometric mean to calculate alternative priorities. Thanks to this approach, we can simultaneously capture the phenomenon of inconsistency in pairwise comparisons and the preference distance between different alternatives. In this paper, we define indicators that measure the quality of the obtained weight vector, which, thanks to the statistical approach, have an understandable interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出成对比较法（pairwise comparison）在采用参考值和几何平均计算备选方案优先级时的统计视角。作者认为该框架能同时刻画成对比较的不一致性以及不同备选方案之间的偏好距离，并定义了一组衡量所得权重向量质量的指标，这些指标在统计框架下有可解释的含义。摘要未报告具体数值实验。
Motivation: 经典的 Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) 用比较矩阵的主特征向量计算权重，但处理不一致性和偏好距离时缺少直接的概率或统计解释。作者希望为基于参考值与几何平均的成对比较方法建立统计基础，使质量指标具有清晰语义。
Method: 论文提出一种统计化的成对比较方法：以参考值为基准、用几何平均计算备选方案权重，并在此基础上定义用于评价权重向量质量的指标。该指标借助统计视角同时解释成对比较的不一致性和备选方案间的偏好距离。
Result: 摘要没有给出数据集、基线或数值结果；主要成果是权重向量质量指标的提出及其统计可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该统计方法能同时捕捉成对比较中的不一致现象与备选方案间的偏好距离，且质量指标易于理解。论文涉及的是决策方法理论，摘要未提及具体应用领域。

papers.title: Exposure is not manifestation: measurement target and output resolution jointly determine which behavioural-faithfulness evaluator wins
papers.abstract_en: Behavioural auditing asks whether a language model behaves as it claims, but detection scores are reported without separating two targets: whether a reply was produced under a behaviour-inducing condition (exposure) and whether the behaviour surfaced in it (manifestation). Scoring a compact 146-million-parameter auditor's frozen-representation read-out and a frontier judge against each label on the identical 720 replies, the gap between the instruments moves by roughly 0.2 AUROC when the target changes. Under the judge's deployed interface, a single verdict, the ranking reverses: the auditor leads on exposure, 0.804 against 0.718, and trails on manifestation, 0.690 against 0.811. Matching the output resolution from either direction, by asking the judge a target-specific question answered with a continuous confidence score or by thresholding the auditor's read-out, removes the reversal but not the interaction, which excludes zero at all three resolutions (0.207, 0.237 and 0.169). The target governs how far apart the instruments are; the interface governs whether that distance changes their order. The auditor's hyperbolic geometry confers no advantage here. A single behavioural-detection AUROC is under-specified: such claims are comparable only when they state the estimand, the evaluator, and its output interface.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and narrowed version with a new title and estimand-centred analysis. Comparisons are now reported at three output resolutions, and the reproducibility package has been rebuilt. The author list was changed with the approval of all authors listed on v1-v2; previous versions remain publicly available. 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型行为审计（behavioural auditing）中评估指标的设定问题，指出检测分数未区分“暴露”（exposure，回复是否在行为诱导条件下产生）与“表征”（manifestation，行为是否实际出现在回复中）两个目标。作者在相同的 720 条回复上比较一个 1.46 亿参数审计器的冻结表示读出器与一个前沿 judge 模型，发现目标改变会使两者的 AUROC 差距移动约 0.2。在 judge 的部署界面（单一判定）下排名发生反转：审计器在暴露目标上领先 0.804 对 0.718，在表征目标上落后 0.690 对 0.811。匹配输出分辨率可消除反转，但无法消除交互作用，三种分辨率下的交互项均显著异于零（0.207、0.237、0.169）。
Motivation: 行为审计通常报告检测分数，但没有分离两个不同的测量目标：回复是否在行为诱导条件下产生（exposure）以及行为是否在回复中体现（manifestation）。这一混淆使单个 AUROC 声称缺乏可比性，作者试图系统检验目标与输出分辨率如何决定评估者表现。
Method: 在固定的 720 条回复上，对紧凑型审计器（146M 参数，使用冻结表示读出）和前沿 judge 分别按两个目标标签评分，并在三种输出分辨率下比较：judge 部署界面的单一判定、目标特定问题的连续置信度得分、以及对审计器读出做阈值化处理。通过改变目标和界面来观察 AUROC 差距与排序的变化。
Result: 目标变化使两个评估工具的 AUROC 差距移动约 0.2；在 judge 的单一判定界面下，审计器在 exposure 上领先（0.804 对 0.718），在 manifestation 上落后（0.690 对 0.811）。从任一方向匹配输出分辨率（连续置信度或阈值化读出）会消除排序反转，但目标与界面的交互作用在三种分辨率下都显著不为零（0.207、0.237、0.169）。审计器的双曲几何结构未带来优势。
Conclusion: 单个行为检测 AUROC 是不够明确（under-specified）的指标；这类声称只有当同时说明估计目标（estimand）、评估器及其输出界面时才可比。作者强调摘要中未给出超出该比较设置的具体适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-matched evaluation of operational Earth-observation classifiers: a three-number reporting method demonstrated on Sentinel-1 internal-wave detection
papers.abstract_en: The Internal Waves Service screens the Sentinel-1 Wave-mode archive for internal solitary waves, routing detections to experts whose adjudication time is the resource the effort exists to conserve. Because attention is the cost of error, precision leads. Its classifier was trained and reported at a one-to-one class balance, fixed before the operational rate could be known. That rate has since emerged at roughly one scene in twenty, and a balanced-test score badly overstates the precision a validator meets. A model that scores 0.794 balanced-test precision scores 0.192 in real operation: the gap is a systematic artefact of reporting at the wrong prior, invisible to the metric most work quotes. We show the mismatch to be an evaluation problem in the costume of a training one at a fixed recall, prior correction and calibration cannot move precision, and answer it with a prior-matched reporting method based on three numbers: balanced-test, operational-prior, and real post-deployment, whose contrast is the honest measure. A precision-first, leakage-controlled development cycle then improves the classifier lever by lever, each promoted only against a pre-registered margin; negative variety and the aggregation head lifting, capacity paying once then stopping, calibration inert, so the honest negatives are as much a result as the gains. Holding recall at a floor of 0.80 and certifying against a sealed, single-read lockbox, the promoted model reports 0.927 precision at the operational prior; an out-of-time check confirms discrimination transfers to unseen periods while a fixed operating point does not. Prior-matched reporting, begin balanced, then move to the prior as the stream reveals it, transfers to any operational Earth-observation service bootstrapping a rare-event detector under a prior it has yet to discover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测分类器在操作部署中的评估偏差问题，提出一种先验匹配（prior-matched）的三数字报告方法，并以 Sentinel-1 内孤立波检测为例。作者展示了一对一类别平衡下训练的模型，其平衡测试精度 0.794 在真实操作先验下只有 0.192，说明该差距是由错误先验带来的系统性评估伪影。通过固定召回率下限 0.80 并在密封 lockbox 认证下迭代改进，推广模型在操作先验下达到 0.927 的精度。
Motivation: Internal Waves Service 需要人工审核检测结果，而注意力是成本，因此精度优先；但分类器在一对一类别平衡下训练和报告，实际场景中约二十分之一的场景出现内波，导致平衡测试分数严重高估操作精度，且该问题在固定召回率下无法通过先验校正或校准解决，本质上是一个评估问题而非训练问题。
Method: 提出基于三个数字的先验匹配报告方法：balanced-test、operational-prior 和 real post-deployment，用三者之间的对比作为诚实度量；开发周期采用精度优先、泄漏控制（leakage-controlled）的方式逐项改进模型，每项改进仅在预注册（pre-registered）的边际下通过才被采纳，并固定召回率下限 0.80，最终用密封单读 lockbox 进行认证。
Result: 摘要报告推广模型在操作先验下精度达到 0.927；时间外（out-of-time）检查表明判别能力可迁移到未见时间段，但固定操作点（fixed operating point）不可迁移。负样本多样性（negative variety）与聚合头（aggregation head）提升有效，容量投入只带来一次性收益，校准没有作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为先验匹配报告应首先从平衡先验开始，待数据流揭示真实先验后转向操作先验，该方法可推广到任何在未知先验下启动罕见事件检测器的操作地球观测服务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SiamJEPA: On the Role of Siamese Student Encoders in JEPA
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have attracted significant attention in the computer vision and machine learning communities as a promising framework for self-supervised representation learning. Unlike masked autoencoders that reconstruct pixels, JEPA models learn representations by predicting latent embeddings of masked regions. Existing JEPA-based methods, such as I-JEPA and V-JEPA, typically employ a single encoder in the student network. In contrast, using Siamese encoders for student network is more naturally aligned with brain-inspired representation learning frameworks, yet their role in JEPA models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the effect of Siamese student encoders in JEPA-based representation learning. To this end, we propose SiamJEPA, masked Siamese student encoders equipped with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher network. SiamJEPA can also be viewed as a JEPA formulation of the brain-inspired representation learning model PhiNet. Through extensive experiments on ImageNet linear probing, we demonstrate that Siamese encoders act as an effective regularizer for the JEPA objective, improving representation separability and accelerating learning during the early stages of training. Furthermore, SiamJEPA consistently outperforms comparable single-encoder JEPA variants under limited training budgets and achieves higher linear probing accuracy than Masked Autoencoders (MAE) which requires longer training. Our findings reveal that Siamese student encoders are not merely an architectural choice but constitute an important inductive bias for predictive representation learning. These results provide new insights into the design of JEPA-based models and suggest that incorporating Siamese student architectures offers a simple yet effective approach for improving self-supervised representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 JEPA（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture）自监督表示学习中 Siamese 学生编码器的作用，提出 SiamJEPA：带指数移动平均（EMA）教师网络的掩码 Siamese 学生编码器，并视为脑启发表示学习模型 PhiNet 的 JEPA 形式。在 ImageNet 线性探测实验上，作者发现 Siamese 编码器对 JEPA 目标起到有效的正则化作用，提升表示可分性并加速早期训练；在有限训练预算下优于可比单编码器 JEPA 变体，线性探测准确率也高于需要更长训练的 MAE。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 类方法（如 I-JEPA、V-JEPA）的学生网络通常只使用单一编码器，而 Siamese 双编码器更贴合脑启发表示学习框架，但其在 JEPA 模型中的作用尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 SiamJEPA，即在学生网络中使用掩码 Siamese 编码器，并配合 EMA 教师网络；该方法可被看作 PhiNet 的 JEPA 化表述，通过预测掩码区域的潜在嵌入进行自监督学习。
Result: ImageNet 线性探测实验显示，Siamese 编码器作为 JEPA 目标的正则化器，改善了表示可分性并加速训练初期收敛；SiamJEPA 在有限训练预算下持续优于可比单编码器 JEPA 变体，并取得比需要更长训练的 MAE 更高的线性探测准确率。

papers.title: ACPO: Asymmetric Credit Policy Optimization via Mode-Local Entropy Surrogate
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning scales to verifiable reasoning tasks, but trajectory-level rewards assign the same outcome signal to all sampled tokens, overlooking their unequal contributions to the reasoning process. Entropy provides a natural indicator of the model's decision state, yet using it for token-level credit assignment presents two key challenges: long-tail probabilities in large vocabularies corrupt both entropy values and gradients, and uncertainty carries distinct semantics across positive- and non-positive-advantage trajectories. We propose Asymmetric Credit Policy Optimization (ACPO), which replaces global entropy with the complement of the top-token probability as a mode-local proxy. Guided by gradient analysis, ACPO incorporates mismatch routing and saturation correction to shape policy updates into the desired asymmetric form, emphasizing uncertain decisions on positive trajectories while penalizing confident regions on failed ones. Theoretically, ACPO locally preserves the advantage direction while bounding surrogate error. Experiments on mathematical and coding reasoning benchmarks, including AIME 2025 and HumanEval Pro, show that ACPO consistently outperforms both entropy-aware methods (e.g., 80/20, GTPO) and strong outcome-supervised RL baselines (e.g., DAPO, SAPO).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非对称信用分配策略优化 (Asymmetric Credit Policy Optimization, ACPO)，针对结果监督强化学习 (outcome-supervised RL) 中轨迹级奖励给所有 token 分配相同信号而忽略其贡献差异的问题。ACPO 用 top-token 概率的补数作为模式局部熵代理 (mode-local entropy surrogate)，并结合失配路由与饱和校正，把策略更新塑造成非对称形式：在正优势轨迹上强调不确定决策，在失败轨迹上惩罚置信区域。理论部分证明该方法局部保持优势方向并约束代理误差；在 AIME 2025、HumanEval Pro 等数学和代码推理基准上，ACPO 一致优于 80/20、GTPO 等熵感知方法以及 DAPO、SAPO 等结果监督 RL 基线。
Motivation: 结果监督的强化学习虽能扩展到可验证推理任务，但轨迹级奖励将相同结果信号分配给所有采样 token，忽略了它们在推理过程中的不同贡献。熵是模型决策状态的自然指标，但直接用于 token 级信用分配存在两个难题：大词表下的长尾概率会破坏熵值及其梯度；不确定性在正优势与非正优势轨迹中具有不同语义。
Method: ACPO 使用 top-token 概率的补数替代全局熵作为模式局部代理。在梯度分析的指导下，该方法引入失配路由 (mismatch routing) 和饱和校正 (saturation correction)，使策略更新呈现期望的非对称形式：对正轨迹强调不确定决策，对失败轨迹惩罚置信区域。理论上，ACPO 在局部保持优势方向的同时约束代理误差上界。
Result: 在 AIME 2025、HumanEval Pro 等数学和代码推理基准上，摘要报告 ACPO 持续优于熵感知方法（如 80/20、GTPO）以及强结果监督 RL 基线（如 DAPO、SAPO）。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，以模式局部熵代理配合非对称更新可以改善 token 级信用分配，并且该设计在理论上保证了优势方向不变与代理误差有界。适用范围是结果监督的可验证推理任务。

papers.title: Reading Without a Reader: Large Language Models Collapse Reading and Writing into a Single Entangled Code
papers.abstract_en: In the literate human brain, reading and writing doubly dissociate: a ventral decoding route (pure alexia) and a fronto-parietal encoding route (pure agraphia), sharing a partial orthographic core. A decoder-only large language model (LLM) drives both from one autoregressive path optimized on text (a \emph{cultural} invention, not an evolved instinct). We ask how entangled it is, comparing an input-side ``reading code'' $\mathbf{W}_{E}$ with an output-side ``writing code'' $\mathbf{W}_{U}$ via an index $\mathcal{E}\in[0,1]$ (CKA, Procrustes residual, mutual $k$-NN) calibrated against an independent-init floor and tied ceiling. On GPT-2, OPT and Pythia (14M--1.4B), untied models hold one \emph{coupled but sub-ceiling} code ($\mathcal{E}=0.23$--$0.35$, far above floor) on a non-monotonic couple-then-differentiate trajectory, $\mathbf{W}_{U}$ drifting $\sim$3.2$\times$ farther than $\mathbf{W}_{E}$ in every decile. Equally informative is a negative: the matching behavioural test, that comprehension and production fail together rather than dissociate, cannot be run. For minimal pairs the alexia analogue is empty by theorem: greedy production implies a vocabulary-wide argmax, so it wins the pairwise ranking. Differential-damage indices are not scale-identified: heavy-tailed damage makes linear standardizations collapse onto their larger term, and the rank transform fixing this is bounded, so its null saturates. Both scores also contain the target's log-probability, which alone explains most of their variance and manufactures the apparent coupling. We withdraw a coupling statistic, a cross-level bridge and a separation measure. In a model reading and writing off one next-token distribution, no output-side pair isolates either ability: entanglement needing no index to see. By analogy, not homology, this situates LLMs in the space of possible minds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 decoder-only 语言模型中输入侧『阅读代码』WE 与输出侧『写作代码』WU 的纠缠程度，提出一个标定过的纠缠指数 E∈[0,1]（基于 CKA、Procrustes 残差和互 k-NN）。在 GPT-2、OPT 和 Pythia（14M–1.4B）上，未绑定权重的模型表现出耦合但低于上限的代码（E=0.23–0.35，远高于随机初始化下限），且轨迹呈非单调的『先耦合后分化』，WU 在每个十分位的漂移约为 WE 的 3.2 倍。摘要同时给出负面结果：行为学类比测试无法进行，差异损伤指标不可尺度识别，且两个分数都包含目标 token 的对数概率，这本身就能解释大部分方差并制造出看似耦合的假象。作者撤回了耦合统计量、跨层桥梁和分离度量。
Motivation: 在 literate 人类大脑中，阅读和写作通过腹侧解码通路与额顶编码通路双重分离（double dissociation），共享部分正字法核心；而 decoder-only LLM 仅靠一条在文本上优化的自回归路径同时驱动两者，因此作者要追问这两套表征究竟有多纠缠。
Method: 将输入嵌入矩阵视为『阅读代码』、输出嵌入矩阵视为『写作代码』，用 CKA、Procrustes 残差和互 k-NN 构造纠缠指数 E，并以独立随机初始化作为下限、权重绑定作为上限进行标定；同时考察模型规模轨迹、最小词对行为测试和差分损伤指标。
Result: 摘要报告 E=0.23–0.35，远高于随机初始化下限但低于绑定上限；WU 的漂移在每个十分位都约为 WE 的 3.2 倍。作者还证明这类指标存在严重缺陷：贪婪生成等价于词表级 argmax 使配对排序失效，重尾损伤使线性标准化坍缩到较大项，而两个分数都包含目标 token 的对数概率，该单一变量即可解释大部分方差并产生虚假耦合。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在一个从同一个 next-token 分布进行阅读和写作的模型中，没有任何输出侧配对能单独分离出某一能力，纠缠本身无需指数即可看出；该结论是以类比而非同源（analogy, not homology）的方式将 LLM 定位于可能心智的空间中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Computer vision-based neural networks for radioisotope identification in urban environments
papers.abstract_en: Algorithm development for radioisotope identification in mobile urban search scenarios face significant challenges from non-uniform backgrounds, momentary source encounters, and severe class imbalance between rare threat signatures and background measurements. We present a machine learning-based approach to this problem that converts list-mode gamma-ray data into two-dimensional waterfall spectrograms and applies computer vision architectures to the resulting images. Rather than treating waterfalls as conventional images, we employ a representation where consecutive time spectra can form input channels, similar to RGB channels in color images. This representation encodes both spectral and temporal information, enabling neural networks to more effectively learn patterns that distinguish source signatures from background fluctuations. We evaluate three architectures, a multilayer perceptron (MLP), convolutional neural network (CNN), and vision transformer (ViT), on the Radiological Anomaly Detection and Identification (RADAI) benchmark dataset. At a false positive rate of less than one false alarm per hour, our CNN outperforms the previous-best non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) method across all global metrics, achieving true detection, classification, and identification rates of 0.4334, 0.3965, and 0.2950 respectively, compared to 0.4151, 0.3611, and 0.2625 for NMF. At lower false positive rate constraints, the neural network approaches show comparable but ultimately lower performance than NMF, indicating opportunities for further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市移动搜索场景中的放射性同位素识别问题，提出将列表模式（list-mode）伽马射线数据转换为二维瀑布光谱图（waterfall spectrograms），并采用连续时间谱作为输入通道（类似RGB通道）的表示来编码光谱与时间信息，然后应用计算机视觉架构进行分类。在RADAI基准上评估了MLP、CNN和ViT三种架构，其中CNN在较低误报率下优于此前最佳的NMF方法。
Motivation: 移动城市搜索中的放射性同位素识别面临非均匀背景、短暂源遭遇以及威胁信号与背景测量之间的严重类别不平衡，传统算法在这些条件下性能受限。
Method: 将list-mode伽马射线数据转换为二维瀑布光谱图，并采用连续时间谱作为输入通道的表示（类比RGB通道），使神经网络能够同时利用光谱和时间信息；随后评估了多层感知机（MLP）、卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉Transformer（ViT）三种架构。
Result: 在低于每小时一次误报的假阳性率约束下，CNN在真检测率、分类率和识别率上分别达到0.4334、0.3965和0.2950，均超过NMF的0.4151、0.3611和0.2625；但在更低的假阳性率约束下，神经网络方法性能与NMF相当但略低。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于计算机视觉的神经网络方法在常规误报率约束下优于NMF方法，但在更严格误报率下仍有差距，指出了进一步研究的方向。

papers.title: Learning to Select, Not Relearn: Hard-Routed Mixtures of Reasoning LoRAs
papers.abstract_en: Composing independently trained LoRA adapters into a single large language model is useful for multi-domain adaptation, especially when the original training data cannot be shared. A common approach is to use MoE-style routing over LoRA experts, but for frozen pretrained adapters, soft weighted combinations can change the unit-scale additive update under which each LoRA module was originally trained. We propose \textbf{Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA}, a two-stage framework for composing frozen reasoning LoRA experts through unit-scale hard selection. First, domain-specific LoRA adapters are trained independently using reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback to obtain reasoning experts. Then, all experts are frozen, reasoning traces are distilled from them, and only a lightweight shared router together with a small attention LoRA is trained for integration. The router selects exactly one expert per token using hard top-1 routing, while a straight-through estimator enables gradient-based training. Experiments across five benchmarks, multiple model scales, and additional model families show that Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA preserves expert behavior while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters than soft-routing mixture baselines. Our analysis further shows that normalized soft mixtures often concentrate most routing mass on a single expert, suggesting that hard unit-scale routing provides a simple and efficient abstraction for frozen LoRA expert composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA，一种两阶段框架，用于把冻结的推理 LoRA 专家组合进单一 LLM：先通过可验证反馈的强化学习 (reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback, RLVR) 独立训练领域 LoRA 专家，再冻结全部专家、蒸馏推理轨迹，只训练一个轻量共享路由器和一个小的 attention LoRA 来完成集成。路由器使用 hard top-1 路由为每个 token 恰好选择一个专家，并用 straight-through estimator 支持梯度训练。摘要报告在五个基准、多种模型规模和额外模型家族上，该方法在保持专家行为的同时，相比软路由混合基线大幅减少可训练参数。
Motivation: 将独立训练的 LoRA 适配器组合进一个 LLM 对多领域适配很有用，尤其是原始训练数据无法共享时；但常见的 MoE 式软加权组合会改变冻结 LoRA 模块最初训练时依赖的单位尺度加性更新 (unit-scale additive update)，从而破坏专家行为。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用 RLVR 独立训练领域特定的推理 LoRA 专家；第二阶段冻结所有专家，从专家中蒸馏推理轨迹，仅训练一个轻量共享路由器与一个小 attention LoRA。路由器采用每 token 的 hard top-1 单位尺度选择，并通过 straight-through estimator 实现可微训练。
Result: 在五个基准、多个模型规模和额外模型家族上的实验表明，Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA 在保留专家行为的同时，所需的可训练参数远少于软路由混合基线；分析还显示，归一化的软混合通常把绝大部分路由质量集中到单一专家上，这支持了硬单位尺度路由的合理性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对冻结 LoRA 专家组合，hard unit-scale routing 提供了一种简单且高效的抽象，避免了软加权混合改变单位尺度更新的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SpecPrefetch: Parameter-Efficient Expert Prefetching for Sparse MoE Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models expand foundation model capacity through conditional expert activation, but their full expert pools remain difficult to deploy under limited accelerator memory. Although expert offloading alleviates memory pressure by moving inactive experts to host memory or storage, it introduces a routing-dependent transfer bottleneck: required experts are known only after native top-\(K\) routing, which serializes routing, expert loading, and expert execution during inference. To address this bottleneck, we propose SpecPrefetch, a parameter-efficient prefetching framework for offloaded MoE inference. SpecPrefetch uses a shared lightweight adapter to predict next-layer expert candidates only for asynchronous transfer, while the frozen native router still determines the final executed experts. By separating transfer prediction from execution routing, SpecPrefetch reduces exposed expert-loading latency without changing pretrained routing semantics, so prediction errors affect transfer efficiency rather than model outputs. In addition, a window-aware scheduler prioritizes feasible transfers under cache and bandwidth constraints. Across Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B and DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, SpecPrefetch achieves the best average expert recall in 9 out of 10 model-benchmark settings with substantially fewer trainable parameters than learned predictor baselines. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite device, SpecPrefetch further improves decoding throughput by up to \(20\%\) over a compute-optimized offloading runtime, demonstrating practical benefits for storage-constrained MoE deployment. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/wei390/SpecPrefetch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecPrefetch 面向稀疏 MoE 模型在有限加速器内存下的推理，提出一种参数高效的专家预取框架。其核心是用共享轻量 adapter 只为异步传输预测下一层专家候选，而最终执行专家仍由冻结的原生 top-K router 决定，从而把传输预测与执行路由分离。在 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B 和 DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny 上，10 个 model-benchmark 设置中有 9 个取得最佳平均专家召回率，并在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 设备上相对 compute-optimized offloading runtime 提升解码吞吐最高 20%。
Motivation: 专家卸载（expert offloading）将非活动专家放到主机内存或存储以缓解显存压力，但所需专家只有在原生 top-K 路由完成后才可知，导致推理期间路由、专家加载、专家执行三者串行，形成依赖路由的传输瓶颈。
Method: 提出 SpecPrefetch，用共享轻量 adapter 仅预测下一层专家候选用于异步传输，而最终执行的专家仍由冻结的 native router 决定；通过分离传输预测与执行路由，预测错误只影响传输效率而不改变预训练路由语义。还引入 window-aware scheduler，在缓存和带宽约束下优先调度可行的传输。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B 和 DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny 的评估中，SpecPrefetch 在 10 个 model-benchmark 设置里 9 个取得最佳平均专家召回率，且比 learned predictor 基线使用更少的可训练参数；在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 上比 compute-optimized offloading runtime 解码吞吐最高提升 20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SpecPrefetch 在不改变预训练路由语义的前提下减少暴露的专家加载延迟，对存储受限的 MoE 部署具有实用价值，并已公开代码与模型权重。

papers.title: A Matter of Time: Towards a General Theory of Agency
papers.abstract_en: Agency is widely invoked in biology, cognitive science, artificial intelligence, and philosophy, yet its organizational basis, its empirical thresholds, and the operational criteria that distinguish it from other teleonomic terminology remain unsettled. Building on temporally parametrized (F, A)-systems, we propose a multidimensional theory of biological agency grounded in relational biology, physical biosemiotics, and process ontology. Our central claim is that the precarious physical realization of self-reference is necessarily diachronic; constitutive constraints act, decay, and are regenerated over distinct characteristic timescales. By temporalizing organizational diagrams ordered by specified relation deletion, we obtain a structural partial order, rather than an evolutionary ladder, that distinguishes four defeasible conditions: autonomy as internal regeneration of constitutive constraints under material openness; goal-directedness as viability-biased maintenance; agency as endogenous anticipatory modulation of organism--environment coupling; and open-endedness as reconstruction of the variables, measurement relations, effectors, and norms through which future viability is defined. We translate these distinctions into a closure-sensitive mechanistic workflow and a provisional profile of operational signatures for semantic closure, measurement--control complementarity, anticipatory modulation, affordance reconstruction, syntactic open-endedness, and viability-corrected skill acquisition. Markov blankets and active inference are treated as derived modeling tools, while Bickhard's interactivism clarifies anticipatory error and normativity. Across chemical, cellular, multicellular, and artificial systems, our framework turns agency from an all-or-none attribution into a falsifiable, scale-explicit research program.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于时间参数化的 (F, A)-systems，在关系生物学、物理生物符号学和过程本体论的基础上提出一个多维的生物能动性 (agency) 理论。核心主张是自我指涉的脆弱物理实现必然是历时性的：构成性约束在不同特征时间尺度上作用、衰减并被再生。作者通过按特定关系删除排序的时间化组织图，得到一个结构偏序而非演化阶梯，从而区分自治性 (autonomy)、目标导向性 (goal-directedness)、能动性 (agency) 和开放终结性 (open-endedness) 四种可废止条件，并将其转化为封闭敏感性机制工作流和一组操作特征概貌。
Motivation: 能动性在生物学、认知科学、人工智能和哲学中被广泛使用，但其组织基础、经验阈值以及将其与其他目的论术语区分开的操作标准尚未解决。
Method: 提出将组织图按指定关系删除进行排序并时间化，以得到结构偏序；据此定义四种可废止条件，并构建一个封闭敏感性 (closure-sensitive) 的机制工作流，以及针对语义封闭、测量-控制互补性、预期调节、可供性重构、句法开放终结性和生存力校正技能获取的操作签名概貌。
Result: 框架将能动性从全有或全无的归因转变为可证伪的、尺度明确的研究纲领，并声称可应用于化学、细胞、多细胞和人工系统；未报告定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 摘要将马尔可夫毯 (Markov blankets) 和主动推理 (active inference) 视为派生建模工具，并借助 Bickhard 的互动主义 (interactivism) 阐明预期误差与规范性，强调能动性的历时性 (diachronic) 本质。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FORGE: Fused On-Register Gradient Elimination for Memory-Efficient LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Reverse-mode differentiation computes every weight gradient, writes it to memory, and only then lets the optimizer read it back. This two-phase schedule sets the memory ceiling of modern training: at the seam between the phases, every layer's gradient is live at once. We argue that this materialized gradient is an artifact of how differentiation is staged, not a quantity that learning requires -- and we eliminate it. FORGE folds the optimizer step into the backward pass and applies it one tile at a time, entirely in registers, so each gradient tile is consumed the instant it is produced and never becomes a tensor. The fusion changes only when the update happens, not what it computes: in full precision the fused step is provably exact -- the identical optimizer update, for every element-wise rule -- and that exactness survives tensor- and sequence-parallel sharding; in the bf16 and 8-bit regimes used in practice it is faithful rather than bit-identical, its deviation bounded and, for the weight store, rendered unbiased by stochastic rounding. Because each gradient tile is born and consumed in the same registers, it is never converted down to bf16 to be stored and read back; FORGE thus preserves the full-precision fidelity that both bf16 and 8-bit optimizers lose to that conversion. Nor is the method tied to one architecture or one optimizer: linear layers are ubiquitous, and FORGE reclaims the gradient memory of any of them under any element-wise rule. Empirically FORGE more than halves the memory of an optimizer step and, at the small batch sizes typical of fine-tuning and continued pretraining, runs about 1.5x faster; integrated into tensor-parallel Megatron-LM it fits 8B training at four times the micro-batch a standard optimizer allows on the same GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORGE 提出将优化器更新融合进反向传播，以寄存器内逐 tile 的方式逐个消费梯度，使梯度永远不会物化为张量，从而消除训练中的梯度内存峰值。作者证明在全精度下该融合更新与标准优化器更新逐元素完全一致，且在张量并行与序列并行切分下仍然精确；在 bf16/8-bit 下为有界偏差并通过随机舍入保持无偏。实验显示在微调与持续预训练的小批量场景下可将优化器步骤内存降低一半以上，速度提升约 1.5 倍，并在张量并行的 Megatron-LM 中使 8B 训练支持四倍于标准优化器的 micro-batch。
Motivation: 反向模式求导先写出全部梯度再交由优化器读取，这种两阶段安排在交界处使所有层梯度同时存活，构成现代训练的内存上限。作者认为物化梯度只是微分阶段化的产物，并非学习所需的量，因而试图将其消除。
Method: FORGE 将优化器步骤折叠进反向传播，每次只处理一个梯度 tile 并全程在寄存器中完成更新，梯度 tile 一旦产生即被消费、不会成为张量。该方法适用于任意逐元素优化规则，并能与张量并行和序列并行切分兼容；在低精度下使用随机舍入保证权重存储的无偏性。
Result: 摘要报告 FORGE 使优化器步骤内存减少一半以上，在微调和持续预训练典型的小批量下运行速度快约 1.5 倍；集成到张量并行的 Megatron-LM 后，可在相同 GPU 上以标准优化器允许的四倍 micro-batch 训练 8B 模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调融合只改变更新发生的时机而不改变计算结果，并指出方法不绑定特定架构或优化器，可回收任意线性层在任意逐元素规则下的梯度内存。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms for Online Vertex Cover
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies learning-augmented online weighted vertex cover with local advice and a tradeoff parameter $λ\in (0,1)$. We consider two graph settings: bipartite graphs and general graphs. In both settings, the online algorithm must maintain a feasible vertex cover under irrevocable decisions. We show that these problems admit the same robustness--consistency tradeoffs as learning-augmented ski rental. For the bipartite graph model, we give a randomized algorithm that is $\frac{1}{1-e^{-λ}}$-robust and $\fracλ{1-e^{-λ}}$-consistent. For the general graph model, we give a deterministic algorithm that is $(1+\frac{1}λ)$-robust and $(1+λ)$-consistent. We prove that the tradeoffs above are optimal in both settings. We also validate the proposed algorithms through experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带局部建议 (local advice) 的学习增强在线加权顶点覆盖问题，在二部图和一般图两种模型下给出鲁棒性-一致性 (robustness--consistency) 权衡算法，并证明这些权衡在两种设定下均为最优。摘要还对所提算法在合成与真实数据集上进行了实验验证。
Motivation: 在线顶点覆盖问题要求算法在不可撤销的决策下维护可行覆盖，传统在线算法无法利用对未来请求的预测；学习增强算法旨在借助预测信息在保证鲁棒性的同时获得更好的一致性表现。
Method: 针对二部图模型提出随机化算法，达到 1/(1-e^{-λ}) 鲁棒性与 λ/(1-e^{-λ}) 一致性；针对一般图模型提出确定性算法，达到 (1+1/λ) 鲁棒性与 (1+λ) 一致性，并证明两种设定下的权衡均是最优的。

papers.title: Generative Relightable Avatars
papers.abstract_en: We present Generative Relightable Avatars (GRA), a person-specific method for photorealistic free-view rendering and environment-map relighting of full-body humans. We postulate that modeling fine-grained appearance details is inherently a one-to-many problem that can benefit from a generative formulation. In contrast to fully regressive relightable avatar methods, GRA follows a hybrid approach that combines controllable, physics-grounded relighting with probabilistic refinement. Starting from a tracked animated mesh, we optimize material parameters in UV-space and render a coarse relit appearance under a target HDR environment map. Next, we refine the textures with a feed-forward model to capture pose-dependent texture dynamics and illumination effects beyond simplified reflectance assumptions. Finally, a fine-tuned video-to-video diffusion model transforms the physically grounded renderings into temporally coherent, high-detail videos while preserving 3D control, with an error-recycling strategy for generating long videos. Experimental evaluations demonstrate our method's improved perceptual quality over prior relightable avatar baselines. Project Page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/GRA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Generative Relightable Avatars (GRA)，一种针对具体人物的全身人体照片级自由视角渲染与环境贴图重光照方法。方法结合物理驱动的可控重光照与生成式细化：先在 UV 空间优化材质参数并渲染粗重光照结果，再用前馈模型细化纹理以捕捉姿态相关纹理动态，最后用微调的视频到视频扩散模型将物理渲染转换为时序一致的高细节视频，并采用错误回收策略生成长视频。摘要报告该方法在感知质量上优于先前的可重光照虚拟化身基线。
Motivation: 建模精细外观细节本质上是多对一问题（one-to-many），完全回归式的可重光照虚拟化身方法难以捕捉这类细节，因此需要生成式建模来提升真实感。
Method: 混合式管线：从跟踪的动画网格出发，在 UV 空间优化材质参数并在目标 HDR 环境贴图下渲染粗重光照结果；随后用前馈模型细化纹理以处理姿态相关纹理动态和超出简化反射假设的照明效应；最后用微调的视频到视频扩散模型将物理渲染转换为高细节且时序一致的视频，并使用错误回收策略支持长视频生成。
Result: 实验评估表明该方法在感知质量上优于先前的可重光照虚拟化身基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将物理可解释的重光照与生成式概率细化结合，可以在保持 3D 控制的同时提升重光照虚拟化身的感知真实感与时序一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GIM-ENDO: A Multimodal Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Morphology and Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) is a precursor lesion to gastric dysplasia and adenocarcinoma whose early detection is crucial for intervening in the carcinogenesis cascade. Artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise for real-time endoscopic detection and characterization of GIM. However, development of reliable AI models has been constrained by the absence of publicly available, histopathologically validated datasets that combine detailed endoscopic annotations, histological subtype (complete and incomplete), standardized grading systems, and normal mucosal patterns. GIM-ENDO was designed to fill this gap. The dataset comprises demographic data, endoscopic findings, histopathological results, and H. pylori status acquired using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE) and image-enhanced endoscopy (IEE), including narrow-band imaging (NBI) and magnifying NBI (M-NBI), along with images and video clips from 24 patients (22 GIM-positive, 2 normal controls). Annotations cover six primary IEE endoscopic signs -- light blue crest (LBC), marginal turbid band (MTB), white opaque substance (WOS), TV pattern (Fusion), atrophy, and map-like erythema (MLE) -- plus two additional endoscopic findings (AHP and GA) recorded where present. GIM subtypes (complete and incomplete) are annotated for all GIM-positive cases; OLGA and OLGIM staging are provided where complete histological sampling was available. The dataset is publicly accessible at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20707267. For the latest updates and further information regarding this dataset, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com A short version of this work has been submitted to MICCAI 2026 Open Data Track.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GIM-ENDO 是一个面向胃黏膜肠上皮化生（GIM）的多模态内镜图像与视频数据集，包含来自 24 名患者（22 例 GIM 阳性、2 例正常对照）的白光内镜和图像增强内镜数据，并提供了六种主要 IEE 内镜征象、GIM 亚型（完全型与不完全型）以及 OLGA/OLGIM 分期等标注。该数据集旨在弥补缺乏经组织病理学验证的公开 GIM 数据集这一空白，并已公开在 Zenodo 上。
Motivation: 胃黏膜肠上皮化生是胃癌前病变，早期检测对干预癌变进程至关重要；但现有 AI 模型的开发受限于缺少公开、经组织病理学验证、且包含详细内镜标注和标准化分期的数据集。
Method: 作者构建了 GIM-ENDO 数据集，使用 Olympus EVIS X1 系统采集 WLE、IEE（含 NBI 和 M-NBI）图像与视频，整合人口学数据、内镜发现、病理结果和 H. pylori 状态，并对内镜征象、GIM 亚型和分期进行标注。
Result: 摘要报告数据集包含 24 名患者的数据，标注覆盖 LBC、MTB、WOS、TV pattern、萎缩和地图样红斑等六种主要 IEE 征象，另含两种附加发现；所有 GIM 阳性病例均标注了亚型，部分病例提供了 OLGA 和 OLGIM 分期。
Conclusion: 作者将该数据集公开提供，以支持实时内镜下 GIM 检测与表征的 AI 模型开发；相关工作短版已提交至 MICCAI 2026 Open Data Track。

papers.title: DIPHINE: Diffusion-based $Φ$-ID Neural Estimator
papers.abstract_en: Uncovering the true informational architecture of real-world complex systems requires disentangling how their components uniquely store, redundantly share, and synergistically integrate information over time. Integrated Information Decomposition ($Φ$ID) is a framework for decomposing the information dynamics of multivariate systems into sixteen non-overlapping atoms that characterize redundant, unique, and synergistic modes of information storage, transfer, and integration. Existing methods to compute $Φ$ID are restricted to Gaussian or discrete systems, preventing its application to continuous non-Gaussian dynamical systems. We address this limitation by proposing DIPHINE (Diffusion-based $Φ$-ID Neural Estimator), the first neural estimator that leverages score-based diffusion models to jointly estimate all the mutual information terms required by $Φ$ID from a single amortized network, recovering the sixteen atoms through Möbius inversion. We provide a theoretical analysis of error propagation through the inversion, showing that the Jacobian of the mapping from mutual informations to atoms is integer-valued and that the synergy-to-synergy atom is provably the hardest to estimate. We demonstrate accurate recovery of ground-truth atoms on synthetic benchmarks, superior performance compared to established mutual information estimators, and the ability to extract physiologically interpretable information-dynamic structure on an application involving real data without any distributional assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIPHINE，一种基于分数扩散模型 (score-based diffusion) 的 $\Phi$ID 神经估计器，从单个摊销网络联合估计全部所需互信息项，并通过 Möbius 反演恢复集成信息分解的十六个原子。它面向连续非高斯动力系统，在合成基准上准确恢复真值原子，并在真实数据上提取出生理上可解释的信息动态结构，无需分布假设。
Motivation: 现有计算 $\Phi$ID 的方法仅限于高斯系统或离散系统，无法处理真实世界中常见的连续非高斯动力系统。这阻碍了用 $\Phi$ID 框架分析复杂系统信息架构的通用应用。
Method: 提出首个利用 score-based diffusion 模型的神经估计器，用一个摊销网络同时估计 $\Phi$ID 所需的全部互信息项，再通过 Möbius 反演恢复十六个信息原子；同时给出误差传播的理论分析，证明该映射的 Jacobian 为整数值，且 synergy-to-synergy 原子理论上最难估计。
Result: 在合成基准上准确恢复 ground-truth 原子，性能优于已有互信息估计器；在真实数据应用中无需任何分布假设即可提取生理上可解释的信息动态结构。
Conclusion: DIPHINE 将 $\Phi$ID 的适用范围从高斯/离散系统扩展到一般的连续非高斯动力系统，并通过理论分析指出了误差在 Möbius 反演中的传播特性。
Relevance: 8
