papers.title: Geometric Risk Control for Vision-Language Model OCR
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable flexible generative optical character recognition (OCR), while their open-ended decoders can expose wrong but fluent text with weak visual support. In audit-sensitive records, such an output can be more costly than abstention. Frozen or externally served VLMs therefore require an external decision layer that can determine whether a transcription has sufficient visual evidence for release. We introduce the Geometric Risk Controller (GRC), a model-agnostic controller that treats controlled geometric transformations as repeatable black-box probes, screens structurally implausible continuations, and releases the unique candidate supported by coherent cross-view evidence. The protocol provides empirical selective exposure control with explicit coverage and query cost under a reproducible fixed decision rule. Experiments across frozen VLMs and standard scene-text benchmarks consistently reduce mean, upper-tail, and catastrophic error among released outputs while retaining high coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）生成式 OCR 中开放解码器可能输出流畅但视觉支撑不足的错误文本的问题，提出一种模型无关的外部决策层 Geometric Risk Controller (GRC)。GRC 将受控几何变换当作可重复的黑盒探针，筛除结构上不合理的续接，并只释放由跨视角证据一致支持的唯一候选。摘要报告在冻结 VLM 和标准场景文本基准上，该方法在保持高覆盖率的同时降低了已释放输出的均值、右尾和灾难性错误。
Motivation: 开放式的 VLM 解码器在 OCR 中可能生成错误但流畅的转录，且缺乏足够的视觉证据支持；在审计敏感场景中，这类错误输出比直接拒识（abstention）代价更高。现有的冻结或外部托管的 VLM 需要一个外部决策层来判断转录是否有足够的视觉证据可被释放。
Method: 提出模型无关的 Geometric Risk Controller (GRC)，把受控几何变换作为可重复的黑盒探针，筛除结构上不可能的续接，只释放由连贯跨视图证据支持的唯一候选；协议在可复现的固定决策规则下提供经验性的选择性释放控制，并显式给出覆盖率与查询成本。
Result: 在多种冻结 VLM 和标准场景文本基准上的实验一致地降低了已释放输出的均值误差、右尾误差和灾难性错误，同时保持高覆盖率。
Conclusion: 该方法以可复现的固定决策规则实现对释放输出的经验性风险控制，并显式权衡覆盖率与查询成本，适用于不能微调的冻结或外部 VLM 的审计敏感 OCR 场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated task-space motion planning with stable loco-manipulation command tracking under complex robot-environment dynamics and long-horizon tasks. While diffusion policies (DPs) show promise for learning from demonstrations, deploying them on humanoids poses critical challenges: the motion planner trained offline is decoupled from the loco-manipulation controller, leading to poor command tracking, compounding distribution shift, and task failures. The common approach of scaling demonstration data is prohibitively expensive for high-dimensional humanoid systems. To address this challenge, we present REFINE-DP (REinforcement learning FINE-tuning of Diffusion Policy), a hierarchical framework that jointly optimizes a DP motion planner and an RL-based loco-manipulation controller. The DP is fine-tuned via a PPO-based diffusion policy gradient to improve task success rate, while the controller is simultaneously updated to accurately track the planner's evolving command distribution, reducing the distributional mismatch that degrades motion quality. We validate REFINE-DP on a humanoid robot performing loco-manipulation tasks, including door traversal and long-horizon object transport. REFINE-DP achieves an over 90% success rate in simulation, even in out-of-distribution cases not seen in the pre-training data, and enables real-world execution without privileged state information. Our proposed method substantially outperforms pre-trained DP baselines and demonstrates that RL fine-tuning is key to reliable humanoid loco-manipulation. https://refine-dp.github.io/REFINE-DP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REFINE-DP，一个层次化框架，联合优化扩散策略 (diffusion policy, DP) 运动规划器和基于强化学习 (RL) 的人形移动操作控制器。摘要称该方法在 door traversal 和 long-horizon object transport 任务上使仿真成功率超过 90%，包括预训练数据未见的分布外情况，并能在无特权状态信息下进行真实世界执行。
Motivation: 离线训练的 DP 运动规划器与人形移动操作控制器相互解耦，导致命令跟踪差、复合分布偏移和任务失败；而对高维人形系统扩大演示数据规模代价过高。
Method: 提出层次化框架 REFINE-DP，包含 DP 运动规划器和 RL 移动操作控制器；DP 通过基于 PPO 的扩散策略梯度进行微调以提高任务成功率，控制器则同步更新以准确跟踪规划器不断演化的命令分布，从而减少分布失配。
Result: 摘要报告在 door traversal 与长时程物体运输等仿真任务上成功率超过 90%，其中包含预训练数据未见的分布外情况；方法无需特权状态信息即可实现真实世界执行，并明显优于预训练 DP 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RL 微调是实现可靠人形移动操作的关键，并表明联合优化规划器与控制器可减少分布失配；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Continual Learning with Vision-Language Models via Semantic-Geometry Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) is prone to catastrophic forgetting, yet current approaches adapt to new tasks without explicitly preserving the cross-modal semantic geometry inherited from pretraining and previous stages, allowing new-task supervision to induce geometric distortion. We observe that the most pronounced drift tends to concentrate in vulnerable neighborhoods near the old-new semantic interface, where shared visual patterns are easily re-explained by new textual semantics. To address this under an exemplar-free constraint, we propose Semantic Geometry Preservation for Continual Learning (SeGP-CL). SeGP-CL first probes the drift-prone region by constructing a compact set of adversarial anchors with dual-targeted projected gradient descent (DPGD), which drives selected new-task seeds toward old-class semantics while remaining faithful in raw visual space. During training, we preserve cross-modal structure by anchor-guided cross-modal geometry distillation (ACGD), and stabilize the textual reference frame across tasks via a lightweight text semantic-geometry regularization (TSGR). After training, we estimate anchor-induced raw-space drift to transfer old visual prototypes and perform dual-path inference by fusing cross-modal and visual cues. Extensive experiments on five continual learning benchmarks demonstrate that SeGP-CL consistently improves stability and forward transfer, achieving state-of-the-art performance while better preserving semantic geometry of VLMs. Code is available at: https://github.com/chiyuan-IVIPLab/SeGP-CL.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Semantic Geometry Preservation for Continual Learning (SeGP-CL)，在无样本回放约束下缓解预训练视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。作者观察到遗忘漂移集中在旧-新语义接口附近的脆弱邻域，因此用双目标投影梯度下降 (DPGD) 构造对抗锚点来探测漂移区，并通过锚点引导的跨模态几何蒸馏、文本语义几何正则化与双路径推理保持跨模态语义几何。摘要称在五个持续学习基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 持续学习方法在适配新任务时没有显式保留预训练及先前阶段继承的跨模态语义几何，导致新任务监督造成几何失真；且漂移在最靠近旧-新语义接口的脆弱区域最明显，其中共享视觉模式容易被新文本语义重新解释。
Method: SeGP-CL 包含三个阶段：先用双目标投影梯度下降 (DPGD) 构造紧凑的对抗锚点集，使选中的新任务种子靠近旧类语义但保持原始视觉空间忠实；训练时用锚点引导的跨模态几何蒸馏 (ACGD) 保留跨模态结构，并用轻量文本语义几何正则化 (TSGR) 稳定各任务间的文本参考框架；训练后估计锚点引起的原始空间漂移以迁移旧视觉原型，并融合跨模态与视觉线索进行双路径推理。
Result: 在五个持续学习基准上的大量实验表明，SeGP-CL 一致地提升稳定性 (stability) 与前向迁移 (forward transfer)，取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时更好地保留 VLM 的语义几何。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为在无样本回放约束下显式保留跨模态语义几何是缓解 VLM 持续学习中灾难性遗忘的关键，SeGP-CL 通过对抗锚点探测与几何蒸馏实现这一目标，并已开源代码。

papers.title: ReDiff: Reliability-Guided Diffusion for Trustworthy Ultra-Low-Field to High-Field MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Low-field to high-field MRI synthesis has emerged as a promising strategy to improve image quality when access to high-field scanners is limited. However, in ultra-low-field settings, the degradation of anatomical detail is spatially heterogeneous: structurally ambiguous regions are more susceptible to unstable high-frequency generation, which may produce anatomically inconsistent textures and boundaries. This issue is particularly problematic when synthesized images are used for downstream quantitative analysis. We therefore study how to make diffusion-based LF-to-HF synthesis more spatially reliable, rather than only sharper on average. To this end, we propose a reliability-guided diffusion framework (ReDiff) with two complementary inference-time mechanisms. First, a reliability-guided sampling strategy attenuates unstable reverse-diffusion updates in regions with weak low-field support. Second, an uncertainty-aware candidate selection scheme aggregates multiple stochastic reconstructions according to spatial consensus and predictive uncertainty. Beyond aggregate image quality, we test whether the uncertainty is itself a usable reliability signal. Experiments on paired 64mT$\rightarrow$3T MRI datasets show that ReDiff attains the lowest LPIPS across three contrasts and two datasets while remaining competitive on PSNR and SSIM, and downstream segmentation analysis indicates better preservation of anatomical structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReDiff，一个面向超低场到高场 MRI 合成的可靠性引导扩散框架。针对超低场下解剖细节退化在空间上不均匀、结构模糊区域易产生不稳定高频生成的问题，ReDiff 在推理阶段引入可靠性引导采样和不确定性感知候选选择两种机制。在配对 64mT→3T MRI 数据集上，该方法在三种对比度和两个数据集上取得最低 LPIPS，PSNR 与 SSIM 保持竞争力，下游分割分析显示解剖结构保留更好。
Motivation: 超低场 (ultra-low-field) 设置下解剖细节退化是空间异质的，结构模糊区域更容易出现不稳定的高频生成，导致解剖上不一致的纹理和边界；当合成图像用于下游定量分析时，这一问题尤为严重。现有方法只追求平均更清晰，缺乏空间层面的可靠性保证。
Method: 提出可靠性引导扩散框架 ReDiff，包含两个互补的推理期机制：一是可靠性引导采样，在低场支撑较弱的区域衰减不稳定的反向扩散更新；二是不确定性感知候选选择，依据空间一致性与预测不确定性聚合多次随机重建结果。
Result: 在配对 64mT→3T MRI 数据集上，ReDiff 在三种对比度和两个数据集上取得最低 LPIPS，同时 PSNR 和 SSIM 保持竞争力；下游分割分析表明其更好地保留了解剖结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应使扩散式低场到高场合成在空间上更可靠，而不仅是平均更锐利，并验证了不确定性本身可以作为可用的可靠性信号。

papers.title: Verbalizing LLM's Higher-order Uncertainty via Imprecise Probabilities
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing demand for eliciting uncertainty from large language models (LLMs), empirical evidence suggests that LLM behavior is not always adequately captured by the elicitation techniques developed under the classical probabilistic uncertainty framework. This mismatch leads to systematic failure modes, particularly in settings that involve ambiguous question-answering, in-context learning, and self-reflection. To address this, we propose novel prompt-based uncertainty elicitation techniques grounded in \emph{imprecise probabilities}, a principled framework for repesenting and eliciting higher-order uncertainty. Here, first-order uncertainty captures uncertainty over possible responses to a prompt, while second-order uncertainty (uncertainty about uncertainty) quantifies indeterminacy in the underlying probability model itself. We introduce general-purpose prompting and post-processing procedures to directly elicit and quantify both orders of uncertainty, and demonstrate their effectiveness across diverse settings. Our approach enables more faithful uncertainty reporting from LLMs, improving credibility and supporting downstream decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对经典概率不确定性框架下LLM不确定性 elicitation 技术无法充分刻画模型行为的现象，提出基于不精确概率 (imprecise probabilities) 的提示式不确定性 elicitation 方法，直接量化一阶不确定性（对回答的不确定性）和二阶不确定性（对底层概率模型的不确定性）。摘要称该方法在多种设置下有效，能够带来更可靠的不确定性报告并支持下游决策。
Motivation: 现有面向LLM的不确定性 elicitation 技术建立在经典概率框架上，在模糊问答、上下文学习和自我反思等场景中会出现系统性失效，需要更原则性的框架来刻画高阶不确定性。
Method: 提出通用的提示 (prompting) 与后处理 (post-processing) 流程，基于不精确概率同时 elicitation 和量化一阶与二阶不确定性，其中二阶不确定性用于衡量底层概率模型本身的不确定性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多样化的设置中展现出有效性，能带来更忠实的不确定性报告，提升可信度并支持下游决策。
Conclusion: 作者认为不精确概率为表达和 elicitation LLM高阶不确定性提供了原则性框架，有助于更可靠的不确定性报告。

papers.title: RiO-DETR: DETR for Real-time Oriented Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: We present RiO-DETR: DETR for Real-time Oriented Object Detection, the first real-time oriented detection transformer to the best of our knowledge. Adapting DETR to oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) poses three challenges: semantics-dependent orientation, angle periodicity that breaks standard Euclidean refinement, and an enlarged search space that slows convergence. RiO-DETR resolves these issues with task-native designs while preserving real-time efficiency. First, we propose Content-Driven Angle Estimation by decoupling angle from positional queries, together with Rotation-Rectified Orthogonal Attention to capture complementary cues for reliable orientation. Second, Decoupled Periodic Refinement combines bounded coarse-to-fine updates with a Shortest-Path Periodic Loss for stable learning across angular seams. Third, Oriented Dense O2O injects angular diversity into dense supervision to speed up angle convergence at no extra cost. Extensive experiments on DOTA-1.0, DIOR-R, and FAIR-1M-2.0 demonstrate RiO-DETR establishes a new speed--accuracy trade-off for real-time oriented detection. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/RicePasteM/RiO-DETR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RiO-DETR，据称是首个实时旋转目标检测 Transformer。针对 DETR 适配旋转边界框 (OBB) 的三个难题——语义依赖的方向性、角度周期性与标准欧氏细化冲突、以及搜索空间增大导致收敛变慢——作者设计了内容驱动的角度估计、解耦的周期性细化以及面向角度的密集监督机制。在 DOTA-1.0、DIOR-R 和 FAIR-1M-2.0 上验证了新的速度-精度权衡。
Motivation: DETR 家族此前主要面向水平框检测，直接迁移到旋转目标检测时面临角度周期性和方向语义依赖等问题，导致难以在保持实时效率的同时实现可靠的角度回归。
Method: 提出 Content-Driven Angle Estimation，将角度从位置查询中解耦，并配合 Rotation-Rectified Orthogonal Attention 捕获互补线索；提出 Decoupled Periodic Refinement，结合有界粗到细更新与 Shortest-Path Periodic Loss，解决角度边界处的学习不稳定；提出 Oriented Dense O2O，将角度多样性注入密集监督以加速角度收敛。
Result: 在 DOTA-1.0、DIOR-R 和 FAIR-1M-2.0 上的实验表明，RiO-DETR 在实时旋转目标检测中建立了新的速度-精度权衡，且额外开销为零。
Conclusion: 作者认为任务原生的设计可以在不牺牲实时效率的前提下解决 DETR 适配 OBB 的核心挑战，并在多个旋转检测基准上验证了该方法的有效性。

papers.title: Energy-Driven Adaptive Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual token reduction is critical for accelerating Vision-Language Models (VLMs), since visual inputs are represented as token sequences that introduce substantial computational overhead in the LLM backbone. However, most pruning pipelines treat efficiency primarily as a token selection problem and retain a fixed visual token budget across inputs, overlooking the substantial variation in image information density. We propose E-AdaPrune, an energy driven adaptive pruning framework that determines an image specific token budget from the singular value spectrum of the visual feature matrix and passes this budget to existing token selectors. By preserving a certain proportion of spectral energy, our method allocates more tokens to information dense scenes while assigning fewer tokens to redundant scenes, without introducing additional learnable parameters. We evaluate E-AdaPrune across four VLM backbones, three token selectors, and nine benchmarks under matched average token budgets. Results show that E-AdaPrune removes a substantial amount of redundant computation from simple cases and converts the saved budget into larger gains on information rich cases. Notably, on SQA$^\mathrm{I}$ with Qwen2.5-VL-3B, E-AdaPrune uses 35.8\% fewer tokens for simple cases with only a 0.52\% relative performance decrease. The saved budget is redirected to hard cases, which receive 52.5\% more tokens and achieve a 1.94\% relative performance improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E-AdaPrune，一种能量驱动的自适应视觉 token 剪枝框架，用于加速视觉语言模型 (VLM)。该方法从视觉特征矩阵的奇异值谱确定每张图像专属的 token 预算，并传递给现有 token 选择器，无需新增可学习参数。在四个 VLM 主干、三个 token 选择器和九个基准上，E-AdaPrune 在匹配平均 token 预算的条件下，为简单样本节省计算并将预算重新分配给信息密集样本，例如在 SQA^I 与 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上简单样本减少 35.8% token 且性能仅下降 0.52%，困难样本获得 52.5% 更多 token 并提升 1.94% 相对性能。
Motivation: 现有的视觉 token 剪枝管道大多把效率问题当作 token 选择问题，并对所有输入保留固定的 token 预算，忽略了不同图像之间信息密度的显著差异。
Method: 提出 E-AdaPrune，通过视觉特征矩阵的奇异值谱保留一定比例的谱能量 (spectral energy)，为每张图像计算专属 token 预算，再将预算传递给已有的 token 选择器，整个过程不引入额外可学习参数。
Result: 在四个 VLM 主干、三个 token 选择器和九个基准上的匹配平均 token 预算实验显示，E-AdaPrune 能从简单样本中移除大量冗余计算，并将节省的预算用于信息丰富样本；在 SQA^I 与 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上，简单样本 token 减少 35.8%、相对性能仅降 0.52%，困难样本 token 增加 52.5%、相对性能提升 1.94%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将 token 预算从固定改为由图像信息密度自适应决定，可以在不增加参数的情况下提升 VLM 的剪枝效率，并把节省的计算转化为困难样本上的性能增益。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的视觉 token 剪枝管道大多把效率问题当作 token 选择问题，并对所有输入保留固定的 token 预算，忽略了不同图像之间信息密度的显著差异。
summary_sections.method: 提出 E-AdaPrune，通过视觉特征矩阵的奇异值谱保留一定比例的谱能量 (spectral energy)，为每张图像计算专属 token 预算，再将预算传递给已有的 token 选择器，整个过程不引入额外可学习参数。
summary_sections.result: 在四个 VLM 主干、三个 token 选择器和九个基准上的匹配平均 token 预算实验显示，E-AdaPrune 能从简单样本中移除大量冗余计算，并将节省的预算用于信息丰富样本；在 SQA^I 与 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上，简单样本 token 减少 35.8%、相对性能仅降 0.52%，困难样本 token 增加 52.5%、相对性能提升 1.94%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，将 token 预算从固定改为由图像信息密度自适应决定，可以在不增加参数的情况下提升 VLM 的剪枝效率，并把节省的计算转化为困难样本上的性能增益。

papers.title: RMBench: Memory-Dependent Robotic Manipulation Benchmark with Insights into Policy Design
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation policies have made rapid progress in recent years, yet most existing approaches give limited consideration to memory capabilities. Consequently, they struggle to solve tasks that require reasoning over historical observations and maintaining task-relevant information over time, which are common requirements in real-world manipulation scenarios. Although several memory-aware policies have been proposed, systematic evaluation of memory-dependent manipulation remains underexplored, and the relationship between architectural design choices and memory performance is still not well understood. To address this gap, we introduce RMBench, a simulation benchmark comprising 9 manipulation tasks that span multiple levels of memory complexity, enabling systematic evaluation of policy memory capabilities. We further propose Mem-0, a modular manipulation policy with explicit memory components designed to support controlled ablation studies. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we identify memory-related limitations in existing policies and provide empirical insights into how architectural design choices influence memory performance. The website is available at https://rmbench.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RMBench，一个包含 9 个模拟操作任务的基准，任务覆盖多级记忆复杂度，用于系统评估机器人操作策略的记忆能力；同时提出 Mem-0，一种带显式记忆组件的模块化操作策略，以支持受控消融研究。作者通过大量仿真与真实世界实验，指出现有策略在记忆相关任务上的局限，并给出架构设计选择如何影响记忆性能的经验性结论。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略对记忆能力的考虑有限，难以完成需要基于历史观测推理并随时间维持任务相关信息的一类任务；尽管已有若干记忆感知策略，但记忆依赖操作的系统评估仍不充分，架构设计与记忆性能之间的关系也缺乏理解。
Method: 构建 RMBench 仿真基准，包含 9 个覆盖不同记忆复杂度层次的操作任务；提出 Mem-0 模块化操作策略，内置显式记忆组件以便进行受控消融实验，并通过仿真和真实世界实验验证。
Result: 实验识别出现有策略在记忆相关任务上的局限，并提供关于架构设计选择如何影响记忆性能的经验性洞见。
Conclusion: RMBench 与 Mem-0 为记忆依赖操作任务提供了系统评估与消融分析的平台，作者强调架构选择对记忆性能的影响。

papers.title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Ising Solvers
papers.abstract_en: We present an Ising-compatible framework for formal neural-network robustness verification under bounded input perturbations. For piecewise-linear activations, the Exact Logarithmic PWL Model (Log-PWL) provides an exact, sound, and complete formulation with a state-optimal logarithmic encoding, reducing the binary variables per neuron from linear to information-theoretically minimal logarithmic complexity. For general bounded element-wise activations, the Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env) uses sound piecewise-constant envelopes whose lower and upper neuron states remain decision variables coupled to a common adversarial input. We prove that its globally optimized output bounds converge uniformly to the true network extrema as the segment width vanishes, yielding asymptotic completeness of verification. We further develop a hybrid Benders solver. Interval pruning, certificate transfer for pruned networks, and layerwise classical--Ising partitioning further reduce spin requirements. Experiments show exact certification fidelity for piecewise-linear networks and near-reference accuracy for sigmoid networks with compact spin budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Ising 求解器的形式化神经网络鲁棒性验证框架，适用于有界输入扰动。针对分段线性激活函数，作者给出 Exact Logarithmic PWL Model (Log-PWL)，以信息论意义下最小的对数级二进制变量完成精确、可靠且完备的编码；针对一般有界逐元素激活，提出 Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env)，用分段常数包络逼近，并证明当段宽趋于零时全局优化输出界一致收敛到真实网络极值，从而获得验证的渐近完备性。实验显示分段线性网络可达到精确验证保真度，sigmoid 网络在紧凑的 spin 预算下接近参考精度。
Motivation: 形式化神经网络鲁棒性验证在分段线性激活下往往需要线性数量的二进制变量，编码效率低；而对一般有界逐元素激活函数，缺乏可证明完备且可落地的验证方案。
Method: 提出 Ising 兼容的验证框架：Log-PWL 用状态最优的对数编码把每个神经元的二进制变量从线性降到对数复杂度；Step-Env 用上下神经元状态耦合到共同对抗输入的可靠分段常数包络构造，并配合混合 Benders 求解器、区间剪枝、被剪枝网络的证书迁移以及逐层的经典–Ising 划分来降低自旋需求。
Result: 实验表明该框架对分段线性网络实现精确的验证保真度，对 sigmoid 网络在紧凑自旋预算下取得接近参考解的验证精度。
Conclusion: 作者证明所提 Step-Env 模型在段宽趋于零时具备验证的渐近完备性，并展示了 Ising 求解器用于神经网络形式化验证的可行性；摘要未讨论扩展到大规模网络或实际 Ising 硬件部署的具体限制。

papers.title: Latent Matters: Learning Deep State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep state-space models (DSSMs) enable temporal predictions by learning the underlying dynamics of observed sequence data. They are often trained by maximising the evidence lower bound. However, as we show, this does not ensure the model actually learns the underlying dynamics. We therefore propose a constrained optimisation framework as a general approach for training DSSMs. Building upon this, we introduce the extended Kalman VAE (EKVAE), which combines amortised variational inference with classic Bayesian filtering/smoothing to model dynamics more accurately than RNN-based DSSMs. Our results show that the constrained optimisation framework significantly improves system identification and prediction accuracy on the example of established state-of-the-art DSSMs. The EKVAE outperforms previous models w.r.t. prediction accuracy, achieves remarkable results in identifying dynamical systems, and can furthermore successfully learn state-space representations where static and dynamic features are disentangled.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (2021): 10234-10245
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出以最大化证据下界 (ELBO) 训练深度状态空间模型 (DSSM) 并不能保证模型真正学到序列数据背后的底层动力学，并提出一种约束优化框架作为通用训练方案。基于该框架，作者引入 extended Kalman VAE (EKVAE)，将摊销变分推断 (amortised variational inference) 与经典贝叶斯滤波/平滑 (Bayesian filtering/smoothing) 结合，以替代基于 RNN 的 DSSM。摘要报告该方法在系统辨识和预测精度上优于已有 SOTA DSSM，并能学习静态与动态特征解耦的状态空间表示。
Motivation: 现有 DSSM 训练普遍采用最大化 ELBO，但作者证明该目标不能确保模型学习到真实的底层动力学，从而限制时序预测与系统辨识能力。
Method: 提出一个用于训练 DSSM 的约束优化框架，并在此基础上提出 EKVAE，用摊销变分推断配合经典贝叶斯滤波/平滑来更准确地建模动力学，而不是依赖 RNN 形式的 DSSM。
Result: 摘要显示约束优化框架在已有 SOTA DSSM 上显著提升系统辨识与预测精度；EKVAE 在预测精度上超过此前模型，在动力学系统辨识上表现突出，并能成功学到静态特征与动态特征解耦的状态空间表示。
Conclusion: 作者强调约束优化训练与显式滤波/平滑建模对 DSSM 学习底层动力学的重要性；论文发表于 NeurIPS 2021。

papers.title: Transporting Task Vectors across Different Architectures without Training
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large pre-trained models to downstream tasks often produces task-specific parameter updates that are expensive to relearn for every model variant. While recent work has shown that such updates can be transferred between models with identical architectures, transferring them across models of different widths remains unexplored. In this work, we introduce Theseus, a training-free method for transporting task updates across heterogeneous-width models. Rather than matching parameters, we characterize a task update by the functional effect it induces on intermediate representations. We formalize task-vector transport as a functional matching problem on observed activations and show that, after aligning representation spaces via orthogonal Procrustes analysis, it admits a stable closed-form solution that preserves the geometry of the update. We evaluate Theseus on vision and language models across different widths, showing consistent improvements over baselines without additional training or backpropagation. Our results show that task updates can be meaningfully transferred across architectures when task identity is defined functionally rather than parametrically. Code is available at https://github.com/apanariello4/merge-and-rebase.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Theseus，一种无需训练的跨异质宽度模型传输任务向量（task vector）的方法。与参数匹配不同，作者用任务更新对中间表征（intermediate representations）产生的功能效应来刻画更新，将传输形式化为观测激活上的功能匹配问题，并通过正交 Procrustes 分析对齐表示空间后得到保持更新几何性质的封闭解（closed-form solution）。该方法在视觉和语言模型的不同宽度设置上评估，无需额外训练或反向传播。
Motivation: 下游任务微调产生的任务相关参数更新难以针对每个模型变体重新学习；已有工作只能在同一架构的模型之间传输这类更新，跨不同宽度模型的传输此前尚未被探索。
Method: 不直接匹配参数，而是通过任务更新对中间表征的功能效应来定义任务向量；将跨宽度传输建模为激活上的功能匹配问题，先用正交 Procrustes 分析（orthogonal Procrustes analysis）对齐表示空间，再得到保持更新几何性质的稳定封闭解。整个过程无需训练或反向传播。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在视觉和语言模型跨不同宽度的设置上相比基线取得一致改进（consistent improvements），且不需要额外训练或反向传播。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，当任务身份以功能性（functionally）而非参数性（parametrically）定义时，任务更新可以跨架构有意义地传输；代码已开源。

papers.title: FinVault: Benchmarking Financial Agent Safety in Execution-Grounded Environments
papers.abstract_en: Financial agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for investment analysis, risk assessment, and automated decision-making, where their abilities to plan, invoke tools, and manipulate mutable state introduce new security risks in high-stakes and highly regulated financial environments. However, existing safety evaluations largely focus on language-model-level content compliance or abstract agent settings, failing to capture execution-grounded risks arising from real operational workflows and state-changing actions. To bridge this gap, we propose FinVault, the first execution-grounded security benchmark for financial agents, comprising 31 regulatory case-driven sandbox scenarios with state-writable databases and explicit compliance constraints, together with 107 real-world vulnerabilities and 963 test cases that systematically cover prompt injection, jailbreaking, financially adapted attacks, as well as benign inputs for false-positive evaluation. Experimental results reveal that existing defense mechanisms remain ineffective in realistic financial agent settings, with average attack success rates (ASR) still reaching up to 50.0\% on state-of-the-art models and remaining non-negligible even for the most robust systems (ASR 6.7\%), highlighting the limited transferability of current safety designs and the need for stronger financial-specific defenses. Our code can be found at https://github.com/aifinlab/FinVault.
papers.comment: After further review of the current submission, we have identified potential legal and intellectual property concerns associated with keeping the manuscript publicly available as a preprint. In particular, there are ongoing considerations regarding institutional affiliation information, intellectual property ownership, and related compliance matters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinVault，据称是首个执行落地（execution-grounded）的金融代理安全基准，包含 31 个监管案例驱动的沙箱场景、107 个真实漏洞和 963 个测试用例，覆盖提示注入（prompt injection）、越狱（jailbreaking）、金融适配攻击及用于误报评估的良性输入。实验表明现有防御机制在现实金融代理环境下效果有限，平均攻击成功率（ASR）最高可达 50.0%，即使最稳健的模型仍有 6.7% 的 ASR。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全评测大多停留在语言模型层面的内容合规或抽象代理设置，无法刻画真实运营工作流与状态改变动作带来的执行落地风险，而金融代理在高度监管的环境中部署，需要更贴近实际的安全评估。
Method: 构建 FinVault，一个执行落地式金融代理安全基准，包含带可写状态数据库和显式合规约束的监管案例沙箱场景，并系统覆盖提示注入、越狱、金融适配攻击和良性输入等测试用例。
Result: 摘要报告现有防御机制在现实金融代理设置下基本无效，SOTA 模型上的平均攻击成功率最高达 50.0%，即使最稳健的防御系统仍存在 6.7% 的 ASR，表明当前安全设计迁移性有限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要针对金融领域设计更强的专用防御机制，因为现有安全方案在真实金融代理工作流中的表现不足以应对执行落地风险。

papers.title: Women Worry, Men Adopt? Gendered Risk Perceptions and Generative AI Adoption
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is spreading rapidly across work and daily life, yet adoption remains uneven. Men use GenAI more frequently than women, potentially widening inequalities in productivity, skills, and career opportunities. Existing research has largely explained this gap through differences in access, digital skills, and confidence. We argue that these explanations are incomplete: gender differences in GenAI adoption may also reflect how women and men evaluate AI's societal risks. Using two waves (2023-2024) of the nationally representative UK Public Attitudes to Data and AI Tracker (N = 9,172), we combine descriptive analyses with gender-specific, age-stratified random forest models and a parametric score-matching analysis of repeated cross-sections. We first show that men report substantially higher levels of frequent personal GenAI use than women. We then show that this gap is especially pronounced among respondents who express concerns about AI's societal consequences, particularly its effects on mental health and the environment. Intersectional analyses show that the largest disparities arise among younger, digitally fluent individuals with high societal risk concerns, where gender gaps in personal use exceed 45 percentage points. Across predictive models, perceived societal risk has greater predictive relevance for women's adoption than for men's and ranks among the strongest predictors of women's GenAI use. Finally, in score-matched comparisons, higher optimism about AI's societal impact is associated with larger increases in women's uptake, narrowing the gender gap. We interpret these findings as an indication that unresolved AI harms may contribute to unequal access to GenAI's productivity, learning, and career benefits. The findings point to societal risk perception as an important behavioural pathway underlying digital inequality in the AI era.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用英国全国代表性调查数据（2023-2024两波，N=9,172）研究生成式人工智能（GenAI）采用中的性别差距。作者结合描述统计、按性别与年龄分层的随机森林模型和重复横断面的参数得分匹配分析，发现男性频繁使用GenAI的比例明显高于女性；该差距在社会风险担忧者中更为突出，尤其是在年轻、数字熟练且高社会风险担忧的人群中。作者将结果解释为对AI社会危害的未解决担忧可能加剧AI时代的生产力与职业机会不平等。
Motivation: 现有研究主要用接入、数字技能和信心解释GenAI采用的性别差距，作者认为这些解释不完整，提出性别差异也可能反映女性和男性对AI社会风险的不同评价。
Method: 使用英国Public Attitudes to Data and AI Tracker的两波全国代表性调查数据，结合描述性分析、性别特定的年龄分层随机森林（random forest）模型，以及对重复横断面进行的参数得分匹配（score-matching）分析。
Result: 摘要报告男性比女性报告更高频率的个人GenAI使用；性别差距在担忧AI社会后果（尤其是心理健康和环境）的受访者中尤为显著，其中年轻、数字熟练且高社会风险担忧人群的性别差距超过45个百分点。感知社会风险对女性采用行为的预测相关性高于男性，而更高的社会影响乐观度与女性采用率更大幅提升相关，从而缩小性别差距。
Conclusion: 作者将发现解读为未解决的人工智能危害可能造成对GenAI生产力、学习和职业收益的不平等获取，并指出社会风险感知是AI时代数字不平等的重要行为路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Concurrent training methods for Kolmogorov-Arnold networks: Disjoint datasets and FPGA implementation
papers.abstract_en: The present paper introduces concurrency-driven enhancements to the training algorithm for the Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) that is based on the Newton-Kaczmarz (NK) method. Prior research shows that KANs trained using the NK-based approach outperform classical neural networks (multilayer perceptrons - MLPs) both in terms of accuracy and training time. Up to now, the fundamental limitation of the algorithm has been the sequential computation of the updates - each update depends on the results of the previous step, obstructing parallelisation; even though parallelisation of some parts of the algorithm, such as the evaluation of the basis functions, has already been proposed and tested. However, substantial acceleration is achievable. Three complementary concurrency-driven novel strategies are proposed in the present paper: (i) a pre-training procedure tailored to the NK updates' structure, (ii) training on disjoint subsets of data together with models' merging, and (iii) a division-free customisation of the algorithm for field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), which is implemented and tested directly on the device. Computational experiments are used to assess the scalability and to compare the authors' KAN implementation with popular MLP packages. All presented experimental results are fully reproducible, with the complete source codes available online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于 Newton-Kaczmarz (NK) 方法的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络 (KAN) 训练算法提出三种并发增强策略：面向 NK 更新结构设计的预训练程序、在不相交数据子集上训练并合并模型、以及为 FPGA 实现的无除法定制版本并在硬件上直接测试。摘要称这些方法显著加速训练，并通过计算实验评估可扩展性，与主流 MLP 包对比，所有源码公开可复现。
Motivation: 现有 NK 方法训练的 KAN 在精度和训练时间上优于多层感知机 (MLP)，但其更新步骤必须顺序计算，每一步依赖上一步结果，阻碍并行化，成为算法的根本局限。
Method: 提出三种互补的并发策略：(i) 针对 NK 更新结构定制的预训练程序；(ii) 在重叠较少甚至不相交的数据子集上并行训练模型，再合并模型；(iii) 面向 FPGA 的无除法算法自定义版本，并直接在器件上实现与测试。
Result: 计算实验用于评估可扩展性，并将作者的 KAN 实现与流行的 MLP 包进行比较；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过并发策略可获得大幅加速，且所有实验结果完全可复现，完整源代码已在线提供。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: One Leak Away: How Pretrained Model Exposure Amplifies Jailbreak Risks in Finetuned LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning pretrained large language models (LLMs) has become the standard paradigm for developing downstream applications. However, its security implications remain unclear, particularly regarding whether finetuned LLMs inherit jailbreak vulnerabilities from their pretrained sources. We investigate this question in a realistic pretrain-to-finetune threat model, where an attacker has full access to a released pretrained LLM but no access to its proprietary finetuned derivatives. Empirical analysis shows that adversarial prompts optimized on the pretrained model transfer most effectively to its finetuned variants, revealing inherited vulnerabilities from pretrained to finetuned LLMs. To further examine this inheritance, we conduct representation-level probing, which shows that transferable prompts are linearly separable within the pretrained hidden states, suggesting that transferability-relevant structure is already encoded in pretrained representations. Building on this insight, we propose the Probe-Guided Projection (PGP) attack, which steers optimization toward transferability-relevant directions. Experiments across multiple LLM families and diverse finetuned tasks confirm PGP's strong transfer success, underscoring the security risks inherent in the pretrain-to-finetune paradigm. Finally, we demonstrate that the same representation-level insights also enable a lightweight defense that mitigates pretrain-to-finetune jailbreak transfer while preserving downstream utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练大模型（LLM）在下游微调后是否继承来自预训练源的越狱（jailbreak）漏洞。作者在现实威胁模型下证明，在预训练模型上优化的对抗提示能最有效地迁移到微调变体上，并通过表征级探测发现可迁移提示在预训练隐藏状态中线性可分。基于此提出 Probe-Guided Projection (PGP) 攻击，并在多个 LLM 家族与微调任务上验证其强迁移成功率，同时提出一种利用同一表征级洞察的轻量防御。
Motivation: 微调预训练 LLM 已成为下游应用的标准范式，但其安全影响尚不清楚，特别是微调模型是否从预训练来源继承越狱漏洞。
Method: 采用预训练到微调（pretrain-to-finetune）威胁模型，攻击者可访问公开预训练模型但无法访问专有微调模型；通过表征级探测发现可迁移提示的线性可分结构，进而提出 Probe-Guided Projection (PGP) 攻击，将优化导向与迁移相关的表征方向。
Result: 实验显示在预训练模型上优化的对抗提示对微调变体迁移最有效；PGP 攻击在多个 LLM 家族和多样化微调任务上表现出强迁移成功率；同一表征级洞察还可实现轻量防御，在保持下游效用的同时缓解预训练到微调越狱迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预训练到微调范式固有不安全风险，且表征级分析既可用于构造强迁移攻击，也可用于设计保持效用的防御。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MRD: Using Physically Based Differentiable Rendering to Probe Vision Models for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning methods have achieved impressive success in many vision benchmarks, it remains difficult to understand and explain the representations and decisions of these models. Though vision models are typically trained on 2D inputs, they are often assumed to develop an implicit representation of the underlying 3D scene (for example, showing tolerance to partial occlusion, or the ability to reason about relative depth). Here, we introduce MRD (metamers rendered differentiably), an approach that uses physically based differentiable rendering to probe vision models' implicit understanding of generative 3D scene properties, by finding 3D scene parameters that are physically different but produce the same model activation (i.e. are model metamers). Unlike previous pixel-based methods for evaluating model representations, these reconstruction results are always grounded in physical scene descriptions. This means we can, for example, probe a model's sensitivity to object shape while holding material and lighting constant. As a proof-of-principle, we assess multiple models in their ability to recover scene parameters of geometry (shape) and bidirectional reflectance distribution function (material). The results show high similarity in model activation between target and optimized scenes, with varying visual results. Qualitatively, these reconstructions help investigate the physical scene attributes to which models are sensitive or invariant. MRD holds promise for advancing our understanding of both computer and human vision by enabling analysis of how physical scene parameters drive changes in model responses.
papers.comment: v5: Accepted version at Journal of Vision. Note: v2/v3 had a false citation (citation key 16) which was fixed in v4 and was already correct in v1. Code is available here: https://github.com/ag-perception-wallis-lab/MRD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MRD（metamers rendered differentiably），一种利用基于物理的可微渲染（physically based differentiable rendering）来探测视觉模型隐式 3D 场景理解的方法：通过优化物理上不同但能产生相同模型激活的 3D 场景参数，构造模型 metamer。与以往基于像素的评估方法不同，MRD 的重构结果始终锚定在物理场景描述上，从而可以在保持材质和光照不变的同时探测模型对物体形状的敏感性。作为概念验证，作者评估了多个模型恢复几何（形状）和双向反射分布函数（BRDF，材质）场景参数的能力，结果显示目标场景与优化场景之间的模型激活高度相似，但视觉结果差异较大。
Motivation: 深度学习视觉模型在众多基准上表现优异，但其表征和决策仍难以理解和解释；模型虽常以 2D 输入训练，却被认为会隐式形成对 3D 场景的表征（如对部分遮挡的容忍或对相对深度的推理）。以往的像素级评估方法缺乏对物理场景描述的约束，难以直接回答模型对哪些物理场景属性敏感。
Method: MRD 通过基于物理的可微渲染，在 3D 场景参数空间中搜索与目标场景产生相同模型激活的参数（即模型 metamer），使重构结果始终落在物理可解释的场景描述中。这种方式允许研究者独立控制形状、材质和光照等物理属性，分别探测模型对特定属性的敏感度。
Result: 在多个模型上的概念验证实验表明，模型能够恢复形状和 BRDF（材质）等场景参数，目标场景与优化场景在模型激活上高度相似，但两者在视觉上可有明显差异；定性结果表明该方法有助于考察模型对哪些物理场景属性敏感或不变。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MRD 有望通过分析物理场景参数如何驱动模型响应变化，推进对计算机视觉和人类视觉的理解。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 MRD（metamers rendered differentiably），一种利用基于物理的可微渲染（physically based differentiable rendering）来探测视觉模型隐式 3D 场景理解的方法：通过优化物理上不同但能产生相同模型激活的 3D 场景参数，构造模型 metamer。与以往基于像素的评估方法不同，MRD 的重构结果始终锚定在物理场景描述上，从而可以在保持材质和光照不变的同时探测模型对物体形状的敏感性。作为概念验证，作者评估了多个模型恢复几何（形状）和双向反射分布函数（BRDF，材质）场景参数的能力，结果显示目标场景与优化场景之间的模型激活高度相似，但视觉结果差异较大。
summary_sections.motivation: 深度学习视觉模型在众多基准上表现优异，但其表征和决策仍难以理解和解释；模型虽常以 2D 输入训练，却被认为会隐式形成对 3D 场景的表征（如对部分遮挡的容忍或对相对深度的推理）。以往的像素级评估方法缺乏对物理场景描述的约束，难以直接回答模型对哪些物理场景属性敏感。
summary_sections.method: MRD 通过基于物理的可微渲染，在 3D 场景参数空间中搜索与目标场景产生相同模型激活的参数（即模型 metamer），使重构结果始终落在物理可解释的场景描述中。这种方式允许研究者独立控制形状、材质和光照等物理属性，分别探测模型对特定属性的敏感度。
summary_sections.result: 在多个模型上的概念验证实验表明，模型能够恢复形状和 BRDF（材质）等场景参数，目标场景与优化场景在模型激活上高度相似，但两者在视觉上可有明显差异；定性结果表明该方法有助于考察模型对哪些物理场景属性敏感或不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 MRD 有望通过分析物理场景参数如何驱动模型响应变化，推进对计算机视觉和人类视觉的理解。

papers.title: Functional Percolation: Criticality of Form and Function
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how network structure constrains and enables information processing is a central problem in the statistical mechanics of interacting systems. Here we study random networks across the structural percolation transition and analyze how connectivity governs realizable input-output transformations under cascade dynamics. Using Erdos-Renyi networks as a minimal ensemble, we examine structural, functional, and information-theoretic observables as functions of mean degree. We find that the emergence of the giant connected component coincides with a sharp transition in realizable information processing: complex input-output response functions become accessible, functional diversity increases rapidly, output entropy rises, and directed information flow, quantified by transfer entropy, extends beyond local neighborhoods. We term this coincidence of structural, functional, and informational transitions functional percolation, referring to a sharp expansion of the space of realizable input-output functions at the percolation threshold. Near criticality, networks exhibit a Pareto-optimal tradeoff between functional complexity and diversity, suggesting that percolation criticality may provide a general organizing principle of information processing capacity in systems with local interactions and propagating influences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机网络在结构渗流转变附近的信息处理能力，以 Erdos-Renyi 网络为最小系综，将结构、功能和信息论观测量作为平均度的函数进行分析。作者发现巨连通分支的出现与可实现输入-输出函数空间的急剧扩张同步发生：复杂响应函数变得可实现，功能多样性快速增加，输出熵上升，且由迁移熵 (transfer entropy) 量化的定向信息流超出局部邻域。作者将这种结构、功能和信息转变的重合称为功能渗流 (functional percolation)。
Motivation: 理解网络结构如何约束和支持信息处理是相互作用系统统计力学的核心问题；已有结构渗流理论主要刻画连通性，较少回答连通性如何在级联动力学下决定可实现输入-输出变换。
Method: 在 Erdos-Renyi 随机网络上跨越结构渗流转变，考察结构、功能与信息论可观测量随平均度的变化，并用迁移熵量化定向信息流，同时分析复杂输入-输出响应函数的可实现性。
Result: 摘要报告，巨连通分支的形成与可实现信息处理的尖锐转变重合：复杂输入-输出响应函数变得可访问，功能多样性快速上升，输出熵增加，迁移熵所反映的定向信息流扩展至局部邻域之外；近临界点处网络表现出功能复杂度与多样性之间的 Pareto 最优权衡。
Conclusion: 作者据此提出功能渗流概念，认为渗流临界性可能是具有局部相互作用和传播影响的系统中信息处理容量的一般组织原则。摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Continuous-time reinforcement learning for optimal switching over multiple regimes
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the continuous-time reinforcement learning (RL) for optimal switching problems across multiple regimes. We consider a type of exploratory formulation under entropy regularization where the agent randomizes both the timing of switches and the selection of regimes through the generator matrix of an associated continuous-time finite-state Markov chain. We establish the well-posedness of the associated system of Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations and provide a characterization of the optimal policy. The policy improvement and the convergence of the policy iterations are rigorously established by analyzing the system of equations. We also show that the value function in the exploratory formulation converges to the one in the classical formulation as the temperature parameter vanishes. Finally, a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm is devised and implemented by invoking the policy evaluation based on the martingale characterization. Our numerical examples with financial applications illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed RL algorithm.
papers.comment: Keywords: Optimal regime switching, continuous-time reinforcement learning, system of HJB equations, policy improvement, policy iteration convergence, financial applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多机制最优切换 (optimal switching) 问题的连续时间强化学习 (RL)，采用熵正则化下的探索性设定，通过连续时间有限状态马尔可夫链的生成矩阵 (generator matrix) 同时随机化切换时机和机制选择。作者建立了相应 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程组的存在唯一性并刻画最优策略，严格证明了策略改进和策略迭代的收敛性，同时证明探索性设定下的值函数在温度参数趋于零时收敛到经典设定。最后基于鞅刻画 (martingale characterization) 设计了无模型 RL 算法，并用金融应用数值例子展示其有效性和效率。
Motivation: 经典最优切换问题通常需要完整的模型知识，难以直接用于数据驱动的场景。论文目标是构建多机制最优切换的连续时间 RL 框架，使得智能体可以在熵正则化探索下学习最优策略。
Method: 提出熵正则化的探索性公式，通过连续时间有限状态马尔可夫链的生成矩阵同时随机化切换时机与机制选择；分析相应的 HJB 方程组，证明良定性并刻画最优策略；利用鞅刻画设计策略评估，从而构造无模型连续时间 RL 算法。
Result: 摘要报告了策略迭代收敛性和探索值函数向经典值函数收敛的理论结果，并在金融应用的数值例子中验证了所提 RL 算法的有效性和效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为，该工作为多机制最优切换问题提供了严格的理论基础（HJB 方程组良定性、策略改进与收敛性）以及可计算的无模型 RL 算法，并在金融场景中展示其适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful method for guiding the behavior of generative models towards desired outcomes such as toxicity mitigation. However, most existing methods apply interventions uniformly across all inputs, degrading model performance when steering is unnecessary. We introduce Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering (DSAS), a method-agnostic steering framework that decouples when to steer from how to steer. DSAS adaptively modulates the strength of existing steering transformations across layers and inputs, intervening strongly only when undesired behavior is detected. At generation time, DSAS computes context-dependent scaling factors that selectively adjust the strength of any steering method. We also show how DSAS can be jointly optimized end-to-end together with the steering function. When combined with existing steering methods, DSAS consistently improves the Pareto front with respect to steering alone, achieving a better trade-off between toxicity mitigation and utility preservation. We further demonstrate DSAS's generality by applying it to a text-to-image diffusion model, showing how adaptive steering allows the modulation of specific concepts. Finally, DSAS introduces minimal computational overhead while improving interpretability, pinpointing which tokens require steering and by how much.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamically Scaled Activation Steering (DSAS)，一种与具体方法无关的 activation steering 框架，将“何时干预”与“如何干预”解耦。DSAS 在生成时计算上下文相关的缩放因子，只在检测到不期望行为时加强干预，并可端到端与 steering 函数联合优化。与已有 steering 方法结合时，DSAS 在毒性缓解与效用保持之间改进 Pareto 前沿，并同样适用于文本到图像扩散模型。
Motivation: 现有 activation steering 方法对所有输入施加统一干预，在不需要 steering 的输入上会损害模型性能。需要一种自适应机制，根据输入决定是否干预以及干预的强度。
Method: DSAS 提出解耦“何时”与“如何”steering 的通用框架，跨层、跨输入自适应调节已有 steering 变换的强度。它在生成时计算上下文相关的缩放因子，可选择性调整任意 steering 方法的强度，并支持与 steering 函数端到端联合优化，且计算开销极小。
Result: 与已有 steering 方法结合时，DSAS 一致改进 Pareto 前沿，在毒性缓解与效用保持之间取得更好权衡；在 text-to-image 扩散模型上的实验表明自适应 steering 可调制特定概念；此外 DSAS 提升了可解释性，可指出哪些 token 需要 steering 及其力度。
Conclusion: DSAS 是方法无关的自适应 steering 框架，具备通用性、极小计算开销和更好的可解释性，适用于语言模型与扩散模型等生成式模型。

papers.title: Adaptive Weighted LSSVM for Multi-View Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view learning integrates diverse representations of the same instances and can improve performance when interactions across views are effectively exploited. Most existing kernel-based multi-view learning methods either rely on fusion techniques without explicitly enforcing a consensus or complementary collaboration across views, or use co-regularization-based loss functions that impose only pairwise interactions, thereby limiting global collaboration. We propose AW-LSSVM, an adaptive weighted LS-SVM that explicitly enforces complementary learning across all views through an iterative global coupling mechanism. At each iteration, each view not only learns from its own data but is also guided to compensate for samples misclassified by other views in previous iterations by assigning adaptive sample weights. We introduce two strategies for computing these weights: (1) based on averaging misclassification errors across other views and, (2) based on a dissimilarity-aware error aggregation that puts more emphasis on errors from more dissimilar views. Experiments demonstrate that AW-LSSVM outperforms existing multi-view methods on most benchmark datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICANN 2026, to appear in the Springer LNCS proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AW-LSSVM，一种用于多视图分类的自适应加权最小二乘支持向量机 (adaptive weighted LS-SVM)。方法通过迭代全局耦合机制显式强制跨视图互补学习：每轮迭代中，每个视图不仅从自身数据学习，还会被引导通过自适应样本权重去补偿其他视图在上一轮中误分类的样本。实验表明 AW-LSSVM 在大多数基准数据集上优于现有多视图方法。该论文已被 ICANN 2026 接收，将发表于 Springer LNCS 论文集。
Motivation: 现有基于核的多视图学习方法存在两类不足：一类仅做特征融合而没有显式强制视图间的共识或互补协作，另一类使用基于共同正则化 (co-regularization) 的损失函数但只施加两两交互，限制了全局协作。因此需要一种能显式促进全视图范围互补学习的机制。
Method: 提出 AW-LSSVM，采用迭代全局耦合机制，在每个迭代中让每个视图补偿其他视图上一轮误分类的样本，并通过自适应样本权重实现。作者给出两种权重计算策略：一是基于其他视图平均误分类误差，二是基于差异性感知的误差聚合 (dissimilarity-aware error aggregation)，对来自更不相似视图的误差赋予更大权重。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明 AW-LSSVM 在大多数基准数据集上优于现有多视图方法；摘要未给出具体数值或数据集清单。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式的跨视图互补学习、而非仅两两交互，能够提升多视图分类性能；方法的适用范围和局限性在摘要中未讨论。

papers.title: Variance-Aware Baselines and Adaptive Learning Rates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective paradigm for post-training large language models, yet the design of its baselines and learning-rate schedules remains largely heuristic. This limits our understanding of the statistical properties of policy-gradient estimators and their interaction with optimization dynamics. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for variance-aware baseline design and adaptive learning-rate selection in RLVR. Under a KL-regularized policy-optimization setting, we establish the unbiasedness of the resulting gradient estimator, derive exact variance expressions including the KL cross-covariance, and obtain an optimization-loss upper bound that enables principled reasoning about learning dynamics. Building on these results, we prove convergence guarantees and derive an adaptive learning-rate schedule governed by the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the policy gradient. We further show that the variance-optimal baseline is a gradient-weighted estimator of the KL-regularized reward, providing a principled alternative to commonly used reward-based baselines. These results lead to two complementary improvements: a variance-optimal baseline and an SNR-adaptive learning-rate rule. Experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base show that each component independently improves policy-optimization performance. The learning-rate rule can also be naturally integrated with existing policy optimization methods to yield further gains, while combining it with the variance-optimal baseline gives the full Optimal Baseline and Learning-Rate Policy Optimization (OBLR-PO) method and achieves the strongest overall performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）建立了一个理论框架，用于设计方差感知的基线与自适应学习率。作者在 KL 正则化策略优化下证明了梯度估计量的无偏性，推导了包含 KL 交叉协方差的精确方差表达式和优化损失上界，并据此给出收敛保证与由策略梯度信噪比（SNR）控制的自适应学习率规则。在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上的实验显示，方差最优基线和 SNR 自适应学习率各自独立提升策略优化性能，二者结合的完整 OBLR-PO 方法取得最强整体表现。
Motivation: RLVR 已成为大语言模型后训练的有效范式，但其基线设计和学习率调度仍主要依赖启发式，缺乏对策略梯度估计量统计性质及其与优化动力学交互的深入理解。
Method: 提出方差感知的基线设计与自适应学习率选择的理论框架：在 KL 正则化策略优化下建立无偏梯度估计量，推导精确方差表达式（含 KL 交叉协方差）和优化损失上界，并证明收敛性；进而提出基于信号噪声比（SNR）的自适应学习率规则，并指出方差最优基线是 KL 正则化奖励的梯度加权估计量。两者结合构成 OBLR-PO 方法。
Result: 实验在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上显示，方差最优基线与 SNR 自适应学习率各自独立改进策略优化性能；学习率规则可与现有策略优化方法自然集成带来进一步增益，与方差最优基线组合的完整 OBLR-PO 方法整体性能最强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能为 RLVR 提供有原理依据的基线与学习率设计，并给出可集成到现有方法中的互补改进组件；其验证主要限于中规模模型的实验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARES: Anomaly Recognition Model For Edge Streams
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world scenarios involving streaming information can be represented as temporal graphs, where data flows through dynamic changes in edges over time. Anomaly detection in this context has the objective of identifying unusual temporal connections within the graph structure. Detecting edge anomalies in real time is crucial for mitigating potential risks. Unlike traditional anomaly detection, this task is particularly challenging due to concept drifts, large data volumes, and the need for real-time response. To face these challenges, we introduce ARES, an unsupervised anomaly detection framework for edge streams. ARES combines Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for feature extraction with Half-Space Trees (HST) for anomaly scoring. GNNs capture both spike and burst anomalous behaviors within streams by embedding node and edge properties in a latent space, while HST partitions this space to isolate anomalies efficiently. ARES operates in an unsupervised way without the need for prior data labeling. To further validate its detection capabilities, we additionally incorporate a simple yet effective supervised thresholding mechanism. This approach leverages statistical dispersion among anomaly scores to determine the optimal threshold using a minimal set of labeled data, ensuring adaptability across different domains. We validate ARES through extensive evaluations across several real-world cyber-attack scenarios, comparing its performance against existing methods while analyzing its space and time complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARES，一个面向边缘流 (edge streams) 的无监督异常检测框架，将图神经网络 (GNN) 用于特征提取、半空间树 (HST) 用于异常评分。GNN 将节点和边属性嵌入潜在空间以捕获尖峰与突发异常，HST 对该空间进行划分以高效隔离异常。ARES 在多个真实网络攻击场景中与现有方法比较，并分析了空间与时间复杂度。
Motivation: 许多流式场景可建模为时间图，实时识别图中异常边连接对于降低风险至关重要；但该任务面临概念漂移 (concept drift)、数据量大以及实时响应需求，传统异常检测方法难以直接适用。
Method: ARES 结合 GNN 与 HST：GNN 在潜在空间中编码节点和边属性，捕捉尖峰和突发两类异常行为；HST 划分该潜在空间来高效隔离异常。此外，论文加入一个简单有效的监督阈值机制，利用异常分数的统计离散度，仅用少量标注数据即可确定最优阈值，以增强跨领域适应性。
Result: 摘要报告在多个真实网络攻击场景下进行了广泛评估，并与现有方法对比，同时分析了空间和时间复杂度；未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: ARES 以无监督方式运行，无需预先数据标注，其阈值机制可适配不同领域。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。

papers.title: MetaRank: Task-Aware Metric Selection for Model Transferability Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Selecting an appropriate pre-trained source model is a critical, yet computationally expensive, task in transfer learning. Model Transferability Estimation (MTE) methods address this by providing efficient proxy metrics to rank models without full fine-tuning. In practice, the choice of which MTE metric to use is often ad hoc or guided simply by a metric's average historical performance. However, we observe that the effectiveness of MTE metrics is highly task-dependent and no single metric is universally optimal across all target datasets. To address this gap, we introduce MetaRank, a meta-learning framework for automatic, task-aware MTE metric selection. MetaRank adopts a retrieve-and-rerank cascade. A lightweight retrieval stage first narrows the metric pool using performance observed on similar meta-training datasets. To address the heterogeneous definitions and scales of MTE scores, the reranking stage represents each retrieved metric through the pairwise source-model ordering it induces on the target dataset. A product-kernel regressor combines dataset and ordering similarities to refine the ranking, enabling cross-metric transfer from historical metrics with similar ordering behavior. MetaRank then ranks the retrieved metrics and selects the most appropriate one to guide source-model selection on an unseen target dataset. Extensive experiments across 11 pre-trained models, 13 candidate MTE metrics, and 14 target datasets demonstrate that MetaRank significantly outperforms all compared baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaRank，一个用于自动、任务感知的模型迁移性估计（MTE）指标选择的元学习框架。它采用 retrieve-and-rerank 级联结构，先用轻量检索基于元训练数据上的历史性能缩小候选指标池，再通过产品核回归（product-kernel regressor）结合数据集相似度与排序相似度对指标重新排序，从而在未见过的目标数据集上选出最合适的 MTE 指标来指导源模型选择。实验覆盖 11 个预训练模型、13 个候选 MTE 指标和 14 个目标数据集，结果显示 MetaRank 显著优于所有对比基线。
Motivation: 在实际迁移学习中选择合适的预训练源模型时，使用哪种 MTE 指标往往是临时的或仅依据历史平均性能，但 MTE 指标的有效性高度依赖目标任务，单一指标无法在所有目标数据集上通用。
Method: MetaRank 采用两级级联：先通过轻量检索阶段依据相似元训练数据集上观测到的性能缩小指标池；再通过每个指标在目标数据集上诱导的源模型两两排序来表示异构的 MTE 分数，并用产品核回归结合数据集相似性与排序相似性来细化排序，最终选出最合适的指标。
Result: 在 11 个预训练模型、13 个候选 MTE 指标和 14 个目标数据集上的大量实验表明，MetaRank 显著优于所有对比基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MTE 指标有效性具有任务依赖性，并表明通过跨指标迁移（cross-metric transfer）可以实现任务感知的自动指标选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DinoLizer: Separating VAE and Diffusion Artifacts in Generative Inpainting Localization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DinoLizer, a DINOv2-based localizer of manipulated areas in generative inpainting. The model is trained to focus on semantically altered regions by treating reconstructed areas outside the inpainted mask as a separate class, which yields significant improvements w.r.t. the conven- tional approach. We train the model with LORA on the Query and Value of the transformer blocks and simply add 1 linear layer on top of the backbone to predict manipulations on a 14 x 14 patch resolution. Because DINOv2 only accepts fixed- sized images, we use a sliding window approach to aggregate the predictions on larger images. Empirical results show that DinoLizer outperforms state-of-the-art methods on our proposed dataset and SOTA inpainting datasets. Furthermore, it is very robust to JPEG (double) compression. On average, DinoLizer achieves a 20% higher Intersection over Union score compared to the second best model. The code is publicly available here: https://github.com/anonyme610/dinolizer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DinoLizer，一种基于 DINOv2 的生成式图像修复（generative inpainting）篡改区域定位方法。作者将修复掩码之外的重建区域作为单独类别训练，使模型聚焦于语义改变区域。摘要报告该方法在自建数据集与现有 SOTA inpainting 数据集上均超过对比方法，并对 JPEG（双重）压缩稳健，平均 IoU 比次优模型高 20%。
Motivation: 生成式图像修复会在图像中留下与普通后处理不同的痕迹，现有定位方法对掩码内外区域的建模不够有效，难以准确且鲁棒地定位被语义篡改的区域。
Method: 以 DINOv2 为骨干，用 LoRA 仅微调 Transformer 块的 Query 与 Value，并在骨干之上添加单层线性层，在 14x14 patch 分辨率上输出篡改预测；通过将掩码外的重建区域单独划分为一类来强化对语义改变的感知；由于 DINOv2 只接受固定尺寸输入，对更大图像使用滑动窗口聚合预测。
Result: 摘要称 DinoLizer 在作者提出的数据集以及现有 SOTA inpainting 数据集上优于已有方法，平均 Intersection over Union 比第二名高 20%，并且对 JPEG（双重）压缩具有很强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将修复掩码外的重建区域作为独立类别、配合 LoRA 轻量微调，能够显著提升生成式修复定位性能；代码已公开。

papers.title: EmoFeedback$^2$: Reinforcement of Continuous Emotional Image Generation via LVLM-based Reward and Textual Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Continuous emotional image content generation (C-EICG) is emerging rapidly due to its ability to produce images aligned with both user descriptions and continuous emotional values. However, existing approaches lack emotional feedback from generated images, limiting the control of emotional continuity. Additionally, their simple emotion-text alignment fails to adaptively adjust emotional prompts according to image content, leading to insufficient emotional fidelity. To address these concerns, we propose a novel generation-understanding-feedback reinforcement paradigm (EmoFeedback$^2$) for C-EICG, which exploits the reasoning capability of the fine-tuned large vision-language model (LVLM) to provide reward and textual feedback for generating high-quality images with continuous emotions. Specifically, we introduce an emotion-aware reward feedback strategy, where the LVLM evaluates the emotional values of generated images and computes the reward against target emotions, guiding the reinforcement fine-tuning of the generative model and enhancing the emotional continuity of images. Furthermore, we design a self-promotion textual feedback framework, in which the LVLM iteratively analyzes the emotional content of generated images and adaptively produces refinement suggestions for the next-round prompt, improving the emotional fidelity with fine-grained content. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively generates high-quality images with the desired emotions, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods on both our custom dataset and public dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmoFeedback$^2$，一种用于连续情感图像内容生成 (C-EICG) 的生成-理解-反馈强化范式。方法利用微调后的大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 同时提供奖励信号和文本反馈：一方面评估生成图像的情感值并与目标情感计算奖励，指导生成模型的强化微调；另一方面迭代分析图像情感内容并自动产生下一轮提示词的细化建议。摘要称该方法在自建数据集和公开数据集上均优于现有最先进方法，能生成具有期望连续情感的图像。
Motivation: 现有连续情感图像生成方法缺乏来自生成图像的情感反馈，难以控制情感连续性；其简单的情感-文本对齐也无法根据图像内容自适应调整情感提示词，导致情感保真度不足。
Method: 提出 EmoFeedback$^2$ 范式，包含两个核心组件：情感感知奖励反馈策略 (emotion-aware reward feedback)，由微调 LVLM 评估生成图像的情感值并相对目标情感计算奖励，用于强化微调生成模型；以及自提升文本反馈框架 (self-promotion textual feedback)，LVLM 迭代分析已生成图像的情感内容，并自适应生成下一轮提示词的细化建议。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法能有效生成具有期望情感的高质量图像，并在自建数据集和公开数据集上均超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用 LVLM 的推理能力同时提供奖励与文本反馈，可以增强图像的情感连续性与细粒度情感保真度。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，利用 LVLM 的推理能力同时提供奖励与文本反馈，可以增强图像的情感连续性与细粒度情感保真度。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis of Northern Hemisphere SLP Anomalies: Identifying and Tracking the Structural Skeleton of Atmospheric Pressure Systems
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel framework based on Topological Data Analysis (TDA) to identify and track cyclonic and anticyclonic structures in the Northern Hemisphere. Using persistent homology applied to seven decades of daily sea-level pressure anomalies (1948--2023), we represent the atmospheric field as a cubical complex and compute sublevel- and superlevel-set filtrations. This approach allows us to identify 1-dimensional topological features (1-holes) that correspond to coherent pressure systems, which we term 1-cyclones and 1-anticyclones. The structural intensity of these features is quantified through their topological depth, while their dynamical evolution is followed using an optimal matching procedure based on the Wasserstein distance between consecutive persistence diagrams. Our results reveal robust seasonal patterns characterized by winter maxima and summer minima in total persistence, frequency, and spatial extent. We show that cyclonic activity is topologically more fragmented and intense, consistent with the seasonal deepening of the Icelandic Low, whereas anticyclones exhibit a heavier long-duration tail associated with persistent blocking episodes. Crucially, we demonstrate that TDA metrics can differentiate between distinct dynamical regimes of atmospheric blocking, distinguishing the quasi-stationary, ``frozen'' topology of the 2003 European heatwave from the more volatile and unstable configuration of the 2012 cold spell. Compared to classical geometric tracking algorithms, this framework provides an objective, multiscale, and noise-robust characterization of the atmospheric skeleton, offering a unified mathematical description of the organization and stability of mid-latitude circulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于拓扑数据分析 (TDA) 的框架，用于识别和追踪北半球气旋与反气旋结构。作者对 1948-2023 年逐日海平面气压异常构建 cubical complex，通过 sublevel- 与 superlevel-set filtrations 的持续同调提取一维拓扑特征（称为 1-cyclones 和 1-anticyclones），并利用连续 persistence diagrams 之间的 Wasserstein 距离做最优匹配来追踪演化。结果显示总持续量、频率和空间范围呈现冬季最大、夏季最小的季节模式，且 TDA 指标能区分 2003 年欧洲热浪与 2012 年寒潮的不同阻塞动力学。
Motivation: 经典几何跟踪算法缺乏对大气压力系统结构的客观、多尺度且抗噪的统一数学刻画，难以精细描述中纬度环流的组织方式与稳定性。
Method: 将大气场表示为 cubical complex，对 SLP 异常同时计算 sublevel- 和 superlevel-set filtrations，用持续同调识别对应相干压力系统的一维洞；以 topological depth 量化结构强度，并通过相邻 persistence diagrams 间的 Wasserstein 距离执行最优匹配以追踪系统演化。
Result: 基于七十年日数据的分析显示，冬季总持续量、频率和空间范围达到峰值而夏季最小；气旋活动在拓扑上更破碎且更强，而反气旋具有与持续阻塞事件相关的更长持续时间尾部。TDA 指标还可将 2003 年欧洲热浪的准静止“冻结”拓扑与 2012 年寒潮的易变不稳定构型区分开来。
Conclusion: 作者认为，相比经典几何跟踪算法，该框架提供了客观、多尺度、抗噪的大气结构骨架描述，为中纬度环流组织与稳定性给出统一的数学刻画。
Relevance: 28

papers.title: PartDiffuser: Part-wise 3D Mesh Generation via Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing autoregressive (AR) methods for generating artist-designed meshes struggle to balance global structural consistency with high-fidelity local details, and are susceptible to error accumulation. To address this, we propose PartDiffuser, a novel semi-autoregressive diffusion framework for point-cloud-to-mesh generation. The method first performs semantic segmentation on the mesh and then operates in a "part-wise" manner: it employs autoregression between parts to ensure global topology, while utilizing a parallel discrete diffusion process within each semantic part to precisely reconstruct high-frequency geometric features. PartDiffuser is based on the DiT architecture and introduces a part-aware cross-attention mechanism, using point clouds as hierarchical geometric conditioning to dynamically control the generation process, thereby effectively decoupling the global and local generation tasks. Experiments demonstrate that this method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) models in generating 3D meshes with rich detail, exhibiting exceptional detail representation suitable for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PartDiffuser，一种半自回归离散扩散框架，用于点云到三维网格 (mesh) 的生成。方法先对网格做语义分割，再按部件生成：部件间使用自回归确保全局拓扑，部件内使用并行离散扩散过程重建高频几何特征。框架基于 DiT 架构，引入部件感知交叉注意力机制，以点云作为层次化几何条件动态控制生成过程。实验表明其在生成细节丰富的 3D 网格上显著优于现有 SOTA 模型。
Motivation: 现有自回归 (AR) 方法生成艺术家设计网格时难以平衡全局结构一致性与高保真局部细节，并且容易产生误差累积。
Method: 提出半自回归扩散框架 PartDiffuser：先对网格进行语义分割，然后在部件级操作，部件间采用自回归以保持全局拓扑，每个语义部件内采用并行离散扩散过程精确重建高频几何特征；基于 DiT 架构，引入部件感知交叉注意力，以点云作为层次化几何条件动态控制生成，从而解耦全局与局部生成任务。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在生成细节丰富的 3D 网格上显著优于 SOTA 模型，并展现出适合实际应用的细节表达能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过解耦全局拓扑与局部高频细节生成，半自回归扩散框架能够兼顾结构一致性与细节保真度，并具有实际应用潜力。

papers.title: Distributions In, Distributions Out: The Case for Soft-Label Training
papers.abstract_en: Supervised classifiers output a distribution over classes but are typically trained against a single label obtained by collapsing multiple annotators into a majority vote. On tasks where annotator disagreement reflects genuine ambiguity -- natural language inference, politeness, visually ambiguous categorization -- this collapse discards information and forces models to express uniform confidence on inputs where humans systematically disagree. We compare soft-label training, which uses the full annotation distribution as the target, against hard-label training across three datasets spanning vision and NLP (ChaosNLI, POPQUORN, CIFAR-10H). Soft-label training matches or exceeds hard-label accuracy on every dataset, reduces KL divergence to the annotator distribution by 32% on average (p < 10^-4), and produces predictions whose per-sample entropy correlates 61% more strongly with annotator entropy -- models trained on distributions are uncertain precisely where humans are. We argue these benefits follow from a basic observation: when annotators legitimately disagree, the annotation distribution is the correct learning target, not a noisy estimate of it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论监督分类器在多标注者场景下的训练目标选择：传统做法将多个标注者投票折叠成单一硬标签 (hard label)，而作者主张使用完整标注分布作为软标签 (soft label) 训练目标。作者在三个涵盖视觉与 NLP 的数据集（ChaosNLI、POPQUORN、CIFAR-10H）上对比软标签与硬标签训练，发现软标签训练在准确率上不逊色或更优，并显著降低预测分布与标注者分布之间的 KL 散度。核心论点是：当标注者分歧反映真实歧义时，标注分布本身就是正确的学习目标，而非有噪声的估计。
Motivation: 现有监督分类器针对单一多数投票标签训练，但在自然语言推断、礼貌性判断、视觉模糊分类等任务中，标注者分歧反映真实语义歧义，折叠成多数票会丢失信息，并迫使模型对存在系统性人类分歧的输入表现出统一置信度。
Method: 提出并系统比较软标签训练（以完整标注分布为目标）与硬标签训练（以多数投票单标签为目标），在三个数据集（ChaosNLI、POPQUORN、CIFAR-10H）上进行实验评估。
Result: 软标签训练在每个数据集上均达到或超过硬标签训练的准确率；平均将预测分布与标注者分布的 KL 散度降低 32%（p < 10^-4）；预测的逐样本熵与标注者熵的相关性比硬标签训练高 61%，即模型恰好在人类存在分歧处表现不确定。
Conclusion: 作者认为收益源于一个基本观察：当标注者合法分歧时，标注分布是正确学习目标，而非其噪声估计；该工作为分类器训练目标的选择提供了经验依据。

papers.title: You Only Look Omni Gradient Backpropagation for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Moving infrared small target detection is a key component of infrared search and tracking systems, yet it remains extremely challenging due to low signal-to-clutter ratios, severe target-background imbalance, and weak discriminative features. Existing deep learning methods primarily focus on spatio-temporal feature aggregation, but their gains are limited, revealing that the fundamental bottleneck lies in ambiguous per-frame feature representations rather than spatio-temporal modeling itself. Motivated by this insight, we propose BP-FPN, a backpropagation-driven feature pyramid architecture that fundamentally rethinks feature learning for small target. BP-FPN introduces Gradient-Isolated Low-Level Shortcut (GILS) to efficiently incorporate fine-grained target details without inducing shortcut learning, and Directional Gradient Regularization (DGR) to enforce hierarchical feature consistency during backpropagation. The design is theoretically grounded, introduces negligible computational overhead, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing frameworks. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets show that BP-FPN consistently establishes new state-of-the-art performance. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first FPN designed for this task entirely from the backpropagation perspective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对运动红外小目标检测中逐帧特征表示模糊这一根本瓶颈，提出 BP-FPN，一种从反向传播视角设计的特征金字塔架构。BP-FPN 引入梯度隔离的低层捷径 (Gradient-Isolated Low-Level Shortcut, GILS) 和方向梯度正则化 (Directional Gradient Regularization, DGR)，在不引入捷径学习的前提下融合细粒度目标细节，并在反向传播中强制层次特征一致性。多个公开数据集上的实验表明 BP-FPN 取得新的最优性能，且计算开销可忽略、可无缝集成到现有框架。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法主要聚焦于时空特征聚合，但性能提升有限；作者认为根本瓶颈在于逐帧特征表示模糊，而非时空建模本身。
Method: 提出 BP-FPN：通过 GILS 高效融入细粒度目标细节并避免捷径学习 (shortcut learning)，通过 DGR 在反向传播中强制执行层次特征一致性；设计具有理论依据，额外计算开销可忽略。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上的大量实验显示 BP-FPN 一致地刷新了该任务的最优性能 (state-of-the-art)。
Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个完全从反向传播视角为红外小目标检测设计的 FPN，且可无缝集成到现有框架中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Oral Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of oral cancer and potentially malignant diseases is a major challenge in low-resource settings due to the scarcity of annotated data. We provide a unified approach for oral lesion classification that incorporates deep learning, spectral analysis, and demographic data. A pathologist verified subset of oral cavity images was curated from a publicly available dataset. Oral cavity pictures were processed using a fine tuned ConvNeXtv2 network for deep embeddings before being translated into the hyperspectral domain using a reconstruction algorithm. Haemoglobin sensitive, textural, and spectral descriptors were obtained from the reconstructed hyperspectral cubes and combined with demographic data. Multiple machine learning models were evaluated using patient specific validation. Finally, an incremental heuristic meta learner (IHML) was developed that merged calibrated base classifiers via probabilistic feature stacking and uncertainty-aware abstraction of multimodal representations with patient level smoothing. By decoupling evidence extraction from decision fusion, IHML stabilizes predictions in heterogeneous, small sample medical datasets. On an unseen test set, our proposed model achieved a macro F1 of 66.23% and an overall accuracy of 64.56%. The findings demonstrate that RGB to hyperspectral reconstruction and ensemble meta learning improve diagnostic robustness in real world oral lesion screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低资源环境中口腔癌及潜在恶性病变早期检测因标注数据稀缺而困难的问题，提出一种统一的口腔病变分类方法，结合深度学习、光谱分析和人口统计学数据。作者从公开数据集构建经过病理学家验证的口腔图像子集，用微调的 ConvNeXtv2 提取深度嵌入，再经重建算法转入高光谱域，获取血红蛋白敏感、纹理和光谱描述符，并与人口统计学数据合并。最终开发了增量启发式元学习器 (IHML)，通过概率特征堆叠和不确定性感知的多模态抽象融合校准基分类器，并在未见测试集上达到宏 F1 66.23% 和总体准确率 64.56%。
Motivation: 口腔癌和潜在恶性疾病的早期检测在低资源环境中面临重大挑战，主要原因是标注数据稀缺，导致现有模型难以获得稳健性能。
Method: 方法包括：用微调 ConvNeXtv2 提取口腔图像的深度嵌入，通过重建算法将 RGB 图像转换到高光谱域，提取血红蛋白敏感、纹理和光谱描述符，并与人口统计学数据结合；评估多种机器学习模型，并开发增量启发式元学习器 (IHML)，其将证据提取与决策融合解耦，采用概率特征堆叠、不确定性感知的多模态表示抽象和患者级平滑。
Result: 在未见测试集上，所提模型取得宏 F1 66.23% 和总体准确率 64.56%；结果表明 RGB 到高光谱重建与集成元学习能够提升真实世界口腔病变筛查的诊断鲁棒性。

papers.title: Linking Heterogeneous Data with Coordinated Agent Flows for Social Media Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Social media platforms generate volumes of heterogeneous data, capturing user behaviors, textual content, and network structures. Analyzing such data is crucial for understanding phenomena such as opinion dynamics, community formation, and information diffusion. However, discovering insights from this complex landscape is exploratory, conceptually challenging, and requires expertise in social media mining and visualization. Existing automated approaches, including large language models (LLMs), remain largely confined to structured tabular data and cannot adequately address the heterogeneity of social media analysis. We present SIA (Social Insight Agents), an LLM agent system that links heterogeneous multi-modal data, including raw inputs (e.g., text, network, and behavioral data), mined analytical results, and rendered visual artifacts, through coordinated agent flows. Guided by an insight-oriented taxonomy connecting insight types with suitable mining methods and visualization strategies, SIA adopts a stage-synchronized strategy that proceeds through goal decomposition, query, mining, visualization, and reporting stages. At each stage, it collects prior information to jointly plan and execute agent actions, while the coordinator maintains cross-stage action dependencies and assembles and distributes data to agents. Through quantitative evaluation and case studies supported by an interactive interface, we show that SIA can discover diverse and meaningful insights from social media with opportunities for subsequent reliability assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIA（Social Insight Agents），一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统，用于社交媒体异构数据分析。SIA 通过协调的智能体流程（coordinated agent flows）将原始输入（文本、网络、行为数据）、挖掘出的分析结果和渲染的可视化产物连接起来，并依据面向洞察的分类体系，采用目标分解、查询、挖掘、可视化和报告的分阶段同步策略。摘要称，通过定量评估和交互界面的案例研究，SIA 能从社交媒体中发现多样且有意义的洞察。
Motivation: 社交媒体产生海量异构数据，涵盖用户行为、文本内容和网络结构，但分析这类数据是探索性的、概念上具有挑战性，且需要社交媒体挖掘与可视化方面的专业知识。现有的自动化方法（包括 LLM）主要局限于结构化表格数据，无法充分处理社交媒体的异构性。
Method: SIA 是一个 LLM 智能体系统，通过协调的智能体流程链接异构多模态数据（原始输入、挖掘的分析结果、渲染的可视化产物）。系统采用洞察导向的分类体系（insight-oriented taxonomy）将洞察类型与合适的挖掘方法和可视化策略对应起来，并采用阶段同步策略：在每个阶段收集先前信息，联合规划并执行智能体动作，由协调器维护跨阶段的动作依赖关系，并汇总分发数据给各智能体。
Result: 摘要报告了定量评估以及在交互式界面支持下开展的案例研究，表明 SIA 能够从社交媒体中发现多样化且有意义的洞察，并为进一步的可靠性评估提供机会。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将异构数据、挖掘结果与可视化产物通过协调的智能体流程加以整合，可以有效支持社交媒体分析中的探索性洞察发现；同时指出后续仍有可靠性评估方面的研究空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Critical attention scaling in long-context transformers
papers.abstract_en: As large language models scale to longer contexts, attention layers suffer from a fundamental pathology: attention scores collapse toward uniformity as context length $n$ increases, causing tokens to cluster excessively, a phenomenon known as rank-collapse. While $\textit{attention scaling}$ effectively addresses this deficiency by rescaling attention scores with a polylogarithmic factor $β_n$, theoretical justification for this approach remains lacking. We analyze a simplified yet tractable model that magnifies the effect of attention scaling. In this model, attention exhibits a phase transition governed by the scaling factor $β_n$: insufficient scaling collapses all tokens to a single direction, while excessive scaling reduces attention to identity, thereby eliminating meaningful interactions between tokens. Our main result identifies the critical scaling $β_n \asymp \log n$ and provides a rigorous justification for attention scaling in YaRN and Qwen, clarifying why logarithmic scaling maintains sparse, content-adaptive attention at large context lengths.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长上下文 Transformer 中注意力分数随上下文长度 n 增大而趋于均匀、导致秩崩溃（rank-collapse）的问题，并提出注意力缩放（attention scaling）通过 polylog 因子 β_n 重新缩放注意力分数。作者在一个简化但可处理的模型中分析缩放效应，发现注意力存在相变：缩放不足会使所有 token 坍缩到单一方向，缩放过度则使注意力退化为恒等映射。主要结果表明临界缩放为 β_n ≍ log n，为 YaRN 和 Qwen 中的注意力缩放提供了严格的理论依据。
Motivation: 随着大语言模型上下文不断变长，注意力分数会向均匀分布坍缩，造成 token 过度集聚，即 rank-collapse 现象；已有的注意力缩放方法虽能缓解该问题，但一直缺乏理论上的严格解释。
Method: 作者构建了一个简化但可处理的模型来放大注意力缩放的影响，并分析缩放因子 β_n 如何控制注意力的行为。通过该模型，注意力表现出由 β_n 决定的相变结构，最终导出临界缩放条件。
Result: 模型显示相变：当 β_n 过小时所有 token 坍缩为一个方向；当 β_n 过大时注意力退化为恒等映射，token 间有效交互消失。主要结果为临界缩放 β_n ≍ log n，并据此严格解释了为何对数缩放能在大上下文长度下维持稀疏、内容自适应的注意力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该结果给出了 YaRN 与 Qwen 中注意力缩放的理论基础，澄清了对数缩放能够在大上下文长度下保持注意力稀疏且内容自适应的原因。

papers.title: RetiBridge: Bridging Quantitative Retinal Biomarkers and Qualitative Diagnosis with a Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Retinal biomarkers captured by color fundus photography and optical coherence tomography provide clinically valuable evidence for both ocular and systemic diseases. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown promise for retinal image interpretation, yet existing ophthalmic models rarely quantify these clinically relevant biomarkers or explicitly translate their measurements into qualitative, evidence-grounded diagnostic conclusions. To address this gap, we introduce RetiBridge, a knowledge-guided multimodal large language model that jointly analyzes color fundus photography (CFP), optical coherence tomography (OCT), and text, explicitly bridging quantitative retinal biomarkers to qualitative clinical sub-inferences and coherent diagnostic conclusions. RetiBridge combines knowledge-guided instruction generation, OCT-biomarker alignment, and supervised multimodal instruction tuning to learn a biomarker-grounded quantitative-to-qualitative diagnostic pathway. Using 15,611 paired CFP-OCT samples from UK Biobank with 31 OCT and 6 CFP biomarkers, we construct the Grounded Ophthalmic Understanding benchmark to evaluate diagnostic classification, report generation quality, and fine-grained clinical quality. Despite using only LoRA-based fine-tuning of a 7B-parameter Qwen2 backbone, RetiBridge outperforms all evaluated open-source 7B and 32B baselines, achieving the highest quantitative accuracy, evidence grounding, coverage completeness, and BERTScore, while surpassing OpenAI o3 on these key biomarker-grounded metrics. Our code and data are released in the RetiBridge repository.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 table. Equal contribution: Zhuangzhi Gao and Hongyi Qin. Corresponding author: Yalin Zheng (yzheng@liverpool.ac.uk)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RetiBridge，一个知识引导的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)，用于联合分析彩色眼底照相 (CFP)、OCT 和文本，将定量视网膜生物标志物显式桥接到定性临床子推断和诊断结论。作者利用英国生物银行 (UK Biobank) 的 15,611 对 CFP-OCT 样本及 31 个 OCT、6 个 CFP 生物标志物构建 Grounded Ophthalmic Understanding 评估基准。基于 LoRA 微调的 7B 参数 Qwen2，该模型在定量准确度、证据扎根、覆盖完整性和 BERTScore 上优于所有开源 7B/32B 基线，并超过 OpenAI o3。
Motivation: 现有眼科多模态模型很少对临床相关视网膜生物标志物进行定量，也没有把测量结果明确转化为有证据支撑的定性诊断，造成了定量指标与临床结论之间的断裂。
Method: RetiBridge 结合知识引导的指令生成、OCT-生物标志物对齐以及监督式多模态指令微调，学习一条由定量生物标志物通向定性诊断的路径；训练仅采用基于 Qwen2-7B 的 LoRA 微调。
Result: 在自建的 Grounded Ophthalmic Understanding 基准上，RetiBridge 的诊断分类、报告生成质量与细粒度临床质量均达到最优，定量准确性、证据扎根度、覆盖完整性和 BERTScore 超过所有开源 7B/32B 基线，并在这些关键指标上超越 OpenAI o3。
Conclusion: 作者认为将定量视网膜生物标志物显式桥接至定性结论可以提升多模态眼科诊断的可解释性与证据性，并已发布代码和数据供复现与后续使用。

papers.title: A Tale of LLMs and Induced Small Proxies: Scalable Small Language Models for Knowledge Mining
papers.abstract_en: At the core of Deep Research is knowledge mining, the task of extracting structured information from massive unstructured text in response to user instructions. Large language models (LLMs) excel at interpreting such instructions but are prohibitively expensive to deploy at scale, while traditional pipelines of classifiers and extractors remain efficient yet brittle and unable to generalize to new tasks. We introduce Falconer, a collaborative framework that combines the agentic reasoning of LLMs with lightweight proxy models for scalable knowledge mining. In Falconer, LLMs act as planners, decomposing user instructions into executable pipelines, and as annotators, generating supervision to train small proxies. The framework unifies classification and extraction into two atomic operations, get label and get span, enabling a single instruction-following model to replace multiple task-specific components. To evaluate the consistency between proxy models incubated by Falconer and annotations provided by humans and large models, we construct new benchmarks covering both planning and end-to-end execution. Experiments show that Falconer closely matches state-of-the-art LLMs in instruction-following accuracy while reducing inference cost by up to 90% and accelerating large-scale knowledge mining by more than 20x, offering an efficient and scalable foundation for Deep Research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Falconer，一个将 LLM 的智能体推理 (agentic reasoning) 与轻量代理模型 (proxy models) 结合的协作框架，用于大规模知识挖掘 (knowledge mining)。框架中 LLM 充当规划器将用户指令分解为可执行流水线，并作为标注器生成监督数据来训练小型代理；统一分类与抽取为 get label 和 get span 两种原子操作，使单一指令跟随模型替代多个任务专用组件。摘要报告 Falconer 在指令跟随准确率上接近最先进的 LLM，同时推理成本最高降低 90%，大规模知识挖掘速度提升超过 20 倍。
Motivation: Deep Research 的核心是知识挖掘，即从海量非结构化文本中按用户指令提取结构化信息；LLM 擅长解释指令但规模部署成本过高，而传统分类器与抽取器流水线高效却脆弱、难以泛化到新任务。
Method: 提出 Falconer 协作框架：LLM 作为规划器分解用户指令为可执行流水线，并作为标注器生成监督信号以训练小型代理模型；将分类与抽取统一为 get label 与 get span 两种原子操作，使单个指令跟随模型替代多个任务特定组件。
Result: 摘要报告 Falconer 在指令跟随准确率上接近最先进的 LLM，推理成本最高降低 90%，大规模知识挖掘加速超过 20 倍；并构建了覆盖规划与端到端执行的新基准来评估代理模型与人类及大模型标注的一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 Falconer 为 Deep Research 提供了高效且可扩展的知识挖掘基础，在不牺牲指令跟随准确率的前提下显著降低推理成本并加速大规模处理。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 Falconer 协作框架：LLM 作为规划器分解用户指令为可执行流水线，并作为标注器生成监督信号以训练小型代理模型；将分类与抽取统一为 get label 与 get span 两种原子操作，使单个指令跟随模型替代多个任务特定组件。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Falconer 在指令跟随准确率上接近最先进的 LLM，推理成本最高降低 90%，大规模知识挖掘加速超过 20 倍；并构建了覆盖规划与端到端执行的新基准来评估代理模型与人类及大模型标注的一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为 Falconer 为 Deep Research 提供了高效且可扩展的知识挖掘基础，在不牺牲指令跟随准确率的前提下显著降低推理成本并加速大规模处理。

papers.title: Towards Unified Multimodal Misinformation Detection in Social Media: A Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
papers.abstract_en: Detecting deceptive multimodal content on social media has become an increasingly important problem. Two major types of deception dominate: human-crafted misinformation (e.g., rumors and misleading posts) and AI-generated content produced by image synthesis models or vision-language models (VLMs). However, these two types are usually addressed as separate tasks. Consequently, existing models are often specialized for only one type of fake content. In real deployments, however, the fake-content type of an incoming multimodal post is typically unknown, which limits the practicality of such specialized systems. To study this setting, we build OmniFake, a benchmark with 98K samples that combines human-curated misinformation from existing resources with newly created AI-generated examples. To address this new task, we propose Unified Multimodal Fake Content Detection (UMFDet), a framework designed to handle both types of deception. UMFDet builds on a VLM backbone augmented with a Category-aware Mixture-of-Experts (CMoE) adapter to capture category-specific cues. We further introduce an Expert-wise Discriminative Regularization to enforce intra-expert compactness. In addition, cross-modal consistency alignment is proposed to improve the perceptual capability of experts for handling different deception types. Experiments show that UMFDet consistently outperforms competitive specialized baselines across both deception types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社交媒体中两类欺骗性多模态内容——人工编造的虚假信息（如谣言、误导帖）与由图像合成模型或视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的 AI 内容——提出统一检测设定，并构建含 98K 样本的基准 OmniFake。作者提出 UMFDet 框架，基于 VLM 主干并加入类别感知的混合专家（CMoE）适配器，配合专家级判别正则化与跨模态一致性对齐。实验表明 UMFDet 在两类欺骗内容上均稳定优于专用的强基线。
Motivation: 现有的多模态虚假内容检测通常把人工虚假信息和 AI 生成内容当作两个独立任务，模型往往只擅长其中一类；然而真实部署中一条多模态帖子的伪造内容类型通常是未知的，这限制了专用系统的实用性。
Method: 构建 OmniFake 基准，将现有资源中人工整理的虚假信息与新建的 AI 生成样本结合，共 98K 样本；提出 Unified Multimodal Fake Content Detection (UMFDet) 框架，采用 VLM 主干并附加 Category-aware Mixture-of-Experts (CMoE) 适配器捕捉类别特有线索，引入 Expert-wise Discriminative Regularization 增强专家内紧凑性，并通过跨模态一致性对齐提升专家对不同欺骗类型的感知能力。
Result: 实验显示 UMFDet 在两类欺骗内容上均一致优于竞争性的专用基线模型；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一的检测设定具有实际部署价值，并表明一个统一框架可以同时处理人工虚假信息与 AI 生成内容，而不需要预先知道伪造内容类型。
Relevance: 0
