papers.title: On the Rate of Convergence of Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Regression Estimators
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) approximate multivariate functions by composing univariate transformations through additive or multiplicative aggregation. We establish convergence guarantees for KANs whose univariate components are B-splines. The least-squares estimator over the KAN spline sieve attains the rate $O((\log n / n)^{2r/(2r+1)})$, uniformly over a ball of regression functions admitting a KAN representation with univariate components of Sobolev smoothness $r$; a matching lower bound of order $n^{-2r/(2r+1)}$ shows this is minimax optimal up to the logarithmic factor, which we trace to the nonlinearity of the sieve rather than to the architecture. The rate is free of the ambient dimension $d$; this dimension-free exponent reflects the assumed KAN structure of the target, not an escape from the minimax rate $n^{-2r/(2r+d)}$ on Sobolev classes over $[0,1]^d$. We derive a knot-selection rule, show that penalized selection over a dyadic knot grid attains the rate adaptively in the unknown smoothness, and show that univariate components are not identifiable under centering alone, so consistency of the fit does not imply consistency of the components. On targets of exactly known smoothness the fitted risk exponent is at least as steep as the bound in every configuration, and the predicted knot scaling and $k^{-r}$ approximation decay are checked directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) 回归估计量的收敛速度，针对单变量成分为 B 样条的 KAN，证明样条筛上的最小二乘估计达到 O((log n / n)^{2r/(2r+1)}) 的上界，并给出 n^{-2r/(2r+1)} 的匹配下界，说明在至多相差对数因子的意义下该速率是 minimax 最优的。速率不依赖环境维数 d，但作者明确指出这反映的是目标函数本身的 KAN 结构假设，而非对 [0,1]^d 上 Sobolev 类 minimax 率 n^{-2r/(2r+d)} 的逃离。文中还推导了节点选择规则、光滑度未知时的自适应惩罚选择，以及单变量分量在仅做 centering 时不可识别的问题。
Motivation: 现有 KAN 工作主要关注其表示能力，但作为回归估计器时的统计收敛速率、最优性和自适应性问题缺乏系统刻画；需要明确维数无关速率背后的假设来源，以及筛的非线性对速率的影响。
Method: 采用单变量成分为 B 样条的 KAN 样条筛 (spline sieve)，对最小二乘估计器建立上界与匹配下界；通过对数因子来源的分析区分架构与筛非线性的作用；推导节点选择规则，并在二进节点网格上进行惩罚选择以实现对未知光滑度的自适应；利用 centering 条件讨论 KAN 单变量分量的可识别性。
Result: 上界为 O((log n / n)^{2r/(2r+1)})，下界为 n^{-2r/(2r+1)}，两者在 [0,1]^d 上带 r 阶 Sobolev 光滑单变量分量的 KAN 回归球上匹配；对数因子被归因于筛的非线性而非架构。速率不含环境维数 d；惩罚选择可在未知光滑度下达到该速率；仅靠 centering 无法识别单变量分量，因此拟合一致不蕴含分量一致。对光滑度已知的目标，拟合风险指数在所有配置下至少与界一样陡，且预测的节点缩放与 k^{-r} 逼近衰减得到直接检验。
Conclusion: 论文的收尾强调维数无关速率源于对目标函数的 KAN 结构假设，不能理解为对一般 Sobolev 类 minimax 率的突破；同时指出分量不可识别性意味着 KAN 拟合本身的一致并不保证其内部单变量成分可解释或可恢复。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Generalized Synapse Detection Across Invertebrate Species
papers.abstract_en: Behavioural differences across organisms, whether healthy or pathological, are closely tied to the structure of their neural circuits. Yet, the fine-scale synaptic changes that give rise to these variations remain poorly understood, in part due to persistent challenges in detecting synapses reliably and at scale. Volume electron microscopy (EM) offers the resolution required to capture synaptic architecture, but automated detection remains difficult due to sparse annotations, morphological variability, and cross-dataset domain shifts. To address this, we make three key contributions. First, we curate a diverse EM benchmark spanning four datasets across two invertebrate species: adult and larval Drosophila melanogaster, and Megaphragma viggianii (micro-WASP). Second, we propose SimpSyn, a single-stage Residual U-Net trained to predict dual-channel spherical masks around pre- and post-synaptic sites, designed to prioritize training and inference speeds and annotation efficiency over architectural complexity. Third, we benchmark SimpSyn against Buhmann et al.'s Synful [1], a state-of-the-art multi-task model that jointly infers synaptic pairs. Despite its simplicity, SimpSyn consistently outperforms Synful in F1-score across all volumes for synaptic site detection. While generalization across datasets remains limited, SimpSyn achieves competitive performance when trained on the combined cohort. Finally, ablations reveal that simple post-processing strategies - such as local peak detection and distance-based filtering - yield strong performance without complex test-time heuristics. Taken together, our results suggest that lightweight models, when aligned with task structure, offer a practical and scalable solution for synapse detection in large-scale connectomic pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无脊椎动物体积电子显微镜（EM）数据中的突触检测问题，提出并评估了轻量级模型 SimpSyn。作者构建了一个涵盖果蝇成虫、果蝇幼虫与微黄蜂 Megaphragma viggianii 四个数据集的基准，并用单阶段 Residual U-Net 预测突触前后位点的双通道球形掩膜。结果显示 SimpSyn 在突触位点检测的 F1-score 上一致优于多任务模型 Synful，但跨数据集泛化仍有限。
Motivation: 突触的精细结构变化与行为差异密切相关，但可靠的规模化突触检测仍因标注稀疏、形态变异和跨数据集域偏移而困难。现有自动化方法复杂且昂贵，需要更简单高效的检测方案以支持大规模连接组学管线。
Method: 提出 SimpSyn，一个单阶段 Residual U-Net，训练目标是预测突触前和突触后位点周围的双通道球形掩膜（dual-channel spherical masks），优先考虑训练与推理速度及标注效率。作者还收集并整理了跨越两个物种四个数据集的 EM 基准，并与 Buhmann 等人的多任务模型 Synful 进行比较。
Result: 在所有体积数据上，SimpSyn 在突触位点检测的 F1-score 上一致优于 Synful。尽管跨数据集泛化仍然有限，但在合并数据集上训练时 SimpSyn 能达到有竞争力的性能。消融实验表明，简单的后处理策略（如局部峰值检测和基于距离的过滤）即可获得强性能，无需复杂的测试时启发式。
Conclusion: 作者认为，与任务结构对齐的轻量级模型能够为大规模连接组学管线中的突触检测提供实用且可扩展的解决方案，同时承认跨数据集泛化仍是当前局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dissecting Federated-Graph Aggregation under Domain Shift: Importance-Aware Aggregation via Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Federated graph learning (FGL) trains a shared graph model across clients whose local graphs differ in node features, labels, and connectivity while keeping raw graph data decentralized. Although graph-domain shifts across clients can severely degrade the global model, existing FGL approaches for graph-domain shift mainly adapt local representations, propagation, or graph-derived collaboration, while the server typically applies the same aggregation rule to every parameter coordinate. In this work, we analyze how graph-domain shifts affect server-side aggregation. We find that, as clients optimize under distinct graph-domain conditions, they gradually concentrate their strongest updates on different parameter coordinates, making important update coordinates less shared across clients. Consequently, standard averaging can weaken these domain-specific signals even when client updates are not directly opposed. These findings reveal an aggregationinduced signal dilution effect: parameter coordinates strongly expressed by only a subset of domains are attenuated by nearzero contributions from the remaining domains. Motivated by these findings, we propose FedIA, a lightweight serverside aggregation method that calibrates parameter selection and client weighting. FedIA identifies important coordinates =within each layer and adjusts client aggregation weights according to their contributions on the selected subspace, without modifying local graph training or the standard clientupdate payload. Experiments on Twitch Gamers and WikiNet using two graph-learning backbones and nine FL/FGL baselines show improvements of up to 11.58 percentage points, with particularly strong gains under domain skew.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦图学习 (Federated Graph Learning) 在客户端图域偏移 (graph-domain shift) 下的服务端聚合问题。作者发现客户端在不同图域条件下会把最强更新集中在不同的参数坐标上，使得标准平均聚合削弱这类域特有信号，产生聚合导致的信号稀释效应。为此提出轻量级服务端聚合方法 FedIA，通过校准参数选择与客户端权重来缓解该问题，并在两个数据集上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有应对图域偏移的 FGL 方法主要调整本地表示、传播或基于图的协作，但服务端对所有参数坐标仍使用同一聚合规则；图域偏移会严重损害全局模型，而服务端聚合这一环节缺乏针对性分析。
Method: 先通过实证分析揭示聚合导致的信号稀释效应，再提出 FedIA：在每个层内识别重要参数坐标 (important coordinates)，并依据客户端在所选子空间上的贡献调整聚合权重；该方法不修改本地图训练，也不改变标准客户端更新载荷。
Result: 在 Twitch Gamers 和 WikiNet 上，使用两种图学习骨干和九个 FL/FGL 基线进行实验，取得最高 11.58 个百分点的提升，在域偏斜 (domain skew) 条件下增益尤为明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为服务端聚合本身会稀释仅由部分域强表达的坐标信号，FedIA 能在不增加本地训练负担的前提下减轻这一效应；本文结论限于服务端聚合层面的分析，未涉及对本地训练的修改。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有应对图域偏移的 FGL 方法主要调整本地表示、传播或基于图的协作，但服务端对所有参数坐标仍使用同一聚合规则；图域偏移会严重损害全局模型，而服务端聚合这一环节缺乏针对性分析。
summary_sections.method: 先通过实证分析揭示聚合导致的信号稀释效应，再提出 FedIA：在每个层内识别重要参数坐标 (important coordinates)，并依据客户端在所选子空间上的贡献调整聚合权重；该方法不修改本地图训练，也不改变标准客户端更新载荷。
summary_sections.result: 在 Twitch Gamers 和 WikiNet 上，使用两种图学习骨干和九个 FL/FGL 基线进行实验，取得最高 11.58 个百分点的提升，在域偏斜 (domain skew) 条件下增益尤为明显。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为服务端聚合本身会稀释仅由部分域强表达的坐标信号，FedIA 能在不增加本地训练负担的前提下减轻这一效应；本文结论限于服务端聚合层面的分析，未涉及对本地训练的修改。

papers.title: Improved Classification of Nitrogen Stress Severity in Plants Under Combined Stress Conditions Using Spatio-Temporal Deep Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Plants in their natural habitats endure an array of interacting stresses, both biotic and abiotic, that rarely occur in isolation. Nutrient stress-particularly nitrogen deficiency-becomes even more critical when compounded with drought and weed competition, making it increasingly difficult to distinguish and address its effects. Early detection of nitrogen stress is therefore crucial for protecting plant health and implementing effective management strategies. This study proposes a novel deep learning framework to accurately classify nitrogen stress severity in a combined stress environment. Our model uses a unique blend of four imaging modalities-RGB, multispectral, and two infrared wavelengths-to capture a wide range of physiological plant responses from canopy images. These images, provided as time-series data, document plant health across three levels of nitrogen availability (low, medium, and high) under varying water stress and weed pressures. The core of our approach is a spatio-temporal deep learning pipeline that merges a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for extracting spatial features from images with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dependencies. We also devised and evaluated a spatial-only CNN pipeline for comparison. Our CNN-LSTM pipeline achieved an impressive accuracy of 98%, impressively surpassing the spatial-only model's 80.45% and other previously reported machine learning method's 76%. These results bring actionable insights based on the power of our CNN-LSTM approach in effectively capturing the subtle and complex interactions between nitrogen deficiency, water stress, and weed pressure. This robust platform offers a promising tool for the timely and proactive identification of nitrogen stress severity, enabling better crop management and improved plant health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合 CNN 与 LSTM 的时空深度学习框架，用于在复合胁迫（干旱与杂草竞争）条件下对植物氮胁迫严重程度进行分类。模型融合 RGB、多光谱和两个红外波段的四种成像模态，以时间序列冠层图像覆盖低、中、高三种氮水平。摘要报告 CNN-LSTM 流程达到 98% 的准确率，明显高于仅空间的 CNN 模型（80.45%）和此前报道的机器学习方法（76%）。
Motivation: 自然环境中植物同时承受多种生物与非生物胁迫，氮缺乏与干旱、杂草竞争叠加后更难识别，早期检测氮胁迫对作物管理至关重要。现有方法难以在这种复合胁迫下准确区分氮胁迫的严重程度。
Method: 核心是时空深度学习流程：CNN 提取图像空间特征，LSTM 捕获时间依赖；同时设计了仅空间的 CNN 流程作对比。输入为四种成像模态（RGB、多光谱、两个红外波长）的冠层时间序列图像，覆盖三种氮水平和变化的缺水与杂草压力。
Result: CNN-LSTM 在氮胁迫严重程度分类上达到 98% 的准确率，超过仅空间模型的 80.45% 和此前报道的机器学习方法的 76%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CNN-LSTM 方法能有效捕捉氮缺乏、水胁迫与杂草压力之间细微复杂的相互作用，可作为及时、主动识别氮胁迫严重程度的工具，有助于改善作物管理和植物健康。

papers.title: Isolating to Harness: Cross-Division Distillation for Fully Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Fully Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (FUAD) addresses the practical scenario where training data is contaminated with unlabeled anomalies. This setting critically challenges conventional Unsupervised Anomaly Detection (UAD) methods, as they tend to misinterpret training anomalies as normal patterns, leading to false negatives. Although filtering anomalies from the training set is a common countermeasure, it inevitably discards valuable data and degrades the model's representation of normality. To overcome this dilemma, we propose an "isolating to harness" strategy, which isolates the influence of anomalies within specialized divisions and then leverages cross-division collaboration to generate robust pseudo supervision. We materialize this idea via a novel Cross-Division Distillation framework based on the widely studied Reverse Distillation paradigm. CDD first partitions the data into divisions with reduced anomaly ratios to train division-specific students. It then aggregates pseudo-normal features generated by each division-specific student for samples from other data divisions to guide a global student towards a robust anomaly-free representation. Experimental results on noisy versions of multiple AD datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significant performance improvements over the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/hito2448/CDD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全无监督异常检测（FUAD）场景提出跨领域蒸馏框架 CDD：先将训练数据划分为异常比例更低的分区，训练分区专用学生网络，再聚合各区学生为其他分区样本生成的伪正常特征，引导全局学生获得鲁棒的无异常表示。该方法基于 Reverse Distillation 范式，在多个 AD 数据集的噪声版本上相对基线有显著性能提升。
Motivation: FUAD 中训练数据混有无标签异常，传统无监督异常检测（UAD）会把这些训练异常误当作正常模式，导致漏检（false negatives）；常见做法是过滤异常，但这会丢弃有价值数据并削弱对正常性的建模。
Method: 提出“隔离-利用”策略，即先隔离异常在专门分区中的影响，再通过跨分区协作生成稳健伪监督；具体实现为基于 Reverse Distillation 的 Cross-Division Distillation（CDD）框架，先划分数据并训练分区专用学生，再聚合跨分区的伪正常特征来训练全局学生。
Result: 在多个异常检测（AD）数据集的噪声版本上，CDD 相比基线取得了显著的性能提升；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该隔离与跨分区协作策略能有效缓解 FUAD 中训练数据异常污染导致的漏检问题，同时不因过滤而丢失数据信息。

papers.title: Robust Residual Finite Scalar Quantization for Neural Compression
papers.abstract_en: Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) offers simplified training but suffers from residual magnitude decay in multi-stage settings, where subsequent stages receive exponentially weaker signals. We propose Robust Residual Finite Scalar Quantization (RFSQ), addressing this fundamental limitation through two novel conditioning strategies: learnable scaling factors and invertible layer normalization. Our experiments across audio and image modalities demonstrate RFSQ's effectiveness and generalizability. In audio reconstruction at 24 bits/frame, RFSQ-LayerNorm achieves 3.646 DNSMOS, a 3.6% improvement over state-of-the-art RVQ (3.518). On ImageNet, RFSQ achieves 0.102 L1 loss and 0.100 perceptual loss, with LayerNorm providing 9.7% L1 improvement and 17.4% perceptual improvement over unconditioned variants. The LayerNorm strategy consistently outperforms alternatives by maintaining normalized input statistics across stages, effectively preventing exponential magnitude decay that limits naive residual approaches. RFSQ combines FSQ's simplicity with multi-stage quantization's representational power, establishing a new standard for neural compression across diverse modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限标量量化 (Finite Scalar Quantization, FSQ) 在多级残差设置中残差幅度逐级指数衰减的问题，提出稳健残差有限标量量化 (RFSQ)，通过可学习缩放因子和可逆层归一化 (invertible layer normalization) 两种条件化策略来稳定各级输入统计量。实验覆盖音频与图像模态：在 24 bits/frame 音频重建中，RFSQ-LayerNorm 达到 3.646 DNSMOS，比当前最优 RVQ (3.518) 提升 3.6%；在 ImageNet 上达到 0.102 L1 loss 与 0.100 perceptual loss，其中 LayerNorm 相对无条件变体带来 9.7% 的 L1 改进和 17.4% 的感知损失改进。作者认为 RFSQ 结合了 FSQ 的训练简便性与多级量化的表示能力，成为跨模态神经压缩的新基准。
Motivation: FSQ 虽然简化了量化训练，但在多级残差量化中后续级接收到的信号呈指数衰减，导致残差幅度退化，限制了朴素残差方案的有效性。
Method: 提出 RFSQ，引入两种条件化策略：可学习缩放因子 (learnable scaling factors) 和可逆层归一化 (invertible layer normalization)，使各级保持归一化的输入统计量，从而防止指数级幅度衰减。
Result: 音频重建中 RFSQ-LayerNorm 达到 3.646 DNSMOS，较 RVQ (3.518) 提升 3.6%；ImageNet 上 RFSQ 取得 0.102 L1 loss 和 0.100 perceptual loss，LayerNorm 相对无条件变体分别带来 9.7% 和 17.4% 的改进。
Conclusion: LayerNorm 策略通过跨级维持归一化输入统计量，一致优于其他条件化变体；RFSQ 将 FSQ 的简单性与多级量化的表示能力结合，为不同模态的神经压缩确立了新标准。

papers.title: Continual Learning for VLMs: A Survey and Taxonomy Beyond Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), spanning predictive architectures to generative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), have revolutionized artificial intelligence through powerful cross-modal alignment and zero-shot generalization. However, enabling them to learn continually from non-stationary data remains a major challenge, as their cross-modal alignment and generalization capabilities are particularly vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting. Unlike traditional unimodal continual learning (CL), VLMs face unique challenges such as cross-modal feature drift, parameter interference due to shared architectures, and zero-shot capability erosion. Furthermore, generative MLLMs exhibit a unique "alignment tax," where catastrophic forgetting manifests not merely as factual amnesia, but as a systemic collapse of deep Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. This survey presents the first comprehensive diagnostic review bridging continual learning across predictive VLMs and generative MLLMs. We systematically deconstruct the aforementioned failure modes and propose a challenge-driven taxonomy comprising four core paradigms: (1) Multi-Modal Replay Strategies addressing explicit and implicit memory drift; (2) Cross-Modal Regularization enforcing topological and geometric alignment; (3) Parameter-Efficient Adaptation utilizing dynamic routing and subspace projections; and the emerging (4) Model Fusion and Decoupling paradigms. We critically analyze the evolution of evaluation protocols, highlighting the essential shift toward dual-track benchmarks (Domain vs. Ability CL). Finally, we chart a roadmap for future research, emphasizing compositional zero-shot learning, embodied AI with sensor fusion, and autonomous agentic ecosystems. All resources are available at: https://github.com/YuyangSunshine/Awesome-Continual-learning-of-Vision-Language-Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是第一篇系统综述预测式视觉语言模型（VLM）与生成式多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中持续学习（continual learning）的论文。它指出VLM的跨模态对齐和泛化能力在非平稳数据下尤其容易遭受灾难性遗忘，并归纳出跨模态特征漂移、共享架构参数干扰、零样本能力侵蚀以及生成式MLLM特有的“对齐税”（alignment tax）等失败模式。作者提出一种以挑战为驱动的四范式分类法，并讨论评估协议从单一基准向领域与能力双轨基准的演进。
Motivation: VLM和MLLM需要从非平稳数据中持续学习，但跨模态对齐和泛化能力对灾难性遗忘尤为脆弱，而传统单模态持续学习框架无法覆盖其特有的失败模式，如跨模态特征漂移、参数干扰和零样本能力退化。
Method: 本文是综述，提出一个由挑战驱动的分类法，包含四种核心范式：多模态回放策略（Multi-Modal Replay）、跨模态正则化（Cross-Modal Regularization）、参数高效适配（Parameter-Efficient Adaptation）以及新兴的模型融合与解耦（Model Fusion and Decoupling），并系统分析评估协议和未来研究方向。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值；主要贡献是首次对预测式VLM和生成式MLLM的持续学习进行诊断性综述，提出四范式分类法，并强调评估需转向Domain与Ability双轨基准。
Conclusion: 作者指出未来研究应关注组合零样本学习、具身智能中的传感器融合以及自主智能体生态系统，并开放了相关资源列表。

papers.title: Accelerating SGDM via Learning Rate and Batch Size Schedules: A Lyapunov-Based Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the convergence behavior of stochastic gradient descent with momentum (SGDM) under dynamic learning-rate and batch-size schedules by introducing a novel and simpler Lyapunov function. We extend the existing theoretical framework to cover three practical scheduling strategies commonly used in deep learning: a constant batch size with a decaying learning rate, an increasing batch size with a decaying learning rate, and an increasing batch size with an increasing learning rate. Our results reveal a clear hierarchy in convergence: a constant batch size does not guarantee convergence of the expected gradient norm under our Lyapunov-based analysis, whereas an increasing batch size does, and simultaneously increasing both the batch size and learning rate achieves a provably faster decay. Empirical results validate our theory, showing that dynamically scheduled SGDM significantly outperforms its fixed-hyperparameter counterpart in convergence speed. We also evaluated a warmup schedule in experiments, which empirically outperformed all other strategies in convergence behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动量随机梯度下降（SGDM）在动态学习率和批量大小调度下的收敛行为，引入一个新颖且更简单的Lyapunov函数进行分析。摘要覆盖三种实际调度策略：恒定批量大小配衰减学习率、递增批量大小配衰减学习率、递增批量大小配递增学习率，并揭示收敛性的层级：恒定批量大小无法保证期望梯度范数收敛，递增批量大小可以保证，同时递增两者可获得可证明的更快速衰减。实验验证动态调度显著优于固定超参数版本，且warmup调度在经验上表现最佳。
Motivation: 深度学习中常用动态学习率和批量大小调度，但现有SGDM理论分析缺乏对这些实际调度策略的收敛性保证，本文旨在通过Lyapunov框架填补这一空白。
Method: 引入一个更简单的Lyapunov函数来扩展现有理论框架，覆盖恒定批量大小配衰减学习率、递增批量大小配衰减学习率、递增批量大小配递增学习率三种调度策略的理论分析，并用实验验证理论。
Result: 理论结果呈现清晰层级：恒定批量大小不能保证期望梯度范数收敛，递增批量大小可以，同时递增批量大小和学习率能实现可证明的更快衰减；实验表明动态调度的SGDM在收敛速度上显著超过固定超参数版本，warmup调度在实验中经验性地优于所有其他策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态调度的SGDM相比固定超参数版本具有显著的收敛速度优势，并指出warmup调度在经验上表现最佳，但未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CLIP-Guided Backdoor Defense through Entropy-Based Poisoned Dataset Separation
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are susceptible to backdoor attacks, where adversaries poison training data to implant backdoor into the victim model. Current backdoor defenses on poisoned data often suffer from high computational costs or low effectiveness against advanced attacks like clean-label and clean-image backdoors. To address them, we introduce CLIP-Guided backdoor Defense (CGD), an efficient and effective method that mitigates various backdoor attacks. CGD utilizes a publicly accessible CLIP model to identify inputs that are likely to be clean or poisoned. It then retrains the model with these inputs, using CLIP's logits as a guidance to effectively neutralize the backdoor. Experiments on 4 datasets and 11 attack types demonstrate that CGD reduces attack success rates (ASRs) to below 1% while maintaining clean accuracy (CA) with a maximum drop of only 0.3%, outperforming existing defenses. Additionally, we show that clean-data-based defenses can be adapted to poisoned data using CGD. Also, CGD exhibits strong robustness, maintaining low ASRs even when employing a weaker CLIP model or when CLIP itself is compromised by a backdoor. These findings underscore CGD's exceptional efficiency, effectiveness, and applicability for real-world backdoor defense scenarios. Code: https://github.com/binyxu/CGD.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, 15 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '25)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP-Guided Backdoor Defense (CGD)，一种利用公开 CLIP 模型区分训练数据中干净与中毒样本、并以 CLIP logits 作为指导重新训练模型的后门防御方法。实验覆盖 4 个数据集和 11 种攻击类型，摘要报告将攻击成功率 (ASR) 降至 1% 以下，同时干净准确率 (CA) 最大仅下降 0.3%，并优于现有防御。作者还展示了干净数据防御可借 CGD 适配中毒数据，且在使用较弱 CLIP 或 CLIP 本身被植入后门时仍保持低 ASR。
Motivation: 现有针对中毒数据的后门防御常面临高计算成本或对高级攻击（如 clean-label 和 clean-image 后门）效果不佳的问题。
Method: CGD 使用公开的 CLIP 模型识别可能干净或中毒的输入，然后利用这些输入重新训练模型，并以 CLIP 的 logits 作为指导来中和后门。
Result: 在 4 个数据集和 11 种攻击类型上，CGD 将 ASR 降低到 1% 以下，CA 最大仅下降 0.3%，表现优于现有防御；同时表现出强鲁棒性，即使使用较弱的 CLIP 模型或 CLIP 被后门攻陷时仍保持低 ASR。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CGD 在效率、有效性和现实后门防御场景适用性方面均表现突出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Must a Fairness Audit Report When Demographic Data Is Incomplete?
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits are a key component of responsible machine-learning deployment. Yet what such an audit must disclose, when the protected labels it depends on are incomplete, remains unsettled. In this work, we focused on the rates a fairness audit publishes and on what an oversight reader needs beside them. We paired every published rate with a matched baseline drawn from the same audit, one hiding protected labels and one varying only the run seed. Across ACS/Folktables tasks, missingness settings that kept some protected labels moved the selected mitigation less than an ordinary rerun did. At zero protected-label access, candidates collapsed to empirical risk minimization, so the apparent exception there reflected the candidate set's composition. Equalized-odds threshold optimization most often regressed an intersectional subgroup, but that rate fell back to its baseline once we kept only the configurations an auditor would accept. Any accuracy it lost fell on the population as heavily as on the worst-off cell, so the mechanism is levelling down. The one effect that survived was a change in which cell is worst-off. Overall, our results highlight that a published audit rate should be reported with the baseline needed to interpret it, the candidate set it came from, and its intersectional effects, before it is treated as evidence about a deployed model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当公平性审计所依赖的受保护标签不完整时，审计应披露哪些内容。作者为每个发布的审计率配对同审计中导出的匹配基线（包括隐藏受保护标签和仅改变运行种子的版本），在 ACS/Folktables 任务上考察不同缺失设置，发现部分受保护标签保留时对所选缓解措施的影响小于普通重跑，而零访问时候选集退化为经验风险最小化。最终建议审计率应附上解释所需基线、候选集来源及其交叉性影响，再作为已部署模型的证据。
Motivation: 公平性审计是负责任机器学习部署的关键环节，但当审计依赖的受保护标签不完整时，审计应当披露什么内容仍无定论，导致审计发布的比率可能被监管读者误解。
Method: 将每个发布的审计率与同审计中匹配的基线配对，基线有两种：一种隐藏受保护标签，另一种仅改变运行种子；并在受保护标签零访问的场景下分析候选集构成对结果的影响。
Result: 在 ACS/Folktables 任务上，保留部分受保护标签的缺失设置对所选缓解措施的影响小于普通重跑；零标签访问时候选集退化为经验风险最小化（empirical risk minimization）。等优势比阈值优化（equalized-odds threshold optimization）最常使某个交叉性子组回归，但只保留审计者会接受的配置后该比率回落至基线；其准确率损失同时落在整体人群和最差单元上，机制是拉低整体水平（levelling down），唯一存活的效果是最差单元归属的改变。
Conclusion: 发布的审计率应附带解释所需的基线、其来源的候选集以及交叉性影响，之后才能被当作关于已部署模型的证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PoseMaster: A Unified 3D Native Framework for Stylized Pose Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pose stylization, which aims to synthesize stylized content aligning with target poses, serves as a fundamental task across 2D, 3D, and video domains. In the 3D realm, prevailing approaches typically rely on a cascade pipeline: first manipulating the image pose via 2D foundation models and subsequently lifting it into 3D representations. However, this paradigm limits the precision and diversity of the 3d pose stylization. To this end, we propose a novel paradigm for 3D pose stylization that unifies pose stylization and 3D generation within a cohesive framework. This integration minimizes the risk of cumulative errors and enhances the model's efficiency and effectiveness. In addition, diverging from previous works that typically utilize 2D skeleton images as guidance, we directly utilize the 3D skeleton because it can provide a more accurate representation of 3D spatial and topological relationships, which significantly enhances the model's capacity to achieve richer and more precise pose stylization. Moreover, we develop a scalable data engine to construct a large-scale dataset of ''Image-Skeleton-Mesh'' triplets, enabling the model to jointly learn identity preservation and geometric alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseMaster significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative metrics. Owing to the strict spatial alignment between the generated 3D meshes and the conditioning skeletons, PoseMaster enables the direct creation of animatable assets when coupled with automated skinning models, highlighting its compelling potential for automated character rigging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PoseMaster，一个统一的 3D 原生框架，用于风格化姿态生成（pose stylization）。与以往先通过 2D 基础模型操纵图像姿态再提升到 3D 的级联范式不同，该方法将姿态风格化与 3D 生成统一在一个框架中，并直接使用 3D 骨架作为条件，避免累积误差并提升空间与拓扑关系的准确性。作者还构建了可扩展的数据引擎，生成大规模“图像-骨架-网格”（Image-Skeleton-Mesh）三元组数据集，用于联合学习身份保持与几何对齐。实验表明 PoseMaster 在定性与定量指标上均优于现有方法，且生成的 3D 网格与条件骨架严格对齐，配合自动蒙皮模型可直接创建可动画资产。
Motivation: 现有 3D 姿态风格化方法多采用级联管道，先用 2D 基础模型生成姿态图像再提升为 3D，这种范式限制了 3D 姿态风格化的精度与多样性；同时使用 2D 骨架图像作为引导无法准确表达 3D 空间和拓扑关系。
Method: 提出将姿态风格化和 3D 生成统一在一个框架中的新范式，直接使用 3D 骨架而非 2D 骨架图像作为条件，并开发可扩展的数据引擎构建大规模“图像-骨架-网格”三元组数据集，使模型联合学习身份保持与几何对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 PoseMaster 在定性和定量指标上显著优于最先进方法，且由于生成的 3D 网格与条件骨架严格空间对齐，可结合自动蒙皮模型直接创建可动画资产，展示了自动角色绑定的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一范式降低了累积误差，提升了模型效率与效果，并直接利用 3D 骨架增强了姿态风格化的丰富性和精确性；该框架在自动角色绑定等应用上具有潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLAM: Continuous Latent Action Models for Robot Learning from Unlabeled Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Learning robot control policies from demonstrations typically requires action-labeled expert data, which is expensive to collect through teleoperation. We study a more practical setting in which expert demonstrations are available only as observation sequences without action labels, and only task-agnostic play data contains actions. We introduce continuous latent action models (CLAM), a framework that infers continuous latent actions between consecutive observations using self-supervised dynamics prediction. To ground these latent actions into executable motor commands, CLAM jointly trains an action decoder using a small amount of task-agnostic play data. We show that continuous latent actions combined with this joint training are essential for high-dimensional continuous control. Across DMControl locomotion, MetaWorld manipulation, and real-world WidowX robot tasks, CLAM improves average task success rates by 2-3x over prior latent-action baselines and approaches behavior cloning trained with privileged expert action labels. Our results demonstrate that effective robot policies can be learned from unlabeled demonstrations and deployed on real hardware without collecting expert action-labeled data. Videos and code are available at clamrobot.github.io.
papers.comment: Latent Action Models, Self-supervised Pretraining, Learning from Videos
papers.journal_ref: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续隐式动作模型 (CLAM)，研究仅含观测序列而无动作标签的专家演示设置，利用少量任务无关 (task-agnostic) play 数据获得动作标签。CLAM 通过自监督动力学预测推断相邻观测之间的连续隐式动作，并联合训练动作解码器将其映射为可执行电机指令。在 DMControl 运动、MetaWorld 操作和真实 WidowX 机器人任务上，摘要报告相较此前隐式动作基线将平均任务成功率提升 2-3 倍，且接近使用特权专家动作标签的行为克隆水平。
Motivation: 通过遥操作收集带动作标签的专家数据成本高昂，而实际中专家演示往往只有观测序列没有动作标签；论文针对这一更实际的设置，希望仅利用任务无关 play 数据中的动作来学习策略。
Method: 提出 CLAM 框架，用自监督动力学预测在连续观测之间推断连续隐式动作 (continuous latent actions)，同时使用少量任务无关 play 数据联合训练动作解码器，把隐式动作接地为可执行的电机指令。
Result: 摘要声称连续隐式动作与联合训练对高维连续控制至关重要；在 DMControl、MetaWorld 和真实 WidowX 任务上平均成功率比此前隐式动作基线提升 2-3 倍，并接近使用专家动作标签的行为克隆。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需收集专家动作标签数据，即可从无标签演示中学习有效策略并部署到真实硬件；视频与代码已公开。

papers.title: EHGCN: Hierarchical Euclidean-Hyperbolic Fusion via Motion-Aware GCN for Hybrid Event Stream Perception
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras, characterized by microsecond temporal resolution and very High Dynamic Range (HDR), emit high-speed event streams for perception tasks. In recent advancements, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)-based methods show great potential in event perception. However, they typically rely on straightforward pairwise node connectivity in Euclidean space where they struggle to capture long-range dependencies and faithfully characterize the inherent hierarchical structures of event streams. To this end, we propose EHGCN, a dual-space event perception approach that, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to jointly model event streams in Euclidean and hyperbolic spaces. By introducing hyperbolic geometry into event stream perception, EHGCN enables to naturally capture the anisotropic and hierarchical structures of non-uniform, motion-driven event streams. Specifically, we first introduce a distribution-aware event sifting method based on multi-scale voxel grids and Gaussian distribution modeling, retaining discriminative events while attenuating chaotic noise. Then, we present a Markov Random Field (MRF)-optimized motion-aware hyperedge generation scheme, which minimizes a motion consistency energy function to explicitly capture consistent global motion patterns within short time intervals, thereby eliminating cross-target spurious associations and providing critically topological priors while capturing long-range dependencies among events. Finally, we propose a Euclidean-hyperbolic GCN to fuse the retinal events densely aggregated and hierarchically modeled in local Euclidean and global hyperbolic spaces, respectively, to achieve a hybrid event perception. Extensive experimental results on event perception tasks, such as object detection and recognition, show the effectiveness of our approach. Our code will be released for public use at https://github.com/ev-lluo/EHGCN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EHGCN，一种在欧氏空间与双曲空间中联合建模事件流（event stream）的双空间感知方法，据称是首个将双曲几何引入事件流感知的工作，并用于目标检测与识别。方法包含基于多尺度体素网格和高斯分布建模的分布感知事件筛选、基于马尔可夫随机场（MRF）优化的运动感知超边生成，以及欧氏-双曲 GCN 融合局部欧氏与全局双曲表示。摘要报告大量实验验证了有效性，但未给出具体量化指标。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的事件感知方法通常依赖欧氏空间中的简单成对节点连接，难以捕捉长程依赖，也无法忠实刻画事件流固有的层次结构。
Method: 提出 EHGCN 三阶段框架：首先用多尺度体素网格与高斯分布建模对事件做分布感知筛选，抑制噪声；其次用 MRF 优化的运动感知超边生成，通过最小化运动一致性能量函数捕获短时间内的全局运动模式并消除跨目标伪关联；最后用欧氏-双曲 GCN 将局部欧氏空间的密集聚合表示与全局双曲空间的层次化表示融合。
Result: 摘要仅在事件感知任务（目标检测与识别）上报告广泛实验表明方法有效，未给出具体数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: 作者认为在欧氏与双曲双空间联合建模能自然捕捉非均匀、运动驱动事件流的各向异性与层次结构，并计划开源代码。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Gradient-Free Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are notorious for forgetting old skills when taught new ones - a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Standard continual learning techniques try to fix this by saving old data or relying on complex gradient updates, but these methods fail when past data cannot be stored due to memory or privacy constraints. To solve this, we propose EvoCL, a gradient-free approach that uses evolutionary algorithms to update the network without needing old data or gradients. EvoCL uses a lightweight adapter module to translate saved representations from past tasks into the model's current space, allowing it to learn new tasks while keeping past knowledge intact. Across multiple benchmarks, EvoCL matches or exceeds standard performance under strict memory constraints, offering a simple and flexible new direction for continual learning. The code to reproduce these results is available at https://github.com/grypesc/EvoCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoCL，一种无需梯度即可进行持续学习 (continual learning) 的方法：用进化算法 (evolutionary algorithms) 更新网络，并通过轻量级适配器模块将过去任务的已保存表征转换到当前模型空间中，从而在不保存旧数据、不依赖梯度更新的情况下缓解灾难性遗忘 (catastrophic forgetting)。摘要称在多个基准上，EvoCL 在严格内存约束下能达到或超过标准方法的性能，代码已开源。
Motivation: 神经网络在学习新任务时会遗忘旧技能（灾难性遗忘），现有持续学习方法通常依赖保存旧数据或复杂的梯度更新，在内存或隐私约束下无法存储历史数据时这些方法会失效。
Method: 提出梯度无关方法 EvoCL：使用进化算法更新网络，并引入一个轻量级适配器模块，将过去任务保存的表征转换到模型当前的特征空间中，使模型在学习新任务的同时保留旧知识。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上，EvoCL 在严格内存约束下达到或超过标准持续学习方法的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EvoCL 为持续学习提供了一个简单、灵活的新方向，并在 https://github.com/grypesc/EvoCL 提供复现代码。

papers.title: Test-Time Backdoor Detection for Object Detection Models
papers.abstract_en: Object detection models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where attackers poison a small subset of training samples by embedding a predefined trigger to manipulate prediction. Detecting poisoned samples (i.e., those containing triggers) at test time can prevent backdoor activation. However, unlike image classification tasks, the unique characteristics of object detection -- particularly its output of numerous objects -- pose fresh challenges for backdoor detection. The complex attack effects (e.g., "ghost" object emergence or "vanishing" object) further render current defenses fundamentally inadequate. To this end, we design TRAnsformation Consistency Evaluation (TRACE), a brand-new method for detecting poisoned samples at test time in object detection. Our journey begins with two intriguing observations: (1) poisoned samples exhibit significantly more consistent detection results than clean ones across varied backgrounds. (2) clean samples show higher detection consistency when introduced to different focal information. Based on these phenomena, TRACE applies foreground and background transformations to each test sample, then assesses transformation consistency by calculating the variance in objects confidences. TRACE achieves black-box, universal backdoor detection, with extensive experiments showing a 30% improvement in AUROC over state-of-the-art defenses and resistance to adaptive attacks.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2025. Code is available at https://github.com/Rookie143/Trace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE（TRAnsformation Consistency Evaluation），一种用于目标检测模型在测试时检测中毒样本（含触发器）的方法。方法基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果比干净样本更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高。TRACE 通过对每个测试样本施加前景与背景变换，并计算目标置信度的方差来评估变换一致性，实现黑盒、通用的后门检测。
Motivation: 目标检测模型易受后门攻击，攻击者通过嵌入触发器污染少量训练样本以操纵预测。与图像分类不同，目标检测输出大量目标，且攻击效果复杂（如“幽灵”目标出现或目标消失），现有防御方法难以有效应对测试时后门检测。
Method: TRACE 基于两个观察设计：一是中毒样本在不同背景变换下检测结果比干净样本更一致，二是干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高。对每个测试样本施加前景和背景变换，通过计算目标置信度方差来评估变换一致性，从而在测试时识别中毒样本，且无需访问模型内部（黑盒）。
Result: 大量实验表明，TRACE 相比现有最先进防御在 AUROC 上提升 30%，并能够抵抗自适应攻击，实现通用的黑盒后门检测。
Conclusion: TRACE 是面向目标检测测试时后门检测的新方法，利用变换一致性区分中毒与干净样本，强调其黑盒性和通用性，并具备对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MedHallTune: An Instruction-Tuning Benchmark for Mitigating Medical Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of vision-language models (VLMs) in healthcare applications presents great challenges related to hallucinations, in which the models may generate seemingly plausible results that are in fact incorrect. Such hallucinations can jeopardize clinical decision making, potentially harming the diagnosis and treatments. In this work, we propose MedHallTune, a large-scale benchmark designed specifically to evaluate and mitigate hallucinations in medical VLMs. Comprising over 100,000 images and 1,000,000 instruction pairs, MedHallTune includes both hallucination and non-hallucination samples, each with ground-truth annotations. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of current medical and general VLMs using MedHallTune, assessing their performance across key metrics, including clinical accuracy, relevance, detail level, and risk level. The experimental results show that fine-tuning with MedHallTune successfully improves the ability of several existing models to manage hallucinations and boost their zero-shot performance on downstream visual-question-answering (VQA) tasks, making them more reliable for practical medical applications. Our work contributes to the development of more trustworthy VLMs. Codes and dataset will be available at \href{https://github.com/russellyq/MedHallTune}{MedHallTune}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedHallTune 是一个面向医学视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的大规模指令微调基准，包含超过 10 万张图像和 100 万个指令对，并提供幻觉与非幻觉样本及 ground-truth 标注。作者用该基准评估了现有医学和通用 VLM，发现用 MedHallTune 微调能提升若干模型在幻觉管理和下游视觉问答 (VQA) 零样本任务上的表现。代码和数据集将公开于 GitHub。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在医疗应用中的幻觉可能误导临床决策，威胁诊断和治疗；现有工作缺乏专门针对医学 VLM 幻觉的大规模评估与缓解基准。
Method: 构建大规模基准 MedHallTune，包含幻觉与非幻觉两类样本及 ground-truth 标注；基于该基准对现有医学与通用 VLM 进行评估，并通过指令微调 (instruction tuning) 提升模型的抗幻觉能力。
Result: 实验表明，使用 MedHallTune 微调能改善多个现有模型的幻觉管理能力，并提升其在下游视觉问答任务上的零样本性能；评估指标涵盖临床准确性、相关性、细节水平和风险水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MedHallTune 有助于提升医学 VLM 的可靠性，推动更值得信赖的医疗视觉语言模型发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Metareasoning constraints couple narratives, affect and cognition
papers.abstract_en: Narratives and emotions shape thoughts, and thoughts shape our feelings and stories we tell. Why narrative, affective and cognitive states interact remains unclear. We examine whether this mutual relationship reflects constraints on metareasoning - deciding what to think about - imposed by a shared computational state. Combining self-report and quantification of depression narratives using large language models, Study 1 (n=704) shows narrative state structure closely reflects the factorial structure in formal affect assessments, and that perturbation of the narrative state has commensurate effects on affect via a latent computational state. Study 2 (n=553) uses exposure to structured narratives to test model predictions causally in vivo. Narrative exposure has consistent effect on narrative states, with consequences on momentary mood, cognition, and affect. Critically, effects are predicted by latent computational state engagement. This supports the hypothesis that metareasoning constraints determine interactions between narratives, cognition and affect via a shared computational state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出元推理约束（metareasoning constraints）假说，认为叙事、情感与认知之间的相互作用源于共享计算状态对“决定想什么”（deciding what to think about）的限制。两项研究（研究1 n=704，研究2 n=553）结合自陈报告与基于大语言模型的抑郁叙事量化，分别通过叙事状态结构分析和结构化叙事暴露实验来检验该假说。
Motivation: 叙事、情感和认知相互塑造，但其内在机制尚不清楚。作者试图检验这种相互关系是否反映元推理在共享计算状态上施加的约束。
Method: 研究1（n=704）用大语言模型量化抑郁叙事，分析叙事状态结构与正式情感评估的因子结构是否吻合，并考察叙事状态扰动经由潜在计算状态对情感的影响；研究2（n=553）采用结构化叙事暴露，在真实被试中因果地检验模型预测。
Result: 研究1显示叙事状态结构紧密反映正式情感评估的因子结构，叙事扰动通过潜在计算状态对情感产生相应效应；研究2显示叙事暴露对叙事状态有一致影响，并传导至瞬时情绪、认知和情感，且该效应可由潜在计算状态的参与度预测。
Conclusion: 结果支持元推理约束通过共享计算状态决定叙事、认知与情感之间相互作用的假说。作者强调这是基于两项研究的证据，具体的计算机制仍需进一步验证。

summary_sections.motivation: 叙事、情感和认知相互塑造，但其内在机制尚不清楚。作者试图检验这种相互关系是否反映元推理在共享计算状态上施加的约束。
summary_sections.method: 研究1（n=704）用大语言模型量化抑郁叙事，分析叙事状态结构与正式情感评估的因子结构是否吻合，并考察叙事状态扰动经由潜在计算状态对情感的影响；研究2（n=553）采用结构化叙事暴露，在真实被试中因果地检验模型预测。
summary_sections.result: 研究1显示叙事状态结构紧密反映正式情感评估的因子结构，叙事扰动通过潜在计算状态对情感产生相应效应；研究2显示叙事暴露对叙事状态有一致影响，并传导至瞬时情绪、认知和情感，且该效应可由潜在计算状态的参与度预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果支持元推理约束通过共享计算状态决定叙事、认知与情感之间相互作用的假说。作者强调这是基于两项研究的证据，具体的计算机制仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Re-examining Granger Causality with Causal Bayesian Networks and Reichenbachs Principles
papers.abstract_en: Granger causality (GC) is widely used to infer directed relationships in time-series data. However, its predictive criterion does not by itself distinguish direct causal effects from dependencies induced by common causes, indirect paths, collider conditioning, or model misspecification. We revisit this limitation by interpreting bivariate and multivariate GC through causal Bayesian networks and Reichenbachs common cause principles. Under explicit graphical assumptions, bivariate GC provides a marginal dependence check, while multivariate GC tests whether the same association persists after conditioning on relevant histories. This view motivates causalised Granger causality (c-GC), which combines the two decisions, and c-GC*, a more conservative variant with a richer conditioning set. We validate both methods on synthetic dynamical systems, established time-series causal discovery benchmarks, Sachs protein-signalling data, and Lorenz-96 simulations. The results show that the proposed criteria recover plausible causal structure in settings with delayed effects, cycles, bidirectional links, and nonlinear or noisy dynamics. The framework clarifies how GC-style inference can be given a causal interpretation without treating temporal prediction alone as sufficient evidence of causation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视格兰杰因果 (Granger causality, GC) 在时间序列中推断因果关系的能力，指出其预测准则自身无法区分直接因果效应与共同原因、间接路径、对撞因子条件化或模型误设所导致的依赖。作者借助因果贝叶斯网络和 Reichenbach 共同原因原理，将双变量与多变量 GC 解释为边际依赖检验与条件化检验，并提出因果化格兰杰因果 c-GC 及其更保守的变体 c-GC*。方法在合成动力系统、时间序列因果发现基准、Sachs 蛋白信号数据及 Lorenz-96 模拟上得到验证。
Motivation: 格兰杰因果被广泛用于时间序列推断方向性关系，但其基于预测的判据在逻辑上不足以确证因果关系，容易将非直接因果的依赖关系误判为因果。
Method: 作者从因果贝叶斯网络和 Reichenbach 共同原因原则出发，在显式图假设下把双变量 GC 视为边际依赖检验、多变量 GC 视为条件化后关联是否持续的检验，并由此构造组合两种决策的 c-GC 以及具有更丰富条件集的保守变体 c-GC*。
Result: 在合成动力学系统、既有时间序列因果发现基准、Sachs 蛋白信号数据和 Lorenz-96 模拟上，所提准则能在延迟效应、环状结构、双向连接以及非线性或含噪动力学中恢复合理的因果结构。
Conclusion: 该框架表明，无需把时间预测单独视为因果证据，即可为 GC 式推断赋予因果解释；摘要未提及对实际降水或天气系统的直接应用。

papers.title: LLM Self-Correction with DeCRIM: Decompose, Critique, and Refine for Enhanced Following of Instructions with Multiple Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Instruction following is a key capability for LLMs. However, recent studies have shown that LLMs often struggle with instructions containing multiple constraints (e.g. a request to create a social media post "in a funny tone" with "no hashtag"). Despite this, most evaluations focus solely on synthetic data. To address this, we introduce RealInstruct, the first benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to follow real-world multi-constrained instructions by leveraging queries real users asked AI assistants. We also investigate model-based evaluation as a cost-effective alternative to human annotation for this task. Our findings reveal that even the proprietary GPT-4 model fails to meet at least one constraint on over 21% of instructions, highlighting the limitations of state-of-the-art models. To address the performance gap between open-source and proprietary models, we propose the Decompose, Critique and Refine (DeCRIM) self-correction pipeline, which enhances LLMs' ability to follow constraints. DeCRIM works by decomposing the original instruction into a list of constraints and using a Critic model to decide when and where the LLM's response needs refinement. Our results show that DeCRIM improves Mistral's performance by 7.3% on RealInstruct and 8.0% on IFEval even with weak feedback. Moreover, we demonstrate that with strong feedback, open-source LLMs with DeCRIM can outperform GPT-4 on both benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealInstruct，一个基于真实用户向 AI 助手提问的多约束指令跟随基准，并针对开放与闭源模型间的差距提出 DeCRIM（Decompose, Critique and Refine）自我修正流水线。摘要报告 DeCRIM 在 RealInstruct 和 IFEval 上分别将 Mistral 提升 7.3% 和 8.0%，且在使用强反馈时，开源模型搭配 DeCRIM 能在这两个基准上超过 GPT-4。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 指令跟随评估大多依赖合成数据，而模型在多约束真实指令上表现不佳；同时缺少以真实用户查询为来源的基准，也有必要寻找比人工标注更经济的模型评估方式。
Method: DeCRIM 将原始指令分解为约束列表，并利用一个 Critic 模型判断 LLM 响应何时在何处需要细化，形成分解-批判-修正的自我修正流水线。
Result: 摘要显示即使 GPT-4 也在超过 21% 的指令上至少违反一个约束；DeCRIM 在 RealInstruct 上带来 7.3% 的提升、在 IFEval 上带来 8.0% 的提升，即使使用弱反馈；强反馈下开源模型可超越 GPT-4。
Conclusion: 摘要强调真实世界多约束指令是当前 LLM 的明显短板，模型与评估双管齐下（即 RealInstruct 基准与 DeCRIM 流水线）可以缩小开源与闭源模型的差距。

papers.title: ID-Guard: A Universal Framework for Combating Facial Manipulation via Breaking Identification
papers.abstract_en: The misuse of deep learning-based facial manipulation poses a serious threat to civil rights. To prevent such fraud at its source, proactive defense methods have been proposed that embed invisible adversarial perturbations into images, disrupting the manipulation process and rendering the forged output unconvincing to observers. However, non-targeted disruption of the output may leave identifiable facial features intact, potentially leading to the stigmatization of individuals. In this work, we propose a universal framework for combating facial manipulation, termed ID-Guard. The framework employs a single forward pass of an encoder-decoder network to generate cross-model transferable adversarial perturbations. We introduce a novel Identity Destruction Module (IDM) to suppress identifiable features in manipulated faces. The perturbation generation is optimized by formulating the disruption of various manipulation types as a multi-task learning problem, with a dynamic weighting strategy designed to enhance cross-model performance. Experimental results show that ID-Guard effectively defends against diverse facial manipulation models while degrading identifiable regions in manipulated images. It also enables disrupted images to evade facial inpainting and facial recognition systems. Moreover, ID-Guard can be seamlessly integrated as a plug-and-play component into other tasks, such as adversarial training. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZOMIN28/ID-Guard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ID-Guard，一个面向人脸篡改的通用防御框架，通过单次前向的编码器-解码器网络生成跨模型可迁移的对抗扰动，并引入身份破坏模块 (Identity Destruction Module, IDM) 抑制篡改人脸中的可识别特征。摘要报告该方法能防御多种人脸篡改模型，同时破坏篡改图像中的可识别区域，并可使扰动图像绕过人脸修复与人脸识别系统。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有主动防御通过在人脸图像中嵌入不可见对抗扰动来破坏篡改过程，但非定向的扰动可能仍保留可识别的人脸特征，从而可能导致个人被污名化。
Method: 框架采用单个编码器-解码器前向过程生成跨模型可迁移的对抗扰动；将多种篡改类型的破坏建模为多任务学习问题，并用动态权重策略提升跨模型性能；核心模块 IDM 用于抑制篡改人脸中的可识别特征。
Result: 实验表明 ID-Guard 能有效防御多种人脸篡改模型，降低篡改图像中可识别区域的质量，并能使被扰动图像规避人脸修复和人脸识别系统。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架可作为即插即用组件集成到对抗训练等其他任务中，并公开了源代码。

papers.title: Learning to Detect Cyber Attacks: Neural Anomaly Detection for Cybersecurity with Theoretical Insights
papers.abstract_en: In cybersecurity practice, new forms of cyberattacks continuously emerge, deliberately designed to evade defense systems that rely on previously observed behaviors. Motivated by this challenge, we propose a neural network-based method for anomaly detection that does not rely on (1) prior knowledge of anomaly distributions or (2) the availability of real anomalies during training. Our proposed method trains a neural network classifier using only normal samples, combining the supervision from synthetic anomalies, and is particularly suitable when collecting real anomaly samples is expensive or impractical. The trained classifier is proven to attain minimax excess risk, and more importantly, it is guaranteed to learn the boundary of the normal region. Once the normal region is well estimated, the model can detect a wide range of anomalies without requiring explicit modeling of their distributions. Extensive experiments across cybersecurity, industrial, and medical anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that our method is consistently robust and competitive compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, in the context of network intrusion detection, our approach significantly enhances the detection of difficult and previously unseen cyberattacks compared to other baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络安全中新型攻击不断出现、刻意规避基于已知行为防御的问题，提出一种仅用正常样本训练神经网络分类器的异常检测方法，利用合成异常 (synthetic anomalies) 提供监督，不依赖异常分布的先验知识，也不要求训练阶段存在真实异常。作者证明该分类器能达到 minimax excess risk，并保证学习到正常区域的边界。在网络安全、工业、医学等异常检测任务上的实验显示该方法稳健且与最先进基线相当，在网络入侵检测中尤其提升了对困难且未见过的攻击的检测。
Motivation: 实际网络安全环境中不断涌现新型攻击，它们被刻意设计为绕过依赖已知行为的防御系统；同时收集真实异常样本往往代价高昂或不现实，因此需要一种不依赖先验异常分布、也不需要训练期真实异常的检测方法。
Method: 提出一种神经网络分类器训练方法，仅利用正常样本并结合合成异常提供的监督信号进行训练；通过估计正常区域 (normal region) 的边界，使模型无需显式建模各种异常分布即可检测广泛类型的异常。
Result: 理论上证明训练所得分类器达到 minimax excess risk，并保证能学习正常区域的边界；在网络安全、工业、医学异常检测任务上的大量实验表明该方法相对最先进基线稳健且具有竞争力，其中在网络入侵检测中显著增强了对困难且先前未见攻击的检测。
Conclusion: 该方法特别适用于真实异常样本获取昂贵或不切实际的场景，一旦正常区域被准确估计，即可检测范围广泛的异常；摘要未明确说明其他局限。

papers.title: Structuring Quantitative Image Analysis with Object Prominence
papers.abstract_en: When photographers or media professionals compose an image, they make deliberate choices about what to foreground and what to background, shaping how viewers interpret visual content. Yet most quantitative approaches to image analysis overlook this structure and treat detected objects as equally important. We introduce a framework for measuring object prominence-- the relative salience of objects in an image-- as a means to make computational image analysis attentive to the compositional emphasis a curator has built into an image. Drawing on research in cognitive psychology and computer vision, we outline three approaches for estimating object prominence: size and centeredness, inferred depth, and saliency maps. Validating that curator-composed prominence measurably shifts human visual attention in a pre-registered eye-tracking study, we illustrate this framework's benefits in two further applications. First, we demonstrate how weighting features in line with their prominence can enhance the unsupervised ideological scaling of U.S. newspaper images. Second, we examine gendered visual prominence in U.S. presidential campaign ads from 2016 and 2020, showing that Republican candidates depict women less prominently than their Democratic counterparts. Our framework lets researchers analyze image data at scale while remaining attentive to its communicative structure and intent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个衡量图像中物体显著性 (object prominence) 的框架，旨在让计算图像分析关注策展人嵌入的构图强调。作者基于认知心理学和计算机视觉研究，概述了三种估计物体显著性的方法：尺寸与居中程度、推断深度、显著性图 (saliency maps)。通过预注册的眼动实验验证了策展式显著性会可测量地改变人类视觉注意，并在两个应用中展示框架价值：按显著性加权特征可提升美国报纸图像的无监督意识形态尺度化，以及2016/2020年美国总统竞选广告中的性别化视觉显著性分析。
Motivation: 现有大多数定量图像分析方法忽略构图结构，将检测到的物体视为同等重要，而摄影师或媒体专业人士会有意识地决定前景与背景，从而塑造观众对视觉内容的解读。
Method: 提出一个测量物体相对显著性的框架，包含三种估计途径：尺寸与居中程度、推断深度、显著性图；并用预注册眼动研究验证框架的有效性，随后将其应用于新闻报道图像的意识形态尺度化和政治广告的性别显著性分析。

papers.title: Towards Robust Monocular Depth Estimation in Non-Lambertian Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: In the field of monocular depth estimation (MDE), many models with excellent zero-shot performance in general scenes emerge recently. However, these methods often fail in predicting non-Lambertian surfaces, such as transparent or mirror (ToM) surfaces, due to the unique reflective properties of these regions. Previous methods utilize externally provided ToM masks and aim to obtain correct depth maps through direct in-painting of RGB images. These methods highly depend on the accuracy of additional input masks, and the use of random colors during in-painting makes them insufficiently robust. We are committed to incrementally enabling the baseline model to directly learn the uniqueness of non-Lambertian surface regions for depth estimation through a well-designed training framework. Therefore, we propose non-Lambertian surface regional guidance, which constrains the predictions of MDE model from the gradient domain to enhance its robustness. Noting the significant impact of lighting on this task, we employ the random tone-mapping augmentation during training to ensure the network can predict correct results for varying lighting inputs. Additionally, we propose an optional novel lighting fusion module, which uses Variational Autoencoders to fuse multiple images and obtain the most advantageous input RGB image for depth estimation when multi-exposure images are available. Our method achieves accuracy improvements of 33.39% and 5.21% in zero-shot testing on the Booster and Mirror3D dataset for non-Lambertian surfaces, respectively, compared to the Depth Anything V2. The state-of-the-art performance of 90.75 in delta1.05 within the ToM regions on the TRICKY2024 competition test set demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单目深度估计（MDE）在非朗伯表面（如透明和镜面物体）上性能退化的问题，提出一种训练框架，使基线模型无需外部遮罩即可直接学习这类区域的深度估计。方法包括非朗伯表面区域梯度域约束、随机色调映射增强，以及一个可选的多曝光光照融合模块（基于 VAE）。在 Booster 和 Mirror3D 数据集上，零样本测试相对 Depth Anything V2 分别提升 33.39% 和 5.21%，并在 TRICKY2024 竞赛测试集的 ToM 区域达到 delta1.05 为 90.75 的当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 MDE 模型在一般场景表现优异，但在透明或镜面等非朗伯表面上常失效；以往方法依赖外部提供的 ToM 掩码并通过 RGB 图像修复来获得深度，这既受掩码精度限制，又因修复时使用随机颜色而鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出非朗伯表面区域引导（non-Lambertian surface regional guidance），从梯度域约束 MDE 模型的预测以增强鲁棒性；训练中采用随机色调映射增强（random tone-mapping augmentation）应对光照变化；并可选地提出基于变分自编码器（VAE）的光照融合模块，在多曝光图像可用时将多张图像融合为最适合深度估计的 RGB 输入。
Result: 在 Booster 和 Mirror3D 数据集上，零样本测试相对 Depth Anything V2 在非朗伯表面上分别取得 33.39% 和 5.21% 的精度提升；在 TRICKY2024 竞赛测试集的 ToM 区域内 delta1.05 达到 90.75，为当前最优（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过设计训练框架使模型直接学习非朗伯表面的独特性，可摆脱对外部掩码的依赖并提升鲁棒性；摘要未讨论该方法在一般场景或更多类型表面上的局限。

papers.title: Physical prior guided cooperative learning framework for joint turbulence degradation estimation and infrared video restoration
papers.abstract_en: Infrared imaging and turbulence strength measurements are in widespread demand in many fields. This paper introduces a Physical Prior Guided Cooperative Learning (P2GCL) framework to jointly enhance atmospheric turbulence strength estimation and infrared image restoration. P2GCL involves a cyclic collaboration between two models, i.e., a TMNet measures turbulence strength and outputs the refractive index structure constant (Cn2) as a physical prior, a TRNet conducts infrared image sequence restoration based on Cn2 and feeds the restored images back to the TMNet to boost the measurement accuracy. A novel Cn2-guided frequency loss function and a physical constraint loss are introduced to align the training process with physical theories. Experiments demonstrate P2GCL achieves the best performance for both turbulence strength estimation (improving Cn2 MAE by 0.0156, enhancing R2 by 0.1065) and image restoration (enhancing PSNR by 0.2775 dB), validating the significant impact of physical prior guided cooperative learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理先验引导的协同学习框架 (P2GCL)，用于联合估计大气湍流强度与红外图像序列复原。框架由湍流测量网络 TMNet 输出折射率结构常数 Cn2 作为物理先验，再由复原网络 TRNet 基于 Cn2 进行红外图像复原，并将复原结果反馈给 TMNet 以提升测量精度。实验显示该方法在湍流强度估计与图像复原上均取得最佳性能。需要特别注意的是，arXiv 评论区标注“方法不正确”，该警告可能影响对本文结果的采信。
Motivation: 红外成像与湍流强度测量在多个领域有广泛需求，但二者通常被分开处理；现有方法缺乏将物理先验融入协同学习的机制，导致湍流估计与图像复原无法相互促进。
Method: 提出 P2GCL 框架，通过 TMNet 和 TRNet 的循环协作实现联合优化：TMNet 输出 Cn2 作为物理先验，TRNet 依据 Cn2 进行序列复原并将复原图像反馈回 TMNet；同时引入 Cn2 引导的频率损失函数和物理约束损失，使训练过程与物理理论对齐。
Result: 实验表明 P2GCL 在湍流强度估计上将 Cn2 MAE 降低 0.0156、R2 提升 0.1065，在图像复原上将 PSNR 提升 0.2775 dB，均达到最佳性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为物理先验引导的协同学习对湍流估计和图像复原均有显著效果；但论文的 arXiv 评论明确指出该方法不正确，读者在参考其结论和数据时需保持警惕。

papers.title: A Review on Building Blocks of Decentralized Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is transforming our lives, and technological progress and transfer from the academic and theoretical sphere to the real world are accelerating yearly. But during that progress and transition, several open problems and questions need to be addressed for the field to develop ethically, such as digital privacy, ownership, and control. These are some of the reasons why the currently most popular approaches of artificial intelligence, i.e., centralized AI (CEAI), are questionable, with other directions also being widely explored, such as decentralized artificial intelligence (DEAI), to solve some of the most reaching problems. This paper provides a systematic literature review (SLR) of existing work in the field of DEAI, presenting the findings of 71 identified studies. The paper's primary focus is identifying the building blocks of DEAI solutions and networks, tackling the DEAI analysis from a bottom-up approach. In the end, future directions of research and open problems are proposed.
papers.comment: This paper has been published in ICT Express
papers.journal_ref: ICT Express, Volume 11, Issue 3, June 2025, Pages 486-506
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于去中心化人工智能（decentralized artificial intelligence, DEAI）的系统性文献综述（systematic literature review, SLR），基于对71项研究的分析，采用自底向上的方法识别DEAI解决方案与网络的构建模块，并提出了未来研究方向与开放问题。论文已发表于ICT Express。
Motivation: 中心化人工智能（centralized AI, CEAI）在数字隐私、所有权和控制等方面存在亟待解决的开放问题，作者认为这些问题使CEAI受到质疑，有必要系统梳理DEAI这一替代方向的研究现状。
Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，筛选并分析71项DEAI相关研究，从底层构建模块出发对DEAI解决方案和网络进行拆解与归纳。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验数据，主要成果是识别出DEAI的构建模块，并提出该领域的未来研究方向与开放问题。
Conclusion: 作者认为DEAI是应对中心化AI若干根本问题的重要探索方向，但指出仍需进一步研究；该文主要贡献在于综述性梳理而非提出具体解决方案。

papers.title: Long-range near-surface wake signatures of offshore wind farm clusters revealed by satellite observations
papers.abstract_en: Wind energy has expanded rapidly in recent years, leading to increasingly dense clusters of offshore wind farms. As a result, wind farm wake effects, manifested as reduced wind speeds downstream of operating turbines, have become an important consideration for wind resource assessment and large-scale planning. Here we investigate near-surface wake signatures using wind speeds retrieved from 7122 Sentinel-1A/B synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired between 2020 and 2022, covering more than 60 offshore wind farms across Europe and Asia. A consistent processing workflow and an automated wake-detection algorithm are applied to identify wake-affected regions and quantify wake-related wind speed changes at 10 m height. The results show that near-surface wake signatures can persist over distances exceeding 100 km under favorable conditions and that wake-affected regions exhibit an average wind speed reduction of 0.990 m/s (12.4%) at 10 m height. Several cases of wake interactions extending across national boundaries are also observed in densely developed offshore regions. These findings provide a large-scale, observation-based characterization of near-surface wind farm wake signatures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 2020—2022 年间获取的 7122 幅 Sentinel-1A/B 合成孔径雷达（SAR）影像反演 10 m 高度风场，覆盖欧洲和亚洲 60 余座海上风电场，并采用一致的处理流程与自动尾流检测算法来刻画近地表尾流特征。结果表明，在有利条件下近地表尾流信号可延伸超过 100 km，尾流影响区域在 10 m 高度平均风速降低 0.990 m/s（12.4%）；在密集开发的海上区域还观察到若干个跨越国家边界的尾流相互作用案例。
Motivation: 风能快速扩张使海上风电场集群日益密集，风机下游风速降低形成的尾流效应对风资源评估和大尺度规划越来越重要，需要基于观测的大范围近地表尾流刻画。
Method: 基于 7122 幅 Sentinel-1A/B SAR 影像反演 10 m 风速，建立统一处理流程并开发自动化尾流检测算法，用于识别尾流影响区域并量化尾流引起的风速变化。
Result: 摘要报告近地表尾流信号在有利条件下可持续超过 100 km，尾流影响区域 10 m 高度平均风速降低 0.990 m/s（12.4%），并在密集开发的近海区域观测到数个跨国的尾流相互作用实例。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了大尺度、基于观测的海上风电场近地表尾流特征刻画，但摘要未给出方法的局限或适用范围的明确讨论。

papers.title: Bridging AI and Energy Forecasting: An Autonomous Workflow with Customized Toolkit
papers.abstract_en: Energy forecasting is crucial for the power grid, but fundamentally different from general time series analysis: it highly relies on covariates like meteorological factors, and its goals must align with actual power grid operations, such as risk assessment and system reliability. In order to bridge the huge gap between advanced machine learning forecasting models and actual power grid demand, this paper proposes an autonomous forecasting workflow based on LLMs. As a virtual analyst, the agent replaces tedious manual adjustments by autonomously analyzing data features, dynamically orchestrating optimal forecasting pipelines, and generating actionable analysis reports for decision-makers. The carefully arranged pipeline directly addresses the demand of the power grid through probabilistic forecasting for uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, the framework acts as an automated testbed, enabling seamless A/B testing of specific algorithmic plugins across various architectures to evaluate their empirical effectiveness. As the foundation of the algorithm, the underlying toolkit integrates 31 advanced temporal architectures and 6 customized exogenous modules, resulting in 146 highly configurable variants. In addition, to provide experience references for the agents, we established a large-scale benchmark on 21 energy datasets and released new high-quality renewable energy datasets with meteorological factors.

papers.title: Deep R Programming
papers.abstract_en: Deep R Programming is a comprehensive and in-depth introductory course on one of the most popular languages for data science. It equips ambitious students, professionals, and researchers with the knowledge and skills to become independent users of this potent environment so that they can tackle any problem related to data wrangling and analytics, numerical computing, statistics, and machine learning. This textbook is a non-profit project. Its online and PDF versions are freely available at <https://deepr.gagolewski.com/>.
papers.journal_ref: Zenodo, Melbourne, ISBN: 978-0-6455719-2-9 (2026) https://deepr.gagolewski.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一本面向数据科学的 R 语言深度入门教材，由 Marek Gagolewski 撰写，内容覆盖数据整理与分析、数值计算、统计学和机器学习。摘要称该教材面向有抱负的学生、专业人士和研究人员，旨在帮助读者成为 R 环境的独立使用者。作为非营利项目，其在线版和 PDF 版可免费获取。

papers.title: MSGNN: A Spectral Graph Neural Network Based on a Novel Magnetic Signed Laplacian
papers.abstract_en: Signed and directed networks are ubiquitous in real-world applications. However, there has been relatively little work proposing spectral graph neural networks (GNNs) for such networks. Here we introduce a signed directed Laplacian matrix, which we call the magnetic signed Laplacian, as a natural generalization of both the signed Laplacian on signed graphs and the magnetic Laplacian on directed graphs. We then use this matrix to construct a novel efficient spectral GNN architecture and conduct extensive experiments on both node clustering and link prediction tasks. In these experiments, we consider tasks related to signed information, tasks related to directional information, and tasks related to both signed and directional information. We demonstrate that our proposed spectral GNN is effective for incorporating both signed and directional information, and attains leading performance on a wide range of data sets. Additionally, we provide a novel synthetic network model, which we refer to as the Signed Directed Stochastic Block Model, and a number of novel real-world data sets based on lead-lag relationships in financial time series.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 10 pages for the main text, accepted to LoG 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出磁符号拉普拉斯矩阵 (magnetic signed Laplacian)，作为符号图上的符号拉普拉斯与有向图上的磁拉普拉斯的自然推广，并基于该矩阵构建高效的谱图神经网络 (spectral GNN)。作者在节点聚类和链接预测任务上开展实验，覆盖仅含符号信息、仅含方向信息以及同时含两类信息的任务，表明该模型能有效融合符号与方向信息，并在多个数据集上取得领先性能。此外，论文还提出新的合成网络模型 Signed Directed Stochastic Block Model，并基于金融时间序列中的领先-滞后关系构造了若干新的真实数据集。
Motivation: 符号网络和有向网络在实际应用中普遍存在，但针对这类网络的谱图神经网络研究相对较少，现有方法难以同时利用符号与方向两类信息。
Method: 定义磁符号拉普拉斯矩阵，将符号拉普拉斯与磁拉普拉斯统一起来；基于该矩阵构造高效的谱 GNN 架构，并引入 Signed Directed Stochastic Block Model 作为合成数据生成模型，同时提出基于金融时间序列领先-滞后关系的真实数据集。
Result: 在节点聚类和链接预测的大量实验中，该方法在仅含符号信息、仅含方向信息以及同时含两类信息的任务上均有效，并在广泛数据集上达到领先性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的谱 GNN 能有效整合符号与方向信息，论文的额外贡献包括新的合成网络模型和基于金融数据的新真实数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BCNet: Bronchus Classification via Structure Guided Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: CT-based bronchial tree analysis is essential for diagnosing lung and airway diseases, yet automatic bronchus classification remains challenging because bronchial topology varies substantially across individuals. We propose the Bronchus Classification Network (BCNet), a structure-guided framework that uses segment-level topological information from point clouds to improve voxel-level representation learning. BCNet contains two jointly trained branches: a Point-Voxel Graph Neural Network (PV-GNN) for segment classification and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for voxel-wise labeling. The branches share a common convolutional backbone, allowing topology-aware supervision from the PV-GNN to enhance voxel-level features. During inference, only the CNN branch is required, so BCNet retains the computational efficiency of its CNN baseline. Experiments on BronAtlas demonstrate that BCNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods by more than 8.0% in F1-score for bronchus classification. We also introduce BronAtlas, an open-access benchmark for bronchial imaging analysis that contains high-quality voxel-wise annotations of anatomical and abnormal bronchial segments. BronAtlas provides a valuable resource for developing and evaluating advanced methods for bronchial tree analysis, disease diagnosis, and surgical planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BCNet，一个面向 CT 支气管树分类的结构引导表示学习框架。BCNet 联合训练两个分支：用于段分类的 Point-Voxel 图神经网络（PV-GNN）和用于体素级标注的 CNN，两者共享卷积骨干，使拓扑感知监督能增强体素级特征；推理时只需 CNN 分支。在 BronAtlas 基准上，BCNet 的 F1-score 比现有最优方法提高超过 8.0%。作者同时发布了带高质量体素级标注的开放基准 BronAtlas。
Motivation: CT 支气管树分析对肺部和气道疾病诊断很关键，但不同个体间支气管拓扑差异大，使得自动支气管分类具有挑战性。
Method: 提出双分支联合训练框架：PV-GNN 利用点云的段级拓扑信息进行段分类，CNN 负责体素级标注，两个分支共享卷积骨干以传递拓扑感知监督；推理阶段仅保留 CNN 分支以维持计算效率。
Result: 在 BronAtlas 上，BCNet 的支气管分类 F1-score 比现有最优方法提升超过 8.0%。
Conclusion: 作者引入开放基准 BronAtlas，包含解剖与异常支气管段的体素级标注，为支气管树分析、疾病诊断和手术规划研究提供资源。

papers.title: Representation and Invariance in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Researchers have formalized reinforcement learning (RL) in different ways. If an agent in one RL framework is to run within another RL framework's environments, the agent must first be converted, or mapped, into that other framework. In this paper, we lay foundations for studying relative-intelligence-preserving mappability between RL frameworks. We introduce a criterion which is sufficient for relative intelligence to be preserved according to one particular method of measuring intelligence. We show that this criterion cannot be met when mapping between certain deterministic and stochastic RL frameworks, suggesting inherent fundamental diffences between these different versions of RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为不同强化学习（RL）框架之间保持相对智能（relative intelligence）的可映射性建立研究基础。作者提出一个充分条件，该条件可在一种特定智能度量方法下保持相对智能，并证明该条件在若干确定性与随机性 RL 框架之间无法满足，从而暗示这些 RL 版本之间存在内在的根本性差异。
Motivation: 研究者以不同方式形式化了强化学习；若一个框架中的智能体要在另一个框架的环境下运行，必须先将其转换或映射到另一框架。论文的目标是研究这种映射能否在保持相对智能的意义下进行。
Method: 引入一个判断准则，用来保证按照某一特定的智能度量方法，相对智能在 RL 框架间的映射中得以保持。
Result: 作者证明该准则在从某些确定性 RL 框架映射到随机性 RL 框架（或反之）时无法满足。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这一不可满足性暗示不同版本的 RL 之间存在固有的根本差异。

papers.title: SciDataSailor: Deep Scientific Data Exploring
papers.abstract_en: Scientific datasets are commonly organized as hierarchical repositories containing heterogeneous and interdependent files, making their inspection, integration, and analysis labor-intensive and reliant on domain expertise. Although large language model (LLM) agents have advanced substantially in planning, reasoning, and tool use, existing research has largely overlooked their ability to interact with real scientific data assets through executable environments. We introduce Deep Scientific Data Exploration, an agentic task paradigm in which agents navigate repositories, interpret heterogeneous files and schemas, execute analyses, integrate cross-file evidence, and produce conclusions grounded in executed observations. To operationalize this paradigm, we present SciDataSailor, a framework for synthesizing tool-interactive trajectories by balancing broad exploration with targeted exploitation. SciDataSailor instantiates trajectory synthesis as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with four task-specific mechanisms: difficulty-stratified exploration seeds, dual-feedback first-play urgency, hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation, and entropy-guided branching. Using this framework, we construct SciDataSailor-SFT-2K for supervised fine-tuning and SciDataSailor-Bench for evaluation, with the latter comprising 627 meta-information summarization tasks and 586 scientific question-answering tasks across 27 datasets spanning the life, earth, and physical sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度科学数据探索 (Deep Scientific Data Exploration) 这一智能体任务范式，并构建 SciDataSailor 框架，用 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) 合成工具交互轨迹，加入难度分层探索种子、双反馈首次出牌紧迫性、层级策略到工具动作生成和熵引导分支等机制。作者基于该框架构建了监督微调数据集 SciDataSailor-SFT-2K 与评测基准 SciDataSailor-Bench，后者包含 627 个元信息总结任务和 586 个科学问答任务，覆盖生命、地球与物理科学的 27 个数据集。
Motivation: 科学数据集常以包含异构且相互依赖文件的层级仓库形式组织，检查、整合和分析这些数据费时且依赖领域专家；尽管 LLM 智能体在规划、推理和工具使用上进展显著，现有研究忽视了它们通过可执行环境与真实科学数据资产交互的能力。
Method: 将该能力形式化为深度科学数据探索任务：智能体需导航仓库、解释异构文件和模式、执行分析、整合跨文件证据并生成基于可执行观测的结论。SciDataSailor 将轨迹合成建模为 MCTS，并引入四个任务特定机制：难度分层探索种子 (difficulty-stratified exploration seeds)、双反馈首次出牌紧迫性 (dual-feedback first-play urgency)、层级策略到工具动作生成 (hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation) 和熵引导分支 (entropy-guided branching)。
Result: 摘要未报告具体性能数字，主要贡献是构建了用于监督微调的 SciDataSailor-SFT-2K 和用于评估的 SciDataSailor-Bench；后者含 627 个元信息总结任务和 586 个科学问答任务，覆盖 27 个来自生命、地球和物理科学领域的数据集。

papers.title: HOMER: Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation in Hilbert Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Heavy tails weaken high-confidence control for the empirical mean. Geometric median-of-means (MOM) also lacks a threshold that moves toward mean efficiency. We propose \emph{HOMER}, or Huber-of-Means for Efficient and Robust Estimation. HOMER aggregates block means through a radial Huber center. Its canonical and pseudo-Huber forms bound each block score and interpolate between median-like robustness and the empirical mean. We establish a Hilbert-space majority theorem and a MOM-order deviation bound under a finite second moment. Canonical HOMER recovers the sample mean inside its quadratic region. Pseudo-HOMER approaches the sample mean as the threshold grows. It also admits asymptotic linearity and consistent sandwich covariance estimation around the population block-Huber target. Under a finite third moment, fixed finite-dimensional projections support mean inference at the usual parametric rate. This result requires growing block sizes and counts, with block sizes increasing faster. Heavy-tailed simulations show that HOMER remains stable when a minority of block summaries is displaced. On clean Gaussian data, both versions closely approach the empirical mean's efficiency. Finite-block sandwich intervals undercovered, especially for skewed functional data. Further studies show failure when contamination affects most blocks or compromises ordinary within-block means.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOMER（Huber-of-Means），一种在 Hilbert 空间中进行高效且稳健均值估计的方法，通过径向 Huber 中心聚合分块均值。作者建立了 Hilbert 空间多数定理和有限二阶矩下的 MOM 阶偏差界，并证明规范 HOMER 在其二次区域内恢复样本均值、伪 HOMER 在阈值增大时逼近样本均值。重尾模拟显示 HOMER 在少数分块汇总被扰动时保持稳定，干净 Gaussian 数据下两种版本都接近经验均值效率。
Motivation: 重尾分布会削弱经验均值的置信控制，而几何中位数均值法（geometric median-of-means）缺少一个能向均值效率移动的阈值，因此需要在稳健性与效率之间提供可插值的估计器。
Method: HOMER 将数据分块后通过径向 Huber 中心聚合块均值，提供规范（canonical）与伪 Huber（pseudo-Huber）两种形式，分别限制每个块的得分；理论部分包括 Hilbert 空间多数定理、MOM 阶偏差界、渐近线性性与稳健的 sandwich 协方差估计。
Result: 在有限三阶矩下，固定有限维投影支持通常参数速率下的均值推断，但需要块大小与块数同时增长且块大小增长更快。重尾模拟显示 HOMER 在少数分块被扰动时稳定；在干净 Gaussian 数据上两种版本都接近经验均值效率；有限块 sandwich 区间存在欠覆盖，尤其对偏斜函数型数据；当污染影响大多数分块或破坏普通块内均值时方法失效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HOMER 通过在均值稳健性与效率之间插值来改进 Hilbert 空间中的均值估计，但其适用性受限于污染分块占比以及块内均值未被破坏的前提。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Does Explicit View Routing Work? A Controlled Study of Multi-View Graph-Text Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Graph-text retrieval typically maps a graph and its description to a single embedding, even when a query concerns only one semantic aspect, such as a class label or molecular property. Multiple heads can separate these aspects, but a change in the query head may alter retrieval even when the wrong text is sent to that head. Such behavior demonstrates architectural channelization, not necessarily semantic routing. We examine the conditions under which this distinction can be resolved. Our controlled version of MV-GTA uses deterministic, verifiable text segments; isolated text encoders; view-specific graph heads; and relevance derived from external labels or RDKit descriptors. Correct routing and per-sample derangements form a causal test of whether retrieval depends on content. On BBBP and BACE, correct routing improves label and property nDCG by 0.305 to 0.685 over deranged training. The expected graph head exceeds the best wrong head by 0.303 to 0.453. Topology does not specialize consistently across the two datasets. In a matched three-seed comparison, one joint model obtains mean topology, label, and property nDCG of 0.720/1.000/0.877; three separately trained Single specialists obtain 0.633/0.976/0.859. Property paraphrase augmentation also improves unseen-template nDCG by 0.140 and 0.147 over a matched-exposure canonical control. Consistency and hard-template extensions, however, reduce canonical retrieval in some settings. The evidence is therefore limited to explicit, externally grounded label and property routing and observed multi-interface consolidation. It does not establish free-form routing, consistent three-view specialization, statistical equivalence to specialists, or superior downstream prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多视图图-文本对齐 (multi-view graph-text alignment) 中显式视图路由何时真正有效。作者提出受控的 MV-GTA 变体，使用确定性可验证文本段、隔离的文本编码器、视图特定的图头以及由外部标签或 RDKit 描述符导出的相关性，并以正确路由与逐样本错乱 (derangement) 作为因果检验。在 BBBP 和 BACE 上，正确路由将标签和属性 nDCG 比错乱训练提高 0.305 至 0.685，但拓扑结构未在两个数据集上一致特化。作者强调证据仅限于显式、外部锚定的标签和属性路由，并不支持自由形式路由或一致的三视图特化。
Motivation: 图-文本检索通常将图和描述映射到单一嵌入，即使查询只关注某一语义方面（如类别标签或分子性质）；多头可以分离这些方面，但切换查询头可能改变检索结果，即使该头收到的是错误文本，这反映的是架构通道化而非语义路由。
Method: 构建受控的 MV-GTA 版本，包含确定性可验证文本段、隔离的文本编码器、视图特定图头，以及由外部标签或 RDKit 描述符导出的相关性；用正确路由与逐样本错乱训练构成判断检索是否依赖内容的因果测试，并加入属性释义增强及一致性与硬模板扩展。
Result: 在 BBBP 和 BACE 上，正确路由比错乱训练在标签和属性 nDCG 上提升 0.305 至 0.685，期望图头超过最佳错误图头 0.303 至 0.453；三种子匹配比较中，联合模型平均拓扑/标签/属性 nDCG 为 0.720/1.000/0.877，三个独立训练的 Single 专家为 0.633/0.976/0.859；属性释义增强将未见模板 nDCG 提高 0.140 和 0.147，但一致性和硬模板扩展在某些设置下降低规范检索性能。
Conclusion: 证据仅限于显式的、外部锚定的标签和属性路由以及观察到的多接口整合；该研究并未确立自由形式路由、一致的三视图特化、与专家模型的统计等价性，也未证明下游预测更优。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps for Few-Step Generation
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion and flow-matching models denoise a sequence over many steps, but to keep each step cheap, they factorize the transition across positions and decide every token independently. This makes few-step generation challenging for text when the target couples two positions, such as a subject and a verb that must agree. An independent update commits to them separately, and many function evaluations are spent repairing the mismatch. Existing few-step methods buy back the lost correlation by distilling or rectifying a slow teacher, and so inherit the teacher's quality ceiling. We ask instead whether a model can express correlated steps natively, and answer with Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps (LKF), a from-scratch flow-map kernel that is a mixture of M factorized components tied by a single shared latent. Conditioned on the latent, each component is cheap, and the mixture is summed over the latent in closed form for small M. We show that a single step places mass on correlated completions with the same sampling time complexity as a factorized model, since one latent is drawn per sequence and reused across the entire denoising trajectory. We also show that the Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) is a special case of our LKF model at M=1. The experiments for unconditional text generation on the One-Billion-Word (LM1B) and WikiText-103 benchmarks show that our LKF model learns strongly heterogeneous components and improves generative perplexity by 2.1x to 3.3x over the likelihood baselines without losing diversity. The gain grows with M, and at M=8, it surpasses distilled and rectified few-step samplers. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/lkf.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-Kernel Discrete Flow Maps (LKF)，一种从零训练的流映射核 (flow-map kernel)，由 M 个因子化分量混合而成，并通过单一共享潜变量 (latent) 绑定。条件于该潜变量时每个分量计算廉价，且对小 M 可在闭式下对潜变量求和。作者证明单步即可在保持与因子化模型相同采样时间复杂度的前提下，将概率质量置于相关补全上，并指出 Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) 是 M=1 时的特例。在 One-Billion-Word (LM1B) 与 WikiText-103 的无条件文本生成实验中，LKF 相对似然基线将生成困惑度 (generative perplexity) 提升 2.1 倍到 3.3 倍且不损失多样性；增益随 M 增大，M=8 时超过蒸馏与校正 (distilled and rectified) 的少步采样器。
Motivation: 离散扩散与流匹配模型通常将转移按位置因子化并独立决定每个 token，这使得文本中涉及两个位置耦合（如主谓一致）的少步生成很困难，且独立更新会反复投入大量函数评估去修复不一致。已有的少步方法通过蒸馏或校正慢速教师模型来挽回相关性，因此受限于教师模型的质量上限。
Method: LKF 是一种直接建模相关步骤的流映射核：它为 M 个因子化分量共享一个潜变量；给定潜变量后每个分量的计算很廉价，而对小 M 可将混合分布在潜变量上闭式求和。整个去噪轨迹只需每序列抽取一次潜变量并复用，因此采样时间复杂度与因子化模型相同。
Result: 在 LM1B 与 WikiText-103 的无条件文本生成上，LKF 相对似然基线将生成困惑度提升 2.1x 到 3.3x 且不损失多样性；增益随 M 增长，当 M=8 时超越蒸馏与校正的少步采样器。作者还证明 MDLM 是 LKF 在 M=1 时的特例。
Conclusion: 摘要表明模型可以原生表达相关步骤，从而以与因子化模型相同的采样时间复杂度实现高质量的少步生成；源代码已公开在 GitHub。

papers.title: ThreatForest: Multi-Agent Attack Tree Generation with Pluggable TTP Framework Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Threat modeling is essential for secure software development, yet manual analysis of cloud-native architectures is slow and demands scarce security expertise. We present ThreatForest, a multi-agent system that generates structured attack trees from source code repositories, maps attack steps to adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) from a pluggable set of frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, CAPEC, and cloud-specific threat matrices), and synthesizes actionable mitigations. ThreatForest decomposes threat modeling into a multi-stage agent pipeline -- repository analysis, context refinement, threat generation, parallel attack-tree construction with TTP mapping and mitigation synthesis, and report generation -- orchestrated as a directed graph with deterministic verification gates, bounded retries, and three human-in-the-loop validation points. A domain-specific sentence-transformer maps each attack step to candidate techniques by cosine similarity; we show empirically that this embedding stage, not the surrounding pipeline, is the dominant accuracy bottleneck. We evaluate ThreatForest across seven application domains on a sixteen-dimension rubric, scored by a panel of independent LLM raters with an adversarial verification pass and expert review. Panel-measured quality reaches 0.63-0.68 (on a 0-1 scale) for threat statements, attack trees, and mitigations, but only 0.29 for embedding-only TTP mapping -- a gap stable across all seven domains that isolates the binding constraint. A controlled single-call baseline on the same model more than doubles mapping defensibility, pinning the limitation on the embedding encoder rather than the multi-agent design. To our knowledge, ThreatForest is the first end-to-end system that turns a code repository into TTP-mapped attack trees with evidence-based mitigations across adversary frameworks, with a reusable framework for benchmarking such systems.
