papers.title: Hierarchical Reranking for Scalable Financial RAG System
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing financial documents such as 10-K filings, tabular disclosures, and macroeconomic reports demands expert reasoning and extensive time. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems often struggle to process hybrid text-table structures or the massive scale of financial documents. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Reranker, a RAG framework designed to improve retrieval performance and generative reliability across large-scale financial datasets. The system integrates three key innovations: Pre-Retrieval Optimization, enhancing query clarity and search efficiency through normalization, keyword expansion, and table transformation; Hierarchical Reranker Architecture, improving retrieval precision through a two-stage ranking mechanism; and Long-Context Management, preserving reasoning accuracy through adaptive input partitioning and fusion under extensive contexts. Across multiple benchmarks, including FinQA, FinanceBench, and ConvFinQA, the proposed system achieved an NDCG@20 score of 0.7918 and demonstrated superior factual consistency. Its robustness was further validated by achieving second place in the ACM-ICAIF '24 FinanceRAG Challenge. This work presents a deployable, domain-optimized RAG pipeline that enhances both the accuracy and scalability of financial reasoning, paving the way for automated audit reporting and quantitative investment analysis. The source code will be made publicly available on GitHub upon acceptance.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at FinLLM @ IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向大规模金融文档的 RAG 框架 Hierarchical Reranker，整合预检索优化、两层级的层级重排序架构和长上下文管理。系统在 FinQA、FinanceBench、ConvFinQA 等基准上取得 NDCG@20 为 0.7918，事实一致性表现更优，并在 ACM-ICAIF '24 FinanceRAG Challenge 中获得第二名。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统难以处理金融文档中混合文本-表格的结构以及大规模数据，导致检索性能和生成可靠性不足。
Method: 提出三个关键组件：预检索优化（归一化、关键词扩展、表格转换）、层级重排序架构（两阶段排序机制）、长上下文管理（自适应输入划分与融合）。
Result: 在 FinQA、FinanceBench、ConvFinQA 等基准上 NDCG@20 达到 0.7918，并展现更优的事实一致性；此外在 ACM-ICAIF '24 FinanceRAG Challenge 中取得第二名。
Conclusion: 该工作呈现一条可部署、面向金融领域优化的 RAG 流水线，提升金融推理的准确性和可扩展性，为自动化审计报告和量化投资分析奠定基础；源码将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: Expanding Data-Agnostic Pivotal Instances Selection Models with Proximity Trees and Ensemble Learning
papers.abstract_en: As decision-making processes grow more complex, machine learning tools have become essential for tackling business and societal challenges. However, many existing methods rely on decision-making procedures that are difficult to interpret. Since humans naturally make decisions by comparing new cases with a few representative examples, we aim to design an approach that selects such pivots to construct an interpretable predictive model. Inspired by decision trees, we propose a hierarchical, interpretable-by-design pivot selection model based on the similarity between pivots and input instances. Our method functions both as a pivot selection technique and a standalone predictive model. Extending beyond single pivots, we incorporate pairs of pivots that are used by proximity and oblique trees, as well as ensembles, which enhance the versatility and effectiveness of our proposal. Additionally, our approach is data modality-agnostic, leveraging pre-trained networks for data transformation. Experiments across diverse datasets, including tabular data, text, images, and time series, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming alternative instance selection strategies and achieving competitive results against state-of-the-art interpretable models while maintaining a minimal number of pivots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据模态无关、可解释的 pivotal instances（枢轴实例）选择模型，受决策树启发，基于枢轴与输入实例之间的相似性进行层级划分。该方法既可以作为实例选择技术，也可以作为独立预测模型，并扩展了双枢轴（proximity/oblique trees）以及集成学习（ensemble learning）版本。实验覆盖表格、文本、图像和时间序列数据，声称优于其他实例选择策略，并在保持少量枢轴的同时达到与最先进可解释模型相当的效果。
Motivation: 现有机器学习决策过程难以解释，而人类天然通过少数代表性例子进行类比决策。作者希望设计一种能自动选择 pivots 的方法，从而构建可解释的预测模型。
Method: 提出一种层级化、可解释的 pivot 选择模型，基于 pivots 与输入实例的相似性。方法结合决策树思路，延伸至双 pivots（用于 proximity trees 和 oblique trees）以及集成学习；通过预训练网络进行数据变换，使方法适用于任意数据模态。
Result: 在多种数据集（包括表格、文本、图像和时间序列）上的实验表明，该方法优于其他实例选择策略，并与最先进可解释模型相比具有竞争力，同时使用极少数量的 pivots。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法兼具 pivot 选择与独立预测能力，且数据模态无关，能够以少量 pivots 维持可解释性和性能。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Automated Transcript Analysis for Detecting Flaws in Agentic Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Capabilities of frontier models are often assessed using agentic benchmarks. To trust these results, benchmarks must accurately measure what they claim to and be free from invalidating flaws. Previous manual audits of benchmarks such as SWE-Bench-Verified have uncovered several validity issues in transcripts. However, manual review is difficult to scale, and it is unclear whether automated methods can reliably surface flaws that compromise benchmark validity. In this paper, we developed AI scanners to detect four types of validity issues: ground truth access, tool failure, guessing vulnerability, and answer format ambiguity. We produced grading rubrics for each to instruct human labeling, and evaluated the scanners against human labels on a held-out test set of Inspect Evals benchmarks. Our scanners identified several verified quality issues in five widely used benchmarks, including cases unlikely to be caught by random manual inspection. Not all cases were identified, and scanner performance varied substantially across benchmarks, criteria and models. We highlight several open challenges to be addressed to improve scanners for stronger quality assurance claims, including broader standardization gaps in the evaluation field that degrade scanner performance. Together, these results serve as a proof of concept for using automated transcript analysis to audit benchmark quality more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用自动化 AI 扫描器检测 agentic benchmark 中的四类有效性问题：ground truth 访问、工具失败、猜测脆弱性和答案格式歧义。作者为每类问题制定评分标准并训练人类标注，在 Inspect Evals bench 的留出测试集上评估扫描器，并在五个广泛使用的 benchmark 中发现若干已确证的质量问题，其中部分问题难以通过随机人工检查发现。结果作为自动化转录分析用于基准质量审计的概念验证，但扫描器性能在不同基准、标准和模型间差异显著。
Motivation: 前沿模型能力常通过 agentic benchmark 评估，但基准若存在失效性缺陷则结果不可信。此前对 SWE-Bench-Verified 等基准的人工审计发现了有效性问题，但人工审查难以规模化，且尚不清楚自动化方法能否可靠地找出损害基准有效性的缺陷。
Method: 开发了四类 AI 扫描器，分别检测 ground truth 访问、工具失败、猜测脆弱性和答案格式歧义；为每类编写评分标准以指导人工标注，并在 Inspect Evals benchmarks 的留出测试集上对照人工标签评估扫描器性能。
Result: 扫描器在五个广泛使用的 benchmark 中识别出多个已证实的质量问题，包括随机人工检查难以发现的案例；但并非所有案例都被识别，且性能在不同基准、标准和模型间差异很大。
Conclusion: 作者指出该方法可作为自动化审计 benchmark 质量的概念验证，同时强调需要解决开放挑战，包括评估领域更广泛的标准差异，才能做出更强的质量保证声明。

papers.title: Sparsity Induced Identifiability in Matrix Tri-Factorisation
papers.abstract_en: Matrix factorisation is a fundamental tool for exploiting low-dimensional structure in high-dimensional data, with applications such as data compression, denoising, structure discovery, interpretable representation learning, and dimensionality reduction. Compared to conventional two-factor models, matrix tri-factorisation provides greater modelling flexibility, while sparsity constraints often improve both interpretability and recovery performance. Although the role of sparsity has been extensively studied for two-factor matrix factorisation, rigorous theoretical guarantees for general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we establish, to the best of our knowledge, the first rigorous theoretical study for sparsity-induced identifiability in general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation. Our analysis is enabled by a novel decomposition strategy that transforms the original problem into two coupled auxiliary factorisation problems, while preserving the structural information necessary to the recovery of the original factor matrices from the observations. Building upon this decomposition, we derive recovery guarantees and structural consistency results that characterise how coefficient sparsity influences the sufficient recovery conditions, convergence behaviour, spectral approximation error, high-probability bounds, and structure preservation. Comprehensive Monte Carlo experiments validate the proposed theory and demonstrate close agreement between the theoretical results and empirical observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对一般实值矩阵三因子分解 (matrix tri-factorisation) 中的稀疏诱导可辨识性问题，提出了据称首个严格理论分析。作者通过一种新的分解策略将原问题转化为两个耦合的辅助因子分解问题，并在此基础上推导出恢复保证与结构一致性结果，刻画系数稀疏性对充分恢复条件、收敛行为、谱逼近误差、高概率界和结构保持的影响。蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论与经验观测的吻合。
Motivation: 矩阵因子分解是挖掘高维数据低维结构的基本工具，三因子分解相比两因子模型具有更强的建模灵活性，稀疏约束也能提升可解释性和恢复性能。然而稀疏性在两因子分解中的角色已被广泛研究，一般实值矩阵三因子分解的严格理论保证仍基本空白。
Method: 提出一种新的分解策略，将一般实值矩阵三因子分解问题转化为两个耦合的辅助因子分解问题，同时保留从观测中恢复原始因子矩阵所需的结构信息；在该分解基础上推导恢复保证和结构一致性结果，并辅以蒙特卡洛实验验证理论。
Result: 摘要报告推导了系数稀疏性影响下的恢复保证、结构一致性、收敛行为、谱逼近误差、高概率界与结构保持等理论结果，并通过综合蒙特卡洛实验表明理论预测与经验观察高度一致。
Conclusion: 本文建立了稀疏诱导可辨识性在一般实值矩阵三因子分解中的首个严格理论框架，强调该分解策略是分析的关键，且实验支持理论结论。摘要未讨论实际数据应用或与其他方法对比的局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出一种新的分解策略，将一般实值矩阵三因子分解问题转化为两个耦合的辅助因子分解问题，同时保留从观测中恢复原始因子矩阵所需的结构信息；在该分解基础上推导恢复保证和结构一致性结果，并辅以蒙特卡洛实验验证理论。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告推导了系数稀疏性影响下的恢复保证、结构一致性、收敛行为、谱逼近误差、高概率界与结构保持等理论结果，并通过综合蒙特卡洛实验表明理论预测与经验观察高度一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文建立了稀疏诱导可辨识性在一般实值矩阵三因子分解中的首个严格理论框架，强调该分解策略是分析的关键，且实验支持理论结论。摘要未讨论实际数据应用或与其他方法对比的局限。

papers.title: Models for minimalist RAG: B1ade 335M Embedding and 1B Parameter Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language and embedding models used in RAG systems are conventionally assumed to require large-scale pretraining and explicit grounding supervision. We present B1ade, an efficient RAG architecture comprising two purpose-built components: a compact embedding model and a purpose-built SLM. B1ade-embed, a 335M parameter retrieval model constructed via parameter-free fusion of five pretrained encoders achieves top MTEB scores among sub-500M models with zero additional training, and B1ade-1B, an SLM trained on low-cost GPUs using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on 723M tokens (2.2M examples) of curated context-question pairs with rewards that optimize only answer similarity. Our central finding is emergent attribution: despite receiving no explicit supervision for source citation, B1ade-1B cites retrieved passages in 42.4% of responses, exceeding the attribution rate of its training distribution by 5.5 percentage points. This demonstrates that grounding behavior can emerge as an accuracy-maximizing strategy under RL training, without explicit reward engineering. On standard QA benchmarks, B1ade-1B achieves 81.82% on PopQA, 65.8% on PubMedQA, and 51.09% on FEVER. In end-to-end RAG evaluation, B1ade-1B achieves an average score of 0.654 across correctness, completeness, coherence, and faithfulness, a 10.8% improvement over the SFT, while closing the gap with models 1.5x its size. These results show that strategic model composition and reward design suffice for resource-efficient RAG, without large-scale pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 B1ade，一个面向 RAG 的高效架构，由 335M 参数的嵌入模型 B1ade-embed 和 1B 参数的 SLM B1ade-1B 组成。B1ade-embed 通过参数无关融合五个预训练编码器，零额外训练即在 sub-500M 模型中取得最高 MTEB 分数；B1ade-1B 使用 GRPO 在 723M tokens（2.2M 示例）上训练，奖励仅优化答案相似度。核心发现是涌现归因（emergent attribution）：尽管没有显式引用监督，模型在 42.4% 的响应中引用检索段落，比训练分布高 5.5 个百分点。在端到端 RAG 评估中平均分 0.654，较 SFT 提升 10.8%。
Motivation: RAG 系统中的语言模型和嵌入模型通常被认为需要大规模预训练和显式接地监督。本文试图说明，通过策略性模型组合与奖励设计，可以在不进行大规模预训练的情况下实现资源高效的 RAG。
Method: 提出 B1ade 两组件架构：B1ade-embed 将五个预训练编码器做参数无关融合作为检索模型；B1ade-1B 则是一个在低成本 GPU 上训练的 SLM，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 在精心整理的上下文-问题对上训练，奖励函数只针对答案相似度，不包含任何引用或归因奖励。
Result: B1ade-embed 在 sub-500M 模型中取得最高 MTEB 分数且无需额外训练；B1ade-1B 在 PopQA、PubMedQA、FEVER 上分别达到 81.82%、65.8%、51.09%。端到端 RAG 评估在正确性、完整性、连贯性和忠实性上平均 0.654，比 SFT 提升 10.8%，并缩小了与 1.5 倍规模模型的差距。模型自发引用检索段落的比率达到 42.4%，超过训练分布 5.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要认为接地行为可以在 RL 训练中作为最大化准确率的策略涌现，无需显式奖励工程；策略性模型组合和奖励设计足以支撑资源高效的 RAG，而无须大规模预训练。

papers.title: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Collider Physics with Multi-Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We present a lightweight approach to foundation modeling (\textbf{NEXUS}) that leverages pre-trained learning from collider physics data towards out-of-domain tasks in other scientific datasets, using a fully connected autoencoder model with approximately 3 million parameters. The model pre-trains with no supervision over a large-scale collision dataset from the Large Hadron Collider modeled by charged particle track features. Downstream tasks for collider analyses, such as kinematic regression and event classification, are developed on pre-trained model weights and achieve improved accuracy with only small labeled datasets when compared to equivalent architectures trained from scratch. The benefits of pre-training are additionally investigated through latent space interpretation and application to other domains, including gravitational waves, flood forecasting, and neural activity. Furthermore, the relative computational simplicity of NEXUS is demonstrated compared to transformer approaches at comparable scale, opening the door to power-efficient inference and real-time or edge applications of foundation models in scientific experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级基础模型 NEXUS，基于约 300 万参数的 fully connected autoencoder，在大型强子对撞机带电粒子径迹特征的大规模碰撞数据上无监督预训练，再用于对撞机分析的下游任务（运动学回归与事件分类）。摘要报告 NEXUS 在小标注数据集上比从零训练的等价架构精度更高，并将预训练收益扩展到引力波、洪水预报和神经活动等其他领域，同时相比同规模 Transformer 更具计算效率，适合实时或边缘场景。
Motivation: 科学实验场景中基础模型通常计算开销大，难以支撑实时或边缘推理；对撞机物理数据标注稀缺，需要利用无监督预训练降低下游任务对标注样本的需求。摘要还希望验证预训练表示能否迁移到其他科学数据域。
Method: NEXUS 使用约 300 万参数的 fully connected autoencoder，在 LHC 碰撞数据的带电粒子径迹特征上进行无监督预训练，随后用预训练权重微调对撞分析的下游任务；另通过潜在空间解释和跨域应用评估预训练表示的迁移性。
Result: 摘要称该方法在运动学回归和事件分类等下游任务上，仅用少量标注数据即可超过从零训练的等价架构；预训练收益在引力波、洪水预报和神经活动数据上得到观察；NEXUS 的推理计算复杂度低于同规模 Transformer 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量预训练基础模型可以兼顾跨域迁移能力与计算效率，为科学实验中功耗受限的实时或边缘基础模型应用开辟了可能性。

papers.title: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have improved rapidly on tasks with verifiable answers, such as mathematics and programming. Much less is known about their ability to reason about what we call conceptual questions: questions for which no ground truth is realistically accessible and no widely accepted resolution methodology exists, but on which progress can still be made by debating arguments. Most philosophical questions are of this kind, as are central components of questions in AI safety, decision theory, and social choice. Our approach is based on the view that while bottom-line conclusions on such questions are hard to evaluate, individual contextualized arguments can be evaluated far more reliably. We therefore introduce a dataset of 951 argumentative critiques of 442 position texts, spanning topics from AI safety and decision theory to ethics and politics, with 1,458 ratings by six expert raters along dimensions including centrality, strength, correctness, and clarity. We propose two scoring functions and benchmark a range of models. Performance tracks general capability rankings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在无可验证标准的概念性问题（conceptual questions）上的推理能力，提出一个由 951 条论证性批评（argumentative critiques）和 442 篇立场文本（position texts）组成的评级数据集，涵盖 AI 安全、决策论、伦理学与政治学等主题。数据集包含六位专家评级者给出的 1,458 条评分，维度包括中心性、强度、正确性与清晰度。作者提出两个评分函数并对多种模型进行基准测试，结果显示模型表现与通用能力排名一致。
Motivation: 大语言模型在数学、编程等可验证任务上进展迅速，但在没有现实可获取的真相、也没有公认解决方法的 conceptual questions 上推理能力尚不清楚，而这类问题在哲学、AI 安全、决策论和社会选择中普遍存在。作者认为直接的最终结论难以评估，但单个情境化论证可以更可靠地评估。
Method: 构建一个数据集：951 条论证性批评对应 442 篇立场文本，由六位专家评级者在中心性、强度、正确性和清晰度等维度上给出共 1,458 条评级；并提出两种评分函数，用于在数据集上对多种模型进行基准评估。
Result: 作者对一系列模型进行基准测试，摘要报告模型性能与通用能力排名（general capability rankings）相一致，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对单个情境化论证进行评估比评估最终结论更为可靠，并以此为基础提供了可用于研究概念性论证质量评级的资源与评分方法。

papers.title: MedLLM: An Open Medical Language Model at the Sub-Billion Scale
papers.abstract_en: Open medical language models have converged on a single scale: every widely used system runs at 7B parameters or more, leaving the sub-billion regime uncharacterized. We present MedLLM, an open 0.1B-parameter medical language model trained through a fully open three-phase pipeline: general pretraining with curriculum sequence-length scheduling, domain fine-tuning on MedFineWeb, a reference-guided medical corpus we release that is selected from general web data by embedding similarity to medical question-answering (QA) data, and preference-aligned fine-tuning combining SFT with direct preference optimization (DPO). Across medical benchmarks, MedLLM shows a pattern visible only at sub-billion scale: medical competence does not degrade uniformly under compression but splits by task type. On context-grounded QA it comes within $2.9$pp of a medically adapted 7B model and surpasses the instruction-tuned and general-purpose 7B baselines; on knowledge-recall QA it stays near the task floor on clinical-vignette MedQA yet significantly exceeds every 7B and sub-7B baseline on MedMCQA, indicating that where recall fails the constraint is model capacity rather than adaptation. This dissociation is masked at 7B, where both capabilities are present, and surfaces only when capacity is scarce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedLLM，一个仅 0.1B 参数的开源医学语言模型，采用完全开放的三阶段训练流程：通用预训练（含课程序列长度调度）、在发布的参考引导医学语料 MedFineWeb 上进行领域微调、以及结合 SFT 与直接偏好优化（DPO）的偏好对齐微调。摘要报告，在亚十亿规模下医学能力并非均匀退化，而是按任务类型分离：上下文问答接近医学适配的 7B 模型，而知识回忆类问答在不同基准上表现不一。作者指出这种能力分离在 7B 规模被掩盖，仅在容量稀缺时显现。
Motivation: 开放医学语言模型几乎全部集中在 7B 及以上参数规模，亚十亿参数区间缺乏系统性刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白并研究该规模下的能力模式。
Method: 构建 0.1B 参数的 MedLLM，训练分为三阶段：通用预训练采用课程序列长度调度；随后在 MedFineWeb 上领域微调，该语料通过嵌入相似性从通用网页数据中筛选与医学问答（QA）数据相关的引用引导文本；最后结合 SFT 与 DPO 进行偏好对齐。
Result: 在医学基准上，MedLLM 在上下文接地问答中与医学适配的 7B 模型相差 2.9 个百分点，并超过指令微调和通用 7B 基线；在知识回忆问答中，其在临床小插曲式 MedQA 上接近任务下限，但在 MedMCQA 上显著超过所有 7B 和亚 7B 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，医学能力在模型压缩下不是均匀退化而是按任务类型分离，知识回忆失败主要受限于模型容量而非领域适应，这一现象只在亚十亿规模下可见。

papers.title: INCLAIR: Inception-Based Longitudinal Clinical Anomaly Detection with Informed Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Detecting anomalies in longitudinal clinical profiles is clinically important but difficult: abnormal evidence is often sparse, patient histories have unequal length, and expert explanations are costly. We propose INCLAIR, a framework that scores each observation against multiple historical contexts, aggregates evidence at the profile level, and generates grounded natural-language explanations under limited expert supervision. Under stated within-profile exchangeability assumptions, the complete mean subsequence score takes an order-$l$ U-statistic form, yielding a variance decomposition and an incomplete-subset approximation that controls combinatorial inference cost independently of profile length. The same analysis shows that mean aggregation attenuates localized anomalies by a factor set by the anomaly support and profile length, motivating validation-selected top-$k$ pooling. Across three clinical datasets, INCLAIR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. We further validate practical relevance through a case study on longitudinal steroid profiles, comparing INCLAIR's predictions and explanations against domain-expert assessments supported by DNA analysis. The results show that INCLAIR enables clinically actionable anomaly detection under limited expert supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INCLAIR，一个面向纵向临床画像的异常检测框架，对每个观测相对于多个历史上下文打分、在画像层面聚合证据，并在有限专家监督下生成有依据的自然语言解释。在可交换性假设下，完整均值子序列得分具有 l 阶 U-统计量形式，由此得到方差分解和不完整子集近似；分析还表明均值聚合会按异常支撑与画像长度衰减局部异常，因此采用验证集选择的 top-k 池化。在三个临床数据集上持续优于现有基线，并通过纵向类固醇画像案例研究验证其实用价值。
Motivation: 纵向临床画像中的异常检测具有临床重要性，但异常证据稀疏、患者历史长度不齐、专家解释成本高，使该任务变得困难。
Method: 提出 INCLAIR 框架：对每个观测基于多个历史上下文打分，在画像层聚合证据，并在有限专家监督下生成有依据的自然语言解释；理论上利用可交换性假设给出得分函数的 U-统计量形式，导出方差分解与不完整子集近似，并据此设计验证集选择的 top-k 池化。
Result: 在三个临床数据集上，INCLAIR 一致优于现有最优基线；在结合 DNA 分析的纵向类固醇画像案例研究中，其预测和解释与领域专家评估具有可比性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够在有限专家监督下实现临床可操作的异常检测。

papers.title: Skill Use or Skill Theater? Evaluating the Reasoning Backroom in Skill-Augmented Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skills are becoming a standard interface for extending language agents with task procedures. Yet evaluators usually infer skill use from visible reasoning or the agent's own attribution. These signals show what the agent appears to use, not whether the skill changed its decision. We ask whether skill-augmented agents exhibit a \textbf{Reasoning Backroom}, a systematic gap between stated skill use and intervention-measured influence. We introduce BACKTRACE, an evaluation framework that pairs each skill-conditioned answer with a matched no-skill counterfactual, intervenes on skill meaning, wording, identity, content, and assignment, and elicits attribution only after the answer is committed. We instantiate the framework as BACKROOMBench, a verified testbed spanning controlled logic and competition mathematics, multiple skill conditions, single-agent and multi-agent settings, and diverse model families. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive provenance failure. Across models and domains, stated skill use often remains stable while causal reliance and signed utility vary, producing both silent uptake and performative use. Behavioral effects follow procedural content more reliably than displayed skill identity, whereas stated attributions respond strongly to artifact availability. Observational detectors based on direct skill-use claims, text mentions, trace similarity, and an LLM judge do not identify which decisions actually depend on the skill. In multi-agent systems, skill influence can survive communication even after its source is lost, while no-skill teams still name skills and sources that were never supplied. These findings establish the Reasoning Backroom as a general AI provenance problem whose audit requires intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BACKTRACE 评估框架，用于检测技能增强型语言代理中“陈述的技能使用”与“干预测量出的实际影响”之间的系统性差距，并将其实现为 BACKROOMBench 测试台。测试台覆盖受控逻辑与竞赛数学、多技能条件、单代理与多代理设置以及多种模型家族。评估发现普遍的存在性失败 (provenance failure)：陈述技能使用保持稳定但因果依赖与符号效用变化，观测式检测器无法识别决策是否真正依赖技能。
Motivation: 现有评估通常从可见推理或代理自身归因推断技能使用，但这些信号只显示代理表面使用了什么，而非技能是否真正改变了其决策；作者希望揭示这种“推理后台”(Reasoning Backroom) 并论证其审计需要干预式测量。
Method: 引入 BACKTRACE 框架：将每个技能条件下的回答与匹配的无技能反事实配对，对技能的含义、措辞、身份、内容和分配进行干预，并在答案确定之后才收集归因；以此构建包含逻辑与竞赛数学、单/多代理及多模型家族的 BACKROOMBench 基准。
Result: 跨模型和领域存在普遍的存在性失败：陈述技能使用常保持稳定，而因果依赖与符号效用 (signed utility) 变化，出现静默采纳 (silent uptake) 和表演性使用 (performative use)。行为效应更多跟随程序性内容而非显示的技能身份，而陈述归因对工件可得性敏感；基于直接技能使用声明、文本提及、轨迹相似度和 LLM 评判的观测式检测器均无法识别真正依赖技能的决策。多代理系统中技能影响在来源丢失后仍能通过通信存续，无技能的团队也会提及从未提供的技能和来源。
Conclusion: 作者将 Reasoning Backroom 确立为一个普遍的 AI 存在性 (provenance) 问题，并强调其审计必须依赖干预手段而非观测信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent States in Neural Networks: Recovering the Temporal Structure of Drifting Data from Model Weights
papers.abstract_en: A temporally drifting data stream may pass through discrete regimes rather than changing continuously. We ask whether such regimes are recoverable from the weights of models trained on the stream, using a hidden Markov model (HMM) fit to the chronologically ordered trajectory of those weights. We study this question in two domains known to drift over time: multimodal misinformation detection, using the Fakeddit dataset; and sentiment analysis, using the Yelp dataset. We train classifiers on consecutive temporal windows and fit an HMM to the trajectory of their aligned weights, recovering latent states that partition each timeline into coherent phases. On both datasets, classifiers generalize better to data from windows sharing the state of their training window than to windows across state boundaries. This within-state transfer advantage survives a control for temporal proximity and modestly exceeds the advantage recovered by a naive partition into contiguous states of equal size. Although the states are estimated solely from model weights, they correlate more strongly with shifts in the data's class distribution than with the weight-space geometry used to estimate them. After class divergence and lag are residualized out, the within-state advantage exceeds its permutation null on both tasks, indicating that the states recover structure relevant to transfer beyond the data distribution. Every effect replicates on both tasks but is attenuated on Yelp, whose label distribution is more temporally stable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以从在时间漂移数据流上训练的模型权重中恢复离散的隐状态（latent states）。作者在 Fakeddit 多模态 misinformation 检测和 Yelp 情感分析两个领域，按连续时间窗口训练分类器，并对对齐后的权重轨迹拟合隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），得到将时间线划分为连贯阶段的潜在状态。结果显示，分类器对与训练窗口共享状态的窗口数据泛化更好，这一优势在控制时间邻近性后依然存在，并略高于等大小连续划分的基线；状态与数据类别分布的变化相关性更强，且在残差化后仍超过置换零假设。
Motivation: 时间漂移的数据流可能以离散状态（regimes）方式变化而非连续变化，现有工作很少考察这类状态能否从模型权重中恢复；理解这一点有助于借助训练后的模型权重刻画数据分布的结构变化。
Method: 在连续时间窗口上训练分类器，将权重对齐后按时间顺序构成轨迹，对该轨迹拟合隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），从而估计潜在的离散状态；随后用状态划分时间线，并比较窗口内与跨状态的迁移性能，同时做控制时间邻近性、等大小连续划分、类别分布残差化和置换检验。
Result: 在两个数据集（Fakeddit 和 Yelp）上，分类器对与训练窗口共享状态的窗口数据泛化更好；该优势在控制时间邻近性后仍存在，并适度超过等大小连续划分；状态与数据类别分布的变化相关性强于与权重空间几何的相关性；在残差化类别差异和滞后后，窗口内优势仍超过置换零假设。
Conclusion: 结果表明模型权重中可恢复出与数据分布变化相关的隐状态结构，且这种结构对迁移有额外解释力；两个任务上效果都复现，但在标签分布更稳定的 Yelp 上效应减弱。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Schreier-Coset Graph Rewiring
papers.abstract_en: The information flow in the graph neural networks (GNNs) is fundamentally constrained by over-squashing, where structural bottlenecks impede long range information propagation. Graph-rewiring methods, which modify graph topology, have been extensively used to alleviate this. However, existing approaches often introduce prohibitive structural and computational bottlenecks, fail to preserve the critical properties of original graphs, and increase the edge counts massively. We introduce a novel method Schreier-Coset Graph Rewiring , a group-theoretic rewiring method that augments the input graph with a Schreier-Coset graph derived from a special linear group. Our method provides theoretical guarantees, a graph that exhibits spectral gap and a bounded effective resistance, creating a low-resistance bypass for long-range communication. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that SCGR reduces effective resistance by 5-40% across various learning tasks, effectively mitigating connectivity bottlenecks while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Schreier-Coset Graph Rewiring (SCGR)，一种基于群论的图重连方法，用于缓解图神经网络中的 over-squashing 问题。该方法用特殊线性群构造的 Schreier-Coset 图对输入图进行增广，并在理论上保证谱间隙 (spectral gap) 和有界有效电阻 (effective resistance)，从而为长距离信息传播提供低阻旁路。实验显示 SCGR 在多种学习任务上将有效电阻降低 5-40%，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
Motivation: GNN 的信息流受 over-squashing 限制，结构瓶颈阻碍长距离信息传播；现有图重连方法常引入严重的结构与计算瓶颈，无法保留原始图的关键性质，并会大幅增加边数。
Method: 提出一种群论重连方法 SCGR，将输入图与由特殊线性群导出的 Schreier-Coset 图结合，构造低有效电阻的旁路以支持长距离通信，并提供相应的理论保证。
Result: 摘要报告在多种学习任务上有效电阻降低 5-40%，缓解连通性瓶颈的同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
Conclusion: SCGR 通过群论构造的增广图同时获得谱间隙和有界有效电阻的理论保证，被作者视为缓解 GNN 长距离传播瓶颈的有效重连方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Entropy-Smooth Convex Optimization Cannot Be Accelerated
papers.abstract_en: We prove an $Ω(L/T)$ lower bound for the convergence rate of minimization in the class of functions that are convex and $L$-smooth relative to negative entropy on the standard $d$-simplex, valid for every first-order method when $d = Ω(T^2)$. In particular, this shows that mirror descent is optimal up to a logarithmic factor in this class. This may be surprising due to the fact that accelerated methods are readily available under the assumption of smoothness in $\ell_1$-norm. While Dragomir et al. (Mathematical Programming, 2022) have already showed that acceleration might be impossible under relative smoothness, their prox-function is pathological and constructed together with the hard instance. In contrast, we show non-acceleration for a specific prox-function with particularly favorable structure. We also extend the result to the quantum setting, proving the same lower bound in the class of functions $L$-smooth relative to negative von Neumann entropy on the spectrahedron of $d \times d$ Hermitian positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了一类关于负熵相对光滑（L-smooth relative to negative entropy）的凸函数在标准 d-单纯形上的最小化下界为 $\Omega(L/T)$，对任意一阶方法在 $d = \Omega(T^2)$ 时成立。这使得镜像下降（mirror descent）在该函数类中在 log 因子意义下达到最优。作者强调此前 Dragomir 等人的反例使用了病态构造的 prox-function，而本文针对结构良好的负熵证明加速不可能。结果还扩展到量子设定，即相对于负 von Neumann 熵的光滑函数类。
Motivation: 在 $\ell_1$-范数光滑性假设下加速方法很容易得到，但相对光滑性（relative smoothness）下加速是否可能并不清楚；已有的不可加速反例依赖人为构造的病态 prox-function。本文要检验的是：对于结构良好、自然的负熵 prox-function，加速是否仍然不可实现。
Method: 通过构造适用于所有一阶方法的困难实例，证明在标准单纯形上、相对于负熵光滑的凸函数类中收敛率下界为 $\Omega(L/T)$；并将该论证推广到量子设定，在 d×d 厄米正半定迹一矩阵的 spectrahedron 上，针对相对于负 von Neumann 熵光滑的函数类得到相同下界。
Result: 主要结果是 $\Omega(L/T)$ 的下界，表明此类问题不能被加速；同时说明镜像下降在该函数类中至多差一个对数因子即为最优。该结论对量子设定同样成立。
Conclusion: 即使在 prox-function 具有特别有利结构的情况下，相对光滑凸优化的加速仍然不可能；镜像下降在负熵相对光滑的函数类中接近最优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OneShot: Index-in-Ranking with Neural Scoring for Large-Scale Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: In modern recommendation systems, retrieval serves as a primary stage responsible for filtering billions of candidate items down to thousands prior to refined ranking. To make this massive search effective and efficient, the system relies on ranking accuracy and indexing efficiency. However, these two objectives are traditionally misaligned: while the former optimizes for the alignment between ranking predictions and user behavior, the latter optimizes for a structural grouping of item representations which enables fast search among billions of candidates. Thus, despite extensive efforts to scale up interaction modeling for retrieval, they remain fundamentally limited by the structural misalignment between the ranking objectives and the proximity-learned index. In this work, we address this long-standing dichotomy by proposing a new holistic retrieval framework, OneShot. It is an end-to-end, in-model index learning framework that natively aligns index learning with ranking objectives. Using this joint learning as a structural foundation, OneShot pushes the boundaries of retrieval expressiveness by scaling interaction modeling with neural scoring beyond the persistent dot-product bottleneck. OneShot is fully deployed in Instagram's industrial short-video recommendation system, driving significant wins in user daily sessions, engagement, and time-spent. Additionally, OneShot achieves a $20\%$ recall gain at the operational ranking volume and a 10x efficiency improvement at an equivalent recall level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OneShot，一个用于十亿级候选检索的端到端模型内索引学习框架 (in-model index learning)，将索引学习与排序目标原生对齐，并用神经打分 (neural scoring) 扩展交互建模能力以突破点积瓶颈。该方法已全面部署在 Instagram 工业短视频推荐系统中，摘要报告称在运营排序规模下召回率提升 20%，同等召回水平下效率提升 10 倍。
Motivation: 传统推荐系统中检索阶段同时依赖排序准确性与索引效率，但这两个目标在结构上错位：排序目标优化预测与用户行为的对齐，而索引目标优化表征的结构化分组以支持快速搜索，这种错位限制了大规模检索的扩展。
Method: 提出 OneShot，一种端到端、模型内的索引学习框架，原生地将索引学习与排序目标联合建模；并以该联合学习为结构基础，利用神经打分替代点积方式进行交互建模，从而扩大检索的表示表达能力。
Result: 摘要报告 OneShot 已在 Instagram 工业推荐系统完整上线，带来用户日均会话、参与度和使用时长的显著提升；同时实现运营排序规模下 20% 的召回率提升，以及在同等召回水平下 10 倍的效率提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过在模型内将索引学习与排序目标对齐并摆脱点积瓶颈，可以同时提升大规模检索的准确性与效率，工业部署结果支撑了该方法的实际有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IGME: Efficient Chained Method Ensemble for Transferable Semantic Segmentation Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation models are vulnerable to transferable adversarial perturbations, yet evaluating transfer attacks on dense prediction models can be computationally expensive. Existing ensemble attacks often rely on multiple surrogate models, increasing the computation cost, even harder for segmentation. This paper studies an efficient single-source alternative for transferable attacks on semantic segmentation. We formulate transferable attack composition as a chained computation over differentiable attack components, allowing the expensive source-model gradient computation to be shared. To reduce the update instability introduced by chained composition, we further use an integrated-gradient-style path-averaged direction as an empirical stabilization heuristic. Experiments on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes evaluate the resulting transferability efficiency trade-off across CNN- and transformer-based segmentation models. IGME achieves competitive transferability compared with single-source baselines and favorable runtime compared with model-ensemble attacks, while requiring access to only one source model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语义分割模型的可迁移对抗攻击，提出一种高效的单源模型替代方案，名为 IGME（Efficient Chained Method Ensemble）。作者将可迁移攻击的组成形式化为可微攻击组件的链式计算，使昂贵的源模型梯度计算得以共享，并用积分梯度式路径平均方向作为稳定化启发式。实验在 Pascal VOC 和 Cityscapes 上评估 CNN 与 Transformer 分割模型，结果表明 IGME 在仅需一个源模型的情况下，能达到与单源基线相当的迁移性，并比模型集成攻击有更优的运行时间。
Motivation: 语义分割模型易受可迁移对抗扰动影响，但评估密集预测模型上的迁移攻击计算开销很大。现有集成攻击通常依赖多个代理模型，进一步增加计算成本，尤其对分割更难；本文目标是探索高效的单源替代方案。
Method: 将可迁移攻击组合表述为可微攻击组件上的链式计算，从而共享昂贵的源模型梯度计算；为缓解链式组合引入的更新不稳定性，采用类似积分梯度（integrated-gradient-style）的路径平均方向作为经验性稳定化策略。
Result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 Cityscapes 上针对 CNN 与 Transformer 分割模型的实验显示，IGME 相比单源基线具有有竞争力的迁移性，相比模型集成攻击有更优运行时间，且仅需访问一个源模型。
Conclusion: IGME 表明通过链式组件组合与路径平均方向稳定化，可以在只使用单一源模型的情况下取得良好的迁移性-效率折中，为语义分割迁移攻击提供了更高效的单源方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FADEx: Feature Attribution and Distortion-based Explanation of Dimensionality Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) is a fundamental tool for high-dimensional data exploration, reducing the complexity of latent spaces of machine learning models, and assisting in the explanation of complex opaque models. However, non-linear DR techniques often function as opaque transformations themselves, making it challenging to understand how individual features influence instance positioning in the reduced space. This lack of transparency complicates the analysis and interpretation of structural patterns, hindering the ability to reason about the organization of high-dimensional data based on the projected layout. In order to address this challenge, dimensionality reduction explanation methods have shown promise in improving the understanding of the observed groups and cluster structures. Unfortunately, existing DR explanation approaches tend to suffer from limitations such as multiple attributions per feature and restricted applicability to specific dimensionality reduction methods, which hinder their use. In this work, we propose FADEx, a novel local per-instance feature attribution method that leverages local linear approximation via first-order Taylor expansion and Singular Value Decomposition to provide explanations. FADEx computes the local linear models via weighted least squares, eliminating the need for out-of-sample data mapping, making it agnostic to the DR method, while simultaneously providing local feature attributions and distortion analysis. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations, comparisons with existing methods, and case studies, we demonstrate FADEx's effectiveness and versatility in providing explanations and analytical resources for analyzing the behavior of DR methods. The results indicate FADEx yields robust and reliable explanations, outperforming existing approaches in several aspects.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 17 figures, to be published in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FADEx，一种针对降维 (Dimensionality Reduction) 的局部逐实例特征归因 (local per-instance feature attribution) 解释方法。该方法通过一阶泰勒展开和奇异值分解 (Singular Value Decomposition) 做局部线性近似，并用加权最小二乘计算局部线性模型，从而无需样本外数据映射即可对任意降维方法给出解释。论文通过定性、定量评估、方法对比和案例研究展示其有效性。
Motivation: 非线性降维方法本身往往如同黑盒，难以理解单个特征如何影响实例在降维空间中的位置，现有降维解释方法存在每个特征产生多重归因以及仅适用于特定降维方法的局限。
Method: FADEx 利用一阶泰勒展开和奇异值分解对每个实例的降维映射做局部线性近似，通过加权最小二乘拟合局部线性模型，避免依赖样本外数据映射，因此与具体降维方法无关，同时输出局部特征归因与失真分析 (distortion analysis)。
Result: 摘要报告，通过定性/定量评估、与现有方法对比及案例研究，FADEx 能提供稳健可靠的解释，并在多个方面优于现有降维解释方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FADEx 为分析降维方法行为提供了有效且通用的解释与分析资源，但其局限和具体数值结果未在摘要中说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VAmoS Bench: Voice Agent Simulation Bench
papers.abstract_en: Production voice agents span cascaded, speech-to-speech, and hybrid architectures. Voice-agent benchmarks typically measure component quality and conversational properties such as word error rate, latency, naturalness, and turn-taking. Fewer measure whether the agent handled a phone call correctly on its own. Contact centers refer to this as ``containment'': the share of phone calls the automated system resolves without handing off to a human. On some phone calls the right outcome is refusal or a redirect. To address this gap, we introduce VAmoS Bench, the Voice Agent Simulation Bench. It measures complete voice-agent systems end to end in a stateful customer-support task. The agent is Riley, a credit-card support representative for a fictional bank who can freeze, cancel, replace, or activate a card. Each of 100 scenarios supplies a simulated caller with a private goal and a seeded PostgreSQL backend. The platform uses each scenario to populate and activate an isolated simulation in which the caller reaches Riley over audio; roughly one-third apply adversarial pressure. The agent can use five tools that execute real SQL against the backend. Each scenario also defines binary assertions. A grader evaluates them against the complete trace of what the caller and agent said and what the agent did, including tool invocations, arguments, and returned rows. This catches an agent that claims to have changed a card without updating the database, as well as one that makes the right database change while disclosing protected information. This first benchmark version focuses on financial services. Its evaluation protocol supports an evolving leaderboard: additional voice agents can be evaluated on the same version, while later versions can expand the tasks and scenarios.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/riley-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VAmoS Bench（Voice Agent Simulation Bench），一个面向完整语音智能体系统的端到端评测基准，聚焦有状态的客户支持任务。评测对象是名为 Riley 的信用卡客服智能体，平台通过 100 个场景为每个场景生成带有私有目标和预置 PostgreSQL 后端的模拟来电者，并对整个对话与工具调用轨迹进行二进制断言评判。
Motivation: 现有语音智能体基准多衡量组件质量与对话属性（如词错误率、延迟、自然度、话轮转换），很少评估智能体是否独立正确处理了整通电话，即联络中心所称的 containment（无需转接人工即可解决的电话比例），且部分电话的正确结果是拒办或转介。
Method: VAmoS Bench 以模拟方式构建有状态客服任务：Riley 可冻结、取消、补发或激活信用卡，智能体可通过五个工具对后端执行真实 SQL。每个场景定义二进制断言，由评分器基于来电者与智能体的完整对话轨迹以及工具调用、参数和返回行进行评判，从而能捕获声称改卡但未更新数据库、或正确改库但泄露受保护信息等失败。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；当前第一个基准版本聚焦金融服务业，其评估协议支持同一版本上评测更多语音智能体，后续版本可扩展任务与场景。
Conclusion: 该基准以端到端方式衡量完整语音智能体系统在实际任务中的正确性，而不仅是组件质量；当前版本限定于金融服务场景，并设计了可持续演进的排行榜协议。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；当前第一个基准版本聚焦金融服务业，其评估协议支持同一版本上评测更多语音智能体，后续版本可扩展任务与场景。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该基准以端到端方式衡量完整语音智能体系统在实际任务中的正确性，而不仅是组件质量；当前版本限定于金融服务场景，并设计了可持续演进的排行榜协议。

papers.title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Channel Modeling in Low-SNR Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Accurate multipath parameter estimation is critical for modern wireless communication systems, particularly in challenging low-SNR environments. Traditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation algorithms, such as CLEAN, provide high-resolution parameter extraction but suffer from prohibitive computational complexity due to exhaustive grid search. Conversely, purely data-driven deep learning approaches lack physical grounding and struggle to generalize across variable multipath densities and off-grid parameters. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), a hybrid framework that embeds a multi-head residual network directly into the iterative CLEAN extraction loop. By replacing the exhaustive grid search with rapid, parallelizable forward passes while delegating residual subtraction to exact mathematical models, NN-CLEAN isolates physical multipath parameters without accumulating non- physical errors. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that NN-CLEAN achieves estimation accuracy exceeding 96% at 5 dB SNR, matching the traditional Grid-Search CLEAN (GS- CLEAN) baseline, while providing a massive reduction in computational complexity and substantially outperforming subspace methods and standalone one-shot neural networks. Crucially, NN-CLEAN exhibits a near-flat scaling in execution runtime and memory consumption as batch sizes increase. This highly efficient parallelization establishes NN-CLEAN as a robust, real- time solution for channel estimation in MIMO systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NN-CLEAN，一种将多头部残差网络嵌入迭代 CLEAN 提取循环的混合信道建模框架，用于低信噪比环境下的多径参数估计。该方法用可并行化的前向传播替代传统 CLEAN 的穷举网格搜索，同时保留数学模型的残差相减，避免累积非物理误差。蒙特卡洛仿真显示，在 5 dB SNR 下估计精度超过 96%，匹配传统 Grid-Search CLEAN 基线，同时大幅降低计算复杂度，并显著优于子空间方法和单次前向神经网络。
Motivation: 传统最大似然类算法（如 CLEAN）在低 SNR 下能提供高分辨率多径参数提取，但穷举网格搜索导致计算复杂度过高；而纯数据驱动的深度学习方法缺乏物理基础，难以泛化到可变多径密度和栅格外参数。
Method: 提出混合框架 NN-CLEAN，将多头部残差网络直接嵌入迭代 CLEAN 循环，用快速且可并行化的前向传播替代穷举网格搜索，并将残差相减交给精确数学模型执行，从而在分离物理多径参数的同时避免累积非物理误差。
Result: 蒙特卡洛仿真表明，NN-CLEAN 在 5 dB SNR 下估计精度超过 96%，与 Grid-Search CLEAN 基线相当；计算复杂度大幅降低，性能明显优于子空间方法和单次神经网络；且随着批大小增加，执行时间和内存消耗呈近乎平坦的扩展。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 NN-CLEAN 的高效并行化使其成为 MIMO 系统中鲁棒、实时的信道估计方案。

papers.title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model~(LLM)-based agents have demonstrated exceptional performance across a wide range of complex interactive tasks. However, they often struggle with long-horizon interactive tasks common in domains, such as embodied AI. The complexity and vast action spaces in these settings lead to compounding errors, where a single suboptimal action can derail an entire trajectory, causing the agent to exhaust its limited step budget on inefficient or unrecoverable paths. To overcome this without costly fine-tuning, we draw inspiration from software debugging, where execution logs are analyzed to preemptively catch errors. We propose \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}, a novel framework that acts as a ``copilot'' for LLM agents by diagnosing potential action errors before they are executed. At its core,\textit{Graph Debugger} models historical trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a Graph Neural Network to identify sequential action patterns that frequently lead to failure. Functioning as a proactive diagnostic sandbox, our method provides early warnings on potentially flawed actions, prompting the agent to self-correct. This pre-action error diagnosis prevents costly mistakes, significantly enhancing the agent's ability to complete long-horizon tasks successfully. The extensive experiments on four benchmarks with three LLM agents demonstrate a $14.69\%$ pass ratio improvement on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trajectory Graph Copilot，一个用于 LLM 智能体（agent）的预执行错误诊断框架。其核心组件 Graph Debugger 将历史轨迹建模为概率图，并借助图神经网络（GNN）识别经常导致失败的序列动作模式，在动作真正执行前发出早期警告，促使智能体自我纠正。在四个基准与三个 LLM 智能体上的实验显示 pass ratio 平均提升 14.69%。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在长时程交互任务中容易因单个次优动作产生复合错误（compounding errors），使整条轨迹偏离并在有限步数预算内耗尽于低效或不可恢复的路径；由于微调成本高，需要一种不依赖昂贵微调的预执行错误诊断手段。
Method: 提出 Trajectory Graph Copilot 框架，以 Graph Debugger 为核心，将历史轨迹建模为概率图，并用 GNN 学习高频导致失败的动作序列模式；该方法充当主动式诊断沙箱，在动作执行前提供早期警告，引导智能体进行自我纠正。
Result: 在四个基准上结合三个 LLM 智能体的实验中，pass ratio 平均提升 14.69%。
Conclusion: 预动作错误诊断（pre-action error diagnosis）可以在不进行昂贵微调的情况下避免代价高昂的失误，显著增强智能体完成长时程任务的能力。

papers.title: Comparison of a Parametric Physics-Informed Neural Network and a Tensorial Reduced-Order Model for the Shallow-Water Dam-Break Problem
papers.abstract_en: We develop two parametric data-driven reduced models: a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a non-intrusive tensorial reduced-order model (TROM), and apply both approaches to the parametrized one-dimensional shallow-water dam-break problem. Both reduced models do not require time integration and learn a direct solution map from space, time, and dam-break parameters to the physical state. We present a detailed comparison for out-of-sample and extrapolated parameter values. In addition, we demonstrate that it is essential to introduce shock-aware collocation to improve the robustness of the PINN model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对参数化一维浅水方程溃坝问题，开发了两种无需时间积分的参数化数据驱动降阶模型：物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 与非侵入式张量降阶模型 (TROM)，两者直接学习从空间、时间和溃坝参数到物理状态的映射。摘要报告了对样本外与外推参数值的详细比较，并指出引入激波感知配点 (shock-aware collocation) 对提升 PINN 鲁棒性是必要的。
Motivation: 参数化浅水溃坝问题需要快速且鲁棒的代理模型；现有方法可能依赖时间积分，且对激波等不连续解敏感，因此需要系统比较不同免时间积分降阶建模路线的表现。
Method: 构建参数化 PINN 与非侵入式张量降阶模型 (TROM)，二者均省略时间积分，直接学习从空间、时间和参数到状态的解映射；对 PINN 引入激波感知配点以增强对非光滑解的鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但对样本外 (out-of-sample) 与外推参数值进行了详细对比，并发现激波感知配点对 PINN 的鲁棒性至关重要。
Conclusion: 作者强调针对含激波等非光滑解的参数化问题，需要激波感知配点来提升 PINN 模型鲁棒性；两类免时间积分降阶模型可视为该类问题的有效代理方案。

papers.title: SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized MeanFlow loss that is used for the remainder of pretraining and for rectification-based post-training. In protein backbone generation, SE(3)-MeanFlow matches or exceeds flow-matching baselines that use several times more sampling steps, and its advantage widens in the few-step regime, where rectification lets it lead at every matched budget - at a modest cost in diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SE(3)-MeanFlow，一个面向蛋白质骨架生成的小步数 (few-step) 生成框架，将 MeanFlow 从欧氏空间扩展到蛋白 frame 的李群几何。作者在 so(3) 李代数与 R^3 上推导旋转和平移的平均速度闭式恒等式，得到免模拟 (simulation-free) 的训练目标，并引入 SE(3) alpha-Flow 目标作为 warm-up 阶段。实验表明，在蛋白质骨架生成中，该方法以更少的采样步数达到或超过流匹配基线，且在小步数区间优势更明显，但以一定的多样性下降为代价。
Motivation: 现有 diffusion 和 flow-matching 模型在 SE(3)^N 上生成高质量蛋白质骨架，但推理需要对 ODE 进行数百次网络求值，每次求值都涉及李群指数映射，成为高通量设计流程的计算瓶颈。
Method: 将 MeanFlow 推广到蛋白帧的李群几何，直接在 so(3) 李代数和 R^3 中推导旋转与平移的平均速度闭式恒等式，从而获得免模拟训练目标；随后引入 SE(3) alpha-Flow 目标来去除旋转分支中的 Jacobian-vector product 并作为 warm-up，再切换到 small-t 稳定的 MeanFlow 损失用于后续预训练和基于 rectification 的后训练。
Result: 摘要报告 SE(3)-MeanFlow 在蛋白质骨架生成上匹配或超过使用数倍采样步数的流匹配基线；在小步数区间优势扩大，rectification 使其在每个相同预算下都领先，代价是多样性略有下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过闭式平均速度恒等式与 rectification 后训练，可以在 SE(3) 李群结构上实现小步数生成，同时指出多样性上的适度损失是该方法的权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking Artificial Intelligence in Medical Imaging: Assumptions, Reality, and Reframing
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging has served as primary proving ground for clinical artificial intelligence (AI), yet a decade of intense research has not translated into proportionate bedside impact. We argue that this gap is not primarily a product of insufficient algorithmic performance, inadequate regulation, or limited explainability. Rather, it reflects a structural misalignment, between how AI systems are designed and evaluated, and how clinical decisions are made. This Perspective identifies six interconnected dimensions of this misalignment: the dominance of pixel-only models in a multimodal clinical world; the erosion of physician trust through opaque and inflexible systems; the unfulfilled promise of foundation models in data-sparse medical domains; the persistent bottleneck of non-shareable, under-curated datasets; the gap between validated algorithms and deployable clinical platforms; and the failure of prediction-centric AI to generate actionable clinical guidance. For each dimension, we reframe the problem and propose a path forward, culminating in a vision of agentic, physician-aligned AI that extends, rather than replaces, clinical judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇Perspective性质的文章，认为医学影像AI经过十年密集研究却未带来相应的临床落地影响，且这一落差的主要原因并非算法性能、监管或可解释性不足，而是AI系统设计评估方式与临床决策方式之间的结构性错位。作者梳理了六个相互关联的错位维度，包括像素-only模型vs多模态临床世界、医生信任侵蚀、基础模型在数据稀疏医学领域未能兑现承诺、数据集不可共享且缺乏整理、算法验证与临床平台部署之间的鸿沟，以及预测中心式AI缺乏可操作临床指导。针对每个维度，文章重新框定问题并提出前进路径，最终展望一种与医生对齐的智能体式(agentic)AI，扩展而非取代临床判断。
Motivation: 医学影像虽是临床AI的主要试验场，但研究热度并未转化为相应比例的实际临床影响；作者认为这一差距的根源在于AI系统如何被设计与评估同临床决策方式存在结构性错位，而非单纯的技术或监管问题。
Method: 文章提出一个概念框架，识别六个相互关联的错位维度，逐一重构问题并给出未来方向，最终落到一种agentic、与医生对齐的AI愿景，强调AI应延伸临床判断而不是替代它。
Result: 本文没有报告实证实验结果，核心主张是临床影响不足主要源于结构性错位，并给出六个维度的诊断性分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要从算法中心转向临床对齐的视角，发展agentic且与医生对齐的AI系统，以真正弥合医学影像AI研究与床旁应用之间的差距。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文是一篇Perspective性质的文章，认为医学影像AI经过十年密集研究却未带来相应的临床落地影响，且这一落差的主要原因并非算法性能、监管或可解释性不足，而是AI系统设计评估方式与临床决策方式之间的结构性错位。作者梳理了六个相互关联的错位维度，包括像素-only模型vs多模态临床世界、医生信任侵蚀、基础模型在数据稀疏医学领域未能兑现承诺、数据集不可共享且缺乏整理、算法验证与临床平台部署之间的鸿沟，以及预测中心式AI缺乏可操作临床指导。针对每个维度，文章重新框定问题并提出前进路径，最终展望一种与医生对齐的智能体式(agentic)AI，扩展而非取代临床判断。
summary_sections.motivation: 医学影像虽是临床AI的主要试验场，但研究热度并未转化为相应比例的实际临床影响；作者认为这一差距的根源在于AI系统如何被设计与评估同临床决策方式存在结构性错位，而非单纯的技术或监管问题。
summary_sections.method: 文章提出一个概念框架，识别六个相互关联的错位维度，逐一重构问题并给出未来方向，最终落到一种agentic、与医生对齐的AI愿景，强调AI应延伸临床判断而不是替代它。

papers.title: Adaptive Nyström for Gaussian Process Regression
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) is a robust framework for uncertainty quantification, yet its $O(n^3)$ complexity limits its scalability. Low-rank Nyström approximations can reduce this burden to $O(nm^2)$, but their accuracy depends heavily on the selection of landmark points. We propose an adaptive Nyström approach that greedily selects landmarks to minimize the trace residual of the kernel approximation error. Unlike static approximations, our method interleaves landmark expansion with hyperparameter optimization, allowing the selection process to adapt as the covariance structure is refined. Numerical experiments on five benchmark functions demonstrate that this method significantly outperforms random landmark selection in both accuracy and stability. It achieves predictive performance comparable to exact GP inference while maintaining linear scaling with respect to the sample size, providing a principled and efficient framework for large-scale computer experiments.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted by 2026 Winter Simulation Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程回归（Gaussian Process Regression, GPR）中 O(n^3) 的计算瓶颈，提出一种自适应 Nyström 近似方法，通过贪心选取 landmark 点以最小化核近似误差的迹残差。与静态近似不同，该方法将 landmark 扩展与超参数优化交错进行，使选点过程随协方差结构细化而自适应。数值实验在五个基准函数上显示，该方法显著优于随机 landmark 选取，在准确性和稳定性上均有提升，并能在保持线性扩展的同时达到接近精确 GP 推断的预测性能。
Motivation: 标准 GPR 的 O(n^3) 复杂度限制了其在大规模数据集上的可扩展性；低秩 Nyström 近似虽可将复杂度降至 O(nm^2)，但其精度高度依赖于 landmark 点的选取，而静态选择方法无法随协方差结构的优化而调整。
Method: 提出自适应 Nyström 方法，贪心地选择 landmark 点以最小化核近似误差的迹残差；将 landmark 扩展与超参数优化交织进行，使选点过程随协方差结构细化而动态适应。
Result: 在五个基准函数上的数值实验表明，该方法显著优于随机 landmark 选取，在准确性和稳定性上均有明显改善，达到了与精确 GP 推断相当的预测性能，同时保持关于样本量的线性扩展。
Conclusion: 该方法为大规模计算机实验提供了原则性且高效的高斯过程回归框架；摘要未提及对降水或气象领域的具体应用。

papers.title: Good Rankers, Bad Objectives: Bilinear Contrastive Critics under Expressive Policy Search
papers.abstract_en: Good action rankings do not make a contrastive critic safe to maximize. These critics increasingly act as value-like objectives for best-of-$K$ selection, planning, and critic-guided generation. Unbounded bilinear scores can let large embedding norms inflate off-support values, but cosine bounding does not remove the failure. A controlled support decomposition attributes most raw bilinear regret to norm drift. Cosine and hybrid critics nevertheless select off-support actions from most pools and incur comparable regret. Contrastive scores are weakly calibrated or inverted in the top score decile across four OGBench navigation tasks, and they fail to order fixed-query actions by value. Bellman-trained TD-Q succeeds, including in a parameter-matched function-class control. Realized costs depend on the task: simulator rollouts reveal single-step selection costs on PointMaze and the exact-$Q^*$ toy but well-powered nulls on AntMaze and HumanoidMaze, where the controller can self-correct. A training/readout decomposition traces the lost ordering to the cosine training objective; raw-trained embeddings retain weak ordering after inference-time normalization. Candidate maximization can therefore exploit false positives caused by norm drift, score saturation, or in-support misranking. Contrastive critics remain useful compatibility rankers on navigation and manipulation tasks, but action selection requires a value-calibrated scalar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对比性评论器 (contrastive critic) 被当作类价值目标用于 best-of-K 选择、规划与评论器引导生成时的安全性问题。作者发现，即使动作排序良好，直接最大化这些分数仍不可靠：无界双线性分数会因嵌入范数漂移抬高支持集外的值，而余弦约束并不能消除失败。在 OGBench 导航任务上，对比分数在最高分十分位内弱校准甚至倒置，而 Bellman 训练的 TD-Q 则表现成功。最终结论是此类评论器仍是有效的兼容性排序器，但动作选择需要值校准的标量。
Motivation: 对比性评论器越来越多地被用作价值般的优化目标，但好的排序并不保证目标函数可安全最大化，因此需要系统考察其失效模式与代价。
Method: 通过受控的支持集分解 (support decomposition) 将原始双线性遗憾归因于范数漂移，并比较余弦与混合评论器；还使用训练/读出分解来追溯排序丢失与余弦训练目标的关系，并在参数匹配的函数类控制下进行模拟器 rollout 评估。
Result: 无界双线性分数因范数漂移抬高 off-support 值，但余弦约束无法消除失败；余弦与混合评论器仍从多数池中选中 off-support 动作且遗憾相当。在四个 OGBench 导航任务中，对比分数在最高十分位内弱校准或倒置，无法按价值排序固定查询动作，而 TD-Q 成功；PointMaze 与 exact-Q* toy 出现单步选择代价，AntMaze 与 HumanoidMaze 因控制器可自我纠错而呈无效结果。
Conclusion: 候选最大化可利用范数漂移、分数饱和或支持集内误排序造成的假阳性；对比性评论器仍是导航与操作任务中有用的兼容性排序器，但动作选择必须依赖值校准的标量。

papers.title: Selecting Open-Weight Language Models for Zero-Shot Intent Classification: A Systematic Evaluation of 41 Models
papers.abstract_en: Intent classification is a core component of task-oriented dialogue systems, yet practitioners have limited systematic guidance for selecting deployable open-weight language models under compute, latency, and robustness constraints. We present a systematic zero-shot evaluation of 41 open-weight language models spanning 15 families and the 135M--9B parameter range across eight English single-label intent-classification datasets. A ninth dataset, ATIS, uses five labeled demonstrations and is reported as an auxiliary five-shot result. The evaluation includes standard benchmarks, a large-scale voice-assistant corpus, and production-derived e-commerce datasets. Beyond exact-match accuracy, we analyze confidence calibration, robustness to realistic input perturbations, statistical reliability of model rankings, deployment efficiency, and benchmark saturation. Our results show that instruction-tuned 3B models can outperform several evaluated 7B base models, that differences among leading models on MASSIVE are statistically indistinguishable under pairwise McNemar tests, and that widely used benchmarks such as SNIPS have become saturated and no longer meaningfully discriminate among current open-weight models. Instruction tuning's effect on confidence calibration is inconsistent rather than uniformly harmful. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting and evaluating open-weight language models for intent classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了41个开源权重语言模型（open-weight language models）在零样本意图分类任务上的表现，覆盖15个模型家族、135M到9B参数范围，以及8个英文单标签意图分类数据集，并附加ATIS数据集的五样本结果。评估除了精确匹配准确率外，还分析了置信度校准、输入扰动鲁棒性、模型排名的统计可靠性、部署效率和基准饱和度。
Motivation: 实际部署任务型对话系统时，从业者在计算、延迟和鲁棒性约束下缺乏系统性的开源权重语言模型选择指南，现有研究没有为零样本意图分类提供跨模型家族的充分比较。
Method: 对41个开源权重语言模型进行零样本评估，覆盖15个模型家族和135M–9B参数范围；使用8个英文单标签意图分类数据集，另将ATIS作为带五个标注演示的辅助五样本结果；评估包括标准基准、大规模语音助手语料库和生产来源的电商数据集，并分析精确匹配准确率之外的多个维度。
Result: 结果显示指令微调的3B模型可以超越部分被评估的7B基础模型；在MASSIVE上领先模型之间的差异在成对McNemar检验下统计上不可区分；SNIPS等广泛使用的基准已饱和，不再能有效区分当前开源权重模型；指令微调对置信度校准的影响不一致，而非普遍有害。
Conclusion: 这些发现为选择用于意图分类的开源权重语言模型提供了实际指导，同时指出部分既有基准已不足以反映当前模型的能力差异。

papers.title: Dimensionality and Measurement Precision in HLE's Multiple-Choice Subset
papers.abstract_en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is widely used to evaluate frontier language models. HLE organizes its questions into eight subject-domain categories, whose subscores are often interpreted as evidence of distinct capabilities. However, no study has assessed whether these labels correspond to empirically separable latent constructs, nor whether the benchmark effectively differentiates between models of similar ability. We evaluate 29 LLMs on the text-only multiple-choice subset of HLE ($J = 428$ items) and apply psychometric methods to assess both the dimensionality of the benchmark and the distribution of its measurement precision. Fitting a two-parameter logistic IRT model, we find convergent evidence that HLE measures a single general reasoning factor: McDonald's $ω_h = 0.998$, domain labels explain only 3.5\% of item response variance, within- and between-domain residual correlations are nearly identical (Cohen's $d = 0.016$), and domain-specific ability estimates are near-redundant with the total score ($r \geq 0.81$). A separate analysis of the test information function reveals that measurement precision concentrates at moderate ability levels and drops sharply above $θ= 0$, where frontier models sit. These findings suggest that HLE's domain subscores do not warrant distinct capability interpretations and that the benchmark's ability to discriminate among the strongest models is limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) 的文本单选题子集进行了心理测量学分析，用 29 个 LLM 在 428 个题目上的作答拟合两参数逻辑斯蒂 IRT 模型。结果显示 HLE 主要测量单一的一般推理因子（McDonald's ω_h = 0.998），领域标签只解释 3.5% 的项目反应方差，领域子分数与总分近乎冗余（r ≥ 0.81）。测量精度集中在中等能力区间，并在 θ > 0 处急剧下降，而前沿模型恰好位于该区间，说明 HLE 对最强模型的区分能力有限。
Motivation: HLE 被广泛用于评估前沿语言模型，其八个学科领域子分数常被解释为不同能力的证据；但尚无研究检验这些标签是否对应经验上可分离的潜在构念，也没有评估该基准能否有效区分能力相近的模型。
Method: 在 HLE 文本单选题子集（J = 428 题）上评估 29 个 LLM，采用两参数逻辑斯蒂 IRT 模型（two-parameter logistic IRT）检验基准的维度结构，并通过测验信息函数（test information function）分析测量精度的能力分布。
Result: 多种证据一致表明 HLE 测量单一通用推理因子：McDonald's ω_h = 0.998，领域标签仅解释 3.5% 的项目反应方差，领域内外残差相关几乎相同（Cohen's d = 0.016），领域特异能力估计与总分高度冗余（r ≥ 0.81）；测量精度集中于中等能力水平，在 θ > 0 处快速下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为 HLE 的领域子分数不应当被赋予独立能力解读，且该基准在最强模型之间的区分能力有限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Context-Informed Ship Trajectory Prediction via Conditional Attention
papers.abstract_en: Long-term ship trajectory prediction is a fundamental capability for maritime safety and autonomous navigation. While recent Transformer-based architectures have improved forecasting horizons, they predominantly rely on historical kinematic states, treating vessel motion as an isolated system. In reality, maritime navigation is profoundly modulated by extrinsic factors like weather and constrained by static vessel characteristics. Existing multimodal approaches fundamentally model the joint distribution over states and contexts, treating environmental variables as peer features rather than encoding the directional physical dependence of vessel dynamics on environmental conditions. In this work, we propose the Conditional Informer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that formulates trajectory prediction as a conditional generation task. We employ a dedicated Conditional Attention mechanism where the vessel state explicitly queries environmental contexts through cross-attention, encoding the physical prior that weather modulates - but is not generated by - vessel dynamics. Furthermore, to address the intermittency of real-world data, we introduce a Modality Masking training strategy to prevent catastrophic degradation during sensor fallback. Extensive experiments on AIS and ERA5 data demonstrate that our approach outperforms kinematic and concatenation-based baselines by 15.4% in prediction accuracy when context is available. Crucially, Modality Masking prevents shortcut learning, reducing fallback error by nearly an order of magnitude compared to unconstrained models.

papers.title: Bridging Inference-Time Scaling and Episodic Memory with Action-Centric Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in inference-time scaling have significantly unlocked the complex reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models~(LLMs). However, for agents, these approaches suffer from a critical inefficiency, operating in a stateless manner and engaging in redundant search processes. Existing memory mechanisms largely rely on the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, leading to prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, \textit{GAMER}~(Graph-based Action-centric Memory with Episodic Reasoning), that bridges the gap between inference scaling and episodic memory. Our approach models historical reasoning as a dynamic \textit{Action-Centric Graph}. By decoupling the memory mechanism from LLMs, our method can save token/money usage by providing less memory context than memory mechanism baselines. To extract knowledge from the graph effectively, we use a dual-stream Temporal Difference learning mechanism to estimate the positive~(suggestion) and negative~(avoidance) value of action nodes based on past successes and failures. During the inference phase, this learned value function optimizes decision-making bi-directionally, so that positive values provide action suggestions, while negative values indicate high-risk actions. By performing efficient searches on the graph, our method significantly improves the efficiency of inference scaling. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that \textit{GAMER} achieves superior performance by \textbf{20.81\%/6.17\%} for success/progress rate compared to vanilla baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAMER（Graph-based Action-centric Memory with Episodic Reasoning）框架，用动态的 Action-Centric Graph 建模智能体历史推理过程，将记忆机制与 LLM 解耦，以降低推理扩展（inference-time scaling）中的 token/成本开销。摘要报告在多个基准上相比 vanilla 基线，成功率提升 20.81%、进度率提升 6.17%。
Motivation: 现有 inference-time scaling 方法对智能体是无状态（stateless）的，会产生冗余搜索；已有记忆机制又过度依赖 LLM 自身推理能力，计算成本过高。
Method: 将历史推理建模为动态 Action-Centric Graph；采用双流时序差分学习（dual-stream Temporal Difference learning）估计动作节点的正（suggestion）与负（avoidance）价值；推理阶段用学到的价值函数双向优化决策，并在图上高效搜索。
Result: 在多个基准上，GAMER 相比 vanilla 基线在成功率上提升 20.81%、进度率上提升 6.17%，并且相比记忆机制基线能提供更少的记忆上下文，节省 token/资金。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将记忆机制与 LLM 解耦、基于图的价值学习可以显著提升 inference-time scaling 在智能体任务上的效率。

papers.title: SWE-NFI: Studying and Benchmarking Coding Agents for Non-Functional Improvements
papers.abstract_en: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements. In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on NFIs beyond functional correctness. Our benchmark contains 188 tasks constructed from real merged pull requests in open-source Python projects. We operationalize developer-oriented NFIs into 92 executable rules and develop a comprehensive evaluation suite that combines functional correctness testing with rule-based NFI evaluation. We evaluate state-of-the-art commercial and open-source coding agents. Although the best-performing agent achieves a 70.0\% functional correctness rate, all evaluated agents generally fall short of human developers in overall NFI capability. The gap is particularly evident for structural code improvements, where agents' NFI scores range from 0.0 to 1.3, compared with 1.5 for the human reference. Our benchmark and findings provide a reproducible foundation for evaluating and advancing coding agents beyond functional correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-NFI，一个用于评估编码智能体 (coding agents) 在功能正确性之外进行非功能改进 (non-functional improvements, NFIs) 能力的基准。基准包含从开源 Python 项目真实合并的 pull request 中构建的 188 个任务，将开发者导向的 NFI 操作化为 92 条可执行规则，并构建结合功能正确性测试与基于规则 NFI 评估的评测套件。对最先进商业和开源编码智能体的评估显示，最佳智能体功能正确率达 70.0%，但整体 NFI 能力普遍不及人类开发者，尤其在结构性代码改进上差距明显。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体基准主要评估功能正确性，对保持行为不变的非功能改进（如代码质量、结构性改进）支持有限，而真实软件开发中开发者会持续进行此类改进，因此这一能力尚未被充分探索与评估。
Method: 提出 SWE-NFI 基准：从开源 Python 项目真实合并的 pull request 构建 188 个任务，将开发者导向的 NFI 操作化为 92 条可执行规则，并设计结合功能正确性测试与规则式 NFI 评估的评测套件。
Result: 评估了最先进的商业和开源编码智能体；最佳智能体功能正确率达到 70.0%，但所有被评估智能体在整体 NFI 能力上普遍不如人类开发者。结构性代码改进的差距尤为明显：智能体的 NFI 分数在 0.0 到 1.3 之间，而人类参考分数为 1.5。
Conclusion: 该基准和发现为在功能正确性之外评估和推进编码智能体提供了可复现的基础。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Competence on Logical Inference over Probability Operators
papers.abstract_en: Both expressions of uncertainty and inferences are ubiquitous in natural language, and valid inferences over natural-language expressions of uncertainty are necessary for not only everyday conversations but also for high-stakes domains such as medicine and law. While large language models are increasingly evaluated on logical reasoning tasks, disentangling principled, symbolic reasoning from clever surface-level pattern matching is fraught with difficulty. We introduce a benchmark for reasoning over probability operators--inference over sentences with gradable epistemic modals (e.g., probably, might, must) containing 14,320 procedurally-generated English prompts across fifteen inference templates, systematically varying question form, negation strategy, and surface content. Evaluating 29 models, we find that most show answer biases independent of the logical form, a systematic preference for Yes or No. We summarize this with a competence floor: the worse of a model's accuracy on Yes-correct and No-correct items. Only 9 of 29 models exceed random chance. We also test variations in question form, verb phrases/activity, and both the gender and origin of names used in the prompts, finding biases across every axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估大语言模型在概率算符（probability operators）上逻辑推理能力的基准，涵盖带有可分级认识情态词（gradable epistemic modals，如 probably、might、must）的英文提示，共14,320个程序化生成的句子、15种推理模板，并系统变化问题形式、否定策略和表面内容。作者评估了29个模型，发现大多数模型存在与逻辑形式无关的回答偏见，即系统性偏向Yes或No；只有9个模型超过随机水平。进一步改变问题形式、动词短语/活动以及人名性别和来源时，每个维度都观察到偏见。
Motivation: 自然语言中同时普遍存在不确定性表达和推理，高 stakes 领域（如医学和法律）需要有效的推理能力，而大语言模型在逻辑推理评估中很难区分原则性的符号推理与表面模式匹配，因此需要一个专门针对概率算符推理的基准来揭示真实能力。
Method: 作者程序化生成14,320个英文提示，覆盖15种推理模板，系统操纵问题形式、否定策略和表面内容，并包含可分级认识情态词。在29个模型上评估，并引入competence floor（Yes-correct与No-correct条目的较差准确率）来总结模型的系统性回答偏见。
Result: 多数模型表现出独立于逻辑形式的系统性Yes/No偏好；29个模型中仅有9个超过随机水平。在问题形式、动词短语/活动、人名性别和来源等所有测试变体上均观察到偏见。
Conclusion: 该基准表明当前大语言模型在概率算符推理上能力薄弱，且普遍存在系统性回答偏差，说明模型可能依赖表面线索而非逻辑形式进行推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ECG-InterpBench: Benchmarking the Interpretability of ECG Foundation Models with Matched-Scale Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Existing benchmarks for electrocardiogram foundation models primarily evaluate downstream predictive performance, providing limited insight into whether their internal representations can be faithfully decomposed, clinically interpreted, or reproduced across independent analyses. We introduce ECG-InterpBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the interpretability of ECG foundation-model representations. ECG-InterpBench uses sparse autoencoders as standardized measurement instruments and matches their capacity across models to enable controlled comparisons. We evaluate six frozen ECG foundation models across five standardized encoder depths, five matched dictionary widths, and three random seeds, producing a 450-cell interpretability atlas comprising 75 exactly matched six-model comparison blocks. The benchmark evaluates complementary dimensions of representation interpretability, including sparse reconstruction fidelity, single-feature accessibility and coverage of 49 clinically meaningful ECG measurements, and cross-seed feature reproducibility. The evaluation further quantifies patient-sampling uncertainty, depth- and seed-dependent variation, and sensitivity to the sparsity parameterization. The benchmark reveals that ECG foundation models exhibit distinct interpretability profiles. A matched replication on MIMIC-IV-ECG confirms that reconstruction fidelity and clinical accessibility identify different leading models. The benchmark is accompanied by executable evaluation code, standardized manifests, cell-level metrics, and reproducibility audits. ECG-InterpBench complements performance-centered ECG benchmarks by providing a capacity-controlled and reproducible framework for comparing ECG foundation models across distinct dimensions of representation interpretability.
papers.comment: Research paper. Includes supplementary material and publicly available source code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ECG-InterpBench，一个系统评估心电图基础模型可解释性的基准，使用稀疏自编码器作为标准化测量工具并对模型容量进行匹配，以实现在多个可解释性维度上的受控比较。基准包含 450 个单元格的可解释性图谱，覆盖 6 个冻结的 ECG 基础模型、5 种编码器深度、5 种匹配字典宽度和 3 个随机种子，并评估稀疏重构保真度、49 个临床 ECG 测量的单特征可访问性与覆盖率，以及跨种子特征可复现性。作者在 MIMIC-IV-ECG 上进行了匹配复制，确认重构保真度与临床可访问性会识别出不同的领先模型。
Motivation: 现有心电图基础模型基准主要评估下游预测性能，很少考察其内部表示能否被忠实分解、临床解释或在独立分析中复现，缺乏针对表示可解释性的系统评估框架。
Method: 采用稀疏自编码器作为标准化测量仪器，并在不同模型间匹配其容量（深度、字典宽度）以进行受控比较；构建 450 单元格可解释性图谱，评估稀疏重构保真度、49 个临床测量值的单特征可访问性与覆盖率、跨种子特征可复现性，并量化患者采样不确定性及深度、种子和稀疏度参数化的影响。
Result: 基准揭示 ECG 基础模型具有不同的可解释性画像；在 MIMIC-IV-ECG 上的匹配复制表明，重构保真度和临床可访问性会选出不同的领先模型。
Conclusion: ECG-InterpBench 补充了以性能为中心的 ECG 基准，提供容量受控、可复现的框架，用于在表示可解释性的不同维度上比较 ECG 基础模型；摘要未提及方法局限。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有心电图基础模型基准主要评估下游预测性能，很少考察其内部表示能否被忠实分解、临床解释或在独立分析中复现，缺乏针对表示可解释性的系统评估框架。
summary_sections.method: 采用稀疏自编码器作为标准化测量仪器，并在不同模型间匹配其容量（深度、字典宽度）以进行受控比较；构建 450 单元格可解释性图谱，评估稀疏重构保真度、49 个临床测量值的单特征可访问性与覆盖率、跨种子特征可复现性，并量化患者采样不确定性及深度、种子和稀疏度参数化的影响。

papers.title: AHA-Memes: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Benchmark for Understanding Hate in Arabic Memes
papers.abstract_en: Hateful memes are a growing form of multimodal online harm, where hostile intent is often conveyed through the joint interpretation of images, text, cultural references, and implicit targets. While hateful meme detection has advanced in high-resource languages, Arabic remains underexplored, with existing meme resources focusing mainly on propaganda or coarse harmful-content labels. We introduce AHA-Memes (Arabic HAteful Memes), which is, to our knowledge, the first large-scale Arabic hateful meme benchmark with fine-grained, multi-label annotations. The dataset includes 5K manually annotated memes using a taxonomy that captures hate types, i.e., attack strategies. We further provide ~66K silver-labeled memes to support future studies. We benchmark text-only, image-only, and late-fusion multimodal models, as well as few-shot in-context learning (ICL) and open- and closed-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. Our results establish strong baselines and highlight key challenges in culturally grounded Arabic hateful meme detection. We release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and evaluation scripts to support future research. WARNING: This paper contains examples that may be disturbing to readers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AHA-Memes（Arabic HAteful Memes），据作者称是首个大规模阿拉伯语仇恨表情包多标签基准，包含 5K 条人工标注数据，采用细粒度分类法标注仇恨类型（即攻击策略），并额外提供约 66K 条 silver-labeled 数据。作者对文本、图像、晚期融合多模态模型以及少样本上下文学习（ICL）、开放/闭源视觉语言模型（VLM）在零样本和微调设置下进行基准测试，建立强基线并指出文化背景在阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测中的关键挑战。
Motivation: 仇恨表情包是日益增长的多模态在线伤害形式，但阿拉伯语领域研究不足；现有阿拉伯语表情包资源主要关注宣传或粗粒度的有害内容标签，缺少细粒度、多标签的仇恨标注。
Method: 构建 5K 条人工标注的阿拉伯语仇恨表情包数据集，使用涵盖仇恨类型和攻击策略的分类法进行多标签标注，并生成约 66K 条 silver-labeled 数据；随后评估文本、图像、晚期融合多模态模型、少样本 ICL 以及不同规模和权重的 VLM，覆盖零样本与微调设置。
Result: 论文建立了多个强基线，并突出展示了阿拉伯语仇恨表情包检测中依赖文化背景的挑战；摘要未报告具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者释放数据集、标注指南和评估脚本以支持未来研究，并提醒论文包含可能令人不适的示例。

papers.title: FunL2O: LLM-Guided Feature Function Design for Learning to Optimize
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-optimize (L2O) methods accelerate repeated optimization by training models to predict solutions, warm starts, branching decisions, or other forms of solver guidance. A critical yet largely overlooked component of these pipelines is the feature function that maps problem instances to inputs for machine learning models. Existing L2O methods typically rely on hand-crafted features, making representation design manual and largely fixed across domains. We introduce FunL2O, the first unified framework for automating feature design through LLM-driven program evolution for L2O. In a FunSearch-style loop, an LLM proposes executable feature functions, while a fixed evaluation process retrains the original L2O model and measures downstream optimization performance. We evaluate FunL2O on linear and quadratic programming tasks involving solution prediction and warm-starting, as well as on mixed-integer optimization tasks using GNN-guided backdoor branching and Predict-and-Search. Across continuous and discrete optimization tasks and four LLMs, the evolved features consistently outperform hand-crafted representations. These results establish LLM-driven feature evolution as a general and effective approach to automating representation design in L2O.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FunL2O，一个通过 LLM 驱动的程序演化来自动设计学习优化 (learning-to-optimize, L2O) 特征函数的统一框架。在 FunSearch 式循环中，LLM 提议可执行的特征函数，固定的评估流程重新训练原始 L2O 模型并测量下游优化性能。在连续与离散优化任务以及四个 LLM 上，演化出的特征一致优于手工设计的表示。
Motivation: L2O 方法通常依赖手工设计的特征函数把问题实例映射为机器学习模型输入，但这一表示设计环节在很大程度上被忽视，且跨领域基本固定不变。
Method: 提出 FunL2O，采用 FunSearch 式循环：由 LLM 提议可执行的特征函数，通过固定评估流程重训原始 L2O 模型并度量下游优化性能，从而自动化 L2O 中的特征表示设计。
Result: 在线性规划与二次规划的解预测和 warm-starting 任务，以及使用 GNN-guided backdoor branching 和 Predict-and-Search 的混合整数优化任务上，跨越四个 LLM，演化出的特征均一致优于手工设计表示。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 LLM 驱动的特征演化是一种通用且有效的、自动化 L2O 表示设计的方法。

papers.title: Beyond the Bidirectional Promise: Re-evaluating the Robustness of Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation by enabling bidirectional context and iterative refinement. However, their reliability under natural input noise and adversarial attacks remains under-explored. To address this, we systematically evaluate DLM robustness and calibration against AR baselines, using two parameter-matched pairs (LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B and Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B) across 32 natural perturbation conditions, adversarial gradient probes, and mechanistic hidden-state analyses. This paired design effectively isolates architecture-intrinsic properties from weight-dependent behaviors. We find a nuanced robustness profile: while highly stochastic DLM loss landscapes naturally resist gradient-based adversarial suffixes, they provide no guaranteed defense against natural noise, proving that everyday robustness is weight-dependent rather than inherently architectural. Furthermore, DLMs exhibit systematic overconfidence, presenting a practical deployment hazard. Most crucially, mechanistic probing reveals that all models perfectly encode input corruption, isolating behavioral fragility entirely to a decoder routing failure. Consistent with this diagnosis, we show that surface-level prompt patching fails to improve over noisy baselines. Ultimately, DLM robustness cannot be patched on; it must be fundamentally integrated into the iterative decoding loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估扩散语言模型 (Diffusion Language Models, DLMs) 在自然输入噪声和对抗攻击下的鲁棒性与校准，并与自回归 (autoregressive) 基线进行参数匹配对比。作者使用两对参数匹配模型（LLaDA-8B 对 LLaMA-3-8B，Dream-7B 对 Qwen2.5-7B），在 32 种自然扰动条件、对抗梯度探针和机制性隐状态分析下发现：高度随机的 DLM 损失景观虽能天然抵抗基于梯度的对抗后缀，但不能保证对自然噪声的防御；DLM 还表现出系统性过度自信。机制性探测表明所有模型都能完美编码输入损坏，行为脆弱性完全归因于解码器路由失败，表面提示修补无法改善噪声基线，鲁棒性必须集成进迭代解码循环。
Motivation: DLM 通过双向上下文和迭代精炼成为自回归生成的有力替代，但其在自然输入噪声和对抗攻击下的可靠性研究不足；现有工作也缺乏将架构固有属性与权重依赖行为分离开来的对照设计。
Method: 采用参数匹配的模型对（LLaDA-8B 对 LLaMA-3-8B，Dream-7B 对 Qwen2.5-7B），在 32 种自然扰动条件、对抗梯度探针与机制性隐状态分析下系统比较 DLM 与自回归基线的鲁棒性和校准。
Result: 高度随机的 DLM 损失景观天然抵抗基于梯度的对抗后缀，但对自然噪声没有保证的防御；日常鲁棒性是权重依赖的而非架构固有的。DLM 表现出系统性过度自信。机制性探测发现所有模型都能完美编码输入损坏，行为脆弱性完全来自解码器路由失败，表面提示修补无法改善噪声基线。
Conclusion: DLM 的鲁棒性不能靠表面修补获得，必须从根本上集成进迭代解码循环。

papers.title: Same Facts, Different Diagnosis: Measuring and Mitigating Narrative Anchoring in Clinical Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models used for clinical diagnostic reasoning are sensitive to sociolinguistic register, not just clinical content. We term this failure mode Narrative Anchoring: identical clinical facts expressed in different registers cause diagnostic outputs to diverge. Unlike prior demographic-bias work, which manipulates explicit identity tokens such as race or income, our benchmark isolates register as the sole channel of variation, with no demographic marker present in any form. We construct a dataset of 1,000 USMLE clinical vignettes, each rewritten into three sociolinguistically distinct personas under an independently audited fact-preservation guarantee, verified by a separate model that never sees the generation prompt. Across seven language models spanning three architecture families and scales, Narrative Anchoring is statistically significant under direct prompting in every model tested, with a Narrative Anchoring Gap of 0.064 to 0.151. Chain-of-thought reasoning and explicit debiasing instructions reduce the bias only partially, and their apparent gains are frequently confounded by accuracy collapse. We introduce NarrativeShield, a three-agent pipeline that structurally extracts and verifies clinical facts before diagnostic reasoning begins, reducing the Narrative Anchoring Gap to near-zero ($-0.004$ to $0.037$) and achieving the lowest rate of severely unstable decisions (DSS $<$ 0.8) of any method across all models, at a modest and mechanistically expected accuracy cost for most models. A stress test using a non-instruction-tuned base model shows that executing a debiasing intervention at all is gated by zero-shot instruction-following ability, not prompt content alone. We release our dataset, human-validated for fact preservation, as a standalone resource for studying register-based clinical bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出临床大语言模型中的叙事锚定 (Narrative Anchoring) 现象：完全相同的临床事实以不同社会语言学语域 (register) 表达时，模型的诊断输出会不一致，且该设置不包含任何种族、收入等显式人口统计学标记。作者构建了 1000 条改写为三种语域人格化版本的 USMLE 病例，并由独立模型审计事实保持；在七个模型上，直接提示下所有模型均呈现统计显著的叙事锚定，锚定差距 (Narrative Anchoring Gap) 为 0.064 至 0.151。提出的三智能体流水线 NarrativeShield 将锚定差距降至近零（-0.004 至 0.037），并取得最低的严重不稳定决策率。
Motivation: 现有针对临床模型的人口统计学偏见研究主要操纵种族、收入等显式身份标记；本文指出语域本身可作为唯一变化通道，独立于临床内容导致诊断输出发散，这是一种未被此前工作单独隔离的失败模式，对临床诊断可靠性构成风险。
Method: 构建含 1000 条 USMLE 临床病例的数据集，每条病例改写为三种社会语言学上不同的人格化版本，并用一个不接触生成提示的独立模型审计事实保持。提出 NarrativeShield，一个在诊断推理开始前结构化提取并验证临床事实的三智能体流水线；同时将链式思考 (chain-of-thought) 与显式去偏指令作为对照干预。
Result: 在三个架构家族、多种规模的七个语言模型上，直接提示下所有模型均显示统计显著的叙事锚定，Narrative Anchoring Gap 为 0.064 至 0.151；链式思考与显式去偏指令仅部分削弱偏差，其表面收益常与准确率崩塌混淆。NarrativeShield 将锚定差距降至 -0.004 至 0.037，在所有方法中取得最低的严重不稳定决策率（DSS < 0.8），多数模型仅付出适度且机制上可预期的准确率代价。
Conclusion: 摘要强调释放了经人工验证事实保持的数据集，作为研究语域性临床偏见的独立资源；压力测试还表明，任何去偏干预能否执行都受限于模型的零样本指令遵循能力，而非仅取决于提示内容本身。
