summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调释放了经人工验证事实保持的数据集，作为研究语域性临床偏见的独立资源；压力测试还表明，任何去偏干预能否执行都受限于模型的零样本指令遵循能力，而非仅取决于提示内容本身。

papers.title: The Convergence Behavior of Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We establish the first convergence guarantees for the plain vector-form \emph{Adam} optimizer under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. While several Adam variants are known to achieve optimal iteration complexity in bounded-variance nonconvex optimization, little is understood about their behavior when stochastic gradients admit only a bounded $p$-th central moment for some $p \in (1,2]$, a setting increasingly observed in modern deep learning. To address this gap, we generalize the recent online-to-nonconvex conversion framework to accommodate heavy-tailed martingale-difference noise. Building on this generalized framework, we develop a discounted regret analysis for Adam, without restrictive parameter coupling. Our results show that Adam converges to $(ρ,ε)$-stationary points under heavy-tailed noise. However, it exhibits a suboptimal iteration complexity and $p$-dependent convergence, a suboptimality that persists even in the bounded-variance case ($p=2$). When the domain radius is known and used to control the online-learner output, a standard setup in related literature, the convergence rate improves to match the optimal complexity. These findings provide new theoretical insight into the robustness and limitations of Adam in heavy-tailed regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 plain vector-form Adam 在重尾随机噪声下建立了首批收敛保证，是 UAI 2026 接收论文。作者把 online-to-nonconvex conversion 框架推广到重尾鞅差噪声，并用折扣遗憾分析证明 Adam 收敛到 (ρ,ε)-stationary points，但收敛率次优且依赖矩阶数 p；当已知域半径并据此控制 online-learner 输出时，率可恢复为最优复杂度。
Motivation: 现有 Adam 变体已在有界方差的非凸优化中达到最优迭代复杂度，但随机梯度仅满足 p 阶中心矩 (p∈(1,2]) 的重尾设定下，Adam 的行为几乎未被理解，而这一设定在现代深度学习中越来越常见。
Method: 将 online-to-nonconvex conversion 框架推广到重尾鞅差噪声，并发展针对 Adam 的折扣遗憾分析 (discounted regret analysis)，避免限制性的参数耦合假设；同时考虑已知域半径以控制 online-learner 输出的标准设定。
Result: 摘要显示 Adam 在重尾噪声下收敛到 (ρ,ε)-stationary points，但迭代复杂度次优且依赖 p；即使在有界方差情形 (p=2) 该次优性依然存在。若已知域半径并用于控制输出，则收敛率改进并匹配最优复杂度。
Conclusion: 这些结果揭示了 plain向量形式 Adam 在重尾机制下的鲁棒性与局限：不借助额外设定时无法达到最优迭代复杂度，但利用已知域半径可恢复最优率。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: VideoCoCo: Code-as-CoT for Physically-Consistent Video Generation via an Agentic Dual-Engine System
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video models have achieved remarkable visual quality, yet they still struggle to generate physically consistent dynamics because the temporal evolution of a scene must be inferred implicitly from a highly compressed text prompt. Existing chain-of-thought approaches introduce intermediate plans or visual states, but these representations are typically non-executable or temporally sparse, limiting their ability to instantiate and control the complete spatiotemporal process. To address this limitation, we introduce VideoCoCo, an agentic dual-engine framework in which executable Blender code serves as a process-level chain of thought. Given a text prompt, a coding agent synthesizes a Blender program that explicitly specifies the scene and its temporal evolution. The executable simulation engine runs the program to produce a deterministic spatiotemporal draft, which is subsequently transformed into a photorealistic video by a generative video engine through draft-conditioned editing. This decomposition separates process-level reasoning from high-fidelity visual realization. To adapt the video editor to simulated drafts, we construct VideoCoCo-3K, a curated dataset of draft-instruction-target triplets. VideoCoCo improves the OmniWeaving baseline from 0.475 to 0.558 on PhyGenBench and from 52.18 to 77.88 on VBench-2.0, achieving the best average score on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate that executable code provides an effective, controllable, and inspectable intermediate representation for physically consistent video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoCoCo，一个双引擎智能体框架，用可执行的 Blender 代码作为过程级思维链 (chain of thought) 来生成物理一致的视频。编码智能体根据文本提示合成 Blender 程序，模拟引擎运行程序生成确定性的时空草稿，再由生成式视频引擎通过草稿条件编辑将其转化为逼真视频。在 PhyGenBench 上将 OmniWeaving 基线从 0.475 提升到 0.558，在 VBench-2.0 上从 52.18 提升到 77.88，均取得最佳平均分。
Motivation: 文本到视频模型虽视觉质量高，但需从高度压缩的文本提示隐式推断场景的时间演化，难以生成物理一致的动态。现有链式思考方法引入的中间计划或视觉状态通常不可执行或时间上稀疏，无法实例化和控制完整的时空过程。
Method: 提出智能体双引擎框架 VideoCoCo：编码智能体从文本提示合成可执行的 Blender 程序，显式描述场景及其时间演化；可执行模拟引擎运行该程序生成确定性时空草稿；生成式视频引擎通过草稿条件编辑将草稿转化为逼真视频。此外构造了 VideoCoCo-3K 数据集，包含草稿-指令-目标三元组，用于适配视频编辑器。
Result: VideoCoCo 在 PhyGenBench 上将 OmniWeaving 基线从 0.475 提升至 0.558，在 VBench-2.0 上从 52.18 提升至 77.88，并在两个基准上取得最佳平均分。
Conclusion: 可执行代码为物理一致的视频生成提供了一种有效、可控且可检查的中间表示，将过程级推理与高保真视觉实现相分离。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PanDent: Toward Comprehensive Tooth-Level Structure-Language Consistency in Dental Radiology
papers.abstract_en: Accurate evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in dental panoramic radiography (orthopantomogram, OPG) is limited by the lack of fine-grained, clinically reliable benchmarks that reflect expert interpretation. This work introduces PanDent, a large-scale, clinically grounded OPG benchmark built upon fine-grained, expert-validated tooth-level annotations. The dataset comprises 9,524 high-quality OPGs, each associated with comprehensive structured annotations produced by experienced dentists and further validated by an oral and maxillofacial radiologist, providing clinically reliable supervision for tooth-level diagnosis and reasoning. Clinically consistent radiology reports are constructed from expert-validated findings using clinician-defined reporting logic, establishing explicit correspondence between structured clinical evidence and free-text descriptions. This design enables evaluation of whether MLLMs generate reports that are not only linguistically coherent but also clinically consistent with expert-validated tooth-level findings. Experiments are conducted on diverse MLLMs, including state-of-the-art (SOTA) proprietary models, general-domain open-source models, and medical-specific models. Results show that current MLLMs can generate fluent reports, yet fail to produce clinically consistent descriptions, exhibiting substantial errors in fine-grained localization and tooth-level diagnosis. Fine-tuning on PanDent significantly improves structure-language consistency, substantially enhancing visual localization accuracy and diagnostic correctness, and bringing model outputs closer to expert dental interpretation. These results establish PanDent as a rigorous benchmark for evaluating tooth-level clinical reasoning in MLLMs and a valuable resource for clinically grounded dental AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PanDent，一个大规模、临床导向的牙科全景 X 线（OPG）基准，包含 9,524 张高质量影像及由资深牙医标注、口腔颌面放射科医生验证的细粒度牙齿级结构化标注。作者依据临床定义的报告逻辑构建与结构化证据显式对应的放射报告，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在牙齿级结构与语言一致性上的表现。结果表明现有 MLLM 虽能生成流畅报告，但在细粒度定位和牙齿级诊断上错误明显，在 PanDent 上微调可显著提升结构-语言一致性。
Motivation: 牙科全景放射影像中多模态大语言模型的评估受限于缺乏细粒度、临床可靠且反映专家解读的基准，现有评测无法衡量模型在牙齿级诊断与推理上的临床一致性。
Method: 构建 PanDent 数据集，收集 9,524 张 OPG，配套由经验丰富的牙医生成并经口腔颌面放射科医生验证的细粒度结构化注释；利用临床医生定义的报告逻辑，由专家验证结果生成临床一致的放射学报告，建立结构化临床证据与自由文本描述之间的显式对应，并据此在通用开源、医疗专用及 SOTA 商用 MLLM 上进行评估。
Result: 实验显示当前 MLLM 能生成语言流畅的报告，但难以产生临床一致的描述，在细粒度定位和牙齿级诊断上出现大量错误；在 PanDent 上微调可显著提升视觉定位准确性和诊断正确性，使输出更接近牙科专家解读。
Conclusion: PanDent 可作为评估 MLLM 牙齿级临床推理的严格基准，也是临床牙科 AI 研究的重要资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoguePrompt: Dual-Layer Encoding for Self-Reconstruction to Circumvent LLM Moderation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integrated into mainstream development platforms and daily technological workflows, typically behind moderation and safety controls. Despite these controls, preventing prompt-based policy evasion remains challenging, and adversaries continue to "jailbreak" LLMs by crafting prompts that circumvent implemented safety mechanisms. Prior work has established cipher-mediated interaction, code-embedded decryption, prompt decomposition and reconstruction, and layered custom encryption as viable attack primitives. However, reported evaluations generally collapse visible acceptance, successful recovery of the concealed request, and subsequent execution into an aggregate attack-success outcome. This leaves limited evidence about where multistage prompt-transformation attacks fail within an observable black-box interaction. This paper introduces RoguePrompt, a jailbreak pipeline that partitions a forbidden prompt and applies two nested encodings, Vigenere followed by ROT13, along with natural-language reconstruction instructions. RoguePrompt was developed and evaluated under a black-box threat model, with only API or user-interface access to the hosted models, and was tested on 313 real-world, hard-rejected prompts. Success was measured in terms of moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution when the relevant stage exceeded its automated criterion. RoguePrompt achieved average rates of 93.93% for filter bypass, 79.02% for reconstruction, and 70.18% for execution. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of layered prompt encoding while providing stage-level evidence of where multistage jailbreaks fail during moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution.
papers.comment: This manuscript supersedes the preliminary version available as arXiv:2511.18790. The work has been substantially revised, expanded, and reorganized, with a refined threat model, revised methodology, clearer stage-level evaluation criteria, and expanded analysis of moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoguePrompt，一种将禁用提示拆分为多个部分并施加两层嵌套编码（先 Vigenere 后 ROT13）的越狱流水线，配合自然语言重构指令。作者在仅具备 API 或用户界面访问权限的黑盒威胁模型下，对 313 条真实被硬拒绝的提示进行测试，将攻击成功率拆分为过滤绕过、指令重构和执行三个阶段分别度量。摘要报告平均绕过率为 93.93%，重构率为 79.02%，执行为 70.18%，并以此说明多阶段越狱在各阶段的具体失效位置。
Motivation: 此前的越狱评估通常把可见接受、隐藏请求成功恢复以及后续执行合并为一个聚合攻击成功率，导致难以判断多阶段提示变换攻击在可观测的黑盒交互中究竟在哪个环节失败。
Method: RoguePrompt 将禁用提示分区，应用两层嵌套编码（Vigenere 后接 ROT13），并通过自然语言重构指令指导模型还原原始请求；方法在仅能通过 API 或用户界面访问托管模型的黑盒威胁模型下开发与评估。
Result: 在 313 条真实硬拒绝提示上，RoguePrompt 平均达到 93.93% 的过滤绕过率、79.02% 的指令重构率和 70.18% 的执行率，提供了各阶段的独立证据。
Conclusion: 作者强调分层提示编码的有效性，同时指出该方法的证据能展示多阶段越狱在过滤绕过、指令重构和执行过程中分别失败的位置。

papers.title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
papers.abstract_en: The deep learning revolution, kicked off by AlexNet, taught us that end-to-end training beats decomposing a problem into hand-designed stages. Generative modeling, however, has remained the exception-despite generative models being remarkably capable, they are still not trained end-to-end. This is because, at its core, generative modeling is about handling distributions with many modes, and existing scalable approaches handle this the same way, by factoring the generation procedure, which prevents end-to-end generation. In this work, we introduce Explorative Modeling, a new paradigm that instead factors the training loop, exploring K candidate matches between model generations and data, and training on the best, so predictions commit to modes rather than blurring them. We find Explorative Models (XMs) useful in two settings. First, increasing exploration adds a third pretraining axis beyond parameters and data for existing generative models-where scaling exploration monotonically improves performance across both continuous and discrete domains (images, video, and language). Notably, gains from exploration increase with scale, climbing from 7% to 36% as data scales and from 13% to 23% as models grow, with efficiency gains more than doubling at 3x the compute. Concretely, exploration improves FLOP efficiency by 4.1x, sample efficiency by 6.2x, parameter efficiency by 47%, lifts the strongest of image-generation recipes to a near-state-of-the-art 1.43 FID on ImageNet without guidance, enables scaling how end-to-end existing models are, and unlocks scaling generalization. Second, XMs enable end-to-end reconstructive generative modeling, matching diffusion on control tasks with 16-256x fewer inference steps. Together, these results establish XMs as both a new pretraining axis for existing generative models and a standalone end-to-end generative modeling paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Explorative Modeling（XM）这一生成建模新范式，主张通过分解训练循环而非生成过程，在模型生成与数据之间探索 K 个候选匹配并只训练最佳匹配，从而使预测提交到模态而不是模糊化。作者发现该范式在图像、视频和语言等连续与离散域上，将探索作为一个独立于参数和数据量的第三预训练轴，能单调提升性能并显著提高计算与样本效率，同时支持端到端生成。
Motivation: 现有的可扩展生成建模方法普遍将生成过程分解为多个阶段，因而无法做到端到端训练；本文认为这一限制源于处理多模态分布的方式，并试图通过改变训练循环来突破。
Method: 提出探索式建模（Explorative Modeling）：在训练过程中探索 K 个模型生成与数据之间的候选匹配，仅基于最佳匹配进行梯度更新，以此让预测提交到单个模态。该方法既可作为现有生成模型的额外预训练轴，也可作为独立的端到端重构式生成建模范式。
Result: 摘要报告：扩大探索规模可随数据规模从 7% 提升到 36%、随模型规模从 13% 提升到 23%；探索将 FLOP 效率提高 4.1 倍、样本效率提高 6.2 倍、参数效率提高 47%，在 ImageNet 无引导条件下达到接近 SOTA 的 1.43 FID；在控制任务上以 16-256 倍更少的推理步数匹配扩散模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为 XM 既是现有生成模型的一个新的预训练轴，也是一种独立的端到端生成建模范式，但其通用性仍需在更多任务与设置中检验。

papers.title: Compression-Based Behavioral Similarity for Open-World Sybil Discovery on Ethereum
papers.abstract_en: Sybil attackers are Blockchain actors that adopt the characteristics of regular users to exploit airdrops or influence governance. Current methods of Sybil actor detection include constructing graphs, which requires token transfers between examined wallets. Machine learning algorithms have been employed as well, but they treat the task as a closed-set classification problem, making them vulnerable to frequent changes in attack strategies or evasion tactics. We address the following questions: can compression-based similarity differentiate Sybil bots, organic users, and arbitrage bot wallets without direct financial links? What is the effect of high-signal contracts on the discovery of Sybils, and how robust are behavioral graphs under temporal drift and adversarial perturbations? Our approach synthesizes a symbolic Transaction Grammar from EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) traces, capturing separately transaction rhythm, execution structure, and functional intent. The high-signal contracts are filtered with our own protocol, called the Blind-Spot Protocol. Gzip-based NCD is used to construct a behavioral graph for Sybil discovery. We validate this framework against supervised machine learning baselines, a temporal split, and synthetic camouflage stress tests. Ultimately, we contribute a leakage-aware behavioral framework for Sybil candidate discovery. Its core NCD primitive requires no supervised training and can expand suspicious seed wallets without explicit funding links. We position the method as a training-free local discovery primitive for open-world blockchain audits, rather than as a formal open-set recognition system.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper and scheduled for presentation at the European Conference on Advances in Databases and Information Systems (ADBIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于压缩的相似性方法，用于以太坊上的开放世界 Sybil 发现。作者从 EVM traces 合成符号化的 Transaction Grammar，分别捕捉交易节奏、执行结构和功能意图，并用自研 Blind-Spot Protocol 过滤高信号合约，再以基于 Gzip 的 NCD 构建行为图。验证部分对比了监督式机器学习基线、时间切分和合成伪装压力测试，核心 NCD 原语无需监督训练，能在没有显式资金链接的情况下扩展可疑种子钱包。
Motivation: 现有 Sybil 检测常依赖钱包间的代币转账来构图，且机器学习方法将任务当作闭集分类，难以应对攻击策略的频繁变化或规避手段。作者希望回答能否仅凭行为相似性区分 Sybil 机器人、有机用户与套利机器人钱包，而无需直接财务链接。
Method: 从 EVM 交易轨迹中合成符号化 Transaction Grammar，分别刻画交易节奏、执行结构和功能意图；利用提出的 Blind-Spot Protocol 过滤高信号合约；再使用 Gzip 压缩距离 NCD 构建行为图，作为免训练的本地发现原语以扩展可疑种子集合。
Result: 该方法在监督式机器学习基线、时间切分以及合成伪装压力测试的对比中验证了有效性，能够区分 Sybil 机器人、有机用户和套利机器人钱包，并且不依赖钱包之间的直接资金转移关系。
Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位为泄漏感知的 Sybil 候选发现框架，核心 NCD 原语无需监督训练，适合作为开放世界区块链审计中的训练自由本地发现工具，而非正式的开放集识别系统。

papers.title: SkillMentor: LLM Agent Self-Evolution via Learning Blind-Spot Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Agent self-evolution has primarily focused on learning how to act, while overlooking an equally important capability: learning to discover what an agent does not know. Existing approaches typically assume that failure discovery is given, focusing on how to repair failures once they are identified. We ask whether blind-spot diagnosis itself can be learned. We thus study diagnosis as an agent capability separate from execution, and exclude two alternative sources of progress: executor adaptation and human supervision. Under these constraints, performance cannot improve through executor updates or annotated examples, forcing all improvements to originate from the learned diagnostic capability. We propose SkillMentor, which trains a Mentor policy via reinforcement learning to generate diagnostic tasks, identify recurrent failure modes, and curate them into reusable corrective skills. Across AppWorld and BFCLv3, SkillMentor improves executor performance by an average of 44.2%. These results suggest that blind-spot diagnosis is a learnable capability, enabling self-evolution without updating executor weights or relying on human-curated data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillMentor 框架，将盲点诊断 (blind-spot diagnosis) 视为可与执行分离的智能体能力，用强化学习训练 Mentor 策略来生成诊断任务、识别反复出现的失败模式并整理成可复用的纠正技能。在 AppWorld 和 BFCLv3 上，该方法在不更新执行器权重、不依赖人类标注数据的情况下，平均提升执行器性能 44.2%。
Motivation: 现有智能体自我进化主要关注如何行动，而忽略了发现自身未知的能力；已有方法通常假设失败发现是给定的，只关注识别出失败后的修复。作者提出盲点诊断本身可以被学习，并在实验中排除执行器适应和人类监督两个替代进步来源，迫使所有改进都来自学到的诊断能力。
Method: 提出 SkillMentor，通过强化学习训练一个 Mentor 策略，使其生成诊断任务、识别反复出现的失败模式，并将这些模式整理为可复用的纠正技能。实验设计将诊断与执行分离，排除 executor 更新和人工标注示例，从而单独检验诊断能力的贡献。
Result: 在 AppWorld 和 BFCLv3 两个基准上，SkillMentor 平均提升执行器性能 44.2%。
Conclusion: 结果表明盲点诊断是一种可学习的能力，可以在不更新执行器权重、也不依赖人工策划数据的情况下实现智能体自我进化。

papers.title: Shared Semantic Codebook Distillation for Unpaired Cross-Modal Medical Classification
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal knowledge distillation can transfer diagnostic knowledge from a strong but costly teacher modality to a cheaper and more deployable student modality. In medical image analysis, however, the two modalities are often unpaired: they are collected from different patient cohorts and occupy geometrically incompatible feature spaces. This makes instance-level distillation invalid and direct feature matching unreliable. To address these challenges, we propose Shared Semantic Codebook Distillation (SSCD), which compares teacher and student representations through a shared discrete codebook. Each image is represented as a distribution over a common, modality-agnostic vocabulary, and knowledge is transferred by aligning these distributions across modalities, both globally and class-conditionally, without requiring paired samples or directly comparable raw features. The codebook is evolved online by exponential moving average and kept diverse through entropy regularization and dead-code restart. At inference, all teacher-side and codebook modules are discarded, leaving only the student encoder and classifier. On two heterogeneous unpaired settings, OCT-to-fundus retinal disease classification and CT-to-chest-X-ray pneumonia classification, SSCD improves the student from 64.5 to 70.2 macro-F1 and from 73.8 to 76.3 macro-F1, respectively, outperforming all evaluated distillation baselines on both settings. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/DillanImans/SSCD-unpaired-distillation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出共享语义码本蒸馏 (Shared Semantic Codebook Distillation, SSCD)，用于解决医学图像中跨模态知识蒸馏时的非配对问题。该方法通过一个共享的离散码本将教师和学生模态的图像表示为共同词汇上的分布，并在全局和类条件层面对齐这些分布，从而避免实例级蒸馏和直接特征匹配。作者在 OCT 到眼底视网膜疾病分类和 CT 到胸部 X 光肺炎分类两个非配对设置上验证了效果，学生模型的 macro-F1 分别从 64.5 提升到 70.2、从 73.8 提升到 76.3，均优于所评估的蒸馏基线。
Motivation: 跨模态知识蒸馏依赖教师与学生模态的配对样本，但医学影像中不同模态常来自不同患者队列，特征空间几何不兼容，导致实例级蒸馏失效、直接特征匹配不可靠。
Method: 提出 SSCD，通过在线更新的共享离散码本将每张图像编码为模态无关词汇上的分布，并同时进行全局和类条件分布对齐；码本使用指数移动平均演进，并以熵正则化和死码重启（dead-code restart）保持多样性。推理时丢弃教师侧与码本模块，仅保留学生编码器和分类器。
Result: 在两个非配对跨模态设置上，SSCD 将学生模型从 64.5 提升到 70.2 macro-F1（OCT 到眼底）以及从 73.8 提升到 76.3 macro-F1（CT 到胸片），优于所有评估的蒸馏基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过共享语义码本进行分布对齐可以在无配对样本的情况下有效迁移医学诊断知识，并公开了代码与预训练模型。

papers.title: PAUSE: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personal AI Assistants in Unified Service Environments
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI assistants are increasingly deployed as task-oriented, tool-augmented agents that operate within unified service environments to support everyday user activities. In realistic settings, such assistants must reason over persistent user state, respect user-specific configurations and permissions, and sustain long-horizon, constraint-aware interactions across multiple services. Existing benchmarks, however, often fragment service contexts or abstract away user state, limiting their ability to evaluate user-centric personal assistant behavior in realistic service settings. We introduce PAUSE, a user-centric benchmark for evaluating personal AI assistants in stateful, service-integrated environments. PAUSE captures core challenges of real-world assistant deployment by requiring agents to coordinate actions across heterogeneous user-owned resources while maintaining consistency with environment state, authorization constraints over multi-turn interactions. The benchmark incorporates explicit user-agent interaction via realistic user simulation, enabling evaluation beyond static tool execution. To support principled and reproducible evaluation, PAUSE adopts a multi-regime evaluation framework aligned with task characteristics. Open-ended service management tasks are assessed using semantic and trajectory-level behavioral metrics, while constraint-intensive tasks admit deterministic, state-based verification. Benchmark results show that even state-of-the-art proprietary models fail to reach 70% task completion on scenarios requiring stateful reasoning and configuration awareness, revealing consistent and interpretable failure patterns. Finally, we present a user-centric synthesis pipeline that enables scalable generation of coherent service environments, user configurations, and reliably annotated tasks, supporting benchmark extensibility and future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAUSE 是一个面向个人 AI 助手的用户中心基准测试，在带状态且集成服务的环境中评估智能体行为。它通过真实的用户模拟引入显式用户-智能体交互，并采用多机制评估框架：开放式服务管理任务用语义和轨迹级行为指标，约束密集型任务用确定性的基于状态的验证。基准结果显示，即使最先进的专有模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的场景中任务完成率也低于 70%，且存在一致、可解释的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有基准往往割裂服务上下文或抽象掉用户状态，无法在现实服务场景中评估以用户为中心的个人助理行为；真实部署中助理需要对持久用户状态进行推理、尊重用户配置与权限，并跨多个服务维持长时程且受约束的交互。
Method: 提出 PAUSE 基准，要求智能体在异构用户自有资源间协调动作，同时保持与环境状态及多轮交互授权约束的一致性；引入真实用户模拟以支持超越静态工具执行的评估；并提供一个用户中心的合成流水线，可规模化生成连贯的服务环境、用户配置和带可靠标注的任务。
Result: 基准结果显示，在最先进的专有模型上，需要状态推理和配置感知的场景任务完成率未达到 70%，并暴露出一致且可解释的失败模式。
Conclusion: PAUSE 提供了一种原则化、可复现的评估框架，并通过合成流水线支持基准的可扩展性和未来研究，有助于推动个人 AI 助手在真实服务环境中的用户中心评估。

summary_sections.tldr: PAUSE 是一个面向个人 AI 助手的用户中心基准测试，在带状态且集成服务的环境中评估智能体行为。它通过真实的用户模拟引入显式用户-智能体交互，并采用多机制评估框架：开放式服务管理任务用语义和轨迹级行为指标，约束密集型任务用确定性的基于状态的验证。基准结果显示，即使最先进的专有模型在需要状态推理和配置感知的场景中任务完成率也低于 70%，且存在一致、可解释的失败模式。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有基准往往割裂服务上下文或抽象掉用户状态，无法在现实服务场景中评估以用户为中心的个人助理行为；真实部署中助理需要对持久用户状态进行推理、尊重用户配置与权限，并跨多个服务维持长时程且受约束的交互。
summary_sections.method: 提出 PAUSE 基准，要求智能体在异构用户自有资源间协调动作，同时保持与环境状态及多轮交互授权约束的一致性；引入真实用户模拟以支持超越静态工具执行的评估；并提供一个用户中心的合成流水线，可规模化生成连贯的服务环境、用户配置和带可靠标注的任务。

papers.title: Modeling Decisions in Blockchain Analytics: A Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Tree-Based vs. Sequential Models
papers.abstract_en: Sybil bots are Ethereum actors that imitate legitimate users to extract airdrop rewards or influence governance. Recent Sybil detection methods increasingly use deep learning and treat blockchain activity as a quasi-linguistic sequence. However, complex sequence models are computationally expensive for real-time monitoring, and their reported performance may be inflated by label leakage from high-signal smart contracts. We ask whether and how organic users, Sybil bots, and MEV bots differ in the structural complexity of their transaction histories; whether sequential models outperform tree-based tabular models once leakage is reduced; whether transaction order or timing provides the stronger behavioral signal; and whether the resulting models are practical for low-latency deployment. Our approach to leakage-aware Sybil bot detection consists of a Blind-Spot protocol and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. The former eliminates shortcuts associated with high-signal contracts, whereas the latter models wallets using rhythm, EVM execution structure, and intent. We evaluate this approach on Ethereum actor classification by comparing Transformer and BiLSTM sequence models against XGBoost and SVM baselines. We contribute a framework for leakage-aware Ethereum actor classification and a Transaction Grammar representation of wallet behavior. Our results demonstrate that, under leakage-aware evaluation, XGBoost outperforms Transformer-based sequence models while providing lower latency and estimated energy use.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 23rd International Conference on Modeling Decisions for Artificial Intelligence (MDAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究以太坊上 Sybil 机器人检测中的标签泄漏问题，并提出一种泄漏感知评估框架。作者引入 Blind-Spot 协议去除高信号智能合约带来的捷径，并用 Transaction Grammar 表示钱包行为，随后在以太坊行为者分类任务上比较 Transformer、BiLSTM 与 XGBoost、SVM。结果显示在泄漏感知评估下，XGBoost 优于基于 Transformer 的序列模型，且延迟和估算能耗更低。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的 Sybil 检测方法把区块链活动当作类语言序列，但复杂序列模型在实时监控中计算代价高，且其报告性能可能因来自高信号智能合约的标签泄漏而被高估。论文旨在回答在降低泄漏后序列模型是否仍优于树模型等问题，并追求低延迟可部署性。
Method: 提出 Blind-Spot 协议以消除与高信号合约相关的捷径，并设计 Transaction Grammar 表示钱包行为，从节奏 (rhythm)、EVM 执行结构和意图层面建模。在以太坊行为者分类中对比 Transformer、BiLSTM 序列模型与 XGBoost、SVM 表格模型基线。
Result: 在泄漏感知评估下，XGBoost 优于基于 Transformer 的序列模型，同时提供更低的延迟和估算能耗。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了一套泄漏感知的以太坊行为者分类框架和 Transaction Grammar 表示；其结果表明，在控制标签泄漏后，树模型具备更强的实用性与效率优势。

papers.title: Bunraku: Turning a Single Illustration into an Editable Live2D Character
papers.abstract_en: Live2D is the dominant 2D character-animation format for anime characters and virtual avatars, representing each character as a stack of RGBA layers driven by per-layer mesh deformation. Despite its wide use in virtual streaming, mobile games, and interactive characters, authoring a Live2D model still demands weeks of manual layer separation, occlusion completion, mesh placement, and keyframing, and no prior generative method produces such a structured asset end-to-end. We present the first system that, from a single illustration, generates all the structured information a Live2D runtime consumes: ordered RGBA layers, a deformation mesh per layer, and the parameter-driven keypose vertex offsets that make the character move. Stage 1 casts layered decomposition as a layered diffusion process under a Live2D-aware organ-level taxonomy, producing an ordered RGBA stack with hidden-region completion. Stage 2 builds a content-conforming triangle mesh for each layer from its alpha channel alone, then predicts the keypose displacement field of all layers jointly: every vertex of every layer is one token, self-attention spans layer boundaries, and each displacement is factorised into a bounded direction and a log-magnitude. Joint rather than independent prediction is what makes the result a coherent character instead of separately plausible parts, and is our largest gain; scaling the network 112x yields none. On 50 held-out characters, under true generation with no teacher forcing, Stage 2 attains a per-vertex direction cosine of 0.768 (median 0.828). Because a layer's mesh derives from its alpha channel, a clothing layer can be re-textured from a natural-language instruction while the mesh and predicted animation are reused byte-for-byte. We further contribute Live2D-Bench, the first standardized benchmark for the task, and an 8,884-model Live2D corpus with layer and animation supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出第一个从单张插图端到端生成完整 Live2D 模型的系统，输出有序 RGBA 层、每层的变形网格和参数驱动的关键姿态顶点偏移。方法分两阶段：先用分层扩散过程做 Live2D 感知的图层分解与隐藏区域补全，再基于 alpha 通道构造三角网格并联合预测所有层的关键姿态位移场。在 50 个保留角色上，无 teacher forcing 的真实生成中每顶点方向余弦达到 0.768（中位数 0.828），并附带 Live2D-Bench 基准和 8,884 个模型的语料库。
Motivation: Live2D 是动漫角色和虚拟形象的主流 2D 动画格式，但制作模型需要数周的人工分层、遮挡补全、网格放置和关键帧制作，先前没有生成方法能端到端产出这种结构化资产。自动化该流程对虚拟直播、移动游戏和交互角色等应用具有重要意义。
Method: Stage 1 将图层分解建模为在 Live2D 感知器官级分类下的分层扩散过程，生成有序 RGBA 层堆栈并补全隐藏区域；Stage 2 仅从每层 alpha 通道构建内容一致的三角形网格，然后联合预测所有层的关键姿态位移场，每个顶点作为一个 token、自注意力跨越层边界，位移被分解为有界方向和对数幅度。此外，衣物层可通过自然语言指令重新纹理化，同时复用原有网格和预测动画。
Result: 在 50 个保留角色上，采用真实生成（无 teacher forcing）时，Stage 2 达到每顶点方向余弦 0.768，中位数为 0.828。摘要指出联合预测而非独立预测是最大增益来源，而将网络规模扩大 112 倍没有带来收益。
Conclusion: 作者强调跨层联合预测是生成连贯角色而非各自合理部件（separately plausible parts）的关键，并贡献了标准化基准 Live2D-Bench 和带图层与动画监督的 8,884 模型语料库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emulating Cosmic Structure Formation with a Lagrangian Neural Cellular Automaton
papers.abstract_en: Field-level inference of cosmological initial conditions from galaxy surveys requires a forward model that is simultaneously accurate in the non-linear regime, computationally efficient, and fully differentiable. Traditional N-body simulations are accurate but computationally prohibitive for iterative inference, while approximate solvers like Lagrangian Perturbation Theory (LPT) fail to capture the knotty halo-forming dynamics of the cosmic web at late times. We introduce the \textit{Lagrangian Neural Cellular Automaton} (LNCA), a hybrid deep learning framework that can be applied to emulate structure formation as a local, iterative dynamical process on a comoving lattice. Unlike standard Eulerian Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) which map fixed density fields, the LNCA operates in the Lagrangian frame, advecting the computational graph itself to follow the flow of mass. By training the network to learn only the \textit{residual} displacement corrections to the Zeldovich approximation, we achieve high-fidelity emulation of the non-linear physics while guaranteeing accuracy at large scales. We further constrain our model to produce complete trajectories, not just final states, by adopting an equivariant cellular automaton architecture, which recurrently iterates on its internal states to yield a dynamic history. The resulting model is strictly local, translationally and rotationally equivariant, and naturally supports continuous time integration, making it a reliable differentiable forward model for reconstructing the initial conditions of the universe from lightcone data. Our trained model supports percent-level precision in the power and cross spectra well into the non-linear regime ($k \lesssim 0.5 \, h \text{Mpc}^{-1}$), while requiring $\sim10^4$ times fewer learned parameters than comparable models which take the form of an interpretable internal dynamic rule set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lagrangian Neural Cellular Automaton (LNCA)，一种在拉格朗日框架下把宇宙结构形成建模为局部迭代动力学过程的混合深度学习仿真器。与固定密度场的欧拉 CNN 不同，LNCA 沿质量流平动计算图本身，只学习对 Zeldovich 近似的残差位移修正，并通过等变元胞自动机循环生成完整轨迹，支持连续时间积分。摘要报告其在非线性区（k ≲ 0.5 h Mpc⁻¹）的功率谱与交叉谱达到百分级精度，可学习参数量比同类模型少约 10⁴ 倍。
Motivation: 从星系巡天进行宇宙初始条件的场级推断需要一个既能在非线性区保持精度、又计算高效且完全可微的前向模型；N-body 模拟精度高但迭代推断代价过大，而 LPT 等近似方法无法捕捉晚期宇宙网的结状成团动力学。
Method: LNCA 在共动格点上把结构形成当作局部迭代过程，在拉格朗日坐标系中随质量流平动计算图本身；网络只学习 Zeldovich 近似的残差位移修正，并采用平移与旋转等变的元胞自动机结构，通过循环更新内部状态输出完整动力学轨迹而非仅终态。
Result: 摘要报告模型在非线性区（k ≲ 0.5 h Mpc⁻¹）的功率谱与交叉谱达到百分级精度，所需可学习参数比同类模型少约 10⁴ 倍，且内部表现为可解释的动力学规则集。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LNCA 是可靠且完全可微的前向模型，适用于从光锥数据重建宇宙初始条件；其核心优势是严格局部、平移与旋转等变、生成完整轨迹并支持连续时间积分。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZUNA1.1，一个 380M 参数的扩散自编码器 (diffusion autoencoder)，用于灵活的脑电 (EEG) 信号重建。该模型支持最长 30 秒的可变长度序列、任意数量的 EEG 通道和任意头皮位置，并能重建通道内的任意时间区间或完整通道。作者声称 ZUNA1.1 在性能上至少与早期 ZUNA1 相当，同时远为灵活，并继续显著优于 MNE 包中广泛使用的球面样条插值 (spherical spline interpolation) 等标准方法。模型以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源发布。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 重建与去噪方法（如球面样条插值）缺乏灵活性，难以处理可变长度、任意通道数和任意通道位置的重建任务，需要更通用的基础模型。
Method: 采用 380M 参数的扩散自编码器架构，支持变长序列（最长 30 秒）、任意头皮位置与通道数量，并允许对通道内任意时间区间以及整条通道进行重建。
Result: 摘要报告 ZUNA1.1 在性能上至少与 ZUNA1 持平，且灵活性显著提升；在 EEG 去噪与重建任务上继续大幅优于 MNE 中常用的球面样条插值方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ZUNA1.1 在不牺牲性能的前提下实现了更强的任务灵活性，并以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源发布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Position, Not Provenance: Separating Reasoning Mediation from Sycophancy in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering clinical questions, but whether this reasoning causally influences predictions remains unclear. We present CoT-Mediate, a behavioral framework that perturbs a single clinically meaningful attribute within a model's own generated reasoning and measures whether the resulting prediction follows the edited reasoning. Our framework combines a dual-arm protocol comparing re-prompted evidence with prefix-forced continuation, together with a provenance-controlled intervention that varies only the attributed source of identical reasoning to disentangle reasoning mediation from sycophancy. We evaluate LLaVA-Med and MedGemma on 1,000 VQA-RAD samples each. Prefix-forced continuation consistently yields higher mediation faithfulness than re-prompting, while the provenance analysis reveals distinct model-specific deference behaviors. Across both models, removing visual evidence increases reliance on injected reasoning, whereas laterality is the least faithfully tracked clinical attribute. These results show that the mechanism used to inject reasoning substantially affects measured faithfulness and that contextual position, rather than stated provenance, is the primary determinant of whether medical VLMs use their generated reasoning.

papers.title: THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 THGFM，一个面向网络规模时序异构图 (temporal heterogeneous graph) 的融合模型，采用双路径架构联合建模跨类型结构异质性与交互的时间动态。其中一条路径是共享空间时间注意力 (Shared-Space Temporal Attention)，用于参数高效的跨类型迁移；另一条是关系类型分区时间注意力 (Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention)，用于关系感知的特化，二者通过类型条件非竞争门控求和融合 (Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion) 整合。此外，THGFM 引入旋转时间注意力 (Rotary Temporal Attention)，将相对时间以半相位旋转 queries 和 keys，使时间直接参与注意力分数计算。在多个学术图基准上，模型一致优于基线图 Transformer，六任务平均增益为 +3.25%，并在 OAG-CS PV 上取得 +12.37% 的峰值相对增益。
Motivation: 现有时序异构图学习方法难以同时兼顾参数高效的跨类型迁移与关系感知的特化，并且通常只把时间作为注意力核之外的加法特征注入，未能让时间直接参与注意力匹配。
Method: THGFM 采用统一双路径架构：一条共享空间时间注意力分支负责跨类型参数共享，另一条关系类型分区时间注意力分支负责关系特化；通过 Dual-Path Relational–Shared Fusion 融合两分支，并用类型条件非竞争门控求和机制为每个分支分配独立的 feature-wise 门控，避免零和竞争。注意力部分引入 Rotary Temporal Attention，在匹配前按相对时间的半相位旋转 queries 和 keys。
Result: 在学术图基准上，THGFM 比基线图 Transformer 获得六任务平均 +3.25% 的增益，其中 OAG-CS PV +12.37%、PF-L2 +4.87%、PF-L1 +1.18%、OGBN-MAG +4.24%、HTAG-ArXiv +3.73%、HTAG-DBLP +4.61%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将相对时间直接纳入注意力核，并通过非竞争门控融合解耦两个分支的放大/抑制，能够同时保留跨类型迁移效率与关系感知特化，从而在时序异构图基准上取得一致提升。摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: An analysis of binary isotonic regression: degrees of freedom and implications for calibration
papers.abstract_en: Isotonic regression is a canonical tool for estimating monotone functions and calibrating probabilistic predictors. We provide a fully sharp finite-sample characterization of its worst-case degrees of freedom on binary samples. Specifically, we identify the binary sequences that maximize the number of distinct fitted values produced by isotonic regression. We develop a sharp bound on the degrees of freedom with a leading term of $\frac{3}{(4π^2)^{1/3}} n^{2/3}$ using analytic number theory, improving on previous bounds. We then apply this result to calibration. Calibration is a central requirement for probabilistic prediction, and isotonic regression is a widely used post-processing method for improving calibration. Building on deterministic degrees-of-freedom bounds, we derive, to our knowledge, the first nontrivial distribution-free guarantee on the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of isotonic regression. This ECE bound is fully model-free and distribution-free, only assuming $Y \in \{0,1\}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对二元样本上的等渗回归 (isotonic regression) 给出最坏情况自由度 (degrees of freedom) 的有限样本精确刻画，并利用解析数论得到主项为 3/(4π^2)^{1/3} n^{2/3} 的尖锐界。作者进一步将该结果应用于概率预测器的校准，推导出等渗回归期望校准误差 (Expected Calibration Error, ECE) 的首个非平凡分布无关保证。
Motivation: 等渗回归是估计单调函数和校准概率预测器的经典工具，但其最坏情况自由度在有限样本下的精确行为此前缺乏刻画；同时，等渗回归作为广泛使用的校准后处理方法，其校准误差缺乏完全模型无关、分布无关的理论保证。
Method: 识别使等渗回归产生最多不同拟合值的二元序列，结合解析数论建立自由度上界；然后将确定性的自由度界用于校准分析，导出仅假设 Y ∈ {0,1} 的 ECE 分布无关界。
Result: 摘要报告最坏情况自由度界的主项为 3/(4π^2)^{1/3} n^{2/3}，优于此前已知界；并给出据作者所知第一个非平凡的、完全模型无关且分布无关的等渗回归 ECE 保证。
Conclusion: 该工作为二元等渗回归的自由度提供了尖锐的有限样本理论，并以此得到概率预测器校准的分布无关 ECE 上界；但结果限定于二值响应 Y ∈ {0,1}。

papers.title: MatCreatioNN: Machine learning-guided computational discovery of photocatalysts for environmental applications
papers.abstract_en: The rational design of photocatalysts for environmental remediation and CO2 conversion remains limited by the high computational cost and sparse experimental data describing multi-parameter photocatalytic behavior. This work presents an integrated machine-learning framework that couples reinforcement learning-based metal-organic framework (MOF) generation with a multi-stage Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Network (CGCNN) prediction funnel to identify photocatalysts optimized across multiple electronic and structural features. 120,000 MOF candidates were generated and screened using 13 key descriptors, including band-gap suitability, CO2/H2O selectivity, adsorption energy, and structural stability. The funnel approach reduced computational cost by 4.13-fold while maintaining predictive robustness. Two top candidates, a Cr-based and a Zn-based MOF, exhibited predicted photocatalytic fitness values of 1.70 +/- 0.25 and 1.20 +/- 0.05 fold higher respectively than benchmark materials such as PCN-224(Zr), demonstrating simultaneous improvements in light absorption, redox energetics, and framework durability. Simulated X-ray diffraction patterns confirmed strong structural agreement with experimentally synthesized MOFs, indicating high synthesizability. Post-hoc analysis revealed recurring structural motifs, such as the N262 metal cluster, that correlated strongly with high predicted photocatalytic activity. These results highlight the potential of data-driven methods to accelerate discovery of efficient and durable photocatalysts for environmental and energy-related transformations, providing a foundation for experimental realization and large-scale implementation of computationally designed MOFs.

TL;DR: 本文提出集成机器学习框架 MatCreatioNN，将基于强化学习（reinforcement learning）的金属有机框架（MOF）生成与多级 Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Network (CGCNN) 预测漏斗结合，用于环境光催化剂的理性设计。系统生成并筛选了 120,000 个 MOF 候选，使用 13 个关键描述符，漏斗方法使计算成本降低 4.13 倍并保持预测稳健性。两个最优候选（Cr 基和 Zn 基 MOF）的预测光催化适应度分别比基准材料 PCN-224(Zr) 高 1.70 ± 0.25 倍和 1.20 ± 0.05 倍；模拟 X 射线衍射图谱与实验合成结构吻合，后验分析发现与高预测活性相关的重复结构基序（如 N262 金属簇）。
Motivation: 环境修复和 CO2 转化的光催化剂理性设计受限于高昂的计算成本，以及描述多参数光催化行为的实验数据稀疏。
Method: 提出一个集成机器学习流程：用强化学习生成 MOF 候选结构，再用多阶段 CGCNN 预测漏斗，基于带隙适配、CO2/H2O 选择性、吸附能和结构稳定性等 13 个描述符对 120,000 个候选进行筛选。
Result: 摘要报告漏斗方法将计算成本降低 4.13 倍；Cr 基和 Zn 基 MOF 的预测光催化适应度分别比 PCN-224(Zr) 等基准高 1.70 ± 0.25 倍和 1.20 ± 0.05 倍；模拟 XRD 与实验合成 MOF 结构一致，指示较高的可合成性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据驱动方法有望加速高效耐用光催化剂的发现，并为计算设计的 MOF 的实验实现和大规模应用奠定基础；预测结果仍需实验验证。

papers.title: VETO: Towards Protecting Images From Frontier AI Editing
papers.abstract_en: The rise of powerful, accessible image-editing models such as FLUX.2 has brought high-fidelity editing within broad reach. Their capabilities now extend beyond localized modifications to extracting and recontextualizing objects and identities in entirely new scenes. By allowing prompt and generation tokens to attend directly to reference-image tokens, modern models blur the boundary between conventional editing and text-to-image synthesis. This expanded generative freedom also broadens the space of potential misuse, as harmful transformations are no longer confined to a predictable set of localized edits. Existing anti-edit defenses are designed to disrupt the semantic bottleneck of the reference-image encoding in legacy diffusion pipelines. However, newer editors distill reference information through joint-attention blocks, thereby often circumventing these protections. We therefore introduce VETO, a subtle anti-edit cloak that disrupts this inner mechanism through which modern models read the source image. Additionally, as existing editing benchmarks leave comprehensive recontextualizations largely untested, we introduce VetoBench, which evaluates defenses not only on conventional localized edits but also on broader contextual shifts. Across two contemporary editing models and three benchmarks, VETO consistently outperforms existing defenses while providing a stronger protection-fidelity trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VETO，一种针对现代图像编辑模型（如 FLUX.2）的防编辑扰动（anti-edit cloak），通过干扰模型联合注意力（joint-attention）机制中对参考图像信息的读取来阻止有害编辑。作者还引入 VetoBench 基准，用于评估传统局部编辑之外的重新情境化（recontextualization）编辑防御。在两个当代编辑模型和三个基准上，VETO 一致优于现有防御，并提供更强的保护-保真度权衡。
Motivation: 现有防编辑防御主要针对传统扩散管线中参考图像编码的语义瓶颈，但新一代编辑器通过联合注意力块直接蒸馏参考信息，往往绕过了这些防护。随着图像编辑能力扩展到物体与身份提取及重新情境化，潜在滥用空间扩大，需要针对新机制的防御与相应评测基准。
Method: 提出 VETO，一种隐蔽的防编辑扰动，用于破坏现代模型读取源图像时经由联合注意力块的内部机制；同时构建 VetoBench 基准，将防御评测从常规局部编辑扩展到更广泛的情境转换（contextual shifts）编辑。
Result: 在两个当代编辑模型及三个基准上，VETO 一致优于现有防御，并提供更强的保护-保真度权衡（protection-fidelity trade-off）。
Conclusion: 作者认为针对现代联合注意力式编辑器的内部读取机制进行扰动，是恢复防编辑保护的有效途径，并通过新基准覆盖了以往被忽视的重新情境化编辑场景。

summary_sections.result: 在两个当代编辑模型及三个基准上，VETO 一致优于现有防御，并提供更强的保护-保真度权衡（protection-fidelity trade-off）。

papers.title: EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern telecommunication, cloud, and microservice systems emit correlated alarm cascades when components fail. Root cause analysis (RCA) aims to identify the small set of alarms that initiate each cascade. A common approach learns a causal graph from observational logs and predicts all zero-in-degree alarms in each incident-induced subgraph. However, the learned graph remains fixed and cannot benefit from expert diagnoses of historical incidents. We close this loop with EvoCause. Expert labels constrain which alarms should be source nodes but do not specify the edge edits needed to satisfy those constraints. EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible graph edits, while deterministic code validates node identities and acyclicity and retains the best graph on a labeled alignment set. At test time, the refined graph alone produces transparent predictions without an LLM call. We also release TeleRCA, an expert-annotated benchmark from a production telecommunication network containing $485{,}681$ alarm events spanning $194$ alarm types over $5{,}621$ resources. On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with the PC causal discovery algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline, raising Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 by $11.59$, $9.40$, and $4.59$ percentage points, respectively, while reducing nSHD by $0.2379$. On TeleRCA, replacing human-readable alarm titles with anonymous identifiers lowers Node F1 and Case EM by $6.12$ and $8.04$ percentage points, respectively, indicating that alarm-name information contributes to graph refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoCause，一种利用大语言模型（LLM）引导因果图演化的根因分析（RCA）方法，面向电信、云和微服务系统中告警级联场景。EvoCause 用专家诊断标签约束告警源节点，由 LLM 提议语义上合理的图编辑，并用确定性代码校验节点身份和无环性，在标注对齐集上保留最优图；测试时仅用精炼后的图做透明预测，无需调用 LLM。作者还发布了来自生产电信网络的专家标注基准 TeleRCA，包含 485,681 条告警事件、194 种告警类型和 5,621 个资源。
Motivation: 现有 RCA 方法从观测日志学习因果图后保持固定，无法利用历史事件的专家诊断结果来改进图结构，形成反馈闭环的缺失。
Method: EvoCause 将专家标签作为源节点约束，但不指定具体边编辑；使用 LLM 提出语义合理的图编辑候选，由确定性代码验证节点身份和 acyclicity，并在带标签的对齐集上保留最优图，测试阶段仅依赖精炼后的图进行预测。
Result: 在合成数据上，以 PC 因果发现算法初始化的 EvoCause 相比未精炼的 PC 基线，Node F1、Case EM 和 Graph F1 分别提升 11.59、9.40 和 4.59 个百分点，nSHD 降低 0.2379。在 TeleRCA 上，将可读的告警标题替换为匿名标识符会使 Node F1 和 Case EM 分别下降 6.12 和 8.04 个百分点，说明告警名称信息有助于图精炼。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 引导的图编辑配合确定性校验可以闭环利用专家诊断改进 RCA 因果图，且推理时无需 LLM 调用；告警名称语义信息对精炼效果有显著贡献。

papers.title: TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification
papers.abstract_en: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIER-MoE，一种风险引导的子空间混合专家（mixture-of-experts）模型，用于多模态生物医学分类。它将样本特定的模态可靠性定义为单模态预测器预期产生的预测损失，并通过未在该样本上训练的模型生成的留折预测（out-of-fold predictions）来学习该风险。TIER-MoE 结合估计风险与专家特定子空间兼容性进行稀疏模态-专家路由，同时用始终激活的共享路径保留多模态互补性。在阿尔茨海默病状态、皮肤病变恶性、视网膜分类等四个公共多模态生物医学数据集上，作者报告其在预测性能和概率校准上优于现有方法，并在外部队列上表现出强零样本泛化。
Motivation: 多模态融合的初衷是结合互补证据源，但更多证据并不总能带来更好的预测。现有融合方法通过更丰富的跨模态交互和样本自适应融合取得进展，然而融合时赋予模态的权重并不能揭示该来源是否不可靠、冗余或与专门专家匹配不佳。
Method: 提出 TIER-MoE，一种风险引导的子空间混合专家模型。它把样本特定模态可靠性定义为单模态预测器预期损失，并利用未在该样本上训练的模型所产生的留折预测来学习该风险；随后将估计风险与专家特定子空间兼容性结合，进行稀疏模态-专家路由，同时保留始终激活的共享路径以维持多模态互补性。
Result: 在四个公共多模态生物医学数据集上，TIER-MoE 在预测性能和概率校准上均优于现有方法，Macro-F1 和 Brier score 取得一致改进，并对来自外部队列的数据表现出强零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将样本级模态风险估计与稀疏专家路由结合，可以在多模态生物医学分类中同时改善判别性能与校准质量，并支持对外部数据的零样本泛化。

papers.title: PIE-APT: A Unified Framework for Temporal Planning and Contradiction Hunting via Incremental Direct-Derivation Abduction
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning and planning over Dynamic Knowledge Graphs (DKGs) present significant challenges, especially in open-world environments with incomplete information. Existing action formalisms often face decidability issues and the Ramification Problem, while managing incomplete knowledge via structural abduction requires expansive combinatorial search. This paper introduces a unified framework with two integrated modules---\textbf{PIE-Abducer} (incremental direct-derivation abduction) and \textbf{PIE-APT} (Abductive Planning for Temporal KGs)---operating natively on the highly expressive Description Logic. We model state transitions along a linear timeline as non-monotonic updates to deductively closed DL theories. Treating the incremental reasoner as a black-box and representing actions natively in OWL without external modal operators preserves logical decidability. To address incomplete knowledge, \textbf{PIE-Abducer} circumvents traditional Minimal Hitting Set (MHS) enumeration. Instead of combinatorial syntactic search, it injects the logical negation of a target goal into a consistent branch and extracts missing premises via direct refutation consequences. \textbf{PIE-APT} then employs a recursive \textit{Generate-and-Test} architecture, interleaving backward-chaining A* search with \textbf{PIE-Abducer} up to a bounded causal depth, followed by strict validation via forward-chaining Temporal Projection. We evaluate four OWL benchmarks stressing semantic abilities absent in classical planning: parameterized goals with witness search, mid-search DL entailment, open-world assumption injection, and adversarial contradiction hunting. Results demonstrate qualitative superiority over classical planners and prove our direct-derivation approach quantitatively outperforms an MHS-faithful baseline during abductive enrichment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向动态知识图谱 (Dynamic Knowledge Graphs, DKGs) 上的时序推理与规划，提出统一框架 PIE-APT，包含 PIE-Abducer 增量直接推导溯因模块和 PIE-APT 溯因规划模块，原生运行在表达力强的描述逻辑 (Description Logic) 上。作者将线性时间线上的状态转移建模为对演绎封闭 DL 理论的非单调更新，把增量推理器视为黑盒，并在 OWL 中直接表示动作而不引入外部模态算子，以保持逻辑可判定性。四个 OWL 基准上的评估显示该方法在定性上优于经典规划器，且直接推导方法在溯因富化阶段定量优于基于最小碰集 (Minimal Hitting Set, MHS) 的基线。
Motivation: 开放世界、信息不完备环境下的 DKG 推理与规划存在显著困难，现有动作形式化常面临可判定性问题与分支问题 (Ramification Problem)，而通过结构溯因管理不完备知识需要庞大的组合搜索。
Method: PIE-Abducer 避免传统 MHS 枚举，通过将目标公式的逻辑否定注入一致分支并从直接反驳后果中提取缺失前提；PIE-APT 采用递归的 Generate-and-Test 架构，在有界因果深度内交替进行反向链 A* 搜索与 PIE-Abducer，再用前向链时序投影 (Temporal Projection) 做严格验证。
Result: 在四个强调经典规划中不具备的语义能力的 OWL 基准上（参数化目标与见证搜索、搜索中途的 DL 蕴含、开放世界假设注入、对抗性矛盾狩猎），该方法定性优于经典规划器；直接推导方法在溯因富化阶段定量优于 MHS 忠实基线。
Conclusion: 该框架通过黑盒增量推理与 OWL 原生动作表示保持逻辑可判定性，并以直接反驳推导规避 MHS 组合搜索，适用于不完备信息下的时序知识图谱规划与矛盾发现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Toward Multi-Modal Deep Learning for Pulmonary Disease Classification: A Texture-Based Machine Learning Pilot Study on Public Chest X-Ray Data
papers.abstract_en: Automated classification of pulmonary disease from chest radiographs is a widely studied application of machine learning in medical imaging. This paper presents a pilot study evaluating classical texture- and gradient-based feature representations for distinguishing COVID-19 from other forms of pneumonia using the publicly available COVID-19 Image Data Collection (668 posteroanterior/anteroposterior radiographs from 408 patients). Using histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) and gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) texture descriptors with classical classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machine), evaluated under patient-level 5-fold stratified cross-validation to prevent data leakage, we obtain a best mean accuracy of 75.4% and AUC of 0.755, modestly exceeding the 71.6% majority-class baseline. We report these results transparently, including their limitations, and use them to motivate and scope a proposed multi-modal deep learning architecture -- combining convolutional and transformer-based encoders across imaging modalities -- as a direction for future work requiring access to larger, multi-institutional, ethically sourced datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项针对胸部X射线影像的肺病分类试点研究，利用公开的 COVID-19 Image Data Collection 数据集（408名患者的668张后前位/前后位影像），评估基于纹理和梯度的经典特征表示。研究比较了 HOG 与 GLCM 特征搭配逻辑回归、随机森林和支持向量机等经典分类器，并在患者层面5折分层交叉验证下取得了75.4%的最佳平均准确率和0.755的AUC，略高于71.6%的多数类基线。作者将此结果作为后续多模态深度学习架构（结合卷积与Transformer编码器）的动机和范围界定。
Motivation: 胸部X射线的肺部疾病自动分类是医学影像机器学习中的常见任务，本文针对 COVID-19 与其他类型肺炎的区分进行早期探索，并强调需要防止数据泄漏的评估方式。
Method: 提取方向梯度直方图（HOG）和灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）纹理描述符，使用逻辑回归、随机森林和支持向量机等经典分类器进行分类，采用患者层面的5折分层交叉验证以避免数据泄漏，并提出了结合卷积与Transformer编码器的多模态深度学习架构作为未来方向。
Result: 最佳平均准确率为75.4%，AUC为0.755，适度超过71.6%的多数类基线。

papers.title: Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，讨论长时程 (long-horizon) 评测基准中 agent 随任务变长而失败增多的现象。作者指出仅观察到失败率上升并不能解释失败原因，提出将完整任务的实际成功率与由单个短阶段预测的基线成功率进行比较，并把两者对数比值定义为 horizon residual。文章强调这类比较必须使用相同 agent 配置，并预先规定阶段、检查点、信息与预算的选择方式。
Motivation: 现有长时程基准普遍显示任务越长 agent 越容易失败，但该观察只对部署有参考价值，无法解释失败根源：更多阶段可能只是让普通错误累积，也可能包含更难的独立决策，或由轨迹本身导致后续更难。作者希望区分这种被称为轨迹诱导退化 (trajectory-induced degradation)、尤其是文本可见时的 context rot 现象。
Method: 提出用短而独立的单阶段表现构造基线预测，将真正全任务成功率与该基线的对数比值称为 horizon residual。要求对比在同一 agent 配置下进行，并事先明确阶段切分、检查点、信息可见性及预算分配等设定。
Result: 作为立场论文，本文不报告实证结果；作者认为 horizon residual 可以证明完整 rollout 与所选基线存在差异，但解释差异成因仍需针对性的实验设计。
Conclusion: 要声称存在“长时程失败”，基准必须把全任务成功率与基于短阶段构造的基线预测做对比，而 residual 只是指明差异存在，不能替代对其来源的因果解释。

papers.title: The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%. One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受成核过程启发的驱动成核速率定律 (driven-nucleation rate law) 来描述语言模型能力的涌现：能力形成的关键步骤是电路各部分的联合对齐，且没有部分学分 (no partial credit)，任何一块未对齐则该次尝试无价值。作者在 Pythia 等模型上通过 Ablation、前向预测、反向延迟实验和受控门控注意力模型验证该定律，并表明验证损失无法监测能力缺失。
Motivation: 标准训练监控（如验证损失）在能力涌现和可塑性丧失过程中保持平滑，无法反映能力尚未形成或永远无法形成的状态；现有理论缺乏对“部分对齐无价值”这一速率限制步骤的刻画。
Method: 将能力形成建模为一次稀有事件：速率方程写作 sites × attempts × drive × exp(−βK) 减去破坏项，其中势垒 K 随缺失部件数增长；配套实验包括 Pythia 上 7 种能力、3 个尺度的部件消融，以及受控 gated-attention 模型来证明机制。
Result: 在无捷径装置中，五部件电路缺三件与三部件电路缺三件的等待时间比为 1.19–1.37，说明等待取决于缺失部件数而非电路大小；消融单部件后 32/32 个判别单元的中位残留能力为 17%，而部分学分预期为 50–83%（p = 2e-10）。前向预测在浓度阈值之上 10/10 点火、之下 0/12；反向学习中延迟超过临界步后能力永不涌现，且验证损失始终平滑下降；仅重初始化 query-key 切片恢复可学习性 (6/6)，value 切片无效 (0/6)。
Conclusion: 作者将适用范围界定为 1.4B 规模以内的 Transformer 中的合取电路 (conjunction circuits)，并指出该机制下标准监控指标对可塑性丧失不可见，而定向重初始化 query-key 是有效的干预手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Expected Survival-Time Bounds for Robust Optimization Over Time under Isotropic Gaussian Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Robust Optimization Over Time (ROOT) is a recent branch of evolutionary dynamic optimization that seeks solutions capable of remaining effective across multiple consecutive environments. Unlike the traditional track-the-moving-optimum (TMO) paradigm, which reoptimizes after every environmental change, ROOT explicitly values persistence. Although the field has grown considerably, most contributions remain algorithmic and empirical, leaving several fundamental properties poorly understood from a theoretical perspective. One such property is survival time, defined as the number of future environments in which a deployed solution continues to satisfy a prescribed quality threshold. While survival time is widely used as a measure of temporal robustness, little is known about how its expected value depends on environmental dynamics, deployment quality, or problem characteristics. This paper studies expected survival time for a fixed deployed solution under isotropic Gaussian environmental dynamics. Modeling survival as a discrete first-exit problem, we derive a rigorous lower bound and a computable multi-step upper bound. The analysis shows that expected survival scales as $Θ(σ^-{2})$ in slowly varying environments and approaches its minimum value of one future change in high dimensions. A comprehensive Monte Carlo study validates the theoretical predictions, examines sensitivity to modeling assumptions and parameter uncertainty, and illustrates how the bounds can support deployment decisions after optimization. The resulting framework provides an analytical characterization of deployment lifetime and identifies when a required deployment horizon can be guaranteed, ruled out, or remains analytically unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究鲁棒优化随时间变化（ROOT）中固定部署解在等向高斯环境动态下的期望生存时间（expected survival time），将生存建模为离散首出（discrete first-exit）问题。作者推导了严格下界与可计算的多步上界，证明在缓慢变化环境中期望生存时间按 Θ(σ^{-2}) 缩放，而在高维下趋于最小值 1。蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论预测，并展示了这些界可用于部署决策。
Motivation: ROOT 领域的大多数贡献仍是算法与经验性的，生存时间作为时间鲁棒性的常用度量，其期望值如何依赖环境动态、部署质量与问题特征在理论上缺乏刻画。
Method: 将生存时间建模为离散首出问题，在等向高斯环境动态下推导固定部署解的期望生存时间严格下界与可计算的多步上界，并通过蒙特卡洛研究检验模型假设与参数不确定性下的敏感性。
Result: 分析表明期望生存时间在缓慢变化环境中按 Θ(σ^{-2}) 缩放，在高维环境中趋近其最小值（一次未来变化）。全面的蒙特卡洛研究验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 所提框架给出了部署寿命的解析刻画，并识别出给定部署时域时可以保证、可以排除或仍无法解析判定的情况。

papers.title: OVEarth-Bench: Evaluating Category Breadth and Query Diversity for Open-Vocabulary Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary Earth observation (EO) aims to localize geospatial concepts specified in natural language rather than a fixed label set. Existing benchmarks, however, usually cover narrow category vocabularies or limited query forms. To fill this gap, we introduce OVEarth-Bench, which extends existing evaluation in two directions: category breadth, through broad hierarchical category coverage with positive and negative expressions, and query diversity, through vocabulary, referring, and reasoning queries. The benchmark supports mask and box localization under a unified zero-shot protocol. We evaluate a broad set of general and EO-specific methods. The evaluation reveals that: (1) the performance of current methods remains limited, while broader category coverage yields more stable model rankings; (2) MLLM-based methods achieve the strongest overall performance; and (3) EO-specific methods generally underperform general models and rarely match the strongest methods. These findings provide guidance for future open-vocabulary EO method design and highlight the importance of developing more realistic, diverse, high-quality, and large-scale benchmarks for reliable evaluation. Our data and evaluation package are released at https://earth-insights.github.io/OVEarth-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OVEarth-Bench，一个面向开放词汇地球观测 (open-vocabulary Earth observation, EO) 的评测基准，从类别广度与查询多样性两个方向扩展现有评估。基准涵盖分层类别并包含肯定与否定表达，查询类型分为词汇、指代和推理三类，并在统一零样本协议下支持掩码与框定位。评测结果表明当前方法性能仍然有限，MLLM 类方法整体最强，而 EO 专用方法普遍不如通用模型。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇地球观测基准通常只覆盖较窄的类别词汇表或有限的查询形式，难以可靠评测模型在真实多样场景下的表现。
Method: 构建 OVEarth-Bench，通过广度分层类别覆盖（含正负表达式）和三类查询多样性（词汇、指代、推理）扩展评估，并在统一零样本协议下同时支持掩码定位与框定位。
Result: 对通用方法与 EO 专用方法的评估显示：当前方法整体性能有限，更广的类别覆盖带来更稳定的模型排名；基于 MLLM 的方法取得最强综合性能；EO 专用方法普遍低于通用模型，且很少能匹敌最强方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为未来开放词汇 EO 方法设计提供指导，并强调构建更真实、多样、高质量和大规模基准对于可靠评测的重要性；数据和评测包已公开。

papers.title: Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

papers.title: Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision
papers.abstract_en: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BridgeMIL，一个将 EEG 实例表示学习与主题级监督解耦的两阶段框架。第一阶段在没有继承实例标签的情况下预训练编码器，通过时间邻近窗口与同主题子袋对齐，并引入方差和协方差正则化防止表示坍缩；第二阶段将编码器迁移到基于注意力的 MIL 聚合器，仅对主题预测施加监督，并用特征保留机制限制表示漂移。在三个 EEG 疾病数据集和五个代表性骨干网络上，BridgeMIL 在 15 个数据集-骨干设置中的 14 个取得最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率为 76.57%，比最强基线高 4.28 个百分点。
Motivation: 常见 EEG 诊断流程将记录切分为短实例并继承主题标签，隐式假设所有实例提供等价的诊断证据；而端到端 MIL 虽避免继承标签，但 EEG 数据集中主题数远少于实例数，可能限制所学表示的质量。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段不依赖继承标签，通过时间邻近窗口和同主题内子袋的样本对齐来预训练编码器，并用方差与协方差正则化防止表示坍缩、降低冗余，且不引入负样本对；第二阶段将编码器适配到注意力式 MIL 聚合器，监督信号只作用于主题预测，并通过特征保留限制表示漂移。
Result: 在三个 EEG 疾病数据集和五个骨干网络构成的 15 个设置中，BridgeMIL 有 14 个达到最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率 76.57%，比最强基线高 4.28 个百分点。进一步分析显示实例间继承标签可靠性差异明显，性能对主题稀缺比实例稀缺更敏感，且学到的表示空间更结构化，主题级簇更清晰、诊断类别分离更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应使监督与主题级预测目标保持一致，同时利用大量 EEG 实例而不必为每个实例赋予疾病标签；这种解耦式训练能提升基于脑电的疾病诊断性能。

papers.title: SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SDO（Structure-Aware Data Organization），一种即插即用的 LLM 后训练数据组织框架，通过基于表示空间结构的逐轮（epoch）小批量组合与样本曝光调度来加速 SFT、DPO 和 GRPO 的收敛。SDO 使用冻结的外部嵌入，在轮内通过 KNN 邻居遍历构造局部连贯的小批量，在轮间记录样本参与次数并降低过度曝光样本的采样概率。摘要报告其在早期到中期训练阶段收敛加速最明显，并产生更连贯的梯度和更均衡的各题型准确率，且不会永久排除训练样本。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后训练的效率改进主要关注样本选择或训练调度，而数据组织本身被视为静态预处理步骤：基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构造固定划分，无法适应优化过程中样本曝光的动态变化，导致部分样本冗余更新、部分样本欠优化。
Method: 提出 SDO 框架，包含两个机制：轮内 locality-aware batching 通过 KNN 邻域遍历形成连贯的小批量；轮间 exposure-balanced scheduling 记录每个样本的参与次数并降低过度曝光样本的采样概率。框架基于冻结的外部嵌入逐轮运行，避免模型热身训练开销。
Result: 在 SFT、DPO 和 GRPO 上，SDO 均加速收敛，最大收益出现在早期到中期训练阶段，并产生更连贯的梯度和更均衡的各题型准确率。
Conclusion: SDO 作为即插即用框架证明数据组织本身可以动态适应训练过程，在不永久排除样本的情况下提升后训练效率。

papers.title: RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLPF（reinforcement learning from performance feedback），把执行结果转化为分阶段奖励：失败程序按执行进度排序，正确程序按相对基线与专家参考的改进程度排序，从而让代码智能体在正确性之外也优化运行效率。用 RLPF 微调 Qwen3-32B 后，在 PerfCodeBench 上 correct-and-runnable solutions 从 11.1% 提升到 54.6%，相对效率从 8.1% 提升到 38.6%，并适度迁移到 EffiBench-X。
Motivation: 现有代码模型训练信号大多止步于正确性，但系统代码中两个程序可以通过相同测试却运行时间差异很大；运行时作为奖励很脆弱，只对正确程序有意义、跨任务变化大，且多数采样程序无法编译或运行。
Method: 提出 RLPF，将执行结果设计为 staged reward：失败程序按执行进度排序，正确程序按相对基线向专家参考的改进排序，从而在正确性之前提供有用反馈、在正确性之后提供性能敏感反馈。
Result: 摘要报告在 PerfCodeBench 上微调 Qwen3-32B 后，correct-and-runnable solutions 从 11.1% 提高到 54.6%，相对效率从 8.1% 提高到 38.6%；训练出的模型可匹敌更强的开源权重系统，且优化行为适度迁移到 EffiBench-X。额外研究表明模型生成参考提供有用但较弱的监督，完整组合奖励比正确性-only 或 runtime-only 基线更可靠。
Conclusion: 摘要强调代码智能体可以被训练为不仅通过测试、还优化其编写的程序；组合式分阶段奖励比单一正确性或单一运行时信号更可靠。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. papers.title: FAVA: Formal Authorization for Verified Agents with Evidence-Backed Permission Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents autonomously interleave semantic reasoning with complex system operations. In these dynamic environments, static tool-level permissions are fundamentally insufficient; safe authorization is highly context-dependent and heavily reliant on evolving runtime states and data flows. We present FAVA (Formal Authorization for Verified Agents), a permission-carrying authorization framework for agent execution. FAVA utilizes an LLM-guided Permission Intermediate Representation (IR) to translate ambiguous natural-language tasks into structured constraints. A deterministic lowering pass then converts this IR into an evidence-backed permission graph that explicitly tracks data flows, dependencies, and contextual labels. To provide strict security guarantees, a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) authorizer mathematically verifies the current graph against security policies before any effectful action executes. A runtime gateway then enforces the solver's result, either authorizing the execution or intercepting it with a precise counterexample. We evaluate FAVA across OpenAgentSafety, OctoBench, and ActPlane scenarios. Our evaluation demonstrates that FAVA achieves a 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate (DCR) over the aggregate dataset, successfully intercepting dynamic violating traces in the evaluated trace-conditioned scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAVA（Formal Authorization for Verified Agents），一个面向 LLM 代理执行的权限携带式授权框架。FAVA 利用 LLM 引导的权限中间表示（Permission IR）将模糊的自然语言任务翻译为结构化约束，再通过确定性 lowering 过程转换为证据支撑的权限图（permission graph），显式追踪数据流、依赖和上下文标签；SMT 求解器在任何有效动作执行前对权限图与安全策略做数学验证，运行时网关强制执行求解结果。在 OpenAgentSafety、OctoBench 和 ActPlane 场景上的评估显示，聚合数据集上的决策合规率（Decision Compliance Rate, DCR）达到 90.5%，并能拦截动态违规轨迹。
Motivation: LLM 代理将语义推理与复杂系统操作交织，静态工具级权限在这种动态环境中本质上不够安全，授权高度依赖运行状态和数据流，因而需要上下文相关且可验证的授权机制。
Method: 提出 LLM 引导的 Permission IR 将任务转化为结构化权限约束，再经确定性 lowering 生成带证据的权限图；随后用 Satisfiability Modulo Theories（SMT）求解器形式化验证当前图是否符合安全策略，并在运行时网关处执行或拦截，拦截时提供精确反例。
Result: 在 OpenAgentSafety、OctoBench 和 ActPlane 上评估，聚合数据集上 DCR 为 90.5%，并在所评估的轨迹条件场景中成功拦截动态违反轨迹。
Conclusion: FAVA 通过证据支撑的权限图与 SMT 形式化验证为代理执行提供严格安全保证，实验表明其在动态授权场景中有效；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Theatre Chapbooks At Scale: A Statistical Comparative Analysis of Typography
papers.abstract_en: We propose a statistical methodology that quantifies the similarity of typefaces between printed historical books. This provides a tool that accelerates philological analysis. Using character prototypes derived from clustering and aligning automatically extracted character images, the method defines a typeface distance between any two books. To produce actionable outputs, we develop an a contrario statistical framework to interpret the significance of the computed typeface distances. We apply the method to the philological study of 17 th -century Spanish printed theatre chapbooks in a quantity that exceeds the capabilities of systematic visual inspection by human experts. Our method enables the automatic comparison of Roman and Italic types extracted from different books. After validation by human experts, our method has led to new printer attributions being discovered, and former printer attributions being revised. This success strongly suggests that our method has the potential to enable digital bibliography on a larger scale than was previously possible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套统计方法，用于量化历史印刷书籍之间字体（typeface）的相似度。方法先通过聚类和对齐自动提取的字符图像得到字符原型（character prototypes），据此定义任意两本书之间的字体距离，并用 a contrario 统计框架判定距离的显著性。作者将该方法用于 17 世纪西班牙印刷戏剧 chapbooks 的语文学研究，规模超出人工目检能力；经专家验证后，方法发现了新的印刷商归属并修正了原有归属。
Motivation: 现有语文学分析依赖专家对印刷字体进行系统化目检，在书籍规模增大时不可行；本文目标是提供可加速语文学分析、并支持更大规模数字书目学（digital bibliography）的自动化定量工具。
Method: 通过聚类和对齐自动提取的字符图像来构建字符原型；基于原型定义任意两本书之间的字体距离，并开发 a contrario 统计框架来判断计算所得字体距离是否显著；支持自动比较不同书籍中的罗马体（Roman）与斜体（Italic）字样。
Result: 将该方法应用于超出人工系统目检能力的 17 世纪西班牙印刷戏剧 chapbooks；经人类专家验证，方法发现了新的印刷商归属，并修正了既有的印刷商归属。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，该方法的成功表明它有望以前所未有的规模支持数字书目学；目前结论建立在专家验证的案例上。

papers.title: PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlatformBid，一个从统一广告平台视角构建的自动出价 (auto-bidding) 综合基准。该基准考虑平台内部整合 SSP、DSP 与 Ad Exchange 的现实场景，目标同时优化广告主转化与平台总营收。作者定义了同质竞争、异质竞争和促销竞争三种代表性设置，系统评估了经典控制、基于 RL 与近期生成式方法，并提出基于流匹配 (flow-matching) 的新方法 BidFlow。在线实验在快手平台上显示目标成本提升 +0.68%，为离线-在线一致性提供了部署证据。
Motivation: 现有自动出价研究只聚焦 DSP 侧，以最大化广告主转化率为目标，而当前大型广告平台已将 SSP、DSP 和 Ad Exchange 功能内部整合，平台视角下还需考虑平台总营收；同时缺乏以平台为中心的评估框架，阻碍了自动出价研究的推进。
Method: 提出 PlatformBid 基准，包含三种反映真实场景的设置：广告主使用相同算法的同质竞争、使用多样算法的异质竞争，以及类似黑色星期五期间部分广告主突增预算的促销竞争。除评估经典控制、RL 和生成式方法外，还提出基于流匹配的 BidFlow，利用其富有表达力的策略表示来应对动态竞争环境。
Result: 摘要报告对多种现有自动出价方法的系统评估，并称在线实验在快手上实现目标成本 +0.68% 的提升，为 PlatformBid 的离线-在线一致性提供了部署证据。
Conclusion: PlatformBid 是首个从统一广告平台视角构建的自动出价基准，覆盖三种代表性竞争设置；BidFlow 在动态竞争中表现有效，且在线部署结果支持基准的离线-在线一致性。
Relevance: 2
