papers.title: A novel k-means clustering approach using two distance measures for Gaussian data
authors: Naitik Gada (1) ((1) Rochester Institute of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Clustering algorithms have long been the topic of research, representing the more popular side of unsupervised learning. Since clustering analysis is one of the best ways to find some clarity and structure within raw data, this paper explores a novel approach to k-means clustering. Here we present a k-means clustering algorithm that takes both the within cluster distance (WCD) and the inter cluster distance (ICD) as the distance metric to cluster the data into k clusters pre-determined by the Calinski-Harabasz criterion in order to provide a more robust output for the clustering analysis. The idea with this approach is that by including both the measurement metrics, the convergence of the data into their clusters becomes solidified and more robust. We run the algorithm with some synthetically produced data and also some benchmark data sets obtained from the UCI repository. The results show that the convergence of the data into their respective clusters is more accurate by using both WCD and ICD measurement metrics. The algorithm is also better at clustering the outliers into their true clusters as opposed to the traditional k means method. We also address some interesting possible research topics that reveal themselves as we answer the questions we initially set out to address.
papers.comment: Keywords: machine learning, clustering algorithms, k-means
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型 k-means 聚类算法，将簇内距离 (WCD) 与簇间距离 (ICD) 共同作为距离度量，并用 Calinski-Harabasz 准则预先确定簇数 k。作者在合成数据与 UCI 基准数据集上运行算法，结果显示相比传统 k-means，数据收敛到各自簇的准确度更高，且能更好地将离群点聚类到其真实簇。
Motivation: 聚类分析是理解原始数据结构的常用手段，但传统 k-means 的收敛稳健性以及离群点归属效果有限；论文希望同时纳入簇内和簇间距离度量，使数据向簇的收敛更加稳健。
Method: 提出一个同时使用簇内距离 (WCD) 与簇间距离 (ICD) 作为距离度量的 k-means 变体，簇数 k 由 Calinski-Harabasz 准则预先确定，从而为聚类分析提供更稳健的输出。
Result: 论文在合成数据和 UCI 仓库的基准数据集上的实验表明，同时使用 WCD 与 ICD 两种度量时，数据向其各自簇的收敛更准确；与传统 k-means 相比，该算法也能更好地将离群点聚类到其真实簇。
Conclusion: 摘要指出在回答初始问题过程中还涌现出一些值得关注的未来研究方向；论文针对高斯数据设计该方法，且未提供超出上述实验结果的更广泛适用范围声明。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MOON2.0: Dynamic Modality-balanced Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced e-commerce product understanding. However, they still face three challenges: (i) the modality imbalance induced by modality mixed training; (ii) underutilization of the intrinsic alignment relationships among visual and textual information within a product; and (iii) limited handling of noise in e-commerce multimodal data. To address these, we propose MOON2.0, a dynamic modality-balanced MultimOdal representation learning framework for e-commerce prOduct uNderstanding. It comprises: (1) a Modality-driven Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) that adaptively processes input samples by their modality composition, enabling Multimodal Joint Learning to mitigate the modality imbalance; (2) a Dual-level Alignment method to better leverage semantic alignment properties inside individual products; and (3) an MLLM-based Image-text Co-augmentation strategy that integrates textual enrichment with visual expansion, coupled with Dynamic Sample Filtering to improve training data quality. We further release MBE2.0, a co-augmented Multimodal representation Benchmark for E-commerce representation learning and evaluation at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZHNie/MBE2.0. Experiments show that MOON2.0 delivers state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on MBE2.0 and multiple public datasets. Furthermore, attention-based heatmap visualization provides qualitative evidence of improved multimodal alignment of MOON2.0.
papers.comment: Accepted by the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026. 11 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOON2.0，一个面向电商商品理解的动态模态均衡多模态表示学习框架，针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在模态混合训练下的模态失衡、商品内图文语义对齐利用不足以及电商多模态数据噪声等问题。方法包括模态驱动的混合专家（Modality-driven MoE）、双层级对齐（Dual-level Alignment）以及基于 MLLM 的图像-文本协同增强与动态样本过滤。作者还发布了协同增强的多模态表示基准 MBE2.0，实验显示 MOON2.0 在 MBE2.0 及多个公开数据集上取得 SOTA 零样本性能。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在电商商品理解中面临三个问题：模态混合训练导致模态不平衡、商品内视觉与文本信息的内在对齐关系未被充分利用、对电商多模态数据中的噪声处理有限。
Method: 提出 MOON2.0 框架，包含三个组件：按输入样本模态组成自适应处理的 Modality-driven MoE 以支持多模态联合学习并缓解模态失衡；双层级对齐方法利用单个商品内部的语义对齐属性；基于 MLLM 的图像-文本协同增强策略结合文本丰富化与视觉扩展，并配合动态样本过滤提升训练数据质量。
Result: 实验表明 MOON2.0 在 MBE2.0 和多个公开数据集上达到 SOTA 零样本性能；基于注意力的热图可视化提供了改进多模态对齐的定性证据。
Conclusion: 作者通过发布 MBE2.0 基准并验证 MOON2.0 的零样本表现，表明动态模态均衡与协同增强策略能够有效提升电商场景下的多模态商品表示学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human Mesh Modeling for Anny Body
papers.abstract_en: Parametric body models provide the structural basis for many human-centric tasks, yet existing models often rely on costly 3D scans and learned shape spaces that are proprietary and demographically narrow. We introduce Anny, a simple, fully differentiable, and scan-free human body model grounded in anthropometric knowledge from the MakeHuman community. Anny defines a continuous, interpretable shape space, where phenotype parameters (e.g. gender, age, height, weight) control blendshapes spanning a wide range of human forms---across ages (from infants to elders), body types, and proportions. Calibrated using WHO population statistics, Anny provides realistic and demographically grounded human shape variation within a single unified model. We release the Anny body model and its code under the Apache 2.0 license. Thanks to its openness and semantic control, Anny serves as a versatile foundation for 3D human modeling---supporting millimeter-accurate scan fitting, controlled synthetic data generation, and Human Mesh Recovery (HMR). We further introduce Anny-One, a collection of 780k photorealistic images generated with Anny, showing that despite its simplicity, HMR models trained with Anny can match the performance of those trained with scan-based body models.
papers.comment: Presented at ECCV 2026. Code available at https://github.com/naver/anny
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anny，一个完全可微、无需 3D 扫描的人体参数化模型，基于 MakeHuman 社区的人类学知识构建。Anny 提供连续且可解释的形状空间，用性别、年龄、身高、体重等表型参数控制 blendshapes，并依据 WHO 人群统计校准，覆盖从婴儿到老年的广泛体型。作者还发布 Anny-One，一个包含 78 万张照片级逼真图像的合成数据集，并展示用 Anny 训练的 HMR 模型性能可与基于扫描的模型相当。
Motivation: 现有参数化人体模型通常依赖昂贵的 3D 扫描数据，且学习的形状空间多为专有、人口学覆盖狭窄。本文旨在提供一个基于公开人类学知识的、开放且无扫描的人体模型，以支持更广泛的人群形状变化。
Method: 引入 Anny 人体模型，利用 MakeHuman 社区的人类学统计知识定义连续可解释形状空间，通过表型参数控制 blendshapes，并使用 WHO 人群统计进行校准。模型以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源发布，同时生成 78 万张合成图像数据集 Anny-One 用于训练 HMR。
Result: 摘要报告 Anny 支持毫米级精度的扫描拟合，Anny-One 数据集包含 78 万张照片级逼真图像；在 Human Mesh Recovery 任务上，基于 Anny 训练的模型性能可以匹配基于扫描数据训练的模型。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Anny 因其开放性和语义化控制，可作为 3D 人体建模的通用基础，适用于扫描拟合、受控合成数据生成和 HMR；其优越性来自基于人群统计的校准与无需扫描数据的设计。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有参数化人体模型通常依赖昂贵的 3D 扫描数据，且学习的形状空间多为专有、人口学覆盖狭窄。本文旨在提供一个基于公开人类学知识的、开放且无扫描的人体模型，以支持更广泛的人群形状变化。
summary_sections.method: 引入 Anny 人体模型，利用 MakeHuman 社区的人类学统计知识定义连续可解释形状空间，通过表型参数控制 blendshapes，并使用 WHO 人群统计进行校准。模型以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源发布，同时生成 78 万张合成图像数据集 Anny-One 用于训练 HMR。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Anny 支持毫米级精度的扫描拟合，Anny-One 数据集包含 78 万张照片级逼真图像；在 Human Mesh Recovery 任务上，基于 Anny 训练的模型性能可以匹配基于扫描数据训练的模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 Anny 因其开放性和语义化控制，可作为 3D 人体建模的通用基础，适用于扫描拟合、受控合成数据生成和 HMR；其优越性来自基于人群统计的校准与无需扫描数据的设计。

papers.title: What Is The Performance Ceiling of My Classifier? Utilizing Category-Wise Influence Functions for Pareto Frontier Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Data-centric learning seeks to improve model performance from the perspective of data quality, and has been drawing increasing attention in the machine learning community. Among its key tools, influence functions provide a powerful framework to quantify the impact of individual training samples on model predictions, enabling practitioners to identify detrimental samples and retrain models on a cleaner dataset for improved performance. However, most existing work focuses on the question: "what data benefits the learning model?" In this paper, we take a step further and investigate a more fundamental question: "what is the performance ceiling of the learning model?" Unlike prior studies that primarily measure improvement through overall accuracy, we emphasize category-wise accuracy and aim for Pareto improvements, ensuring that every class benefits, rather than allowing tradeoffs where some classes improve at the expense of others. To address this challenge, we propose category-wise influence functions and introduce an influence vector that quantifies the impact of each training sample across all categories. Leveraging these influence vectors, we develop a principled criterion to determine whether a model can still be improved, and further design a linear programming-based sample reweighting framework to achieve Pareto performance improvements. Through extensive experiments on synthetic datasets, vision, and text benchmarks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in estimating and achieving a model's performance improvement across multiple categories of interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类别级影响函数 (category-wise influence functions) 与影响向量 (influence vector)，用于估计分类模型的性能上限并实现跨类别的 Pareto 改进。作者通过线性规划 (linear programming) 的样本重加权框架，在合成数据、视觉和文本基准上验证了该方法能够在不牺牲其他类别精度的前提下提升多类别性能。
Motivation: 现有基于影响函数的数据中心学习主要回答“哪些数据对模型有益”，且通常以总体准确率衡量改进；本文转向更根本的问题：模型性能的天花板在哪里，并强调类别级精度的 Pareto 改进而非类间折衷。
Method: 定义类别级影响函数，为每个训练样本构造一个跨所有类别的影响向量；基于这些向量设计判定模型是否仍可改进的准则，并提出基于线性规划的样本重加权框架以实现 Pareto 性能改进。
Result: 在合成数据集、视觉和文本基准上的大量实验表明，该方法能够估计并实现模型在多个感兴趣类别上的性能提升，且实现 Pareto 改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调类别级精度与 Pareto 改进的重要性，认为该方法为数据中心学习提供了估计性能上限并指导数据重加权的原则性途径。

papers.title: Random Projection Flows for Efficient Manifold Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate density estimation is crucial for understanding complex high-dimensional data, but it becomes challenging when the data lies on or near low-dimensional manifolds. Random projections provide a natural way to reduce dimensionality while approximately preserving geometric structure, enabling effective density estimation in these settings. We introduce \emph{Random Projection Flows} (RPFs), a principled framework for injective normalizing flows that leverages tools from random matrix theory and the geometry of random projections. RPFs employ random semi-orthogonal matrices, drawn from Haar-distributed orthogonal ensembles via QR decomposition of Gaussian matrices, to project data into lower-dimensional latent spaces for the base distribution. Unlike principal component analysis flows or learned injective maps, RPFs are plug-and-play, efficient, and yield closed-form expressions for the Riemannian volume correction term. We demonstrate that RPFs are both theoretically grounded and practically effective, providing a strong baseline for generative modeling and a bridge between random projection theory and normalizing flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出随机投影流 (Random Projection Flows, RPFs)，一种基于随机半正交矩阵的内射归一化流 (injective normalizing flows) 密度估计框架。作者利用随机矩阵理论，通过高斯矩阵的 QR 分解从 Haar 分布正交系综中采样投影矩阵，将数据映射到低维潜空间，并得到 Riemannian 体积校正项的闭式表达式。摘要称该方法在理论上可解释、实践中有效，可作为生成建模的强基线，并连接随机投影理论与归一化流。
Motivation: 高维数据常位于或近似位于低维流形上，传统的密度估计方法难以处理这种退化结构；随机投影能以近似保持几何结构的方式降维，从而支持有效密度估计。
Method: RPFs 使用随机半正交矩阵（由高斯矩阵的 QR 分解从 Haar 分布正交系综中采样）将数据投影到低维潜空间作为基分布，区别于 PCA 流或学习型内射映射，属于即插即用 (plug-and-play) 方案，并为 Riemannian 体积校正项提供闭式解。
Result: 摘要没有给出具体数值，但声称 RPFs 在理论上有根基且实践有效，可作为生成建模的强基线。
Conclusion: RPFs 以高效且即插即用的方式实现流形上的密度估计，在随机投影理论与归一化流之间建立桥梁；其适用性仍限于摘要所述的理论与基线验证范围。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving High-Order Methods for the Compressible Euler Equations in Potential Temperature Formulation for Atmospheric Flows
papers.abstract_en: We develop structure-preserving numerical methods for the compressible Euler equations, employing potential temperature as a prognostic variable. We construct three numerical fluxes designed to ensure the conservation of entropy and total energy within the discontinuous Galerkin framework on general curvilinear meshes. Furthermore, we introduce a generalization for the kinetic energy preservation property and total energy conservation in the presence of a gravitational potential term. To this end, we adopt a flux-differencing approach for the discretization of the source term, treated as non-conservative product. We present well-balanced schemes for different constant background states for both formulations (total energy and potential temperature) on curvilinear meshes. Finally, we validate the methods by comparing the potential temperature formulation with the traditional Euler equations formulation across a range of classical atmospheric scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Computational Physics, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为可压缩欧拉方程（以位温作为预报变量）构建保结构数值方法，在一般曲线网格上的间断伽辽金（DG）框架中设计三种数值通量，以保证熵与总能守恒，并引入动能守恒性质及含重力势源项时总能守恒的推广。作者采用通量差分（flux-differencing）途径处理被当作非守恒乘积的源项，针对总能与位温两种公式给出不同常数背景态下的良平衡格式，并在经典大气场景中与传统欧拉方程公式进行对比验证。
Motivation: 大气流动数值模拟中，传统欧拉方程离散难以同时保持熵、总能等物理结构，位温作为预报变量时的守恒性与平衡态保持也缺少系统性方法。该文目标是构建在曲线网格上既保结构又良平衡的高阶离散格式。
Method: 在DG框架下构造三种数值通量以保证熵和总能守恒，给出动能守恒性质和含重力势时总能守恒的推广；采用通量差分途径离散被当作非守恒乘积的源项，并对总能与位温两种公式在不同常数背景态上设计良平衡格式。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验数字；方法通过一系列经典大气场景，将位温公式与传统欧拉方程公式进行对比验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提方法能在曲线网格上实现保结构（熵、总能、动能守恒）与良平衡性质，位温公式可作为传统欧拉方程公式的有效替代。摘要未说明局限性。

papers.title: Enhancing Scene Transition Awareness in Video Generation via Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-generated video have shown strong performance on \emph{text-to-video} tasks, particularly for short clips depicting a single scene. However, current models struggle to generate longer videos with coherent scene transitions, primarily because they cannot infer when a transition is needed from the prompt. Most open-source models are trained on datasets consisting of single-scene video clips, which limits their capacity to learn and respond to prompts requiring multiple scenes. Developing scene transition awareness is essential for multi-scene generation, as it allows models to identify and segment videos into distinct clips by accurately detecting transitions. To address this, we propose the \textbf{Transition-Aware Video} (TAV) dataset, which consists of preprocessed video clips with multiple scene transitions. Our experiment shows that post-training on the \textbf{TAV} dataset improves prompt-based scene transition understanding, narrows the gap between required and generated scenes, and maintains image quality.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 14th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing and the 4th Conference of the Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (2025) 706-721
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有文本生成视频模型难以生成具有连贯场景转换的长视频的问题，提出 Transition-Aware Video (TAV) 数据集，该数据集包含经过预处理的、具有多个场景转换的视频片段。摘要报告称在 TAV 数据集上进行后训练 (post-training) 能提升模型基于提示的场景转换理解能力，缩小所需场景与生成场景之间的差距，并保持图像质量。
Motivation: 当前 AI 生成视频模型在单场景短片上的 text-to-video 任务表现良好，但难以生成场景转换连贯的长视频，主要原因是从提示中无法推断何时需要转换。开源模型大多在单场景视频片段数据集上训练，限制了它们对多场景提示的学习和响应能力，因此需要发展场景转换意识 (scene transition awareness)。
Method: 提出 Transition-Aware Video (TAV) 数据集，由经过预处理的、包含多个场景转换的视频片段组成，并利用该数据集对现有视频生成模型进行后训练，以增强其场景转换意识。
Result: 实验表明，在 TAV 数据集上后训练能够改善基于提示的场景转换理解，缩小所需场景数与实际生成场景数之间的差距，同时保持图像质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为后训练于 TAV 数据集是增强视频生成模型场景转换意识的有效途径，有助于多场景视频生成任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Do AI Gains Become Broadly Shareable? A Policy Threshold for AI-Driven Automation
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven automation generates broad-based social benefit only if technical gains become visible, durable, and publicly claimable. We develop a policy-facing stress test by extending a standard task-automation growth model with an AI capability parameter that raises productivity on automatable tasks while holding the set of tasks fixed. The exercise is intentionally limited: it is not a forecast of AI timelines or a full welfare analysis, but a way to identify which institutions determine whether AI rents can support broad transfers. Calibrated to U.S. quantities, the model shows that capability alone is not decisive. Public capture, deployment costs, automation scope, and market structure jointly determine when AI gains become shareable. The main policy lesson is that moving from low to moderate public capture (33\%) can substitute for substantial AI capability growth, while pushing capture further to full nationalization yields smaller gains, especially if deployment or safety costs are high. Competition policy also has distributional consequences: opening concentrated AI markets may improve fairness and resilience, but can reduce the rent pool unless alternative public-claim institutions are built. Cross-nationally, tax-heavy systems lower the needed AI capability threshold through stronger effective revenue collection, while Singaporean and Abu Dhabi-style public-asset models show that governments can also capture AI gains through ownership and investment returns rather than taxes alone. Our framework therefore identifies which levers governments can act on now to make future AI gains easier to measure, claim, and distribute broadly.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. To appear in AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个面向政策的压力测试，通过扩展标准任务自动化增长模型并引入AI能力参数（在任务集合固定的前提下提高可自动化任务的生产率），考察AI驱动的自动化何时能产生广泛可共享的社会收益。模型以美国经济数据校准，结论是AI能力本身并非决定性因素，公共捕获（public capture）、部署成本、自动化范围与市场结构共同决定AI收益何时可被广泛分配。
Motivation: AI自动化只有在技术收益可见、持久且可被公众主张时才能产生广泛社会收益，但现有讨论缺乏识别哪些制度决定AI租金能否支撑普惠转移的分析工具。
Method: 扩展标准任务自动化增长模型，加入一个提高可自动化任务生产率的AI能力参数，并保持任务集合固定；用美国数据校准，作为非预测性、非完整福利分析的政策压力测试。
Result: 模型显示能力提升并非决定性：从低公共捕获转向中等公共捕获（33%）可在很大程度上替代显著的AI能力增长，而进一步推向完全国有化的收益递减，尤其在部署或安全成本较高时。竞争政策会改变分配：开放集中化的AI市场可能改善公平与韧性，但会缩小租金池，除非建立替代性的公共主张制度。跨国比较中，重税体系通过更强的有效税收征管降低所需AI能力门槛，而新加坡和阿布扎比式公共资产模型表明政府可通过所有权和投资回报而非仅靠税收捕获AI收益。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在识别政府当前可以采取行动的杠杆，使未来的AI收益更易于衡量、主张和广泛分配；作者明确限定该工作不是AI时间线预测或完整福利分析。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向政策的压力测试，通过扩展标准任务自动化增长模型并引入AI能力参数（在任务集合固定的前提下提高可自动化任务的生产率），考察AI驱动的自动化何时能产生广泛可共享的社会收益。模型以美国经济数据校准，结论是AI能力本身并非决定性因素，公共捕获（public capture）、部署成本、自动化范围与市场结构共同决定AI收益何时可被广泛分配。
summary_sections.motivation: AI自动化只有在技术收益可见、持久且可被公众主张时才能产生广泛社会收益，但现有讨论缺乏识别哪些制度决定AI租金能否支撑普惠转移的分析工具。
summary_sections.method: 扩展标准任务自动化增长模型，加入一个提高可自动化任务生产率的AI能力参数，并保持任务集合固定；用美国数据校准，作为非预测性、非完整福利分析的政策压力测试。

papers.title: Efficient LLMs with AMP: Attention Heads and MLP Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning drives a new wave in computing systems and triggers the automation of increasingly complex problems. In particular, Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced cognitive tasks, often matching or even surpassing human-level performance. However, their extensive parameters result in high computational costs and slow inference, posing challenges for deployment in resource-limited settings. Among the strategies to overcome the aforementioned challenges, pruning emerges as a successful mechanism since it reduces model size while maintaining predictive ability. In this paper, we introduce AMP: Attention Heads and MLP Pruning, a novel structured pruning method that efficiently compresses LLMs by removing less critical structures within Multi-Head Attention (MHA) and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). By projecting the input data onto weights, AMP assesses structural importance and overcomes the limitations of existing techniques, which often fall short in flexibility or efficiency. In particular, AMP surpasses the current state-of-the-art on commonsense reasoning tasks by up to 1.49 percentage points, achieving a 30% pruning ratio with minimal impact on zero-shot task performance. Moreover, AMP also improves inference speeds, making it well-suited for deployment in resource-constrained environments. We confirm the flexibility of AMP on different families of LLMs, including LLaMA and Phi.
papers.comment: Published in International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AMP (Attention Heads and MLP Pruning)，一种面向大语言模型的结构化剪枝方法，通过将输入数据投影到权重上来评估多头注意力 (MHA) 与多层感知机 (MLP) 中结构的重要性，并移除不关键的结构。摘要报告在常识推理任务上比当前 SOTA 最多提升 1.49 个百分点，在 30% 剪枝率下对 zero-shot 性能影响极小，同时提升推理速度，并在 LLaMA 和 Phi 等不同 LLM 家族上验证了灵活性。
Motivation: LLM 因参数量庞大导致计算成本高、推理慢，难以部署在资源受限环境；现有剪枝方法在灵活性或效率上存在不足。
Method: AMP 将输入数据投影到权重上，以此评估 MHA 和 MLP 内各结构的重要性，并据此进行结构化剪枝，从而压缩模型同时保持预测能力。
Result: 在常识推理任务上，AMP 比当前最优方法最多高 1.49 个百分点；在 30% 剪枝率下对 zero-shot 任务性能影响极小，并且提高了推理速度，在 LLaMA 和 Phi 上均有效。
Conclusion: AMP 能高效压缩 LLM，适合资源受限环境的部署，其灵活性在不同模型家族中得到验证。

papers.title: Hallucinations and Truth: A Comprehensive Accuracy Evaluation of RAG, LoRA and DoRA
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Generative AI have significantly improved the efficiency and adaptability of natural language processing (NLP) systems, particularly through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA). RAG integrates external knowledge to enhance factual consistency in generative outputs, while LoRA enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). DoRA further refines this process by optimizing fine-tuning through adaptive parameter ranking and domain-aware weight adjustments, improving learning efficiency while maintaining inference performance. This paper presents a large-scale empirical evaluation of RAG, LoRA, and DoRA, with model fine-tuning and generation performance assessed on 20,000 FAQ-based queries, while the knowledge base spans 400,000 entries. The study analyzes key performance metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and inference latency. Experimental results demonstrate that DoRA achieves the highest accuracy (90.1%), relevance score (0.88), and lowest latency (110 ms per query), outperforming both LoRA and RAG in real-world, domain-specific generative AI applications. Furthermore, this study examines the trade-offs between fine-tuning efficiency, computational cost, and real-time adaptability across different models. Findings highlight RAG's effectiveness in knowledge grounding, LoRA's cost-efficient domain adaptation, and DoRA's ability to balance fine-tuning efficiency with model precision. These insights provide practical guidance for deploying AI-driven generative systems in accuracy-critical domains such as healthcare, finance, and legal services, ensuring scalability, reliability, and optimal performance in dynamic environments.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 2nd International Conference on Federated Learning and Intelligent Computing Systems (FLICS), 10.1109/FLICS70075.2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 RAG、LoRA 与 DoRA 在领域特定生成式 AI 场景下进行大规模实证评估，使用 40 万条目的知识库和 2 万条 FAQ 查询完成模型微调与生成测试。摘要报告 DoRA 取得最高准确率 90.1%、相关性分数 0.88 和最低延迟 110 ms/query，优于 LoRA 与 RAG。作者还讨论了微调效率、计算成本与实时适应性之间的权衡，并为医疗、金融、法律等准确性关键领域提供部署指导。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 系统在准确性关键领域需要同时实现事实一致性、参数高效微调与低推理延迟，但缺乏对 RAG、LoRA、DoRA 在大规模真实场景下的系统性对比评估。
Method: 构建包含 40 万条知识库条目和 2 万条 FAQ 查询的大规模评测框架，对 RAG、LoRA、DoRA 进行微调和生成性能评估，并分析准确率、相关性与推理延迟等指标，以及微调效率、计算成本与实时适应性的权衡。
Result: DoRA 达到最高准确率 90.1%、相关性分数 0.88 和最低延迟 110 ms/query，全面优于 LoRA 与 RAG；RAG 在知识接地方面表现有效，LoRA 在低成本领域适应上表现高效。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些实证结果可为准确性关键领域部署生成式 AI 系统提供实践指导，并强调 DoRA 能在微调效率与模型精度之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Scalable Drift Monitoring in Medical Imaging AI
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into medical imaging has advanced clinical diagnostics but poses challenges in managing model drift and ensuring long-term reliability. To address these challenges, we develop MMC+, an enhanced framework for scalable drift monitoring, building upon the CheXstray framework that introduced real-time drift detection for medical imaging AI models using multi-modal data concordance. This work extends the original framework's methodologies, providing a more scalable and adaptable solution for real-world healthcare settings and offers a reliable and cost-effective alternative to continuous performance monitoring addressing limitations of both continuous and periodic monitoring methods. MMC+ introduces critical improvements to the original framework, including more robust handling of diverse data streams, improved scalability with the integration of foundation models like MedImageInsight for high-dimensional image embeddings without site-specific training, and the introduction of uncertainty bounds to better capture drift in dynamic clinical environments. Validated with real-world data from Massachusetts General Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, MMC+ effectively detects significant data shifts and correlates them with model performance changes. While not directly predicting performance degradation, MMC+ serves as an early warning system, indicating when AI systems may deviate from acceptable performance bounds and enabling timely interventions. By emphasizing the importance of monitoring diverse data streams and evaluating data shifts alongside model performance, this work contributes to the broader adoption and integration of AI solutions in clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMC+，一个可扩展的医学影像 AI 漂移监测框架，在 CheXstray 框架的基础上扩展，利用多模态数据一致性进行实时漂移检测。MMC+ 引入对多样化数据流的更稳健处理、集成 MedImageInsight 等基础模型以支持高维图像嵌入而无需站点特定训练，并引入不确定性边界以捕捉动态临床环境中的漂移。使用麻省总医院（Massachusetts General Hospital）COVID-19 期间的真实数据验证，MMC+ 能有效检测显著数据偏移并将其与模型性能变化相关联，但并非直接预测性能退化，而是作为早期预警系统。
Motivation: AI 在医学影像中的整合推进了临床诊断，但模型漂移的管理和长期可靠性成为挑战。连续监测与周期监测方法各有局限，需要一种可扩展、成本效益高的替代方案来保障真实医疗环境中的 AI 模型可靠性。
Method: 在 CheXstray 框架基础上开发 MMC+，增强多模态数据一致性的漂移监测；集成 MedImageInsight 等基础模型以生成高维图像嵌入，避免站点特定训练；引入不确定性边界以更稳健地处理多样化数据流，并适应动态临床环境。
Result: 使用麻省总医院 COVID-19 疫情期间的真实数据验证，MMC+ 能有效检测显著数据偏移并将这些偏移与模型性能变化相关联。摘要明确表示它不直接预测性能退化，而是作为早期预警系统。
Conclusion: MMC+ 作为早期预警系统，可指示 AI 系统何时可能偏离可接受的性能界限，从而支持及时干预。作者强调监测多样化数据流、将数据偏移评估与模型性能评估结合，对临床环境中 AI 的广泛采用与整合具有重要意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Morphological Detection and Classification of Microplastics and Nanoplastics Emerged from Consumer Products by Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Plastic pollution presents an escalating global issue, impacting health and environmental systems, with micro- and nanoplastics found across mediums from potable water to air. Traditional methods for studying these contaminants are labor-intensive and time-consuming, necessitating a shift towards more efficient technologies. In response, this paper introduces micro- and nanoplastics (MiNa), a novel and open-source dataset engineered for the automatic detection and classification of micro and nanoplastics using object detection algorithms. The dataset, comprising scanning electron microscopy images simulated under realistic aquatic conditions, categorizes plastics by polymer type across a broad size spectrum. We demonstrate the application of state-of-the-art detection algorithms on MiNa, assessing their effectiveness and identifying the unique challenges and potential of each method. The dataset not only fills a critical gap in available resources for microplastic research but also provides a robust foundation for future advancements in the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 MiNa 的新型开源数据集，用于微塑料和纳米塑料的自动检测与分类，包含在模拟真实水生条件下生成的扫描电子显微镜图像，并按聚合物类型和尺寸跨度对塑料进行分类。作者在该数据集上评估了多种最先进的目标检测算法，分析了各方法的挑战与潜力。该数据集旨在填补微塑料研究资源中的关键空白。
Motivation: 传统微塑料研究方法耗时费力，需要向更高效的自动化技术转变，而现有资源中缺乏专用于微塑料和纳米塑料检测与分类的数据集。
Method: 构建并开源 MiNa 数据集，使用扫描电子显微镜图像模拟真实水生条件，覆盖不同聚合物类型和广泛尺寸范围；并应用多种最先进的目标检测算法进行检测与分类评估。
Result: 摘要报告了在 MiNa 数据集上评估多种最先进检测算法的效果，并指出了每种方法的独特挑战和潜力，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 该数据集填补了微塑料研究可用资源的关键空白，并为该领域未来的方法发展提供了基础。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation under Noncompliance in the Illinois Workplace Wellness Study with Bayesian Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Estimating varying treatment effects in randomized trials with noncompliance is inherently challenging since variation comes from two separate sources: variation in the impact itself and variation in the compliance rate. In this setting, existing flexible machine learning methods are sensitive to the weak instruments problem and can yield unstable estimates of heterogeneity when run repeatedly with different initialization or random seeds. Our main methodological contribution is to present a Bayesian Causal Forest model for binary response variables in scenarios with noncompliance. By repeatedly imputing individuals' compliance types, we can flexibly estimate heterogeneous treatment effects among compliers. Simulation studies demonstrate the usefulness of our approach when compliance and treatment effects are heterogeneous. We use this method to detect and analyze heterogeneity in the treatment effects in the Illinois Workplace Wellness Study, which not only features heterogeneous and one-sided compliance but also several binary outcomes of interest. We focus on three outcomes one year after intervention. We confirm a null effect on the presence of a chronic condition, discover meaningful heterogeneity in the impact of the intervention on metabolic parameters though the average effect is null in classical partial effect estimates, and find heterogeneity in the intervention's effect on individuals' perception of management prioritization of health and safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对存在不依从（noncompliance）的随机试验，提出一种面向二值响应变量的贝叶斯因果森林（Bayesian Causal Forest）模型。通过重复插补个体的依从类型，该方法可在依从者（compliers）中灵活估计异质性处理效应，并应用于伊利诺伊工作场所健康研究（Illinois Workplace Wellness Study）的一年随访结局。
Motivation: 在不依从的随机试验中，异质性同时来自处理效应本身和依从率的变异；现有灵活机器学习方法对弱工具变量问题敏感，且在不同随机种子下重复运行时常产生不稳定的异质性估计。
Method: 提出适用于二值响应和存在不依从情形的贝叶斯因果森林模型，核心手段是重复插补个体的依从类型（compliance types），从而灵活估计依从者中的异质性处理效应。

papers.title: Towards Stability of Parameter-Free Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter tuning, particularly the selection of an appropriate learning rate in adaptive gradient training methods, remains a challenge. To address this challenge, we propose a novel parameter-free optimizer, \textsc{AdamG} (Adam with the Golden step size), designed to automatically adapt to diverse optimization problems without task-specific learning-rate tuning. The core technique underlying \textsc{AdamG} is our golden step size derived for the AdaGrad-Norm algorithm, which is expected to help AdaGrad-Norm preserve tuning-free convergence and approximate the optimal step size in expectation across diverse optimization scenarios. To better evaluate tuning-free performance, we propose a novel evaluation criterion, \textit{reliability}, to comprehensively assess the efficacy of parameter-free optimizers in addition to classical performance criteria. Empirical results demonstrate that \textsc{AdamG} outperforms other parameter-free baselines and consistently performs on par with Adam using a manually tuned learning rate across various optimization tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 SIAM International Conference on Data Mining (SDM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自适应梯度优化方法中学习率选择困难的问题，提出无参数优化器 AdamG（Adam with the Golden step size），其核心是为 AdaGrad-Norm 推导出 golden step size，使优化器无需针对任务手动调节学习率。作者还提出名为 reliability 的新评估准则，用于综合衡量无参数优化器的效果。实验表明 AdamG 优于其他无参数基线，并在多种优化任务上与使用手动调参学习率的 Adam 表现相当。
Motivation: 超参数调优，尤其是自适应梯度训练方法中学习率的选取，仍然是优化实践中的主要挑战；现有无参数优化器在多样任务上的稳定性和评估方式尚不完善。
Method: 提出 AdamG 优化器，基于为 AdaGrad-Norm 算法推导的 golden step size，使步长在多种优化场景下无需调参即可接近最优期望值；同时提出 reliability 准则，在经典性能指标之外补充评估无参数优化器的稳定性。
Result: 摘要报告 AdamG 在多个优化任务上优于其他无参数优化基线，并与使用手动调节学习率的 Adam 表现相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的 golden step size 与 reliability 评估准则有助于推动无参数优化器的实用化，但摘要未讨论具体任务范围或局限性。

papers.title: More Data, Worse Decisions? Preference Reversals in Neural Networks under Gram Incompatibility
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks increasingly combine data across populations, time periods, and operating conditions to improve generalization. This raises a reliability question: whether a model refitted on pooled data preserves an action ordering supported by both sources. Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) formalizes this requirement through its composition axiom, which requires source-supported preferences to survive their union. We study when this property holds for fixed-representation neural networks with ordinary least squares (OLS) output heads. First, we show that pooled refitting recomputes the inverse-Gram geometry used to weight source evidence, which can reverse shared preferences, and derive exact and approximate preservation conditions. Next, we introduce a scale-invariant Gram mismatch measure for prioritizing candidate pools and geometry-oriented regularization for shaping source geometry during training. Finally, we develop a three-stage audit that traces strict pairwise reversals through decision changes to task-defined utility loss. Experiments spanning a load-based bidding proxy and medical and financial decision proxies reveal stable and reversal-prone pooling regimes: the load audit identifies a measurable nonzero class of source-consensus-relative harmful decisions under the proxy utility, while cross-domain audits show that comparable mismatch can correspond to sharply different preservation rates. Geometry-oriented objectives occupy distinct descriptive accuracy-consistency-geometry-harm operating points. Together, the framework makes compositional reliability measurable and operational through screening, analytic certification, geometry-oriented training, and decision-consequence auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在混合多个来源数据后重新拟合时，是否仍能保持各来源单独支持的行为排序。作者证明池化重拟合会重算用于加权源证据的逆 Gram 几何，从而可能逆转共享偏好，并据此提出保序条件、Gram 不匹配度量、几何导向正则化以及三阶段审计框架。实验覆盖负荷竞价代理以及医疗、金融决策代理，刻画了稳定与易反转的池化区间。
Motivation: 神经网络常通过跨总体、时间段和运行条件合并数据来提升泛化，但模型在合并数据上重新拟合后是否保持各来源支持的动作排序是一个可靠性问题；来源偏好可能被逆转并导致决策损害。
Method: 基于 Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) 的组合公理，推导精确与近似保序条件；引入尺度不变的 Gram 不匹配度量用于候选池优先级排序，提出几何导向正则化以在训练中塑造源几何；开发三阶段审计，将严格成对反转追踪到任务定义效用损失。
Result: 摘要报告存在稳定与易反转的池化区间：负荷审计在代理效用下识别出可测量的非零类源共识相对有害决策；跨域审计显示相近的不匹配度可对应显著不同的保序率；几何导向目标占据不同的描述准确性-一致性-几何-危害运行点。
Conclusion: 该框架通过筛选、分析式认证、几何导向训练和决策后果审计，使组合可靠性可度量且可操作；摘要未讨论明确局限性。

papers.title: Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工程设计中常见的小规模、低维数据集场景,指出传统 Transformer 因参数量过大容易过拟合,提出转向增加计算而非增加参数的方向。作者做了一项硬件感知的评估,比较三类递归 Transformer 范式——Tiny Recursive Model、作者提出的 Depth Recursive transformer 以及简单递归 Transformer——用于先进封装的热机械可靠性代理建模,并在两个低维工程预测任务上验证。总体结论是递归权重共享 Transformer 在小数据工程代理建模中能取得预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间的有效折衷。
Motivation: 工程设计中高质量仿真数据昂贵,数据集通常小而低维,而传统 Transformer 架构在这种场景下参数容量过剩,不仅导致过拟合,还带来不必要的内存和计算开销。
Method: 对三类递归 Transformer 范式进行硬件感知评估: Tiny Recursive Model、新提出的 Depth Recursive transformer,以及简单递归 Transformer;使用 Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank、参数量和 FLOPs 做系统比较。验证任务包括先进半导体封装的热机械可靠性分析(需在设计实验扫描中重复评估热循环下的应力和翘曲,伴随昂贵的有限元分析 FEA),以及面向电容场的 Laplace PDE 迭代数值求解器。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数字,但报告递归权重共享 Transformer 能提供预测精度、参数效率与计算成本之间有效且可泛化的折衷。
Conclusion: 作者为资源受限场景下选择递归 Transformer 架构提供了实用设计指南,并认为该方向适用于小数据工程代理建模。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do Context Files Help Coding Agents? A Two-Agent Ablation Study on Real Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding AI coding agents, yet evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory. We present a controlled ablation of context-injection strategy across two frontier agents (Claude Code and Codex), 17 real tasks from 3 repositories (15 shared + 2 Codex-only), and 288 evaluated runs with gold-test evaluation. Context strategy does not measurably move correctness on either agent (bounded to <=10-15pp via equivalence testing). A failure-mode triage reveals why: agents fail on implementation skill---feature design, pattern selection, exact wiring---not missing repository knowledge that a context file could supply; a manipulation probe confirms the real AGENTS.md never converts a near-miss to a pass on either agent. We further show that borderline task difficulty is agent-specific (Spearman rho=0.75), offering a candidate explanation for prior contradictions: single-agent studies draw tasks from different agents' informative bands. We release all code, data, and analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 这类持久上下文文件对 AI 编码智能体的实际效用展开受控双智能体消融研究。作者在 Claude Code 与 Codex 两个前沿智能体上，用 3 个真实仓库的 17 个任务（15 个共享 + 2 个 Codex 专属）共 288 次评估运行进行 gold-test 评测，结果发现上下文注入策略在任一智能体上都没有可测量的正确性提升（等价检验边界为 <=10-15pp）。失败模式分类显示智能体主要败在实现技能（如特征设计、模式选择、精确接线）而非缺失仓库知识，操作探测也确认真实 AGENTS.md 不会把 near-miss 变为通过。任务难度在智能体间具有特异性（Spearman rho=0.75），作者认为这解释了以往单智能体研究结论矛盾的现象，并公开了全部代码、数据与分析。
Motivation: 持久上下文文件是指导 AI 编码智能体的常见做法，但现有证据对其有效性相互矛盾；缺乏在真实仓库、多个前沿智能体上的受控消融来检验上下文注入策略的因果作用。
Method: 采用双智能体消融设计，在 Claude Code 和 Codex 上比较不同上下文注入策略，配合等价检验（equivalence testing）、失败模式分类以及一个操作探针（manipulation probe），并用 gold-test 统一评估 288 次运行。
Result: 上下文策略对任一智能体的正确性无可测量影响；真实 AGENTS.md 无法将 near-miss 案例转化为通过；任务难度跨智能体的排序相关性为 Spearman rho=0.75，说明边缘任务难度因智能体而异。
Conclusion: 作者认为先前结论矛盾的原因在于单智能体研究从不同智能体的信息有效区间（informative bands）选取任务，而智能体失败的主因是实现技能不足而非缺少可写入上下文文件的仓库知识；论文附带完整代码、数据与复现分析。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Divergence Decoding: Training-Free Capability Fusion
papers.abstract_en: While large language models excel in reasoning, these generalists often lack knowledge for specialized scientific domains. Conversely, domain models~(specialists), while knowledgeable, suffer from specialization side-effects including diminished logic and reduced robustness.To address this dilemma, we introduce Divergence Decoding, a training-free framework for capability fusion. It reconstructs the "draft-and-verify" skeleton of speculative decoding into an adaptive routing mechanism. The core is using Jensen-Shannon divergence to monitor the distributional disagreement between the two models at each token. When the specialist exhibits significant divergence, our method identifies it as a potential reasoning risk and instantaneously routes control to the generalist. This allows the dynamic injection of general reasoning while preserving domain expertise, achieving inference-time policy composition of the generalist and the specialist.We evaluate Divergence Decoding across diverse model families (Qwen and Llama series) on challenging scientific benchmarks (GPQA, ChemBench, and ChemCoTBench). Experimental results demonstrate that Divergence Decoding outperforms both the domain-specialized and general-purpose models, effectively surpassing the performance of most single-model baseline. This suggests that Divergence Decoding provides a general, training-free paradigm for fusing diverse LLM capabilities through adaptive inference-time collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Divergence Decoding，一种无需训练的能力融合框架，将投机解码（speculative decoding）的 draft-and-verify 骨架重构为自适应路由机制，用 Jensen-Shannon 散度监测通用模型与领域专家模型在每个 token 上的分布分歧，当专家出现显著分歧时即时切换控制到通用模型。在 GPQA、ChemBench、ChemCoTBench 等科学基准上的实验表明，该方法同时超过领域专家模型和通用模型，并优于大多数单模型基线。
Motivation: 通用大模型推理能力强但缺少专门科学领域知识，而领域专家模型虽有知识却存在逻辑减弱和鲁棒性下降等专业化副作用，需要一种无需训练、在推理期融合两种能力的方案。
Method: 将投机解码的 draft-and-verify 结构改造为自适应路由：以 Jensen-Shannon 散度逐 token 度量两个模型输出的分布分歧，一旦专家模型出现显著分歧就判定为推理风险，并即时将控制权交给通用模型，实现推理时策略组合。
Result: 在 Qwen 与 Llama 系列模型上，针对 GPQA、ChemBench 和 ChemCoTBench 等科学基准，Divergence Decoding 的性能优于领域专家模型和通用模型，超过大多数单模型基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法提供了一种通用、无需训练的能力融合范式，通过自适应的推理期协作融合不同 LLM 的能力。

papers.title: Enhancing Law-Enforcement Audio Transcription: A LoRA-Based Adaptation of Whisper for BWC Footage
papers.abstract_en: Modern policing faces a "visibility paradox" where law enforcement agencies possess petabytes of Body-Worn Camera (BWC) footage that remains largely unutilized for accountability or systemic review due to the prohibitive labor costs of manual transcription. This research presents a framework for adapting the OpenAI Whisper architecture to the unique acoustic and linguistic challenges of the policing environment. By employing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), we address the significant performance degradation observed in zero-shot models when confronted with high-stress scenarios, sirens, and radio interference. Crucially, we demonstrate that this adaptation is feasible on consumer-grade hardware (Acer Nitro local machine with NVIDIA 4GB GTX GPU) using 8-bit quantization and gradient checkpointing. We further integrate these transcriptions into a symbolic reasoning pipeline using a domain-specific ontology to transform raw audio into evidence-linked incident graphs, achieving a 93.7% lexicon mapping rate for the advancement of procedural justice and transparency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对执法记录仪 (Body-Worn Camera, BWC) 音频转写成本高昂的问题，提出用参数高效微调 (PEFT) 中的低秩适配 (LoRA) 来适配 OpenAI Whisper，以应对警用场景中的高压力语音、警报声和无线电干扰。作者在消费级硬件（Acer Nitro 笔记本，NVIDIA 4GB GTX GPU）上用 8-bit 量化与梯度检查点完成适配，并把转写结果接入基于领域本体的符号推理管线，生成证据关联的事件图。摘要报告词典映射率达到 93.7%，用于推进程序正义与透明度。
Motivation: 执法机构拥有 PB 级 BWC 视频，但人工转写成本极高，导致这些录像难以用于问责或系统性审查；同时零样本 (zero-shot) Whisper 在高压力场景、警报声和无线电干扰下性能明显下降。
Method: 采用 LoRA 实现参数高效微调，并结合 8-bit 量化与梯度检查点，使训练能在 4GB 显存的消费级 GPU 上完成；随后将转写文本输入到基于领域本体的符号推理管线，生成证据链接 (evidence-linked incident) 的图结构。
Result: 在警用音频转写与本体映射任务上实现 93.7% 的词典映射率，并证明了在消费级硬件上进行 LoRA 适配的可行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能在算力受限条件下完成 Whisper 的警用场景适配，并通过符号推理增强可解释性与透明度，服务于程序正义和系统性审查。

papers.title: Asymmetric Collapse in Model Merging: When Refusal Over- writes Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Model merging is often used to combine capabilities from separately fine-tuned models without additional training, but it is unclear whether standard merging methods preserve multiple safety-relevant behaviors simultaneously. We study this question through a controlled case study using two Gemma-3-1B-IT finetunes on two complementary safety objectives: CARES harm-level classification and WildJailbreak adversarial refusal. We merge the two fine-tunes using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and DARE-TIES, and evaluate the merged models on classification accuracy, attack resistance, and benign compliance. Across all four methods, attack resistance transfers significantly more than classification accuracy: merged models retain 81-85% jailbreak refusal rates while CARES accuracy falls to at most 12.9%. Weight-space measurements suggest that this asymmetry is not caused by strongly opposing task-vector directions: the two task vectors are nearly orthogonal (cosine similarity 0.011). Instead, the refusal fine-tune induces consistently larger per-layer task-vector magnitudes, causing magnitude-sensitive methods to favor refusal updates. These results show that standard model merging can collapse safety recognition into broad refusal when safety-relevant task vectors differ substantially in scale.
papers.comment: Accepted into COLM AIW, waiting decision for AdvML-Frontiers x CoTMA and HAIPS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控案例研究考察模型合并（model merging）能否同时保留多个与安全相关的行为。作者将两个 Gemma-3-1B-IT 微调模型分别用于 CARES 危害级别分类与 WildJailbreak 对抗性拒答两个互补的安全目标，并用 Linear、SLERP、TIES、DARE-TIES 四种方法合并。结果显示四种合并方法下攻击抵抗力显著迁移而分类精度大幅损失：合并模型保留 81-85% 的越狱拒答率，但 CARES 准确率最多只有 12.9%。权重空间分析表明两个任务向量几乎正交（余弦相似度 0.011），不对称性主要来自拒答微调在每层产生更大的任务向量幅度。
Motivation: 模型合并常用于在不进行额外训练的情况下组合多个微调模型的能力，但标准合并方法能否同时保留多种安全相关行为尚不清楚，这一缺口可能影响安全能力的可靠组合。
Method: 采用两个 Gemma-3-1B-IT 微调模型的受控案例，分别针对 CARES 危害级别分类和 WildJailbreak 对抗性拒答；使用 Linear、SLERP、TIES 和 DARE-TIES 四种合并方法，并在分类精度、攻击抵抗力和良性合规性上评估合并模型，同时测量任务向量的权重空间几何性质。
Result: 在所有四种合并方法中，攻击抵抗力的迁移都明显强于分类精度：合并模型的越狱拒答率保持在 81-85%，而 CARES 准确率降至最多 12.9%。两个任务向量近乎正交（余弦相似度 0.011），但拒答微调在每层诱导出更大的任务向量幅度，使得对幅度敏感的合并方法偏向拒答更新。
Conclusion: 当安全相关任务向量在规模上差异显著时，标准模型合并会把安全识别坍缩为宽泛拒答（broad refusal）；作者强调这种不对称性不是由任务向量方向强烈对立造成的，而是由幅度差异驱动的。

papers.title: RadHarmony: Radiological Data Handling in the Era of Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Training deep learning models on radiological images requires integrating heterogeneous datasets across different sources, file formats, directory layouts, label schemas, and annotation types. We present RadHarmony, an open-source Python library that provides a unified API for loading, harmonizing, and augmenting radiological datasets, with a primary focus on chest radiographs and early support for computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). RadHarmony standardizes metadata from 24 public datasets into a single tabular format, wraps MONAI's map-style datasets for deep-learning-ready sample delivery with optional on-disk caching, and supports classification labels, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and radiology report text through a single interface, with an interactive visualization tool for dataset exploration and verification. To lower the barrier for integrating new datasets, RadHarmony introduces an AI-agent skill that guides the full integration workflow from raw data inspection through code generation and testing. We demonstrate the library's utility by pretraining RadHarmony-ViT, a reference vision transformer baseline that combines three heterogeneous chest radiograph datasets with no dataset-specific code. The code and pretrained model weights are available at https://github.com/f10409/RadHarmony.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 RadHarmony，一个开源 Python 库，为放射学影像数据集提供统一的加载、协调（harmonization）和增强 API，主要支持胸部 X 光片，并早期支持 CT 和 MRI。该库将 24 个公共数据集标准化为单一表格格式，包装 MONAI 的 map-style 数据集并提供可选磁盘缓存，通过单一接口支持分类标签、分割掩膜、边界框和放射学报告文本，还附带交互式可视化工具和 AI 代理技能以简化新数据集的集成。作者通过预训练参考视觉 Transformer 基线 RadHarmony-ViT（组合三个异质胸部 X 光数据集，无需数据集特定代码）展示其实用性。
Motivation: 在放射学影像上训练深度学习模型需要整合来自不同来源、文件格式、目录布局、标签模式和注释类型的异质数据集，缺乏统一接口导致集成成本高、重复劳动多，阻碍研究可复现性。
Method: 提出 RadHarmony 库，提供统一 API 进行数据加载、协调和增强；将 24 个公共数据集的元数据标准化为单一表格形式，包装 MONAI 数据集以按需提供深度学习样本；设计一个支持多类标注（分类、分割、检测框、报告文本）的接口，并配备交互式可视化工具。此外，引入 AI 代理技能，指导从原始数据检查到代码生成与测试的完整集成流程。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标；其效用体现在预训练 RadHarmony-ViT 基线，该模型在无数据集特定代码的情况下整合三个异质胸部 X 光数据集，代码和预训练权重已公开。
Conclusion: 论文强调 RadHarmony 降低新放射学数据集集成门槛，并可作为该领域数据处理的通用基础设施；当前重点在胸部 X 光片，CT/MRI 为早期支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sympathetic Framing: Evaluating AI Alignment across Sociodemographic Groups
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly shaping how we consume information and form our worldview. This raises concerns beyond bias in AI: do LLMs grasp the emotional nuances conveyed via textual framing? In this work, we empirically evaluate how well an array of LLMs aligns with human emotional perception. Considering news headlines covering political and geopolitical conflicts, both human participants (n = 3011, a representative sample of the U.K. adult population, via a YouGov survey) and seven LLMs answered whether headlines evoked sympathy for a specified side in a conflict. We find that the correlation between AI and human evaluations varies across models, ranging from very high (0.789, GPT-5.2) to medium (0.4 ,Mistral Large 2512). Crucially, the leading models are broadly aligned with human judgments across all demographic subgroups, including age, gender, level of education, prior geopolitical knowledge, and participants' predispositions regarding the conflict, although there are statistically significant differences between groups. This research, with its robust design and large, demographically diverse dataset, offers the most comprehensive evaluation of LLMs' comprehension of news framing to date. Findings highlight an important, often-ignored aspect of differential alignment: even when aggregate performance is high, AI alignment is not universal -- it may correspond differently with demographic features and cultural norms. Considering or ignoring the need for differential alignment may therefore have significant implications for the development of ethical and useful AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过新闻标题中的情感框架（framing）检验大语言模型（LLM）是否与人类的情感感知对齐。研究者利用 YouGov 调查获取 3011 名具有代表性的英国成人样本，并让七个 LLM 判断标题是否对冲突中的特定一方引发同情。结果显示 AI 与人类评估的相关性因模型而异，从 GPT-5.2 的 0.789 到 Mistral Large 2512 的 0.4 不等；表现领先的模型在年龄、性别、教育水平、地缘政治知识和既有立场等人口统计子群体上与人类判断大体一致，但仍存在统计显著的组间差异。作者称这是迄今对 LLM 理解新闻框架最全面的评估。
Motivation: LLM 正日益影响信息消费和世界观形成，这引发超越简单偏见的担忧：模型能否把握文本框架所传达的情感细微差别。作者认为，即使聚合层面的对齐性能很高，AI 对齐也并非普遍成立，可能随人口统计特征和文化规范而有差异，因此需要评估这种差异化对齐（differential alignment）。
Method: 采用实证评估方法，选取政治和地缘政治冲突的新闻标题，让 3011 名英国成年人（YouGov 代表性样本）和七个 LLM 分别回答标题是否引发对冲突某一方的同情，然后计算人类与各模型评估分数之间的相关性。
Result: AI 与人类评估的相关性在不同模型间差异很大，最高为 GPT-5.2 的 0.789，最低为 Mistral Large 2512 的 0.4。领先模型在全部人口统计子群体上与人类判断大体对齐，但各群体之间存在统计显著差异。

papers.title: KernelGenBench: A Multi-Source and Multi-Chip Benchmark for LLM-based Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly increased the demand for efficient accelerator kernels, but kernel development remains a highly specialized and labor-intensive task. The recent rise of LLMs and agentic frameworks offers a promising pathway toward automatic kernel generation. However, despite rapid progress, there is still no comprehensive benchmark to rigorously evaluate LLM-generated kernels across diverse operator sources or heterogeneous hardware platforms. We present KernelGenBench, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM- and agent-generated Triton kernels across diverse operator sources and heterogeneous hardware platforms. It comprises two complementary sub-benchmarks: KernelGenBench-MS (Multi-Source), evaluating 210 operators from three sources beyond standard PyTorch-centric tasks, and KernelGenBench-MC (Multi-Chip), measuring performance portability across six heterogeneous hardware platforms using a 110-operator subset. Our large-scale evaluation, consuming over 15 billion tokens, shows: (1) agent-based methods consistently outperform pure LLM sampling methods, while cuBLAS operators are the most challenging across all methods; (2) generation performance varies significantly across hardware platforms, with even recent kernel-specialized agents experiencing severe cross-platform degradation (e.g., AutoKernel drops from 87% on NVIDIA to 25% on Platform E); (3) autonomous kernel generation remains highly cost-intensive, with specialized agent methods averaging 5.11 million tokens per successful operator (AKO4all reaches 5.19 million), orders of magnitude higher than simple LLM sampling approaches.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/flagos-ai/KernelGenBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KernelGenBench，一个用于系统评估 LLM 与智能体 (agent) 生成的 Triton kernel 的统一基准，涵盖多样算子来源与异构硬件平台。基准包含 KernelGenBench-MS（210 个算子、三个来源）与 KernelGenBench-MC（110 个算子的子集、六个硬件平台）两个子基准。基于超 150 亿 token 的大规模评测，摘要报告智能体方法一致优于纯 LLM 采样、跨平台性能显著波动，且自主 kernel 生成仍高度消耗 token。
Motivation: kernel 开发高度专业化且劳动密集，LLM 与 agentic 框架为自动生成 kernel 提供了可能，但目前缺乏一个能跨多样算子来源和异构硬件平台严格评估 LLM 生成 kernel 的综合基准。
Method: 构建统一基准 KernelGenBench，包含两个互补子基准：KernelGenBench-MS 从标准 PyTorch 任务之外评估三个来源的 210 个算子，KernelGenBench-MC 使用 110 个算子的子集在六个异构硬件平台上测量性能可移植性 (performance portability)。作者开展了消耗超过 150 亿 token 的大规模评测。
Result: 评测显示：(1) 基于智能体的方法一致优于纯 LLM 采样方法，而 cuBLAS 算子对所有方法最具挑战性；(2) 生成性能在不同硬件平台上差异显著，近期 kernel 专用智能体也出现严重跨平台退化，例如 AutoKernel 从 NVIDIA 上的 87% 降至 Platform E 上的 25%；(3) 自主 kernel 生成仍高度耗费 token，专用智能体方法平均每个成功算子需 511 万 token（AKO4all 达 519 万），比简单 LLM 采样方法高出数个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要一个统一基准来严格评估跨算子来源和异构硬件的 LLM 生成 kernel，并指出当前自主 kernel 生成的 token 成本极高、跨平台可移植性仍是明显短板。

papers.title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Transformers propagate information across depth through a single additive residual stream: every sublayer reads only the most recent state. Attention residuals relax this by letting each sublayer attend, through a learned softmax. However, that read uses a single query shared across the entire width, so every feature subspace must read the depth history through one distribution. The cost of this forced compromise grows with how much the subspaces disagree about which layers to read, and disagreement grows with model width. We introduce Multi-Head Attention Residuals (MHAR): the routing query is reshaped into H per-subspace heads, each with its own softmax over the depth history. The read becomes block-diagonal, the reshape adds zero parameters and negligible compute, and H = 1 recovers attention residuals exactly. Trained from scratch on a deduplicated Nemotron-based anneal corpus that is quality-filtered and STEM- and code-heavy, MHAR improves validation loss over a standard Transformer at 100M, 350M, and 1B (-0.061, -0.149, and -0.140). It achieves the best result among four methods in every setting, with the gain increasing from 100M to the larger scales. The head count is a real design axis rather than a free knob: validation loss is U-shaped with respect to H, with a flat optimum at H = 4 or H = 8 across scales. We adopt H = 8 for large-scale models; over-splitting beyond this point (H = 16) consistently gives back part of the gain. A direct probe of the trained queries confirms that learned subspace disagreement is the underlying driver. Fused Triton routing kernels increase attention-residual training throughput from 0.2-0.5x to 0.55-0.88x of the baseline while maintaining near-baseline peak memory. An identity-preserving conversion using delta attention residuals supports 8B mid-training, yielding improvements of +3.2 on GSM8K and +3.1 on GPQA.

papers.title: AI-assisted pre-review of open-source software submissions: an experience report from BOSC 2026
papers.abstract_en: Most conferences rely on peer-review of submissions, but as generative AI makes it easier than ever to prepare submission materials, some conferences are seeing an overwhelming surge of submissions. We wanted to see if generative AI could help our conference's volunteer reviewers by pre-reviewing abstracts for certain criteria. The Bioinformatics Open Source Conference (BOSC) was well-positioned to experiment with this, as we already had a detailed rubric used by reviewers to evaluate submitted abstracts on multiple criteria, including openness (public availability of the code or other content associated with the project), valid open source license, and "runnability" (how easy it is to download, build, and run the project - an important measure of reusability). For BOSC 2026, we built bosc-pre-review, an agentic skill that assessed six review criteria, and Runabilly, which builds and tests each project in a disposable Docker container for safety. The AI only gathered evidence to present to the reviewers; humans made every decision regarding the acceptance of the abstracts. After the review period, we surveyed the reviewers to determine how useful they found the pre-review. Most of those who responded said they found it useful, but they preferred to check the AI's conclusions against their own, rather than accepting the AI results unquestioningly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告 BOSC 2026 使用生成式 AI 对开源软件投稿摘要进行预评审的实践经验。作者构建 bosc-pre-review agentic skill 评估六项评审标准，并用 Runabilly 在一次性 Docker 容器中构建和测试项目以收集可运行性证据。评审后调查显示多数评审者认为预评审有用，但仍倾向于人工核对 AI 结论而不是直接接受。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 使投稿材料制备更容易，导致会议投稿量激增，志愿者评审负担加重；作者想验证生成式 AI 能否按既有评审 rubric 预先评估摘要的部分标准。
Method: 构建 bosc-pre-review，一个 agentic skill，用于评估六个评审标准；并实现 Runabilly，在一次性 Docker 容器中构建并测试每个项目以收集证据。AI 只负责汇总证据提交给评审者，所有接收决定由人做出。
Result: 评审期后的调查中，大多数回复的评审者认为预评审有用，但更倾向于将 AI 结论与自己判断对照，而非不加质疑地接受 AI 结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 预评审可作为辅助手段减轻评审负担，但人类评审者的最终判断仍是必需；该经验来自 BOSC 2026 的特定评审流程。

papers.title: Psych-ECA: A Reproducible Semi-Synthetic Benchmark for Synthetic Control Arms in Longitudinal Psychiatry
papers.abstract_en: External and synthetic control arms (ECAs) are entering psychiatric drug development, but the field lacks a benchmark that evaluates the properties regulators care about: not only how accurately a method reconstructs untreated trajectories, but whether its uncertainty is calibrated, whether it is robust to the informative observation times common in mental-health records (sicker patients are seen more often), and what false-positive rate it induces in go/no-go trial decisions. Real psychiatric trial data (e.g. STAR-D and registry cohorts) require credentialed access and lack ground-truth counterfactuals, so, following established semi-synthetic benchmarks in causal inference (IHDP, ACIC, and the PK-PD tumor-growth simulator), we release Psych-ECA, a fully reproducible generator of longitudinal symptom trajectories for depression (PHQ-9), anxiety (HAM-A), and psychosis (PANSS) with known counterfactual control arms, informative visits, and validated-scale measurement noise. We benchmark eight estimators spanning carry-forward, pooled real-world-data averages, nearest-neighbour matching, linear mixed models, gradient boosting, and the Scribe trajectory-bridge method. Three findings emerge. First, trajectory and flexible machine learning methods achieve the best counterfactual accuracy (about 2.3 PHQ-9 RMSE), outperforming cross-sectional baselines. Second, only Scribe is both accurate and calibrated, achieving 93-96% empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals, compared with 87-88% for gradient boosting and 62-75% for uncalibrated SDE models. Third, inverse-intensity correction reduces bias under informative sampling, while Scribe's calibrated intervals are the only trajectory method that maintains nominal false-positive rates as informativeness increases. We release all code, data-generation scripts, and random seeds to enable fully reproducible evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布 Psych-ECA，一个可完全复现的半合成基准，用于评估精神科药物研发中的合成对照臂 (synthetic control arms)。它生成抑郁 (PHQ-9)、焦虑 (HAM-A) 和精神病 (PANSS) 的纵向症状轨迹，并带有已知反事实对照臂、信息性访视和验证过的量表测量噪声；作者对八种估计器进行了基准测试，报告了轨迹类与灵活机器学习方法在反事实精度上的优势，并指出只有 Scribe 方法同时满足准确性和校准性。
Motivation: 外部与合成对照臂正在进入精神科药物开发，但该领域缺少一个能评估监管方关注属性的基准——不仅要看重构未治疗轨迹的准确度，还要看不确定性是否校准、是否对精神健康记录中常见的信息性观测时间 (病情更重者就诊更频繁) 鲁棒，以及给 go/no-go 决策带来的假阳性率。真实精神科试验数据 (如 STAR-D 和注册队列) 需要凭据访问且缺乏真实反事实，因此需要半合成基准。
Method: 提出 Psych-ECA：一个完全可复现的纵向症状轨迹生成器，支持抑郁、焦虑、精神病三类量表，内置已知反事实对照臂、信息性访视和经过验证的量表测量噪声。随后对八种估计器进行基准测试，包括 carry-forward、汇集真实世界数据均值、最近邻匹配、线性混合模型、梯度提升和 Scribe 轨迹桥接方法。
Result: 摘要报告三个主要发现：轨迹类与灵活机器学习方法达到最佳反事实精度 (约 2.3 的 PHQ-9 RMSE)，优于横截面基线；只有 Scribe 同时准确且校准，对名义 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖率是 93-96%，而梯度提升是 87-88%，未校准 SDE 模型只有 62-75%；逆强度校正 (inverse-intensity correction) 在信息性采样下降低偏差，且 Scribe 的校准区间是唯一在信息性增强时仍维持名义假阳性率的轨迹方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，面向监管关注属性的半合成基准表明轨迹方法与校准不确定性在精神科合成对照臂中的重要性，并发布全部代码、数据生成脚本和随机种子以支持完全可复现的评估。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 Psych-ECA：一个完全可复现的纵向症状轨迹生成器，支持抑郁、焦虑、精神病三类量表，内置已知反事实对照臂、信息性访视和经过验证的量表测量噪声。随后对八种估计器进行基准测试，包括 carry-forward、汇集真实世界数据均值、最近邻匹配、线性混合模型、梯度提升和 Scribe 轨迹桥接方法。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告三个主要发现：轨迹类与灵活机器学习方法达到最佳反事实精度 (约 2.3 的 PHQ-9 RMSE)，优于横截面基线；只有 Scribe 同时准确且校准，对名义 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖率是 93-96%，而梯度提升是 87-88%，未校准 SDE 模型只有 62-75%；逆强度校正 (inverse-intensity correction) 在信息性采样下降低偏差，且 Scribe 的校准区间是唯一在信息性增强时仍维持名义假阳性率的轨迹方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，面向监管关注属性的半合成基准表明轨迹方法与校准不确定性在精神科合成对照臂中的重要性，并发布全部代码、数据生成脚本和随机种子以支持完全可复现的评估。

papers.title: Foundation-Model Earth Representations Enable Regional-Scale Forest Aboveground Biomass Monitoring Across the Northeastern United States
papers.abstract_en: Forest aboveground biomass (AGB) is a critical indicator of ecosystem productivity and terrestrial carbon storage, yet regional carbon monitoring remains constrained by the sparse spatial and temporal availability of field inventories and airborne structural measurements. Recent Earth observation foundation models provide globally consistent geospatial representations derived from diverse multimodal datasets, offering a potential pathway toward scalable biomass monitoring. Here, we evaluate Google Satellite Embeddings (GSE), generated by the AplphaEarth Foundation Model, for regional-scale AGB estimation across diverse temperate forest ecosystems in the northeastern United States. We integrated annual GSE observations, airborne LiDAR, and continuous forest inventory measurements from the Northeastern Forest Inventory Network (NEFIN) within a machine-learning framework. Combined LiDAR-GSE models achieved an R^2 of 0.79 for AGB estimation. Capitalizing on annual GSE observations expanded the training dataset by more than tenfold through temporal growth adjustment, increasing predictive performance to R^2 = 0.82 while reducing model bias by over 70%. Spatial autocorrelation analyses showed that integrating foundation-model representations and structural predictors substantially reduced residual spatial dependence. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrated that hyperparameter optimization reduced model-performance variability by 27.9%. Our findings demonstrate that foundation-model Earth representations capture ecologically meaningful information relevant to forest biomass and provide a scalable framework for annual carbon monitoring in regions with incomplete airborne LiDAR coverage. Our fundings establish a pathway toward next-generation forest carbon assessment based on globally available foundation-model Earth observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 Google Satellite Embeddings (GSE) 等地球观测基础模型在区域尺度森林地上生物量 (AGB) 估测中的能力，结合机载 LiDAR 和连续森林清查数据，在美国东北部建立机器学习框架。利用年度 GSE 观测通过时间增长调整将训练数据扩展十倍以上，最终 R² 达到 0.82，模型偏差降低超 70%，并显示基础模型表征可减少残差空间自相关。作者认为这为缺乏 LiDAR 覆盖的区域提供了可扩展的年际碳监测途径。
Motivation: 区域碳监测受限于野外清查和机载结构测量的时空覆盖稀疏，难以支撑大规模、可重复的森林生物量监测，需要更可扩展的数据与建模途径。
Method: 将年度 GSE 基础模型表征、机载 LiDAR 和 NEFIN 连续森林清查数据集成到机器学习框架中进行 AGB 估测；利用年度 GSE 观测做时间增长调整以扩充训练集，并结合空间自相关分析与蒙特卡洛模拟进行超参数优化评估。
Result: LiDAR-GSE 组合模型实现 R²=0.79；时间增长调整使训练集扩大十倍以上，R² 提升至 0.82，模型偏差降低超 70%；超参数优化将模型性能变异性降低 27.9%，残差空间依赖显著减小。
Conclusion: 基础模型地球表征能捕捉与森林生物量相关的生态信息，为 LiDAR 覆盖不完整的地区提供可扩展的年碳监测框架，并指向基于全球可用基础模型观测的下一代森林碳评估。

papers.title: Estimating Treatment Effects for Depression in Longitudinal Therapy Switching Settings
papers.abstract_en: Depression treatment often requires switching medications due to inadequate response or adverse effects. Estimating individualized treatment effects in this setting is challenging because treatment assignment is confounded by patient characteristics, switching induces time-varying selection, and counterfactual outcomes are not observed in follow-up data. Using a proprietary longitudinal major depressive disorder (MDD) clinical trial dataset, we formulate a next-visit counterfactual prediction task to estimate Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD-17) total scores under alternative treatments. We benchmark 8 estimators, including meta-learners, residual-based methods, and tree-based approaches. Causal Forest (CF) demonstrates the most favorable and consistent performance across all criteria. Our analysis shows that symptom benefits concentrate in specific switch directions, with dose intensification being generally beneficial. Notably, we identify a counterintuitive exception where a lower-intensity regimen outperforms a higher-intensity alternative for specific patient subsets. While crude observational comparisons substantially overstate gains, confounding-adjusted estimates yield modest, actionable magnitudes. These findings provide prospectively testable candidates for clinical decision support in depression care.
papers.comment: Accepted as an Oral Presentation at the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference (EMBC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用专有的纵向重度抑郁障碍（MDD）临床试验数据，构建下一次就诊的反事实预测任务，估计替代治疗方案下的 Hamilton Depression Rating Scale（HAMD-17）总分。作者基准测试了元学习器、残差方法和树方法等 8 种估计器，Causal Forest（CF）在各项标准下表现最稳定。分析显示症状获益集中在特定换药方向，剂量强化通常有益，但也存在特定患者子集中低强度方案优于高强度方案的例外。粗略的观察性比较会严重高估获益，而混淆调整后的效应量适中且具有可操作性。
Motivation: 抑郁治疗常因应答不足或不良反应需要换药，但该场景下估计个体化治疗效果面临多重挑战：治疗分配受患者特征混淆、换药引入时变选择（time-varying selection），且随访数据中观测不到反事实结局。
Method: 作者将问题形式化为下一次就诊的反事实预测任务，使用专有的纵向 MDD 临床试验数据集，并基准测试 8 种估计器，包括 meta-learners、基于残差的方法和基于树的方法，以估计 HAMD-17 总分。
Result: Causal Forest（CF）在所有评估标准上表现最有利且一致；症状获益集中于特定换药方向，剂量强化总体上有益，但特定患者子集中低强度方案反而优于高强度方案；未调整的观察比较大幅高估获益，经混淆调整后效应量变为适中且可操作。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些发现为抑郁诊疗的临床决策支持提供了可供前瞻性检验的候选结论。

papers.title: Prompt Chaining in Practice: A Case Study in Automated Scholarly Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: The exponential growth of scholarly publications requires automated tools for effective information synthesis. However, simple, single-shot prompting methods often lack the reliability and quality required for complex synthesis tasks. This paper introduces and empirically evaluates a multi-stage prompt chaining methodology as a more reliable architectural pattern for such tasks. This approach is implemented in our system, AI SciBrief, which automatically generates scholarly digests. We conducted a comparative experiment, measuring the performance of our prompt chaining method against a carefully optimized single-shot baseline. Both systems were evaluated against a human-authored "gold standard" report for the "Education" domain. The results demonstrate a significant difference in reliability: our prompt chaining method achieved a 100% success rate, whereas the optimized baseline failed in 50% of its runs. In terms of quality, the proposed method also demonstrated a clear advantage, achieving a superior ROUGE-L F1-score (0.507 vs. 0.486), driven primarily by higher precision. We conclude that prompt chaining is a more dependable and effective engineering approach for complex, multi-step generative tasks, significantly mitigating the risks of failure and inconsistency inherent in monolithic prompts.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并实证评估了一种多阶段提示链 (prompt chaining) 方法，用于自动化生成学术文献摘要报告，并将其实现于系统 AI SciBrief。在 “Education” 领域的对比实验中，该方法达到100%成功率，而经过优化的单次提示 (single-shot) 基线在50%的运行中失败；质量上提示链的 ROUGE-L F1 为0.507，优于基线的0.486，优势主要来自更高的精确率。
Motivation: 学术出版物数量快速增长，需要自动化工具进行有效的信息综合；然而简单的单次提示方法在复杂综合任务上缺乏所需的可靠性和质量。
Method: 引入多阶段提示链方法论，作为复杂生成任务中更可靠的架构模式，并在 AI SciBrief 系统中实现；通过与精心优化的单次提示基线对比，并以人工撰写的 “gold standard” 报告为参照进行评测。
Result: 提示链方法在成功率上显著优于基线，达到100%，而优化基线有一半运行失败；ROUGE-L F1 上提示链为0.507 vs 基线的0.486，主要提升来自更高的精确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为提示链是复杂多步生成任务中更可靠、有效的工程方法，能够显著缓解单体提示 (monolithic prompts) 固有的失败和不一致风险。

papers.title: Reviewer Scores Are Not Comparable Across Research Areas in ML Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: Peer review at ML conferences increasingly relies on reviewer scores as the primary decision instrument. As submissions have scaled from thousands to tens of thousands per year, no systematic audit has examined whether this instrument functions uniformly across research areas, or whether acceptance outcomes are in practice shaped by forces that reviewer scores neither capture nor control. This position paper argues that acceptance outcomes are shaped by forces beyond reviewer scores, and that the underlying cause is a measurement design failure, not individual bias. When a fixed numerical scale aggregates quality judgments across communities with structurally non-uniform reviewer pools, absolute scores become incomparable across areas, and area chairs must substitute community priors for score-based decisions. Using ICLR 2021--2026 data covering 50,289 papers across 219 research topics, we show that at any given reviewer score, a paper's acceptance probability varies by up to 8x depending on its topic. We rule out scoring culture, expert reviewer standards, rational area chair reweighting, and quality dilution as alternative explanations. We call on program committees to adopt inherently calibrated review signals and publish topic-stratified, score-conditional acceptance rates as a first-class fairness metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，论证 ML 会议同行评审中不同研究领域的评审分数不可比较，接受结果受评审分数之外的因素塑造，根本原因是测量设计失败而非个体偏差。基于 ICLR 2021-2026 的 50,289 篇论文和 219 个研究主题数据，作者发现同一评审分数下论文接受概率随主题不同最多相差 8 倍，并排除了评分文化、专家标准、领域主席理性重新加权和质量稀释等替代解释。作者呼吁项目委员会采用内在校准的评审信号，并将按主题分层的分数条件接受率作为首要公平性指标。
Motivation: ML 会议同行评审越来越依赖评审分数作为主要决策工具，投稿量从数千增至数万，但缺乏系统性审计来检验这一工具是否在不同研究领域间一致运作，或者接受结果是否被评审分数既未捕捉也无法控制的力量所塑造。
Method: 使用 ICLR 2021-2026 的 50,289 篇论文和 219 个研究主题数据，分析给定评审分数下不同主题的接受概率差异，并通过检验评分文化、专家评审标准、领域主席理性重新加权和质量稀释等替代解释来支撑其论证。
Result: 摘要报告，在任意给定的评审分数下，论文的接受概率随其主题不同最多变化 8 倍；作者声称这些差异无法用上述四种替代解释说明。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁项目委员会采用内在校准 (inherently calibrated) 的评审信号，并发布按主题分层的、分数条件的接受率 (topic-stratified, score-conditional acceptance rates) 作为一等公平性指标。
